comments: Fernanda and Pedro’s house is with no doubt, the best place i’ve ever stayed with airbnb. The flat is super well decorated, kitchen is perfectly equiped, bathroon is renewed and confortable. Nothing to say but 3 thumbs up!

Fernanda’s place is just as it looks, and feels even better once you arrive. Everything was sparkling clean and so stilish! But the best were the small details and Fernanda’s hospitality. Follow her recommendations and you’ll definitely have a great time in Porto. Highly recommended!!!

Fernanda´s apartment is beautiful! Clean, nicely furnished, comfortable bed, nice kitchen and a great bathroom. Great location, there is everything you need and more. We had a wonderful time in Porto, thank you Pedro and Fernanda!

The apartment was perfect, well decorated and cosy. Fernanda was very friendly and made everything easy for us !
And the city center is only a five-minute walk away !

This was definitely one of the best airbnb experience I had. Apartment is perfectly clean and well equipped everything you need. It’s also very close to the city centre (10-15 min. by walk).
Fernanda is super friendly host, providing me with good tip about Porto. I had a really wonderful stay in Porto thanks to her, and want to recommend this apartment to everyone. I would stay again for sure!

Fernanda is a kind host. She let us checkin earlier even she was tidying up the place. The apartment is so cozy and stylish. We appreciate the simple map prepared by Nanda and the advices on the restaurants around. Highly recommended.
Lovely space, very clean and very very good host. Walking distance to bars and restaurants in Ribeira. Busy location not affected by noise etc.

We had a lovely time in Porto and Nanda’s apartment was perfectly located and allowed us to easily visit all of the places we wanted. The apartment was well equipped and clean and the map Nanda provided highlighting restaurants and cafés to visit was priceless.
We highly recommend Nanda’s apartment for a pleasant and convenient stay in Porto.

I had one of my best Airbnb experiences in Fernanda's apartment. I stayed for almost two months and enjoyed the apartment itself and the neighborhood very much. It's a clean, modern and a very functional one-bedroom apartment with everything one needs for a long stay. The kitchen was fully equipped and the bathroom was supplied with everything needed for weeks to come. The neighborhood was very walkable with a variety of shops and restaurants. The bed was also very comfortable. Fernanda was always responsive and gave me a refund when I had to leave a little early due to a family emergency. I highly recommend this apartment.

Lovely apartment—well located, clean, updated bathroom. Everything you need and more. Fernanda took care of a few glitches immediately, and was very kind and helpful overall. She loves her city, amd provided information (many books and pamphlets for newcomers). Highly recommended!
Apartment has everything you need. It is spacious yet very homely. 10 min walk onto the city. Lots of bars and restaraunts and boutique shops.

Fernanda’s place was incredibly clean, comfortable, quiet, and stylish. The location has everything you need, and you are within walking distance from so many great bars, restaurants, and the famous Luis 1 bridge! Her guidebook was incredible! I highly recommend anyone to stay at Fernanda’s and will come back to next time when in Porto.

a perfect place, especially for a longer stay. full equipped in kitchen and bathroom and bedroom.
located in porto‘s best quarter to live, you should know that it‘s not completely quiet - but the neighborhood is beautiful.
high recommandation for a longer stay in porto. thanks to fernanda.

This is a fantastic apartment and a great base from which to explore Porto. It‘s one of the cleanest and best designed Airbnb places we have stayed in - definitely the best equipped. Everything you could need in a short or long term stay is there, kitchen tools even for more advanced cooking, enough storage space … Location is also excellent - in walking distance to most of the main sights, but in a slightly less touristy, more down to earth area of the city. Some useful bus lines stop directly in front of the apartment, metro and the train station are in walking distance. Communication with Fernanda has been very good and helpful as well. We would definitely come back here next time we are in Porto.

We stayed for 4 weeks at Fernandas working remotely and we loved it! Perfect location outside of the madness of downtown but still walkable everywhere. Grocery stores really close by and the kitchen was well equipped. Washing machine and dishwasher in the apartment were key. Best bakery in town right next door (dangerous and delicious). Would stay again!
The apartment is within walking distance to the city centre and getting an Uber was easy and affordable. The grocery store is just round the corner. Overall, I had a great short stay there.

Pedro’s apartment is very modern and well equipped - lovely bathroom, good kitchen and double glazed, so very quiet at night. We were met by Maria who welcomed us and showed us around. It’s about a 20 minute walk to downtown or just a couple of stops on the metro - we preferred the walk both ways (to walk off all the pastries we were eating!) . There is a good bakery/ coffee shop right downstairs too. Highly recommend this apartment

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this incredible Airbnb with my friends, and I cannot say enough good things about it! The communication with the host was excellent. Pedro was incredibly responsive and helpful, providing all the necessary informations. The location was perfect too, offering both convenience and serenity. I couldn't have asked for a better experience. Highly recommended!

I've had a excellent 15-night stay at Pedro's place. Very comfy bed, I really appreciated the external curtains that can give perfect blackness at night :) A/C works perfectly, even at higher temperatures. I'd be very happy to stay there again.

The apartment is very nice, very well situated. You can find everything nearby like laundry, groceries stores, bakery store and more things.
The bus stop is in front of the main door.
Pedro and the team were really nice and attentive. They responded quickly. In general we enjoyed our stay. We surely come back soon :)

A lovely home with a lovely host on a lovely location. The view and large garden are amazing, the house is really cosy and clean. The owner's dog was walking around, giving us a great welcome after every time we came back (even when we were only gone for a few minutes to get something from the minimercado from around the corner), which was a really nice addition to our holidays.
Beautiful and wonderfully thought out property. Gorgeous pool and we loved the place as a whole - meeting the resident animals! Ideal for a quiet get away, beautiful walking all around the area.

The house is beautiful, the bed and the pillows were very comfortable. Very clean and quiet place but! The internet was shit and the connection inacceptable!!! There were problems some times with the water and the dishwasher seems not to work very well. There were lot of flies and mosquitoes. We were not really happy with the place.

The house is super, clean , new, with fresh flower on the table and batroom, is fully equiped for eat: they offer salt, oil, vineagre, tea, coffe, sugar, oven ecc..Is a real host, always present for any question. They tell you where to go for good dinner, breakfast , train, what visit. The beach at100m .Caterina and her family are really kind and polite.The house is really like the pictures..one of best ever.Many thanks. Our 2 children enjoi the private garden and their bedroom.It's 25 minut by train to Porto and we left the car in their parking , and spent one night in Porto. Train station is 400m from the  hause.super
Very cozy and lovely place to stay. Emilia was very kind, she gave us cookies and bread, that was so lovely :) The hose is very small, but clean, nice and very new.

Don’t hesitate, the most beautiful house in a perfect location. We adored our stay and our only regret was not booking for longer.
The river beach is gorgeous, the suspension bridge awesome and make sure you go to the abandoned village.

Beautiful schist village, situated right above the river. The house was cozy and well outfitted. Very quiet and peaceful in the winter. Isabel sent us great recommendations, and was always responsive. It is a little remote, but you are a 15 minute drive to the beautiful village of Alvarenga, where you can get all of your supplies. Very close to the suspension bridge as well. Beautiful area for hiking and relaxation.

The apartment was in a great place. The view from the terrace was really cool and everything we'd look for was close and nearby.

We expected a wireless internet connection but it wasn't compatible with our tablet because it was offered via a USB stick with 3G connectivity. There's a FON spot available but we had to pay for that.

Everything was clean and tidy!

Gundega and Antonio were great hosts. They met us upon our arrival gave us a walk through the flat and tips where to eat and shop. The walk from station was short to the flat. The flat had everything you needed. The only problem with the flat was the water pressure there was none. We were told about it up front and it is a city problem. So if you like a good shower this is not the place for you.

Great apartment in a great location (especially if you are arriving by train into Campanha), lovely big terrace to sit in the sun. The apartment itself was well laid out for a couple, we stayed for 6 nights, and the kitchen and living area etc were perfect for us. Gundega and her partner were amazing hosts, letting us know many great places to eat and hang out, even taking us out one day for an amazing lunch in one of their favourite restaurants. We had a great time here.

Very nice flat with a big Terrace,
Location is very good, quiet and convenient,
Gundega is super nice and helpful
Thanks so much!

Gundega and Antonio were excellent hosts - Antonio picked us up from the airport and chatted with us about the city in general, then when we arrived at the apartment pulled out a map and showed us where to go, what to see, etc. from a local's point of view. Even with the busy life that a baby brings, they were available by phone for any questions and concerns, and even called us a cab to the airport to go home. Great people and great place, strongly recommended!

Gundega and her husband are great hosts! They provide you with very useful tips fro your time in Porto. The appartment is beautiful, especially the terasse, with a wonderful view over the roofs of Porto. Good place to be.

Great apartment - for me it is located in one of the really authentic neighbourhoods of Porto which means it's surrounded by great cheap eating places, you can walk to more or less anywhere and the actual building is actually lived in by residents of the city, rather than a stream of travellers (apart from you of course!).

The apartment is absolutely terrific, it's very comfortable and in excellent condition. It's located within easy walking distance from the city centre and all the attractions Porto has to offer. And Gundega was very helpful in explaining what's worth seeing and visiting: and there's enough there for several week-end trips. We will be back!
Very nice apartment, ideally situated, well furnished and a superb terrace . Antonio and Gundega were very kind and helpful to help us find our way in Porto. A place to recommend.

Me and my girlfriend enjoyed our stay in this cozy appartment. The highlight is for sure the terrace and it is exactly how you can see it on the photos. We sat there in the evenings and enjoyed the atmosphere. Also for having breakfast outside it must be very nice. Moreover, the location of the appartment is good and you can reach most of the things easily by walking. There is a supermarket near by and also a nice café directly next to the entrance of the building.
On our arrival we met Antonio. Gundega was out of town at this time. He gave us a short introduction to the appartment and a lot of advices for Porto. As we stayed only two days his advices were very helpful for making most out of our time.
Thank you again for your hospitality, we felt very welcomed.
Wonderful place close to the center of the city. We really appreciated the tips Antonio gave us upon arrival and their help during the trip. The apartment is comfortable and the terrace unbeatable!
This is a really nice appartment in Porto especially the big, private terrace. The host is friendly and fast at communicating. Cosy neighbourhood.

Gundega and Antonio are super host. They showed us around their home, where to go, what are the amazing things to do, which is the best restaurant around the neighborhood.
Their home is true to pic and feels like home away from home.
We love everything about Porto... The weather, people, atmosphere, scenery... Too much to mention....
Come stay in their lovely home in this amazing city.
If you drive, I'd recommend you to park in the 24hr carpark which is not overly expensive. It cost around 9.80 euro a day (if I recall correctly).
Once again, thank you for hosting us and come visit Singapore soon!

Second time staying at Gundega' and Antonio' flats. Flat is cozy and the location is amazing. We loved the balcony. Separate thanks to hospitality: Gundega and Antonio met us and told the best places, life hacks and answered questions. They are very open to help and make your stay in Porto comfortable.

Gundega is very friendly and schedules to meet her guests in the apartment. She shares great tips on what to do in Porto! Her outdoor patio is a highlight (we really enjoyed having a few meals there!) the apartment is very well located within walking distance to the main attractions in the city.

Great place to call home while in Porto! The owners are so welcoming and VERY informative!
Excellent value for your dollar and the restaurant right below called Kinay was wonderful and inexpensive too.
Walking or bus access to anywhere you wish to go.
Only 5 minutes walk to Redi express bus line that can take you to Lisbon etc.
The flat is  nice and very well located, sunny terrace greatly appreciated. The host are very helpful and give very good advices to have a nice stay in Porto.

Antonio was most helpful on check in. Lots of good recommendations. Bike ride to Chapel in the Sea a must do then Portuguese style fish meal on the way back. Nice to sit on the largish balcony for breakfast and sunset We packed lots into our 2 days and lots of walking. Apartment had everything we needed and was close to everything. Fernicular a must for getting back up the hill!
The flat is lovely and a brilliant Base from which to explore Porto. Cannot recommend more highly and Gundega and Antonio are fantastic.
A great place to stay in Porto. Antonio and Gundega were very helpful and sweet. They gave us so many tips. Wish we could've stayed longer!

This is a very tiny apartment in a lovely neighbourbood. Book here in spring, summer or autumn when you can count on the use of the huge terrace, which is almost as big as the whole apartment. The hosts are great.

Great place, well located. In a private building With elevator. Amazing and spacious terrasse with lots of furnitures to chill (sofa, chairs, tables, long chairs...). Gundega is also a great host who will spend time with you at check-in to give you details on places to visit. Definitely recommend her place!

We had a great stay at Gundegas place, they were very accommodating hosts who were very flexible with check in and check out,and gave us awesome local tips for our stay in Porto! The terracewas absolutely perfect and had the Sun from midday until sunset every day

Flat is located in a great location that is walkable from all the main Porto attractions. Everything you need for a comfortable stay is supplied in the flat along with great communication from the helpful host and great local eateries. Would definitely use again.

Place was clean tidy and had everything you needed. Gundega and Antonio were extremely friendly and flexible about checking in and out times, which was really appreciated. Place is in a great location with good amenities in the immediate area and easy walking distance to most local sites.

A beautiful home with an amazing terraces - I enjoyed many breakfasts in the sun on there. Very good location, everything is within a reasonable walking distance and then in the evenings (as a lone traveller) I felt very safe going out at night to grab something quick; it was also very near!

This is a great location in the heart of Porto. Only 10 minutes footwalk to the centre.
You can easily find supermarketes and restaurants for all tastes in the near.
The apartment is good for two people has all you need. Clean, light and comfortable. Perfect.
We had warm and nice welcome by Antonio and Gundega and got also a lot of tips for sightseeings.
Antonio you are right: Porto is a very great city!!! We would stay again for sure.

You won’t find a better place to stay in Porto. António was a great host and really helpful. The place has a huge terrance and is perfect for 1-2 people. I’ve stayed in other places in Porto that were similar, and this one was the best. The location is also perfect for someone looking to stay just outside the center. It’s about 15 minute walk to the Douro River. Highly recommend it!
Cool place with large sunny terrase very close to the city Center and bars/restaurants around the corner. Very nice and flexible hosts.
Such a nice place! The terrace is even more amazing than it looks and the flat is super close to everything. Really nice and helpful host as well. I would highly recommend.

Great location that was walkable toots of amenities.  Antonio provided lots of tips on things to see and do in the neighborhood and Porto. Bonth Gundega and Antonio were friendly and proactive in communication.  I would definitely stay there again!

This house is really awesome. It looks exactly the same like on the pics. You can find everything you need for a marvelous stay in Porto in this house. By foot you need ca. 10-15 min to the city and 20 to the port. In november the weather in Porto hasn't been on our sight, that's why we've been happy to return to a comfortable and dry home. There are fan heaters - which I've really appreciated, because for my personal view Porto has been much too cold and wet in november ... Next time it'll be this house again, but definitley in the summer! By the way: Henrique has been a kind and caring host! Thank you!

Henrique's house was just what we needed for a great stay in Porto. It was clean, well furnished and had enough space for our family and a couple of friends to enjoy 4 days of fun and sightseeing around the city. Henrique was a great host, communicating very well and having things all arranged  even though he was not there when we visited. Would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was very tastefully decorated. There were two rooms, with ample space for four to stay in. Location was a bit further out but still within walking distance to Santa Catarina, about less than ten minutes away. However, it is a bit of a walk to the old town and the river, but we still managed to walk everywhere. Henrique was a pleasant host, and tried to help us as much as he could. He struggled a little with communicating in English, but still managed to get his points across. We were just a little annoyed that we ran out of toilet rolls and had to get more on our own.

Henrique always responded very quickly to my emails and answered everything I asked in a friendly manner. His family explained how things worked. Overall, we had great communication and the place was exactly as described and close to a metro station, not far from downtown sao bento. I would definitely stay there again.
Lovely apartment, very spacious and very comfortable beds. Henrique was a very helpful host.  Can't find fault with it!

We had a nice stay in Henrique's apt. It is exactly as shown in the photos - modern, very clean, very well decorated, and with all the necessary comforts. Henrique greeted us on time and was very welcoming and friendly. The house is 5 minutes from the metro and 20 minutes walk from the center, and the neighborhood felt safe. A good stay!

The house is a dream. Very unique and special. Especially our kids enjoyed the stay a lot as there were so many toys around. Also the garden is a paradise. After a long day in downtown Porto to relax in the hammock - a dream. The beach and a great playground are in walking distance. Also Fien and Ricardo were very proactive with recommondations and prompt responses whenever needed. We can definitely recommend this place.

We stayed in Fien and Ricardos house for one week now in September 2022. The house is well equipped and great for a longer stay and has ideal conditions also with small kids.
The beach, supermarket and a few paderias for a nice breakfast are all in walking distance.
The neighborhood is quiet - we liked the typical 🐓-clucks in the backyards around.. their early morning wake up crowing give a typical and cosy countryside feeling so close to a big city.
The father of Ricardo received us in time and was very helpful and polite.
We can recommend the house 💯% with absolutely nothing to complain about.

Really well equipped house with plenty of beach and garden toys for children to use.
Very convenient location for walking to the beautiful nearby beach and sea pools or nearby supermarkets.
The neighbouring roosters giving us their wake up call fascinated our toddler daughter, and we found it an enhancing experience to our stay rather than an annoyance. They are lovingly called “Daddy Chickens” 😂

We found ourselves in need of a place to stay on very short notice and Marcelo fixed us up quickly with very comfortable beds and good wifi in a central neighborhood. It was all we needed.
Mario was very responsive and kind, but we didn't met him in person. If you're looking to stay with locals, this may not be your place. It's like a hostel with a number of rooms sharing a kitchen, living area, balcony and bathrooms. It's very nice.

I foubd my 2 night stay very enjoyable. I was need to look around the area as Im moving across in the newer future and found the apartment to be in an excellent location for walking around and using the the metro. The apartment itself was very clean, individual rooms could be locked as well which was very reassuring. Highly recommend the stay!
Perfect. Everything was great. Really nice flat, nice atmosphere. A bit noisy in the morning but Porto has to be seen anyway so not a problem at all! Very good location as well.

Amazing location!! In The heart of Porto! Nice Flat, very confortable. Mario was very kind and available for any requests.
I defenitely suggest it!
Everything is perfect! The host gave us all the information we needed even at night. The location is the best and recommended stay!

Even we didn't get to meet mario, his place is very nice and well managed. Location is unbeatable - walking distance to metro and near to a lot of nice restaurants / supermarkets. The room is clean, warm and nice bed! Definitely highly recommend this place!

Mario's place is really nicely decorated, in a good location, and just as advertised. I didn't see any other renters while there, it was super quiet. Mario provided really helpful information to find the place and find parking. Thanks!!
The apartment was super nice and clean! Check-in was uncomplicated and Mike always quickly replied to our messages. Moreover, he provided a really cool map to discover Porto

It's a central located bright and clean room in an apartment with other rented rooms. Check-in and communication with Mario were easy and friendly. You find a individually designed map of all the sights to visit in and around Porto that Mario made for his guests. I would return to this place for sure!

The flat is very very cool and a nice spot to live in Porto. It’s close to all spots you have to visit and a good place to meet new people if you want to. The Room, the bathroom and the Kitchen are clean and the host is very nice!
We had a good stay here in Porto. Everything was clean and the check in was easy. The road in front of the Apartment was a bit noisy in the morning.

Everything that needs to be good about this place is great! The location: 5 min walk from the bus station and supermarket. Lots of food options nearby.
The space: Very clean, tidy and functional.
The hosts: Super accommodating (pun intended!). Allowed us to leave our bags before and after check-in, gave us this lovely map they developed which guides you through a walking tour of Porto capturing all the landmarks.
Can't ask for more. Highly recommended!

Very nice, clean and comfortable apartment at good location, just 3 min walk from metro station. Even that it is not in a center of Porto, the neighborhood is nice.
I would recommend it to anyone.
Excellent location and absolutely beautiful apartment! One of the only places I've stayed in Europe that has had both a washer and dryer! Highly recommend!!!

Extremely spacious apartment,the picture didn't show the real condition,we guess it's about 150-170 square meters. Spacious living room and kitchen with everything u need. Very clean.the location is very central, we go everywhere by walk. Sofia is very warm to give me many useful infos about Porto. Thank u Sofia,can't wait to come back to your apartment.

The house is perfectly located in front of San Bento Station. Communication was very easy and we did not have any problems in getting the keys of the house. The girl that opened the house for girl was really nice. I really recommend this place if you are staying in Porto!

Sofia was best host and her apartment was really good. it was just like pictures (even. better) location is the best for sightseeing. you can see the beautiful Porto view at night from window. it is very center but couldn't hear any noisy at night. Bed was very comfortable and you can find everything you need inside apartment. I only stayed 2 nights but I regret it. next time I will stay more :)

I have stayed in several places in Porto. This one is the best listing I have found in the city, perhaps the best listing I ever stayed in my life. We had an amazing experience as a family, Sofia was caring all along the way and made sure we have all the baby equipment and that we are comfortable. The location is fantastic, in front of the train station clocks and church, right in the heart of the city. It is on the fifth floor, and the windows are soundproof. Everything about this apartment is in style to the very last detail. Book this place now, before someone else gets it!
Thanks for hosting us. The apt is very well located and fully equiped. You're 5 minutes away from the many things to see in porto. Loved it

We had a great stay at Sofia apartment .
The apartment is modern , clean and very spacious .
The location is just great . Centraly located in the old Porto within walking distance of all you need to see in town .
Very good restaurants , cafés and shopping near the apt .
I recommend highly this apartment , can't imagine a better place to stay .
Obrigado Sofia

The apartment was fantastic and the location can't be beat! The apartment was spacious and perfectly equipped with everything anyone would need.
There was professional and detailed communication from Sofia throughout the whole process.
I highly recommend it.
Thank you!

Large, splendid and modern apartment centrally located but facing two quiet squares. We walked everywhere: to the Port lodges, crystal palace gardens and concert hall as well as more locally, and, importantly the beer warehouse. Great apartment in a very friendly city.
The location and convenience to all restaurants and sites is ideal. The apartment has everything one needs for a comfortable stay.
Excellent apartment, really spacious, great bathrooms, very central. A real pleasure to stay here and explore the city.

Just adding to the other great reviews. Sofia’s place is wonderful, location fantastic. On this trip between Spain and Portugal, it was the best place we have been. Sofia is super attentive and a great host.

Sofia and Matthew's apartment was amazing.  It is beautifully furnished and has everything you need for a comfortable place to call home while traveling. It is immaculate and is the best Airbnb apartment we have stayed in.  The location is great, with a short walk to a grocery store, shops and fabulous restaurants. We had a super view of the train station from the apartment.  Sofia and Matthew were so responsive and helpful before and during our stay. This was our first trip to Portugal and they helped make our trip so enjoyable.  We hope to return to Porto and will definitely stay at their apartment again.

This apartment in Porto is wonderful. It has every amenity, is beautifully appointed, is very secure, and has an amazing location. You can easily fill several days by walking to experience Porto. Parking is very handy, but being in the city centre is costly. An absolutely wonderful place!

Sofia and Matthew's place was an amazing base for our stay in Porto.  The flat is incredibly centrally located, just minutes from Sao Bento station and most of the tourist destinations.  The flat itself is large and beautifully decorated.  Sofia and Matthew accommodated our early check in and were responsive throughout the journey.  We'd love to stay with them again next time we're in Porto!

This is simple—BEST AIRBNB EVER! By far the cleanest we’ve stayed in, and Sofia was incredibly attentive and helpful, including making sure check in and settling in went smoothly. This property has a great location, great views, and beds and furniture were far more comfortable then most. I would definitely give my highest recommendation; they set the standard for a prime AirBnB property. Also—great kitchen, very roomy, and easy access to very nice washer/dryer which was very helpful on a long stay.
Fantastic apartment in a great location! The apartment was clean and spacious and the hosts were very communicative. Couldn’t have asked for a better stay!
Large, modern apartment convenient to everywhere in Porto.  The kitchen is well stocked and the washer / dryer were great. Loved our stay.

The place is lovely and so clean. Location even better. Sofia was so helpful and we tried several of her recommendations which all lived up to their expectations. Wonderful place! We stayed with small kids and the apartment is perfect for a family too.

This was our second stay at this beautiful apartment.  And it was exactly as we remembered it - and it still remains one of the best equipped, and cleanest, places we’ve ever stayed in.  The location is perfect for sightseeing, wining and dining, or simply strolling the streets soaking up the atmosphere.

This place is great! The location is amazing. It was a very spacious apartment that had many amenities. It was within walking distance of many sites and very close to the river. There are many great restaurants near the apartment. The place was very clean. The 2 balconies were great to see the streets below. There was plenty of light. The bathrooms and showers were large. It was a great kitchen and laundry space. We really enjoyed our stay here and would highly recommend this. This place is especially great for families. We had 2 teenagers aged 13 and 16.  We would definitely come back! We very much loved our stay here!

The apartment is in the center of Porto and bigger than the photos. Everything possible was in the kitchen to make a meal. They even had washcloths in the bathrooms. Lovely time staying at Sofia and Matthew’s home.

Great location. The apartment is very spacious, we traveled as a family of 4 and never felt  cramped. The views are amazing. Great experience overall. Highly recommended. Will definitely stay here if/when we go back to Porto.
This was the cleanest, most comfortable apartment. Close to tourist sites, but quiet at night. Would highly recommend.
Outstanding location. The apartment is beautifully furnished and well stocked with amenities. We really enjoyed our stay.
Great hosts, very responsive and provided lots of local info. Place was spacious and very clean. Hosts provided an extensive description of local dining and attraction information.

I can not say enough about how wonderful this Airbnb apartment is! Look no further, this has everything you would want or think of! It is the perfect location to shops, restaurants, grocery store, transportation, tourist attractions and more! Sofia gave us very clear instructions and her place was very easy to find. The photos don’t do it justice, it is HUGE! We loved having the washer and dryer, the coffee in the morning (she left a few for us to use), the fans (it does get hot but expected in August), extra towels, and ice in the freezer! Highly recommend staying here. Also, we sleep with sound machines and always have, so we didn’t hear anything outside and slept very peacefully.

Helena's apartment is simply perfect: prime location, very well designed and has everything one may need for a convenient stay in Porto. In reality it looks even better than on the photos. Helena and her husband are wonderful hosts and I would recommend them to anyone planning a trip to Porto.

There were 3 wonderful days in Porto. The apartment is similar to the photos. It is ideally situated. The handing of the keys went easy.
Thanks to Artur and his tips of Porto (the beach was realy nice ;) )

We really enjoyed our short stay. Arthur gave us a lot of great tips for our visit to Porto. The apartment is really nice, clean and well located, everything is in walking distance. Thanks for the uncomplicated stay in Porto! Julia & Raphael

The apartment looks beautiful. It's modern and beautifully decorated. The balcony has a nice view and it's great just to sit there, have a glass of wine and watch the sunset. The location is near the city center in a old neighborhood with lots of small supermarkets, cool shops and authentic restaurants. The owner is helpful and friendly and everything went smoothly. I'd definitely like to stay there again and I can recommend it as a great place for others to stay :)

We really enjoyed our stay in the super tidy and beautiful apartment. It is located in a great area where you can find cute bars and cafes and it is only around 10 min by walk to the main sightseeing places.
We would always like to come back.
The apartment is absolutely wonderful! I felt there like in home. In centre of Porto, close to all main attractions, bars and restaurants.
Wonderful place in a great area. Only issue was the wifi continually cut out but I was able to reach the host each time and they were able to reset the connection within the hour.
Enjoyed our stay here. It was easy to get to from the airport on the metro and even easier to walk straight into the city. Great local tips and directions at check in too!

Loved staying here! The apartment is spacious, has great amenities, and is located within walking distance from restaurants and all the main attraction points. The host gave us some good tips on what to visit and how to get around easily.

The apartment is fantastic. I really enjoyed staying there. It has everything you need. The location is great. Very close to the metro station, everything is in walking distance. I would defiantly book this again if I come back to Porto.

The apartment is really great! Very stylish and comfortable, with all necessary facilities. Setting is great, downtown. All the necessary cutlery, towels and other facilities. Next time I will also stay here
The apartment is just amazing! Great location, super clean, flexible check-in, the owners answer very fast! We were extremly happy staying herr :)

Wonderful apartment in a great location.
Maria was a super nice host. She gave us a lot of information about the city and tips were to go. She was really lovely and spent a lot of time explaining us what we should do in Porto. The apartment was exactly like on the pictures. I can really recommend the apartment.
We had a great time there. Thanks again Maria =)

Maria was a great host. She was always very quick to respond to messages, she gave us some good suggestions of things to do (and lent us maps and a copy of Time Out Porto), and she was very flexible with our arrival and departure times. The apartment was lovely, well located and more than big enough for our group.

The apartment is really really really pretty and well-organized. My friend and I feel like home when we stay at this place. Everything is clean and looks new. Maria and her father are so lovely, friendly and passionate. We know lots of information about delicious food, tourist attraction, and special shops from them. They make us have an unforgettable trip in Porto.
Great apartment, in a perfect location. Maria was really helpful and would love to stay there again.

Really nice apartment in the center of the city with plenty of restaurants nearby. Maria was an amazing host and gave me and my friends really good tips to visit the city; she also provided us with maps of the city and a lot of material for different activities. Really good experience, highly recommended.
Maria was very helpful and provided a lot of insider tips. The apartment was beautiful, exactly as on the photos. The apartment is within walking distance from all important places in Porto.

We were very warm welcomed and got a bunch of good suggestions.
The apartment is super stylish and we felt almost at home. Furthermore, the location is just perfect!

Maria and her partner were very nice and helpful when we arrived at the apartment. The stay was great, we had 4 peaceful nights with only the sound of seagulls. The location was lively, with a number of good bars and restaurants in the neighborhood. It was a good place to come home after a day of walking in the nice city of Porto.
Thanks!
Marc and Katrien
Maria's space was lovely, clean,  modern, and close to commercial areas!   Porto overall is very walkable and she provided us with some wonderful suggestions of what to do,  and where to dine.
Really lovely apartment with lots of space, excellent decoration. Great amenities and central location with lots of nice cafes and bars. Thanks

Beautiful apartment and a lovely welcome by Maria and Paulo! They both were great and helped us enjoy Porto with great recommendations.
The apartment is really bright and beautifully decorated.
Thank you Maria and Paulo for your hospitality!
The apartment is in such a convenient location for exploring Porto. A big thank you to Maria who took time to share her recommedations - she is a fantastic host!

The apartment was beautiful, clean and comfortable. The location perfect for our needs.
The host, Paulo was really friendly and explained us many tips about the city!

Staying at Maria's flat was simply amazing.
Such a nice and modern appartment.
We were greeted by Raquel, who was very nice and provided us with plenty useful information.
The neighbourhood was very authentic.
The staircase was very narrow though, but hey who doesn't like a little challenge now and then ;)

Maria's boyfriend welcomed us very nicely: he was punctual, he showed where everything is and gave us some tipps for Porto, including a map of the city.
The apartment is very nice, hipster in the fourniture :) and with a complete kitchen, in case you want to cook.
It is quite central so you are quickly everywhere.
Thanks Maria and Pablo, I would re-book your room if I come back to Porto :)

Super nice host. Maria has been very reactive since the beginning of the booking. Smooth trip - the apartment is centrally located and quiet. I definitely recommend this flat for a weekend getaway in porto!

Perfect location, spacious apartment, with a definite charm in summer that we could only guess in January. :) It could do with a little more heating during the winter season, otherwise everything was perfect.

The studio/apartment is very good. Everthing is very clean, the location is also very good with public transportation and the lively city center around the corner. Owners of the apartment are very helpful in any way they can. All in all, very recommendable!

Beautiful apartment in a very nice neighborhood, not too touristic, with fantastic places to eat or drink. The city centre is only a 10 minutes walk! Maria and her husband were the best hosts, they give me many personal suggestions where to eat, drink, go.. Even when I made a mistake with the check-out, they stayed superchill and friendly. I really recommend this place!

What a great stay we had at the apartment of Maria & Paulo! Very spacious and it had pretty much everything you need :) Especially the map with the local tips of Maria made our city trip to Porto amazing!

Top location! The flat is okay for a short stay. If it was cleaner I would recommend it. 2 sets of keys would've been helpful.. The whole experience feels too much like a business and a bit impersonal.
Great people with great personalities! The appartment is great, really clean and spacious, at a super location, nearby the city center.

I would recommend this place. It's a well decorated space that is pretty central. A lot of room! More than we expected! Also Paulo sat down with me and took me over all the sites around the area which was a nice touch.

Overall we were satisfied with this accommodation.
The apartment is super stylish and even though it’s right in the city center you don’t notice it too much the bedroom at night.
Parking is pretty difficult in the area, make sure to really check the prices of the parking garages before ending up paying a lot of money.
Dear Maria & Paulo, thank you for your welcoming. It was perfect ! Best regards, Gwenaëlle & Yoann

We loved our stay here! You are walking distance to great spots to eat and hang out. We were there in the winter so the space heater upstairs was great. The apartment is a duplex. Please note the bedroom is up the stairs and the bathroom is down the stairs. The living space is very stylish and modern. The apartment is very clean. Also note that the apartment is on the first floor near the front door.

The house was really nice and thanks Manuela a lot for the warm welcome and giving us a tour of the house. She also left some cookies and a bottle of water for us! Nice design with great facilities. Also, Manuela was very helpful and replied our questions very quickly. Enjoyed the stay really much!

This apartment was perfect for our stay in Porto! We were met by Manuela's husband Antonio on our arrival, who showed us everything and was really nice. The apartment had secure underground parking (included in the price) which we made use of. The place was beautifully decorated and had everything that you would need for a long or short stay. Short walk to the metro which is only a few stops to the centre, which had lots of great bars and restaurants. Porto was one of our favourites and we travelled most of Spain and Portugal. The apartment was a great place to come back to and enjoy a glass of wine on the balcony. Really large, roomy, clean and well decorated apartment, good location and great hosts. Would recommend :)

The apartment is very well located and is fully equipped. Only 30 minutes by walk to city center which is a pleasure considering the great weather. Ms Manuela was very attentive to have everything perfect before our arrival and she is very nice. So, great place, good location and lovely city. We will visit again. Thank you!

Me and my boyfriend had such a great and comfortable experience at Manuela's house. She was so kind, friendly and available since we contacted her. The house was very clean, bright, cozy and each room was well equipped. We found all the necessary and even more we needed for our staying and it seemed to be home. The building and the neighborhood are quite, you have the possibility to park your car inside and, to reach the centre of Porto, it is just twenty pleasant minutes of walk during which you can appreciate the city and its traditional corners. Very good experience, five stars for all and strongly advised!! We will come back in the future!  Obrigado por tudo Manuela :-)
Nice apartment, modern, very confortable and fully equipped. Manuela is very friendly and available; nice opportunity to visit Porto.
We had a lovely time at the host's comfortable and clean apt., great to have free parking. Manuela was a great communicator, always responded whenever required. Thank you!
Manuela was very friendly and helpful. The apartment was very large and had everything you could possibly want and more. We will definitely be using again.

Unfortunately we couldn’t meet Manuela but she was very kind with us and ready to help us when necessary.
Her apartment is conform to the description and 15min walking to the closest metro station.
Thank you Manuela!

We had such a comfortable stay at Manuela’s place. Everything went smooth in terms of communication and check in (which was done earlier than 3pm). Manuela was always in touch and replied immediately when we got in contact.
The flat is very spacious and very well equipped. The garage was definitely a bonus. There are many shops around and it’s quite easy to reach the centre by foot (30-45mins by foot).
Overall, very happy with our choice.
Thank you Manuela!

The apartment is spacious and clean with secure access to underground parking.  Manuela was a great host, very efficient in communication. She accommodated our check in when we arrived an hour earlier than expected.  When we had problem with hot water  towards the end of our stay, Manuela immediately coordinated repairs and offered refund.   All her effort to make our stay comfortable is greatly appreciated.
The apartment was super clean, comfortable and the service/communication with the host excellent. A really recommended place for your stay in Porto!
We really enjoyed our stay here while in Porto. Place is very spacious and has everything you need. It’s a bit out of the centre but easy to get to and in a quiet area.

Manuela's place was more run down than what the pictures show, including some dirty walls. Biggest problem was the distance from the center of town. It says in the ad that it is a 20 minute walk to the center of town, when it is really a 45 minute walk. We left one day early because of this.

Good value for the price.
Manuela was very proactive in her communication especially for check-in. I chose this place for the garage parking.
Easy to go downtown by bus.

Manuela was quick to respond & was very accommodating. The apt is spacious, well equipped with dishes, cutlery & had a washer and dishwasher. The indoor parking was huge! The apt doesn’t have a/c so it did get a little hot however Manuela did provide fans. The shower is a hand shower and there was no sheet on the bed. All pretty minor but that is why not a 5. Overall good value and a great host!

Once again, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay in Manuela's. This is a lovely, spacious apartment and has all that you need. Manuela is a caring host and, unlike some, deserves the super host title.    Manuela responded to my queries within 15 minutes.

Our stay was great in Ana's place. Even if the appartment is independant with a kitchen and bathroom, you have to go through a common utility to access the room and it was not precised as we booked it.
Second point, as the room is upstairs, we were having a glass of wine on the terrace when one little girl which was living downstairs I guess came promptly to get back her cat. Even though the cat was cute and the kid did not stay long, that is not what I expect when I book a "full appartment". We could have been in other situations which would have been more annoying.
Except these few details, the place was as clean as I have never seen before, comfy, well located in Vila Nova de Gaia, close to Porto. Ana has been convenient with us as we entered the room before the indicated time.
Thanks again

The flat clean and the location is very good. It’s about 15-20mins walking to the historical Center. The accommodation is smaller then it’s looks like in the picture. But for 1 or 2 persons good. Nice seats on the balcony but the view are house from the back.
Supermarkt is very near by (5mins) walking.
Obrigata for my very nice trip to Porto! :-)
Everything went smoothly. The host was really nice and available for anything. Its a loft that has everything that we needed. Bed was very comfortable. Super clean.  Definitely recommend.

Central and walking distance to many local eateries, commercial and business districts, the port and porto wine cellars. Host is a food lover and gave very good recommendation to local eateries. Very helpful and pleasant to have a conversation with. Easy with check-in and out timings. Fast communication. We have everything we need in the house.

Pedro's house has huge rooms and is very inviting for that.   Pedro is a young guy and his house is great and well located to walk everywhere.   It will be good when he has a little more furniture but it is not an issue.   High ceilings and big rooms ..... love it.   Also we love a lounge chair in the bathroom... great.

The building itself was authentic to the architecture of Porto, a reflection of the city. You could feel that it was a real home. Situated near a big roundabout that had paths leading to many wonderful spots. Travelling around by foot or public transport was very easy. Lots of good and lively places for food and snacks around the area yet inside the house it is always quiet and peaceful. Pedro was so kind and welcoming. He let us use his kitchen and washing machine. Will definitely be back if we are in Porto again.

Walking distance from the center (10 minutes). The bathroom could use a little cleaning. As for the free parking spot, it does not really exist, but it is possible to park for free a couple of hundred meters from the house if you are lucky enough to find a spot.
very cool location to live in Porto. quiet and also close to center. we loved the way to home, everyday something different and beautiful.

I would highly recommend staying at this place if you want to experience a Porto mansion in a non-touristy corner of the city. It's in a quiet residential neighbourhood, however, the tourist spots are a short walk away. Pedro was a great host. We checked in the morning after an early flight. In spite of working night shifts, he was there to greet us and gave us great tips about where to eat and what to see. He has two adorable black cats whose company we enjoyed. The house is being renovated, so the garden is not usable. And the toilets (both private and shared) could be a little cleaner. However, the cleanliness of shared toilets also depends on fellow boarders. And when we requested Pedro for cleaning and toilet paper he promptly delivered. What this place lacks in luxury, it more than makes up in experience. I'd stay here again.

Very nice house! I really loved it ,very authentic. Close  to city center. Train station. Next to it several cafe there locals eat. Everything provided for your needs. Pedro is extremely friendly host!
great location pedro is realy a nice guy and anwser fast. the shower is not realy nice and the bed make a lot of noise. good price for location .

Pedro’s apartment is not in an acceptable and decent condition, and the pictures don’t reflect reality.  The bedroom was not clean, the bathroom was very old (moisture everywhere in the bathtub, smelly, and there were holes in the low part of the wall). Electricity is not working in every rooms of the house, for instance to get down to the kitchen we had to use the torches of our phones. The living room and the kitchen are in very poor conditions, there is a big hole in the “arcade” bringing to the kitchen. The garden looked abandoned, with a broken and dirty sofa and tools/pieces of house to be fixed everywhere.

The house is huge and very charming, with a nice patio. It is quiet and luminous, located in a cute neighbourhood near the city center. We loved the atmosphere there, we met some of Pedro's roomates and we felt like home so we would definitely recommend it if you stay in Porto.

The place was great. Loads of space. Perfect location. Easy to park right outside for free. cool cats. Well equipped kitchen.
Porto is awesome and Pedros house was the best base for us to explore the magic city.

I felt very comfortable in Pedro’s house. The check in was super easy and flexible and the apartment has its own charme and looked like the pictures. you can walk to the center of Porto. Also the cat and dog were very entertaining and lovely :) can recommend 100% when you like house projects, pets and not the standard hotel.

We had such a wonderful stay in Pedro’s beautiful home. Me and my partner love places with character and this was definitely it. We felt like at home. Plus, if you are a dog person this stay has two absolutely lovely dogs to cuddle and keep you extra company!
It’s not your typical airbnb where everything is perfect, however we think this is better!

Pedro was very friendly and responded quickly to messages. His place was fairly clean and had a nice rustic feel. Although he had roommates at the time, I barely saw them and the place was always quiet especially at night time. The location was amazing. It was close to good restaurants and cafes and felt very safe to walk around. Only 10-15 minute walk to the city centre. I would recommend this place to anyone who would like a more authentic stay in Porto. There were also 2 dogs which were very friendly and loving!

we thought the same about Eloi!
very nice flat, very good position and really charming city!
Great host showed us were to go and what to do showed us where to get a great coffee, ideally situated we loved our stay In porto

Our stay in Oporto was wonderful. The flat is perfectly located, very comfortable and Miguel was really helpful in introducing us to the area. Meet up went really smoothly and the checkout was just as easy.
This is really a noisy room. The view are marvellous and the service of its owner is excellent and very charming but this flat really needs new windows with double glass.

Eloi meet us when we arrived to Porto !! He was kind and full of wonderful Information about the area !!! He was very generous with his time and making sure we felt welcome !! The flat was clean and in a great location ! We were able to walk to so many different Porto attractions !!! We fell in love with Porto ... It's beautiful an charming and the people are so kind !!! We ate at a delicious restaurant... Walking distance of the flat called Solar MoinRo de vento !!! A gentleman working at the booze store below the flat suggested we eat there!! Fantastic recommendation! We also ate at a place called Paparickos ... Also wonderful!!!! Make sure to have a drink at Taylor's ( port ) on the terrace !!!

We had a great time in the apartment which is very central in the middle of town. The bus to the airport leaves in front of the door and it couldnt be easier.
Eloi is a very friendly and welcoming host who gave us lots of suggestions for things to see in town. The apt is tip top, full marks and we hope to return again.

The apartment is in a great central location, just a few minutes walking from sightseeing, shopping, great restaurants, nightlife, etc. It has a great view of the beautiful church across the street. Check in and check out were very easy. Joana was quick to respond and when we met her she was very helpful. She shared a map of the city and some great recommendations on things to do and places to eat that were all delicious. Thank you Joana
Super located and nice apartment. Eloi and Joana provided us also great recommendations for places to see and to eat.

Great location - near the center of Porto with easy walks to the river, restaurants, shopping, and sights. The apartment is clean, efficient, and has beautiful views! It's a bit noisy in the afternoons and evenings  due to a main road, but that just made it lively. Cafes, restaurants, and little markets surround the area for any food, water, and fruits/veggies you'd need during your stay. Our host was easy to reach and made helpful recommendations for our Porto experience. Getting to and from the airport was extremely easy to navigate, even at odd travel times. We definitely highly recommend this pleasant studio and wonderful city.
From start to finish it was a pleasure to stay here. The communication and check in was very easy. The restaurant tips for Porto were fantastic and the apartment was in a great location.
Cosy studio in the center of Porto. Most of the Porto highlights were accesible in no time which was a plus. Due to the central location it was pretty loud at night. Overall a very good stay!
Amazing place. Perfect location for the night life and very central. Host super friendly and helpful. We couldn’t choose better place!

The location is excellent. The apartment was very clean and they were flexible with check in. A young lady checked us in and gave very good suggestions for local restaurants. We went to all of them and they did not disappoint.
The reason for only 3 stars is that the windows do little to insulate street noise. We were here on a Saturday night, and there were people partying outside until 6 am. Very very hard to sleep on the weekend.

Check in and check out was simple, easy and flexible. The host was super responsive. The space is simple but offers an awesome view. There is occasional noise from the street but I was never woken up by it. We loved our stay here and could easily walk the whole city from the apartment. I can’t wait to come back to Porto!
Nice place to stay with lovely view!  You will get what you see..BUT For these who cant sleep take a ear plugs its really noisy !

Very friendly hosts, amazing location, nice flat with 3 big windows.
But be careful if you have sensitive sleep, as it’s pretty loud during the night, especially with some concerts going on just a hundred meters away near the church. Earplugs help, though.

Amazing location and beautiful space. Nice and cozy! Joana was very helpful and gave me great tips of spots to visit. The only downside was to be a noisy area, what it's expected in such a central location.

Photos on the web are exactly same but that's it. It means there is no other space. There are bed, table, kichenette, and bathroom only. If you open your bag on the floor, then you have to watch out your step, otherwise you kick your bag because there is no space.
When you check in, you have a large towel and a small towel, and you have to use them for several days because they don't change them. There are hairs on the floor...
But the location is perfect!!!
I can communicate with a host very easily.

This room is perfectly located. The room is great for two with quick access to all the sites. The cafe noshi below is a great way to start the day. The communication was brilliant. Loved the local tips for things to do and we followed them. Recommend Porto recommend this apartment.
The apartment was in a really good place in the city. When asking for information on ideal places to visit we were given so many options. The apartment was gorgeous and well kept
thanks to Jaoa for waiting for us after being delayed for a few hours. location is ideal for young couples.

This was a perfect space for a solo traveler. The location was ideal and walking distance to everything. Also super safe. There are three locks to get into the space. The hosts are super quick with communication as well!

Lovely studio apartment in the heart of Porto. Great views and light. The room was comfortable and clean and the hosts were super responsive. Joana shared great recommendations with us and made sure all was good during our entire stay.
Highly recommend!
We really enjoyed our stay! The host was helpful and communication was great. We would absolutely stay here again! :)

Nice appartments in city center, beautiful view from the windows, the only thing that bothered me is that room was too cold and the only thing that worked was small radiator, which was not enough to warm up the room even when you turn it on for the entire day. I hope host will fix main radiator soon.

Studio was clean and in a great location with a fantastic view from the windows. The hosts were very helpful and the communication was good, we appreciated the recommendations of things to do that we were provided with when we checked in. The studio had everything we needed for 2 people and would definitely recommend it.
Great location! Place was walkable to shops, bakeries and restaurants. Had a wonderful time and would recommend!

Great place, within walking distance to so many great sights and places to dine.
The room was clean and tidy and exactly how the photos looked.
I highly recommend this place.

This very clean and great located apt had all that we needed for our three day stay.  Our host gave us some good eating locations as well.  The apt and bed were very comfy.  Would definitely stay again.

We had a very comfortable stay at Estudios. It was on the top floor of a building that overlooks a really pretty cathedral. The space, although a studio apartment, was spacious for 2 people and the bathroom was super clean. The bed was comfortable, and we were able to walk everywhere in Porto easily from this location. The stairwell at times did smell like smoke, but I do think that's a common thing in European apartments. The hosts were very communicative and helpful with check-in. Would recommend reading the arrival instructions well -- we arrived in pouring rain, and the apartment was not as easy to find then. Overall, would highly recommend (and would stay again!) in this apartment.

The places is exactly what you see in the photos. Small beautiful, centrally located, a lot of restaurants and things to do walking distance. The apartment is easy to find. I would stay again if I come back to Porto.

The studio is perfectly situated within walkable distance to many great attractions, restaurants, and beautiful architecture. Joana was fantastic and very responsive. She even helped us with finding a photographer for our engagement photos!

Eduardo was flexible on our arrival times and was ready to suggested nice places in Porto, he even left an apperitivo for us in the room! The neighborhood is quiet, not very touristic and very well connected. (680) 132-266

We had a lovely stay. The place was very beautifull. There were very nice decorations. It was a nice place to stay.
Near the metro, direct line to city and airport.
Carlos is a nice men, he welcomes you.
We had some good tips for local food and we enjoyed the bikes that we could borrow.
The place feels like your home!

We had a very nice weekend at Carlo's place. The house is very well decorated with a lot of nice details, and despite all the stairs is a very kid's friendly house. And most important, the sympathy of Carlos made us feel like we were at our home. We recommend and we are sure we'll soon repeat this experience. The kids loved the house and the trip.

We did have a wonderful time in Porto thanks to the apartment of Carlos.
We felt very much at home in the house of Carlos. Every morning we got up and played records on the record player. We got nice tips on what to do in and around Porto. With the bikes Carlos offered us, we cycled to the beach and to the old fisher town Afurada. Also the original fado place was very special and local. There was a nice welcome in the apartment with port wine and juice. And the place of Carlos looks very original with creative details. I fell in love with Porto and next time I will come back to the house of Carlos for sure!

Airbnb at it`s best!
I really enjoyed my stay in Porto, Carlos is a very kind host and his house is amazing.

Carlos' home is very well placed, not in the busy town center, but on a quiet road very close to a metro station that brings you in 5 min to the center. The appartment is spacious and very originally decorated, an eclectic place!
Carlos is a good host, very helpful and of good advise.
Our children enjoyed staying in his place (specially due to his dog).

Carlos Eduardo’s house is very interesting, decorated with antiques and very comfortable. It suited our needs perfectly. Carlos Eduardo was very helpful giving us all the information we needed. He even walked us to the subway station next door to show us how to purchase tickets – this is not a simple task in Porto. He provided us with subway tickets that only needed to be charged with how many trips we required. We appreciated his suggestions for restaurants nearby. The house is located only a few minutes away from the city center, either by car or subway – very convenient. We quite enjoyed our stay in Porto, thank you Carlos Eduardo for all your

Amazing apartment, loved all the details in it and all its quirkiness. The location was great, very close to the center, you could walk everywhere if you want to. it's very spacious, very pretty and very comfortable and I would definitely go back there if I go to Porto again.

From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, we felt at home in Carlos' place. On arrival at the airport it is easiest to buy a metro ticket from the Tourist Office in the arrival lounge as the ticket machine in the metro takes a bit of getting used to. The card is 60cents and the journey €2 Keep the card (Andante card) for future trips. Carlos' house is about 50metres from Heroismo metro. There is also a Lidl store a little way in the opposite direction. Just ask Carlos for anything else you need to know, he is most helpful and friendly.

Carlos and Zecka are very friendly hosts. Apartment is beautiful and comfortable.  The Porto center is a 15-minute walk away. We advise you to visit the places recommended by Carlos. The places we've  visited were great.

carlos is amazing and Zeca Afonso to die for.  the most stylish artsy wicked place i ever had the pleasure to stay. a place that  is like being in an exhibition. loved it, will recommend and certainly try to come back. location is awesome and as a plus...a fresh bakery next door. thank you for everything Carlos, it was a pleasure meeting you and stay at the top floor of your house. regards liliana, andreia and ewa
Carlos was an excellent host, really enjoyed staying there, extremely  close to metro and supermarket, very spacious and really enjoyed the wood burning stove in the evenings, would highly recommend.
Had a lovely stay at this very unique flat. Everything was clean and comfortable and it was an excellent location. Right next to the metro station, making travel around the city very quick and easy.
Nice spot not too far from the centre of Porto. His dog, Zeca is so lovely, he is there to say hi and goodbye when you enter and leave the property. You feel super safe 😊🐶

we stayed 5 days at Carlos place.  after 2  hours we felt like at home . the flat is large , quite and charming with it's cosy atphosfere  . Carlos gave really a lot of ideas and very good suggestions on trips and restaurants etc.  and we were really like with a friend. Pity the holidays was only 5 days we would have continued ...we highly recommend  Massimo and Paola

Carlos was a great host. The place was definitely on the edge of town, took a while to walk into the center. Convenient market and good nearby. I LOVED the artistic and thoughtful touches throughout the apartment. Felt spacious enough to spread out across rooms. Would recommend. Thank you Carlos!

Amazingly friendly host. Carlos is an artist and his home radiates with creativity and joy. There are so many details, moments of care and attention, that you keep finding little gems everywhere you look. He made me feel like this was also my home and took every effort to make sure I was having a great stay and that I was experiencing what Porto had to offer. I loved my time there and look forward to returning.
Extremely warm and welcoming host. Place is clean, accurate and at the good location. Eduardo gets all the recommendations!
Carlos is an amazing host and we loved our stay at Porto. would and will come back as soon as I can

I loved staying with Carlos. The home is perfect, there is silence and peace. Everywhere you turn in the house you see part of Carlo’s art collection and his own. Would love to stay there again anytime.

Carlos is a very friendly and interesting person to talk to. He was helpful and communicative. The decor apartment is unique ina good way. Lots of space for us. We loved staying there . Thanks, Carlos!
Small but nice, quiet and very clean room in a central and charming neighbourhood, the staff is nice and reliable, a very good experience overall!

Very welcoming host who went out of his way to share local info as well as walk us to a nearby recommended place for lunch pointing out where to grab pastries and groceries for the coming days!

Location was perfect for us. Walking distance to shopping, beach and fantastic restaurants. The food was fantastic I must say.

The apartment is nicely furnished and had a lot of nice little touches for visitors. Next time in Oporto, I would definitely book this place again.

The Design Sea House was the perfect place to base ourselves while in Porto. Well designed and fully kitted out, it is just a few minutes from the beach, lovely restaurants, and local shops. Everything was catered for, including great recommendations for things to see in Porto.
We loved the sea house, it was very comfortable and in a great location. I would recommend staying there.

Everything was perfect with our stay.. We fell in love with the gorgeous house immediately, well designed and well thought out. Fernando was lovely informing us of local places to visit and recommendations of where to eat. Nice local wine waiting as a welcome gift was a nice touch. Loved the location, just right for a summer stay, close to the beach and good restaurants. We will most certainly choose to stay here again when we return to Porto. Was sad to leave to be honest!

What an effortless weekend away. The check in, kindly done by Rita's Dad was late which I appreciated as I came on the last flight. He explained how the house worked thoroughly. I slept very well in the cosy apex room. The house itself was spacious and well appointed with lots of attention to detail. The location could not really be better with the bars and restaurants of Foz close by. All in all a very good stay and I am very appreciative of the late check out which really helped on a rainy Sunday.

This place is in a perfect quiet location, while being close to supermarkets, bakeries and the beach.  It's clean and looks just as great as the photos, with all the essentials provided.  We had a great time here and I would definitely stay here again!

Lovely town, Porto is easily accessible,lots of great little restaurants and shops.
The apartments are tastefully decorated and have all amenities you need.
Rita’s father Fernando does all the checking in etc and is really helpful.

Fernando went above and beyond to make sure we were welcome and sorting out any issues. Also allowing us to store our bags made a huge difference for us on our last day- things like that make airbnb and hosts like you unparalleled.

We had a great time in the Rita's House. It is very nicely renovated and tastefully equipped and located in a quiet street only a few blocks from the beach front. Rita's dad who checked us in was very freindly and helpful and gave us many good tips on how to discover the area (e.g. by bike). If we'll ever come back to the Foz area of Porto, we'll make sure to rent one of Rita's tiny & stylish houses!
João and Rita's apartment was perfect for us. Within walking distance of everything we needed. Clean, quiet, sweet accommodations and all modern comforts. Will recommend to friends visiting.

It was a magical time in Porto. The house was even prettier than we expected. Everything from the check in moment to check out was top experience. House has a fully equipped kitchen, so we could enjoy a home made dinner with fish from a local market.
We had an amazing time there. And we will definitely stay at Their place again.
Thank you!
This house is great - very stylish, in a lovely location and, although it's fairly small, it doesn't feel it at all because it's been cleverly designed. Porto is beautiful and we had a great time.
The place is amazing, and perfect for a short stay in Porto. Very convenient, nicely decorated and  great location by the beach. Rita and Fernando were outstanding hosts!
Great host with beautiful apartments, 200m from the beach. Great location in Foz, we will be back.

We stayed in the small but cozy apartment for 2 nights. Everything is clean and comfy. The seagulls are a bit noisy but this gives a special maritime flair. I do recommend the apartment if you just stay for a few days.

I don't speak Portuguese, but Mario must translate to LEGEND! This was my first experience with Air BnB and based on Mario, and the site, it won't be my last.

The location, amazing. Although at first it was difficult to find, not Mario's fault, using Google Maps once found it was very easy to find again. It is literally a hop skip and a jump from everything in Porto in any direction. It's location is great for hitting up the cafes and shopping as well.

Mario was in contact with us constantly and accommodated our arrival and departure times. He's super easy going, has great suggestions and greeted us with map in hand going over each point carefully and thoroughly. We said our goodbyes over coffee, Portuguese style.
A fantastic view on Porto. Mario is easy going. The flat is small but very functional and clean. It is a quite charming place with a nice ceiling.

Highly recommended. The apartment was very well located, within easy reach of the Cathedral and other attractions. It was small but not cramped and had everything we required for our stay. Mario was a very welcoming and informative host and the checking in and out procedures were straightforward. And the port waiting for us on arrival was an added bonus!

great hoster! great apartment(small) with nice-view! everything is said if u read the comments.

THANK YOU, MARIO!

René from Vienna
The apartment was great, in a very good location and close to all the main  attractions. Mario was also very helpful. I would definitely be coming back on my next trip to Porto.
Mario's place was perfect for us as a travelling young couple! Amazing view, small space but that's all we needed! Everything was clean and a great location. We were more than happy with our stay.

The view is stunning and the flat is ideally situated. As for the interior - very luminous, modern, clean and has all the required essentials. There is even a tiny coffee machine which makes the flat more cozy and (combined with the lovely view) allows for that morning boost before heading for a long day of touring. Had a great stay. Mario gave us a few tips on what to go and visit, as well as a map which was very practical. Also despite arriving quite late from the airport, we received a friendly welcome.

My boyfriend and I had a great stay! We were on the top floor (quite a climb) but an amazing view. Mario was very helpful, and recommended some great restaurants. The room was clean but quite small (1 to 2) people max. Overall, I enjoyed my time in the city of Porto!!

Mario was really nice, he told us everything we needed to know for our stay at Porto.
The appartment was clean and the view from the appartment is perfect.

Mario was welcoming and told us about places we must see in Porto. We were a bit surprised about room size as the pictures on the page were well taken and gave the illusion that the room will be a bit bigger. During our stay we got used to it though and enjoyed the perfect location and the view over the city.

Well located, nice little studio, perfect for a weekend. Close to the bars and nice view from the window. However the apartment is a little bit cold in the winter and you will hear loud birds. And you don’t have to be afraid to climb 4 floors!

Great hill top home base in city center. Mario described how best to arrive from the airport, shared a local map with restaurant suggestions with me upon arrival, and made checking out and luggage storage very convenient. He was quick to respond to my questions, was always very helpful, and the apartment was very clean and had safe surrounding areas. The view is the best part of this apartment!
The room is as described, the location is better than I expected. Mario is very easy to reach to.
Excellent central location and clean apartment. Apartment is tiny and much smaller than it appears. Good value.

The location of the apartment is very good. Close to all the sights one would want to see.
The apartment is, however, much smaller than it looks in the photos. It wasn't as clean as one would expect. So if the objective of the apartment is just to sleep, it does the job. Otherwise it is not what one would expect.
The host, on the other hand was not very commutative, including upon arriving. But hey, we are all allowed to have not so great days, no! I guess we landed on one of those days for the host... He just wanted to finish handing the apartment as quickly as possible as we felt.... Nonetheless, the location is really great!

Pretty good overall. Location is great. It's a managed apartment so doesn't have the homely feel.
The room is quite small - not much room for bags. Felt smaller than it appears in the photos. But it's quite nice and has a great view of the city.
Hosts were helpful with recommending places to eat and visit.
A few things could improve the experience:
- the wifi code that was given to us (printed out on paper) was wrong, so we had no internet.
- the coffee wasn't replenished.
- the soap and dishwashing liquid wasn't replenished.

I had a great stay at Mario's! It's location is perfect and the room was very clean when we arrived. It is small but it is perfect for one or two! My friend and I enjoyed the view the most. Mario was helpful and flexible with check in, he also gave us recommendations for he city which was wonderful. I would definitely stay again.
Cozy little room for a short stay in Porto.  Best views from the room above in the top floor, nice neighbarhood, very central, just perfect.

Mário was a great host. He allowed us to check-in early to stow our bags while we explored the city. There is a wonderful view from the apartment and it has a very cool and unique feel. It was a great stay.

It's a small but comfortable place. Everything is very modern.
We didn't even had to use any public transportation, because the apartment is located in the city centre.
Unfortunately we got really sick in the last night and couldn't move on. Marios business partner was very kind and offered to help us searching another accommodation.
So, if you go to Porto, stay at Mario's!
Nice, but very very small Appartment in a very good Location. We need no metro because you can reach everything by foot. At Night it is a bit noisy due to birds.
Nice cozy house near the ocean. Wifi worked really good and an early check-in was also not a problem

This is a lovely place in a great location. It was an easy walk to restaurants and the beach. The kitchen was very well equipped and there were beach towels, a wind screen, and, a beach umbrella.
