The hosts could not have been more helpful in general. The bed was very firm. Overall, it was a great stay.

we had a great stay in Rita's house. We were welcomed by her father Fernando and he gave us some good tips. The house is not so big, but everything you need is there. It's also a great location near different beaches. where you van walk to. you can also go to the city centre by bus. Just a great place to stay if you want to go to Porto!

Amazing location close to all amenities. We loved being able to walk to the bakery, to various dining places and the beach!
Fernando is an awesome host and super responsive.
We highly recommend this place and will not hesitate to use it the next time our travels bring us to the Porto area.

A perfect place, well situated. The welcome bottle of Porto very appreciated and the good addresses, Thank you Marta !
The apartment very spacious with 2 parking. A beautiful view of Porto and the sea.
Nothing to say, everything was perfect.
See you again....

We had a great time in Porto, not in the least case because of Marta's apartment. Because we got a warm welcome by Noemia, Marta's mother. And we were spoiled by Noemia and her friends by a delicious dinner on Friday night.
For the Saturday, Noemia reserved very fine restauarants for lunch and dinner. These places we never would have found ourselves. Also Noemia helped us out when we had problems with finding places or arranging tours.
All and all very recommendable.

We had a wonderfull time in Porto. Absolutaly loved the city and the appartment. we were with a group of 10. Is was spacious enough for a group that big. Everything that we needed was there. Whenever we sent a message to Marta we got an answer within minutes. Thank you for having us. we will recommend your place to everybody visiting Porto with a bigger group.

Lovely home for a weekend in Porto with friends during RemoteYear.  Very centrally located, amazing restaurant on the top floor, and the "Taste of Porto" walking tour arranged by Marta's mother was AMAZING. Sofia was the best!

We were a party of eight with three cars arriving at different times and Marta went out of her way to accommodate us. Although the neighbourhood is not the greatest, it is an easy walk to Santa Catarina and all the life you want. There is a very good Portuguese restaurant down the road as well as a few cafes and bakeries, but you are far from the maddening crowd......a plus. A definite recommendation. And the view and light is superb!

Nice apartment just out of the centre of Porto - but an easy walk to the centre of the city.  Everything worked well and we were accommodated comfortably.  Future guests should note that they shouldn't ring the doorbell from the street as you might ring the wrong bell and wake the neighbour (who has a young child).  Recommended place to stay!
Very good location, can save you the trip to the clerigos tower as the view is even better at the flat ;). Mario was very friendly and accommodating. Great host overall, would recommend.

The room is perfect for those who plan to spend most of their time exploring Porto. The room is small but has all the essentials. The view from he window is amazing and was a pleasure each morning. The room was clean and had most amenities provided. The room is on the 4th floor so it can be tiring after walking around Porto all day to climb up the stairs. The location is a 10 minute walk from the river area and has many great restaurants, cafes, and shops. I would highly recommend this room.

Mário has this location down to a science. He owns the entire building and runs every room as an airbnb/hotel. This is one of the most organized best set up places I have stayed at. Great service, great value, and just take in the views!! The place is small, but well set up, nice and newly renovated - don't look father, this is the place to stay in Porto.

Mario's apartment is perfect for a short stay in the city. It's quite small, but perfectly equipped and clean. And the location is unbeatable. The apartment is situated on the top floor which wasn't a problem for us, but be prepared for stairs and seagulls waking you up in the morning if you're a light sleeper. All in all, a lovely stay.

Great place, very responsive host. Light-filled rooms and comfy beds. Be sure to get Marta’s mother to make you a traditional
Portuguese dinner. We didn’t want to leave!

Great view, clean! Very easy with the check in, close the the subwayand walk distance to many nice places. The pictures made me believe the flat was bigger, it is pretty small, but everything promised was delivered and I think I couldn't have found a better view.
Great place. The view alone is worth it. Mário provided us with some great tips on where to go and was really helpfull with the check in.
The room was lovely with an amazing view over the city. It was small but very well equiped. The area was central and amazing to explore.
This accomodation has a wonderful view and everything you need at your fingertips. It's very well located and easy to explore old Porto from.

The pictures give you the impression of a decent size studio, but is the opposite of that. Not suitable for 2 people, especially if carrying big suitcases. There is no space to even open your bag on the floor to pick some clothes. A part that, the rest was fine.

We had a great time here! :) The flat is on top of quite a few flights of stairs, but the view definitely made up for it. It was also located really close to a lot of famous landmarks, and the inside of the flat was small but very cosy. We would recommend this as a romantic getaway to anyone!
Lots of stairs to go up but the view makes up for it !! Perfect for a little moment in porto !! Loved it and would certainly go back

Unfortunately, I missed my flight and was unable to stay at Mario's place. However, he was exceptional when it came to communication and even offered to switch me to another day. I wish I would have been able to stay. I would highly recommend Mario just based on his thoughtfulness and communication!
Nice apartment with a breathtaking view to the centre. Perfect for having a breakfast at the window to start the day right.

Great place if you're in town for the night life and just general old city site seeing. Really a very compact room with all basic necessities covered. We were lucky to get the apartment with a great view! Price performance, definitely recommend.

We had a good night here. The room is compact but contains everything you need and has an unbeatable view towards the river, which was great to wake up to.
Location-wise the apartment is perfect as a base to explore the city. Everything you need including great restaurants and bars are right on your doorstep.
We didn’t have much interaction with the hosts, but check in and check out were smooth. All in all this place is ideal for those who want somewhere to lay their head while they explore this lovely city.

The appartment is on the upper floor, so prepare to climb some stairs. In return you get a great view over Porto.
The appartment is small but it has everything you need for your stay. Everything is clean. The location is reallt good. It is near to the metro, bakkery, supermarket and restaurants.
The check in was really good. We didn't meet Mario, but the supervisior of the building. He helped us with our luggage and gave us some good local tips. I really reccomend this appartment for a short stay in Porto.

Apartment was uncomfortable for the two of us staying there. There's nothing misleading about the apartment description, it was clean and Mario was a a kind host. But a few things to be cautious about:
1. The apartment is extremely small - there wasn't enough space to lay our large suitcase fully open (only enough space to open the suitcase cover up to ~135 degrees). Once you get what you need from your suitcase, you'll have to pack it up each time and put it in the closet, unless you want the suitcase blocking the only available floor space in the apartment, which would make it hard to move around and walk to the bathroom.
2. There were seagulls constantly right outside of our apartment, squawking all day and making it very hard to get a good night's sleep. Even after shutting the windows closed, it didn't soften the sound enough to sleep well.

Mario was a fantastic host. Place is centrally located. We weren’t expecting so many stairs to get to the apartment (that was a bit hard to carry our suitcase) but the view was worth the climb. Overall we had a great 1 night stay in Porto.

Mario’s place in Porto was amazing! Such a beautiful view out of the window on our top floor. We were greeted by Rafael who kindly helped us in. The bed was comfortable, and the bathroom was large and modern. Best shower we had in Europe! The location of the place was also so central. I highly recommend this spot!

The apartment is very well located and Mario is very nice !
I recomand this place !
We had a great New Year's eve stay at the place. The studio is tiny but clean and stylish. The best choice for 1 night in Porto.
Nice small studio right in the center of the town. You are easily able to explore all of porto from this area. The place is small but perfect for 1 or maybe 2 people. Would recommend!
Really cosy apartment in the heart of Porto, very clean and everything you need was there. Beautiful view from the window, just like on the pictures! I would highly recommend this room!

Excellent location! The studio isn't massive, but for those intending on exploring the city, the place has all you need! Mario was great to deal with too, really responsive and held our bags before check in
Mario's place is im very good location. You wille have everywhere close. If you want to go party, many bars and clubs are nearby. Moreover the place is very clean and well-equipted.
Great little studio in the heart of Porto ! Mario is a kind host, he welcomed us early and he has good local adresses. it was a pleasure to stay there

This apartment is super charming. The pictures are exactly what you see. The view is amazing, and you really pay for the view. Comfortable bed, great shower and bathroom area. Entire apartment is very clean and is exactly as described. Very central to everything. Great place to stay when visiting Porto. I would caution you against bringing heavy bags. This apt is on the 5th floor (ground floor included) and the staircase is very narrow. If you don’t mind the stairs, definitely consider staying here!
As described in the rest of the reviews, the view from this apartment was top-notch. Otherwise, the space itself was small but enough room for 2. Just be ready for a few stairs :)

Mario’s place was exactly as stated.  It’s in a great location walking distance to many places. It is on the 4th floor and you have to take stairs all the way up. It can be tough for someone with a lot of luggage. The view is amazing from the window! Great place to stay if you are planning to see the city most of the day.  Enough space for a single or a couple that doesn’t mind a cozy fit.

A pretty little studio with a wonderful view over Porto. It is in a perfect location to explore the city as well as close to restaurants. The bed is extremely comfortable and there is ample storage for your stuff. The bathroom is nice and clean plus there is some stuff to help you cook if you want. Tastefully decorated. A fantastic place to stay!
The host was easy to get a hold of and very accommodating.

Mário's place is very well located. All the iconic places of Porto are within a few-minute walk. The place was clean and the bed was comfortable, all that most travelers need. I would recommend my friends staying at Mário's place.
The location is amazing, but the space is very small.  It was clean though, and had a great view.
Lovely little place for two with an amazing view of the city! 10/10 would recommend! ☺️

After reading reviews on the size, I was a bit nervous and I’m so glad we ignored that. Yes, it’s a studio and yes, it’s up a 4th floor walk-up (5th floor if you’re from the US) but the location, value, and view can’t be beat. Bonus, the bathroom/shower is pretty large. Perfect spot for a few day stay in Porto. Mario was quick to respond and offer recommendations and being able to enjoy the view with the windows open was a really nice way to wind down the night.

The stay at this place was great. The apartment is at the top of the building and you have to climb a lot of stairs but it‘s really worth the view! Perfect conversation, really flexibel check-in and clean! Nothing to complain.

So nice studio, it is so well located, you have everything near.
I recommended it a lot if you are coming just a few days. It is perfect for 1 or 2 people.
I definitely will choose it again if i come back!

The house is really small but incredibly well located! Its position and stunning view from the window make it absolutely worth it. I highly recommend it for a couple that is willing to visit this wonderful city!
Small but very cozy and functional! Clean and tidy. Plus very easy to check in by yourself. Thanks a lot :)
Great location near lots of amazing little restaurants which are great value. Small but has everything you need for a few days.

Perfect place to stay at a central location in Porto! I loved Porto and this place is the perfect Airbnb to stay to access everything it has to offer. View is exceptional, although the climb is long to get to the top. It was worth the climb, cuz of the view. Bed was really comfortable and helped me sleep comfortably when I had a long day in Porto walking all the hills.
Mario is a great host who helped me with everything. Patricia greeted me when I arrived and told me about Porto and what it has to offer. I will stay here again when I’m in Porto again! Which I definitely will because Porto is amazing. :)
Pros
View from the loft.
Easy access to all the major location.
Comfortable bed.
Con
Really small space.
Lovely spot! The location and view were amazing, and Mario and Rafael were very accommodating and helpful. This was a very comfortable place to stay in Porto.
Mário’s studio was a great jumping off point to explore the city from. View was great as well.
Mário’s Airbnb apartment was clean with a modern bathroom. It’s a great location near public transportation and many excellent restaurants. He was very thoughtful by accommodating our schedule.
Mário’s listing was perfectly located to explore Porto. I highly recommend this listing to anyone visiting the area
Everything was great, the location, the price, the view ! Just bad luck with the Weather these days. A place to come back!
Small but very centrally located, with all the basic amenities you might need. Fantastic location, and perfect communication.

Great communication and simple instructions which lead to this gem of a place. Yes it is a climb up to the apartment but worth it with its fabulous birds eye view over Porto.  The apartment has everything you need, good shower, towels, comfy bed, small table to eat, small kitchen facilities, hairdryer and even an iron if you felt the urge. Close to the metro, many places to eat and historic attraction.  I would stay here again if visiting Porto.

Mario was a very nice host, communication was smooth and he also allowed us for an earlier check in. The apartment is small but has all the comforts, very well equipped and great for a short stay. The location is perfect to visit the city, super central and very close to the main attractions. Also, nearby there are many nice restaurants/bars. A special mention goes to the view from the room which is very very nice!

Mario’s place was very conveniently located to see all the attractions that Porto has to offer. It is also right near all the best cafes, restaurants, and nightlife. Walking down the hill only takes 15-20 minutes and is very picturesque. The space is exactly as pictured but without water provided for guests as pictured. It is also very tiny. I would not be able to stay here for more than a few nights. Also, be prepared to walk up 5 flights of stairs.
The only negatives were the pillows which were not very comfortable. It would’ve also been nice to have the 120V outlet in the bathroom to have been working.
Overall, a great stay with a very clean bathroom and bedroom! And an amazing view and proximity to all of Porto!
Mário was very helpful and kind, also there was someone to welcome us when we arrived. I highly recommend Mário's place. It was clean, cute, and had a very nice view.

We loved Mario’s place. It had an amazing view and was very clean and comfortable. He was very flexible and replied to my messages very promptly. I would definitely recommend this place to friends and family travelling to Portugal!

Great small apartment with an awesome view of the city! Good location and great communication with host. Would stay again!
If you’re someone who likes to sleep in… there is construction just outside the window which started around 8am each morning. Just a note.
The place is in the heart of Porto, close to everything. The place was clean, amazing view, super responsive host. I recommend!
The view was very nice. It was easy to go to different places on foot. The apartment was really small. There were construction works, so it was quite noisy. It was okay for 2 nights

Mario was really nice and helpful, and the place is so lovely with an amazing view! It is on the 4th floor without elevator access though, so i wouldn't recommend a big luggage. but other than that, the location was amazing and was close to everything, it was quiet and peaceful at the same time, and overall was a lovely experience!

Perfect place to stay while visiting Porto. I wish we could have stayed longer. Multiple people have mentioned the stairs (this apartment is the top floor) being an issue but if you’re walking around Porto the stairs are not bad at all. Being on the top floor provides a great view both during the day and at night. It was not super warm when we were there but the ceiling fan was super nice. Would definitely go back!

We had a nice stay at Mario’s apartment. The view was spectacular but the room was really small for 2 people. Not much space to move around or put personal belongings. Unfortunately we had no hand soap or body soap provided by the host on arrival and had to wait until the second day of our stay to get any. Overall it was good!

Super central place with a gorgeous view! The room was small but has everything  you need! Mario let us check in early and store our bags before and after our stay which was really helpful for us! Highly recommend!

We have just returned from a brilliant stay in Porto. The apartment is exactly what we needed for 3 nights. I had contacted Mário ahead of time for a recommendation of where to leave our luggage. He helpfully allowed us to store it at the accommodation. During lunch we then had a message to say we can check in early. The apartment was perfect for us, the location and the views are incredible. We were able to walk everywhere we needed to. The accommodation is at the top of the building and getting larger pieces of luggage up the stairs would take some effort. However, we only had light bags and it’s worth it for the view alone. When we return to Porto we will be looking to return to Mário’s apartment. Top place, top city!

We had a great weekend in Mario’s place. It was the perfect location for exploring Porto, so close to everything. It was quiet at night, clean, the bed was super comfortable and the view was incredible. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Porto as long as you don’t mind walking up 4 flights of stairs.

This is a very central place to stay in Porto near the Sao Bento train station. Mario was extremely responsive and flexible with check-in and bag drop off. The space is small, but well organized and has everything you need to get a good night’s sleep before heading out to explore the city. A heads up, this room is on the 4th floor and there are only stairs, which is something to keep in mind if you have accessibility concerns. Otherwise, we found the that the view was beautiful and the room has great value!

Small studio walking distance from all main attractions and Porto and with an incredible view! I was traveling solo and enjoyed the restaurants, bars, and shops nearby. It is up a hill from the train station and required going to the 4th floor up a spiral staircase. However, Mario carried my heavy checked bag up the stairs for me which was very nice! He also allowed me to store my luggage in his office when I arrived hours before check in. It is probably a 10-15 minute walk to the wine houses across the river. <5 minutes from the main going-out bars and clubs. The apartment is small but if you just need a bed and shower, it works well and is decorated nicely! Mario is also a great communicator.

We enjoyed our stay at Mario's apartment. The view over the city was amazing and the apartment was cozy. Be aware though that the staircase is very steep.
We would definitely come back.
Great location. Within one mile of most of the stuff we wanted to do. Lots of food around and shopping as well.

Beautiful location with stunning views!
The location was absolutely gorgeous, with breathtaking views right outside the window. The facilities were excellent, and everything was spotlessly clean. While carrying our suitcases up the stairs was a bit of a challenge, it was totally worth it for the incredible setting and comfort we enjoyed. Would definitely stay again!

We had an amazing Day and night for the St John, Best view that We could expect and a perfect host Who told us all what We need to know about porto.  Bruno and his wife offered us some gift for the St John it was really nice. ...We Will come back!

Our first AirBNB experience and probably the best ever! What a lovely place to stay! The view is amazing! Drinking port on the balcony was the best! We loved the city, evenmore because Bruno told us everything about it and send us to the best places to go for a coffee, for diner and for the port tasting. Bruno is a great host, we could call him 24/7. The room is very very clean and new. We will be back!
A fantastic place to stay with beautiful view of the Douro river and bridge. Very helpful owner. recomment this place to anyone who wnats to visit Porto!

Bruno was a good host and give to us a map of Porto and explain places in things to do in the city. The apartment is comfortable and very good placed, close to River Duero and historical Ribeira of Porto and has a very good view of the city. I totally recommend  this apartment.

Beautifull apartment, and Bruno was a great host. He gave us advice on where to go and what to see in Porto, I would definitely recommend this apartment to anybody who is going there. It looks exactly like the pictures and the location is awesome!

We had a great stay at Balcony of Douro Riverfronts and can highly recommend this place.  The view across the river to Oporto is absolutely amazing and the location is very convenient; just a short walk across the bridge takes you directly to the historical city centre.  Bruno was a lovely host and provided plenty of information about local restaurants and attractions to visit in Oporto and Vila Nova de Gaia.  The bedroom was very modern and tidy with en-suite bathroom.   There is also a kitchen and outdoor area looking over the riverfront - perfect for a relaxing evening with a glass of Port.  Thanks Bruno - we very much enjoyed our stay.  :)
Wonderful place, just like the pictures! It's very comfortable, impecably clean, and with a spectacular view! Bruno was very nice and helpful and we had a great time!

This apt is a real gem & highly recommended. Super clean, comfortable bed, beautiful decor, and a view of Porto that is amazing. Very convenient for exploring Villa Nova de Gaia & Porto. Bruno was very helpful & responsive.

Absolutely amazing flat to stay at in Porto. The house is amazingly beautiful with very modern furnishings in a lovely old house. No words for the view. I had to take so many pictures at all different times of day, even from within the bedroom itself as the view is simply that amazing. Bruno is a fantastic host, who for even my short visit made sure I had all the required knowledge to have a great time in the city. Be sure to listen to his food and wine recommendations!! Will be returning to Porto soon to see the city properly, and Bruno is the first one I will try and book!
Loved staying here! My only wish was that we could've stayed longer! It was beautifully located with the best views. Love it.

Everything perfect, in a beautiful place of Porto, very clean and new house, but at the same time very tipica.
Bruno is super helpful with a lot of advices for the vacation.
No others words are needed

Bruno was a great host and gave very useful advice for visiting the city.  The place is within an easy walk to the major attractions of Porto and Gaia. And the view of Porto is incredible. Thanks for the great stay.

unbelievable nice view from the window, great location! Bruno is very friendly to give us the tips to enjoy the city!
Highly recommend!

Loved staying here! This side of the river is definitely key as it gives you the beautiful view (and the walk across the bridge is well worth it). Bruno met us at check-in and had amazing suggestions for our stay. We didn't do much trip planning and now I'm glad we didn't because we pretty much used his suggestions. As advertised, it is a shared home. There's wifi but it can be slow/spotty. Overall loved it and would stay here again!
His place is amazing!!! The view here is the best from the whole city. Loved everything about it. Hope to come back someday!

Incredible views. Possibly the best in Porto!!! Short walk to the shops and across the river to Porto. Host was excellent, was there on arrival, showed us around and gave us some very useful tips for getting around. House was very clean, modern and almost hotel-like in terms of features. Great experience

Bruno’s place is INCREDIBLE! If it is available, book it right now. The view for sunset is one of the most beautiful things I have ever seen, not to mention you have a private balcony to walk out on to watch from. Bruno was an excellent host, and he will give you tips for anything and everything in Porto. Thank you so much, Bruno!

Our stay at Bruno’s place was a highlight of our time in Porto. Everything is just as described and the view is outstanding! We were so glad we stayed on the Gaia side to enjoy the views of Porto.
Bruno is also a fabulous host! Not only did he meet us at the place and provide us with a map and description of what to see and do, he also saved a parking spot for us and helped us park our car! I highly recommend staying here if you’re visiting Porto!

This is one of the best Airbnb’s we stayed at! The view is amazing, so even when you’re resting, you get the see all of Porto from your window. Bruno met us at arrival and gave us a quick tour of the property plus a map of Porto with plenty of local tips. He regularly checked in to make sure everything was ok. There’s a supermarket and a bakery nearby so we had breakfast on the balcony overlooking Porto every morning. The best start of the day! Sunsets with a glass of Porto wine were also pretty amazing. Thank you Bruno!

Great location, great space with a lovely view of Porto and easy to find. Bruno responds quickly and is quite helpful in making the stay as accommodating as possible. I look forward to visiting again.

Fantastic place - location is amazing with an unbelievable view! Bruno was a great host and provided us with great suggestions of places to see and things to do in Porto. Would definitely stay here again.
Bruno is such a nice and a really helping person! We appreciated him, our stay and the accommodation a lot. Would come back at any time.

Awesome wee place in a brilliant location with a fabulous view! Comfy bed, coffee for the mornings and a little shared kitchennette with one other room.
We did the self check in which was super easy and the communication was great!

An Amazing place to stay and worth the few extra dollars! Bruno is a wonderful host and meet us at the house. He showed us around and gave tips of the city, which came in so well! The place was clean and plenty of room. Larger than expected shower. The house is located on the side of the river with all of the wineries and food hall.
The best part of the house is the view of Porto. One of the best views of the city hands down. The view out of the window includes the water and a full view of Porto. Best part of our trip was sitting out on the balcony, drinking port, and looking at the city.
We loved this place! It was perfect for two. The view cannot be beaten and is the perfect private spot for watching the sunset!
Bruno was incredibly helpful and the place was wonderful. Fantastic value for money. would highly recommend!

How gorgeous to be able to see the iconic views of Porto from the moment you wake up in the morning until you go to bed at night! The rooms are not large, but clean and tidy, and we are able to leave two large suitcases open.
We stayed around Christmas, so it was difficult to find places to eat, but the location usually has good access to restaurants and tourist attractions. However, it is located in the middle of a cobbled slope, so care must be taken when carrying suitcases. For those who plan to use a washing machine, remember to bring detergent.
Bruno was very courteous and flexible with the check-in time.

We visited Porto as a couple and Bruno’a place was a hidden gem. The views from the room are really nice (better than the photos), the bed was comfortable an the room has a/c for the warm summer days/nights. Location was also good, we never needed the metro to get around.
Bruno's place was just perfect for our stay.  The location and views were amazing.  Bruno also gave us great tips and his communication was excellent!  I highly recommend Bruno and this location.

Would have loved to stay another night or 2 here. The view is fantastic, and the patio in the backyard is perfect for a drink overlooking the Douro river (or breakfast). Clean and the bed was very comfy. Air conditioning as well.
A great location, especially if you want to tour the Port houses and riverfront.
overall I was very happy with our stay here. 👍
You don't need to look for beautiful views in Porto, you have the best one from your bed!
Our stay there, Bruno’s place, the neighborhood, everything was wonderful. Much much better than we expected 😊😍 thank you for everything Bruno🙏
We had a very comfortable stay at Bruno’s. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who is looking for place to stay in Porto/Gaia.

Wonderful stay in a beautiful location! the views of Porto are stunning and it is very easy to walk across the bridge into the city. restaurants on both sides of the river are excellent! Bruno's space was clean and private and had everything we needed. Bruno was very helpful and friendly!

Perfectly located! Amazing view over the river and at the Bridge. Easy to find and Bruno provided a whole Booklet with helpful instructions for the stay. Check-in was really easy with just a door code.

Amazing host, room and location. Can't fault our stay. Bruno and his wife assisted us with dropping off our luggage pre check in, so we could explore the city as soon as we arrived. The river front was within walking distance and the local metro station was just 5 minutes walk away. Will definitely stay again and recommend to others.

Bruno’s place must have the best views in Porto. The views from our windows were simply stunning. The accommodation was beautiful and very comfortable. We slept extremely well due to quality of bed and mattress. The provision of tea/coffee making facilities and a well stocked fridge - beer, wine, water, etc was a nice touch. The air conditioning (which also provided heat on the cooler days) was very good. Bruno was very quick to respond to any queries which was excellent. We would not hesitate to come back here again. The accommodation is on a sloping street but if you access the street via the steps from Jardim Do Morro gardens then you are walking downhill to accommodation. If you use the same route when heading into Vila De Gaia or Porto then you will be fine. Bruno was a fantastic host. He is never intrusive and just lets you get on with your holiday but is always there when you need him. Thank you Bruno.

Very easy check in with a friendly face to greet us at the apartment. The space was just as described and a beautiful open apartment with large balcony and view of the city. Everything was nicely prepared, new, and clean. The location was perfect for seeing all the historic sites and also close to the metro. We had a wonderful time and would highly recommend this location for a great stay in Madrid!
Lovely clean and calm apartment - great location.  Close to the river and the beautiful winding roads that lead to it. Exciting ice cream shop a few doors down!
We had a great stay here in Porto. Amazing view and the apartment is gorgeous.  Rafael was really helpful with check in.
Fantastic location that's super easy to get to and from. Rafael was really kind and welcoming and made our stay a lot easier

Everything was great! We stayed only one night as we stopped in Porto once again on our way home, but we would love to stay longer in this apartment. Spacious, sunny, modern and well equipped. The location and building are 5stars! Host gave us some tips on restaurants and had the best meal in whole trip!

Excellent apartment. Raphael is very helpful and very fast to respond to any question. The apartment is wonderful with large windows that give you a great view of the city. It's centrally located and is very close to an excellent ice cream spot and Casa Guedes that had the best Sande de Pernil I've ever had.

We had a wonderful stay at Rafaëls apartment. It was very spacious and we could find everything that we needed. Rafaël responded so quickly on all our messages. Our first experience with airbnb was great.

This place is amazing for a short or long stay at Oporto. It's location is one of the best we have seen so far in this city. It's about a 5m walk from the center of the town. We visit in the winter and the big windows and sun exposure assured a warm and cosy place to get back to at the end of the day. The only minor drawback is the amount of stairs you have to climb to get to the room. But the view and the noiseless nights make up for it. If you are visiting Oporto, without a car don't hesitate to book this one!

Rafael is an excellent host and was there to greet us and explain the apartment and location of nearby services. The apartment is a very nice bright space and in very walkable location to many Porto attractions. We also appreciated the daily clean towels and being able to use the washing machine. We would certainly recommend staying here.

Great flat, great view from the balcony, great location, great and detail recommendations from the host!
Will definitely recommend this flat!

Comfortable, stunning views and extremely convenient location. We only spent one night there but we would have loved to be able to spend more! Next time we visit Porto, we hope it is available for us again!

Rafael's studio apartment was great! It was perfect for my boyfriend and I for the 3 nights we stayed in Porto - very clean, great location, good view, and had AC which was crucial since it was very hot when we came in September. Highly recommended!
Excellent location, easy walk to the main attractions in Porto. Very comfortable and clean apartment. Our favourite feature was the balcony. Nice modern decor. I would definitely recommend.
This place is beautiful and has everything you need. Simao is a great host and I would really recommend the apartment!

Everything was Perfect! The Check in worked without and complication. We didn‘t meet Simao but one of his colleagues gave us the keys and many recommendations for our stay.
The appartment is Perfect for a couple or close friends. Also the balcony is very beautiful.
We will definetely come back!

Simao’s place was incredible. The entire experience and building makes you feel like you’re staying at a 5 star hotel. We had every amenity we needed and slept incredibly. We loved this place so much that we spent half the day lounging on the huge balcony enjoying the weather and view. Definitely would stay here again!

We had a great time at Simao’s place. The apartment was clean and airy, and we had a nice view from the balcony. Check in was super easy and quick and it was great to be shown around the apartment. Our host was very quick to respond and super helpful with our questions.

We had a great stay here. It had a beautiful view from the balcony. It had soap, shampoo, coffee etc. We were about a 10-15 min walk into the main part of town. The check in process was smooth and they even allowed us to store our luggage when our flight was delayed.

Simao was honestly one of the best hosts I've ever experienced on Airbnb. He helped us find parking for our car, and even got into the car with us to help find the garage because we drove by it several times and didn't even notice! He showed us everything we needed to know about the place, and also offered some restaurant suggestions upon request.
The space itself is as pictured, with high ceilings and an amazing patio. The door-to-floor windows were amazing to wake up to.

This apartment was beautiful and worth the few stairs we had to climb. The views from the terrace were amazing and the space was so thoughtfully designed. The location was also fantastic and we had no problem walking everywhere we wanted to go. Paulo also was very helpful in proving tips and giving an earlier checkin. Although they were still cleaning, we were able to leave our bags while we got some lunch. Overall, a great experience and we would stay again next time we come to Porto.
Fantastic location and views to the city. Very cozy place to stay if you came to visit the city. I recommend it :)

Nice location, cozy apartment and a great balcony to eat breakfast or just enjoy the night view.
Great for a short stay in.
Very good communication with the host and very helpful. It was wonderful staying for a night in this cosy flat. I recommand !

Cesar is a great host. He is very attentive, communicative, reliable and always available. His apartment is amazing, fully equipped (huge tv screen, fast internet, large collection of music and books, games, towels and umbrellas for the beach and a lot more), modern and bigger than it looks in the pictures. I would say that it is an american unit in Portugal. There is everything you need to enjoy and have a great holiday. The beach is really near. The pool is great and perfect for a windy day. The building is surrounded by natural preserved area in a nice and calm quartier. Mr Araujo were there for the check in and the check out. All went so smooth. We are certainly coming back soon. Muito obrigado !

We enjoyed stay in Cesar appartment very well. It was clean and safe and we felt like home. We would also prefer when you visit with your Family or two other friends (2 couples) there are two separte bedrooms with own bathrooms. I like to thank also Nuno for check in and kind showing the appartment.
I should tell that was our first airbnb. But thanks this expierence we will use more in the future. If we would come back anytime to PT or Vila do Conde, we going to come back to Cesar/Nuno.
Thanks also for nice comunication before and after stay.
kind regards from Switzerland
Michaela & Bruno
Really great condo with immediate beach access. Everything was in great shape and it was well-equipped. We had a totally easy and great week at Azurara and in Vila Do Conde.

Great located, just some minutes walking to downtown. Very charming place, just as the pictures are. Very well decorated and clean. It has everything you need!!
Helena was very responsive, she helped with everything before we arrived and Arturo received us, he was super nice, he gave us lots of tips to enjoy Porto, all his recomendations where very useful for our stay! They were also very flexible with our check in and out time
Thank you!!!!!!

Helena was super welcoming, met me up at a convenient time, gave good advice on what to visit. Appartment is fantastic, great quiet location 5-min walk from the heart of the city. Appartment is in excellent condition, with all the appliances and utensils one might need. Can host up to 5 people (has two double beds + has 1 folding bed). Sereral supermarkets nearby. Excellent value for money, highly recommend.

Helena's apartment is just like the pictures. Very spacious and well kitted out.

The bed is really comfy and with the original shutters on the windows it keeps the sun out perfectly until you decide you went to get up. So perfect for lazy mornings.

The area itself seems more local than touristy but it's only 5 minutes from the shopping street and not that much further to the Cathedral.
There are quite a few bars and restaurants with in walking distance of the apartement.
Right downstairs is is a very nice cafe which serves a wonderful breakfast. There is also an ice cream shop which is very nice if you want to sit out for a coffee. If you want supplies you are just minutes away from 2 large supermarkets.

I would definitely recommend this apartment it is spotlessly clean and has a warm feel about it.

Arthur welcomed us during our arrival, showed us everything on the map, recommended some places to eat. The apartment itself was just like described and shown on the photos. The neighborhood is nice, when you open the windows it is a bit noisy but I guess that is what you get when you want an apartment in the city center.
We really like this apartment. It is beautiful, clean, in the city center, and well equipment. The host is hospitality, everything is wonderful. We must come back again if I go to Porto.

It was as lovely as in the pictures or even better. We had the posibility to do an early check-in and also they kept our luggage till late after check-out. Great location with a couple of amazing places for breakfast or to eat and drink at anytime. The apartment is comfortable quiet and has everything we needed. Thanks!
Helena's place was wonderful! Very walkable to shops & restaurants. Great interior with everything you need. Arthur greeted us and he was so friendly and helpful. Would definitely recommend!

José's appartment is very big, very clean and just beautiful with a huge living room, a nice balcony and a well-equipped kitchen. The check-in was easy - I arrived late in the evening, which was no problem at all. And Jose was a great host, very friendly, polite and helpful. I can definitely recommend this appartment - it's not that central but you only have to walk 5-7 minutes to the next metro station and then it takes another 10 minutes to drive to the centre of Porto. So - if you're looking for a relaxing place with a lot of space, go for it!
The apartment was spacious, clean and central! Helena and Artur were greats hosts and very helpful with directions and were quick to respond if we needed anything. We had a great experience.

Lovely flat in a traditional Porto building that was fully renovated - high ceilings, big windows, loads of light, bakeries and bars literally on your doorstep.
There's a small park right in front of the flat, and a great green view greeting you from your window.
I have been to Porto many times and can't recommend this location highly enough - Jardim de Sao Lazaro is right next the core historic city centre (Baixa do Porto) and yet is not a hugely busy area - you can walk to the historic city centre and still enjoy a quiet night of sleep!
Make sure you try the pulled pork sandwich in the restaurant to the left of the flat!
All in all highly recommended flat and area in Porto.

Great apartment, great location, great hospitality. We absolutely loved our stay in this lovely city. We wholeheartedly recommend this apartment - it has everything you need, is super clean and cosy and everything is in walking distance!

We enjoyed the space.  Very close to the downtown area and easy enough to find our way, especially after Pedro spent time explaining the detailed map of porto city and the sites we had to be sure to see.  This made it quite easy to get around.   We walked all day and had a great time.  The flat was great, bed comfortable and we felt right at home.   We would definitely recommend this space.  It is built for two.
Good apartment not far from the city. Nice and clean. All good. Parking is for free, always have space. Was so pleasure to stayed there. Thank you a lots.
Was clean and owner was a great host. Area a little rough around the edges but ok. A little away from city center so you need to take subway or car. A little noisy at night in the street.
Nice and cozy place, apartment very bright and well furnished. Josè has always been helpful and available at any time.
Although I checked in without meeting the owners, that was no problem, and Jose let me check in at 7.00 in the morning. That really made all the difference on my early arrival in Porto.

Wonderful place very central in Porto, easy to reach the sights and good places to eat. We would recommend this to anyone who wants a nice place in Porto. Only minus is that it smells a tiny bit moldy, so for for someone with asthma it should be taken into consideration. But other than that perfect.

We've just arrived home from a great 4 night stay in Porto. The apartment is very centrally located with some great cafes/restaurants/bars within minutes. There's a great supermarket locally & a very cheap pastry shop a few doors away on the corner.
We'd certainly return to this apartment in the near future.
The place was just as described on the web and communication was fast. Great location without being noisy and really cosy place.
Nice place, lovely location but the bedroom does not have a door and leads into the living area where the third person is staying.

Gil was very nice and welcoming. The apartment is immaculate and beautifully decorated. The view of the river in the photos of this flat is not a lie--it is incredible. Everything in the apartment is top-notch.

The neighborhood has a few cafes, and a minipreco if you want to cook, but not much else. It's in Gaia, which is across the bridge from Porto proper. I enjoyed this a lot, because we got to walk across the Dom Luis I bridge a few times per day, which has the best view of Porto.

All in all, 10/10, would stay here again if I ever came back to Porto.

The host were very easy to communicate thru Airbnb messages, we were meeting Sonia instead of Pedro. Sonia was very helpful and provided all the information we need. The apartment is very nice and exactly the same as shown in the pictures. It is very convenience to live here as the metro station is just right outside the apartment. I would recommend this apartment.

We had a lovely stay at this spotless, spacious, luxurious and well-equipped apartment with superb views of Porto. Location was great: a short walk down the road and over the bridge and you'll find yourself in the middle of Porto's centre. Sonia and Pedro were also super helpful and quick to reply. Highly recommend this place!
I have stayed in AirBNB places all over the world, and this was one of the best. A beautiful, well cared for apartment in a great location. And the view in the pictures is real!

Pedro and Sonia's apartment is in a great location for exploring Porto and especially the port cellars of Gaia. The apartment is beautifully renovated with plenty of space. Pedro was very communicative and had no problem meeting us for check in even though we were delayed on arrival. We would definitely consider staying here again when next in Porto. Thanks Pedro and Sonia!

We had a fantastic experience at this flat and highly recommend it.  Everything about the place was top class, from the spacious and fully-equipped kitchen to the comfortable master suite with king bed.  The kitchen view and convenience of neighborhood amenities (pastry shop and fruit stores downstairs, mini-market with GREAT port prices around the corner) were a big bonus, as was the super fast wifi.  Thanks to Sonia and Pedro for being such attentive, informative and accommodating hosts.

The apartment is very lovely, well equiped and very close to the riverside and city centre of Porto. Pedro and Sonia are very welcoming and helped us out whenever we had any questions. We really enjoyed our stay and we will come back again!

A beautiful flat with all of the modern amenities. Pedro was kind enough to show us how all of the appliances worked. There was coffee already in the flat which was much appreciated. There is some street noise, so I'd suggest using a white noise app on a phone or tablet. Great place, will repeat it back in Porto.

Luxury apartment a beautiful 5-10 minutes from all the action.  We loved the view from our balcony of the Douro at night.  The apartment in is Vila Nova de Gaia which I loved -- it allows you to look out over the river and the old town of Porto.  Did I mention everything is on easy transit?  Did I mention you don't need it at all?  We walked across the bridge for the best view and loved feeling part of a neighbourhood quite close to everything but away from the crowds.

The apartment is perfect! Very well located, totally furnished with a beautiful view of the Douro's river and very comfortable! Pedro was an amazing host and gave us all the necessary tips about the city. I would recommend to anyone looking for a perfect spot to stay in Porto.

Perhaps the best apartment I have ever stayed at through Airbnb. The beds are very comfortable, and the entire place is well-stocked and immaculate from the rooms to the living space to the bathrooms. Pedro is a very responsive and gracious host, and gave us tips for where to go in Porto. Fantastic experience overall.
Great spacious and immaculate place to stay in Porto! Pedro was very helpful with timely responses to any of our questions.

Pedro's apartment is very spacious and clean. Everything was very modern.  Beds were comfy, but best of all were the views from the balconies.  Parking spot was a huge plus.  Surprisingly close to almost everything in Porto. Highly recommended

If you are looking for a perfect location apartment with great host, here it is! Very well decorated, spacious and clean. Even if you have a big car it is still possible to park in the garage! It was a perfect choice for our family of 6!
We were impressed by how clean and well decored this place is. Very well located as well. A few minutes away from the Dom Louis bridge and historic center.
Amazing stay at Pedro's apartment, very well located and outstanding river view. For sure will come back!

Beautiful, spacious apartment in the best location.
With a very large, modern and fully loaded kitchen, a comfortable living room filled with natural light, three bedrooms and 2 1/2 bathrooms this place is pretty much all you need while visiting Porto.
A 5 minute walk to the pedestrian bridge and close to everything you might need.
Pedro was very quick to respond and super eager to offer tips on where to eat, what to visit etc.
Would definitely book again next time we're in Porto.

The kitchen and river view are the highlights of this place, not to be understated. Staying on the Gaia side of the river was even better than directly in Porto center. Location is convenient with transit and walking options available. There is an ATM, pastry shops, and grocery stores all within 5 minutes walking. If you're parking a car, best to not have anything larger than a midsize sedan as the garage spot is economical...but very secure and convenient. We are so grateful for Pedro's place and wished we could have stayed longer. Thank you.

A perfect place near Porto. Just across the river where almost all of the Port Caves are found is Pedro’s wonderful home. The flat is obviously recently updated with all modern amenities and extras of everything. The location was perfect for our family and the multiple bathrooms a real hit. We will certainly recommend to friends and hope to one day return.
Excellent place for visiting Porto. Great location, very comfortable apartment (great beds and well-stocked kitchen), and the hosts are top notch in every respect. Highly recommended.

This was one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed in.  Pedro was immediately responsive with any questions, and the apartment was immaculate and extremely well appointed - especially the kitchen!  Although the apartment was not in Porto, it was just a short walk away over the bridge.  And Vila Nova de Gaia had    a bustling waterfront and wonderful port cellars!

We had a wonderful stay in Porto and Pedro was an excellent host!
The location of the apartment is great .

We drove from Salamanca to Porto, after a bit of time we found the apartment and Pedro advised us where to park the van.
Apartment was fantastic with the best view across the Douro River.
The apartment was stylish, spacious and very clean. We loved it and highly recommend!

Really clean, modern apartment with great views over the river. Quieter side of the river which was nice, but still plenty to do, but only a short walk to the Ribeira neighbourhood. Pedro was really helpful and checked us in at 1:30am after a flight delay.
Perfection.   Every night was a gorgeous sunset. The space was clean, accessible,  awesome.  I’d certainly recommend this space to everyone.   Cheers
we both like the apartment very much. it is well designed and very clean. walk to the bridge within several minutes. easy communication   for any queries.

The apartment itself is super-stylish, well-appointed and clean. All the furnishings and fittings are top-notch.
The views are stunning. Porto is really picturesque, day or night, rain or shine.
The location is fantastic. Tram stop right outside. A lovely walk across the bridge to the historic city centre. Great coffee/pastry shop downstairs and a sushi restaurant literally next door.
Pedro is a responsive and generous host. Checking in with Isabel was a breeze. She explained the ins and outs perfectly.
I'll definitely be back.
Obrigado!
Well located apartment in Gaia. A little noisy from the Avenue Republicia side of the apartment. Modern kitchen and lovely views of the river.

This is a beautiful apartment with a high finish throughout. There are three spacious and comfortable bedrooms and a large living area and kitchen. The apartment is very well equipped with every possible thing you could need.
There are many cafes and restaurants nearby and its just a 10 minute walk across the bridge to the city centre.
Porto is a fantastic city and I would highly recommend this apartment.

This location in Gaia was amazing!! It provided everything possible; from the spacious rooms, the kitchen with every amenity possible and an amazing view from the balcony! We took a quick uber ride into the heart of Porto and then made a day of sightseeing and walked back to Gaia. Took a Tram down to the waterfront where we did some shopping and had a fantastic dinner, one of many restaurants. We loved every bit of our stay and recommend staying here! We wish we had more time at this location and would definitely return!!

Loved our stay!
Pedro gave us great tips as a local
Pleasant stay and helpful host!
OMG, total gem.  Location is outstanding.  Can walk anywhere.  Apartment is even more beautiful than pictures.  Best stocked I have ever stayed in.  Lots of room.  Would recommend!!

Lovely and comfortable place.  Appreciated the cinephile and travel themed decor throughout the unit.  Great view of the river from the balcony.  Well stocked kitchen with all the basics needed for cooking in.  Grocery, bakery, place for coffee all just below on street level.   15-20 minute leisurely walk from apartment to San Bento.  < 5 minute walk to bridge/Nova Guia park.

We absolutely loved Pedro's apartment. It's clear he takes great pride and care and the apartment was beautifully furnished, spacious with high quality appliances and fittings. The view from the balcony is great although a bit of a squeeze to get comfy on. The plumbing takes a little mastery and patience to suss out but it eventually delivers a nice hot shower. A really solid location, easy walking distance to Ponte Luis Bridge and downtown Porto. A special mention for the bbq takeaway over the road - great value and pairs nicely with an evening on the sofa and a good film! Top notch all round - thanks Pedro!

A beautiful apartment that was clean and in a great area in Gaia that was an easy walk over to Porto and was on the side of the river with the Port houses.  Pedro met us to check in and helped is park underground.  Beds comfortable.  Air conditioning.  Kitchen fully stocked.  No hesitation in recommending.
Great location. Pedro was a great host at our checkin. Extremely friendly. He really tried to give us as many tips as possible about Porto/Gaia and the surroundings.
host Pedro was very friendly and informative.   very easy check in.  beautiful apartment near all amenities and metro with safe parking.. highly recommended.

This was one of the few occasions when the apartment was actually better than the photos (and the photos were great!).  Pedro's apartment is clean, and extremely well kitted out.  The location is great for exploring Porto, we walked everywhere!  We were grateful for Pedro for his recommendations of places to see, and restaurants to go to too - it really helped us to make the most of our time in Porto.

Great location. Train station is very convenient, 2 stops into Porto and a longer travel station for other cities. Host was nice and accommodating. Walkable to vila de Gaia the port wine coast line area with tons of restaurants and beautiful views of Porto.
Minor things that didn’t bother me enough to drop a star but apartment walls are a bit thin and can hear neighbors late into the night. Water pressure and temperature is very inconsistent where only one of the showers could be used at a time. Renovated but not as nice in person.

We had a wonderful stay in your lovely apartment. Thank you for all your sightseeing help and advice including recommending the chicken take out across the street and the delicious pastries from the pastry shop at ground level under the apartments.
The apartment is in a great location, just a short walk across the bridge from old Porto. The Metro is at the door and the Andante ticket office steps away where we found a very helpful lady. She guided us through the planning of our Metro and bus trips using the Andante card which gives you unlimited use in and around the city.
The view from the apartment, especially the sunsets over the Douro were an extra plus.
Pedro was so helpful.  His recommendations was appreciated and on point.  Beautiful apartment and ideal location. Highly recommend
A beautiful, high spec, perfectly located apartment.  We had a lovely 2 night stay, wish we could have stayed longer!

Great location, walkable around Gaia and over to central Porto across the bridge. Apartment was very nice and spacious and in a quiet area. We weren’t disturbed at all by the trains going past. Showers weren’t great, very low water pressure and kept going from hot to cold several times whilst showering. Pedro provided very useful information when he greeted us at the apartment, and would have been available if we needed anything during our stay.

Luxury, that’s how i would described it.
It has everything you need for a great stay.
Pedro was so helpful, he showed us everything. He also gave us recommendations for how to get to things, this made life so much easier. Also, gave us recommendations for restaurants and places to eat. We tried a few and he was right in every case.
If you go to Porto, this is the place to stay, location is perfect.

Fantastic stay with Pedro. Apartment was exactly what we needed. 3 nice bedrooms equipped with everything you might need other than TV’s. Check-in process was great, pedro met us downstairs, gave us a tour of the apartment and showed us how to use the appliances etc along with a guide as to the area with recommendations for food and travel. Did have an issue with the TV in the front room but wasn’t the end of the world. Plenty of travel options with the tram station right outside. Uber over the bridge in Porto central cost around €5 and took 10mins max. Supermarket around 5 mins walk and open til 11pm. Chicken shop across the road was really good too, Cheap and nice food. Full chicken and various sides came to under €20. All in all I would definitely stay here again if we come back to Porto. Thank you Pedro!

Good location close to Ponte Luis bridge. Can easily walk to all major places in the centre and metro runs close by. Pedro gave us a tour of the apartment and provide us recommendations for restaurants in the local area. Apartment is furnished to a high standard and everything you could need is available. There is a great view from the rear balcony. Some noise currently from building works but this didnt bother us as we were out during the day. Overall great location to explore Porto.

Great place to stay in Porto, very walkable to any area you would want to explore and places to eat. There is also a metro stop right outside the apartment if needed.
Multiple bathrooms and the host lives just above, in case there are any issues.
on Check-in he was very helpful and answered all our questions about where to eat and what to do!

Great stay at Pedro’s place! They were super great communicators and promptly answered all questions immediately. There is construction going on all around the apartment building - this didn’t impact our stay whatsoever since we were busy/out and about all day, but definitely good to consider depending on your plans. It is also important to note that there is only air conditioning in the master bedroom, and we actually ended up moving one of the fans into the master to increase air flow. This would have been a problem if we needed to use the third bedroom, but we made it work! Definitely consider booking this apartment if you’re looking for a newly renovated and sleek place - we would return in cooler months and absolutely book with Pedro again!

I really enjoyed staying in this place. The location is amazing, just behind of a nice square where people usually go to see the sunset!
Suzana, who lives in the second floor is there to help in whatever you need.
The appartment has a great location, near the Clérigo tower. From the balcony you have a nice view on the river. A good place for a short stay in the city.

This place is a very good place to stay for a few days to explore Porto. It is close to all the important sightseeing sites in the historical district and there are many good restaurants around. The place was clean and had everything that we needed for our stay. Most importantly, Susanna was very friendly, made sure we had everything and even made our taxi arrangements for our ride back to the airport and train stations. So, overall, we are very pleased with our stay. Thanks!

You will be in the heart of the old City which is very convenient for all historical sites , bring a good paire of shoes for walking in the old city
Antoine and his wife are very lovely people and very helpful !

We really loved room in Bernardo's garden house. We have been kindy welcomedby Marta, who showed us room and present leaflet with the biggest attractions in Porto. Bernardo was very nice and welcoming, gave me information about other interesting places in Portugal. We have appreciated beautiful and clean room and it's privacy. Communication to city centre is very good by bus  (takes about 15 minuts, bus stop is few stepsfrom house).

We stayed at Bernardo's three nights and really enjoyed it. The room was clean, arranged and corresponded provided information. We were warmly welcomed by his wife. Even though the bedroom is located in their house, we had our own entrance and space - for those who wants privacy. When the weather got cold, Bernardo gave us a heater. Wifi didn't work properly thus we had a rest from social media. Overall, it is a good option for the price.

Our stay in Porto was PERFECT due to this apartment. The apartment itself is gorgeous, it has got all the utensils, it is very clean, the bed was super comfortable, the air-conditioner works really well (it cooled down the whole flat within minutes, very necessary since the average temperature during the day was around 30 degrees or more). The neighbourhood is fantastic, lots of restaurants and bars around and also 2 supermarkets which we used to get our groceries from. The city centre and the metro are within walking distance. "Casa dos Guedes" is a snack bar just downstairs from the apartment and they serve a traditional delicious sandwich, definitely worth a visit. Helena is a great host, she showed us a map of Porto and gave us tips of where to go and what to do. Porto is a fantastic city, so was our stay at Helena's apartment. If you are coming to Porto you won't regret staying here! Thank you Helena for everything!

I certainly recommend staying in one of the flats owned by Helena.

Our flat was very cosy. No to big yet perfect for couple.

Neighborhood is very nice, close to city center (7min walk).

Helenas husband was nice and met us at our arrival in the late evening at the appartement and was helpfully showing us the city sites on a map. The appartement is stylish, clean and cosy. Also its location is perfect to start the day with a breakfast in the café next door or to walk to the historic city centre. Two cool bars with young alternative ambiente are situated just across the square left hand side. Thanks for a comfotable stay.

Didn't like it.   Paid for 3 nights. Left after two. Low bathroom doorway. 5' 2"?  Hit my head 4 times. Loose Manhole cover in street, Thunk/Chunk all night. Weak -at best- Internet. Bernardo's response was 200 people have stayed, I was the first to complain & the low doorway was part of the 'charm'.

Each time I asked a question by mail  Bernardo answered  very quickly. His wife was there earlier than first said to welcome us. Public transport are very easy to use to arrive nearly at the gate. The room was as described.

Bernardo was extremely nice. He has a wonderful house with a beautiful garden. The house is very accurately described. A bus stop, supermarket and a few restaurants are just a two minute walk away. The room has an Independent entrance so you won't be disturbing anyone if you get back late in the night. I would definitely recommend this place!

Bernando is so kind and gentle. Also he will suggests and list the places that you should visit or the restaurant you should try;). His house is near the bus stop which is very easy to catch the bus to city center or the beach. Unfortunately the wifi is a little bit low and can not connect sometimes. My brother and I really like staying in his house because it feels like home and I will go back again if I have that chance 😊😊😊

Bernardo's place is a good solution if you want to avoid driving the car in Porto downtown. You can park in the streets around the house and easily reach the city centre by bus. Bernardo is very helpful and, as we arrived, he gave us a list of restaurants where to eat (downtown and also near his place) and things not to miss in Porto. He also let us store our luggage after the check out and called a taxi to the airport for us.
Thank you Bernardo!

Bernardo is a great host, the room was clean and cozy, the best thing that it has private bathroom. The neghborhood is nice and not far from the centre, but you should be prepared to wait for the bus for a while on a weekend.There was just one thing that complicated our stay: the room has no heater, so it was really, really cold. Nevertheless we stayed in November, there is no such problem during the most time of the year.

Bernardo is a friendly host. Communication was good. The place is located 10min from.the centre by car or 20min by buss. It is though very near a buss station. I would recommend it during summer, but less during winter. Because it used to be an old wine cellar the room stays damp and cold when the weather is cold and rainy.
The beds were pretty hard not very comfortable but we do got a lot of blankets to keep ourself warm.
Wifi wasn't working properly when we were there, but I think the host will fix that soon.

You get what you pay for. What to expect for 30€/day?
We received: good check-in, was hard to find the place (look around bus station Berlengas; don’t look at house numbers), parking was on the street somewhere (we could always find one around the corner - walking 300-500m. Parking inside was too inconvenient for us), room was not as bright as it seems on the picture, beds were comfortable, bathroom was clean, bus station nearby, very easy and very frequent in only 15/20 minutes into town but 1,95€/person/trip, kitchen and dishes available for small breakfast and keeping food fresh.
It was a good stay for three days but next time we would choose something different we think. It’s good value for the money though.
Bernardos place is ideally situated for exploring Porto as travel to and from the centre is easy by bus. Unfortunately the property is by a noisy main road. Bernardo is very friendly and helpful.

Bernardo and his lovely wife Marta were absolutely wonderful and so helpful and welcoming.  The AirBnb was comfortable and extremely clean and the property has the most beautiful gardens.  The location is excellent and very easy to travel to the centre of Porto - a short distance by bus.  I can certainly recommend their AirBnB to anyone who will be visiting Porto and I very much enjoyed meeting Bernardo and Marta.

This is a very pleasant Airbnb with a very nice and helpful host. The setting is unexpected and lovely. Although not in the central city, the 600 bus is just outside and goes straight there. The metro is an easy 15 walk as well, stopping at IPO.
The communication with Bernardo was easy and he replied always very fast. The place was as described, it was really clean and next to the bus stop. I only can recommend his place.

Nice apartment with a really small door to the bathroom ;-) It's a bit of distance to the city centre, but there are busses directly in front of the door. A Supermarket and pasteleria are also quite near. Everything was really uncomplicated.

We had a lovely time in Helena's apartment. It is very well located and spacious. The shower is very modern and stylish. The balcony is small but big enough for two to enjoy some porto tonico. We would love to come back some day.

We had a wonderful stay at Helena and Arturo's apartment. It had everything you needed...a convenient location, nice bed, washing machine, air conditioning, big shower, kitchen and dedicated parking for your car if needed. We were greeted by the facility lady who was very sweet and showed us everything we needed to know about the apartment and Porto. When we left my girlfriend forgot a couple of clothes in the apartment and the hosts were so kind to ship them to us. Thank you!! We would definitely stay here again if visit Porto again!

Felt right at home at bernados place. Host met me on arrival, friendly and welcoming. He recommended beaches and buses. The house was located directly opposite a nice food store. Place just like the pictures. He went out his way to help with questions and even helped print out my boarding pass. Near to the squash club also just like he said which was the reason for my visit. Would definitely stay again. Highly recommend. Thank you.

Perfect area to stay.  Short walk to catch the 600 bus into Port City l.  An old building that was tastefully renovated.  Very nice having our own bath.  Unfortunately the weather was rainy and cold.  There were plenty of warm blankets so we stayed very comfortable.   There is heat in the bathroom to take a comfortable shower.  Overall a good stay.
It is quite noisy, the sunsets are gorgeous but the view is not of a park- but tenements.
I highly recommend this place, it has a perfect location, it’s clean and stylish, has everything you could ask for and more. The hosts are very helpful and friendly.

Great apartment, very clean and perfectly located with lots of restaurants/cafés around. Everything you need is in the apartment and there is enough space for 3. Check-in and check-out are very easy although not before 2pm and after 12am. Even if you can hear when people are walking in the corridor, it was quiet and the apartment with view on the backyard are really quiet! This place is highly recommended!

The place was located perfectly near to almost everything . It is walkable to all the city  and you have access to a lot of solid bars and restaurants. It's only 5-10 minutes walking to The main streets and squares, to rua santa Catarina and around 10-15 minutes walking to rio Douro and the bridge of Ponte de Luis. The appartment was very clean and stylish as well. Everything you need if you want to explore Porto in a short period of time

We had an excellent stay to Casa Golgota . Everything was perfect to make and enjoy our wonderful  trip in Porto . The Appartement is new , quiet , absolutely comfortable and well decorated so charming place we recommend it without  hesitation . Marcos gave us a warm  welcoming , and suggest to  us the best place in Porto . Thanks for all Marcos .

Marcos was communicative and helpful throughout our entire stay. He made sure we were comfortable and even allowed us to check in early on short notice. The apartment is beautiful and very spacious with a terrace providing amazing views of the river. The location is a bit out of the center of town, but easily accessible. It is nice to escape to a peaceful, relaxing setting.

We would love to come back and would recommend Marcos' place to anyone!

Marcos was always available to answer questions and accommodate our needs.
The apartment was luxurious and very comfortable. After traveling in Portugal for over a month it was a pleasure to have accommodations as quiet and comfortable as these. The location is near the water front and was a 20 min walk to restraunts and the historical district. The grocery store and tram are a 5 min walk from the apartment. Even though we had a car, we found it more convenient to walk or take the tram.
A fantastic apartment with all you need to relax. Near all local amenities and a short walk or tram ride into the town centre. I would recommend Marco and his apartments to everyone

Great place, not only was the apartment clean and very comfortable, it had a spectacular view. The shared patio was spacious and also with a lovely view. There is a grocery store at the base of the hill which was very convenient. And climbing the hill and steps makes you feel less guilty about all the pastries you're eating.

The view is spectacular and the apartment conditions very good.  The bed was comfortable and the pillows perfect.  If you have difficulty climbing stairs or have trouble with cobbled stone streets, this not the place for you.  If you can overcome these obstacles, you won’t regret staying at the suite.
I was in love with the place, the view and the attention I received, I recommend a lot this place!

Great location and stunning views. The apartment is very nice, with 5 windows overlooking the river. Could be 5 Stars but the mattress is too soft, only two small pillows and the communication with the host was not as I expected after I checked in.

Beautiful views from this lovely little character cottage on the river bank. Quite a few steps so make sure you can handle some climbing.
Comfortable and homey. Great value

Marcos was a perfect host, very helpful and with plenty of ideas of what to do and see in Porto. Communication with Marcos was always quick and easy, he also organized a cab for us when we left. The apartment was great, super clean and had everything you need for a perfect stay. The veranda offered a great view to Porto, Vila Nova de Gaia, the bay and the sea. Great place to relax! From the apartment you can walk into the center - a beautiful walk along the river. I sum: great host, great apartment, great city. We enjoyed it a lot and will be back for sure.
Very nice apartment with a great balcony. Apartment itself was perfectly clean and had everything you wish for. Climbing up to the place was "fun" but very worth it.

Marcos is a very nice and agreable host. Very reachable on the phone and helpful.
The flat has a great view and is very nice and functionnal.
A little far away from Porto's center but not that much.
Definetly a place to go and get some rest.

Gorgeous roof top apartment over looking the Douro river.
Beautiful scenery
Beautiful house
High end quality and finish on furnishings
Well furnished with plenty of utensils (however there was no iron in flat as stated)
Fantastic shower
Comfortable bed
Fantastic host - would say Marcos went above and beyond our expectations of what to expect from a host, took his time to speak to us and give us recommendations on what to see and do. We had some great nights out at restaurants that he recommended to us.
Would highly recommend. Thanks Marcos

Marcos's apartment is in a wonderful location, is well equipped and very comfortable. The view from the terrace is stunning. There is very easy access to different places of interest and Marcos has some great tips. Bus no 500 takes you to lots of key points and the Andante travel card can save you lots of money. The apartment is up quite a steep road and a flight of steps so you will certainly be kept fit! There is a great supermarket and the bus stop a couple of minutes away. We would have liked to stay longer!

Marcos is a charming, friendly and helpful host.  The accommodation was beautifully clean and very well equipped.  Marcos communicated ahead of our visit,  was there to greet us and was hugely helpful regarding local knowledge - recommendations for restaurants etc.  We had a fabulous stay and would thoroughly recommend.

Marcos’ place was very clean, well stocked, and the view was spectacular. Highly recommend this air bnb, definitely the best place we’ve stayed at during our trip to Portugal. Marcos also gave great recommendations on things to see around Porto.

We really enjoyed staying at the apartment of Marcos! The apartment itself as well as the view from the balcony were truly amazing. It was very nice to  have breakfast outside. The apartment was extremely clean and looked just like in the pictures, if not even better. We also really enjoyed the authentic, traditional neighborhood with lemon trees  etc. There is an affordable supermarket within walking distance as well as a bus and a tram station. It is possible to walk to the city center (~30-40 min), but you can also take the bus for less than 10 min. Marcos welcomed us himself and gave us a lot of good tips for sights and wineries. He is a very pleasant host and wants his guests to enjoy their time in Porto. All in all, we can only recommend the apartment. It was one of our best Airbnb experiences so far and we could not be any happier. We will definitely visit again! :)

Marcos went over and beyond as a host. He spent an hour with me upon arrival going over a map and giving me local recommendations based on my interests.
