He was very quick to respond to any communication. I fell ill during my stay. He came to check on me and helped order a doctor to come to the Airbnb. I highly recommend Marcos as a host!
hidden from the tourist mass on a garden and on the river bank in an excellent equipped end very comfortable place
Clean and cozy place near the Douro river with an amazing view. Great accessibility to the centre and moor attractions and sharp, timely communication from the host.

A truely amazing apartment with a great location offering fantastic views of Porto from all rooms and the private terracce.
The standard and condition of the apartment is very high.
You have a very short distance to Porto and all the port wine houses, restaurants etc. on the Gaia side of the river.
Bruno was extremely helpfull offering plenty of tips for both the local area and Porto in general.
I can highly recommend both Bruno as a host and the awesome apartment.
Bruno's place is just wonderful, in a prime location, spotless and with the best view over the river. You will not be disappointed, book it!

It is truly superb. Best place I've stayed anywhere. The views are incredible. Apartment  was very clean and close to everything. I would definitely stay here again. Bruno was best host I've ever had, very responsive and gave us many local tips. Don't think twice about booking this.
A very nice place it is all very easy to reach. Bruno is the perfect host and very nice

I really recommend this rental. The house is really charming and the view is absolutely stunning. Furthermore, the location is perfect, it´s close to the historic center, but you can still enjoy the view of the city.
As for Bruno, he is an amazing host. He is willing to help with everything.
Renting this house was definitely a good decision.

We had a fabulous stay in Bruno's beautiful house. WOW, the views are incredible! We loved how comfortable the beds were - the pillows were really, really lovely. And the en-suite shower in both was lovely and powerful. A short walk over the bridge to the beautiful Old Town - all in all, a really fantastic place to stay.
thank you Bruno!
xJo and Helen

The place worked well and has a gorgeous view. I read the reviews so long ago. I remembered a reference to an elevator. I wish I would have reread them before we arrived. The elevator is in a nearby garage! Our 70+ year old bodies did the steep street. I cussed each time I made the hike.

We had the best stay in Porto! We rented the whole place and were very comfortable. The location is ideal to walk to all of the restaurants and shops, and when we wanted to venture out, we just ordered Ubers which were very reasonable. The rooms were very comfortable and clean, and all of the descriptions online that Bruno provided were accurate. The minibar was great - access to water bottles, soft drinks and wine- and everything was very clean. The place was very accessible and all of the instructions were very clear. Bruno was also super flexible with us for our check-in and check-out, and let us store bags on our last day which made our time in Porto easy and care free. Would highly recommend this accommodation!
Absolutely fantastic stay with Bruno.  This home is perfect for two couples and Bruno is one of the best hosts we've ever had. Highly recommend staying here.
The place was amazing, the views are brilliant, close to every thing, we caught a Uber from the  airport, cheap in Portugal. I would definitely recommend
The location was amazing- walkable to all the great attractions. Great view of Porto and the bridge.

We loved sitting on the back patio overlooking the river and bridge - the view was absolutely stunning.
We weren’t familiar with the concept of key cards for electricity but Bruno’s detailed emailed guide explained how it works. Bruno attentively answered all my questions. Thank you!

Bruno's accommodation is so lovely... The view from the room is so artful. The sunset at evening and the sun's light on the river at morning sunset are impressive. I'd like to book again next time I visit Porto..

Great little apartment just outside of the historic part of Porto. Beautiful little terrace with a great view. Bed was extremely comfortable and the apartment was exactly what we needed. Hosts were flexible with check in times and very responsive to messages. Had great local recommendations! Would definitely stay here again.
All great! Thanks 😊. We appreciated ver much the stay in your lovely apartment! BR Lotta and Jan
Space was functional and very clean. Kitchen was well stocked with implements. Maria was very kind and helpful. Thanks for a great stay!

Great place in a quiet area, has everything you need and is very comfortable. One small downside is that there's not that much light coming into the apartment, but you should spend most of your time on the terrace anyway, it's super cozy and has an incredible view.
Great place to stay. Lovely people give you a warm welcome. We loved to have breakfast on their terrace. They even recommended to cycle along the ocean. Hope to see them again ;-)
Perfect location, apartment and hosts. Excellent breakfast is at a pastry store downstairs run by the hosts!!

What an adorable apartment in a great location!  Elisa and Luis were such wonderful hosts and were so helpful during our stay in Porto.  The apartment was very clean and safe (locked, etc).  Having breakfast at the bakery was also such a nice treat and was special.  We only wished we could have stayed longer!

Elisa and Luís were waiting for us late in the evening. A brief introduction to the appartment was just what we needed. The leaflets and guestbook did the rest, next morning. The introductary almondcookies were right on the spot, though.

The breakfast in the bakery/lunchroom is nice, especially if you walk in and out all day... Just choose your menu, they are very generous. Even when we had to leave early to the airport, he had us a "breakfastbox" for the road. These guys sure know how to be generous in a modest way, we sure appreciated it.
This is a fabulous apartment, beautiful interior, fantastic view and everything you need. Our hosts were very friendly and the breakfast in their bakery was a lovely added bonus.

Conveniently located apartment with all the necessary mod cons. We enjoyed the proximity to Porto's main attractions and the lively night life (the university is cross the square). The sumptuous breakfast served alfresco across the church was the perfect start to every day. The cakes, cookies and Portuguese delicacies that Primarl served up were perfect for packed lunches or midnight snacks..
Luis & Elisa are perfect ! Wine and cookies waiting for us on arrival. Give us infos for the city. Very nice apartment, well renovated. Thank you for everything !
Excellent stay at the Almond Biscuit apartment! Lovely accommodations, friendly and thoughtful hosts, a good location, and top notch breakfast/goodies. We thoroughly enjoyed it.

We spent a wonderful 5 days at Elisa and Luís's apartment! The location is fantastic - walking distance to many places of interest in Porto. The apartment itself is impeccably presented, nicely decorated, light and airy, with everything you could need for a comfortable stay. The view from the apartment is gorgeous and it is spacious for a couple (though would easily accommodate four people). Having breakfast in the bakery downstairs every morning was a great bonus too - the delicious pastries, coffee, and friendly staff were the perfect way to start our days exploring Porto! Elisa and Luis were great hosts, very accommodating, communicative, and helpful throughout our stay. Little touches like the bottle of wine and almond cookies to welcome us to the apartment made this a very special and memorable holiday.
We fell in love with Porto and the apartment. It was everything we could have hoped for and more. Stunning views over the square, a brilliant location .....it was super clean and modern.

Cant imagine when I open the window, a world heritage is right in front of me. Great location, very convenient, most of the attractions are in walking distance. The apartment is clean and spacious. Elisa and Luis , as well as their staffs in the cafe are friendly and helpful. The breakfast and the biscuits are delicious. Vivid atmosphere around.

Porto wound up being our highlight in Portugal! Luis was so accommodating and for provided such a clean and amazing place, along with many extra touches such as free (delicious) breakfasts and deserts and wine for when we arrived. The location was completely perfect as well, our choice could not have been better

This is a very lovely apartment! It’s in walking distance to everything you need in Porto. It was spacious and clean and there was a snack waiting when I arrived with was lovely. Ear plugs and an eye mask are a must however. They provide ear plugs which is great
Beautiful space, special views, perfect location. The breakfast was a bonus and we had a wonderful stay.

One of the best airbnbs we have stayed in! Elisa and Luis's place is right in the centre of Porto you can walk everywhere you need, clean place and perfect for 3 people for the weekend. Our favourite thing was having breakfast in the bakery downstairs!

Great location and great host. Elisa was super nice and proactive. We went to Porto to spent the New Year’s Eve, it was so nice. Elisa was very nice to send us a full basket of breakfast for the first day of the year since most of the cafes were close🌸 The heating, hot water, wi-fi was working perfect. The bakery just below was a perfect convenience and every pastry was extremely satisfying. To sum up, it was a great experience, I highly recommend Elisa’s place🙏🏼🌸

Owner Luis was so friendly and generous, providing breakfast of delicious pastry, juice and coffee each morning! Location was perfect- we walked to every activity!
The apartment was spacious and comfortable. We heard no from other guests. Easy to come and go.
We would definitely stay here again and recommend to friends!
Great place with a beautiful view! Very convenient for getting around Porto and the breakfast was an added bonus!
The view of Igreja de Carmo and the central location made our stay so wonderful. We enjoyed being able to walk everywhere and the included breakfast was a lovely bonus. Thank you!

Everything was perfect.
The breakfast was delicious with to many options.
Staff so friendly and Elisa always responded in time.
We would love to come back to Porto and to this apartment.
Everything was more than we expected. It will be my choice again for my next trips to Porto.

Outstanding one-of-a-kind view.  From the balcony, maybe the best view in all of Porto.  I must have taken two dozen photos from the balcony.  I have stayed at literally dozens of AirBnBs, this may well be my favorite.  Memories of a lifetime.  I will now see the iconic photos of the square by the Douro River and recall that I stayed right there.  The apartment was decorated with traditional Portuguese furniture - couldn't be better.   Highly rated, 5+, for those that want a once-in-lifetime lasting memory of the wonderful city of Porto.

Best location in Porto!!! This Airbnb has a gorgeous view with a terrace right above the main squares of the old/touristic area. I can’t imagine a better home base while staying in Porto. Great restaurants right outside the door. There was live music from buskers starting every afternoon and going into the evening, which was lovely and could be enjoyed from the apartment. The host provided some wine, coffee, chocolates, all kitchen staple ingredients (free) as well as port to sample for a small fee. This apartment is one of the best airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in, and the price is severely discounted for what you get! I would definitely book here again. Plus, 2 bathrooms and a king size bed! My husband and I loved this apartment.

This flat was the perfect location. It’s right on the river. From the balcony, living room or bedroom you can see the river and the plaza below. You can hear music so if you are sensitive to outside noise, you may want to avoid this flat, but for us we did not mind at all. It is in a great location, near everything,  easily walkable and has a lift it’s on the fourth floor. Across the river are the Port houses. Easily crossable using the bridge.

The moment we opened the shutters, we were speechless! The location, the apartment, and the view are far beyond our expectations! Close to many good restaurants. From the many windows you have a great view of the river, boats and the red roofs of old buildings. Apartment is bright, clean and tastefully decorated. The host Cristina is super friendly and helpful, gave us timely help and much needed suggestions when the train strike affected our original plan. We highly recommend this place for your visit to Porto!

It's hard to describe the absolute privilege and perfection of this apartment. Situated on the top two floors, just above the old fountain, the apartment offers breathtaking views of the river and all the life that surrounds it. If you are planning a trip to Porto, this is absolutely the best location and lodging available.

Excellent location, very walkable and close to many popular locations. Great view from balcony. The taxi company recommendation they gave us was wonderful; they took us right up to the door.
Really the only downside is that we didn't stay longer. Would definitely stay here again.

This is the best Airbnb I ever stayed at, and I stayed at a lot of places.   The apartment is even better than described in the photos.   The view from the balcony is majestic.  You feel like a king overlooking the plaza.  This Airbnb is 10x better than the listing presents.   There is a lot of space.  The bedroom is very private and quiet.   I think it is the best place to stay on all of Porto.
Wonderful location right in the heart of Porto with a beautiful view! Apartment was clean & spacious and had a wonderful balcony!

The location of this beautiful building is excellent with an amazing view of the the Ribeira plaza and the Duoro River.
The plaza is busy all day and late into the night with people all over, street performers and loud music you can enjoy from the apartment’s balcony.
The noise level is not for a light sleeper. During our stay, one night I woke up at 1:30am to fireworks across the river.
The host is was very nice and helpful answering questions and providing information.

You are right in the middle of the action going late into the  night. If you want to go to bed early this may not be the place for you but if you enjoy live public music & watching the world go by, you will have a great time,

This was simply a gem.  We can’t recommend the apartment enough.  It was absolutely beautiful, charming beyond belief, and the outside balcony was magical.  If you have the chance to book it, do not hesitate.  You will be thrilled.  Thanks you, Portosense!
The apartment is very beautiful and the view is fantastic. Communication was very easy and professional. Everything went well.
The best view in Porto! Unrivaled location and incredibly helpful host. The location is absolutely unreal but it does get a bit loud at night so perhaps not for people who want to bed early.

Such a wonderful place! I couldn’t ask for a better placement in Porto. You have to park a little ways away but worth it. Pack light. Then, you are in the heart of my favourite place. Wish I cod have stayed longer.
Just what I wanted. Close to ocean and river with excellent walking. Also close to some good food.

A great view from the balcony and the window! We enjoyed the stay, and loved canidelo, the beach nearby..
Gegerly is a responsive and caring host. Thank you, we would love to come again next time we are in Porto.

Gergely was very responsive. Very easy to communicate with and always available to answer questions. The place is in a great location of Gaia where it is quiet and peaceful. It is a very short walk to the ocean which is what I enjoyed.

I spend wonderful time in Porto and Maria is the best host You can get:) She is very helpful, kind and cheerful, so You really feel comfortable and relaxed staying with her:) The flat is near the underground station, so You can easily get to the most important places in town. The room I stayed in was different from the one in the ad, but it was also very spacious, clean and cosy. So if You're looking for a good place to stay in Porto this one is definitely recommendable:)

I spent a while here while I studied Portuguese. Having my own bathroom suited me really well and it's right off the kitchen if you need to cook anything simple. The room is really light and the rooftop view is lovely, especially of an evening. All the family was really nice and Baltasar the small dog is very cute. The area is more typical Portuguese than the Baixa but convenient for walking around and the metro. The Parque Quinta do Covelo was really nice, especially at the weekend with families there and live music. Obrigada!
Maria is a very nice & helpful host. Thank you. :) Room and bathroom is ok. City centre is about 20 min walk or 10 min by bus.

This place was excellent value - we had a private area of the apartment with a bathroom, and Maria was away anyway so we had the place to ourselves. The room was super comfortable, the place was walking distance to the city and on a good running trail too. We met Maria only briefly right at the end and she was lovely. Definitely recommend!!
I had a great stay. Maria is very friendly. I recommend this host. I had no problems and Maria was very flexible. Thanks!

The stay at Maria's place was lovely. The place was clean, and the communication with Maria was perfect. I enjoyed a private bathroom with a towel, shampoo, conditioner and body gel ready for me. The bed was comfortable, there was plenty of space for storing my things, a bedside table, and a desk with small flowers and a chair. Maria is such a nice person, I recommend staying in her place.

Maria was so welcoming and I was so glad to come back and see her again 9 years after !! <3 😊
Maria has a huge heart and is so welcoming with her guests.
Thanks Maria ! and it will be a pleasure to see you again next trip to Porto :-)

Great place to stay. It's about 1,5-2km from most attractions, so it's close enough to reach by foot, but far enough to be quiet at night. The host is very friendly and helpful. The separate bathroom is very, very convenient. There were some small issues with hot water, but they were temporary. There's also a small balcony and a window, so the room can easily be ventilated and it doesn't get too hot. The fridge was a nice addition as well. All in all, great choice!
Maria was very friendly and helpful. The room was clean and the home was in a safe neighborhood.

Maria’s place was amazing. 1 mile walk to the center with many restaurants, things to see, and beautiful viewpoints of the whole city. It’s very nice to have your own bathroom. The bed looks small on the pictures but I am tall and felt fine. Maria was very communicative and would 100% recommend for Porto!
really great moment with Maria, the room is really clean and the pillow smells good :) I will come back
Everything was as expected☺️ Really nice and clean place. The host was really welcoming and friendly, I would book this airbnb again. I felt immediatly like home!
Amazing stay with maria, the place is perfectly as described, and is definetly worth its price, maria was a great host, super kind, super helpful, i recommend.

We were greeted by the concierge for a number of apartments in the building.  The apartment is centrally located, however, there is not sufficient parking available other than in a parking garage which can be very pricey.  The apartment is sufficiently equipped. It actually consists of two rooms connected by a wide corridor that contains the kitchen.  Well equipped kitchen with washer, freezer, refrigerator and dishwasher.
We stayed for one night and the apartment was cozy and nice. The apartment is located on lovely area of Porto. Our stay was pleasant, comfortable & wonderful.

Our stay in Porto has been amazing. Porto as always leaves a mark. Good memories. Good times. The house has been great. Very nice interiors and a perfect location to explore the city (maybe too many tourists nowadays). Teresa and her husband have been super kind and friendly.

Teresa’s place is great. It has a perfect location and is walking distance to the main touristic attractions in Porto. Teresa is also a great host and made pas minute arrangements for us to arrive in the middle of the night because our plane was so delayed.
Definitely recommend staying here.

Teresa is a super host. Very rapid communication. Always responsive and happy to help.  Great central location. Walkable. Nice restaurants near by. Accomodation as described. Teresa goes out of the way to help. For example they did not had an iron for clothes in the flat and she procured one and left for us. We forgot something in the flat and she very quickly arranged for it to be available in the shop on the ground floor. Thank you Teresa for a large, spacious, clean and value for money accomodation and a lovely stay. Five stars.
Thomas was very friendly. The description was correct. To the beach it took longer than expected. The design is perfect, but note that accoustically the rooms are not separate.
The house is an architectural masterpiece. A very good example of a converted barn. Also the old farm is very nice renovated. All is exactly as in the pictures and I will definitely go here again
Our stay was amazing, everything was clean and very beautiful! We enjoyed staying at Tomas mansion and want to come back again!

We travelled as a small group of colleagues (4ppl), visiting suppliers. The location and surroundings provided the best backdrop for us to kick start our busy day and finish it in a calm and peaceful way. Something that a hotel or a busy downtown Porto location can never provide.

The house itself had everything we needed and what we didn't have was provided with a lightning speed and a smile from Tomas and his family. From spare wood for the fire to a taxi to to the airport at 07:00 in the morning. We particularly loved the beds.

With ample space to relax, work or play and a safe location to park your car, this place in the countryside is better that expected. Thank you Tomas.

Tomás’s house is a marvel. The old barn house, the main house rooms, the garden with all its secret spaces, the super nice swimming pool, the view and surroundings… everything is just perfect. We wish we will come back.
Great home, we loved staying here. Perfect for a group/ family. So much space to relax

Very nice place! The house is big an has everything you need for a great holiday. Garden and Pool are perfect! Maria is very nice and the contact was nice and uncomplicated. We will definitly come back!
We (family of 4) enjoyed two weeks at Maria's place. Everything was great and Maria was a fantastic host. We'll return!

Daniela was very kind and helpful. It was really easy to arrange things with her and she answers our questions quickly.  She gave us a map where she had marked restaurants, metro stations and places to visit. The apartment was really good, bright, really good equipped and clean. I would like to visit that place again!

Daniel was a great host. Thank you for a warm welcome with a bottle of wine and sweets, that was very kind! The flat is well located 5 mins walk to the metro station and 10 mins away from the ocean, and it has an elevator (2nd floor). The flat was nicely decorated and clean, although a couple of minor repairs and some re-painting could be done. The kitchen would also benefit from a kettle and bread chopping board. As a host Daniel was very helpful and he even lend umbrellas to us on a rainy day. Thanks for quick responses and effective communication. Highly reccomended.
Daniel is a lovely host and very friendly. The apartment was lovely and stylish and is well located to the beach and the metro.
Very well located, close to supermarket, transport and the beach. We liked it so much that we stayed twice, in 2019 and in 2020.
Nice and courteous hosts. The cleaning ladies were super sweet and did a great job. All in all very positive experience.
Communication was perfect, check in on a friday after 8pm was also possible.  Everything was as described and the flat was clean and nice to spend a few days in.
The place was very nice, comfortable, clean and well equipped. I enjoyed staying in the spacious room with a lot of light. I would definitely go back if I needed it in the future.
Clean and comfortable, and very near to public transportation. Sacha was very helpful and accomodating, definitely recommend to anyone staying for a few nights or longer! :)

Centrally placed in the city centre, near to Bolhao Metro Station. Although on a slight hill, it was not a problem to walk to it. Easy to get into the city centre. The apartment is situated on the 7th floor and as indicated by the photos, there is a good view over the city. The apartment is well appointed for a couple. There are a number of cafes/restaurants within 5 minutes walk.

Fantastic apartment in a great location just up the hill from the market, close to amenities and public transport, in a calm relaxed area, with a view that's just perfect. Comfortable, well appointed, tasteful, like a home from home if you're a swanky urbanite or something.

This spacious apartment is perfectly located for exploring Porto and offers stunning views of the city.
It has everything needed for a self catering stay, and Sven supplied excellent details of local places to eat and visit.
We would definitely return again if visiting Porto.

Loved our 2 month stay here. The apartment was much nicer than the pictures show. It was clean and very stylish. Located one block over from the end of the walking street with great views in the evening. The kitchen had everything we needed to make meals as well as many places in the neighborhood to eat out at. Grocery store is about 3 blocks away and a small convenience store around the corner. Many historical sites are within walking distance as well as some wonderful shopping. Near the Trinidad and Bolhao metro stations. Sven and Sandra were very helpful and responsive hosts!  We will definitely stay here again when in Porto.

I had a fantastic stay at Sven’s place in the heart of Porto. The living room is seriously spacious and the view is spectacular. I'll miss that view for sure! The bedroom is quiet at night, even though you're in the heart of the city. Sven's a top-notch host—professional, responsive, super easy-going, and a pleasure to chat with. 10/10 would stay here again!

Danniel's place was great value. Bathroom right next to bedroom and very private and quiet. Danniel is a great host. Lots of good places to eat close by. The train station to Porto center is only a three min walk and the schedule is extremely convenient.

Bedroom is clean. Pretty cold if you're not used to portuguese houses in winter, but there were sufficient blankets. No towels or pillow provided but I found one pillow on my own and had brought my own towel. Most probably Daniel would have given me one if I had asked. Daniel is a discret host - we did not exchange at all but he was available for questions and polite. Be aware that the kitchen is not available (but Daniel agreed that I use the microwave).

Exceptional stay! From the private setup to the thoughtful amenities, our experience at this Airbnb was simply outstanding. The host was incredibly accommodating and made sure our every need was met. The location was ideal, and we felt right at home. We can't wait to return for another memorable stay. Highly recommend!

It is a wonderful house close to the beach. Well stocked with staple items. There is no clothes dryer although there is one indicated in the listing. The water heater is small and doesn't provide enough hot water for a full shower.
Perfect place for our family stay! Manuel’s house felt just like home. Amazing backyard, very close to the beach. Amazing amazing amazing!

We had a wonderful stay in this beautiful house where everything worked perfectly. The place was spotlessly clean, with a lovely, cozy garden and a great grill area. The location was ideal, and the host was incredibly kind and helpful. Highly recommended!
WOW! Words and images can not describe this magnificent place. It was beyond beautiful, the owner was very friendly and helpful and we just LOVED it!

Great place, may be the best Airbnb I have ever stayed. The place is literally by the Duoro river and has a infinite pool facing the river. The house is well decorated with a great balcony and 4 double beds. I would highly recommend it to a couple or group of friends. We wish we could have stayed a bit longer at this place.

Antonio is the owner of the property and has truly made this place a paradise. The gardens, pool, and home are all well kept and luxurious. Antonio was right when he told us we need a full week to really enjoy the grounds. Looks like we will have to come back :)

This place is so unique and perfect for big family trips. We loved the views, the scenery, the peace, the pool and the beach, and Antonio is such a good and attentive host who wants you to have the best possible experience. He even let us pick fruits and vegetables from his beautiful garden. We also appreciated the possibility to use the kayaks to have a lovely trip down the Douro river. If you want to spend a peaceful time right in the middle of beautiful nature then this is the place to pick!

Great remote location - quiet, beautiful. Definitely recommended for those, who like to stay in the nature.
The pool was great!
The owner was very helpful.
Some nice local natural attractions, like Paiva walkaways less an hour drive from the house.

This is a unique location, the really small road to get there is not what we're used
to in the Netherlands but that's because we're too spoiled !
You'll get used to it very soon.
Once you arrive it really is like paradise! a lot of privacy in the middle of nature
and a great view on the douro river.
Every morning some fresh bread in a basket hanging at the door.
Even our kids had a great time, especially at the pool.
Unfortunatly we have to go back to face our busy lives again
but would happily return in the future.
Dutch: Mooie locatie, geweldig uitzicht, Veel privacy.

Everything was perfect. Antonio was so nice with us. The situation is awesome, very beautiful views, you have some different routes for walking. Good restaurants, ... Everytime that me and my friends went on holidays to visit  some place in the Duero, we come back to our countty more falling in love of this beautiful river and Portugues people. Thanks for all. Kind regards.

The place was better than anticipated. The views are amazing, there’s immense value from the entire estate and farm (great pool, vegetables we could pick daily from the greenhouse).
António was not only super available to help but also a great person to talk with.
The Ripado House has plenty of space and is nicely thought through, and is nicely located close to a river “beach”. This allowed us to get some time in the river, with the downside of adding a little bit of noise during the day due to water sports - still, would happily return and will recommend for friends.
The nights and early mornings were among the calmest we’ve ever experienced. A true gem right outside Porto in the Douro river.
The house is exactly what is expected in the pictures and the amenities are amazing - the pool, the greenhouse and its vegetables, fresh eggs and the proximity to the river and water sports.
A great cabin located just 45 minutes from Porto. Fantastic views of the Douro river with a tranquil and relaxing ambience.

The place is perfect to escape the daily routine, very peaceful in the middle of nature.
There’s a few activities to do like, canoeing, mini golf, badminton etc
You can walk and see the views around or use the bycicle they had available. Everything was great, would visit again and I probably will. :)

Amazing experience in a place surrounded by Amazing Nature.
The pool is wonderful with a view to the river.
Perfect to rest!

Susanna is very friendly and helpful. The rooms are very clean, the bed and cushion very comfortable. It was really a good choice. We really can recommend it! (Only the traffic was a little bit loud outside.)
Thank you very much!!

Very nice & clean bedroom fully furnished, in a big & safe building, with shared kitchen and living room with the other guests.
Jorge and Susana are really helpful, providing you all the tips for the visits and authentic food !
All perfect. Photos reflect the room size correctly. Might be a bit noise for some people because it's right next to the road, but didn't bother us.
Everything was perfect! Jorge is really friendly and gave us a lot of good tipps! We also got a nice welcome-treat :) always again'

We really enjoyed our stay!pilar was very helpful & friendly to us!!we liked the room we were staying in the first night much more- because it wasn't noisy there!!the old town is in walking-distance!we really loved the portwine 😊
It is a nice place to stay, The bathroom and the toilet is in the room. It is separated but still looks to much. Apart that is a good place.
The room is small and not in the city centre. But its clean and very confortable. The checkin is super easy and you have all the information some days before.
We loved our stay in Porto! Carla was very welcoming and the apartment is beautiful and clean. Would definitely recommend!

Pilar was an amazing host and ambassador for Porto. I arrived a little late with only a day in town she helped me plan an incredible walking tour of the city. She answered all my questions, made sure I knew how to find her on what's app and also greeted me with a glass of port and a pastel de nata. I highly recommend staying with her and would extend her the offer to stay with me in San Francisco anytime.
Quaint flat just across the river from the old district and a short walk from major attractions. The free on street parking just outside the flat was also very convenient.

Anas place is in a great location for walking around Porto. Bring a small car though because the city centre has very narrow streets in places, and busy traffic. We left our car parked the 36 hours we were there.
Her apartment is cute and quite roomy. We met two of her neighbours who were really nice, and it felt safe.
Ana gave us a great recommendation for dinner close by.

Very nice host ! Miguel was very nice and gave us some advices about the things to do during our stay.
The flat is very well situated in Porto.

Tudo ótimo - Everything perfect
We stayed for 3 nights with 3 people and Miguel was an extremely kind and helpful host, making research about things we were interested in and providing the apartment with anything you could need and even more.
The apartment is situated in a very nice area next to the river and very centric, the city is awesome.

A cozy place in Vila de Nova Gaia. 3-5 minutes walk to Metro, Buses, supermarket, grocerystores, , vodaphone office (dont buy a tourist sim at the airport for 20 Euros, buy it from their city office for 5 Euros instead). A quiet peaceful place. The host is super nice, she waited for us when we arrived late due to traffic and offered us late checkout. Strongly recommended!

This place was perfect for our needs. Ana met me there and gave me a good tour around. The place is well located for an easy walk down to the water and port houses. We would definitely stay here again
Miguel's apartment was lovely very clean with everything you would need to base you stay great views of the river Miguel went out of his way to help us out

Great place. Excellent location. Miguel also gave us a list of things to do and some wonderful restaurants to try.

Highly recommend.
Miguel was an excellent host! He ahead a list of great things for us to do already set up and he was so accommodating. The apartment is lovely and in a great location!

Miguel has been a great host, very flexible with check-in and check-out timings. He's been helpful giving us a map and some tips about interesting spots and restaurants. The house is very comfortable and furnished with everything a guest may need. The view of the river is amazing. I surely recommend Miguel's apartment. We had a great stay

This is a great location and exactly what you need when in Portugal. Great view of the river and Miguel is beyond wonderful. There are about 3 full flights of stairs though so make sure you have no physical limitations when renting this property. Other than that we give it two thumbs up.

Miguel's apartment was very central. We didn't like the apartment as much as other travelers liked it due to the apartment size and WiFi. It was not possible to open our luggages because the bedroom and corridor size were tiny.

My experience at Miguel's place cannot be better. Miguel picked me up from the airport and offered me loads of information about places to visit and local events which are going on. He's always quick in responding my messages. That's extremely helpful for a solo traveler like me.
The flat is clean and cozy. The flat has beautiful river view, and is close to museums, galleries, shops and restaurants.

Miguel’s place was exactly what we expected from his description and other reviews, very clean and pleasant. It was a great location to get to all the main sites of Porto and had easy access across the river to visit all of the wineries. Miguel offered us lots of suggestions for places to eat and visit. He also was very accommadating and easy to communicate with. Loved our stay in Porto!

Miguel's place has a beautiful charm, immaculately clean and close to everything Porto has to offer. Miguel is  amazingly quick to respons and has heaps of  recommendations and an awesome little personalised map.

Miguel is the one of best host I've ever met. not only the apartment was perfect, but also miguel's recommended places were so awesome.
Absolutely Recommended!!
High quality accommodation in a little town, really worth a visit, the couch bed is very very comfortable

Top location in the historic centre and a super pleasant apartament. Definitely worthwhile when visiting Porto.
The Owner was always very friendly and helpful.

Miguel’s place was a slice of heaven on the river. Cosy and compact but it had everything we needed as a base for a lovely few days in Porto. Miguel was friendly, accomodating and very quick to respond. The location was brilliant for exploring Porto - 10/10 would stay here again!
We had a really nice stay and it was awesome that Jorge and Celeste care for their guest. They answer right away if you have questions.
We really enjoyed our stay here, especially the view over the Douro. The appartment is well comfortable, well fitted and located, with everything at walking distance. Will recommend!

Beautiful space. Has everything you need. Very communicative and helpful hosts. Awesome welcome info email and recommendations. Not the quietest area but was quiet enough after dinner and just have ear plugs if want to sleep in. Million dollar views, just gorgeous view of the river!!!
Highly recommend this place for a central area, easy walk across bridge. The restaurants start closing around 11 pm so try to find stuff earlier. We got lost so beware if your gps keeps trying to change address to travessa instead of rua. Thanks so much to these wonderful hosts for a great stay!
The best part of this apartment is the view! An amazing view over the Duoro River and Porto.  Super clean and responsive hosts!

What a great location!
Very easy self checkin and lots of homey touches: soaps, conditioner, body wash dispense and small basket of amenities, ❤️ a big bottle of water and a container of milk in the fridge , some coffee pods to start you out p, sugar and tea. Would definitely stay here again.
Terrific and responsive hosts. Space had an amazing view and was right next to the bridge to walk into main Porto! The spot itself is near the locations of many of the city’s port wineries.
We had a  lovely stay in the Douro Riverside Appartments. The location was perfect and we loved the view, the appartment was tidy and clean.

Jorge and Celeste went out of their way to make me feel welcome. The kitchen window view and the bathroom window are amazing and unforgettable. The space was quiet and comfortable and smack dab in the heart of everything. 100% clean and modern. Shower was excellent and you can see boats on the water and hear seagulls while you shave...I mean, c’mon...;

Diogo is a great host! he waited at the Sao Bento trainstation upon our arrival in Porto to guide us to the flat (3 minutes walking distance away). Some snacks, fruits and some Porto awaited us in the flat, where Diogo gave us tipps what we should visit in Porto etc. He took his time to explain everything in detail and offered us 2 day cards for public transportation and provided us with a city map (bus & metro). He was very responsive to further
questions. We couldn't have hoped for a better host! I would book the same Airbnb again without hesitation. Only negative point is a rather slow WiFi connection.

My wife and I have stayef in many airbnb places around yhe world and this was one of the better places. Diogo was excellent in making us feel welcome. He met us at the train station helped carry our bags  up the road to his place and had port, cheese, crackers and wine waiting for us. He even brought his own toaster in or us. He is a sincerely nice person and I would not hesitate to stay at his apartment again.

Thanks to Diogo our trip to Porto was just perfect! We couldn't ask for more. The studio is beautiful and romantic, with a really special bathroom (mostly I enjoyed the shower s located very central, but is still quite during night. But the real reason we had such a good time in Porto was the host. Diogo was very nice and helpful, he picked us up from the train station and prepared a tasty snack in the apartment, including very good portwine, tasty cheese and homemade marmelade. He showed us cool locations and nice places to eat and we could text him anytime - he always answered right away. I totally recommend this place and if I ever come back to porto, I would totally stay here again!

The room was private, lovely and included a small kitchen area complete with half refrigerator and microwave, which is rare and welcomed when staying for more than a few days. The bed was extremely comfortable. The location is central and near several very good restaurants. Diogo provides a very good overview of the city and suggestions on what to see and where to eat. He was very helpful! My only suggestion are earplugs if you are a late sleeper.

Diogo's apartment is very nice, right in the middle of everything and very quiet at night. You find a lot of details in the apartment that makes you feel at home. Thanks Diogo!
Best!
Wow! What a beautiful studio! Very clean and in a fantastic location. Diogo went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and at home. Many thanks!

Diogo is a wonderful host. He was very easy to communicate with and gave us great hints and tips of what to do in Porto. The apartment itself is a very central location, clean and very impressive! Everything we needed was provided including extra perks like cheese, fruit, wine and even still warm home-made marmelade! Would highly recommend.

The PERFECT stay for our honeymoon in Porto!
We can’t say enough about Diogo and his hospitality! Aside from this being an absolutely perfect spot to explore Porto, and the apartment being so charming and quaint- what really made this one of our most amazing AirBNB stays ever. Diogo was thoughtful, helpful, responsive and so sweet! It was like having a personal friend in Porto that wanted us to enjoy our stay as much as we did. He was available without being intrusive, and knowledgeable without being pushy.
We recommend this spot to anyone who wants to get to know a local’s Porto!
Obrigado Diogo!!!

Lovely studio in great part of Porto. Everything was smooth and as advertised. Diogo always available and gave me loads of great tips to discover the city and further afield. Recommend and will return!

Diogo provided an excellent welcome and local tips upon arrival. The place is clean and gives a victorian vibe :) only thing was the squeeking bed, so if you are a light sleeper, it can wake you up. Otherwise its a perfect place, centrally located. The apartment is facing a quiet side. Porto is a lovely town and Diogo’s apartment fit into the vibe of the city well :)
Quiet central location. Good value; charming and quirky. Diogo is a wonderful host, very attentive and quick to communicate. His pride in Porto shines through his tips and recommendations.

Diogo is a great host that made our stay in Porto perfect! very friendly and easy in communication!
The room was amazing and the location is Right in the Heart of Porto. Would 100% recommend and always go back when in Porto.

The studio is very classical and quite different from the typical ones which have modern style decoration and a printed books of notes giving information while the host never shows up. Diogo is very friendly, gentle and in deep love with his city  that he gave all sorts of advises for a real deep insight of Porto.
Very central location in Porto and Diogo was very helpful with his local knowledge of the places to visit
Diogo was very friendly and gave us dinner recommendations and was happy to look after our luggage before/after our stay. The room was spacious and clean, good value for money and in a good location.

Loved the place. Stylish and cosy. Lovely bed and pillows. The host Diogo was very friendly and very easy to talk to. For any advices about where to eat or what to do, he is the right person to ask. Always very approachable and friendly. I would definitely recommend this place.
Apartment was easy to find and located right in the middle of everything. We had everything at walking distance. Apartment is well equipped and quiet.

The apartment is just as described, beautiful vintage style in a lively neighborhood. It's not too far from the river either. The host greeted us at the door and provided local recommendations which were much appreciated.
The stay was very nice. It is a beautiful apartment in a good location. The host is nice, there was a minor issue with an appliance but this got resolved right away.

The location of the place was perfect and very central! We could walk to the main sights and had everything we needed. The place was clean and beautiful with a nice view over the city. I also loved the vintage style and the old furniture. Luiza was also very friendly and responsive.
I would definitely recommend! :)

Great apartment, love the vintage theme, fits well with the historical city!
Great location 5 minute walk from train station. Apartment was clean, quiet and comfortable.
Luiza was friendly and helpful :)

Sandra was very helpful from the word go, from being able to meet me with the keys, advice on where to go food shopping and places to eat out.  Apartment was very nice, bright and clean and was perfect for us. Magnificent pastry shop/cafe just around the corner. Beachfront was around a 5 minute walk from the apartment. Could not recommend this more highly when visiting Espinho

Sandra she is a brilliant person! Really nice and really helpful. The apartment was perfect for us. Clean, nice and it is in great location. Everything is so close(cafe, shops, reataurants, train station) and beach is max 5 min by walk.  Espinho is one of our best places on the world :) hope we will back soon to this wonderful city and to perfect apartment- Sandra's apartment :)

We had a lovely stay at Sandta's Apartment.
The apartment is spotlessly clean, we'll equipped and great value for money.
The location is good, close to the beach and shops. With a fantastic bakery nearby!
We would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone staying in Esphino. Sandra was a great host and really helpful during our stay.
It was our first time on Northern Portugal, and we found the locals to be so friendly.

The apartment was wonderful! It was a great space for the three (hubby, baby, and me) of us to call home for 5 nights. Sandra was an incredible host and very accommodating. Once we confirmed our reservation, she ensured there was a pack n play and high chair for our infant. We greatly appreciated that! Highly recommend this apartment and would stay there again in a heartbeat.

This place was perfect and exactly as advertised. Very clean, modern, and a safe place where our family could stay! We wish we had time to visit more of the places Sandra recommended. She was very considerate, friendly and accommodations. Wish we could have stayed longer!

I would give 10 stars if I could! This place is the definition of perfect! Sandra was super helpful, kind and accessible. She even offered tips and advice on places to visit in the area. The apartment has everything, dishwasher, washing machine, coffee maker, hair dryer, iron, etc It is super well located, in a quiet street but close to all amenities and 5 min from the beach. Felt like home since the very first second! Would definitely repeat!
Spacious apartment with a full stocked kitchen and good Wi-Fi. Perfect location in the city, walkable to supermarkets, the beach, and the train. Would highly recommend this place to anyone interested

We spend a few days in Sandra’s apartment. It’s a nice place and we had a good time after cleaning the place. It’s well located and has everything you need. It just needs to be cared for a little more.

We had a brilliant time staying in Porto and were lucky to have Fred as our host who was brilliant in welcoming us and giving recommendations about what to do while we were staying. Would definitely recommend anyone to visit and stay here!

Very transparent and accurate description: what you'll read on the description is exactly what you'll get. With the extra that Fred is an awesome, energetic and always available guy who will make you feel right at home.

PERFECT, PERFECT, PERFECT, above and beyond expectations, It was fantastic experience. Highly recommend it. Excellent host. The apartment is amazing, better than described, ocean view, clean. Great host. We had apartment to ourselves, still family was amazing. Can’t thank them enough, will never forget.

Felipe and Helena were very communicative and helpful with car rides and suggestions for things to do. The location is along a coastal path for pedestrians and bicyclists. It’s a quiet and relaxing get away from the city and great if you have a car or are traveling without children. Uber is available which make it easier and Helena was extremely kind in offering car rides. Metro is a 15-20 minute walk away.
Highly recommend renting bikes from Gaia Bikes (4 miles away) for a day ride into Porto. You can even reach the Port tour/tastings via the safe “red painted path” for bikes. Then have lunch along the Douro river on the way back.

Filipe is a very considerate host for this great apartment . The location was perfect for us, with beautiful beaches on the doorstep, and Porto only a short train ride away. Also allows easy access to the surfing beaches down the coast, whilst being able to stay in a more relaxed, less touristy location. Would highly recommend!

Filipe’s place is as described and located in a nice and quiet area. But a nice apartment is something you can find in many places. What you cannot find elsewhere, is Filipe’s hospitality and friendliness. He went above and beyond to make our stay a great experience: from welcoming us with fresh pastry and fruit after a long travel, to finding places to take our kids, to driving is us through the city and to the best ice-cream place in the city. Best host you can wish for. Thank you!

We've been staying for 5 weeks at Filipe's place and we enjoyed every moment.
The apartment has everything you need for the long term stay.
The area around is really nice and the beach is outstanding.
I'd recommend this place and hope we'll have a chance to return to it one more time.

The apartment is fantastic! A few minutes walk and you’re at the most beautiful beach.
Filipe is a great host, he went above and beyond to make sure my stay was perfect.
Thank you for everything Filipe.
Filipe was very kind and helpful throughout the stay. Location was great, friendly and close to many things. Bars/restaurants around the area were also nice.

Filipe was an exceptional host! He was very attentive, meeting us when we arrived explaining how all the appliances in the apartment function. Ensuring that we knew where to go for food and recreation. Offering us suggestions every single day for activities that we could engage in. It is hard to imagine a host who would be more responsive and helpful than Filipe was!
He was so exceptionally kind and helpful that we feel like we have made a new friend and hope he will come visit us!

The apartment was extremely well equipped. Filipe was very helpful, providing lots of recommendations.
The local people were very friendly and restaurants really good

Excellent central location, the apartment was fantastic, very spacious, and spotless. Márcia and Teresa were even kind of enough to arrange transport from the airport and recommend places for us to visit. Best of all they were considerate enough with our request to check out later than expected. I highly recommend this place. A+++

Marcia let us know that her friend David would meet us at the apartment. He was punctual and friendly. David helped us with all our questions. The apartment is nice and spatious, the kitchen offers everything one needs during a short stay in Porto!
We had a four day break with friends. The apartment was more than comfortable with plenty of spcae. We had breakfast on the terrace every day. The location is fantastic. Ian, Anne, Phil and Wendy

Ideally located, great space in out door area, great rooms, very secure and safe and hosts were very helpful with tips and advise. Good air conditioning which was important due to the heatwave at the time. Shops, tours, bus and all public transport very close.

This is a fantastic apartment . We travelled as a party of 4 and the space was perfect. It was extremely clean and the furnishings are really nice. Bedding and towels were good quality. Location excellent , so nice to stay in a traditional building. The terrace is lovely, we had mixed weather but still made good use of it. I could not recommend it enough , when we return to beautiful Porto we would not consider staying anywhere else. We were kindly allowed to stay in the flat later than the usual checkout time as the flat was not booked the next day , amazingly we were charged no extra fee. I am writing this a few days after returning, when I think about our trip, I also think of the apartment, so that says everything.
Thank you Marcia and Teresa

Great location and listing was as expected.
Prefer when we check in with a lock box, as we were late for the check in since we were driving in town.

Excellent apartment, spacious, clean, well-equipped, and best of all a fantastic location right beside Ponte Luis and walking distance to everything. The hosts were very helpful and accommodating, I would highly recommend this listing.
What a great experience! The apartment is really amazing, big and right in the center of everything. Sofia is a great host and she is very helpful and kind. Strongly recommended

Sofia was wonderful, she pointed out some of the main sites on a map and that was all we needed as everything is very close and walkable.  The flat was as described with lots of charming touches.  Highly recommend.

Great location. A lot of bedrooms and a nice living area/deck, however the bathroom was unclean and the shower drain did not work properly / was backed-up. Shower situation made it a difficult stay for five travelers.

Great location of the flat
Good cleanlyness and equipment in general. The terrace was great for having breakfast. We loved it and will defintely be back if we come to porto again. Thank you!

Great location—loved loved loved. Ample space for us 5. Sofia was nice about check in even though due to an error on our part (I got confused with military time), she had to return later. We parking a way down the hill—about a euro an hour, takes card. Would highly recommend.
The location is perfect! Sofia was a great host, she gave us excellent recommendations of restaurants and places to go to. The terrace is lovely.
Great host with great tips for local addresses. Idyllic location near historic sites, with quiet street at night. We were 6 friends and had a great time.

Great accommodation in an excellent location - close to amenities and sightseeing. Really easy to get to from the airport using the metro.
Sofia was a friendly and helpful host - would certainly recommend.

The tempoeature of house was cold, and the electricity was not enough to supply power for every electronic fans on each room. So we had to turn off the air conditioner in the living room if we wanted to turn it on at the rooms. Also the hot water was not enough to use four adults. My son had to take a shower in cold water.
However the location was the best what I had been in Europe.

This apartment is worth recommending to you! It is cozy, fresh, convenient, spacious. It has everything - electric heaters, air conditioners, washing machine, tv, WiFi, nice strong hot shower, 2 toilets, a bidet, huge wardrobes in every of the 4 bedrooms, a nice spacious balcony with a table and chairs and an optional tent and a lift in the building. It is very well located and makes it easy to explore the city. We had a slight difficulty with parking our car - which proves the apartment is right in the center. There is a good city parking very close by for 20 Euros per 3 days - ask Sofia for directions. There are lots of suggestions about the city from Sofia and we recommend having a look at them as we ourselves did enjoy a few. Sofia is very nice and polite, was always available via phone and asked how we were almost daily. Thank you!

The place location is amazing, just one minute walk from the main bridge and 5 minutes walk from the tram station.
The place was perfectly clean and had a great selection of amenities including coffee machine and kettle.
Sofia has been a great host, providing advices about the places to visit and kindly allowing us for a late check out.
If I will visit Porto again I will definitely consider to go back there.

Excellent location and very spacious apartment.
Sofia is very accommodating. She waited for us until late for check in. Also, provided all the necessary information about parking and other stuff.
Definitely recommend this place to make your trip more enjoyable.
Great location, host was flexible and responsive.  Apartment was comfortable although space was a little tight for six.

Great place to stay. The location is amazing, since its right next to the bridge.
The place is clean.
Just there isnt really a view from the balvony, which i was a bit disappointed about.
But nonetheless great communication and a great host.
Great location, we were able to explore the entire city on foot. Communication was super quick as well!

Márcia's apartment was absolutely gorgeous and well exceeded our expectations. A really peaceful location but super easy to get to the livelier parts of town, we could not have asked for a better place to stay. It is spacious and modern, the beds were comfortable, had a beautiful terrace area, and was easy to find. We would absolutely stay here again on our next trip to Porto

We had a wonderful stay in this apartment. Perfect location, and even though it was a busy area the apartment was quiet. We loved the terrace and the kitchen was fully equipped. Super comfortable beds and tons of closet space!
I would absolutely recommend a stay here.
Porto was lovely and would love to visit again!
Very central but it can get noisy for those who may be bothered by this. Not a problem for us. Very comfortable apartment. Would come back again. Thank you.
We had a wonderful time staying at the apartment! Close to lots of the major sites. Easy to get around! Highly recommend!

location!!!! wonderful place and as advertised! great location, right by bridge, on a no car street, near sao bento train station, and everything else! quick walk to anything you need in Porto! highly recommend if you want to be in the middle of the city!

Fantastic apartment which suited our needs perfectly. 4 lady friends on a well earned break. We had a bedroom each with balcony at front to watch world go by and large outside seated area at rear. . Host very responsive and friendly. Spotless clean with shampoo/conditioner/shower gel and hairdryer.  tea/coffee also. Restaurants, bridge , cathedral all on the doorstep. Would absolutely stay there again.
The location was excellent, and the apartment was spacious. Susanna was very helpful to give us guidance on parking options and eating/sightseeing tips.
Filipe waited for us but was very kind and discret and the fridge was filled with the basic breakfast , bread , juice even a bottle of wine.

This was the best place that me and my spouse have stayed in as far as I can remember. Equipped with modern appliances mostly from Ikea. The bathroom and the view of the bridge is superb. Filipe was gracious and accommodating. He provided fruits, bread, good Portugese wine, ham and cheese and more and beverages for us. It was very comfortable, relaxing, and his place was adjacent to the major attractions in Porto. We did not have difficulty exploring the town. Thanks to Filipe and his extraordinary place.  Very attractive Japanese style aesthetic designed we think by his Portugese wife. A little hard to find with GPS but great safe parking right outside.

Thank you Filipe for welcoming us to your wonderful apartment. Your recommendations for restaurants were fantastic and the apartment was clean, modern, and had a great location. The breakfast foods and a bottle a wine was wonderful touch. For future renters if you are arriving by car do not follow a GPS. Follow signs to the Cathedral Se and ask Filipe for guidance to the apartment. Filipe was wonderful with helping us find the apartment and a parking space. Thank you Filipe.
Amazing view over Luis the first bridge. Very close to city centre and transportation. Filipe was very nice to have brought food and drinks for us in the fridge. We loved our stay.
Great location and lovely home.  Filipe was the perfect host.  I would highly recommend it.
Welcoming space with an amazing view and the perfect location from which to explore Porto. Super comfortable and quiet at night. Well appointed -- snacks in fridge, great wifi, all you could ask for!

Located on the oldest street in Porto in the central historic district .. easy access to Sao Bento Metro, train station, restaurants, riverway .. walk over bridge to other side of the Douro River .. the accommodations were as nice and as comfortable as we have experienced .. entering the building by a centuries old door and up a short flight of stairs you step into a bright, ultra clean, modern and well appointed apartment .. two comfortable bedrooms, walk in tiled shower and separate WC .. kitchen has everything and as well as sleek space saving appliances .. Filipe, Anabel and Daniele could not have been more accommodating . we would stay here again and again … HC, Portland, Maine US

Filipe's apartment has to have one of the best views in Porto!
We were welcomed by Daniela at check-in, who was really friendly and equipped with lots of local knowledge and tips which she shared with us. Food was provided in the fridge for our first breakfast and a bottle of wine was left for us, which was appreciated.
The apartment is in a great location - really central and all the attractions are within walking distance. But we spent several evenings in the apartment admiring the great views, with a glass of Port (or two). After all, you can see the Port houses from the balcony!
The host was really flexible with our check-out time as we had a late flight. We really appreciated this flexibility.
Great apartment in the very centre! Newly refurbished, clean and functional. Fantastic view! Great hosts!
Great Airbnb apt: very clean, owners was very responsive and commutative, everything you need is provided, close to everything, etc.  And the view was  AMAZING.  A ”must stay” if you visit Porto.

Highly recommended
This apartment is fantastic. It’s located in the heart of Porto with all tourist attractions within a short walk. The apartment is modern and clean with a breath-taking view of the Dom Luis bridge. We were greeted by a friendly lady, Manuela who informed us about local information and was quick to respond to questions during our stay. The apartment was stocked with basic food and drink which was a lovely touch and there was room to park a hire car outside on the road, free of charge. We requested an early check-in and late check-out which was accommodated with ease; we highly recommend this apartment and hope to return next year.

Very nice place and excellent location. Great view of the river.  Good communication from the host and nice extra touches like a bottle of wine. There was an issue with the WiFi on the last day but Filipe did his best to correct it. Would stay there again.

We absolutely loved our stay at Felipe’s place. If you are thinking of booking, stop looking and just book.
The place is stylish, has the most amazing view of the bridge, and is walking distance to everything. Check in and out were super easy, and best of all, Felipe was super responsive and answered any questions right away. What more could you want!

We had a lovely stay at this apartment. It has the most well equipped kitchen in any Airbnb I’ve stayed at which really allowed us to enjoy this apartment as much as possible, especially in these Covid times when eating out is a little bit more risky. It is very central and the views from the apartment are spectacular and the bed and sofa are really comfortable. The shower is huge and the pictures do not do it justice.
If you want to enjoy Porto and feel like you are at home, book this apartment!

The location is perfect and the view of the bridge is spectacular. Manuela went out of her way to welcome us and provide everything we needed. The apartment was very well-stocked, so we did NOT need to purchase extra paper goods, soaps, etc. We would happily stay here again!
Great location, great view and very roomy. Filipe is a host that cares about his guests

The apartment was lovely and well stocked. Even stocked with some basics items for a light break fast.  Location was phenomenal.  From the balcony, we could enjoy a beautiful Luis I bridge with the river view on fullmoon night. Location was very close to everything. We enjoyed walking down to the river through narrow alleys.. Manuela was very sweet and helpful with direction to the apartment. We will definitely come back  when we visit Porto again.
Absolutely outstanding views in a very private apartment.   Great communication from Filipe and Manuela was extremely helpful at check-in!

Great location, host was helpful, flat was clean and had all the listed amenities, nice balcony overlooking the bridge. Only downside was the building works next door which thankfully were only operating on 2 out of our 7 nights, but on those 2 nights it was very loud and a bit of a struggle to get to sleep.

Great renovated apartment. The views over the Douro are sensational - day and night!! Minor problem initially with the very old front door and actually opening it, but after a few attempts, got the hang of it. The balcony overlooking the river is tiny, really only for one, but it’s great to sit out in the fresh air and have a wine. As highlighted, there is significant building going on next door - commences 7.45am goes through till about 4.30pm daily. But this shouldn’t worry you as you’ll be out most of the day doing the tourist “thing”
Why stay at a five star hotel, when you can stay at Felipe’s five star AirBnb.  Incredible View and location and Manuela was very accommodating and helpful.

Incredible view overlooking the Ponte Luis I bridge from the unit and in a great location. It was very walkable, easy access to the Sao Bento train station, and tucked just behind the Porto Cathedral. We had a great stay and will return the next time we are in Porto.

Excellent location, we were made to feel welcome by Susanna, the apartment was clean and tidy. The flat is in the heart of the city with fantastic views of surrounding area, easy access to transport links and local shops. Myself and family would certainly come back here.

Super convenient location near the river, cathedral, pedestrian bridge, etc. A lovely home. Wish we could have sat on the big patio but it was too rainy. Unfortunately the elevator was out of order the last day so we had to

Fantastic, clean and modern apartment exactly as described. The apartment is in a superb location, within walking distance of all the key places to visit in Porto as well as the metro. We were met on arrival and given great recommendations for places to eat and drink. Would definitely stay here again!

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment! It was absolutely lovely – very clean, stylish, and incredibly well-located. Everything I needed was within walking distance, making my trip so much easier. The host was exceptionally friendly and helpful, always quick to respond and made me feel very welcome. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area and would definitely stay here again!
Unbeatable central location for exploring.  The six of us were all very comfortable and the large terrace is a real treat in this densely packed area

Great large apartment close to the amenities of Porto! We were lucky enough to be able to chrck in early and communication was quick and easy. Grocery store approx. 10 min walk over the bridge. Amazing resturants and bakeries all within a short walk aswell. Loved the back patio to enjoy after the kids went to bed. Would highly recommend this spot for families.

The building was old but the apt was modern.  Very cute inside.  Felt very comfortable.   And the view of the bridge and river was great. There is construction on the building next door but only one day did they wake us up.  You can hear the metro train as it crosses the bridge but we got use to it.  We were so close to restaurants, great coffee, and bars it made it a great stay.

We loved our stay in Porto. The location is amazing, we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. The apartment is quite nice and the view cannot be beat. We stayed over a weekend and had no issue with the construction noise, however, we were not really home much during the day. One thing to note is that the construction has made the front door a little difficult to access by car as there is no where to turn around on the road. However, the door is a short walk from the main road that is easily accessible. If you have a chance, check out the wine bar around the corner - it was a highlight of our trip.

The best view in town, no doubt! We absolutely loved the place and couldn’t get enough of the view!
Despite the ongoing construction right next door (as early as 7:15am which we understand has nothing to do with Fillipe), the place had everything we needed and more. Great, proactive communication with lots of local recommendations helped to get as close to Porto’s culture and vibe as possible. Highly recommend!
This is our third time staying at Filipe's wonderful place. This was our longest stay at 2.5 weeks and it was well worth it. We will be returning again and again!
Great location!  Beautiful view.  The apartment is very well equipped and is modern and clean.

What a great experience!! We spent two days in Porto in Céline's apartment, and it was very good. The apartment has all you need, the room and the living room are really big and it is very nice decorated. Céline was always available for help and she was concerned about our stay. The apartment is 10min walking from the city Center and 5 minutes to a shopping street.
A 10 for the apartment and a 10 for her.
Next time in Porto will be in her house if possible

It was a nice, clean and tidy appartment. It had everything we needed. It was sometimes a little bit warm, although it was really hot at the time we visited Porto. Within minutes you are in the city center, the river was also at walking distance. Celine gave us some good tips and replyed quickly to our questions.

Amazing flat!!! Great location very central and quiet at the same time
Lovely terrace
Céline is a specially friendly and awesome guest

My mom and I had the opportunity to stay at Celine's apartment and had a lovely experience.
Communicating with Céline was always easy and when we arrived in Porto and the taxi dropped us up at the apartment, Céline was waiting for us that the door.
The apartment was perfect, it was beautiful, clean and within a couple of minutes walk to the central part of Porto.
We would stay there again and definitely recommend that apartment!

Céline's flat is the perfect place for a stay in Porto. The location is great, in a quiet area 5-10 minutes walk to the historical centre of Porto. Céline met us at the flat and showed us the parking spot (garage) and the flat. She gave us so many great tips on where to eat and what to see. The flat is really spacious and clean. If you stay in Porto, stay at Céline's place.

the central location, the tranquility of the neighborhood, and the elegant, clean and welcoming house are the setting for a wonderful short or long stay here in Porto. Celine is a friendly, helpful and very nice owner.
A great apartment for those that want to explore Porto and everything is has to offer. Close to everything, yet very quite and peaceful.

This is a really nice apartment. The blackout curtains and the private balcony were extremely nice to have during our stay. There's a washer and plenty of space to dry clothes. If you're bringing a car, this apartment will have you handled. Céline gave us great recommendations for local sights and wineries. Highly recommended.
Celine‘d Place is beautiful, great location, and lovely with a bit of outside space.  Celine was super helpful in giving local tips for restaurants.

The flat is in the centre of Porto. Everything was like the description on Airbnb. The noise outside you can deal with. There are a lot of Bars and restaurants in the district.
We had a warm welcoming by Patricia and Rui and they were almost everytime reachable for any question.

Perfect apartment, clean, decorated with taste and a lot of little touches as well as space to feel calm after being in the energetic city all day. Patricia gave me loads of suggestions, even for some locations for filming. And vegan dining list. As if that isn’t enough, there’s an independent cinema directly opposite! Would certainly stay again
this is the second time we have rented this accommodation and we are still delighted with the location and the spaciousness of the apartment. our favorite place to explore Porto.
The place is really spacious as describe. Great location! everything is walking distance. Patricia is an excellent host! would definite recommend the place!

A lovely place in a perfect location. Bedroom overlooks a beautiful mossy roof and cinema and gets morning sun. There is some construction outside the back balcony but this is seemingly the case all over Porto and you couldn’t hear it from the bedroom. Patricia and Rui were very helpful, gave me tips for the city and allowed me to leave some bags after check out

A clean and spacious flat in an easily accessible location with a helpful and responsisve host...what more could you want? The flat itself is surprisingly large and has wonderful natural light. It's clean and well stocked, perfect for a couple. My only complaints would be that the bathroom is quite small and the bed isn't the most comfortable. It's really well situated however, just a five minute walk from a metro station that goes directly to the airport. There's a supermarket around the corner and numerous good restaruants in a 5 minute radius. Finally, Rui was an absolutely stellar host! He was flexible about a late check in and check out, left us detailed local recommendations, replied promptly to all messages, and gave a very helpful and detailed tour of the flat on check in. Couldn't reccommend more for a couple staying in Porto

Perfect location. Easy access to so many restaurants, shops and Train Station. It's the centre of everything.
lots of conveniences nearby such as a grocery and then a convenience store and a laundromat next door.
The apartment was as described and even more spacious than expected. Highly recommend this place.

we stayed at Rui and  Patricia's place for 4 nights. Place was exactly as advertised and extremely clean. our host was perfectly on time to let us in and carefully explained everything about the place, surroundings and recommended local restaurants which we enjoyed. Location was great with just 5 minutes walk to Trindade Metro station and close to all historic center sights. We definitely recommend Rui and Patricia's place if you plan to visit Porto.
Apartment super clean and much bigger than photos. Very clean and comfortable with a really walkable location.

FeelPorto company has been extremely accommodating and responsive. Very nice and clean apartment and well managed. Would definitely stay with them again. We had a great experience and a wonderful time in Porto!
We would say the same as for the review of the other apartment we rented at the same time - fantastic

We had a great stay at this apartment. It was very homey and had everything we needed to enjoy a week in the city. It was in a great location and was very comfortable and spacious for two people. Would definitely stay here again!

The Stay at Trebid'Ouro exceeded our expectations! First of all, we were very warmly welcome from the very begining by the staff in charge. Then we had lots of small attentions, like fresh fruits and vegetables directly from the tenants' garden. The location is big enough and lies in a very quiet place, away from any other house. Staying with a whole group was fantastic, as everyone had their own room and bathroom. The rest area stays away from the common rooms, so that some of us could rest in peace, while others had fun together. The swimming-pool is THE attraction of the location. Connection to Porto is very easy and shorter tahn expected (40 minutes to Porto center by motorway). Grocery stores available in area (Vale Cabra 10 minutes). Very nice view on the ocean and the Aveiro area. We would come back more often, if we did not live so far away!
Great space in a really convenient part of town. We were well looked after during our stay and the communication was great.

Great location, 15 min walk away from tourist attractions and the port. Really close to restaurants, bars and cafes. Very very clean, really comfy beds! Suited a group of 12 comfortably, hosts really friendly and responsive. Paid extra for airport transfer which was very efficient. Would 100% recommend this place!!
