This apartment is exactly what it looks like in the photos. It was clean and had all the amenities (every bathroom its own hairdryer, high chair, crib, baby toys, drying rack, iron, washer). They also provided a map and when we requested a car service the day before, they were able to accomodate with no issues. This apartment is walking distance to 3 grocery stores and the city centre. Would definitely stay here again!
Super location - near but not in busiest sections.  Great lay-out.  StayPorto people very nice and professional.

The location made it easy to get around the city. The apartment is run by a business and that being the case there could have been a few improvements, like extra towels, cleaning supplies for a unit this size, super fast wifi and making sure all repairs to the unit are complete before guest check in. That being said, the staff members were amazing and really took extra care to make sure we got all the things we needed and had a pleasant experience overall.

We didnt enjoy the place. The basic is ok but Iit It was cold, the air-conditioner didn't work, not a lot of hot water.
No shelf the shower or rooms to make the stay comfortable.
So only the basic was ok but nothing more.

We thoroughly enjoyed our 6-night stay. The apartment’s in a great location close to cafes, bars, shops and transport links. We were there as a family group (7 adults) and the apartment, as the pictures show, provided a clean, comfortable and well-equipped base. Feel Porto team were friendly and helpful and the airport transfer  we’d booked was quick, easy and really appreciated by us all given our flight arrival time.

Hugo arranged my car from the airport, showed me everything in the apartment (door code, air conditioning, etc) and gave great recommendations in the city. He was always easy to reach by text, email. The location of the apartment is perfect: down on the river with beautiful views of the D. Luis bridge. The apartment is as advertised - a clean cool space, very comfortable for three people.
Great location with a great view of the river and very close to the Ribeira district. We enjoyed our short stay very much and loved Porto!
Love this apartment. View from the window is stunning, and the location is central. Walkable to most of the places in the city if you are fine with walking uphills. Responsive and nice host.

This is a great apartment - right next to the river with incredible views - 3 minutes walks to the main riverside restaurant area but just far enough away to be much quieter. The host team were incredibly responsible and helpful. Fantastic.
Amazing stay, close to all main sights in both Gaia and Porto. Suggest arranging airport transfer as it's much cheaper than a cab. All amenities, excess towels, blankets etc were provided--perfect!

It's a great apartment (comfortable, clean, spacious, cosy), perfectly situated with an amazing view. There are bars and restaurants nearby with a nice people and nice atmosphere. We had a great time in Porto.
The only thing I can complain is a lack of communication with a host.

The place was very convenient for a large group with bathroom in each bedrooms. All the required equipment was provided in the flat and they were very responsive. Walking distance to most location in Porto.

Easy 15 min walk down to the waterfront, bridge and Cathedral.
Lots of lovely bakery, restaurants and a supermarket within a few mins.
Place was larger than expected with everything we needed.
The most amazing AirBNB we have ever rented.  Amazing location right next to the bridge, whole apartment has AC, very clean and very quiet.  Would highly recommend.

Great location.  Easy check in.  Views are amazing.  Only issue we had was the floor boards in front of first floor room squeaked badly so if you walked around at night you woke the loft room up.  But overall wonderful stay.  Owners were very helpful and responsive.  Tapas restaurant next door is a hidden gem.

Loved loved the location and check in was super easy and smooth. Apartment was clean and comfortable and had everything we needed and more. Extremely professional service and even went above and beyond to help us organize a private driver to the airport. Thank you for hosting us! We can't wait to visit again! xo
The location of this unit was ideal. Down the street from everything on the riverfront and walkable.  Highly recommend this unit and its unique loft 2nd bedroom/bath.

A perfect and stylish flat. Located in the midst of a very nice area full of restaurants and bars, all with a quite youth vibe to. Ana and Thiego were very nice and helpful, recommended us several things and place (restaurants, museums etc) which we all tried out and enjoyed the hell out of.
Thank you so much for the hospitality.
We'll meet again

I highly recommend this place for staying. It is very nice and cozy space which is newly removated by Tiao who is owner of this house and archtect. And so very beautiful and clean. The fresh fruits and wine provided by them are very tasted, and the provided tour infomation is very easy and useful. It is located in downtown and so very easy to commute any place. And communication with them is no problem as Ana is a fluent speaker and gives feedback promptly. Porto was wonderful place I've ever been and this place added to falling in love Porto.

Best Airbnb experience we've had so far!!
What an amazing apartment with an unique interior. Such a beautiful old house, fully renovated and with a cool, minimalistic touch. Not to forget the stunning winter garden with a view to the green backyard.
Ana was a very nice and helpful host. She let us check in late at night and still wasn't too tired to give us great tips to enjoy Porto to the fullest.
Everything was clean and silent at night. We felt very much at home.
The location and neighborhood are great, too. All sights are within walking distance and you're in the middle of nice bars, hip restaurants, trendy boutiques and cool design shops.
If we come back to Porto, this will definitely be our first choice. :) Thanks Ana & Tiago!

It was a perfect stay. Ana prepared our arrival perfectly and she gave us many tips what to do in Porto. The flat is very nice. It was recently refurbished and is in perfect condition. The location is perfect, walking distance to the centre of Porto and very close to the main subway station. A very good experience!

Ana was super friendly and everything was good, better than expected. The appartment was in a very good location close to everything. I would definitly highly recommend the appartment and hope to come back soon. Thanx for having us!
Ana was waiting for us as planned and made us feel very welcome. She spent a while showing us around the apartment and explaining how everything worked.

My friend and I had an amazing time in the apartment of Ana and Tiago which is very nearby to the city life of wonderful Porto !! Ana recommended us many great places nearby and was helping wherever she could. We definitely would recommend the flat and hope to come back one day :)

Ana and Tiago's flat is really beautiful – even nicer than the pictures, with lovely high ceilings which kept us cool in the hot weather. Everything in the flat works perfectly, the design is perfect for the space. It's in a great area, with lots of bars, restaurants and shops, and is really close to the train station for easy airport transfer. We had a great time staying in Porto and hope to visit again soon. Thank you Ana and Tiago!

Ana & Tiago's place is so much lovelier than the photos can convey. There are just so many beautiful, thoughtful touches. You can tell no detail has gone unconsidered. And even though it's a small space, it manages to have a feeling of space and light. As if that weren't enough to recommend it, Ana & Tiago are amazing hosts! Super friendly, easy-going, and with tons of GREAT recommendations — trust these guys, they know what they're talking about. Would love to stay again, and would recommend to everyone!

Ana and Tiago’s apartment is so stylishly  decorated. It’s the perfect place to come home to after a long day of wandering around magical Porto. The balcony/porch is refreshing on sunny afternoons and romantic on rainy mornings. It was the perfect spot for a solo traveler!

We had a great stay in Ana and Tiago's apartment. It is small but perfect for one person or a couple. The design is lovely and interesting and there's a cool Zen touch to the interior. The enclosed balcony with a garden view is a definite highlight. We loved the neighborhood too - and had super recommendations of cafés and restaurants in the area from our hosts. Communication was friendly and easy throughout and check in went smoothly. Thanks Ana and Tiago for a comfortable base from which to explore beautiful Porto!

Beautifully renovated apartment and good contact with Ana : she welcomed us in the apartment and provided a great guide with recommendations of places to visit in Porto. Also she speaks French very well! Thank you

Ana and Tiago’s apartment was beautiful - the pictures don’t do it justice! If you’re interested in an apartment with a modern, quiet aesthetic, I would recommend it without hesitation. Check-in with Ana was easy, and we had no issues during our stay. The bathroom was roomier than I initially thought, and the bed was very comfortable. Great location, too!
A beautiful studio in an elegant building with everything within walking distance. Ana and Tiago were wonderful hosts. I couldn't have asked for a nicer place to stay.

We really enjoyed staying at Ana and Tiago’s place. The apartment is located in a very central location. We were very pleased with the cleanliness of the apartment and we would definitely recommend this place to others.

Good size for a bachelor suit, nice layout, with a lovely terrace overlooking a small, quiet backyard. The location is ideal - near the centre of town and plenty of excellent local restaurants but in a quiet neighborhood.

We had a wonderful stay with Ana and Tiago. The place is in a perfect location, close to transit and in a cute neighborhood. The bed was comfy and the whole place was super stylish. Ana and Tiago also gave great local recs. I would definitely stay here again!

Fabulous location, close to lots of places for food & drinks, walking distance to the river and all the sights in Porto.
The space was super clean and Ana was accommodating and quick to respond upon arrival.
Would stay here again, no brainer!

Ana & Tiago’s place is stylish and very modern located 10 min walk from Sao Bento station! Location was excellent! Ana met us on arrival and gave us a list of tips of where to go and what to eat.
All in all 10 out of 10!

This is a great little place in central Porto. Its an easy walk from the train station and an easy walk down to the river and around town to see the sights. The building is charming and well kept and the unit features cool vintage furniture and nice design touches like storage adjacent to the sleeping area and a sliding wood panel wall to section off the living space from sleeping quarters. The outdoor kitchen and indoor/outdoor space at the back is very well designed and a pleasure to spend time in. In the book shelves, you'll find some cool zines featuring design and architecture of Portugal. I even learned all about how the underground Metro system was designed by a famous architecture team local to Porto.  Ana and Tiago are such nice people and will gladly give you recommendations. Recommended!
A wonderful space to stay! Exactly as pictured and in a great location! Would highly recommend to everyone I know going to Porto!
Perfect place to stay a few days for exploring the city by foot. You feel just like home, thank you!

Wonderful place! Ana greeted us in person, showed us the apartment and told us a bit about the history of the house. We got some tips for nearby restaurants and bars. We felt very welcome! The apartment itself is beautiful and perfect for 2 people. We would come back there anytime!

This apartment is just amazing! It’s super  beautiful, everything very comfortable, and it has a special vibe. It’s also really well located to explore Oporto and you will find anything you need to enjoy your stay.  Ana was very nice welcoming me. Thank you Ana & Tiago! :)

Mario was a great and accommodating host. Easy to get in touch with him and he picked us up at the train station to guide us to his apartment. Would definitely stay at this apartment again the next time I am in Porto.

Mario' s apartments was a really great choice for our stay in Porto. The house is located in a very nice and convenient region. It's  really close to public transportation and central roads. The apartment provides everything it promises. It is neat,  bright and cosy.

The place was ideal for a short stay in Porto! Everything was clean and the apartment was a great size for two, and very close to everything. Mario was very helpful with instructions on how to get there from the (very close) metro stop and also allowed us to check in early. I'd highly recommend staying here!

Great place! Good location in the center. Spacious and very neat, all very modern. We requested a babybed which was there for us.
There is no view from this apartment and there are quite soms stairs to take, however in total we had a really good stay and will return one day!
We had a great time in Porto, Mario’s place was walking distance to everything we wanted to experience. AC was great during one of the hottest weeks in Portugal when we were there!

Perfect location, wonderful house and host's so kindness :)
Have good security and It's easy to go back and forth because of its location.
I would like to stay here again if I come to Porto again.
Thanks :)

We had a wonderful stay at Mario’s apartment. It was super clean and the location couldn’t be better. Great local recommendations that helped make our trip more special. Highly recommend this apt to any travelers visiting Porto!
Nice appartment in Porto which is located very well. Mario was a very good host. We can highly recommend this apartment.

Great place. Very conveniently located for getting to and from the airport, and walking distance from anywhere in central Porto. Clean and just as nice as it looks in the pictures. Would recommend to all!

Very central, this is a big plus in Porto. It was a short walk down into the main part of Porto, close to the train station and metro, near a local supermarket and just up the road from a great bakery.

The apartment it's very nice, confortable and clean.
Great location to visit the city with everything you need around, supermarket, restaurants, shops...
We recommend this place and we hope to come back.

Perfect apartment for a City trip !
Great location and good communication
The host was very flexible for the check in which was very helpful !
I recommend this apartment !
Mario went out of his way help us having an amazing stay in porto. great host, great location!
Good communication, great location (the apartment is in the city center, nearby, there are some restaurants and bars). Flat was clean and well-equipped. Definitely recommend.

We had a lovely 4-night stay in Mario's apartment. It is as advertised, perfectly located, spacious and quiet. We also enjoyed some extra help checking in, good communication and great site-seeing advice.
Would definitely visit again.
We had a wonderful time in our short stay. Great locations, clean apartment, and great communication. No complaints at all!

The best of this house is the location! You are walking distance from everywhere in the centre. In addition, the apartment was very clean and the hosts were very nice! The apartment could be more modern though.

Quaint looking room with nice wood and brick decor.   Part of a cafe building, with common kitchenette and tv room, so we didnt get to use kitchenette as freely as i like.  Location is perfect and plenty of restaurants around.  Parking garage 300m away.
Great apartment! The location was amazing and it only took a few minutes to walk to the city center. Mário was a great host and the communication was smooth and easy.
The apartment from Mario is very spacious and clean. it's located near the shopping mall and street from Porto. the communication went good and the instructions were very clear.
It was on the 2nd floor without lift so you need to carry your luggages up the stairs.
Lovely area and easy location for the city centre! The appartment is quite big so more then enough room for 2. Would recommend!

A great location. The apartment needs some repair. The view is unpleasant, windows cant be opened as a kitchen of neighbouring restaurant produces to much smell. Overall a normal place to spend a night or two

The accommodation is spacious and in a great location. Mario is easy to communicate with and was very responsive. Access was easy and there were great amenities like AC and a nice TV if you need a quiet evening. It is a very short walk to a nice market and about 15-20 minute walk to the Douro River. Overall a great spot!
Thank you for a swift stop over stay at Oporto. The flat was very nice and spacious. Wish we could have stayed longer to enjoy it more. I would recommend this apartment.

Mário’s place is perfect for a visit to Porto,  in the middle of everything you would want to see and also right on the Metro line. Also, I want to note that the shower had amazing water pressure, something that I am always desperate for in a stay.

Mario's apartment was spacious, clean and conveniently located. Mario was responsive to my questions leading up to our visit. When we arrived, Patricia provided us with an amazing list of tips and suggestions. We loved being so close to the Balhao market. Definitely very good value.

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment!
It is in an ideal location in Porto with lots to do around the area.
Mario gave lots of recommendations of things to do which were close by.
Great place to stay would defo recommend and would defo stay again!

A very nice apartment with a fantastic location. Close to the main shopping street and a lot of restaurants close by.
The apartment has a balcony but unfortunately there is not a nice view.
Mario went out of his way to assist with the parking. His recommendations about was spot on. I will recommend Mario’s place to my friends! Thank you Mario, keep it up!

We had a perfect stay at Mario's place! Great location, great apartment! Easy to find, and the check in was very flexible, once it was self check in.
The only thing to note is that, even though in the add it said there would be cooking supplies such as salt as olive oil, there were none for our stay. But there's a supermarket close by and we were able to buy it :)
The apartment was clean, modern and spacious. Mário was very accommodating and easy to communicate with throughout our stay. Highly recommended!

Place as per photos, super central location and right next to Bolhao market and main shopping street. Easy to check in and check out. The only thing is the sofa bed was not sturdy and I got back pain after two nights. Good for two people but third person who sleeps on sofa bed might suffer. Other than that everything was nice, air cons are perfect for the weather.
Priscilla's apartment gave us quiet, hassle free, clean accommodation, 3 minutes from the metro. Couldnt have asked for more.

Priscilla was clear and thorough right from the start. Everything was as listed and better. She cleaned meticulously and was easy to chat with when she was there to make sure all was well. The location was great and I would come again anytime.

Excellent location in the hart of porto.
The appartment is really nice and has a good feel to it
I was with my son for a week and we really enjoyed our week in porto

I could live here, I immediately thought when I entered the apartment (and when I left). The place is very arty, super clean, and has a great location. Trendy and good restaurants are only one street away and if you want to cook, you have a cosy and well-equiped kitchen. Booking an Airbnb is always exciting and for us, a clean place and friendly host is very important. And we were lucky: we really loved Rute, she is a great woman, has a lovely family and is very hospital. She selected a very nice red wine as a welcoming gift as well ! We would definitely stay here again when we visit Porto ! But without our little son, so we can have more time for those lovely restaurants and port wine :)
Rute was very friendly and reacted very quickly on all our messages. The neighborhood is great and the place is clean, has nice light en a cool garden.

Great place that is exactly as shown in the pictures. What you don't see though is the perfect location of the appartment. Right in the middle of shops, bars and restaurants but simultaneously quiet and cosy in a street without traffic. The main touristic sights are in walking distance and so are the local neighbourhoods. Simply amazing.

Hi Rute,
We had spent very nice days in Porto, at least also because of your so nice flat. Although the weather was not the best, we enjoyed to stay in your flat, next to the best bakery in town and very close to the sigthseeings, nice Restaurants, bars etc. Everything was very clean, well equipped, even for our kids.
Thanks you so much

We had such a lovely stay- the travel cot was all set up for our baby and a bottle of wine was on the table ready for us!
We can't wait to come back!

The apartment is even better than described! Great location, well equipped and very well designed. Rute is a very good host, she was not able to meet us at the apartment but she promptly communicated. I would recommend to stay here and probably come back again next year. Thank you Rute!

We had a pleasant time at porto,
And lucky to stay at Dilia’s apartment, it’s very clean and well furnished in style , we got everything we needed ; Dilia offered us a bottle of red wine even ; and it’s easy to get to most of the place for visiting;
We may back to Porto soon !

We absolutely loved staying in Rute's place and it was the ideal location in Porto. We loved the charm of the old building but especially loved the modern touches in the apartment. The neighborhood is so quaint and it was so lovely and peaceful sitting in the back garden after a long day of walking. Everything was so close and easy to walk to. Rute was easy to communicate with and check-in was very simple. If we ever make it back to Porto we will definitely stay here again.

The place was even more spacious and beautiful than we expected. There was a bottle of wine waiting for us with a guide book of suggestions. The location was perfect. It’s right next to everything, but also on a quiet street.
Super clean, very compact and well appointed apartment. Even the sofa bed was very comfortable. Great location to explore Porto. Very satisfied.

I recently stayed at this Airbnb and had a great experience. The location is excellent, right in the heart of the city. There are numerous coffee shops, bars, and restaurants conveniently located nearby. Yet at the same time, given it’s located on a side street, the nights were peaceful and quiet, allowing for a good sleep and the private backyard patio was a nice feature. The host was responsive and communication was smooth. Overall, I had a pleasant stay and look forward to staying here again.
We can definitely recommend this place. It’s location is very central but quiet and has everything you need. The communication with the host was very easy.

perfect location so close to all attractions, plenty of local restaurants that we really enjoyed. Not disappointed with a single meal. Apartment was very clean, comfortable and quiet considering how close it is to the city centre.
Very modern, spacious and great apartment. Host was helpful and communicated well. Would recommend to everyone!

Fatima was very nice, received us on time and well explained about the city.That help us save many time.
The apartment is new and fancy but the only problem was there's not enough hot water for showering, beside the hot water everything is perfect.

The apartment was exactly as described, modern and clean in a convenient location with access to amenities such as public transport  (buses and metro), supermarket  (opposite), bars and bakeries  (200m). The journey to the city center is a pleasant walk. Fatima is a helpful, friendly and responsive host.

This was a beautiful, new and bright apartment very close to the train station. There is lots to see and do in the area. Fatima met us at the apartment and was very helpful. We loved Porto. We had 3 people.

It was a nice stay. Rooms are okay, nothing special, but cozy :)
The only bad thing is that there was no kettle in the apartment.
The apartment was very comfortable, cosy and modern. opposite the apartment is grocery. I can recommend everybody this nice apartment.

Hi Fátima and Abel,
Thanks for being a great host!
We really have a great stay at your cozy place and we enjoyed the city.
We highly recommend you!
Many thanks!
Regards,
My parents and I (Maite)

The apartment is as shown in the pictures, very nice, tidy and clean. The host is very helpful and communicates fast always. The location is great as well.
I highly recommend it.
Apartment is nice and clean with a fantastic size. Kitchen was good and the wine glasses a plus. Will definitively stay again.
The flat was clean and tidy with good amenities and the host was friendly. There was just a bit of mold on the bathroom ceiling. Apart from that everything was great.

Great apartment about 10 minutes walk from Porto centre. Close to the metro and several good bakeries and coffee shops close by for breakfast in the morning. Right opposite a small supermarket too which was handy. Check in was very easy, apartment was very clean.

This was such an amazing place. Has all of the essentials and is very relaxing.
The hosts are amazing and super communicative as well. Not one thing would I have changed about our stay!
Great stay, big apartment, second bedroom is really small, but the rest is nice. 17 minutes walk to the city center
The flat is good, the location is good, but there was a problem with router (wifi), for work-from-home people can be an issue.
Patricia and Lui were very nice and helpful, the apartment is nice and very well located. Thank you so much, we strongly recommend the place !

We had an amazing stay in Porto. Rui is very friendly and he showed us around where to go. The apartment was very nice. Clean, new, cosy and a perfect location near the centre of the town. Just bring some earplugs because it can get busy at the street at night (or just grab another drink in one of the great bars that Porto has got to offer :-))

Love the place, everything you see in the photos are accurate, ...host was very helpful and very friendly, the neighborhood is safe and lots of restaurants and bars, .. would recommend this place in a heartbeat..thank you Rui

Really enjoyed my stay at this place. Apartment is clean, cozy, and central. I've only had a chance to chat with Rui during my stay and he was very helpful and responsive.
Would definitely come back!

We spent 5 days there and had a really nice stay. The flat is super clean, well equipped and its location is ideal to discover Porto. Patricia was really helpful, quick in her answers and smily when we arrived, despite our late arrival. Would definitely recommend the place.

Great,  awsome appartment close to the old city. Rui was very helpful in explaining everything and had a lot of  tips for bars, restaurants and places to visit. I absolutely recommend the appartment of Patricia and Rui!
An absolutely lovely stay. Great amenities and clear communication. Made staying in Porto a warm, comfortable experience

Rui welcomed us to the loft and gave us lots of really good visting tips to walk around Porto.
Also great to show all around the flat and then let us be free for the rest of the time.
He was available for any questions and gave us contact details in case of anything happening.
Couldnt ask for more.

We had a lovely time staying in Patrícia and Rui’s apartment in Porto. We were welcomed by Rui on our arrival who showed us around the apartment and gave us fantastic tips on places to go and restaurants to eat at. The apartment was also great- it was very spacious with great kitchen and bathroom facilities in a central location just 20 minutes walk from Ribeira Square. A perfect place to spend a long weekend (or more) in Porto and fantastic value for money. Highly recommended!

I can only recommend this place. The location is just perfect for exploring Porto and is very central. The apartment has everything you need, is very clean and modern. We were welcomed very nicely and received a lot of good recommendations. I will definetly come back the next time I am in Porto.
Thanks for having us!
Patricia and Rui were very helpful with the check in, gave helpful recommendations and were always available for questions at any time ;)
Lovely clean apartment and great location! My parents stayed here for three nights and it had everything they need. Would highly recommend!
Great stay! Rui and Patricia were delightful and super helpful! Great location and wonderful apartment 🙂. Thank you both!

We spent five days in this beautiful apartment.
Patricia was very welcoming, friendly and recommended us a lot of activities and places to visit, but also restaurants to eat at.
Would definitely recommend staying at this apartment if you want to experience the city and the life!
Patricia was very kind and communicative. She took her time in pointing out places of interest in the map.
Lovely apartment and well located to local attractions, and only a 20 min walk to the river.  Definitely some street noise (particularly on Saturday night) but I slept well with my earplugs in.

We got very lucky to stay in Ana and Tiago's flat! It was in a beautiful building and everything was brand new. It is one big room with a comfy bed and sofa bed that fit three of us well. It is a short walk into the city center and has a nice cafe just across the street. I'd recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto it was fantastic!

The apartment is nicely located within walking distance from most of Porto, and with great access to public transportation. The sofa and dining table makes it easy to relax after a busy day in the city, and the balcony is nice for some air. The bed was comfortable, and the building was quiet, clean and in a good neighborhood. It is best suited for a couple or a small family, as the bathroom has somewhat transparent walls. We had a great time in Porto, and the location and quality of the apartment gave us a great experience, and we would recommend it :)

Chic and cozy house five minutes away from the core of the city. The area is quiet yet very nice, far enough to keep tourists away but very close to the city center, with many choices to have a great francesinha and very close to Cafe Majestic. The experience of staying in such a beautiful building was great.
The flat is well located but only suitable for a couple. The bathroom has no privacy and the condition of the finer touches needs reviewed.

We loved staying at Ana´s place.
The Apartment was exactly as mentioned in the description. Also we were able to check-in earlier. More Over Ana was kind and had some welcome wine and choclate ready for us to digg in.
If i´m going to visit Porto again i defintily would book this apartment.

The place is clean and beautifully decorated, though the bathroom is a bit cramped. The apartment itself is beautifully historic and the staircase leading up is spaciously wide. The hosts were patient with our later arrival and the neighborhood was lovely.

We loved staying at Ana‘s apartment. Everything was very clean and beautifully decorated. It looked exactly like in the fotos. The apartment is also very close to the city centre. The communication with Ana was also very good. We would definitely book the apartment again!

Ana’s place is wonderful! Exactly as pictured:) It is in a great location. Just far enough from city center to be quiet at night but close enough to walk most everywhere. I have already reserved the place again for a future visit!
It is very beautiful apartment. All the thing you need is there. The furniture are very new and chick, very clean of course.
Thank you Carolina, we had a lovely stay in the Appartment, well located, well decorated, it feels good for a trip in Porto!

I visited Porto with my mom for a few days and this studio was perfect for our needs. It’s comfortable: there is one bed and a sofa-bed (which I used and slept very well). It’s also ideally situated: there are many amenities on the street, at walking distance to the city centre and to a metro station, and the bus on the street will bring you to all the main sightseeing attractions in Porto. Carolina was a very helpful host. She answered very quickly when we contacted her. I would definitely recommend staying there if you visit Porto. Thank you Carolina for your hospitality!
Excellent stay! Highly recommend. Great apartment in a very cool neighbourhood. Communication with Carolina was great too, and she provided some awesome recommendations :)

Apartment is located in the upper side of Porto. This was an advantage to spend time around the near by attractions, however, it can be difficult to get back from the rivier side, old town. Apartment is very clean and well equipped. Decoration and overall looks as shown and described.
Close to public transportation. We loved the welcome drink and chocolate s.

We so enjoyed our stay here, the apartment is stunning and spacious! It was great to have access to Netflix too during a rainy visit too. & The bed was so comfortable! We would definitely visit again ☺️

Great location and space but it was dirty on arrival after I was kept waiting an extra hour for cleaning to finish and it smelt terrible. I deep cleaned the place and aired it and even after a few days the smell of what seemed to be rotting fish persisted. I asked for a refund of the cleaning fee and was refused repeatedly until they agreed. After I left the owner called me to complain that the stove was warm and I hadn't left the place clean enough which seemed strange as it was better than when I'd arrived. Their electrical heating unit doesn't work so on cold days it was necessary to burn wood to warm the space.
We really enjoyed our few days in Porto in Carolina’s place. Everything was just easy. Lovely location, quiet but close to everything. Perfect for a couple
Excellent location, walking distance to everywhere you’d want to go. Smooth check in and responsive host. Bright and modern apartment. We loved our stay!

Daniel was really friendly and helpful. I wasn't there at a time when the people in the other rooms were particularly social but I really liked the layout of the place and it was certainly nice to have a private room in a hostel like environment. Nice and quiet, good location, clean, good facilities!

I love porto, what an inspiring city!! the house is nice and friendly and from here you can visit everything by feet: going to bars at evening, seeing the historic city or walking to 'casa da musica' and listen to bands for free. I could also check-out flexible, the host is very friendly! Recommendation unless you wanna have a whirl-pool in your flat... Cheers

Very nice place, with kitchen and garden.
The house is near to the pedestrian street Cedofeita and you can go to the center and old city in a few minutes.
Bragas is very helpfull and the communication was reactive.
I'll keep the adress for my next stay in Porto.

The Bragas House is the ideal spot for travelers spending a few days in Porto. Checking in was very simple and communication prior to arriving was responded to quickly. The house itself is very clean and offers free laundry service, a main refrigerator, and is perfectly set up for meeting other travelers and locals!
I greatly enjoyed my stay in Bragas and Porto and recommend it to all!

I got to Porto at 8PM instead of 3PM because of train delays at Lisboa. Bragas was so accommodating even when I was late for check in. I appreciate this so much. The location was close to everything too and I even walked everytime I went out. Will go here again next time I’m in Porto!

Nice accommodation in a quiet area, near to everything.
The room is clean and the bed very comfortable.
Internet connection everywhere.
Well organised, maintained and functional space.
Good communication with host. A+
Perfect for those who want to enjoy the city and meet new friends.
Lovely stay, recommend! :)
Unfortunately I couldn’t stay there because my flight to Porto was cancelled. But communication was very easy, super friendly & helpful.
Quite cheap and good value for the money. Very clean and good facilities. The area is a little dodgy, but gets better after walking 2 blocks. Very close to centre.

I had a very nice stay at Bragas House! Pedro was very easy to reach by messages, he was there when I arrived. The house is very well located! close to the historic area but still in a quiet street which is a plus after a long day walking around. In front of the house there is a very nice place to eat "Honolulu", perfect for a breakfast before visiting! I really enjoyed my stay there! Thanks you :)
This is a hostel like environment and is centrally located. Everything I needed was provided and I enjoyed my stay here. Thanks!

The location is awesome! It´s few minutes walk to the city center and to plenty of bars. Braga was super helpful, when there was a problem, he immediately tried to fix it.  Abslolutely recommend this place!

It is my first time staying here
Excellent for the price and I will come back again.

Location is good to move around the city. In less than 10 minutes walking I could easily reach the city centre. Rooms are comfortable and shared areas are well equipped.
Great place to meet other people.

Good location close to the Trindade Metro station. Pedro, the host, was excellent with checking in with me and making sure I was okay. The house is spacious  & comfortable. Big clean kitchen & common areas. Refrigerator nicely organized with marked shelves for each room. The outdoor space has a rack to dry clothes which came in handy.  Recommended.
very ok room for this price. very simple but totally fine and clean. I just stayed one night. it was quiet and the communication with Bragas was very kind.

The house and garden is nice but my room was pretty basic - a very thin mattress over a block of foam and no reading light. There isn't anyone on site and communication is minimal, so guests wander in and work things out for themselves. It's a bit like staying in dorms or a hostel without much atmosphere.

The location is good, it takes like 15 minutes to get to the center.
My room was very clean, the bed comfy and the designated work area perfect for online meetings.
Thankfully there was a heater in my room because without it would have been freezing. The walls aren't very well insulated.
Shower room and bathroom were very clean aswell and the water got hot really quick. Each floor shares bath&shower room.
Generally is the house more of clairaudient, so you can hear your neighbors talking, walking and showering.
The common area is huge and invites the different guests to come together for a meal/snack. The kitchen holds everything one needs. Overall I would recommend staying at this fair-priced hostel, would go there again.
The location is good, the room is clean and tidy, it is convenient to stay in, and the room is quiet and easy to rest.
Nice and basic place, perfect for solo traveling. Walking distance from Trindade station. Not fancy but with the necessary for a few days stay! Host very helpful and with speedy response.
The accommodation in Bragas is perfect. The bathroom is clean every day, and the room is clean, so it's comfortable. This is the accommodation I want to come back to when I visit Porto.
The problem no one to explain to you , no one in the reception , someone talk to you by Airbnb

This consist of a big building in Porto, 15 minutes walking to the city centre. You will have your own room with a shared toilet. My room was a little bit small, but not bad. In my opinion, they should have better curtains and another pillow. The rest is fine, I also liked the shared kitchen and a lot of items included

This is an old impersonal hostal. Unfriendly. Bad communication with abrupt standard answers. Never saw hosts. It should say it’s a hostal in description It quite spoiled my visit to Porto.  The only good thing was cleal’nliness

The apartment is nice and very well located, close to the River and to good restaurants.
The communication with the host was very good.

The apartment was perfect for our mini break in Porto. Clean, spacious with all the amenities that you'd need - coffee maker, cooking utensils, heater and extra blankets should you need (and Netflix, perfect for a pyjama day when the weather isn't so great!) The location is perfect, right next to the Old Town Square with nice tabernas and restaurants nearby. Everything is within walking distance but be prepared to do a lot of walking uphill; don't think my heels made it out of the suitcase!
We couldn't have wished for a nicer host than Carlos. He met us at the apartment to check us in which was really easy and gave us great recommendations for places to eat and visit. Friendly, welcoming and always available on the phone, Carlos is the perfect host!
I can't rate Carlos and the apartment highly enough - if your dates are free, get it booked!
Great value for the location and historic interior. Carlos met us up and gifted us a bottle of wine. Very satisfied with the communication and his professionalism!

Great apartment in the historic old section of Porto. Right near the water and tons of restaurants and shops! Clara and Carlos were very helpful with tips on what to see and where to eat. Very easy to communicate with as well. I might hesitate to book this place in the hotter months because you would want to leave the windows open for air, but the street traffic below is loud. All around great place and we enjoyed our stay!

Carlos, you were very professional in a good way. It was a pleasure staying at your wonderful and well equipped apartment. Everything we needed was there.
We would come again - Porto is wonderful and the stay at your place as well.

Very good location, close to a central square at the river area.  Street was noisy due to the summer festival that was going on but we knew this based on other reviews.  Carlos was very helpful at check giving us suggestions for what to do, and answered questions that we had.  We were able to store our luggage prior to the check in.

This apartment is perfectly located if you like being close to the popular areas and the river, but still in a quiet enough Porto alley. We enjoyd it tremendously and during our stay in Porto did not experience any other area we would rather have stayed. Surrounded by wonderful little alleys and restaurants galore, the apartment is perfect for a couple on holiday!

The apartment is great, located in the heart of Porto, in walking distance to many highlights of the city. We had an awesome time - thank you very much! Jorge let us in, helped with the luggage and gave us a perfect introduction for our stay. 100% recommendable!

This was a perfect place to navigate Porto! Close to everything and had everything we needed. Comfortable and cozy. After a hotel stay in Lisbon, it was great to be able to spread out and have our own space for a few days in Porto!
Great historic building so close to river and restaurants. Even a wash machine. Perfect!
Wonderful host met us personally and showed us in. Lots of maps and other resources within apt. Easy communication and fast replies as needed. Would highly recommend!

Great location and value, but perhaps due to the timing of our travel in winter, there were some things we wish there were. Two very small heaters were provided but not enough to heat the entire place - it was very cold at night. Also the apartment was dark when the window coverings were closed for privacy (next building is very close) - curtains might help this issue? It is also an old apartment with minimal soundproofing - we were often woken up by neighbours talking inside the building and people on the street. Not recommended for light sleepers. Otherwise Jorge was kind to wait for us and check us in and gave us many local tips for enjoying Porto. Location is central, nice to be by the river. Clean, cute apartment we would've loved more if not for reasons above.

The host is absolutely wonderful. Creates a personalized map with places to see and go great conversation and a really nice guy. The apartment is awesome. The location is amazing. I got a nasty cold on ny stay and was so happy and surprised that three have netflix! I was able ro relax and recover with "comfort shows" until I was well enough to go out. Thank you!!

Our stay at HomePorto was great! The apartment is in a great location, right near the river and the Dom Luis bridge. Claudia and Carlos were very attentive and responsive. When we arrived, Carlos gave us a map of Porto and pointed out the landmarks and gave us suggestions for places to see. He also helped carry our luggage up the stairs which was much appreciated! Thank you Claudia and Carlos, for a rest stay!
Very central place, but very Cold room. Super friendly and flexible host. Uncomfortable pillows. Shower could be improve with new shower curtains.

We really enjoyed our stay at this property. The apartment is charming and full of character and felt very spacious. Very stylish interior, super comfortable bed, spotlessly clean and excellent shower with plenty of hot water. It had all the amenities as described. The location was excellent too - very close to restaurants, shops and other attractions making it easy to walk almost everywhere. Being close to the Douro, the apartment was also ideal for a morning run along the river.
Our host Claudia was great too. Speedy communications before our arrival and, despite our flight being delayed and us arriving almost 2 hours later than anticipated, Claudia was waiting at the apartment to welcome us. She spent time explaining about the local area and recommending restaurants and sites to see - most of which we went to! We would recommend this apartment to anyone wanting to stay in a central location in Porto. We would definitely come back.

Great place in the heart of Porto. A little noisy, but that didn't affect our stay.
Claudia was a lovely.
You can't go wrong with this great apartment in the heart of Ribeira.  I had a wonderful stay.  Very comfortable and convenient, and the place has great character.

Lovely flat. Very good location, you can easily visit everything just walking.
Carlos was very kind, he let us check in early
Carlos let us into the apartment and then spent time highlighting the best places to visit. The apartment itself was great- was worried it would be too loud but it wasn’t
Amazing location, lovely flat. Needs a little bit of repair here and there but overall it was just what we needed for our weekend in Porto
Could not have been a more perfect airbnb! Best location, and the host was super helpful every step of the way
I would have rated it higher except the apartment is quite dark (unlike the photo) and could use some TLC.  But, the host was amazing, the location is great and it’s a good value.

Great location! Easy check-in. Apartment is as described and was perfect. Would recommend it to any couple looking for a stay in the old town Great walkability right by the water and bridge.  We would definitely stay here again.

Excellent location, everything is in walking distance. Apartment has character and comfortable bed. Host provided map with wonderful suggestions for exploring Porto. Everything works great, and we were gifted a welcome bottle of wine. At night it can be a bit noisy, so earplugs helped to sleep peacefully. Would highly recommend.

Everything was very good , the host met us and explained all, and was accommodating, only one thing you have to know , is I guess it depends on what floor your on , but we were at the top floor , no elevator , your legs will get a work out , but relaxing nice big space once you get there , I was surprised that he didn’t have any towel hangers in the bathroom of any kind , and I didn’t like the red color in the bathroom , but love the windows

place was phenomenal, upstairs neighbours were loud sometimes but a tenant from the building put a stop to that pretty quickly. Pedro was always available if we needed help or recommendations. Location is perfect and surrounded by restaurants and shops. cannot recommend this place enough
Great place, very close to the river which was lovely! The hosts were super helpful and communicative. Super walkable to everything we wanted to do in Porto.

Pedro was very kind and helpful. He waited for us even after our flight was delayed, gave us very useful tips and the response time for messages we sent was incredibly quick. The flat is amazingly placed, with loads to do within short walking distance.
Incredible location and super cute apartment! The hosts were very helpful throughout our stay and gave excellent restaurant recommendations :)

Very nice place! It was just how it looked in the photos. Walkable to everything. It’s an energetic area so can get loud weekend nights. I’m a sound sleeper so this didn’t bother me. Pedro was very nice, helpful and flexible. I’d stay here again!

Overall the place was fine. Description of amenities, kitchen cookware and supplies, bathroom supplies and size of space did not match the description or reviews entirely. The bed and two sofas were quite uncomfortable. There was a dank smell if windows were closed, which was required at night due to noise. Mold was on wall of adjacent apartment/window wall and the owner was notified. Location was great! Access and ease of exploring Porto was wonderful. Very charming and fun city apartment but not comfortable for any down time or long term.
Pedro and Sandra made our stay unforgettable!   Description was exactly as written.   Couldn't ask for more!   Would definitely recommend.

Fabulous place, very tastefully done, right next to the river and other tourist attractions.
Highly recommended.

We wanted to be able to be central in Porto and walk all the sites. This location was AMAZING. You are in it. The room makes you feel like you're part of the history and you open the windows and you can see down the cobblestone alley to the river. But when you're ready for bed the windows make you feel like you're no where near a city. Pedro met us at the door the night of check in and came up and gave us tips of the entire city. We followed his plans  to a T and it was the best weekend ever! Highly recommend this location if you want central walking, gorgeous views and a great host.

We loved our stay! Pedro and Sandra were very accommodating hosts - friendly and responsive with lots of recommendations. The apartment is in a fantastic location just moments away from the waterfront, metro station and lots of brilliant restaurants (one of the most popular restaurants in Porto is located at the building entrance). We would certainly stay again.

Loved staying at this apartment in Porto!! It is just a minutes walk from the waterfront and continently located to anything you would want to get to in Porto. Pedro and Sandra are great hosts and I will always remember my stay fondly!!

Sandra and Pedro place is lovely! Is nice , cosy, clean full of appliances, and most importantly is right by the river Douro! In Ribeira, I chose for being near, but it was a lovely surprise it was 1 min walk! Where everything is happening!
Sandra and Pedro were so helpful, give us loads of tips and advice! Lovely hosts! I will definitely will rent this place again!

Sandra and Pedro are an amazing Duo. Pedro is out in the field while Sandra is running the back office. Sandra gave me some  amazing suggestions  based on what I told her I'd like to achieve during this trip. When I come back to Porto I will definitely look at their properties first before booking with someone else! Thanks again guys.
Great place to stay, really helpful hosts, fantastic to be right by the river and Ponte Luis

We had a wonderful time staying in their home! It was comfortable and in the perfect place next to the train station. Manuela and her husband gave us lots of great suggestions and we felt like we were able to live as locals in Porto. It is not necessarily quiet at night (they warned us of this) but if you want to be in the middle of the action, this is the perfect place to stay!
We had a lovely stay at the apartment.  It is very centrally located and can walk to everything.  It is very new inside and comfortable.  It had everything we needed and was very nice!
Very comfortable and cosy, but a little cold and noisy at night. The hosts are more than welcome and helpful, the conversation was just perfect.

Even though I booked the Airbnb at the last minute, Manuela was an amazing host! Not only did she welcome us and help us make a dinner reservation at one of her favorite restaurant, but the apartment is just as it appears - perfectly located and beautifully decorated.
Fantastic apartment in a very convenient, central location for exploring Porto. The apartment had everything you needed including a fantastic shower and some port!

Lovely apartment with tall ceilings and vintage-styled furniture. It comfortably housed 3 of us. Conveniently located near places of interest (e.g. Sao Bento, Livraria Lello) and only 15-20 min walk away from the river, with plenty of cool boutiques to check out along the way. Raquel was very friendly and responsive. Would definitely stay here again!

The place was perfect. 3 minute walk to the train and the subway. Very clean and the hosts responded quickly to our texts. Very centrally located. I would add and air conditioner as is did get very hot  but thus seems to be the norm in Portugal. There was a fan though and that helped.

Manuela’s place was wonderful.  It was very spacious, spotless and pretty, especially with the balconies that look down onto the bustling street below.  The place was also very quiet and provided a great night’s sleep!   The location was perfect and Manuela provided great information on things to do in Porto.  We loved Porto and were happy to have such a nice place to stay while visiting.  Thank you Manuela!
It is amazing apartment. Clean, comfortable, cozy and also very good location which is close to most of places and são bento station.
Manuela was a fantastic host, offering great local tips for the best places to eat. Flat is beautiful and in a great location, walking distance to beautiful Ribeira and the university district

Great location, in the heart of Porto. The host is very responsive and helpful.
In case you have a lot of luggage, do note that there are two flights of stairs.. not too steep and doable but present.

This place's location is excellent.  Walking distance to Sao Bento station,  restaurants and many landmarks. The place is clean and neat.  Manuela's very nice to prepare a surprise welcome gift and a tourists guide book.  I'd like to give 5 stars to this place but the living heater was something wrong.    It made some drumming noises. I thought it's ok but the third /last night was even worse.  I noticed Manuela when I left. She apologized and said she'd change it right away after I texted her.  Overall it's a 5 stars place to stay.

We had a lovely time in Porto and choosing this apartment was a great decision. The location was perfect - a few minutes' walk from all places we wanted to visit, close to the station, stylish decor and very clean. Marta was very helpful and so nice to talk to. The apartment can get rather cold (like most older buildings in Porto, I'm sure) and when one of the heaters stopped working we got the replacement on the same day. We would stay here again :) Thanks Marta and Manuela !
Manuela was a wonderful host and based at the shop downstairs so easy to access. Location was very central and the apartment was large with lots of personal touches

Lovely apartment and Ana was a very welcoming host with some some great suggestions for experiencing the best of Porto.

Everything in the apartment was lovely. It is very close to the metro and it is also possible to walk into the centre of the city.

Stunning, breathtaking and wonderful room! Besides the beautiful accommodation - which is nearby the metro station and also just a ten minute walk to the city center - Ana is a perfect host! Her hospitality made us speechless. Her ambition is to make you see her hometown through her eyes. We got a lot of recommendations including places to meet locals and have dinner, great breakfast spots and cultural must sees. like art galleries. We fell in love. With Porto, it's people and the awesome room designed by Ana herself. We highly recommend to experience this city and stay in Ana's apartments. We'll be back for sure!
Ana is really kind and her apartment is really clean and comfortable to go to old town! I recommend abpolitely!

Ana's apartment is absolutely stunning along with the whole building. Clean calm and spacious room with a fantastic bathroom.
Ana is wonderful host and offered us great recommendations. I think it's a fantastic base from which to explore Porto!
The appartement is amazing, just like the photos. Its has everything you need. The hostes Ana is very friendly and has some great city and restaurant tips that you should really try out.
So friendly and carefully host,we love the graceful apartment so much.Everying is better than expect.

Very nice apartment, near the center. Ana is so kind and gave us a lot of advices!
Best host ever!!
The house is amazing, clean, well located, auper confortable. Ana is super responsive and nice. I highly recommend it and definitely would repeat!
Ana's flat is amazing if you appreciate great taste in interior design (as we do). Lovely local tips of what to see and do and eat in Porto. We had a great time!! Many thanks

This appartment is amazing! It has a lot of nice details and the perfect  combination of historic and modern elements. We spent a great time in Porto. You can explore everything by walking around and the host gave us a lot of useful hints what to explore. Thanks so much for having us! And we definitely would like to come back.

The apartment was really nice and perfect for a short trip or holidays in Porto. Liliana warmly welcomed us and had really good and helpful tips for the city - restaurants, sights and other local spots. So we could enjoy our stay very much. Porto is a great city, we would love to come back. Thanks a lot!
We had a wonderful time in the pretty apartment. We can highly recommend it for a stay in Porto! We hope to be back one day.

This is an excellent location to stay in Porto. Liliana met us upon our arrival and gave us many useful tips. It is a beautiful apartment, and very bright and very clean.
Parking your car is convenient and there is a small café just outside.

Yes !! We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment : lovely, clean, bright, functionnal... !! and well located for those who like calm !
Liliana is a very nice host, she welcomed us on time, with smile, and took the time to tell us about all the tips to enjoy our stay in Porto and Portugal !!
And a very appreciable plate of food and a glass of Porto was waiting for us !!
So yes we recommand !!

Great little flat perfect for a couple and really well located just a 10 minute walk into town along Rua Santa Catarina. Place was absolutely spotless and communication with Liliana easy and quick - highly recommended.

Ana’s place is amazing!
It’s super stylish, bright, clean and well located. Ana herself is a great host - she shared a lot of local tips, was always around and ready to help, and helped us to navigate)
Highly recommended from our side - would love to come back one day.
Thank you Ana!;)

We travelled a lot around the world and rented many airbnb.. this was out best airbnb experience!
Ana is super welcoming and takes time to explain how to move atound in the city.
Her renovated appartment is just incredible! Every item, big or small, was carefully selected to make us feel like we were living in the 2018 version of a Portuguese castle.
I strongly recommend this airbnb to any couple wanting to have a portuguese experience.

Ana’s husband greeted us on arrival. We sat in the back garden and he mapped out all his recommendations based on our preferences. Really above and beyond our expectations. The apartment is really lovely and away from the crowds, but still walkable. That ceiling is even more beautiful in person! Would definitely recommend staying here!
Just loved our stay at Ana & João’s place. Very clean and Ana was so kind to help me with the washing machine! Would stay again.
Ana and João have refurbished a beautiful old bourgeois building with care and great taste, it’s close to the main attractions in Porto and they’ll recommend you where to go best!

Beautiful home and room just a little bit outside of downtown Porto.  We loved our room and despite being on a fairly busy street did not get woken up at all at night.  Great experience all around and Ana is a wonderful host, she was super accommodating with check in and out.

A very nice flat not far from the center of Porto :) We really enjoyed the stay here!! We felt very comfortable and Liliana helped us any time immediately when we had a question! :) She gave us many tips what we can do in Porto so we had a great holiday! We would love to go back there! :) :) :)

Liliana was really nice and gave us lots of good adresses! She answered all of our questions ! She has nice small attentions like receiving us with a local bottle of wine and cheese. The appartement is super nice and really clean. I would definetly recommend her place if you want to visit Porto!

Lilana is the loveliest and most accommodating host. Her apartment is beautiful, just a few walking minutes away from the center of Porto, and is a beautiful spot to come home to and even enjoy home-made dinner. Liliana's welcome and local tips greatly improved our experience. Would happily stay again!

Thomas and Liliana’s were amazing hosts and their place was an absolute dream. The place itself was stylish and spacious in a lovely quite area not too far a walk from the main shopping streets in Porto. I would most definitely recommend staying here!

The apartment is very clean, tasteful and in a great location for exploring the sights of Porto. Liliana was a fantastic host; very responsive and hospitable. All in all a great stay thanks to great hosts :-)

This apartment is stunning. It’s like the pictures, only better. It’s really airy, high ceilings with beautiful artwork and decor, and is very peaceful.
It’s an easy walk in to Porto, which is also lovely, is fronted by a small park, and backed by a lovely balcony.
Liliana was really helpful, giving us lots of tips about where to go.
We would highly recommend staying here. We could not fault it.

We are a family of three, our daughter is 7, and we had a great time in the appartment. It’s a really nice place, enough space and a cozy balcony. Liliana has some nice recommendations for sightseeing and food. We would definitely come back.
João was great at giving us local tips. The room was spotless clean, spacious and had great decor just like the pictures! Would recommend staying here to anyone going to Porto :)

The place is extremely beautiful! Although slightly on the side of the city, it is super quiet but still very close to every attractions and restaurants etc. The space is amazing, and the hosts are super nice. Totally recommend!
The apartment is beautiful and tidy. The location was good, you can explore Porto by foot. Joao gave us some tips of eating and sightseeing. He was nice and friendly.

Ana & João’s place was in a great location! Not to mention João greeted us and gave us tons of recommendations and main highlights for our short stay! The room was comfortable and very clean with tons of plug ins which was a great perk! Would definitely recommend Ana & João’s place for a comfortable and cute place to stay!

Beautiful property. Location was fine. João was very kind and communicative. Helped us a lot and gave us some nice tips. It was a pleasure to  stay there. We used the free parking which was very close to the building.

The apartment is like it is shown on the picture - very beautiful and stylish. We got a lot of useful recommendations, which helped us to discover porto. The communication was without any problems and we even got access to the apartment at the morning of our arrival day!

Tasteful and huge room with beautiful settings, with very high ceiling and some surprisingly classy and antigue furnitures. Ana and João are amazing hosts who gave me really personal local tips based on my preference and reasons for visiting Porto. A serene and wonderful abode to rest and rejuvenate after a day's visit in and around Porto!
Beautifully restored home in a convenient area. Our stay was short but the beauty of the building was a really highlight of this stay. Easy to walk into town, spacious, and very kind hosts.

Everything’s was great! Beautiful flat. Perfect location as you are in perfect walking distance to the city centre, however still in a area where locals live and not it’s not super touristic!
Overall a great experience!!!
Thanks again!

We stayed 2 nights at Ana's and João's place. When we arrived we had a warm welcome and got some insider tips from João to discover Porto. From the place your can walk easily to all the must sees of Porto.
The room and the whole building is incredible! We fell in love with it. It was super spaceous, comfy and SO clean.
We really Wang to come back to explore more of Porto and will book this place again for sure!
Also we had a delicious „welcome Portwine“ ;)
Thank you Ana&João!
This is a great place to land in Porto, park your car (if you have one) and experience the city on foot.  Within fairly easy walking distance of the sights and good places for dinner.

This is an excellent apartment and almost perfect.  It’s clean and big enough for 1-2 people. Everything is well organized.  Landlord prepared all good quality and premium daily consumption for guest.  The mattress is super comfy!  The map address  from Airbnb is not accurate enough, landlord can make an additional reminder to guests.  Very convenient location with metro and 3-4 buses stations just downstairs of the flat. Porto is also an excellent city with lots of good foods and nice seaside (beach Foz)
Great place to stay. We didn’t get a car but used Uber to get into Porto when we wanted. Ideal for escaping from the city heat.
Really nice place with beautiful architecture. It was a quick 15 minute walk to all the lovely places in the city. We loved the garden area and the sweet kitties, especially Pepito!

Everything was perfect! The flat was amazing, very well located, and the recommendations they gave to us were fantastic.
We will 100% be looking forward to coming back to Porto 😁

This apartment is lovely! High ceilings and spacious bedroom. The kitchen is very small and doesn’t have a lot of things for cooking. The bathroom needs some towel racks, but has a lovely shower. The location is on a busy street with busses all day long. It is a bit of a walk to the streets with shops and restaurants.

This was an incredible stay! We loved the neighborhood, the decor, the city, everything. João was an amazing incredible host - very kind, thoughtful, communicative, and helpful. This place is truly a hidden gem. The pictures don’t do it justice. We can’t thank you enough for helping to facilitate a truly wonderful time in Porto.

the place is lovely  and  in a good location.   the host was  and very helpful.   internet worked very well which was important  for me.  the house across the street is abandoned which is a shame and of course no fault of host.  if you don't like cats,  may not recommend.

We had a great first time experience in Porto. Ana is fluent in several languages and gave us great suggestions to visit the city and very clear instructions to park the car. We didn’t have any issues during our stay, the apartment is very clean and cozy. Loved the ceiling!

An excellent place to stay with excellent hosts! The flat is intelligently and elegantly designed. João met us at check in and gave us the inside track on where to go for all the best food and experiences in Porto - plus he was super responsive throughout our trip. Would highly recommend staying here. Quiet, stylish and well located.
We had a great stay! Comfortable, stylish, unique, and close to everything we wanted to see. Ana & João were exceptional hosts.

An outstanding accommodation!
Host was great with communication. The location was perfect. Away from the hustle and bustle, but next to a metro station and only $4-5 Uber to the hotspots. Apartment was clean and spacious. The cats on site are so sweet and loving (they only hangout in the garden, so no worries if you’re allergic).

We had a wonderful stay in the apartment. It is a gorgeous decor, with a very elegant and romantic atmosphere. We appreciated the little attentions left in the apartment and helpful guidance of the host.

Overall this was a great place for us to stay while we explored Porto for a few days. The room was beautiful, was clean and tidy when we arrived, and it was helpful to have a small kitchen so we could cook a few meals. It's about a 20 minute walk to the city center, which we enjoyed because it was easy to get to all the things to do, but was much quieter after returning home for the night. One thing to note is that, if you drive like we did, then the parking garage is on a different street. So you'll need to temporarily park across the street to drop luggage, then drive a couple blocks away to park the car, and then walk back (and then do it all in reverse when checking out). Not terribly difficult, but just not as convenient as everything being in the same building, so something to keep in mind. Still a really great place that we'd recommend and would certainly stay again!

The apartment was beautiful. We loved the decor, it fitted perfectly with the age and history of the building. Check-in was quick & seamless. We tried some of Ana & João’s bar & brunch recommendations, we now have some new faves in Porto! Overall, very happy with our stay. Our only suggestion is having a wider range of toiletries, some shampoo and conditioner would have been great. The apartment is in walking distance to the centre, exactly as described. Thank you for a wonderful stay.
Beautiful building. Great shower and comfy bed. But the star is the garden, perfect for breakfast or relaxing with a glass of wine and a book.

What a dreamy apartment. Beautiful details and close enough to walk to everything. Directions for check in and out were clear and easy. The garden area was a bonus- a quiet reprieve to take a break from the city. Definitely recommend.

The apartment was great, clean and really well maintained. We felt safe in the building, it was right on a very busy street but it was exceptionally quiet.
We found some nice places nearby with the best being the Korean restaurant right down the street.
The bed and the linen were really good quality and comfortable, we had a really good sleep experience.
It is max 15min walking from the most popular sights but if walking isn't your thing there is bus and metro station really close.
It is huge plus the parking which is offered, we went everywhere in Porto on feet and when we were tired we used the metro, really convenient.
Our hosts were great, even if we didn't meet them eventually they were really fast responding to our messages.
It was a great experience

Small but very comfortable and tastefully decorated Appartement with everything needed for a short stay, especially a very comfortable bed. It is located within short walking distance to the Metro and very close to the city Centre.
The host was extremely responsive and offered recommendations e.g. for restaurants.
Would definitely stay again when in Porto.
What a beautiful and romantic appartment you have. This was the cherry on top of our stay in Porto.
My husband and I enjoyed our stay in Porto! Ana and Joao’s place is in a perfect location. It is clean, safe, and came with parking!! We highly recommend!!

don't look any further than Ana and João's gorgeous home. we only stayed 2 nights and wish we could have stayed longer. it was a short walk to the downtown, which was nice to not be in a super busy area, it was perfect to check out the neighborhood, lots to see and eat near by.
details are everything and this place knocks it out of the park. absolutely charming from top to bottom, the ceiling, bathroom, bed plus we loved the secret garden out back with the kitties. can't wait to return!

This place is great and has an awesome location for exploring Porto. The train is very close and easy to navigate if you don’t want to walk. Free parking was amazing since we rented a car. Hopefully we will find time to return!

As a design and history nerd, this belle époque apartment was a dream come true. The tall, tin ceiling and crown molding is a work of art. The bedding and king size bed allowed me to have full nights of sleep. I can’t say enough about this place and I hope to return. Ana and Joao were quick to respond to our needs. The location in Bonfim is our favorite part of Porto. Thank you Ana and Joao!!!

We really enjoyed our stay! Our favourite part was the back garden and the original charm of the building. The building was quiet and peaceful and we found great cafe's and bars within walking distance. Thank you Ana & João!
Wonderful appartment very well located , beach restaurant et market within few  minutes walk. José was a wonderful host and reply to our mail very quickly. For sure we recommand this place.

Christina went above and beyond to make our stay just perfect.  The room was beautiful.  There were so many added touches to make our stay absolutely wonderful.  The room was decorated and looks just as pictured, and even had black out shades.  Our stay with Christina was our best nights sleep!  We had a private bathroom, also decorated beautifully and spotlessly clean.  Christina was just lovely.  If you need somewhere to stay, I highly recommend staying at Christina's.
Christina's home is clean and comfortable.  Everything is done by detailed skills.  Highly recommended
Cristina is such a nice nad helpful person! The room is very cosy :) We got a local wine! Thank you Cristina...
We had a great time in Porto. The apartment was clean and very cosy. We would definitely like to come back here. Thank you Cristina! Love, Steven & Milou

Christina is a delightful host. Her home is great, and the guest room and bathroom are lovely spaces. Both are super clean and live up to the pictures and descriptions online. Close to bus routes and a reasonable walking distance to Porto. I would definitely stay with Christina again if I were fortunate enough to return to Porto.

Cristina is very friendly and answers within minutes. She also sent a lot of useful information in advance, like maps or detailed descriptions of how to get around in Porto. The room was pretty and clean and the bathroom was also very clean. We enjoyed our stay there. :)
We had a really good time in Porto - thanks to this perfectly clean & cozy room in Cristina‘s home. I can really recommend this accommodation!

Cristina's apartment is extremely well maintained and located at a prime location. Both the beachfront and the river are within 10-15 minutes of public transport commute from her place.  She is very proactive and perfectly understands what a tourist needs to see in Porto and how to get around. She had emailed me precise information on how to get around in Porto a week in advance. It helped me so much that I hardly took an Uber ride during my week's stay. The room itself is very clean and nicely decorated. Highly recommend staying at her apartment when visiting Porto.

We had a wonderful stay at Cristina's flat, which is conveniently located within walking distance (15 min) to a major metro station (Casa da Música). Cristina and Afonso were exceptionally welcoming, very warm and friendly while also reserved and private - a most perfect balance. We stayed for a week and felt very welcomed from beginning to end. The room and the bathroom are bigger than they look in the pictures and everything is perfectly equipped to make sure you feel at home: the mattres is very comfortable, the shower had the right pressure, and the wine bottle is the cherry on top of the cake, such a thoughtful detail!

This is awesomw house.  It has TV,  loats of species so you can cook your own food.  It even has coffee,  which is trully cool.  Also,  restaurant exaclty in the same building.  It's really comfy and cool.  Thx a lot :)

A stylish modern apartment in the very heart of Porto. The riverfront is a 5 minute walk, and pretty much else within 10 minutes. The apartment has a great range of facilities and is spotlessly clean. Tim was an excellent host, providing great communication and a comprehensive written guide. Wish we could have stayed longer

The apartment has a perfect location, you can easily reach sights of Porto on foot. There is also a great wine bar just downstairs! Tim was very attentive and gave us a list of places to visit and eat, definitely worth checking them out. Kitchen was well equipped so we could also comfortably prepare a nice meal with local products from the market. Place is very spacious as well. Nothing to complain about!

Ideal location for those who want to discover Porto! The apartment is close to the city centre and in a 5-10 min walking distance from the river. It is clean and functional and Tim is an excellent host! He is prompt and reactive. I really recommend the place.
Great location. Tim responses to all questions very fast and is very helpfull. Apartament is really nice, clean and well equipped. Best place to stay! Really recomend!

The apartment is on a prime spot.
Super clean.
Perfect for 2
A wonderful stay in Porto, superb value for money, spacious apartment and excellent location! Tim was super quick to respond and check in and check out couldn’t have been easier.
Perfect location in central street, 5 mins from San Bento station and another 5 mins from the Riberia square! It was really clean, cozy and nice apartment :)
Incredible value. This is a fantastic location in the historic core of Porto. Basically everything you could want is present. Super-quiet overnight.

It was really good accommodation!
If i come again, I want to stay ;)
Thank you Tim!
The place looked exactly like the pictures, spotless and well taken care of. You'll find everything you need to make your stay much easier. If I ever return to Porto, I'll book this place again.

Lovely flat in the heart of the action. Close to Sao Bento train station.  (Campanha is probably 45 min walk or so), close to the water, restaurants and stuff to do. The flat is up a couple flights of stairs, the elevator doesn't take you to the floor where the flat is, but they are easy stairs compared to most in Porto. Tim was responsive and we loved the flat and would definitesly stay there again
