A great stay that was even better than I hoped for! The location was perfect, in a picturesque, safe, clean area with great restaurants, bars, shops and bakeries right outside your door. The apartment was very clean, had great Wi-Fi, a good shower and a really comfortable bed. Tim was a very responsive host and I would absolutely stay here again!

Great location with walking distance to all major spots. Amazing host with great recommendation of restaurants and was very responsive. Can’t wait to arrange another visit to Porto and will definitely stay at Tim’s place again. Thanks for everything! :-)

The location was great, walking distance to heaps of restaurants and attractions and local park down the road. The 2 flights of stairs were manageable each day and the apartment was comfortable, and the host Tim was always helpful with our requests, would highly recommend!!

José+Luis’s place was incredible for our stay in Porto. We spent 2 nights in their flat and everything went very smoothly. José was very easy to communicate with and was very informative about the city and the region. We loved watching the sunset from the terrace while drinking local wine. We hope to return to the region again soon and when we do, we would love to stay here again. We highly recommend this flat and hope you enjoy it as much as we did!

the short version is, that everything was perfect. the apartment was sweet, clean and had the best view. all pics that we saw before were complete true. we enjoyed every minute and come back for sure. also the complete handling was easy and uncomplicated and really friendly.

The value for money of the house is poor, the house itself does not seem adjusted to accommodate guests, its appliances are old, sometimes dirty and the terrace was next to a chicken farm, which made sitting on the terrace  impossible. Plus it is far away from city center.

Despite the bad weather, everything was good in this apartment. It is a great place to get away as it is quiet and located in a non-tourist area. My room is a Seaview room, I love to open the window and enjoy the amazing view when I woke up everyday.
The bathroom is quite small, the shower room is tight on space and somehow the hotwater was not sufficient enough for a long shower. It was not a big problem but would be great if it can improve.
During my stay, Luis suggested few restaurants and must try dishes for me also helped to make reservation. Those suggested restaurants are great.
I would definitely recommend people to stay in this apartment.

The location was spectacular.  The views of the river alone were mesmerizing. The house itself is on a very quiet cul de sac that sits on the top of a little Jill. There is a terrace with greenery and a small cafe table where you can have your coffee or an evening drink. The interior decorations made us feel surrounded very stylishly. Both bedrooms have great views. We took the tram that is just down the street and within minutes we were in the city center or in nearby Foz. We interacted with both Jose and Luis. Perfectly charming, helpful, and very responsive communicating with them. Oh, the highlight was they recommended we take a small ferry that crosses the river in less than five minutes to the small fishing village.  The small restaurant had a grill on the street and made the best sardines and squid. We were sad to leave and would recommend there home.

amazing view! cosy and simple appartement/house.
I staid here in winter time, although I had the luck of enjoying sunny days was left wondering how it would be to stay in summetime with such a nice view an terrace.

Lovely place, quiet away from the city. Jose and Luis were amazing in the communication and also gave a really good introduction both to the house and the city, especially for architects! Thanks for everything!
Great place with a huge terrace looking over the Duoro. Very good location for the centre of Porto as well as Matasenhios & Foz. Thanks Jose & Luis!
This place is amazing. Off the beaten path but close enough. Quiet and relaxing place to work, enjoy the city and overall have a great escape.

Beautiful space with a beautiful view! Quiet neighborhood and very clean apartment. About a 20 min walk to city center right along the water (gorgeous!) or ~10 min bus ride for €2. We had a great time!
Great location with a fantastic view over the river and to the sea from the terrace. Luis was very helpful and friendly - thanks for a great stay!

Jose was fantastic! The apartment has everything you need and great views. Highly recommended.
Caution: if you are bringing a rental car, do not follow google maps and come from the north. You will come to an extremely tight, panic enduring street.
Lovely apartment in a good location between the city centre and Foz. The outdoor space has great views of the river and Jose and Luis are terrific hosts.

José and Luis where great hosts, quick to respond and explain things. Property was in quiet location right by the tram and ferry across the river.
The property was a little smaller than expected from the photos so if there are 4 people could feel a bit cramped. The only negative experience we had were the people above were noisy, as sound really travels in the apartment. But I think we were just unlucky in this occasion.
Lovely view! Very relaxing. 5 flights of stairs to get to the unit were a little tough for my older parents (60 and 67), not bad but something to keep in mind!
definitely a place we'd like to come back to, cozy, beautiful view from the terrace, great location between downtown Porto and costal Matosinhos

After staying a few days in the center of Porto we loved coming to this place, which is very calm and just a nice place to relax.
The apartment is really small but cleverly arranged, we had no problem settling in. The beds (and furniture in general) was perhaps not the last word in comfort and quality, but it worked out fine for a short 4-day stay. The outdoor yard was very nice with beautiful views.
Kitchen and bathroom was, well, not so great and could definitely need an upgrade in hardware and cleanliness, especially the kitchen. Also there were smells coming from the cabinets, and basic stuff like kithcen towels and cloth was missing. We prefered not to cook any meals here and to keep breakfast as simple as possible.
Communication with Marta and JP was great throughout our stay.
All in all we enjoyed our stay, but would recommend certain things to be fixed so as not to appear neglected.
We had a wonderful stay at Marta and JP’s place. The view on the terrace is amazing and the apartment was as expected. Thank you!

The flat was perfect.
Clean and looked like the pictures! Easy self check in and out!
Great place to stay! Very centrally located and clean. Wifi also works great, and Mario is very good at coordinating.

We had a great stay at Mario's apartment. The location is perfect and the apartment was very spacious and clean. Mario's friend, Paolo, showed us the apartment and gave us great tips for what to do around Porto. He also gave us a place to put our luggage for the few hours after checkout so we didn't have to carry our stuff around while sight seeing. We definitely recommend this place.
The apartment is clean, cozy and confortable. It also is close to everything. I recommend it to spend some days in Oporto.
We had a great time in Mario's place, great location and super apartment, with everything you need.
Mário's place was great for our stay in Porto. It was very close to all the restaurants, night life and shopping in town.
Mario was a great host. Provided a map with useful tips and recommanded attractions and restaurants. Perfect location for our trip in Porto.

We stayed 4 nights in Mario's apartment and whilst we never met Mario, we did have a great stay. Fantastic location for exploring Porto. Very clean and stylish space. Very tall ceilings. Photos differ slightly from the apartment presentation, but not in a detrimental way. I would definitely recommend to all!
Mario’s Place is stylish and spacious.  We had a lovely stay and the eating place a stone’s throw from the flat gave us good food and drink and a fun evening.

The flat was decent for the price. The location was nice and central, not more than 15-20 minutes walking from all Porto attractions. The building and unit are fairly old and run down, with a very basic bathroom. There were ants in the apartment when we checked in, but the host addressed this quickly and it wasn’t an issue for the rest of our stay.
Perfect location, huge flat, very comfortable bad and the smell of the shower gel is very good :) Mario is very responsive it was a good choice i can recommend to anyone!
Beautiful place exactly as advertised and in a great location. Walking distance from all the Porto sights. Mario is a great host and makes sure everything runs smoothly. Would highly recommend.

Had a great stay. The map and local information provided were very helpful. Everything worked, all you needed for a good stay whether eating in or out. Loved Porto, and the central location made everything easy. Spot on directions to get to the apartment. All was great.
The apartment is very nice, well located and super clean. Great communication and flexibility on arrival! We enjoyed our stay there and recommend it to any traveler!

If you are looking for a centrally located apartment when visiting or Oporto , this is the place. Literally 65 feet from one of the best Portuguese restaurants in the city (Abadia), also near Bolhao Market, Mercearia do Bolhao, Manteigaria, to name a few. Metro stop a block away. We had a wonderful time in Oporto.

We had a cab driver from the airport who did not speak English and could not read the address.  Mario guided him to the airbnb.  He also had someone meet us where the cab dropped us off to guide us to the accommodation, open it up for us, explain the local area and how everything worked in the unit and where to get a good breakfast, dinner, bars, etc.  The unit was very clean, comfortable and well located.  The little cafe on the corner only a few feet from our front door was highly recommended by an Uber driver for good and inexpensive food.  Thanks for being a Superhost, Mario.  We really enjoyed our stay in your beautiful city of Porto.
A great apartment in the centre of town close to the market, underground, and attractions. Lots of places to eat and drink locally and within walking distance to the river.
Lovely location and space, there were some building works going on nearby but they finished early Erin the evening and weren’t much bother
Spacious flat just few steps from main Porto attractions. Smooth communication with the host and check-in. We enjoyed our stay here!

Super convenient place to stay that's close to public transport and within walking distance of many great places to eat and visit. We thought that the apartment was good value for what we paid. Good place for our intro to Portugal.

The location of the apartment is amazing, very close to everything!
Mário is a great host who was very helpful providing all the needed support while being super responsive over texts!
The flat was cleaned and well equipped! It has all you need for a great stay!
Very centrally placed with a lot of space and super comfortable check in. Mario was an extremely nice Host :)

We had a great stay in Porto. The apartment was sized well and the doors and shutters kept most noise from the city out. Restaurants and coffee around the corner. And close to the subway and city center. We would certainly come back.

Absolutely I cannot recommend this space enough! Amazing location, clean and open, with everything you need in walking distance. Mario is very quick to respond to any questions or concerns and is an excellent host. Thank you Mario!
Awesome apartment, clean and well located. The  owner is really nice. I will book this apartment again.
We had a lovely stay in Mario’s apartment. Very well located, clean, and fairly quiet. Communication with the host was very smooth, I would definitely recommend it! Thanks again :)

The perfect location and place to stay in Porto, really close to the center in a quiet neighborhood. The apartment is comfortable and huge, Mario was a great host and gave us everything we needed :) a supermarket and a bakery is close to the location
Mario was a great host. Replied very quickly and check in was very easy.  The apartment is in a perfect location. I highly recommend Mario’s place.
Apartment is perfect for exploring Porto, great location, silent at night, very spacious, super responsive host. Recommended

Great location, even better flat. We enjoyed our stay, the AC, the nice view, the personal welcome and the size of the flat. We would love to come again. Mário was very friendly and quick with open questions from our side.

Mario and his partner Rafael, who welcome us in Porto, were great hosts. The check-in was easy and fast, they allowed us to leave our baggages before the time. The position of the apartment was very central, we walked easly everywhere from there. The apartment was cozy and nice for two days. The only suggestion is to check the shower: unfortunately the temperature of water was not stable and it wasn’t easy to take a hot shower.

Located 30-minutes from Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport via train, Mario’s apartment is splendidly located within Bolhão neighborhood with a plethora of cafes, restaurants, bars, etc. Received instantaneous responses from Mario and any time I texted. Apartment felt as comfortable as my home. Fabulous for one or two travelers looking to experience all of Oporto’s history. Fortuitously, located next to one of best Fado clubs within city (Ideal Clube de Fado). WiFi and space are as advertised. Definitely recommend Mario’s unique flat for your Oporto excursion.
Mário was an excellent host. The location was amazing and the space was as advertised. Would recommend !
Great stay in a wonderful apartment. Seemed much bigger than it looked on the photos. Would highly recommend!

This is great place. We were able to check in early and store our bags on check out day which with super helpful.
The location is so central and it was great value!

Central location. Nice appartments. Mario was very helpful and even allowed us to store our heavy luggage at the apartment as we arrived in Porto early. Mario was helpful and responses quickly to my messages and questions.
Great little airbnb, spacious living area and good location for exploring Porto by foot. The Aircon was also greatly appreciated!
A really great place to explore Porto from. Plenty of space for two people. Comfy sofa and bed!
A very nicely located, tidy and comfortable place, perfect for a weekend! Mario is very helpful and flexible too!

Mario is a fantastic host - efficient communication and let us check in early. Also extremely accommodating with letting us leave our bags in storage while we continued to explore on our last day. Great flat, great location, great price - would recommend!

We stayed for 5 nights, so central to everything especially the Bolhão Market area which we love. Communication with Mario & Patricia were always promptly replied to when required. Code received to enter complex.  Apartment was clean & had everything to suit our needs & we would stay again when visiting Porto❤️
Had a great stay! We were greeted at the door and got some helpful tips including local recommendations. AC worked great!

Excellent location to base yourself for seeing the sights of Porto.
Price was fair for the condition of the apartment. Bathroom a bit tired and headboard a bit worn. Apart from this, really nice accommodation.

We had a great stay! The location is excellent, easy to get around. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We really appreciated the flexibility in allowing us to drop off our luggage before the check-in time. Overall, a wonderful experience and we would definitely recommend staying here!

The location was the best thing about Marios place. Right by the metro and his clear instructions on how to find apartment were accurate. It had everything you needed for a great stay. Would definitely return and recommend to friends.
Beautiful building in a central location, and a spacious apartment. The raised kitchen floor could be a hazard in the dark but otherwise wonderful!

The apartment is very nice, with the beautiful view, is on the 10th floor, it has everything you need, it was very clean and all the essentials were there. The shopping center that is open every day until late is attached to the building. The apartment is just 5 min walk from metro sation Esatadio do Dragao that is 15min from the city center.
I highly racomment Susana's apartment. Thank you for everything.

Amazing studio apartment within a 5 minute walk to the estadio do dragao and the metro stop which brings you to the center in 10 minutes. 30 minute metro ride to the airport. Beautiful and clean place with a great welcoming by Susana's friends. They even met me at the metro so I didn't get lost. Thanks a lot and hope to spend time again
Great apartment, couple of mins walk to metro which takes you to town centre in 10mins. Very clean studio beside shopping mall and stadium
Very modern studio. Attached to a big mall. Close to a train station which connects you with the rest of porto

Although brief, I only stayed for two nights, I really enjoyed my stay at Susana's place. Everything is as described and it is a wonderful place to start exploring the city of Porto. I would highly recommend her place if you are travelling on your own or as a couple.
Susana's place was beautiful, very clean and in a good location. Communication was easy, friendly and fast. I highly recommend!

Really stylish place; the flat was really clean and full furnished. A bit far from the center but close to the tube.
Very good for couple
Good place to discover Porto and be closed to any shopping areas. Studio is cozy. Bed quality is medium. Susanna and her mother are really kind and take care of visitors.

Definitely the best accommodation we have stayed so far, a really lovely apartment, spotless, modern, comfortable, close to bus and metro stations, Susana was a great host and everything went well. We’ll be back soon for sure...

We had a good stay at Susanas Apartment. It is well-provided, there's a dish washer, stove, fridge, coffee mashine,... Safe parking in a garage. The Train station is only 10 minutes away with good connection to the city centre.
There's nothing to complain about. Thank you for having us, Susana.
Susana welcomed us very well. She has a super clean and comfortable apartment. There are a large range of utensils to use in the kitchen. I enjoyed my stay here a lot!

Everything was according to the description.
The apartement is well located next to the stadium and close to a metro station, 20min ride from the city center.
I really enjoyed my stay at Susana's place!

Wonderful little studio apartment, perfect for 2 people, in a great location, right next a shopping centre! Will stay again. :) Only thing would be, it was a bit confusing to find at first, but the door man was great!

Susana's place is cozy apartment, very clean, very bright. Stylish design, great view (especially at night). Private parking inside building garage. Shopping center available from the parking lot. City center 15 min away by single bus.
Thank you Susana for all your hospitality and for the early check in. We had a lovely time in Porto and in your apartment. Highly recommended!

The apartment was very comfortable and clean, with many amenities that made our stay effortless. The location near the mall was very convenient, and Susana responded promptly to all of our questions. Would highly recommend!
I really recommend this host. Great place to stay in Porto :) lovely sunrise from the 10th floor.
Susana was a really great host! My experience with her has made me really enjoy our one day trip in Porto!

Nice, cozy, with attention to detail apartment next to the shopping center (what is very comfortable) and close to metro station. Great contact with Susana, good location with a fine view (a bit noisy because of the highway, but windows are noise-canceling), nice doormen:)
Highly recommend this place to stay!

The studio was the perfect getaway for a weekend in beautiful Porto. Although there’s a motorway nearby the studio was quiet and had all the amenities that we needed.
Super clean and well located. Definitely a gem in Porto.

Great apartment, very clean, comfy, and a friendly and helpful host.  Communication with the host is perfect. Expect great service and and smooth and enjoyable stay. I'd be more than happy staying here again. Highly recommended.

Beautiful and cozy accommodation with availability for parking and easy access to the metro. It is located next door to a mall that has a grocery store. Bonus of beautiful views of Porto.
5* all around for communication from the day that the reservation was booked and throughout our stay, very clean and it has all of the necessities for a comfortable stay.
Highly recommended accommodation !

Very lovely apartment, there is a mall and supermarket just next to the building, it’s convenient, and the room is clean, perfect for 2 people.
Thank you

Good location, access was very well explained !
The place was clean, I recommend.
Great location and great apartment. The communication with Susana was smooth. Just to keep in mind that furnitures at the kitchen are basic but okay to cook for few days.

The apartment is located a 10-15 min. walk from the beautiful Labirinto do Parque de São Roque, which is my favorite park in Porto and the best part about staying in this location. Everything else in Porto is pretty accessible by metro, which is less than a 5-min. walk from the apartment.
The place was nicely furnished with everything you need for a short- to long-term stay (I stayed for 2 weeks). The only things I was missing were a big cutting knife (there were 3 small ones) and a clothesline / drying rack for hanging my laundry (the apartment complex has washing and drying machines, but I never use dryers for my more delicate clothes). The host was very responsive, and I enjoyed my stay here.
Catarina and Alexandra were amazing! Very friendly, helpful and caring. They provided us all information we needed. Exceptionally kind hosts!

Alexandra and Catarina have a great apartment and are very involved with their guests. they took care of a Google maps to share their hotspots with guest, took care of a clean and really fashionable apartment. They made the start of our holiday really good! Thanks!

Such an amazing place. To make a Trip to Porto this is the best Apartment to stay. It is near the City and you can walk to every place. The hosts have a warm heart, are very helpfull and sympathic. Thank you for making That Trip unforgatable.

As we already stayed at another apartment of Alexandra and Catarina, we knew that they are very friendly, helpful and professional people. All the accommodations they rent have quality, and this one as well. Modern, spacious, with little details in design, well-equipped and always located in nice areas of the town, these rooms are highly recommended.

Great location in Porto, near the commercial centre (shopping streets) and a short walk to the Port. The room and apartment was as described. Best check in experience to date with a Airbnb host, lots of information and tips on restaurants etc. Best bit was the roof terrace in the apartment, great for chilling out after a good day's walking seeing the sites. Great location/place for lone travellers. Thanks again xxxx

Her house is really beautiful and nice.
I can relax fully her room .
Her room is cozy and really clean.
Her house is little far of main city but it is fine to walk. I recommend!

Alex is extremely kind and accomodating. She gave great advice and suggestions for places to visit, eat and supermarkets close by and even precise  directions for how to get to the apartment from the airport. The apartment is beautiful and stylish and comforting, it did not feel as though I was staying in a different country as I felt so at home! The apartment is so close to the city and very easy route back home.
Quiet place, clean and beautiful! And there is a balcony,we can sit and hang up our clothes. Everything elements is easy to use. Alexandra is friendly and nice . We like her place
We had a great stay at Alexandra's place. The appartment was clean, spacious and well equiped. Recommended!

The apartment is very centrally located and hence both very convenient and a bit noisy.  The flat is well designed and has all you need for a short and nice stay. Maria is very reactive and provides the necessary support if needed.

Daniel is a great host. always helpful, responds super quick and gave us loads of useful information.
the flat is clean, recently refurbished, well located and has everything you need for a nice stay in Porto.
I can definitely recommend this place.

Daniel's apartment is even more beautiful than the pictures. Spotlessly clean, floor to ceiling windows and wonderfully stylish. It's in a great neighbourhood, you can easily walk all over the city from where the flat is situated - we did anyway! Perfect place to catch up on life and explore Porto - one of my favourite experiences via air b n b to date! Also Daniel is a brilliant host and we were furnished with tips and ideas 💡 thanks to his recommendations and maps/guides etc. We will be back!

Very central, about 10 mins walk from Sao Bento station and close to everything you could need and want to see in Porto. The entire building has been beautifully renovated, with great care taken to preserve some charming historic detail/decor. The apartment was also very clean and has everything we needed for our short stay in Porto. We never met Daniel as he was working but that was no issue as he was very easy to reach and very helpful. Great stay in Porto and amazing value!

I had a fantastic time staying in Daniel's gorgeous apartment in Porto - I only wish I could have stayed longer! The apartment was lovely, very clean, just as it looks in the photo with lots of space for 1-2 people. It's in a great location - I walked everywhere from there, with great restaurants and bars nearby. Daniel was a great host, always responded to messages very quickly and gave great advice about where to go and what to see. Would love to stay here again next time I'm in Porto!

Daniel's place is wonderful! I beautifully restored classic building with gorgeous high ceilings. The apartment is also located very centric in a great neighborhood filled with nice restaurants and bars.
Aside from the beauty and location of the apartment, Daniel is a great host. He was very friendly and accommodating. He gave us many great tips to explore the city as well.
Great place, with nice furniture and a very comfortable bed. Perfect to start exploring the beautiful city.

This apartment has it all. It's compact and well designed and as a result it is very comfortable. The location is ideal. It is close to everything, but just far enough away to be very quiet. It is well equipped. Daniel welcomed us and oriented us to the apartment and Porto. He even helped carry our bags. His recommendations for things to see and where to eat were very helpful. This is a wonderful place to stay and Daniel is the ideal host. Highly recommended.
Beautiful, clean, stylish apartment extremely central and perfect to explore Porto. Daniel is a fantastic host, easy to communicate with and had great tips for us. Thank you again!

The apartment was gorgeous; so liveable and had everything we needed, but also a clean minimalistic space.
Very central and easy to walk to everything, plenty of bars and cafes around, but still very quiet at night.
Daniel made it so easy for us to check in even though we had unreliable wifi and an uncertain arrival time. He was very gracious and gave us plenty of local tips.
We loved our stay here. Porto is a beautiful city.
Would come back in a heartbeat.

Daniel's place is everything you want in an Airbnb: beautiful and stylish decor, comfortable bed, ideal location, lovely amenities like beer, wine & tea in the kitchen, and excellent logistics and communication. The apartment is very historic, with beautiful high ceilings and windows/balconies, but also recently renovated to be ultra comfortable. Daniel went above and beyond to make us feel welcome in Porto-- he even sent me a Google Map with dozens of locations marked off for great restaurants, bars, and shops. This was one of the best airbnbs I've stayed at anywhere in the world, would come back in a heartbeat!

Great little apartment!! Very well located, gorgeous space with lots of light and good amenities. Didn’t get to cook but there was everything you need in the kitchen. Daniel was warm and welcoming and very quick to respond. Had a great stay and highly recommend :)
Amazing stay in this charming place that has everything you need. Daniel was very nice and helpful  throughout the process. Very good location as well.
Daniel's place was absolutely AMAZING. Perfect location, stylish interior design, hospitable host. Totally recommend.

Amazing stylish space in the great location, close to the city buzz but still not too noisy.
Daniel’s local tips were spot on!

Great central location to many shops and restaurants.  Easy access to most everything!  A little noisy at night but expected from the area.  Clean, fresh apartment in the heart of a wonderful neighborhood.

Centrally located but quiet, sparkling clean, and comfortable. Like many places, no AC but we definitely did not need it. Good communication and recommendations from Daniel!  We’d love to stay here again.

Central, beautifully appointed apartment in the heart of Porto. Wonderful host and so helpful.
We loved staying in this lovely space and highly recommend it!
Perfect location, clean and surprisingly spacious for a studio. If you need a well-located base for sightseeing around Porto, Daniel's place is perfect.

Great apartment to stay. You got exactly what you see on the photos. The whole house and apartment were very clean and well maintained. We didn't use the kitchenette, but it seemed to be very well equipped. The location was great from where you could explore the whole city perfectly by foot. However,  due to the cobblestone street and narrow alley the traffic was quite loud - even at night. My companion didn't mind that and I always have earplugs with me - so it was no problem.

Daniel’s flat is way more than I was expected! Really great location and beautiful place too!!
Truly recommend it!

Lovely apartment, beautiful building, very stylish interior and a good location!
The owner is very friendly, responds quickly and gave us tips about the neighbourhood.
We had a very pleasant stay and would certainly recommend this apartment!
I only have one small remark : there is a bit too much noise on the street to sleep with the windows open and it was a bit too hot with the windows closed.
Thanks for an easy stay at this beautiful room. It is fully equipped and perfect for a trip to Porto. We would definitely recommend!

This was just extraordinary experience! The accomodation is very stylish, clean and the location couldn’t be better. The communication with Daniel was fast also with recommendations what to see and where to eat. I am very happy that we chose for our stay this property! :)

Perfect apartment, has everything you need. Good location and good recommendations from Daniel per message.
We had a great stay and were sad to leave!
The location is perfect and the apartment is so beautiful! We wished we could have taken the bed home! It is one of the most comfortable we have ever slept in!

This Airbnb was just wonderfully! Really the most aesthetically pleasing place ✨ all the communication was great and the flat is very central. You walk 3 minutes and will find a supermarket bars and restaurants. Just great 🌱 we loved everything

Daniel’s place is in a great location. Very close to the city center you can reach everything. The neighbourhood is full with bars and restaurants. It is on a street at the first floor so some noises can be heard but anything we couldn’t sleep.
I will return to Daniel’s if I will be in Porto!

The apartment is located in a cosy neighbourhood with great restaurants and bars around.
I would definitely recommend.

This place is perfect, very close to main areas you will visit. You can rent scooters very close, or walk.
I highly recommend this place!
Daniel was super helpful and sent amazing Porto tips!

Daniel’s apartment was the perfect landing pad for our romantic trip to Porto. Check-in was easy, and near Trinidade metro station from the airport walkable with luggage.
The location is ideal for restaurants, bars, sightseeing, and shopping but tucked away enough to be more quiet for privacy and sleep. Porto is very hilly everywhere so prepare to get your steps in.
The studio apartment itself is the perfect size for a couple and very stylishly decorated with comfort and function in mind. A modernized, tastefully updated old building with style.
The true standouts for us were the bed — it is SO comfortable! We slept like babies. And the location, which was perfect.
Daniel provided some great recs for the area. We love Porto.
We will be back!

Daniel’s place is an absolute gem - we loved waking up to the beautiful, lofty ceiling and being so close to some really tasty places to eat. Daniel was quick to respond and made check in a breeze. We would definitely stay here again the next time we are in Porto!
We loved our stay in Daniel’s Porto apartment. The lighting, vibes, and location were all great. Highly recommend!

The apartment is very bright and open and is really stylish. The city centre is close by and everything is basically in walking distance. Daniel was a kind host with lots of nice tips for the area. We felt very welcome and overall it was a genuinely nice stay.

Beautiful place, clean, exactly as described, and centrally located to all the popular spots yet was still quiet at night. Daniel was also very responsive and offered a very helpful guide of Porto. Highly recommend!

Daniel's apartment was the ideal location to stay in Porto! It looks exactly like the photos: clean, spacious with high ceilings, well-ventilated. The place is beautiful and added to the loveliness of the trip. Finding the location and checking-in was convenient. Daniel was proactive and provided great recommendations to explore. He was very responsive and made check-out very easy. Highly recommend staying here!

I enjoyed staying at Daniel’s place. The apartment was very clean and equipped with everything you need. The area is quiet and is walkable distance to all main attractions. The checkin instructions were very easy to follow and the place is easy to find. Would definitely come back.
Great flat. Great location. The road outside is noisy and when hot you do need the windows open at night.

Amazing place to stay, such great value for location. Very close to many restaurants and key bus lines that take you to other parts of the city, or you can just walk!
Loved the windows and high ceilings. As others have said, be wary that the bathroom is on the smaller side, and it can be a little loud at night, especially on weekends. Otherwise, this place was great, would definitely come back.
Lovely apartment, Daniel was great for recommending us places to visit. Perfect for our 3 day stay in Porto. Would definitely recommend!
Loved our stay in Daniel’s apartment. Beautiful place to stay, perfect location and Daniel was so helpful and responsive. Would recommend to anyone travelling to Porto.

I'd highly recommend staying at Daniels place if you plan on going to Porto. The flat was spotless, ecactly as advertised on Airbnb and the location of the flat is very close to some amazing bars and restaurants. Daniel was very responsive and sent a list of local things to do in the city. Everything is in walking distance of the flat as well. The price I paid was also very fair for the offering. Just all-around a great stay!

Daniel’s pace was a great base for our Porto visit. The location is so perfect— quiet but full of great restaurant, in the center, and an artsy part of town in walking distance. Daniel gave us great tips and was very communicative. The apartment is well-equipped with everything you might need (including water bottles!) and we had a very comfortable stay.

Daniel was a great host.
Ideal location, everything in walking distance.
Would 100% stay in the same apartment again.
Beautifully furnished apartment in a period building, in a good location in a very nice city. I can only recommend this place.

We had a wonderful time staying here! The apartment is lovely and perfectly equipped with everything you could need during your stay. It's just a five minute walk to the beach, and it's easy enough to get into the centre of Porto with buses and trams etc. Highly recommended!

Nice appartement in great location! The appartement is very close to the ocean and good connection to the city center.. 10 min by bus. The communication worked very well. The father was there to give us the key. He is very nice, explained us everything. And thank you for the gift, it was delicous! :)

This is the perfet place for a cozy holiday in Porto. We spent most of the days in Foz at the beach and therefore it was just lovely. The beach is reached within 5 minutes and it is so beautiful. We also got some recommendations for restaurants which all had been very tasty. To get to the city center we took the city tram on the cost side which offered us beautiful view. This took us about 20 minutes but with such a nice view it seems to be less. All in all it's the perfect place for having a nice and relaxing holiday at the beach with some trips to the city center. We will definitely come back.
A massive thanks to your hosts and especially to the father of Rita who offered us a very warm welcome.

The apartment highly modern and well equiped and in perfect location, a quiet spot just in 5 min walking distance from the sea and in good accesibility by bus. The communication with João and Rita was really easy. I highly recommend the facility and the host.

The Sea House is in a great location, Foz is a fabulous area with lovely beaches and promenade.  It is easy to get into the centre of Porto and we actually had a lovely walk back on our last afternoon and there are regular buses and trams.  We were provided with lots of really useful information about Porto.  The Sea House itself was really clean and comfortable.  Would highly recommend.

Rita's place is such a cosy house, well located near the lovely shops and restaurants of the hood. the most welcoming hosts and heart warming arrival.
We will definetly be back! Thanks for having us!

The apartment is well located very close to the sea, well connected to city center by public transport, quiet area. Very discreet, but helpful host. Everything needed available in the house, including air conditioning. Extremely clean, newly refurbished, vintage tasteful decorations. We loved our home, as well as Porto!
We loved staying at this place in Porto. It was exactly what we had hoped for - close to the beach with great access to long, beautiful walks and the best restaurants in town.

Rita's and Joaos house is a really beautiful place to enjoy some time by the sea and the city. Very clean with stylish decoration and comfy beds. It's right beside five other small houses of the same kind and has a little terrace, not facing the street so it's quiet but right in the middle of Foz. Two minutes walk and you are right at the beach, the bus stop to go to Porto city centre is just around the corner. And the neighbourhood is also really nice and worth exploring! So: Perfect, I'd like to come again!

The location in the Foz is walking distance to the beach, restaurants,  and bars. The recommendations made for dining were excellent,  and included phenomenal sushi (and service) at Terra. Communications were efficient and clear. The accomodations are excellent.  We stayed in The Foz 2 years ago and loved it. Our return this time only enhanced our visit. Highly recommend.
Fantastic location, we stayed for four nights and walked down to the beech each day and enjoyed the city in the evenings via a very reasonably priced uber . Would recommend.
Lovely apartment, close to all the facilities in Foz and a short bus ride from the centre of Porto.
João & Rita’s place made for a great stay by the beach. It was super comfortable and instantly felt like a good place to rest between trips to the beach or out exploring.

Rien à dire. Everything was as described, and Fernando (Rita's dad) is the best host you could hope for. He was very responsive and helpful throughout all our stay. The place was super clean, and the location was very convenient (bus stops everywhere around to go to the city or elsewhere). Bonus: Fernando speaks very good French. All in all, it was great.

If you think about booking this place, please do!
I really enjoyed my stay - everything from the warm welcome to recommendations for the area to (of course) the gorgeous little house itself was just perfect.
The house is modern, stylish, clean and feels like a true home away from home. It is situated in a quiet street, just steps away from restaurants, the supermarket and the beach as well as the bus stop. A truly wonderful place! I hope I will be able to make it back here one day.

Nice location if you have a car. Our flight was cancelled so we weren’t able to stay one night and they refused to do anything about that except charge us. If you are trying to check in at night it is VERY HARD to find the key. Also, be careful not to hit your head on the ceiling by the bed! Ouch!

This is a great place to stay. The house is well furnished, very clean and is in a great location. You are only 5 minutes from the beach. There are several great bakeries and restaurants very close by as wel as a supermarket and you can easily reach Porto centre by the tram or bus or taxi. All very reasonably priced and stops are close by. Don’t hesitate to book!!
Great location, so close to the beach and a bus stop to center city. Also clean and a full kitchen!

For those thinking of visiting Porto, staying in Foz is a great way to see more of the city and get away from the touristic aspects of the city center. This place has great access to the water, bakeries, restaurants, and beachfront bars. Highly recommend. It’s only a short Uber ride from Porto too.

It was nice being guests of Rita and Joao.  The house is well equipped and close to the beach. Bus station and shops are also very close to the house. We had a great time and went back with many new impressions.

My wife, daughter and myself really enjoyed this space! It was quiet, private, clean and a great price! They even had everything we needed for our toddler daughter. I would recommend this place to anyone!
Ritas place was absolutely amazing. Fast walk to grocery stores and some nice restaurants/bars! Made our first experience in Portugal absolutely amazing. Will stay again if we come to Europe again

Came for Primavera, amazing location for it. Easily walkable, and then hungover days spent on the beach. Would also totally recommend if you’re just exploring Porto, as it’s a €5 Uber into town, and you get to stay next to beach rather than the town centre. The apartment itself is a perfect HQ with everything you need.
Everything about this stay was perfect. In a great location for food and the beach and only a cheap taxi ride from Porto. Would 100% recommend them to anyone
Perfect and easy getaway close to the beach! 5min walk to all you need. The apartment was quiet and restful with easy set up. Perfect for a short trip!

Thanks Joao and Rita. We loved Foz and its proximity to the ocean. Fernando gave us some wonderful recommendations. Tavi, the coffee and bakery was very close. Very clean accommodations and near to the wonderful and very tasty Foz Mercado.

Great place to have a has a base. Host was polite and very friendly. Good location for the tram into Porto and close to the ocean. We were fortunate to find an amazing shop, Mercado Organico, just around the corner selling organic foods, drinks, snacks ran by Paulo. Parking was free in the street if you have a car. Highly recommended for a couple on an adventure.
Lovely apartment near the beach, on a pretty street with great restaurants and bakeries nearby. We were welcomed on arrival and felt that the hosts were always contactable. Highly recommend!
We had a great time at the apartment and in the neighbourhood. Communication was super friendly both beforehand and during our stay — it’s simply the perfect place to stay when you're in Porto :)

Maria was a lovely host who made us feel very welcome.  The apartment is in a beautiful, historic building while the inside is newly renovated.  It's on street with modern art galleries, interesting street art and across from a sweet cafe.  We also enjoyed walking to the nearby public square.  We were able to watch a bit of the Euro soccer games outside there, where some locals had set up a screen and project.  Pretty neat! Also, nearby is a beautiful public park with a fantastic playground that our kids enjoyed.
Fab location and very smart apartment. Really near all the restaurants, the river and a real local community feeling.

The apartment is as the photo's and listing depict and also close to Oporto's attractions. The apartment was very clean, tastefully decorated and perfect for our family of four quick trip to the city. Maria was also very helpful and we would definitely recommend this apartment. Just wish we had a longer stay than the two days.

We had excelent time in Marias place. It was more than we expected. The apartment is fabolouse, well situated, very comfortable.
Having your first morning coffie on suny balcony is wonderful way to start you day.
And Maria was very helpful. Even provide us with some basic alimentaries ( juce, water, bread,...) on our arrival. Thank you Maria, once again.
It was a very lovely trip in a great city.  Maria was very welcoming and helpful.  The apartment was also very nice.

Maria's apartment was lovely. It was my favorite place to stay on our three week trip to Spain and Portugal. The apartment is very comfortable and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. We cooked dinner for five and had everything we needed. The backyard sparkles with white lights and a Christmas tree and the bedding was quality and very comfortable. The place requires a little bit of walking to the downtown, but is in a quiet, lovely location. We really enjoyed our stay here and would recommend it to others.

Myself and my sister really enjoyed our stay in Maria's lovely apartment in Porto. Maria was very helpful with directions and bus links from the airport and met us on arrival at the apartment to show us around. The apartment was lovely, clean & comfortable - I had 3 great nights of sleep in the very comfy bed! The apartment is in a lovely quiet neighbourhood with art galleries and antique shops to browse in as well as a lovely park close by. I'd highly recommend Maria's apartment. Thanks Maria and I hope to return some day!
Lovely stay in apartment will all needed amenities. Close to old town center. Very nice contact with the owner.
Great place, great location, all in walking distance but still quiet. Appartment spotless and very comfortable. Maria and her husband are very friendly and helpful

Maria’s place is such a gem! It is located on a small quiet street in the middle of an artsy neighborhood filled with neat street art, galleries, and shops. It is filled with lovely antiques and has a great garden in the back. Be aware that the apartment is up a large flight of uneven stairs, which might be tricky for some to navigate with a suitcase. Maria was extremely communicative and thorough. At check in, she helped us with our bags, marked up a map to help us get around, and answered any questions we had. Her shop is right across the street, and she made herself extremely available to us during our stay. There’s definitely a reason she has so many great reviews, and I’m happy to leave one more.

Maria’s place is so lovely. The inside is incredibly clean and comfortable, with enough space for 5 without feeling too crowded. The balcony is great and we loved having use of a garden in the middle of the city! We loved the location, walking distance to all the sights, restaurants and the park - where the views over the river are stunning. Maria was always quick to respond to messages, and check in/out was really easy, with Maria meeting us in person. If we return to Porto we will definitely stay here again!
Maria's place is excellent, centrally located in a lively yet calm and interesting neighborhood, and she is a great host. Next time in Porto, we will certainly see if we can rent this flat!

The apartment was exactly as described, very well equipped (including wifi) and as clean as can be. The owner was very kind and helpful. The apartment was nearby the beach (50 m) and close to the city center.

The place was wonderful! We were greeted very nicely and given a nice tour of the apartment as well as suggestions for main sites to visit. The place was very nicely decorated (loved the tiling in the kitchen) with a very spacious patio! We were also given a nice bottle of red wine at our arrival. I would definitely recommend staying at this place! Location was great, and the walk into Porto (river side) was only around 30 minutes. Definitely want to come back to Helena's air bnb!!!

Helena is realy a super host! The apartment is very well located and you have everything you need nearby! Very close to Porto center, just 2 subway stops! She gave very nice tips about the city! Definitely I'll be back!
For  us this was not a good  choice Further  than expected from the  metro and train  station .Extremely noisy  from the  road

Professionalism was shown throughout the entire stay at the apartment. It was clean, spacious, homey and most of all in a lovely location. The tips that were given to us by the lady doing our check in were great and she made us feel welcome from the moment we met her. Everything was great! Highly recommend staying there!
We had a good stay in the flat. The location is great, many little shops around and very close to the city (10 min walking). The flat has the perfect size for 2 people .

The apartment is perfect location very close to everything and easy to get to and from places around the city. Johanna and Pedro were both very quick to respond to messages and very welcoming. Johanna was very helpful with directions and pointing out places to go and see. Highly recommend!

Lovely and clean apartment. Great host who gave some excellent travel tips.
Really well located (train, shops, restaurants etc...).
Would definitely stay here again.

Cozy, beautiful apartment! In a great location! The host was really welcoming and helpful !! They take the time to make sure you are ok, and that you know the best things to do in Oporto!!

She gave us restaurant recommendations (really good btw)
The apartment has everything that you’d need for your stay !!!

The apartment has the best location in Porto! It’s only 1 min away from the metro, and within walking distance to downtown and almost all the famous tourist sites! It means that if you stay in this house, you can walk to anywhere you want without the need to take the metro! The house also has all the facilities you need. It’s clean, comfortable, well-designed and just a pleasant to stay in. I would definitely recommend to stay in this house:)

Nice cozy apt. well situated with nice view. Easy check in and an elevator great for luggage.
Definitely recommended!
Perfect location really close to metro. Small but perfect for a couple for a short stay in Porto. 20 min walk to river, but close to many restaurants . Really enjoyed our stay.

This place was fantastic!
Perfect in every way. My family stayed here 3days. If I could give this place 10 stars I would.
Central location and a very nice apartment, perfect for working from home and spending the week there. It was very convenient with fast internet and the communication was super easy.
This apartment was adorable, neat and clean! Right on a main promenade that had plenty to do right out the door. Rui was available and helpful when I had questions. Great experience!

The apartment is in front of Trinidade metro station, really easy to reach from the airport. It has two bedrooms and a toilet (no window, but really nice massage-shower). We walked to go almost everywhere in the city from there. Fernando was really precise and always available to answer to all our questions. Suggested to spend a few days in the beautiful Oporto!
Very good location in the center, just next by the metro. The host was nice and friendly. The apartment is good equiped. The shower was fun, you can listen the radio inside :). We recomand it.

Nice apartment, close enough to the river and the city center on foot. The apartement was clean, spacious and very comfortable. The host communicated well throughout the experience and left us bottles of water in the fridge :) , much needed. Parking can be challenging but I have seen worse in cities this size. Highly recommend.

Great apartment, clean and everything you need is there and more. Very central located en metro accross the street. Communicating is different if you don't speak Spanish or Portuguese , but thank google translate :). For us it went like clockwork and great and quick response. Very well recommended , loved the place
Great place to stay for a few days. A bit too loud from the road sometimes but manageable :)

We enjoyed our stay our host was lovely and understanding as we were late arriving
Due to trying to find this address hard to fine due to bad lighting that we could not see the street number

Manuela's apartment is very well located, close to the main attractions, public transportation and markets. It is equipped with everything necessary for short or long stays, as if all possible scenarios were thought of in advance. I've always considered myself quite lucky with my Airbnb experiences, but Manuela redefined the "super" of super host for my family and me. Her kind words, endless smile and tireless dedication will stay with us.

We had a great time at Dayanador's apartment. It is in a fantastic location, literally opposite the metro station directly from the airport, within a few minutes' walk to Porto centre, has a lift, is well equipped (enough crockery to actually cook, a rare find!) and very clean. Very much recommended!
Great location, not as noisy as I thought it would be, walkable to most of the attractions, metro station across the street and supermarket is 1 min walk. Lovely place

Apartment was perfectly situated right opposite the metro station. The apartment was spotlessly clean and more than adequate for our week’s stay. Was 10 mins walk to main shopping street and restaurants. Plus supermarket next door and also a couple of coffee shops.

I had a fantastic time at this apartment in Porto. The space was clean, modern, and well-decorated, with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The location was close to the main station in Porto (Trindade) and within walking distance to the Bolhão area. The host was incredibly friendly and responsive, making check-in and any questions super easy. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to explore Porto!

The AC CAN HELP TO CONTROL TEMPERATURE IN ANY TIME AND WINDOW CAN BE OPENED FOR AIR REFRESH . I HOPE TO IMPROVE BATHROOM ‘s sink and shower room could DRAIN water out MORE QUICKLY. It would be excellent

This was a great experience with an airbnb. The apartment was amazing. It was located near everything we needed, and it was easy to go to the major places in Porto. The apartment is just like in the pictures and we couldn't be more happy about it. João was also an amazing host, and his tips on place to go in Porto were great. He was very accessible and cleared all the questions we had during our stay.
If someone ever goes to Porto I will definitely recommend them to stay here.

João is really super host, very sociable and took the time to explain what to visit, where to eat and to drink!
We had a great stay at his apartment, that was big, clean, safe and have everything you needed. The apartment is located not far from the city center.
I highly recommend João! Choose João's apartment and enjoy the Porto city!
The place was very nice and well furnished with a very nice view! Easy to walk or take the train a few stops to the center of town!

Clean apartment on the top floor of a building 10-15 minutes walk from all the top attractions. João made the check in process very smooth and he had great tips for things to see in Porto. Good value. I recommend this place.

João was simply amazing!!! He was so sweet and nice, and the check in was easy and great and filled with local tips! He's a great guy :) the apartment is wonderful, you couldn't ask for a better place to stay. Location was perfect, and we even got some welcome treats.. We loved it there and felt so comfortable and safe. Would highly recommend!! Obrigada:)

This is a wonderful apartament, everything new and thought for the people there. The reception was so kind, even some cookies and wine, and everything was so clean. It is very good located.
I liked very much the terrace, sunny in the morning to lie on the sun, the bathroom and kitchen well provided with some utilities.
Thanks for everything Gisela!
The apartment  is as nice as it looks in the pictures. João was very welcoming and helpful with his suggestions. Absolutely recommended !

This flat is great! Very clean and has everything you need. Joao was very responsive through the app. He greeted me outside and after a tour he recommended some great spots to check out and provided complementary pastel de natas. Only down side is the washing machine in the flat wasn't working.

We had a great time! Nice apartment, close to the historical centre, and Gisela was very attentive. The wifi was a bit sketchy and there were construction works in the neighbourhood, but in the end that didn't really bother us. Would go here again.

We had a lovely time at this place, were happily surprised to have been left some wine and crackers.
Not a long walk into central Porto and close to supermarket and cafes. Very clean and a great rooftop to enjoy a drink at the end of the day. Thanks!

A superb apartment with everything we needed  The beds were very comfortable the walk-in shower with large shower head and hand held  attachment had full pressure. Air conditioning was handy on the hottest days. Fast WiFi and a large fridge freezer added to a perfect stay.

Very good property, fairly close to all amenities (bit of a walk home at the end of a day as it is all uphill). Good size and all the facilities you need.  Communication with João was great, no problems with check in.

Very nice and quiet flat in Porto, ideal to visit the city for a 1-week period. João is very friendly, available and set to help us at any time if needed. Thanks for all, we had a wonderful time in Porto!

João was extremely friendly and responsive throughout our stay - he would check in to see how we were doing and responded within minutes when we had an issue arise (minor, our own fault, and easily solveable). The apartment was very clean and within a 10-15 min walk of the city center.
One of the best stays I had. Great apartment, perfectly located and clean. Joao is super friendly and had the best suggestions for Porto. 100% recommendation.
The best place for discover the amazing Porto. João is amazing host and the lovely gift him left to us was really tasty , thanks a lot for everything João:)

João was a fantastic host, very attentive and responsive. The apartment is sparkling clean, very cozy and has plenty of light. City center is very close.  We had a great time and wouldn't hesitate a minute to come back to João's apartment!

The location of the apartment is awesome!! The house is fully equipped and clean. I spent there one month and João has been super kind and available for all kind of requests or needs. I am very thankful for the treatment I received the last month.
The neighborhood is quiet and a few minutes walk from the city center. The apartment is clean and very pretty. I enjoyed my 6 night stay.

João's place was the ideal base for a weekend visit - clean, comfortable and very well equipped kitchen. It was an easy 15min walk to the city centre but in a peaceful area. João was a very thoughtful and friendly host, giving us lots of local recommendations and a helpful intro to the flat when we checked in. Definitely recommend!

We spent one month at João’s apartment. It was a comfortable stay. Apartment is centrally located, near to main metro station Trinidad. João is very responsive and helpful. He gave all local advice about the São João day.Apartment is fully equipped with lots of natural light and wonderful view from the windows. Internet is very good. we highly recommend and will come back again. Thank you João for making our stay very pleasant.

We stayed here for a week and it was lovely and comfortable. The house comes with everything you need for a long stay and it's close to restaurants, supermarkets and metro stations. We would definitely stay here again. The host was friendly and responsive.
Joao is a great host. Our unit was exactly as described. Clean and very walkable to Porto city centre. Highly recommend

I had a wonderful stay at João’s place in Porto! From the very beginning, communication was smooth and friendly—João was always quick to respond and very helpful with local tips and recommendations.
The apartment itself was spotless, stylish, and incredibly comfortable. It had everything I needed for a relaxing stay, and the small details—like fresh towels, a well-equipped kitchen, and a cozy bed—made it feel like home. The location was also perfect: quiet but close enough to walk to all the main attractions, restaurants, and public transport.
What truly stood out was João’s hospitality. He clearly cares about making his guests feel welcome and taken care of. I felt very comfortable throughout my entire stay and would absolutely return the next time I’m in Porto.
Highly recommended—thank you, João, for a fantastic experience!

We stayed at this apartment from 5/6-5/30, 2025. It is exactly what the pictures show. The living room has its door and the sofa can be converted to a double bed so it can be another private room, which was very helpful when my adult children visited us.
It took us around 18-20 min to walk from the apartment to the city center, where we would go for shopping, dining, and groceries. The apartment is in a quieter part of the city, although the building right next to us was having a major construction going on while we were there. Without the construction, I’m sure the place is even nicer. The experience with the apartment was quite good except for the shower water. The water pressure was very low and finishing showering was challenging at times. I believe this was because we were located on the top floor.

From the time we booked, our host was super responsive and provided us with detailed information on checkin, nearby and in house amenities. And also local recommendations.
Joao couldnt be there to welcome us but sent his daughter to greet us as we arrived and she was very sweet. She walked us through the home which was very cozy, spacious and well equipped.
We were comfortable throughout our stay and would highly recommend this place if you want to stay some place that is away from the crowds but still walkable within 5 minutes.
You can cook here if you like. The place is also near the popular Bolhao market. The neighbourhood is very safe and we felt at ease.
Prima airbnb, Antonio is a sincere nice guy and was there when we arrived late in the evening from Porto airport. He gave us lots of great info on the region and Portugal in general.
Great quiet and clean rural spot outside Oporto. Communication with Antonio was superb all the time. Thanks for everything.
Very enthusiastic landlord, they gave us a lot of assistance.  I like the peace and plenty of private space here.  The place is very clean and comfortable. I will be back next time!
The villa is perfect for vacations with friends or family, fully equipped and well located ! Communication in particular was great, thank you again !

Very nice and sunny stay in a friendly house ! Surf school on the beach, Diakiri lounge bar at 10 min by feet and Porto at 15 min by car/taxi. Very quiet around the house. Sonia is reactive and flexible.

Really loved the apartment. Big in size and went with two small kids. Joana provided cot bed and high chair for the kids. The apartment has got everything you can think of and it’s close to the beach , restaurants, supermarkets and nice shops. You can reach the centre of Porto by bus.
Really enjoyed our stay there. Thank you Joana !

Joana's house was definitely a home. We stayed there for 1 month and could not ask for an easier way of living. The location is wonderful, less than 5 minutes to walk to a great beach. Multiple grocery stores within walking distance as well. Lots of restaurants, close to a huge park and a few playgrounds.
The home is so roomy. My kids had plenty of space to play and were entertained with the toys that are part of the house. It has good beds, a good sitting and dining area. The kitchen has everything you need to cook daily. It really felt like you're staying at a relative's house.
Joana was friendly and kind. She was flexible and easy to reach when we needed her. We would not hesitate to stay here again. Forget staying in the middle of Porto. Matosinhos is where you should stay!

the place is very well located and has a beautiful garden. it has basic things but some other essesntial things that are usually expected at an airbnb, toilet paper, shampoos and coffee ect.
.

10/10! We have had an amazing stay in Porto thanks to Pedro and his perfect recommendations. This guy really is a super host. Weirdly quiet during the night despite being in the very center and communication was great. Go to Musa das virtudes for a sunset beer.

Our stay at Maria's place in Porto was wonderful! The apartment was cozy, clean, and perfectly located for exploring the city. Maria was a kind and attentive host who made us feel very welcome. We truly enjoyed our time there and would love to come back. Thank you, Maria!

We had a lovely time staying at Maria’s. Her home was centrally located- which was great as we were able to walk to landmarks that were close by and had lots of restaurants nearby. Maria also provided details of a driver (Carlos) who was amazing and reliable. Would recommend staying at Maria’s!
We had a wonderful time! The neighborhood was beautiful and the apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Would definitely stay here again if we ever came back to Porto!

My husband and I had a wonderful stay at Maria's place. The location is absolutely fantastic - very close to many attractions and good restaurants. The apartment was comfortable and clean. We would absolutely stay again.
The flat was very good for the price. It was clean and nice to stay. Its a basic one But the right flat for a stay where mostly only for sleep.

Carlos was a great host and a tremendous help to us. We appreciate all he did. Carlos is the host with the most charming and fun personality, as well as being highly articulate! Carlos has made two friends for life!
If you truly want the feel and personality of Portugal, this quaint little area offers you the best; small cobblestone streets, charming little shops, with access to larger malls that gives you the best shopping and a short tram ride to downtown Porto and the best restaurants in this area.
Lots of beautiful and friendly people are waiting to meet you.
The apartment has everything you need whether you are staying two nights or a few months. Enjoy your stay in beautiful Porto, Portugal - we did!
Very nice place in a quiet neigbourhood. Carlos was a good host and communication was easy. I would really recommend it

Carlos is the best host I have ever had on air bnb! He is a great communicator and was patient with our delayed arrival. He took the time to show us about Porto on a map and he researched some vegetarian restaurants for us. He even provided a lovely bottle of wine. The apartment is exactly as pictured and easily accessible to the downtown. I would highly recommend Carlos as a host and sincerely thank Carlos for making our visit to Porto amazing! We would definitely stay again. What an awesome trip.

Check in was easy. Carlos met us at the apartment and was kind enough to sit and talk with us. Also, gifted us with a bottle of wine. The apartment is large and comfortable in a relatively modern building. The apartment building is in a large community of other apartment buildings. It is a 15 minute walk to the Hospital Sao Joao Metro Station and a 12 - 15 minutes ride to the center. A total of 10 stops. Be sure to validate your ticket before you get on the train.  There is a mini market, an ATM and several restaurants nearby.  The furnishings in the apartment are a bit outdated, but overall it was a comfortable 7-night stay.
Great location, great people, special thanks for Claudia, she was very quick at responding to questions. Amazing folks, would definitely come back and work with them again.

Gorgeous apartment and gorgeous host. The apartment looks exactly like the photos and was perfect for us! The lovely lady that checked us in also sat us down with a map and gave us countless (awesome) recommendations. Would definitely stay here again.
super clean apartment in a quiet area, well connected by public transportation with city centre. Claudia was excepcional, no problems at all

Cláudia place was a nice place to stay in Porto. It’s a nice new building and the plat it’s in a good condition. There’s nice bakeries and restaurants around the property. The only thing to point out is the noise on the street, specially on Friday nights. There was a lot of young people making noise outside the building.
Other than that it was a nice stay. The host was great and replied to our messages super quickly.
This apartment was beautiful and updated. Very safe neighborhood. Walking distance to a small Grocery store and two cafes.

Dark apartment, good location, not the most cozy place. Bad TV connection and no coffee machine.
For the rest it is a quiet area with good access.
Comfortable, the apartment is located in a good zone, near to metro and there are some restaurants on the surrounding.
Excellent and communicative host, place is quite appropriate for normal daily requirements, even if someone needs to work while away. A short walk from public transports and includes a parking spot.

Tiago and his sister Catia where great hosts! Very friendly and accommodating. They printed off our boarding passes, held our luggage on check out, arranged an iron for us, and gave us lots of great recommendations. Very fast response times! The place was super clean and well located! Would stay here again :)
Great location, right next to train/metro station, short walk to the river bank and shopping area.  Host is very warm, friendly and attentive.

The apartment is great, even better in person.
Located centrally so everything was in walking distance with lots of nice bars and restaurants close by. Only a short trip to the vineyards.
Daniel and Adriano were great hosts, responded quickly to all my messages and gave us good tips of what to see locally when we checked in.
Thanks again.
Excellent accommodations in an excellent location.  It’s just far enough away from the heavy tourist areas for a more authentic experience, although all sites are an easy walk.  We enjoyed our stay!
Location is perfect and Adriano was very helpful with suggestions of places to visit. The attic bedroom does get hot as it does not have an a/c unit. Great space and very nice furnishings & décor.
This is by far the best Airbnb that we have rented. The location, amenities and host far exceed our expectations. The terrace was amazing. I highly recommend this apartment!

Wow, what a pleasant surprise.   From the moment we made contact, we realized what a “super host” could be.   We had many questions in advance.   They were not only answered, but we were introduced to guides and restaurant choices that were truly top notch!  Porto is a great tow and worth the visit!
Me and my family really enjoing staying in daniel's  apt., clean, charming and functional.;  as well as perfectly located. Hoping to come back soon.

A fantastic location.  We stayed with our three adult children and were very comfortable. Daniel’s place has fantastic balconies and is very centrally located with all of the amenities.  Daniel left us a lovely bottle wine and was quick to respond to all of our inquiries throughout our stay.
I recommend this apartment a lot of space and very clean. The host did not make problems with late check-out.

A beautiful stylish place in the heart of Porto. We had a great time walking around and seeing the city. They're are a couple flights of stairs to go to, but it's nothing more than you'll do just walking around Porto. They were able to provide a crib which was very useful. Overall we had a wonderful stay.
Great location, very close to main attractions. Very clean space. The area can be a bit loud at night.
The apartment was beautiful and ideally located. The host was extremely helpful and in quick contact whenever needed. I would highly recommend the apartment as we had a fabulous stay.
Great spot, centrally located. Lots of bars and restaurants nearby. Gave us lots of advice for sightseeing and restaurants/bars.

DA'Home was an amazing experience! The amenities are fantastic; clean, comfortable, well located and bright.
More than recommending stay there is a must!
Thank you for all!
Amazing place right in the heart of Porto. Everything you want to see and do is just around the corner. Very friendly staff with good tips which you don,t find on internet

Very nicely remodeled duplex with all necesities needed present. Great location and very friendly hosts that are very helpful!
Nothing more to add 😅

Great central apartment- perfect for visiting Porto. Very close to everything you will need. Area is busy and the apartment provide ear plugs - use them and you’re fine! It wasn’t an issue for us. The second double bedroom with low ceilings we didn’t use as there were 4 of us, but it would be a tight squeeze if 2 adults are in there. This room also has no air con - fan is provided. Communication via W.App was great. Everything you needed for cooking etc was in the kitchen. Lovely terraces throughout - note the big terrace is through the master bedroom. We sent the agency some minor improvements including more mirrors than just the ones in bathrooms. Overall a great place to stay!

Great stay! Close to the market and lots of cafes and restaurants.
Slightly loud in the evening but ear plugs were provided which helped.
Fantastic location and most beautiful apartment .  We loved it and I highly recommend for a family stay.  Really top class .  Thank you all !  We will be back .

This place was in such a great location. If you are ok with the stairs (third floor unit) this place is great. The AC worked perfectly. If we had an issue they were very accommodating in fixing it or figuring out the best solution. Would stay here again!
A big apartment with big rooms. Excellent balconies. We enjoyed spending 3 nights there. A very convenient location.

Maykol was very friendly and helpful. Location of apartment was excellent and in walking distance to city centre and provided car park for our vehicle. Apartment is modern and very clean. A great place to stay!

The apartment was very nice, comfortable and clean. Location is good and you can walk to the city centre and don't use the public transport. Unfortunately the electric kettle did not work and we had to heat the water in a pan. And there was not salt, pepper and oil for cooking. Also, be careful and book a parking in advance, as there is not enough space for all tenants. Paid parking is not cheap in Porto. It was our fault, we did not read the description in Portuguese about it.
Everything was as described. Appartement located near the city center. Beautiful, clean and quiet place. Very easy to communicate.
Had everything we needed and was pretty spacious. It was t as close to downtown as we had hoped but still very easy to get places!!

We stayed @ Maykol & Genesis place for 3 nights with our 2 daughters. we were welcomed by Maykol and Roco. They helped us with our luggage (3rd floor w/o lift) than showed us the apartment which is  exactly as pitured (slightly small though). The appartment was really clean and functional. The neighborhood is really calm still within 10min walking distance from the center and lots of places  can  be found atop the street for delicious breakfast. The hosts were really  reactive and helpful with our questions/requests. A private and secured  parking was also available.

A wonderful place.  Felt very much at home.  It was clean, spacious (there were 3 adults and a 3 year old in our group), great location and the hosts were helpful with advice and tips for the area.  We arrived later on a Sunday evening, and they had even sourced a market and a restaurant that would be open when we arrived.  Highly recommend!  We would love to return.

My family and I had an amazing stay in Maykol & Genesis apartment! The space is much larger than we expected! Very modern and clean.
Maykol was very helpful during check in and showed us all the amenities!
It also has an outdoor balcony area which was great.
The location is perfect! Only 10 min walk to the Metro, lots of shops and cafes within 5 min walk, and around 20 min walk to the train and city center! It was grea because it was nice and quiet at night but close enough to all the landmarks!
We had an incredibly pleasant stay and highly recommend Maykol & Genesis as hosts and their apartment for your trip!
Great apartment on the third floor in a very nice area. You can walk everythere from there, no transportation needed. The hosts were awesome and communication was very easy.

This apartment is very accessible to most of the Porto attractions (about 15 min walk). But still manages to be quiet at night. Close by conveniences include cafe for quick and cheap breakfast, grocery store and good places to eat a late dinner. Seamless check-in. We were met right away by Rocco and he was able to give us great tips about the neighborhood. Would stay here again.
A clean place with a garage, about 15 or so min walk from Sao Bento station. Good match for a family with a car who wants to do day trips, e.g. driving to Braga.

We enjoyed our stay at Maykol’s apartment. The location was great, the place was very clean, checkin and checkout was convenient. Communication was great and we were able to get all the help we needed during our stay.

Great place to stay  for the city trip in Porto, walking distance to the city centre. We had a good time during our holiday. keep in mind the apartment is on the 3rd floor and no elevator. Free parking nearby the apartment. Overall we enjoyed our holiday in Porto.
