Everything you would need for  city stay. Parking was added bonus. Clean and tidy apartment.  Very comfortable beds and high quality linens.

the apartment is good and clean. the host was helpful, and the instructions were clear. looks like what you can see in the pictures. only the bathroom could use a bit of fixing some details in order to match the rest of the place. overall great experience and would recommend

Andre and Ana's place is absolutely beautiful. The place is very spacious, modern and newly renovated, i believe it's a rare find in town. Location is within proximity to most attractions in Porto. I can only recommend this place and if did return to Porto i will probably stay here again!

The apartment is just amazing, as advertised. First, the location itself is perfect : right in the center of the Ribeira district, Where all the fun and all the things to discover take place. Second, it is brand new, perfectly renovated and decorated. Very functional. Third, Our host were very nice with us. We did not see them during the stay, but we had conversation over the phone or by SMS,, and they were concerned about how our stay was nice. They even arranged a transportation to the airport (but finally we took the subway). I would highly recommend these hosts and this apartment. A perfect place to visit Porto.

This was a wonderful place for our family. Clean and sleek in a perfect location. The ceilings are incredibly high which gives a feeling of a lot of space. My son loved the loft bedroom, which was well situated to allow a cross breeze. Thank you so much!
It was a pleasure to stay in this beautiful flat. Everything was well organized and the flat just wonderful! Thanks a lot :-)

Andre was an excellent host, the apartment was even better in person than the pictures. Above all, me and my wife to be were left a complimentary champagne before our wedding. We have already said we would like to come back yearly. Thanks again
Perfect location and great hosts! The only down side is there is no air conditioning however they have many fans.

This is an apartment managed by a company and therefore there is no interest from the owners to present a luxury place as depicted by the photos.  Expect a minimalist space with minimal facilities, small beds, no air conditioning, many maintenance issues, particularly a bad smell in the main bedroom/bathroom.  Door to toilet permanently open as door does not close and a lack of kitchen facilities.  Location and elevator (if working) are the main pluses.

Very nice stay and a modern apartment. The host was very kind and friendly, good communication and always available for questions regarding Porto. He gave us good advice for sightseeing and restaurant. Actually, the best check-in I had with AirBnB so far.
I can really recommend this apartment for your stay in Porto.
What a cool Airbnb in the middle of Porto within walking distance to so many lovely places and restaurants.  Spacious contemporary interior design with lovely views.  We'd definitely book again.

We had a wonderful stay at Ana's apartment. The pictures are a good representation of the apartment. It's beautiful, very clean and fully equipped. There are even toys and books for kids. Our son had a good time too. The apartment is on a great location with a lot of nice restaurants near by and some supermarkets. Ana was also very helpful, quick in her replies and arranged a good transfer from and to the airport. We would love to stay at her place again.  We also recommend this apartment to everyone who wants to visit Porto and have a great time.

Amazing location, spacious apartment, beautifully decorated!
The only downside, it was hot! We knew there was no A/C and were hopping the Porto breeze would be enough to cool things down at night. Unfortunately being so close to the center means there was just too much noise to leave the windows open at night.
We would definitely come back, but not during the summer.
All information was completely accurate. Very happy with the flat and location. Super clean and with everything you need
So close to everything. Beautiful bedroom and just a great place to spend some time. Would highly recommend to anyone going to Porto. We will send our friends. Thanks

Loved our 3 night stay at this apartment - great central location for exploring all Porto has to offer.
Beautifully designed and clean apartment with really unique features. Pictures probably exaggerate size of the place to some extent but it’s still a perfectly formed place and I would highly recommend!
Ana was an incredibly helpful host, happy to continue to provide recommendations throughout our stay. Thank you!
The flat is everything that is specified and more. The location is perfect and the flat is spacious and equipped with anything you may need

Had a great time here with 2 close friends! We stayed for 2 nights and the apartment had everything we needed. It’s also very close to bars/restaurants and not far from the beautiful Douro River! Host was easy to communicate with and very responsive. Would recommend!!
Ana's place was truly amazing, and she was a very helpful host. I would recommend this place to anyone, and stay here again myself.

Ana’s place was amazing, nice and comfy.
The location is great and Ana provided whatever we need to make our stay wonderful.

Excellent location, the apartment is bright with natural light.
The bathroom door of the main bedroom is difficult to open & close and the lift was out of use so we definitely got our steps in - fine for us but if you struggle with stairs then best to enquire that it’s functioning first.
Overall a nice place to stay in a brilliant location.

This is one of the nicest air bnb’s we have stayed at.  It’s absolutely perfect!  Location, communication, and esthetics are all well thought out.  The beds are comfortable , bathroom clean, and kitchen is equipped with everything you could possibly need.  Ana had ample coffee stocked for the entire stay.  The view from the living room is fantastic!   She’s had the best blankets and kitchen amenities.  It truly felt as if we were staying in someone’s home rather than an air bnb.  Thank you for letting us enjoy this home while on vacation.  The location was absolutely perfect!

Ana was easy to communicate with and made sure we had what we needed.
The beds were comfortable and the space bright
Great stay
The place was in the center of everything. The host was responsive and friendly. I would highly recommend for your next Porto stay.

It’s a good place, you can walk surround the neighborhood, it’s not too close to the main center but easy to get there, the bed was uncomfortable with annoyed sounds while you’re moving, much better the sofa bed, the internet was super fast, you have to buy your own flame lighter otherwise you cannot cook

The home is modern, cozy,  impeccable and so quiet is was wonderful. Location wise it's fantastic being this close to the train station and subway. Maria was wonderful and full of joy. This is a home I recommend.

Lovely studio at ~5 mins of walking distance to Campanhã train station. Sparkling clean with everything you need to enjoy your stay. Pedro’s niece was very kind and helped us getting around by providing us a map of the city with all the touristic places to visit. Obrigada!

Maria and her team helped us sort out a minor issue with the booking.  The unit wasn’t available post confirmation, but they made arrangements to accommodate us instead of leaving us out to dry.  Extremely helpful and attentive, she reached out immediately and got us into the place we booked as soon as possible the next day.  A honest host that cared about her guests!
Great apartment in a great location! The host, José, was even giving ya information about a gastronomical event in Porto!
Lovely clean apartment in an excellent location. Jose was easy to communicate with. Thanks for a great stay :)

When we arrived José gave us a bottle of wine and pasteix de Belem along with very useful tips about where to go and what to do in Porto. He was always very fast to answer our questions and made us feel at home in his apartment.
The apartment is close to the city center and is fully equipped with what we needed. We will definitely go back to José's apartment if we ever go to Porto again. It was the best Airbnb experience we ever had so far.

José place was really clean, comfortable and quite. And it is an easy walking distance to the main streets and sights, he was really friendly and informative of Porto. Would definitely stay here again, thank you for the wine and pastel de nata!

We stayed for 2 nights for Porto visit. Jose was amazing host. We came at about 1 am and Jose met us at the apartment. Great thing to have parking in the building. Jose gave us very useful tips for places to see and eat despite very late hour. The apartment is stylish and crystal clean with everything you might need. Especially we loved bedsheets)). The other day we found Portugal pastries at the door and we just melted. Overall it felt like we came to old friend. Thank you for great time and it had big influence on our impressions about Porto.

The apartment was amazing, great amenities, the beds are very comfortables. The check in was easy, the host answered quickly. Very well located, close to the old city and all the historic monuments. We had a really great time in Porto.
Great host, very easy to communicate with. We strongly recommend his place: quiet, free parking, walking distance from everything.
José was a really nice host, very quick to help you whenever needed. The apartment was really nice, clean and close to everything
I didn’t expect the house is that great. The house is very cozy, clean and comfortable. Everyting you need is inside of the house. I highly recommend the José’s house.

This is THE place to stay in Porto! Very conveniently located, clean, functional, and quiet. José is the perfect host, and had a nice bottle of wine and some of his favorite local pastries at check in! Free parking in the garage under the building is great. Highly recommended!

José is a fantastic, friendly and knowledgable host. His apartment is ideally (and very centrally) located for seeing all of the sights of Porto within short walking distance, as well close to Metro stations. The parking was great too - Porto is a very difficult place to park!

Super comfy and cozy flat with amazing location.
Jose is super host - provided us a lot of advices and answered for all our questions.
José is an amazing host! He provided us with loads of tips on where to go around the city. The whole city is in walking distance from the flat which is great

Jose’s place is perfect. It is near the bars and the river shops. It is very nicely decorated and spacious. Jose is a very nice and helpful host. He showed us where we should go and what to eat. The parking spot underground was very useful for our car rental. Jose is one of the best host I had on Airbnb.

José is a great host and a pleasant guy. He shared with us much local knowledge including suggestions for our road trip far from Porto. The apartment is very nice, comfortable and in a great location -- everything is at a walking distance. We would definitely come back.
Perfect location. Jose was super responsive & helpful. Augusta was very sweet & helped us get intomarking lot and gave us tips on sightseeing.  Would recommend strongly to anyone
Jose was as super host and the appartement is very nice location. I will come back for shure.

It was a good stay in this appointment, close to downtown, shopping places. Appointment has everything you need. Good communication with and  recommendations from the host. Jose is a really nice person.
Good location. The pictures are true to the conditions of the house, which has everything you need and is very comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.

House was nice , bit humid but I guess that’s the city , lovely host helpful and kind .
Location is good with a car.

This apartment was outstanding!  Very clean, great location, great bathroom!!!   Jose was super responsive and polite and helpful!   He gave us so many recommendations for places to eat and things to do and see.  If I come back, I’ll definitely stay here again!!

José was very helpful from the begining to the end of our stay, with clear instructions for check-in and plenty of recommendations for our stay in Porto.
The flat is in an ideal location, 10 min walk from Rua da Santa Catarina where you have shops but also cafés. Also close by to the grocery shops which is very convenient! We travelled with our 9 month old baby, and the flat was well equipped for her with cot, high chair, etc.. Would definitely recommend José s flat :)

Overall a great place to stay. Nice area with walking distance to everything, and the parking is awesome. We did feel it could’ve been a bit cleaner especially the shower was a bit yucky. Overall though we were comfortable and Jose was very comprehensive in his instructions which was appreciated!
Great stay! Very pleasant and responsive host. Car drivers, be careful with the garage 😅😅

Good accommodation with a great location. Close to the centre. Convenient that the garage is located in the building. Slightly narrow entrance to the garage, but if you are not in a hurry you can get in fine. Jose is very helpful and attentive. Thank you!

Teresa is a really approachable host and made sure that we were completely settled in before handing over the keys for her amazing apartment.
Just a quick walk away from Porto's most traditional high-street - Rua de Santa Catarina - Teresa's flat brings quietness to a city-centre accommodation, which makes it suitable, not only for those looking for a life-bursting and trendy Porto, but also for those seeking a quiet place to meet that stubborn deadline that keeps us away from some well deserved holidays.
Thanks for having us, Teresa!
Very nice modern flat.  Very warm welcome by Teresa, she even had some wine and jam for us. Ideal for a city trip to Porto. Definite recommendation.
Was great to stay at Teresa’s place, we loved it. Felt very cosy and immediately at home, and easy walking distance to all the main sights. Thanks Teresa!
Teresa is lovely and we had the most perfect stay here! Location is awesome, walking distance to everything and the apartment was cozy and clean. Highly recommend staying here!

We had a fantastic stay at Teresas apartment, which is beautiful and stylish. Easy walking distance to the riverside and town. Teresa was super accommodating for a later check out after we had completed the half marathon. I would recommend to anyone going to Porto
Best stay of our trip. The space was lovely curated and created a sanctuary from our travels and explorations.

Teresas's place is absolutely beautiful. We stayed for two nights and were completely comfortable and cozy. It's very stylish, clean, quiet and well equipped. Teresa was very responsive throughout the process and very helpful. I would definitely stay here again the next time I visit Porto.

We stayed two nights in this apartment. It was very clean and very stylish. There is really nothing to complain about. Also Teresa was very friendly, she was waiting for us in the apartment, gave us some beer, wine and froots.
Fantastic apartment, ideally located and everything you could need! Teresa was lovely and extremely accommodating and hospitality was brilliant. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

We had an amazing stay at Teresa’s place. She greeted us with bread and a bottle of wine that we loved, totally unnecessary and much appreciated! The place was super clean and it was so convenient to have a washing machine and an espresso maker after two weeks of traveling! The sun room was the perfect spot to hangout - we loved all the natural light. We also appreciated  the location- it’s a close walk to anywhere you want to go in Porto, but outside enough that it was quiet. Always felt very safe- would definitely stay here again.  Teresa was also very helpful with recommendations for the area- thanks again!

Teresa's apartment is very unique- tastefully decorated whilst very comfortable. Teresa made every effort to ensure we learned about the local Porto traditions. Don't miss the opportunity to try the amazing dinner in the hotel across the road. It was an unforgettable experience.

The whole experience was outstanding! Teresa went above and beyond expectations. Communication was fast and you can tell that Teresa is willing to help in whatever is needed. The house is fully equipped, clean, comfortable and well located. Plus, small touches such as a bottle of wine in the fridge make all the difference! We asked Teresa to check out a bit later and she was super nice in attending our request! Would love to come back in the future!

Our stay at Teres's apartment was perfect. It had everything we neded for a short stay. The location was great - close to shopping and retaurants. We will  not hesitate to use the place again on our next visit here

Teresa’s place was amazing! The location was good, only minutes away from restaurants. The place was very clean and had a very nice sun room to chill in. Teresa was very friendly, communicative and helpful. We had to check in very late around 2/3 AM but she was up late and very helpful in guiding us through the self check in and tried to make sure that we were able to settle in well. All in all a great stay and definitely will choose to stay here again!

Absolutely wonderful apartment, close to anything you need, and certainly a great value. The washer/dryer in unit is especially helpful for after traveling! You should book this if available, and Teresa is a great and communicative host.
Very clean, lovely apartment, perfectly located in Porto for exploring around the city! Teresa was a very helpful host.

Lovely apartment, well equipped, spotlessly clean, comfortable,  some English language tv channels which was a bonus as we spent some cosy nights in the apartment. Quiet location but only a short walk from shops, bars and restaurants.

Teresa’s place is absolutely beautiful. This is what a true Air B&B should be like. We felt so welcome and comfortable. She truly goes above and beyond expectations. The wine and beer was a nice added touch. Thanks so much Teresa.

Great place to stay while we were in Porto. Close enough to all amenities and locations for a walking distance but far enough from all the noise. Place was clean and large enough for 2 people. It was great having a washer/dryer along with a lil outdoor window nook. I would definitely stay at this place again, 10/10
We stayed for 3 nights, the apartment was exactly as described. Check in was straight forward. Good value. Would stay again!

A wonderful stay! The apartment was fully equipped and Teresa included some thoughtful touches. We loved the sunroom with surrounded by trees and birds chirping and the high ceilings, a quiet place to rest after a busy day in the city. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook, spices and all! The location was great, right near a small market and an even bigger grocery store.
The thing to note that Teresa says - there is no elevator so you have to carry your luggage up 3 flights of stairs, and the stairs to the loft bedroom are steep so pay attention.

What can we say... Everything was just ideal. Brand new top floor appartment with the most wonderful hosts and ideal location. Spacious and full of light, with two terraces, absolutely equiped kitchen, very comfy bedroom with the most emotional shower :-) The location is more than ideal - a few minutes walk to the main areas of attraction, the famous Dom Luis 1 Bridge, the tram station and others. Though centraly located, you are sure to enjoy a quiet neighbourhood. Elspeth and Claudio were always there to help and every time we addresed them we recieved  a very friendly, informative and prompt reply. We are sure to come to Porto one day again and already know where we would like to stand! At Elspeth and Claudio's beautiful appartment...

We were positively impressed by this apartment. The photos looked good, but I believe they don't do the flat justice. It is a really high end flat in a very nice building just in the city centre, walking distance from everywhere. It is a spacious and stylish 1 bedroom flat, that came supplied with a Nespresso coffee machine, had a nice tea selection and the owners left us the surprise of a Port wine bottle which we thought was a really nice touch. Really enjoyed our stay and would thoroughly recommend it to others visiting Porto.

What a lovely place to stay after a day of touring Porto. Our hosts even left us a bottle of port wine to enjoy, a very nice touch after seeing the sites all day.
The apartment is new, very quiet and beautiful . Its has all the amenities you will need to enjoy your stay. It is well situated in the historic area of Porto and within walking distance to everything. We walk most everywhere and even took a Uber to the beaches just south of Porto. If you have time, these beaches are great and the Uber ride cost only 15 euro each way. A great way to spend a day
Thanks to Elspeth and Claudio for providing such a great place! We very much enjoyed our stay and would recommend this apartment to anyone traveling to Porto
Excellent place to stay in Porto. Elspeth and Claudio are great and super quick with responding. Would definitely recommend.
Elspeth and Claudio’s apartment is a fantastic space in a super central but quiet spot in the middle of the city. Everything is in easy reach and we loved our stay.
Elspeth & Claudio,s appartement was great! I highly recommend it to everyone staying in Porto!
Very nice place in a great location.    Super clean, and easy to get to from the train station.
The apartment is beautiful, really central, yet perfectly quiet.  The attention to detail makes it feel like a home from home, we would recommend it as the perfect place to stay.

Elspeth & Claudio's place is amazing! Also, the hosts are very responsive and helpful. The apartment had all the amenites one could wish for. Should we visit Porto again, we would definitely choose to stay at their place!

First, Elspeth & Claudio were great hosts. Very accommodating and thoughtful. They really make sure you have what you need for your stay. Second,  The apartment is sparkling clean, quiet and super stylish. It's open and spacious too with lots of natural light. It's located Central to everything, making it super easy to get around. Highly recommend this place!
Sparkling clean, peaceful accomodation. Comfortable beds and great check in experience! Thank you for being so accommodating...
This apartment is so beautiful! There are a few flights of stairs to climb, but the view is SO worth it!!

The place was absolutely lovely and perfect for my boyfriend and I to work remote while exploring Porto. It was extremely clean, well decorated, SO SPACIOUS, equipped with everything we needed and an easy check in and check out process!
Thank you Elspeth & Claudio for being excellent hosts and offering to help with whatever we needed.
We had a wonderful time at this amazing place! Felt like being at home. We would return any time and recommend Elspeth & Claudio as really good hosts. Nothing could have been better! Thanks a lot!!!
Beautiful, clean, and quiet flat with everything we needed for a very comfortable stay in Porto. Elspeth and Claudio were great hosts!
Large, well-organized and flat out beautiful apartment. Location couldn’t be better. Hosts were kind and helpful. We’d recommend this place to anyone (that can handle a bit of climbing).

Stop looking and rent this apartment for your vacation! We’ve stayed at many Airbnbs and this was our favorite - hands down. Great hosts, thoughtful amenities, every detail thought through. Spotlessly clean. Quiet and in a central location. Would stay here again in a minute! Thank you Elspeth and Claudio!

We loved our stay! Super clean and centrally located spot. Very cozy and comfortable and would stay there again! The hosts were super responsive and communicative. We appreciated they cleaned the apartment earlier in the day for us so we could check in early. Even if we hadn’t been able to check in early, they were going to let us leave our luggage there earlier. To make our stay even better, they provided a wonderful assortment of toiletries, gave us a bottle of port, and provided a welcome guide full of recommendations.
Only things to flag for this property are that it’s on the fourth floor (really the fifth floor for Americans), so if you can’t do stairs, find a different place. Also it’s located on an alleyway that sketched me out slightly in one direction but felt ok in the other direction. Otherwise everything was perfect!

I cannot say enough about Elspeth and Claudio’s apartment. Besides the perfect location and being close to everything, the photos of their apartment don’t do it justice! From the well appointed furniture, to how pristine and spacious the apartment is making you feel at home, it’s clear how much thought they put into providing their guests with everything they might need (coffee AND even milk in the fridge!). They are super responsive and very gracious hosts. I will recommend them to anyone visiting Porto since staying there made our visit to this beautiful city even that much more phenomenal. Don’t hesitate staying here for even a second!

Easily one of the best Airbnbs we've ever stayed in. The apartment is extremely clean, very efficiently designed, and comfortable. There's a ton of natural light and the balconies are welcoming. The beds very comfortable. The bathrooms clean and well designed. We loved the location--very walkable. The entrance to the building is in a small alley where some sketchy vagabonds hang out every evening, although they didn't bother us. The five flights of stairs were exhausting after a full day walking the city, but it's good exercise. We stayed for four nights and would definitely book this place again. Recommended.

to make it shorts and simple: Perfect!
you will have a little workout to get your luggage up to the Penthouse but then you will find the best city-AirBnB I have ever seen.
100% recommended

Elspeth and Claudio’s place was amazing. We loved being so close to all of the main spots to explore and yet it was absolutely quiet and tucked away. The views from the balconies were our favorite and we loved hearing the church bells. Our toddler appreciated the kid-friendly accommodations Elspeth and Claudio provided and loved looking out at the birds from the balcony. We would absolutely stay here again!
Other reviews mentioned the tunnel you may go through to enter the apartment but we found it was not an issue for us at all. It was easy enough to enter from the other street, avoiding the tunnel completely and we felt safe and secure during our entire stay. Don’t let that deter you, this place is amazing!

Wow, absolutely one of my favorite places I have ever experienced on Airbnb. Beautiful apartment, everything that we could have needed was there, amazing location, excellent communication, we will definitely return in the future!

Filipes apartment is a very lovely space with beautiful furniture and 2 super comfy bedrooms. its central and check in and communication is very easy. We enjoyed the welcome present a bottle of wine on the very cozy couch. Only thing is its a little cold in the winter even though you have portable heaters. But we felt at home anyways.

The apartment was perfect for our group of 3 staying in Porto for the weekend. It was spacious, clean and with everything we needed. It is located in a great neighbourhood from which we walked everywhere, into the old town and down to the water. Filipe was easy to communicate with and provided some great local tips. We would have no hesitation staying again!

Filipe’s place is just like what’s in the pictures, very nice, clean and convenient to all the shops and restaurants, we walked to everywhere we needed to go. Filipe provided a lot of written guide, Sarah his colleague who greeted us gave us a lot of useful information to get around town. Really enjoyable stay, highly recommend!

Excellent choice for both location and spotless comfortable apartment. Check-in was warm, friendly and informative about local attractions and restaurant tips. I would recommend the apartment without hesitation.

This place is fantastic! Very nice experience. We stayed here for two days. We loved the bottle of port wine when we arrived. We also loved the local tips that Filipe provided. We ate at two of the restaurants he suggested and they were both excellent. Also, the place worked well with our toddler. About 10 minute walk from the downtown.
Highly recommended! The place is lovely and the communication and handling Filipe provided could not be any better. Thanks a lot!
Great space! Looks like the pictures, very roomy, clean and nice. The communication with the hosts were always super fast and helpful. Location is absolutely great, would absolutely stay here again!

Our stay at the apartment was really great! The host is very responsive and helpful. The place is spacious and we loved having the two bathrooms. The street can get a bit noisy, especially on the weekend, but it was okay after midnight. The neighbourhood is lovely with bars and restaurants and some cute shops. It’s nice to be a little out if the busy centre, and all walkable. I recommend staying here!
This was such a lovely place to stay in Porto. It was super clean, comfortable and well located. The hosts were thoughtful, responsive and kind. I 100% recommend this Airbnb.

This was an excellent place to stay for a great time in Porto. Perfect location for walking around the city and good access to rideshare and transit. The apartment is very well kept up and comfortable. The guide the host provided was also a nice way to start off a list of spots to visit. Highly recommended for anyone on their first visit!

The best thing about this apartment is the proximity to the river beach- if you like to swim (which our family do) and see Porto then this is the place for you! Unfortunately amenities e.g shop, restaurants and public transport were not close by. Taxis did come promptly and we're not pricey, however. I would also say that the flat felt small for 5 people, probably better for 3 or 4. The balconies are very nice and the neighbourhood is quite peaceful and traditional.

I would definitely recommend staying in My Porto Loft. Fernando was super friendly and the Loft is spotless!! You ate in the center of a grat shopping area and everything is within walking distance! Definitely a great place in Porto

This is the best AirBnB I've ever been too!! Clean, comfortable, amazing location... Then we were received with some "Natas" (which is a typical sweet from Portugal), but we also had croissants, milk, jam, wine, coffe, cookies, etc. They have all you can need for a nice stay in Porto. The owner (Andrea) answered my questions just in some minutes, she reccomended us places to go, and she was absolutely nice.
In conclusion, an appartment which in the center of the city, awesome services, clean and very good attention. Thanks for all Andreia and Fernando!

The  apartment and the hosts are fantastic. Centrally located, spacious, clean and had all the required amenities. We were also welcomed with the home baked pies that were absolutely delicious. Response for any questions is very quick and the checkin, checkout were both painless. Really loved the hospitality. Would definitely visit again :). Thank you Andrea and Fernando again.

Had a great time at Fernando’s place. Enjoyed the coffee machine and the food goodies that were left for us to try.
Just note that because it is a heritage building there are about 3 flights of stairs to climb if you’re staying at My Porto Loft (top most apartment). Beautiful apartment which was very clean.
We had a great stay! Very walkable to everything but far enough to be out of the main stretch for a more quiet night. The hosts were very helpful and kind. Definitely would recommend staying here!
lovely people who went above and beyond. They even took our bags up since we got in early. Oh! Also, the apartment is perfect and in a great location.

Fernando’s loft ticked all the boxes: quiet, comfortable bed, lots of space, good internet, less than 5 min walk from metro station, which made it very easy to get to with luggage from the airport. The kitchen had oil and spices which made cooking simple meals easy. The location is very central to lots of sights on foot and transit. Ana was very responsive.
Everything was as expected, good price and location, hot water with good pressure, very nice, helpful and accommodating hosts. Would stay here again.
We had a great stay. Fernando and Ana were very helpful and gave clear instructions that were accurate. The flat is in a great, central and safe location.

A great stay. Ana provided very clear instructions. Everything was as described. The apartment was warm and cosy. The bed was comfy and the water pressure very good. We had coffee pods left for us, which was great. A fantastic location. I would definitely recommend. Thank you Fernado and Ana.
Our stay at the apartment was absolutely wonderful. The host, Fernando, was incredibly kind and welcoming. A big plus was that we could leave our luggage before check-in!

We absolutely loved our stay at Fernando and Ana’s place. They were incredibly responsive and always quick to answer any questions we had. They were also very flexible and accommodating—allowing us to store our luggage on the last day before heading to the airport. The apartment itself was in a fantastic location close to the market, great restaurants, and plenty of stores.
One thing to note: the apartment is on the 3rd floor with no elevator. It wasn’t an issue for us, but it’s something to keep in mind for guests with mobility concerns.

Thank you so much for such a wonderful place to stay! Even before our trip, everyone was so responsive and lovely. The apartment was so pretty and in such a great location. Every time we had questions, the team was available to answer them!

The location was very convenient and central for exploring Porto. The host and co-host communicated instructions and details very clearly and went out of their way to ensure that everything went well with our stay.

Excellent place to stay in the heart of Porto: so close to Mercado do Bolhão we got to sample so many fresh & tasty things. Easy to navigate the metro & walking everywhere. Ana helped make sure everything was perfect & when we asked for help she was immediately helpful. Highly recommend. Thank you Fernando & Ana!
I love Porto! Thanks Bruno, Kamila to hosted me in a confortable and charming home and thanks to their friend Gosia to gave me useful advices to discover the beautiful Porto!
Lovely apartment. Very pretty, brilliant location. Really friendly and gave us loads of tips. Recommend this place highly.
Great hosts and very cozy but noisy place right in the middle of the city! Great value tho! 100% recommended!
The room was very clean, nice and cozy and Kamilla was great with all the useful tips that she gave me. It was a lovely stay, thank you :)

Bruno and Kamika's place was so perfectly located.  Walking distance to everything.  Upon check in, Bruno gave us a map with all of their recommended restaurants and attractions.  Apartment is clean, rooms are large, kitchen is equipped for basic meal preparation if that's what you desire.  I would stay here again.

Excellent location. Close to everything and you feel like a local. Go to The Happy Nest, a great cafe two blocks away and there are other great restaurants and cafes near by. The hosts were excellent communicators, they gave great local tips. the place was nice, safe and comfortable.
Lovely place. The room is stylish and near a centre. However,  they’re at 3rd floor and It was hard for me to carry a big luggage from 1st to 3rd floor.

Super nice and cozy place. We had a wonderful stay and loved Porto. The apartment is very close to the city center (walking distance). The room and the apartment are exactly as shown in the photos. The apartment was very clean and the other guests were also very clean and respectful on the common areas. Bruno was an atentive and helpful host and always replied quickly. We really enjoyed our stay and woundn’t change a thing. Thank you Bruno & Kamilla :)

Kamila was really welcoming and warm host. She shared some really valuable tips of what to see and where to eat in Porto. The snack place (really close to venue) was outstanding. And it serves good food till 1 am.
Close to bus station so it was easy to find.
Nice spacious room, shared bathroom (no problem with that) and really good location from where the one could start exploring Porto.
I will definitely recommend to everybody coming to the city of positive vibes :)

I was met by Kamila, who is lovely and gave me a map with lots of tips about where to go and what to see.
Great location and very safe neighbourhood. The room was spacious and stylish with a lovely sunny balcony off the kitchen.
It is up three flights of stairs! But that was made clear in the description.

I had a lovely stay here! The room is cute, large and bright and has a big window for fresh air. The location is also quite good, I walked to most places. I liked the neighborhood, it felt calm and peaceful!

Good location for the city centre and big supermarkets near. Third floor with no lift, hard with luggage but managable. Flat is convenient but old furniture though bed was comfortable. My room was huge but no tv. Bathroom is well equipped and clean. Kitchen is alright with all the cutlery and crockery you need just a microwave would have been welcomed. I good stay altogether.

We loved our stay - Jose was the perfect host, very helpful and shared great tips. Apartment is modern, extremely clean, comfortable, and secure. It's also literally on the doorstep of the city - an enjoyable walk away from cafes, restaurants, shopping and main sights. We'd highly recommend - great value and experience.

Amazing house and perfect hospitality, great space and comfort.
The position was perfect and we could access all the areas of Porto we wanted just by walking.
Please don't book this house, so it will be free for us when we come back!
Just kidding, you will have a great time in this house so don't hesitate!
Thank you again José for the great opportunity and excellent service!
- Andrea

We really enjoyed our stay in this Apartment. In the beginning, it was very cold, but the heaters José gave us helped. It is perfect to discover the city, has a good location and you can cook your own meals if you wish. The Check-in was smooth. José had plenty of Tipps to offer and was very friendly.

José met us upon our arrival and was really kind to wait for us despite a slight delay. He gave a tour around his apartment and provided very clear instructions. He also prepared some snacks, coffee and tea for us. The apartment is exactly as portrayed in the pictures, in sparkling clean condition and was very comfortable for our four-night stay! José was also contactable throughout our stay and was always there to address any questions we had about the city or the apartment. The apartment is on a quiet street, but just a two-minute walk away from a shopping belt, as well as a number of great restaurants and cafes. It's also very near the Bolhão subway station so it's really accessible. We had a great experience and would highly recommend booking your stay with him. Thanks for the amazing hospitality!
The apartment was perfect for a weekend away with a friend. The kitchen is well equipped and the location is fantastic. Jose was so helpful with information and answering questions.

We spent 3 great nights in this appartment with our 2 year old girl, José even provided a baby bed and a baby chair for us.
The appartment is very nice, clean, and well located near the center of Porto that you can access by foot.
José is very friendly, he offered us a very good welcome, with directions to the places to visit in the city, he also responds very quickly if you have any questions.

We recently stayed in Porto at this apartment. It's in an excellent location and we loved the place.  It's very clean, modern, and well maintained. José is also an excellent host. He pointed us in the right direction for things to do and great restaurants. José was easy to communicate with and always replied quickly with any questions we had. In fact, we informed him of two small issues. A burnt out lightbulb and the shower was draining slowly. We just wanted to let him know so he could look at it before the next guest arrived. He apologized and immediately came over and took care of both issues. If we ever return to Porto we will definitely stay at this apartment again.

The flat is everything you would need for a great stay in Porto! It's close to all the tourist attractions, nice bakeries and the main shopping streets. Jose was a spectacular host, quick to reply and to help in any situation. Everything was really enjoyable and we couldn't have asked for a better location!

José’s place is a great place to stay and explore Porto. He welcomed us on arrival and gave us lots of information about the local area and where would be good to eat before arrival. The apartment is within walking distance of everything we wanted to do in Porto (about a 2 minute walk from Majestic Café). The flat is well equipped should you wish to cook and José keeps a stock of essential cooking stuff like salt, pepper etc. It was a cosy base to come back to after a long day exploring the city. Would highly recommend! Thank you!

Beautiful apartment in a great location within the city centre. The host provided a really helpful PDF of local eateries. Lovely balcony, close to the metro, and bag lock, which were all extremely useful. Well worth staying there!!!

This place has everything. Walking distance to all of the amazing spots in Porto and transport links if one wants to explore beyond the city.  Plenty local places around to grab a coffee or go for nice dinner. 5 min walk from Majestic Cafe and other attractions. Lovely balcony with table and chairs to sit and relax. Comfortable and quiet place to rest after long walks.

We had an amazing time in José’s apartment! He was a very welcoming, attentive and thoughtful host, he had prepared us bread, milk and butter for our first breakfast! The location is perfect and the apartment is very clean and spacious. There are so many amenities that made our stay special like the nespresso machine and Netflix on TV. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay, we recommend it 100%

Excellent apartment with everything for a very comfortable stay.
Location was amazing, and José was very accommodating and helpful.
Would definitely recommend.

This apartment is absolutely great. Spacious and just a very nice place to unwind after being out all day!
Located very near the middle of town (can walk everywhere) makes this place ideal for just wandering around and not having to plan where you may have to be at a certain time.
José is a great host and made us feel very welcome !

The flat perfect to explore Porto - location is perfect and it is so nice furnitured that one feels cosy and at home. Even travelling with a 3 month baby we didn't miss anything in the flat. I loved the fact that there is not only a coffee machine in the flat but there were even coffee capsules so we could enjoy a cup of coffee already in the first morning without having to search for a shop/baker first thing in the morning. Flat is very stylish and I can imagine staying there for a longer time. Host is very very helpful and communication was very quick! We would stay again in the flat if coming back to Porto!

Nice, clean and well located apartment. Functional and comfortable for 2/3 people.
Easy access to restaurants, shops and attractions. Recommend Maria Rita restaurant, 100 meters away and the big grocery shop, Pingo. Definitely recommend. We will come back.
Beautiful apartment. Close to everything. José was a wonderful host. Gave us a map and tips on what to see and do and helped us book a taxi to the airport.

Great location, great apartment to enjoy Porto!
José is very helpful, especially his guide about what to do and where to eat :)
Highly recommended.

I want to express my thanks for this amazing apartment and Jose's hospitality.
Since the moment we booked the apartment we had a great communication and we felt a sincere care towards us, the guests.
I need to praise also the amazing attention to details and the 5 star overall service.
The apartment is in a great location, very beautiful and clean, offering a home when you are away from home.
A very good choice for Porto travels.

José was a fantastic host. The apartment was spotless and just as depicted in the photos. It was also in a great location to visit the sights of Porto. Communication with José was excellent and he gave us lots of useful tips. I would thoroughly recommend the apartment to anyone wanting to visit this beautiful city.
José is a wonderful host and his beautiful apartment has everything you could need for a short stay. It was the perfect base for exploring Porto!

We had a great stay. Communication was easy and the apartment is as advertised. The location is great: central, but quiet at night.  Subway to the airport is nearby, maybe a 5 minute walk. We would really recommend this place!

Very nice spacious apartment in Porto, fantastic location.  Jose was extremely friendly and met us on checkin and provided information on the apartment as well as recommendations on restaurants.   We had a great time in amazing Porto, thanks to Jose and this airbnb apartment.    Would love to come back one day.
Nice apartment in a good location. The host was nice and came late in the night to check us in. It’s basically one room so better for family/2 people. Perfect for 2 adults + 2 children as well:).

We had a great stay in Jose’s apartment. It was very comfortable, clean and was very well located.
Porto is a beautiful city and we were able to walk to all the places of interest that we wanted to visit from the apartment.
Jose was a great host. He met us when we arrived at the apartment and showed us everything we needed to know. He had sent us lots of information in advance about places to eat and things to do.
We had a very enjoyable time in Porto.
Many thanks Jose for a great stay!
Jan and Michael
Great place to stay. Host was amazing.  Perfect location and quiet place, extremely enjoyable stay!
A very nicely equipped apartment with simple but very nice bedrooms and a wonderful spot for a family or group gathering!

We completely loved the apartment, it had everything we needed for our big family group. It is beautifully decorated with amazing views from the living room and from every bedroom. The beds were very comfortable and had big and modern bathrooms. Jose provided with everything we could possibly need for our stay. José was an amazing host, went above and beyond to meet all our needs and was always available when we needed help or guidance with the city. The kitchen is fully equipped and beautifully decorated, as well as the living room, the dining room and the bedrooms which each has its own decor! The location is incredible! The metro is just in front of the building, it has restaurants and cafeterias in the same square where it is located, a supermarket just a block away. We recommend the apartment 100% and will love to come back! José is one of the best hosts we have ever had!

Praça 66 is the perfect place to stay with a medium group of friends or a family. It has all the amenities you need to cook, iron, extra blankets, balconies are super sunny in the morning and the bedrooms look like hotel rooms. :) We where super happy (group of 12) to spend a long weekend there, and José was an amazing host!!!! thanks for everything

This is a great place located infront of a metro stop that takes you straight to downtown. The place is huge!!! It seems to be an old hostel converted to AirbNb, and it is worth it. The only negative thing that I could find was that it does not have Washing Machine. Most Airbnb have one , this one does not. And the other not very important is that they have cameras on kitchen and some areas of the place. Other than that, everything was perfect.
We had a really nice stay in Porto. José was very attentive. The appartement was exactly like the photos and very well situated. We would recommend it.

Super location and nice living space. Very nice host who met us early and gave a good overview of the space. We were out most a LOT because Porto has so much to see. 7 minutes walk from the beautiful Balhao Market and metro stop where we rode directly from airport.
Bed was comfortable and everything clean. Only improvement would be better pillows and small table beside bed for glasses, etc. on the whole it was a marvelous stay.

wonderful airbnb that was clean, well located, spacious and smelt great! wonderful host as well - josé was welcoming and always responsive, made us feel very reassured and welcomed. even met us to show us around the apartment at the start. would 10/10 recommend this place for sure
Place is great, comfy bed, nice big sofa, all you need in the kitchen. Located right in city centre but quiet as the apartment faces the back of the building. We had a very good stay

This was the perfect place for two of us to enjoy a city break in Porto. José was super helpful with directions and local recommendations, and the apartment itself had everything we needed - clean, spacious and in the heart of Porto whilst still being quiet inside. Would definitely recommend!

Wonderful communication by Jose, who was there to meet us at the apartment and went through all the necessary processes. He also recommended some brilliant restaurants around the area which were great.
The flat it self was very clean and tidy, and has all the utensils you need. The location is fantastic, it was only 10 mins walk from Bolhao train station, and situated right in the centre of Porto where we got to see everything we wanted just by walking.
Couldn't have asked for a better location and will be looking to book here again in the future.
Amazing place and hosts! Very clean, very modern and spacious. Great location in a square, and easy check in.

The apartment was exactly as described and in a fantastic location! It was very spacious, perfect for our group, and had everything we needed. José was a great host—always quick to respond to any questions or requests. I would definitely recommend this place to any large group of friends or family looking for a comfortable and convenient stay.

Huge, beautiful loft apartment very well located in Porto. So new and clean and well equipped. Quick walks to the great restaurants and nightlife and shops. Would highly recommended for a couple or small group
Very modern, spacious loft! We didn't want to leave. The hosts were great, even when we locked ourselves out. :/

A beautiful, clean and comfortable apartment located within an easy and short walk of central Porto.
Andre and Patricia were amazing hosts - communication was swift and extremely informative, from booking right through to check-out.
Perfect weekend.

Andre’s apartment looked exactly as shown in he photos. It is conveniently located: slightly away from the most touristic part of the city, with a lot of lovely stores and food places nearby.
A building is under construction opposite to the apartment. But if one goes out most of the day, it doesn’t matter much. In general, we enjoyed a lot staying at Andre’s place.
This place is as good as it looks in the pictures. If it is available, don't hesitate and reserve it!!! The location is unbeatable and the amenities are amazing.

The location of Andre’s apartment is wonderfully located in the heart of Porto. It was a walking distance from local shops and the São Bento train station. It was easy to navigate the town and visit it’s famous attractions.
The size of the apartment is ideal for a couple.
The highlight of the booking is the lovely staff who are quick to respond to questions (Sara you are wonderful!).

Clean and spacious apartment close to Trindade station. Convenient location which is what you want while travelling in Porto. Prompt communication and easy check in.
The only downside of the apartment is they are doing some building works across the road so it is noisy during the day. Otherwise it is very comfortable and we loved our stay here

Looking at the photos of this beautiful apartment it's hard to imagine the real thing being any more impressive but somehow it is. It really is something special. Sadly during our stay the rain in Porto was crazy and a change of plan was needed... this apartment truly was the perfect setting to propose to my girlfriend. (She said yes btw!!!)
If you're undecided about where to stay in Porto then just go for it; I can't see how anyone could regret it. It's expectionally clean, spacious, modern and in such a great location too. We already can't wait to come back one day.

I loved staying here! It was gorgeous, clean, and quiet for being so close to the city center. I can’t wait to come back and stay here again. It’s a perfect walking distance from everything we wanted to do!

What a fabulous time we had. The place is gorgeous.
We loved everything from the property to the location, the check-in service, the assistance provided, the manner in which communication was handled, Andre’s availability, etc.
I truly recommend staying here!

Excelente Apartment!!
Great location! Well done decorate and super clean!
Thanks for the communication with the team!
Highly recommend.
Great location, beautiful and cozy apartment, VERY clean, fantastic check-in process and very easy communication. I will definitely come back and strongly recommend this apartment!
This is a really lovely apartment that’s situated in a great location. My partner and I stayed two nights, and both left wishing we had more time there. I highly recommend this place!

The apartment was spotless, it felt clean, comfortable & inviting. The bed was especially comfortable. The location is really central , with a great coffee shop by the front door for morning goodies. It’s a short walk to Ribeira where all the bars & restaurants are. I would highly recommend it to others guests.

This was a great loft in a fantastic location. Neighbourhood was great and the people friendly. The apartment had everything for our 4 day stay. Having two bathrooms was great. Needs a little help with the heat distribution on the main floor but other than that was a fabulous stay wish we could have stayed longer. There is a great bakery and restaurant just a few doors down in each direction. We walked everywhere from here. Would love to stay here again!

Great modern place with all the things you’d want or need while travelling. Secure building with elevator. Solid locking door. Great kitchen. Close to lots of shopping and activities - further walk to old town or the touristy things (10-15 minutes). Overall would stay again for sure.

The loft was incredible. Right in the heart of Porto, everything we wanted to do and see was no more than a 5 minute walk away. It was a perfect oasis for our family's first trip to Porto and if ever we go back, we'll make sure we stay here again. Well worth it.

Andre’s place looks even better than the pictures. Perfect spacious and stylish loft in the centre of the city. Aircon in the living room worked well once it was on for a while. In the bedroom above the aircon seemed to struggle a bit because it’s the very top of the building. Andre left a bottle of wine and some local cookies which was a really nice touch. Would definitely stay again when in Porto.

Beautiful apartment and location until we found BED BUGS. Host was helpful and provided us an alternative apartment but it wasn’t what we expected. Sadly he disappeared after asking for a partial refund and said his manager would get back to me but never did. The alternative apartment was cold and there was mold in the shower. Overall ruined my Airbnb experience in Porto.
Absolutely loved Andre's place. Super cosy, modern, clean, spacious and also in a quiet street yet, near everything! I would highly recommend it to anyone staying for a few days in Porto.

A fantastic apartment in a great location! It was a quick walk from the metro station to the apartment and it felt like everything in the city was within walking distance. The apartment itself had a nice kitchen and a really nice TV area which we used a lot in the evenings.  Really loved our stay.

What a way to start our vacation!!! Thankful we found this gem. Nestled in a great community and so close to so many restaurants and shops! The host was extremely responsive and helpful! Definitely keeping this gem on my list of places to stay again!
Andre’s place is wonderful. We found the flat clean and cozy.  It is in the main city center and less than a five minute walk to public transportations, shops and restaurants. Highly recommend!

The apartement is marvelous. Clean, well equiped, the view is great. It is a 20 min walk to Luis bridge. 15 min to restaurants. But you can also eat in the village Afurada, 10 min walk. The contact with Hugo was fine. Very helpfull. We recommend this apartement!

We were 3 couples visiting Porto for 5 days and could not have found a more beautiful place for our stay. The apartment is exactly as described, the views were magnificent, and the large terrace was great for sitting around and having drinks. The place is very well equipped and the location is extremely convenient. Walking distance to restaurants (Afurada - 10 minute walk) and a 25  min walk to Luis bridge.  Hugo was very helpful and everyone was very accommodating. I would highly recommend this place  !

Amazing apartment! Five adults spent two nights and the only problem was that we did not have enough time there. Clean, spacious, high quality and luxurious apartment. A beautiful bowl of fruit was waiting for us, as well as coffee and tea. We did not cook but the apartment is well equipped for doing so. The terrace overlooking the river is extraordinary - the highlight of the apartment. Walk or easy cab ride to shopping and restaurants. Quick communication from Hugo and much appreciated being able to drop our luggage when we arrived earlier than check in time. Definitely recommend this apartment for a stay in Porto.

Thank you for this incredibly beautiful stay in the apartment. Maria is such a kind person and gave us a warm welcome. The apartment was very clean and modernly furnished. The view from the balcony is so amazing. It takes some time to walk to Porto by foot, but that didn't bother us at all.
Obregada por tudo.

Fantastic apartment with a fantastic view. The apartment's design is modern, elegant and pleasing. The apartment has a large balcony/terrace with a panoramic view of the river (as advertised) where many of Porto's Bridges and attractions are visible. It's also a few minutes walk from a Hop on Hop off bus stop.
Best Airbnb I've stayed at so far.

Fantastic place for a group of 3 or more. Spacious, beautifully appointed, incredible view, quiet, comfortable and everything you need for a short or long stay.
I loved it here - the old town center is close and far enough. A market and wonderful restaurant a close walk away. Unless you plan on venturing outside of Porto, no need to rent a car. Uber and taxi’s are reasonable and you are super close to town.
Give yourself enough time if you are headed to town for excursions during the weekdays. Commuters are on the road from 8-10am and traffic can put you back about 30 minutes.
Wonderful hosts with loads of info and ready to help out.
Lovely apartment with river views. Good to have a nespresso machine . Only drawback is lack of transport outside apartment unless you walk or take a taxi.

The house is amazing and had plenty of space. Its modern decor and comfortable furniture made for a lovely stay. The best part was the view and balcony- watching the river at all times of day was our favorite pastime.  It’s a bit of a walk to the next village (10-15 min) or Gaia (20-30 min) and Porto, but we enjoyed the exercise and the walk was scenic along the river. My only wish was that we could have stayed longer. Modern amenities and a gorgeous place. Thank you!
We had a wonderful stay at Pedro's! The view was gorgeous and the place was modern and clean. Would definitely stay again.

Comfortable, quiet, spacious apartment with great views. A nice walk along the river (30 mins) to the bridge and old town. Great communication from Pedro and very helpful with leaving bags after check out time.

Amazing apartment, the terrace is incredible! Pedro was really attentive to all our needs. The location is really good, just across the river from the city center. It is more quiet than staying in the city center and an uber takes 5 mins. Would really recommend!

This location is unbeatable and stunning! It’s a short drive to anywhere you want to go in Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia. My family and I had an amazing stay here. The apartment was super clean and spacious.

Pedro's apartment is stunning. The views of the Douro from the balcony are amazing, the location easy to get to from the airport and a 30 minute walk to the Ribeira, it's peaceful but still well located. We had a fantastic time here exploring the local area by foot but could also easily be reached by car and taxi. plenty of bathrooms and a well equipped kitchen in the apartment as well as a good entertainment system and spacious balcony and kitchen/dining area. it's excellent for groups up to 6 and we would happily go again for the terrific value and experience. Pedro was also very accommodating of us when arriving at different times and needing to leave luggage as we were leaving. Thanks Pedro!

This is a great apartment with breathtaking views of the city. Well equipped and clean.  The secure parking garage in a real plus but you can often find parking on the street.  The hot water pressure in the showers in wonderful.
Great location 10 minutes from everything and easy to park. Modern, safe, and stylish building with a tastefully decorated apartment. Would definitely come back!

Better than expected! The views on the balcony were spectacular. It was the best place to come home and relax in after busy days of exploring the city. Many thanks to Pedro and his team for all the help and accommodations!!
Absolutely a wonderful place to stay.  The views from the apartment are beautiful, centrally located with a convenient parking space. Would highly recommend.

A beautiful space for a friend getaway. Pedro was fantastic and everything was really easy.
The location was fantastic, because it was really quick to get to the places we wanted to visit. Spending time in the apartment was also great, as it had everything we needed and it was clean and beautiful. Would highly recommended.
We absolutely loved this condo!  It was so peaceful, and we had a beautiful view of Porto across the river.  Highly recommend!
Pedro‘s place was very beautiful. Great location Fits family of seven no problem very happy with the stay that we had.

We were greeted by Melissa who gave us great recommendations for what to do around Porto, including where to get the best Francesinha (delicious!). The view from the apartment is amazing and there were great amenities too. Easy location to Uber to and from. There were 3 of us and we all loved our time here and would highly recommend it to others.
This place was fantastic!  Beautiful place with an excellent view of Porto.  Location, setting, and host responsiveness was top of the charts. This was our best AIR BNB experience !!

Pedro has a modern, clean, and large place. We loved the apartment. There were some issues where the electric breaker would turn off if we used the stove, oven, and the water heater ran at the same time. Not a big deal to fix.
Biggest drawback was the location. It is great if you want to stay in. However, you will need an Uber anywhere you want to go, including song grocery shopping. There is really nothing close by. At least 20 mins away.
Overall we loved the apartment but the location woulwould keep us From coming back. But that is a personal thing. If you don’t mind me to take an Uber (which are fairy cheap), then I would recommended this place.
Apartment is beautiful and located in gorgeous area.  Highly recommend anyone to stay here.  You won’t regret it!!

Our stay was absolutely incredible. The apartment is beautiful, the photos do not do it justice. We had ample space for our family, and all of the amenities we could hope for. Between the decor and the view, we (almost) didn't want to leave to explore the city. We had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend to anyone wanting to book this location. Thank you Pedro and Tatiana for an amazing stay!

We stayed for a wonderful three night's in Hugo's apartment. Communication was outstanding and we received an excellent welcome with lots of ideas and tips of what to do during our visit. The balcony was a relaxing spot to watch the boats go by, Uber's were cheap and eaily available to get around. The apartment is stunning with everything you need for a memorable stay. We hope to visit the wonderful city of Porto and stay again. Thank you Hugo.

We had a wonderful family trip to Portugal, and this was a fantastic home base for part of our trip. Beautifully appointed, centrally located, and the owner/house manager were extremely accommodating and communicative. I would recommend this home to anyone traveling to beautiful Porto!

Diogo and his family have done a tremendous job completely renovating their apartments, with everything you need for a comfortable stay and... the views of Porto are outstanding. Our hosts could not have been more warm, helpful and welcoming, and the little gifts were a very nice touch. The street below is a bit busy with traffic but just below there is direct access to the Gaia district riverfront with all the porto tasting rooms, lots of good restaurants and a couple of small corner markets. We love to walk, so crossing the bridge on foot and exploring Porto proper was perfect. Five starts across the board!
John & Emmanuelle
Everything was just perfect! The apartment was comfortable and well-equipped, the location was very convenient, views were amazing and Diogo and José were great hosts. Would definitely recommend.

We had an amazing stay in this apartment, all is perfect! Very clean, with fantastic view over Porto and all amenities needed for a stay. There was even porto waiting for us as welcoming drink.
Location is perfect - it's just a short walk through the bridge from all the main touristic side of Porto. It's possible to arrive late at night (as we did), there is also guarded parking lot.
If we are back, we would definitely choose this place once again :)
This apartment was wonderful! Great location and size. As people describe, there is street noise. We luckily brought ear plugs and had no trouble sleeping.

The view is to die for and close proximity to restaurants and port wine cellars is great. The hosts were faultless and off premises parking is very close. Unfortunately, and despite the double glazing windows, the apartment is still very noisy throughout the night. Sleeping on the queen size sofa bed helped somewhat.

The place has a fantastic view of the Porto city and is very close to the bridge and surroundings. Diogo and his father were perfect hosts. The place was just not perfect for us because of the stairs...we are an old couple...

Very friendly owner, waited for us at the parking until we arrived. He was was very helpful when we had a problem.
Beautiful view, excellent location. Very nice equipment.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at this apartment! Not only did we have a stunning view of the town, José was an excellent host—he was super friendly, gave us insider tips into the best local eateries to visit, and even prepared an assortment of Portuguese delicacies upon arrival. Would highly recommend this home to anyone who's visiting Porto!

Everything about our stay was wonderful! Check in was a breeze and they were able to let us in early at the last minute. We were given excellent guidance for our time in Porto and everything was exactly as described. The location ended up being even better than we expected (first time in the city), and the views from the apartment were spectacular -- truly a great surprise!
Great place with an amazing view. The place was very clean and has everything you need, close to restaurants and shops. The host José was very nice and helpful.

I will join the bandwagon of people who have commented on the view from this apartment. It is as good as any rental we've had. We were there for a week and would look at the view at all times of the day, it was so beautiful. The apartment is very convenient to the major tourist sites and is very comfortable. Uber is very practical, efficient, and affordable to get around. Jose was very responsive to all our needs.
I will make one observation if you are older or have issues with climbing. Virtually everything you will need is going to require going up and down steep steps and/or hills. If that is not doable, despite the great features, this might not be something you want to consider.

This place is better than advertised.  Book with confidence.  Beautiful apartment with everything you need for a great stay.   Parking included (2 blocks away) is essential if have your own car.   Incredible views of Porto and Gaia.   Easy walk downhill to the wine cellars on the Gaia side, then cross over the lower section of bridge to get to Porto.   Coming back up the hill…not so easy.   Plenty of Uber, Bolt, and taxis to take you up the hills.

Wonderful stay! Diogo and José are outstanding hosts. Met us upon arrival at flat and showed us around, gave city advice and a bottle of port.
The views from Gaia overlooking the city of Porto and bridges is amazing! One bedroom has a wonderful balcony to enjoy the views from the comfort of the flat, makes for an outstanding place to photograph the city.
The flat has Air conditioning to keep cool in the high heat. 2 bathrooms with showers. All amenities you could need, coffee maker, fridge, cooking items, etc. Plenty of room for our family of 5. Quick walk across bridge to historic Porto, flat is right in the Gaia touristy area.
One of the best Airbnb locations and flats we’ve stayed at! Love the city of Porto and Gaia! It was a pleasure meeting you José, thank you all for an outstanding stay, great job on the flat!

Perfect - you can't ask for better. Location is fantastic, hosts are kind and generous and the view from the balcony is maybe the best in Porto. The apartment is comfortable, convenient and the sunsets are literally breathtaking. We got great recommendations for restaurants, sightseeing and more from our hosts and we loved our time in Porto. Do not hesitate - book with confidence. We will be back.

Our family of four traveled to Portugal on a flight that landed in Lisbon and we took the train to Porto. After a long day of travel we were met by Jose and was told we could leave our luggage at the apartment as it was being setup for us, which was amazing.
The apartment was just right for a family of four. The views were amazing especially at night. The area was quiet and safe. We wouldn't hesitate to book again if we're ever back in Porto again. What a beautiful city and made it all the better with a great Air BnB apartment.
thank you.

Our stay was amazing! The view from the apartment over Gaia and Porto were spectacular. The accommodations were great. Clean, modern, well appointed and very comfortable. On check in we were created at the apartment and provided lots of information to know what places we should tour and where some great restaurants were. Highly recommend this apartment if you have a chance to visit the area.

MagicEscape2 apartment was perfect for our Porto vacation.  Jose met us at the apartment and helped us check in and provide excellent recommendations about the neighborhood restaurants and landmarks.  The location of this apartment is perfect as we were able to walk everywhere and the views from the apartment are stunning.  The place is close to everything including metro, supermarkets, and the historic center of Porto.  The apartment was spotless and had all the amenities including a strong WiFi connection.  We would highly recommend MagicEscape2 to anyone considering a visit to Porto.  Can't wait to go back there again!

What a great apartment! Jose and Diogo were very responsive and allowed us to check-in in the morning after our flight arrived. We were so impressed with the view, and the apartment had everything that we needed. It was easy to walk to the port wine cellars, as well as to the historic parts of town across the river. I can't thank Jose enough for telling us about his suggested attractions. His map helped us to navigate the city quite easily. The metro stop was close to the apartment and was very easy to navigate. We will definitely be returning to Porto and hope that we can stay again in this location.
A flat with a superb view across the river in the best place in Porto. Free parking and good recommendations for restaurants and what-to-do.
Nice apt with a fabulous view from the bedrooms! Host left us some nibbles and a bottle of port, which was very hospitable and a nice touch!

Two things stand out…our amazing host and the incredible view. The pictures on the site do not do this apartment justice (we did benefit from perfect weather). The location is also perfect as it’s very easy to access the river front of Gaia and Porto. An added benefit is a parking spot, with easy entry and exit, which we used to drive to other locations. We were there for four days but I wish it had been four weeks, or months! Thank you Jose!

Just had a 3 day stay at the apartment with the family. It was lovely and truly enjoyed our stay. The location can't be beat if you want to stay across the river and enjoy the beautiful views of Porto. The highlight of the apartment is the view from both the bedrooms. Saw lot of tourists taking pics right underneath the apartment , which just shows how good the view is right from the apartment. The apartment is very professionally run. Clear instructions very provided. The host was waiting for us at the entrance of the building and even helped us with the luggage as there is no elevator in the building. He also spent quite some time going over the apartment and provided lot of recommendations for sight seeing and restaurants and answered all our questions. There is also a convenient parking available close to the apartment.  The bathrooms are on the smaller side &  if you are tall, you will feel a little cramped.  Overall, we had a great stay and recommend this place.

The apartment is in a perfect location, with a view that is simply breathtaking.
We could not recommend it more.

A very unique and special place.   The land is beautiful, the old house built in 1780s is amazing and the location was a great get-away.  It would be nice to have a map of the property, as there are some nice areas to explore with unique birds, swans, ponds, fruit trees, flowers, etc.  recommendation: bring lots of mosquito repellent!!!! Antonio & Luis were great hosts and very kind of them to share this beautiful place.
Mariza is super nice, prompt in replying and the place looks like in the pictures! Thanks again!

Very clean en nice appartment. Mariza was very welcommig en responded very quick! It is a perfect location, central! A bite noisy at night because the traffic! But if i ever came back to Porto i choose this appartment again.

Mariza truly deserves her qualification of « super host » ! Her apartment was modern, really close to the center and to the trindade station. She paid attention to our well-being in her apartment during the whole time we stayed there. This a great place when you want to spend a few days in Porto !
Marisa was a very helpful host. Accommodation was in an excellent location with convenient transport links to the airport.

The apartment is well located. Unfortunately, we had a lot of noise due to traffic and construction work in the street.
Marisa is really nice and helpful!
Everything was as expected. Marisa is very kind and always making sure that everything is ok. Really nice apartment with a great balcony.

We stayed in Marisa’s apartment for 4 nights. It is an excellent t apartment and the location is very good. We walked to all the the attractions during our stay. Marisa is an excellent host who was very responsive to our questions. She was personally present for the checkin and explained everything to us and often checked with us during our stay. The apartment is well equipped and neatly arranged. Recommended as a very good option for visitors to Porto.

This is an outstanding spot located  in the middle of the action of Porto. The place is as calm as you want it to be. It felt very comfortable for two people to stay, I’m sure it can handle more. The host was amicable and proactive, she is clearly invested in providing you with a wildly positive experience. She was consistent and receptive. I would have no qualms about booking again with her.
Really clean apartment and very walkable to all the beautiful places in Porto. Marisa was very responsive, checking in regularly to see how we were getting on, we loved our stay!
Great place to stay when visiting Porto. Marisa was very responsive and friendly. Would stay here again!
Really cute apartment in a great location. I really enjoyed my stay here and loved how sunny the apartment was during the day. There were also metal blackout shades which were perfect for sleeping.

we loved our stay, very lovely home with all you need (except napkins or kitchen paper towels) 😁🧻
great location as well.
thank you so much 👍🏻😊

Superb location - close to the metro station, supermarket, and many attractions. The apartment was clean with a nice view and balcony, but it can be a bit noisy from the busy road below. Overall a pleasant stay!

Studio was great, excellent location for ease of walking into town and to the river, also near metro. Staff were helpful and friendly. You’ll need to be nimble to make the stairs up to the mezzanine bedroom.  Half bottle of wine in the room was a nice touch.

We were visiting Porto for a music festival in Gaia and Rui's flat has the perfect localization to access the venues by feet. It's a bit steep from the Douro but by bus/uber/e-scooter it's also doable.

Big apartment at great location. walkable distance to the Douro river and maybe the biggest landmark of Porto - Ponte Luis bridge. The apartment has everything you may need for a short or long term stay in Porto.

Great appartment to visit Porto, good located next to the Graham Winery.
Good bakery for breakfast in the area to start your day.

I usually do not leave a comment but I can't help writing about my stay. The hosts were fabulous, helpful and accomodating. The room is very private and spacious so it feels like a hotel. Also, as the room is separate, there is no noise at all. The bathroom was super clean and equipped with everything we need. Rosa, her husband, and her daugher were super nice and helpful.
