I didn't want to leave her house on the last night. Also, it's easily accessible to the city center with metro and easy to reach the airport by foot. Thank you for the wonderful stay!

Very neat place. High quality room and house.
No noise while close to the airport.
No breakfast or water in the room.

We enjoyed the stay. Room is great, bedroom comfortable and nice and clean bathroom. Everything is new and in the high standard. Near the airport but I recommend to take taxi because the sidewalks aren't good if you have luggage on wheels.

Maria Rosa and her family were extremely nice! The room incl. bathroom were perfectly clean. It‘s a new house and everything looks really nice. To the airport it‘s just a short walk.
We were kinda sad that we couldn’t stay longer and would definitely come again!

Rosa was very helpful and welcoming  The room was impeccably clean and spacious enough to fit a family of five. We were able to walk with children to the airport. I would definitely stay here again when travelling through Porto airport. Thanks

I have stayed at a lot pf airbnbs and this was by far the best one!  I only stayed one night so I could walk to the Porto airport in the morning, but I wish I could've stayed longer. The house was so beuatiful and clean. The bed was super comfortable. There were treats left by the bed, along with bottled water. You can't go wrong with this place!

Some oft the nicest people I've met in my entire life!
The room was big, very beautiful and very very clean also!! There were some small, sweet attentions too.
Great people, great room, we will come back :-)

A great location very near the airport ( easy to find). The room was very clean and the beds so comfortable! Rosa and her husband were really kind and they  had prepared crackers and drinks for our arrival. I really recommend the place if you have a long stopover between two flights in Porto.

We definitely recommend Maria’s home  if you need to be close to the airport. It is literally at walking distance and super easy to get there. We got to the house by car, and checked in with Maria’s husband. The room was sparkling clean, large and extremely comfortable. We had our private bathroom as well which is a big plus for us. The room was equipped with everything you need for an overnight stay. For us it was perfect! The communication was super easy and prompt. We enjoyed our stay!
Amazing place for a good nights sleep before catching a flight back home. The room was very comfortable, clean, and modern. We experienced some true Portuguese hospitality.

We had the suite, so the room that fits 3 persons. The room was perfect. Feels like if you have your own hotel room. Very clean and very beautiful, the room is equip with everything you need. I would definitely recommend Rosa's place for a stay near the airport before a flight. Rosa and her husband are very kind and they made us very welcome in their house.
Thanks again
Great place near the airport. Very clean and nice... charming family, which cares to inform you. Check out independent and easy. Place recommended :)

Extremely friendly hosts who speak perfect English as well. We were welcomed personally and felt immediatly at home in the stunning apartment. Amazing bed, tv, private (spotless) bathroom,... close to the Oporto Airport. It was perfect!
The room was sparkling clean. Jose gave us advice about the city and transportation. They are very welcoming. Overall, our stay was wonderful!

My husband And I got there really late because we had forgotten our passports in algarve, and had to drive all day to go retrieve them! But Maria and her husband waited patiently for us!
Their place is amazing!! Would choose that room over any hotel!!

Very nice and helpful.
The room was spotless clean, we had coffe, water tea and hot chocolate to drink at the room.
Airport is extremely close you can walk there by 10min. Room has a very nice own bathroom. We will definitely be back at our next travel to Porto.
I absolutely love staying at Rosa's Air bnb! Been there a couple of times and its always a great experience :)

Very clean and comfortable. Great nights sleep and the air con was a bonus! Rosa and her husband made you feel at home straight away and are always on hand to help with whatever you need! Would definitely stay again! Thank you both!

Very clean and spacious room. Calm neighbourhood. Very helpfull with tips for nearby shops and restaurants (the bakery nearby has delicious pastries and good strong coffee). No noice at all of the airplanes but in the house young children can disturb your sleep.
We had an amazing night here. The rooms are beautiful, modern, clean and the service is great. I hardly can imagine a better place in this area.
An excellent staying near the airport of Porto.  Super clean, usefull details and a warm welcome was our experience.  We were here for the second time and hope there wil be a third in the future.
Clean, quiet spot very close to the Porto airport. Definitely recommend if you have a early flight to stay here as it is only a 3 minute drive to the airport.
Jose really went above and beyond in every respect, he even went out of his way to find a wall adapters for my laptop and phone. Would definitely stay again!

It was most convenient to stay so close to the airport in this wonderful airbnb!
Some coffee and the in the room, just wonderful
The host was very helpfull.
Thanks again.
Piet and Conny

My parents stayed here and they couldn’t say more great things about it. Just yesterday, they were telling their friends once again how amazing Maria and her family were. Thank you so much for your hospitality!
Perfect place to stay if you have an early flight! So close to the airport, Very clean, comfortable, and hosts made sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely stay here again!
Ideal location for someone who’s looking for a place close to the airport. Place is clean and has all the necessary stuff. Super friendly and approachable host

The hosts are very welcoming and kind. The Airbnb is located a 12minute walk away from the airport but it’s a relatively straight and easy road. The room is very clean,comfortable  and spacious. This is a good pit stop before heading to or coming from the airport.
Great place and very friendly, helpful host. Very impressed with the cleanliness of the room and bathroom!
Delightful place. Response host.  We had one minor problem with a window blind which the host came right over and fixed. Lovely environment lovely place

Jose and Rosa have a very clean, convenient, and modern place to stay if you need to get to the airport quickly. Jose has a "secret" walking path to the airport if you would like to avoid paying for a taxi or Uber. It's about a 10-14 minute walk.
I recommend!

José and Rosa were extremely kind and accommodating hosts! They gave us very clear instructions and made us feel so welcome. The apartment was very clean and just as described. Would warmly recommend to anyone looking to stay close to the airport!

The place was exactly like the photos, very clean and modern, and it was very close to the airport (a 13 minutes walk). The host was very kind and thoughtful, always avaliable.
I highly recommend it.

This place was great. Exactly like the photos. Very modern, clean and full of natural sunlight.
It has safe, secure and free parking very close by which is perfect for anyone driving around Portugal.
Daniel was extremely helpful. Full of passion for Porto and provided excellent tips and an itinerary of activities to suit our interests and length of stay.
The apartment is 5-10mins walk to all the main attractions of Porto and made for an excellent stay. Would recommend this place for any couples or close friends visiting Porto.

The apartment was as same as on photos. It is great that is placed in typical portuguese house. It is close to city center and everything we want to see is on 10-15 min walking distance. Nuno recommendet us great pastry shop and port cellars.

Daniel's place was perfectly located! He was a wonderful host and even left us a bottle of wine in the Airbnb. The space was immaculate and had great amenities including a tv (with Netflix already on it) & upgraded appliances. And Daniel was very hospitable and a great resource for food recommendations & things to see in Porto. Overall, I'd highly recommend this place !!

This apartment is very close to all you need to see in Porto. It is very clean, close to the metro station. The owner is very friendly, great communication. They even left for us a great Duro  wine. We will certainly return. This is 5 star service.

Nuno goes above and beyond to make sure your stay is smooth. From meeting you at the door, he is very accessible,   providing plenty of suggestions of restaurants and things to do in porto. We accidentally locked our key inside and he was there within minutes. You will not regret staying here.
Daniel is a very responsive and friendly host! I definitely enjoyed my stay and would stay again at his place, should I visit Porto again.

Very good Location with Bus and Metro stations nearby, but we often even ended up just walking into the city historic center, because it was not too far away. Great check in Experience, great Hosts. Would love to return someday :)

A really lovely clean apartment in a lovely building in a quiet location. I would definitely recommend a stay here. It is only a few minutes walk from the metro and close to the beautiful city landmarks. Daniel and Nuno are excellent hosts,, giving lots of useful information prior to my stay. Nuno was very helpful and responded very quickly to my queries. The welcome pack was a lovely touch. I would just say that after a day of walking around Porto, save a little energy for the few flights of stairs to the apartment 🙂 Definitely worth it though!

Amazing hosts, very helpful and hospitable. The place is great, amazing view of the sea, not too far from the train station and as close as you can get to a supermarket and McDonalds. Absolutely nothing bad to say ☺️

When I come back to Portugal this is where I hope to stay again.  The sunsets are amazing, location is great, beach just a short walk.  Home is comfy, cozy and welcoming! Thank you for your hospitality!
Great apartment with an amazing balcony and view of the sea! António was a very nice host, and we'll be definitely going back.

Love this spot in Porto , great restaurants form at Port and lovely views in the evening from there across the river. Also straight across the river from the Wine Caves - don’t get confused they are not actual caves but the port places. Try the sidecar tour- Juan was awesome!
The apartment is smart and clean

Really enjoyed staying at Márcia and Teresa’s apartment. It was a treat. Tucked in a quiet spot in a historical area, it’s very close to major sites, restaurants, and cafes — many of which are right down the street. Clean, inviting and comfortable room with all basic things available. Loved Porto and will be back and will be staying here again. Thank you so much!
Great location, apartment was very comfortable and extremely tidy - we felt very much at home. Thank you!

Perfect location for a few days in Porto!
The hosts were very welcoming and made everything really easy.
The beds were very comfortable.
It was really nice to stay there, apartment is super clean, exactly how it’s on the pictures, atmospheric, I would recommend!!!
Gorgeously looking apartment with fully equipped kitchen . Check-in and communication was amazing. Will definitely come back.
Great location and great place to stay for a couple nights! Carla was super helpful in suggesting locations and restaurants to visit, and helped the great city of Porto become even better!
Very nice place, modern conveniences and very clean.  Good walkable location.  Follow directions to find it and enjoy your stay!

Really nice place to stay when visiting Porto, close to everything. Carla’s son Fabio gave us a really warm welcome. He introduced us to a really useful guide he made with all things worth visiting in Porto. Super great 👍

Carla was a wonderfully responsive host that went out of the way to make sure all our questions were fully answered and done so in a timely way. When we return the area we will surely check her availability first!

Lovely place, we enjoyed our stay, highly recommend!! I will absolutely be looking for availability at this place next time Im in Porto. Everything is was smooth from check in to check out. Location was perfect, a walking distance from many places you’d want to see in Porto. Thank you Carla and Fabio for the everything.
Nice place for exploring Porto. Close to city center and most things which are of interest, even on the other side of the river are walkable within 30 minutes.
Had a lovely stay. Great location, super close to everything. Apartment was very nice and host Carla was fab! The only downside is the seagulls 😂

Carla and her sister Sarah were super helpful and speak great English!. They have a little book of recommendations. I had a problem finding the place as there are 2 #3’s on the street. I sat outside the first one a few minutes before calling Carla and she had her sister come find me!  After that everything was a breeze. Lots of good recommendations and super friendly hosts. It was my birthday, so Carla had a nice bottle of Douro wine as a gift! Loved Porto and the great walkability. Bring good walking shoes!!! Thanks so much for all your help and great positive attitudes, Carla and Sarah.

My fiancé and I absolutely loved staying at Carla’s apartment. The apartment was everything we could have wanted and more. Very clean, had great AC, clean, and very comforting bed and pillows. Carla was a great host she was very sweet and quick with responses. Quick walk to the river and has a bunch of restaurants within 1-2 min walk, easy to get around Porto with taxi, uber or public transportation, and not more than 10-15 min walk to all the shops near by. We enjoyed our stay and will absolutely book with Carla next time we are in Porto. We highly recommend.

The apartment is exactly as pictured, in a perfect location within walking distance of all the major sights, and very well equipped. Carla and her sister Sarah are lovely and all communication was seamless. We had a great stay!
Clara was a great host, speak English fluently. The apartment was clean and comfortable. I would recommend, staying here.
Carla's place was as advertised and great value for money.  She was super responsive and we enjoyed our stay.

Great to walk along the river into the centre, or up
The hill to some great restaurants. The property is very clean, beds were extremely comfortable and we liked the area with a cafe and shop very near by
Beautiful space, walkable to the river, and responsive host. Also, plus for having air conditioning, very rare in Europe but always appreciated especially when traveling during the hot summer months
Great stay overall! Amazing, scenic location. Carla was very responsive. And the place was clean and stocked with things like soap, towels, and even good coffee!

Beautiful place to stay ! Very clean and well located
Its good to be aware of the church bell that rings quite loud often but it gives a charm !

It was great stay. Location is close to the main attractions so it was easy to get around. The room was exactly that was shown on the photos and everything was pretty clean. The host was very friendly and recommended few places which we tried and it was good! Overall, it was well worth the trip ☺️
Away from the busy noisy streets and a short 12 min walk to the center.   A very nice renovated old building with a unique charm.

The apartment was excellent, everything that we hoped for. Checking in and checking out was simple. Carla was very friendly and communicative during our stay and answered any questions we had. The area is quiet and a little distance from the main area of restaurants and shops but still only a few minutes walk to get there... and very close to the beautiful Duoro River. Highly recommended! We will contact Carla again the next time we visit!

Very good place, with a small private backyard for your breakfast or diner, two separate rooms with their own bathroom and it's only 3 minutes from the metro that goes to the center of Porto. Great place and very good host.

The place was cozy and in the quiet area of Porto. The centre can get really noisy so this is a big plus. It is easy to commute to the centre by metro. The apartment had everything we needed and Rosalia was a very helpful host. Overall a lovely stay. Thanks!

Rosalia’s house was great, my family & I really enjoyed our stay. She was a very welcoming host and communication with her was easy. The place has a small & lovely backyard, was overall well-arranged & we felt right at home. Looking fwd to returning to Porto again!

Place away from the hustling of city. Well equipped and amazingly supportive hosts. They mostly oblige to requests, if they can. There is a Mini Preco at 200-300 mts and Marquês metro station is walkable. Just one thing, the TVs are mostly small monitors and not smart TVs. They do show all cable TV channels. The support from hosts is exceptional and she is just  message away.
Great location, spacious apartment, easy check-in. Excellent communication with the host, we've received great tips.
Perfect location to everything. Our spot was quiet with beautiful rooftops views. Our teenager enjoyed having the pullout for his space. Very clean and comfortable.

Very nice and accommodating place, close enough to the city center but far enough to be quiet and peaceful. Very modern apartment with new amenities. We were very happy to use the nespresso machine and drink our morning coffee on the quiet balcony.
Host was friendly and hospitable. All in all a great place to stay in Porto.

The house is near Trinidade metro station and also the city center, so you can visit the city by walk.
Moises speaks only Portuguese but we always find a way to understand each other.
The house is very nice and modern, the room is very comfortable and everything was clean.
We absolutely recommend it!

Moisés was a very decent host. He always was helpful to us and the other guests. The whole flat is very clean and luxuriously equipped. It is close to the centre of Porto. But the traffic calms down early enough to ensure a gentle sleep. We are glad that Moisés shared his flat with us!

I, my husband and my puppy stayed here to go to seminar for my husband.
It was very close to the seminar place and downtown of Porto as well.
The host was kind and the house was clean too.
We will visit here again soon!

When we arrived, Moises (and his translator) were very welcoming, took their time showing us the apartment and its amenities, and sent us locations that we should visit in and around Porto. He also left us a beautiful bowl of fruit for us to eat. We had a great time in Porto and really enjoyed the area we stayed in, which is directly across the street from Igreja de Lapa, a beautiful church. Within a ten minute walk (downhill) there are multiple restaurants and markets for you to visit.
Our journey in Porto was amazing! Gonçalo's flat is perfect: very well located, clean, well-arranged. And to welcome us, Gonçalo offered us some delicious pastries from Porto! :)

We had a fantastic couple of nights at Gonçalo’s place. Really well located, clean and comfortable and he gave us some really helpful hints about what to do and where to go in Porto. Would definitely recommend this apartment and stay again!
Great apartment, modern, clean, and responsive host.  Thanks for a great stay in Porto.

The appartment is small but it is enough for 2 people. The location is really good. It is close to Sao Bento station, yet no too busy. There is a nearby square with places to eat and drink. I'll definitely recommend it.

Great location, easy access to the apartment without having to wait for anyone. There is grocery store around the corner. Communication was easy and prompt. Thank you Goncalo I enjoyed staying at your place.

The flat is simple but well kitted out impeccably clean and the area is quiet.
There’s a lot of building work around, but that is the same in most areas of downtown porto.
We would recommend this accomodation very much. Good location, easy check in and check out, tidy,...
Great space in good location! We would definitely recommend to anyone who wants to pop in to Porto for few days!
Super clean and cosy apartment. The location was perfect and it made our stay easy. Definitely going back there next time I go to Porto !
The flat is in the center of Porto. It is perfect for a family with 2 small kids like us.
Great stay, Location is perfect when you want to visit the city and explore! Also pretty quiet even though it's very central.

Excellent location, accurate to the listing and well-stocked. My only concern would be the lack of air conditioning. This absolutely was not a problem for me because I had terrific October weather, but it might get pretty hot in there in the middle of the summer.
Staying here was perfect! Close to everything, not bad with a 11 month old in tow because they have an elevator 🙌🏼 great space for our week in Porto! Thank you :)

Great place super close to main part of Porto. Minimal issues such as a coffee machine but no supply of coffee pods, as well as no tea towel for kitchen and a broken blind. Otherwise, great facilities and all you need for a stay :)
Beautiful flat in Porto. Calm and clean. Sofia is a great host, super hospitality and with practical information. Very nice neighbourhood in Porto, in calm.

Very nice apartment, cosy and colorful decoration. Perfect for a couple. Very well located in a quiet area in front of a square with a beautiful view, but also very central. But the best is Ana and her family, super nice they gave us lots of tips and took some time to discuss about local wines.. We had great time and we will recommend all our friends to stay there for their next trip in Porto!

Ana was really kind and helpful from the moment we booked the place to the checkout.  She gave great suggestions on what to do in Porto and where to eat, even helping with making reservations on our behalf.  The stay was comfortable  and the location close to most attractions and fantastic food.  Really enjoyed ourselves.  Thanks so much!!
Ana Sofias place is very cosy and we really liked the area and the panoramic view when you walk out the door.

We found Ana Sofia's place cute, clean, friendly, and quite close to the center. The appartment comes with a court that is sourrounded by walls, yet cozy due to the stylish tiles that are so typical for Portugal. Ana Sofia was very available, friendly and had a couple of nice tips about the area and nearby authentic restaurants, which are well worth checking out! All in all, we really enjoyed our stay!

It was a great pleasure to stay at Ana’s apartment. With its own kitchen, living room, bedroom and terrace there was everything we needed. The location of the flat is great - great view and everything in walking distance! Loved it. Obrigada, Ana!
Ana Sofia was really welcoming and helpful. A great host and the apartment was in a wonderful location. Highly recommended.

Ana Sofia's place is modern and stylish. It is conveniently located in a part of town where you can walk to most downtown areas in less than 20 minutes.  Ana Sofia is a great host; though we didn't get to meet in person, she made sure we were all set and checked in with us a couple times during our stay.  We had our 14-month old with us and she was very accommodating and provided all the toddler things for us (crib, high chair, toddler utensils, etc.).  Since we stayed over New Year's, we didn't plan well and didn't make any dinner reservations (most places are either closed or fully booked) and Ana Sofia and her husband went out of their way to call all these restaurants to make sure we had a place to eat that night.  We loved their hospitality and will stay at their place again if we ever visit Porto again.

Ana Sofia’s flat in Miragaia is in a great location to visit all boroughs in Porto, the borough, Miragaia, has a unique atmosphere in which past, present and future magically blend. Her flat is well equipped, comfortable and has a stylish touch. Ana Sofia’s timely replies to my messages confirm that she is a highly realible host. Highly recommended.
Quiet location close to Porto's major sights and train station. Loved having breakfast on the back patio. We had a lovely time and felt at home.

Ana Sofia’s apartment was everything we could have wanted. The location was especially great. It was right in front of the Passeio da Virtudes which is where we witnessed some of the most beautiful sunsets we ever saw. The park was full of life, especially on weekends. A great place to hang out with lots of locals, you really get the feeling of what it is like to live in Porto.
Ana Sofia also had great recommendations for restaurants, which we greatly appreciated. We ate some great local food while in Porto. She was also there if we needed everything and it was very easy to communicate together.
Thanks again Ana Sofia!!
This is a truly lovely place in a great neighborhood. Close to the train station, as well as several must-see sites in Porto. A definite must-book!

Ana Sophia's flat was lovely for our weekend stay! The apartment is perfect for 2 people, and it has a little chic patio. It's very well located too. Highly recommend for young travelers looking for a good location and comfortable, simple accommodations.
We had a lovely stay in Porto. Ana Sofia is a very good host, she provided us with great suggestions.

Ana Sofia is an exceptional host who makes her guests feel just like at home. She had great tips about Porto and recommended some wonderful restaurants. Her apartment is very stylish yet cosy and has the most comfortable bed. Look no further when choosing for a place.

Beautiful apartment well located in Porto, close to great restaurants and across from a park with sunset views. Ana Sofia is an accommodating and gracious host, providing recommendations on nearby food and activities, and always available if any questions. I would highly recommend staying here!

Anna is so sweet and good helper for my trip.
Location is good location. We can use any transportation.
Thank you so much.
Great location! This is a perfect spot for visiting the city, but just be aware that there is no air conditioning so it can get hot in the apartment.
Cute apartment right in the city centre! Location is amazing for a city trip. Host is super nice and communication was super easy :)

Excellent stay. Ana went above and beyond by providing thorough recommendations for our stay in Porto. The place is comfortable and in a good location. If we come back to Porto, we will try to stay here again.
Great location and Ana Sophia was a very accommodating host. She gave us a great intro to the city with lots of ideas on sights to see.
We had a lovely stay! The location is great and the flat had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.

Our stay in Porto hosted by Ana Sofia was the highlight of our 2-week Portugal trip! Despite our train delay, Ana warmly welcomed us and her thoughtfulness made it fantastic. She provided detailed info about the apartment and neighborhood, and her Porto recommendation book was a gem with the best restaurants, places, and activities. The cozy apartment, above the waterfront, had breathtaking views. We fell in love with Porto and can't wait to return. Thank you, Ana Sofia, for an unforgettable experience. Highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Porto! Thanks again!

We really enjoyed how close Ana Sofia’s flat was to everything we wanted to do and all the places we wanted to eat! If it wasn’t within walking distance, getting an Uber was extremely easy! The space was great for us to spread out and not be cramped getting ready or relaxing after being out all day. Ana Sofia met us at the flat to give us the keys and gave us extra time to recommend things to do and places to eat.
Was perfect for our Porto trip. The location is fantastic. The apartment is very well thought out and has very nice personal touches. We really enjoyed our stay!

Our stay at Ana Sofia's apartment was absolutely wonderful! The location couldn't be better – right next to a scenic park and just a short walk from the city centre, combining convenience with beautiful views. The private patio was a delightful bonus, making it ideal for us especially since we were travelling with our infant.
Ana Sofia was an exceptional host. She welcomed us in person (even accommodating an earlier check-in) and took the time to walk us through every detail of the apartment. Her personalised tips on where to go and what to see in the area were incredibly helpful and tailored to our interests.
I highly recommend staying here if you're looking for a comfortable and convenient base to explore the city!
Ana Sofia met us at the apartment and spent time with us describing all the best attractions.  Couldn’t have been nicer.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Ana Sofia's apartment. The apartment is as pictured and very comfortable for our group of 3 adults. The bathroom and kitchen were spotless. The patio area was such a treat! The neighborhood was so charming, with a park for watching a perfect sunset in the evening, lots of restaurants, bars and cafes within walking distance. Major points of attraction are within walking distance. I would love to stay here again one day, and highly recommend it for you.

Ana Sofias place was comfortable and clean. The kitchen was well equipped and fine for cooking the odd meal. To avoid mosquitoes coming in we kept the patio doors shut however there is a modern fan to keep you cool. The beds big and comfy although I’m not a fan of memory mattresses as I find them too warm.
I liked being in a lively area and once inside any sounds were not heard.
We walked everywhere as this was the perfect spot to do so.
Ana Sofia was a perfect host and the apartment is only 3 minutes from the bus stop if you go the right way! I’d recommend getting a taxi from the airport though.

Alina's place is on very good location.
Ponte Luis and Se cathedral is few steps away.
I will definitly recomend for short stay in Porto.

We had a nice stay. Nice appartement, very clean, Well furnished, very convenient for 2 persons. Close To restaurants and metro and near To the places to visit. You can also walk to the places of interest. Thanks Miguel for your warm welcome, for the biscuits and jam and for your availability. We definitely recommand!

Miguel is a great host. He's always here to help and gives great advice. The location of the appartement is excellent. You can easily walk to most tourist sites or use the subway, and it's quiet. The appartement is also very clean, and there's everything you need during your stay.
It was our pleasure to meet Miguel and stay in his apartment! Everything was perfect and we would definitely come again.

I would definitely recommend this airbnb to my friends and family if they come to Porto. The location is really great, close to everything. In the flat you have all the neccessary things  you need and the communication is easy with Miguel.

This was a perfect apartment for travelling solo in Porto. Miguel was incredibly helpful and waited for me to arrive. He provided me with great suggestions to make best use of my limited time in Porto and it was a great experience. The apartment is perfectly located! Thanks for a lovely stay.

I'd like to thank Patrícia and Miguel for being absolutely amazing and accommodating hosts. Everything went smoothly - response time was remarkably fast, check-in was flexible' and any questions were answered swiftly and accurately.
Porto is a beautiful city, and with this AirBnB you get a centrally located and comfortable apartment which lets you make the most of your time here. Can only recommend!
You can’t beat the location! Incredibly central. The space itself was a bit small, but as advertised, and worked great since I wasn’t planning to spend much time in the apartment.
Great location and space! Very clean and well equipped. They also have a ground fan which is very nice to counteract the heat in the summer! Overall amazing stay
Cozy and very well located! stayed for the weekend and it was pretty quiet during the night compared to other places I have stayed at. I recommend it. The host was very caring and helpful!

The perfect location for a stay in Porto, really close to everything, but also in a quiet street, so great for light sleepers! Really nice & helpful staff
It was a very pleasant stay!
Good value and check-in process was very smooth. Great location right by the Sao Bento station.

Excellent location with Sao Bento station a minute walk away, very friendly and easy check in. Some things like the bathroom could be updated to make it more comfortable to use, e.g. fixing toilet seat and replacing the bin with a faulty lid, however, for a few days' stay it was still fine.

Best of the best!!!! I really recommend for everyone! Everything is perfect. Luis and Fatima are so kind! All is made with the soul. The house is placed in eco zone, the air is so fresh! Every morning we find a perfect breakfast with homemade jam and so on. For my birthday they cooked me a homemade cake. It was so pleasant! We were in cold time but there is a fireplace in the house and it was perfect for temperature and our disposition. We wanted to come in the house earlier to spend the time there. Luis was ready to help us in everything! Perfect! Thank you one more time! We will be back for sure and will recommend to all our friends!

This little cottage is absolutely wonderful. We have been touring Portugal for three weeks and this stay was the most comfortable and charming of all our accommodation.
The area was a real surprise - we didn’t know anything about Vale de Cambra, but thought it might be a good spot to visit Coimbra and Porto from. In the end, we liked the area so much we just explored around there. It’s great for hiking.
The house is cosy, well-equipped, quiet and has amazing views. We lit the fire in the evenings, Luis and his wife provided a delicious breakfast in the mornings, and the beds are extremely comfortable.
Thanks so much for a wonderful stay, Luis!

Our stay with Luis was a wonderful experience. Luis was very prompt and helpful with our needs. Both he and his wife go out of their way to make their place comfortable and enjoyable.  We hope to go back in the future.

This place is a little gem in a hidden village. We had wet weather which didn’t matter as we wanted to relax.
The breakfast that was provided was amazing alongside the gorgeous home made treats
Thankyou Louise and Fátima everything was amazing, your little gem has a special place in our heart. 💕💕

We spend a wonderful two nights in Cabanelas. Luis, our host, has been great. He took the time to tour us through the village and its orchards. He supplied us with fruit, fresh bread in the morning, and pastries. The house was cozy, very clean, and comfortable. We visited the "escadinhas da paiva"  and the 516 Arouca suspension bridge nearby using the Cabanelas county house as our base. Great location in the Northern Portuguese countryside. We highly recommend!

This was an amazing place. Its so well appointed with everything you need. Including fresh bread being delivered ever morning. And the freshest water you've ever tasted.
Luis took us around the small village and even showed us his parents small Farm and gave us fresh fruit from the farm
The cottage is perfectly clean, and all the supplies you will need.
The views from the place ate stunning.
We will definitely stay again if we are ever in that area.

This is a great location - living in a beautifully restored cottage high in the mountains. Luis is a wonderful host and really takes care of his guests. We would happily return here for a nother holiday.

Luis is a very kind host. The breakfast was delicious and we enjoyed our stay very much.
Thank you Fatima and Luis

we spent 3 calm days in Cabanelas. You can do nice walks directly starting from the village without using the car. It is an amazing area. Luís and Fatima are very friendly and helpful, Fatima's cakes are very delicious ( we have got  them every day in the morning together with fresh baps and also fruits which grow in the lovely garden)

Luis and Fatima are the perfect hosts. You'll get not only a beautiful authentic Portuguese house with a fireplace and wooden furniture, but you also get a full unforgettable experience. Breakfast with fresh bread and homemade pastries, crystal clear and tasty water from the source, and a calm village with a mountain view. It's a tranquility base for tired souls. Book this house if available, and you won't ever regret it.
Luis is friendly, accommodating, and responsive. We left early though due to local fires, and noise from a dog and roosters just next to the house.

I have stayed almost 20 Airbnb from all Over the world, Patio 25 must be the most unforgettable one. The best location, the best view and the coziest apartment!!! The view is just take my breath away and I will definitely come back!
This is a beautiful studio, with breathtaking view to wake up to each morning. Clean and comfortable, great location.
it is a whole apartment with many rooms so it may help to make sure whicy room you are getting and if the pictures put up are the same as what you get

Perfect location, view, interior or something.
But there were lots of ants nearby sink in kitchen, except that, everything was excellent :)
One of the best views of Porto, and the apartment was in great condition. Would definitely stay here again.
This was the most magnificent place - the photos tell the truth ! It is an amazing location, all the comforts of home , extremely clean. Could not recommend more !

Great place to stay!  Exactly as described-clean and modern!  Air-con was welcome after a day of walking in 35+ degree heat.  View was wonderful-opposite side of river from Porto, at foot of Dom Luis bridge.  Patio just outside was huge and a great spot for watching the sunset.  Only drawback was work on the bridge-awakened by power tools each morning, but certainly nothing to do with the listing itself.
We had a lovely stay at Gabriela's. She was so very kind and helpful, providing us with local tips and information when we arrived. The apartment was very clean. We would love to come back!
loved the place it was lovely and cosy everything was great, a very good communication I really recommend it.

Merc’s place is the best!! We came here on a girls trip and it was everything we needed, plus more! We were greeted by Mariana at arrival and she showed us to our room on the 6 floor. The room was spectacular with amazing views of the city. She provided us with a map of the city and circled every location that we should visit. During our whole visit, Mariana kept in touch with us, asking us if we were having fun or needed anything. We loved Porto, and can’t wait to come up again!!!

Excellent location, could not be more central than that. Communication was perfect, easy check-in and plenty or recommendations for places to visit. On a downside, at least to our liking, the bed is too "bouncy" so if you move at night time the other person can feel it.  Dining area is stylish and looks modern but for us it was uncomfortable as chairs are too heavy to move and uncomfortable.  So overall it's a good apartment in excellent location but few comfort things and "feel like home feeling" for me were missing.
This apartment is perfect in every way. Great communication, amazing location and stunning views of the city.

Super comfortable and spacious for 4 in a very modern and beautiful space. Excellent location to everything but not too noisy. Food market next door with excellent Port selection but it was closed on Sunday. Exceptionally clean and great ambiance.
Really helpful host and brilliant location for an airbnb,  you can reach the river in 2 minutes! It made our stay in Porto really fun

Lovely apartment in a great location. Very clean. Good communication with host who also organised transfers to and from the airport and stored luggage as we had a late flight. We really enjoyed our stay.

Terrific experience! Easy check in and great communication from host. Clean, excellent location, great shower, and comfortable beds. Would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to anyone. It is so well located to all the sights and there are many good restaurants nearby. Very walkable.
This place has it all. Great location in the middle of the city, cool apartment well equipped. Communication went very well with Merc and Dani. Thank you so much for a pleasant stay!
The location is the best of Porto ande the guest was amazing. Their attention was incredible and they fix every problem we had. We will come to this apartment for sure. 😍

Great communication, apartment and location! Highly recommend!
Thank you for sharing your lovely apartment with us.
This was the perfect location for all that we wanted to do and was easy to get to public transportation. Great view of the rooftops and really cute and updated inside. We would stay again!

Simply fabulous! The apartment is very comfortable, very clean, well-equipped and close to everything. I stayed two times in this apartment with friend and with my family and both times were outstanding.
Wonderful location walking distance to everything. Grocery store right next to building. Clear check in instructions. Nice apartment with all needed amenities. Responsive host. Great stay.

This was an amazing stay. It’s the perfect location, and the apartment was exactly as pictured! It was clean and comfortable, and Merc was a wonderful host. He was a great communicator and quick to answer questions. Would definitely recommend!
Great central location to the river and bridge and main tourist sites. Would stay again. Wonderful responsive hosts with lots of recommendations!

We really enjoyed our stay with our host Eva & Dani.
The apartment is beautiful and the location is spot on.
They communicated with us throughout our stay with great recommendations and were always prompt with our enquiries.
They were very flexible with our checking in and checking out times which really helped us as to just drop our bags when we arrived.
If you looking for a place to stay in Porto please do not hesitate to book Merc’s listing as it’s in a fantastic location and you can meander round Porto.
Thank you again for a wonderful stay and we will be back! x

We visited Porto in July and stayed 3 nights in the apartment. It was a great location!!!
Porto is amazing, we spend great time. Hope to come back!
I will definetely recommend this apartment to my friends and family.
Best location I can imagine. Beautiful apartment had everything we needed and the view from the apartment was so nice and inspiring.
My family of four had a lovely stay here! The location was perfect and the space met our needs beautifully.

Excellent location and really beautiful views of the city by the windows.
The flat is really clean and the equipments are quality.
Good for 4 people.
Nice shower as well.
Autonomous entry and exit which is well organized.
We could not have picked a better location. Very close to city center and the river. Very fun and walkable. We hope to return there soon!

Pros: great location, clean, presents as pictures and described
Con: we had difficultly blocking the sunlight in the mornings to sleep later.
Lovely apartment in a perfect location, absolutely perfect for a few days in Porto- so close to everything but also completely quiet when you close the windows. Great to have the aircon too!

We had a great stay at Mercs place. Such a wonderful location with a lovely view. Everything you could need within walking distance. Hosts were the best, responsive and gave us some excellent tips on local
restaurants. Comfy beds, powerful shower and spotlessly clean. We would book again if we return to this beautiful city.

The apartment was perfect! Close to the river, fabulous restaurants, music, everything was walkable. The host was always helpful and friendly. Great rooftop view. Cozy, comfortable. There is a little grocery next door that has amenities and coffee pods. I would recommend this lovely place to anyone!

Really enjoyed our stay here. Location was excellent for tourists. Minutes from the river front and surrounded by restaurants with several small grocery stores on the same block. Access was easy with excellent pictures to guide you so you knew exactly what you were looking for. Merc answered the few questions we had promptly. The unit was nice and spacious for the 3 of us and the kitchen was well stocked. Furniture and beds were comfortable. Loved the view of the city from the windows and being able to hear the music from the local entertainers (which stopped promptly at 10pm each night) With windows closed we heard very little. Would definitely recommend and stay again.
Great place. Neighborhood is walkable (up some hills) to lots of attractions. Apartment worked great for us. We would highly recommend.
The location is extremely convenient. There are shops, restaurants and everything you need just out the door. This is. Beautiful place and perfect for exploring Porto.  We loved it.

The apartment is perfectly located, looks just as good as you expect from the pictures, and is very clean. All sightseeing, dining, and shopping is very close to your doorstep. The service was great as well. We arrived earlier than expected and Silvia did everything to make sure that we could enter the apartment earlier than expected. Both the great service and the lovely apartment make exploring the beautiful city of Porto a comfortable and relaxed experience.

The apartment is well equipped and clean. Situated in the middle of the center you can go easy and visit Porto.
Only the communication with Silvia is not that easy.
The tax you have to pay as mentioned you don’t have to pay at all.
With high expectations from the reviews we'd read about this apartment it didn't disappoint. Gorgeous space and great location.

Great communication and great location. Well laid out and comfortable apartment. Drawbacks were the coffee machine and tv were not working (despite comments being left by previous guests) and the people and traffic noise from outside during sleeping hours.

My mother and I loved this Air BnB. The apartment had alot of books and guides to Porto, which we read and used to pick some sights to see! The apartment was clean, and smelled clean which we appreciated. There was a nespresso maker which we also loved having. Location was perfect too. We couldn't figure out the TV, but having the large table and gorgeous chairs was a lovely touch. We stayed in, drank wine and enjoyed everything about this AirBnB!

it's a nice appartement to stay
with as best part it's location al the tourist attractions are in walking distance. the host is also really nice when we arrived he gave us some really good tips for site seeing and eating
Lovely stay at the apt. I love the area we are in. Apt has very modern design and the building seems to be renovated. I would recommend my friends if they are coming to Porto.

The host is warm and welcoming. Very thoughtful and brought me a wine for my birthday as well as recommended restaurants around the apartment. The apartment is well located in the heart of life and activities of Porto. An easy walk to most Porto tourist areas.  It is clean and looks exactly like in the pictures. The kitchen and bathroom are well equipped.  We really love our stay. Thank you so much

Possibly my most favorite Airbnb I've ever stayed. It's exactly as pictured. In the most perfect location in the entire city. Not too busy of a street yet near all the things. Train station is closer. Water is a quick walk. Silky soft sheets and fluffy towels. Spotless clean!! Host was very helpful and even booked a reliable and affordable car at 3am to the airport for me. The sound proofing is amazing. With windows closed you can't hear a street noise at night. Although the breeze was nice with them open during the day!

Very nice apartment in a very beautiful part of Porto! Absolutely stunning! The place is extremely comfortable and has all the amenities. Being in an apartment building, there is noise from the other units that you will have to get accustomed to.
Great, hip little apartment in a perfect location to see Porto! We loved it and how walkable it was to everything in the city.

On arrival the host (Pedro) met us outside apartment, apartment was exactly like shown in the photos, beautiful apartment and in a prime location, within walking distance from all shops, bars and restaurants.
Would highly recommend for anyone looking at visiting Porto.
Excellent and clean accommodations exactly as described with very responsive hosts that meet you at the door for check in. Great location and walkable!

Perfect location.  We were able to walk the entire city and explore every item on our checklist.  The unit was pristine and has so many food and shopping options close by.  Easy to get to the river, cathedral, stadiums, ext.  Would highly recommend and will stay again!
Great location - very noisy but we knew that going in so brought earplugs. The place is beautiful and well furnished. Was a bit hot without aircon but we managed.

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto. The location of this apartment was great. The elevator is definitely a bonus. Our biggest complaint is the size of the apartment and just nowhere to put your stuff. It wasn’t horrible but maybe even a few shelves in the bathroom would help.
This was a wonderful stay! Such a neat location, very comfortable and enjoyable. Hope to be back!
Great apartment. Lovely and warm for winter. Walkable to the harbour and many tourist sites. Big TV was an enjoyment and every detail was perfect.
Really enjoyed our stay in the heart of Porto. Would absolutely book again on another visit to the city.

Jorge's apartment is nice and functional, conveniently located and at a very reasonable price. We had a very good stay at his place. Also, Jorge was super responsive to messages and sending us tips to make our stay in Porto an even greater experience - we truly appreciated that! So I would definitely recommend staying at his flat for a week-end in this great city!
Jorge’s apartment has perfect location,close to centre and both main train and bus station. Apartment was clean an well furnished. Jorge is awesome host who provided lot of tips &advices.

The location of the apartment was perfect-literally a 2 minute walk from the metro! Jorge was great and was able to meet me so I could drop my stuff off before the place was ready. There is a lot within walking distance-restaurants, shopping, etc. We opted to walk everywhere for the most part and it was easy to get an Uber super early on the morning to the airport. The kitchen had all of the essentials and having a washer is a major plus! The neighborhood felt very safe. I would definitely stay again should I return to Porto! Thanks Jorge =]

Very clean and comfortable flat. This location is well located for visiting Porto.
Jorge is a very nice host.
I recommend this apartment

Jorge was an amazing host. He was rapid on the communication and timed it so that he was at the apartment for my check-in. When we met, he asked if it was my first time in Porto and provided a map where he noted different things I should go see and tourist must does (like Francesina from Cafe Santiago).
After day one, Jorge sent me a message to check in to see if I needed anything. I was just about to head out and it was raining so in a stretch request I asked if he had one and he had someone drop one off within a short time frame. This allowed me to still head out and saved me purchasing an umbrella.
I would definitely stay again. Thank you Jorge for being a great host!
Jorge's place is just as described and had everything we needed. A nice location with local cafes and shops close by and more tourist/central amenities 15 walk away. Jorge was a great host.
Excellent host, went above and beyond to help me out when I had a problem and needed assistance. Great place to stay at and excellent location!

We really really liked our stay at Jorge's flat!
The flat is located in an amazing neighborhood, everything is nearby and in walking distance (subway, supermarkets, bakeries, self-laundry service, restaurants, city center and attractions).
We had a wonderful time in Porto and would definitely stay there again. (We felt like locals and very welcome in this beautiful city.) In particular, we loved the small private terrace in which we could enjoy our breakfast in the sunlight. It was the perfect start in our day. :-)
Furthermore, Jorge is a fantastic host. The communication with him was great, he was supportive and responded to our questions very fast.
Definitely a recommendation. :-)
Large place with everything you need in a great location! Host was extremely welcoming and responsive. Would be happy to return in the near future.

Very highly recommended! Jorge was an impeccable host - one of the best I've encountered on this platform. His communication was exceptional from the moment I booked until our departure from Porto. Throughout the experience, he was available and attentive to my queries and requests, kindly accommodating our early morning arrival time, and going above and beyond to schedule a departure COVID test on our behalf (his help with this was invaluable and took a load of stress off my shoulders). The flat is ideally situated; close enough to the historic tourist centre and train station, but just far enough from them to give us some peace and quiet at night. Lots of great restaurants and groceries situated nearby which we took advantage of. The flat had everything we needed to feel at home, was cozy, clean and contemporary. I will definitely stay here again when I return to Porto.

The place was perfect for our month stay in Porto. It's in a perfect location with a short walk down to the busy area with a shop right around the corner. The place was a perfect size and had all the amenities we needed to feel at home. Diego was extremely helpful and easy to get a hold of, if needed. I'd recommend this place to anyone and we'd stay again!

Diego is a walking billboard for Airbnb. I say so because Airbnb was started so that people can travel and live at other people's homes and meet and make wonderful friends. Well, my family and I have a new and amazing friend in Diego in Porto. He welcomed us with warmth and a genuine smile.  He provided several useful tips to see and do things in Porta, which we appreciated very much. So much of Airbnb has become very impersonal and hope that Airbnb takes a page our of Diego's style and asks owners to take a personal interest in welcoming & meeting guests. We wish him the best and we will be back.

Diego was very welcoming and helped orient us when we arrived by showing us maps of the city and giving us a list of local recommendations. He was also very responsive throughout our stay. The space was cozy and clean and we would 100% stay again. Thanks, Diego!

Diego was a fantastic host, Beautiful clean appartment with a short walk into the city centre. Great value for money and great reccomendations to avoid tourist traps with beautiful restaurants. Much appreciated Diego!!!

The apartment was exactly as described and very comfortable. The terrace is a great bonus for sitting outside and enjoying the atmosphere. The location offers excellent direct metro access to and from Porto's Francisco Sá Carneiro Airport, just 100 meters from Campo 24 de Agosto station. It's close to a few supermarkets with fruit and vegetable markets on the same road. In 10 to 15 minutes, you can walk to the city center and experience everything Porto has to offer. I recommend the apartment and would happily stay again.

We had a brilliant stay! The apartment is close to the centre, very comfortable and spotless. Diego is a great host. He responded promptly, was extremely kind to accommodate our requests and shared a wealth of suggestions and tips - the best one was surely Augusto, his favourite restaurant, which was surely one of the highlights of our visit to Porto.  Thank you, Diego!

Andre is a good host. He responds quickly and gives lots of tips.
The flat is nice, clean and exactly as shown in the pictures.
We really liked the location of the flat. It was in a clean, quiet and less touristic area.
It was also very close to the public transport, walking distance from Gaia and the touristic areas of the city. We really loved the fact that it was right next to Ponte Luís I bridge. We got to enjoy the beautiful view from the top of bridge every day.
For us the house was perfect. The stairs inside the house can be tricky for some people. I would not recommend this place for elderly or people with toddlers or small children.
Super apartment. Andre was a great host, who advised us on where to go, eat etc. Thank you!

Wonderful location! And Andre is such a great host, he was always available to offer tips and advice on Porto and was really responsive. The apartment was clean, bright, and spacious. The bedrooms were perfect and cozy to unwind and rest after busy days sightseeing and touring. Would definitely recommend!

The apartment is really beautiful in a lovely building. Everything was clean as an hotel. The location is ideal close to the bridge and the old city. Also we appreciate the kindness of André, the host, who is very available. I highly recommand this apartment

We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment. Everything was as expected and the communication with André was very good.
The Apartment is well located.
We would book it again if we come back to Porto one day.

Beautiful space, great AC, well located, very clean and spacious, especially loved the hammock
Would love a smart TV in future
Thank you for allowing us to stay the decor and the place was nice and affordable and the host was extremely responsive and ready to help to whenever we needed it.
We had an excellent time in Porto! The apartment was perfect and everything we wished for. Exactly as stated and in an excellent location. Loved it! Thank you for having us

We had a fantastic 3-night stay here! It was the perfect size for our family of four. Andre was super friendly, greeting us upon arrival, giving us a tour of the apartment, and offering lots of local recommendations, maps, and ideas. He was always extremely responsive and helpful.
The entire apartment was very clean, and the beds were really comfortable. Our kids loved the "hammock room".
The location is excellent. Very close to a metro stop. You can walk over the bridge in 10 minutes.
We highly recommend this place!
Honestly can’t give enough praise to this place, couldn’t have asked for more, highly highly recommend this apartment and location
The location is great and accessible to most attractions. Pictures were quite accurate and the place is well kept. Plus, the host is very responsive and easy to reach.
Communication was amazing! We needed an early check in and we were very well accommodated. It was a quick night trip. Parking was a plus and the beds were cozy enough. Thanks for the stay!

This is a wonderful place to stay. Beautiful building, very tastefully decorated with great amenities. Everywhere in Porto and beyond is easily accessible as just a few minutes from the Metro. Most parts of Porto is possible on foot, it’s a lovely interesting walk down hill to the river. Highly recommend for location and also the helpful, thoughtful hosts who made sure our stay was perfect. We will be back I’m sure!

Apartment was clean and modern. There are everything for short or long stay. Location is perfect.
Marcia is kind and perfect host! For me it was a pleasure to communicate with her ☺

From the blue tile facade, central location to the clever modern use of space, this was the perfect base for our two nights in Porto. Marcia was a fab host. When we needed something on our first night, she popped over to drop it off. Even though we insisted that we could wait till the next day. Highly recommend this apartment.

Flat is in the heart of Porto old town. Location is just perfect! Almost all the attractions are in walking distance. Place is very clean and lovely. We really enjoyed our stay and Márcia is a great host! I would definitely recommend her place to stay if you’re planning to visit Porto.
It's a cool space but I did bump my head a few times! The views are worth it and the location would be hard to beat. The host communicated quickly and helped us with a challenge on check out day.

Marcia's place corresponds to the indications given.
It is in an excellent position, easy to reach and close to the station, buses and the metro.
The accommodation is very clean and welcoming.
Marcià is present thanks to his
excellent availability in communicating.
In the vicinity of the accommodation you can find everything you need: restaurants, bars, shops and the historic center is easily accessible on foot.
For us it was a good base for our vacation. If we were to return to Porto we would like to return to Marcia.
Awesome stay at the apartment, it was beautiful and clean. Can’t recommend it enough, plus Marcia was a great host and incredibly helpful!
The apartment is very lovely, full of light, very well located, and fully equipped. Check-in was effortless and Marcia made sure we had everything we needed. I would definitely recommend this place.

Márcia’s apartment is very well located, she was very quick to answer and helped us to get a table at a restaurant I really wanted to try ! We were happy to see all the baby stuff to make our son confortable.

Incredible communication, perfect location. super clean and super easy.
I can't fault them, 5 stars does not do it justice!

Márcia was very nice and the place was pretty great overall. It was a bit cramped for the 3 that were staying there and the windows were very thin so construction and people woke us throughout the night every night. overall prime location though

An absolutely wonderful stay! Such a cute apartment in a great location. I visited for my birthday and Marcia was so sweet and accommodating with thoughtful extra touches! Would definitely recommend to anyone!
Márcia was extremely flexible and helpful during check in and was an amazing host. Will stay here when I come back to Porto, definitely recommend!
Marcia was extremely responsive and helpful.  We loved the location, close to everything and on a quiet street.  Great value.
We loved our time in Porto! The location of the apartment is perfect and even better than described. The apartment is really well equipped and Marcia even provided some toys for our little son!
I was able to feel right at home. Surrounded with walkable restaurants and cafes in every corner you turn into. I definitely do recommend this stay for future guests.

Our stay at Márcia’s place was fantastic. The location is perfect to walk to all the sights in Porto. The check in information was provided ahead of time along with a list of local amenities and attractions. Check in instructions were clear and well detailed, it was very easy to find and get checked in. Thanks again!

We loved our stay here! It was in the perfect spot, easy to find and walkable to everything in the city. Lots of space and full kitchen. Márcia was super responsive and helpful with us coming early to drop off our bags. Would highly recommend!

Márcia's place was wonderful and we enjoyed our stay in Porto.  The location was central to everything and a short walking distance from Sao Bento station, which was very convenient.  The place was clean, very spacious for 2 people, and the bed was comfortable.  I also really appreciated the water and wine provided by Marcia.  Márcia was easily reachable and the check-in and out instructions were clear.  Would definitely choose to stay again.
I had a great stay at Márcia’s airbnb. It was very nice and was in a great location

Wonderful studio in lovely building up the hill from a main strip of restaurants and shops. Nice big open windows. Full bed with pullout sofa bed. Wonderful experience. Marcia is so accommodating and sweet. You’ll love this space!
Amazing place! Marcia was so kind with thorough recommendations and instructions for checking in, and the Airbnb was spacious and full of light. We had an amazing time.

Very nice place and friendly helpful host.
Thank you, Márcia, for a bottle of really good wine in a fridge, which was really welcome after our relatively long trip.
I really enjoyed my stay here! 2 minutes walking distance from the center, but perfectly tucked away so there was never much noise. Clean and nice amenities. I’d recommend this place!
Mario has been a great host. Always willing to help. The apartment is well located and cozy.

You should be aware that you’re not booking an entire apartment. There is a locked door with a laundry room that the cleaning lady uses every day. Although you can lock the door of the main studio, she also has the key to that door as she entered once while I was in there.
Other than that, the studio was very nice, stylish, and with a great location. Mario was incredibly quick to answer my messages and he has a great app with a lot of local tips.
Very nice apartment, and the perfect location to explore Porto from, during day as well as night.

Everything was excellent, as it's announced in the page. Very easy check in indeed.
I'd repeat for sure.
Really nicely laid-out and stylish apartment on a hip street with many great bars and restaurants - our favourite apartment on our trips to Porto!

Nice place, very clean and nicely located, we were 5-10 minutes away from a few touristic places.
The host also let us check in earlier, which was great!

Maybe one of the best Airbnb I've been to yet! The location is simply perfect, in the restaurant area, near to every worth seeing place in Porto. Then the appartement is very classy, perfect for a stay of 2 person's. And the owner is very responsive, nice and helpful. Would recommend to anyone 👌
Good location for singles who want to go out and party , but a little noisy for families with young kids

Great location, everything is near, restaurants, beautiful architecture around. We walked around and saw all the notorious places, the location is just perfect. Easy to get from the airport, Uber not that expensive, there is also an option with the metro.
The place was very clean, beautiful and simple inside, the host was very friendly and even let us leave our luggage a bit more.
Overall, a very good experience! Thank you!

The flat is situated in the centre not far away from all the interesting places. The bathroom was clean, beds comfortable. There was a possibility to leave our luggage in the cleaning room. We recomend this accomodation.
Had an amazing stay in Porto! Thanks so much for having us - a beautiful apartment in a beautiful area. We will definitely stay here again =]

My partner and I were in Porto for just 1 evening (stop over) and found Alex's listing matching what we needed. The location to the city center was our number 1 priority and this property exceeded our expectations. It is very central, near loads of bars and restaurants (but we did not hear these at night when inside), it was a 20 minute walk to the river downhill and overall was located in a fun and vibrant location.
The accommodation itself was clean, the bed was comfortable, black out shutters and a well equipped kitchen including oils and herbs. It also had AC (which was great for Porto in August!) and fresh towels and sheets. We have both agreed next time we are back we will stay here again!

Very nice flat with everything you will need. The flat is located in a central location with restaurants in the same street. Self Check in was very easy and we even received some nice recommendations from Mario for our next days visits.
Great place for our weekend stay, host was responsive and friendly. Place as described, very central. Tips/recommendations for Porto from the host were a nice touch.

Everything was positive. We recommend this place. Inside there were all the comforts and the level of privacy was high. We felt very welcomed by the host and also by the people in the neighborhood. Very close there is a place called Padaria Garrett in which we had breakfast every morning and it was also super good.
Garrett was a fantastic host who responded quickly and greeted me warmly in person at the airbnb. Location is great with a short walk to the beach and surrounding restaurants.
A great, stylish apartment in a very good location just a one minute walk to the river, loads of restaurants nearby but still nice and quiet. The bed was huge and very comfortable!!

Marta's place was really great and very cozy and it happens to be located in one of the best areas in Porto, around all the restaurants, close to the river and Pont Luis Bridge and its super quiet at night when you want to rest after a whole day sightseeing. The apartment is really fancy and check in was super smooth.

Very good location. Marta was super friendly and the communication was perfect.
Can recommend the flat 10/10.

Marta was very communicative, easy to reach and fast to reply. The apartment is excellent - located in a vibrant neighborhood, within walking distance of the waterfront as well as the historic city center. Can truly recommend!

An awesome apartment, in a fantastic location!
A fantastic host with very prompt communication and allowing us to store our bags later than checkout due to a late flight, I would thoroughly recommend this apartment to friends and family who want a centrally located apartment close to all the major sights.
Great communication from booking and during our stay and thank you to Marta for allowing us to store our bags due to a late flight.
I would have no hesitance in recommending your apartment to friends and family.
Many thanks
Paul & Tanya.
The place was really QUITE nice. We had a lovely stay, would certainly consider staying with this host again.
Excellent place to stay - perfectly situated in the heart of the city with everything within 5 minutes walk! Thank you!
Perfect location @ the Ribeira area.Only few steps away from Ponte Luis and the river.The apartman is perfect.Clean and the beds are huge.
We had a wonderful time at Marta’s place. The location was perfect. We were impressed with how quiet it was when we shut the windows and it was very clean. We would definitely stay again.

It is a really nice studio in a renovated ancient building right in the city center close to the river. You can actually see the river from the windows. It literally took us 3 -5 minutes to walk to most places we needed.
The host is so nice, she answered all our questions really fast.
We are actually sorry just for one thing, it is that we came only for one night.
Highly recommend and will definitely come back!

Excellent location, a short walk to many sights and restaurants. The trade off is that it can be a little noisy with the windows open in the summer. Nonetheless my family had a lovely stay and Marta is a nice host, I would definitely recommend this apartment.

Magical flat in the heart of the old city
The street leads to the beautiful riverside and the flat is beautifully decorated mixing old and new.
Marta was responsive and kind and communication with her was good
Enjoyed my stay in Porto in this cute apartment. Well located close to the river, with plenty of restaurants nearby.

Marta was very good at communicating. We had a couple of issues re shower/bath but they were quick to try to help.
Location was excellent. It was within Riberia area so it is busy but once the windows were closed noise levels minimized.

Marta’s apartment is centrally located. We were able to get to most of Porto’s sites on foot and there were lots of great eating places nearby as well as a couple of small supermarkets and a local bakery. As we visited in the peak of the summer, it did get a bit noisy on the streets adjoining the apartment building at night. The place is perfect for a couple but perhaps a bit small for four. Marta is a great host and was very responsive. All in all a great place to stay in Porto.
Great location and nice unit.  Unfortunately,  the raid in front of the unit was undergoing repair so it was quite noisy in the apartment during the day.

Was nice. Exceptional location, maybe a little loud at night, because one of the other residents in the apartment was running around at 3-4 am every night, but that’s the only negative to a nice stay in the centre of Porto

All was as expected and described
everything was in good condition and clean
central location
Difficult to get there by car
quite noisy outside till restaurants close for the night

Andrei's apartment is recently renovated and very clean. It has everything you need (toaster, coffee machine, blow dryer...) It is close to the city centre. I stayed with two of my friends and we had a great time. I definitely recommend this place :)
In the flat you can find everything you need. It's perfectly clean, modern and well located. It's a pleasure to stay there. I can recommend it to everyone.
This place is lovely, with really amazing small touches. A beautiful and comfortable place to stay. 10/10

Andreia's apartment is the perfect spot for a few days in Porto, specially for small groups. Great location, amenities and everything is super functional.
Communication was great since the beginning and I highly recommend her property for some nice days in Porto.

We had a nice stay at Andreia’s place in Porto.
- Very easy check in.
- Quick response.
- Close to everything.
- Very nice kitchen design.
- Washer / dryer works great!
Awesome location, quiet unit, very clean and looks newly remodeled with great amenities. Communicative host, smooth checkin process. Highly recommended. Thanks!
A house where I felt like home. I had everything i needed for a succesful visit in Porto.

Awesome space
Great location for pedestrian exploration
Neat
Tidy
Sparkling clean
Quiet home from home

The apartment was clean, well located and had a really nice balcony. Excellent value for a trip to Porto!

Andreia’s place was a great studio that was close enough to get to a lot of pets of Porto on foot (we enjoy walking though).  Andreia was very responsive and helpful.  Clean and well supplied the only drawback is 4th floor no stairs

Great location!!! Close to bars, restaurants and grocery stores. Walk distance to São Bento train station. Would definitely book it again! The host was very flexible and helped me and my friends by allowing us to drop our bags before check in time. Obrigada, Andréia !

Andreia's place is in a good location, close to public transportation and stores, as well as some attractions. Andreia was a great host and answered quickly to every question we had. The place is very cosy and we found everything we needed during our stay. Thanks again!
Andreia’s place was very nice. You are welcomed with clean fresh smell and some port wine. There’s a nice big binder full of information.

We loved the little terrace and seeing the rest of our block's rear windows.  The OG bakery (sourdough) delicious, just down the opposite alley. Nice corner cafe, popular and a sweet hub for the hood.  Near a grocery and pretty park, excellent access to Bolhau Market, Campanha, etc.

This place has everything you need for short and long stays.
Very clean, lot of small details and useful itemst.
It's a perfect place
Good location, very walkable to monuments and the city centre, as well as a grocery store very close by. Nice view from the balcony.

We had a wonderful stay at Andreia's apartment. The communication with her was perfect, Andreia is very responsive and helpful host. The apartment matched the listing description and photos, it was clean, spacious and well-equipped. The location was also great, near a metro station and not far from the city center. We would definitely recommend this apartment to other guests who are looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Porto.

Our stay at Andreia’s was okay, her apartment is in a very central location and it was easy to walk nearly anywhere. Andreia was a very responsive host and was available to help us when we had questions. However, the apartment was filled with many smells covered up by air fresheners (the bedroom smelled of mold, the fridge smelled of fish, etc.), it made it difficult to enjoy spending time at the airbnb. Another thing to note is the small hot water tank, we could only get through one very quick shower before running out of hot water. Also, the bed is very soft and the sheets are clearly very old and used which was not the most enjoyable. We did also have a situation where the breaker jumped from having too many things run at once, Andreia was helpful in getting this fixed but something to keep in mind.

Excellent location. Apartment is in a very central location and it was easy to walk nearly anywhere. Andreia was a very responsive host and was available to help us when we had questions. Very clean apartment. It is a bit of a walk up to the fourth floor. The apartment has no lift/elevator-be mindful if you cannot do flights of stairs. All and all its a beautiful apartment with a beautiful view. Had a great stay. Thank you for everything!
Nice place to stay for a short 3 day trip to Porto. Updated amenities and very clean space.

Perfect little apartment.  She keeps it very tidy, and extremely clean.   Kitchen was just big enough for our needs, without any clutter or excessive unnecessary appliances.  We were just passing through but everything was as easy as it could be for our one night in Porto.
Andreia communicated very well with us and the apartment was exactly as described. We enjoyed the terrasse & was within walking distance of many sights.

A very nice place. Just a little away from City center, but with a lot of space for parking a car.
Very clean. Luis and his wife are lovely.
Thank you for the great stay at your place in Porto. It was walkinh distance to the river and old part of the City. Beautiful and clean ! We will come again !

The place just as described in the photos. Very clean and tidy. We moved using Uber and it was very handy. It is a very cozy place with all you need for a stay! Highly recommended! Also Luís is super reachable and always checks on you.

Angelo and his family are super nice people and very welcoming. The apartment is super clean and more spacious than it looks like on the picture. We had a great time at their house! It's a 15minutes ride to porto with the car (I would recommend to rent a car or use Uber). The apartment is only few meters from the sea away, which is really nice too. I totally recommend a stay at Angelo's flat!
Nice apartment outside of the center of Porto. Back garden was a nice place to relax after the day. Apartment was as described.
Great apartment and excellent value for money. Really cosy with everything a family needs. Short taxi ride to Porto. Would definitely stay again.

It's a self-check-in system, so we can go in comfortably regardless of check-in time. Luis answered the question quickly and kindly.
There were heaters in the rooms and living room, so we could stay warm.
A wireless vacuum cleaner was also useful.
