Great stay at Luis’s Property. Enjoyed sightseeing Porto. Place was clean, well arranged and as described. Stayed with my partner and 2 year old daughter , was able to use uber to get nearby and even use local buses to get to the city centre . We would book again for sure. Luis also supported us with storing our luggage and was understanding when I made a mistake
Very clean home, wish we could’ve stayed longer! The host was super proactive and made sure everything was okay before, during and after our stay. I would recommend without any hesitation :)

Charming apartment, very spacious and clean. Good beds and great shower! Not so close to the amenities to go walking, but free parking on the street near the apartment. The host is very friendly and responsive. Thank you Luis!
There is not much to think in your choices, come along be comfortable and enjoy your stay. Well located, sparklingly clean, an amazing nights sleep.
Stylish, confortable, centrally located, Ines' apartment got it all. Communication for check in and out was very easy. We had a wonderful time and would definitely stay there again.

The place was amazing, very clean, very stylish! You have double bed and a comfortable couch that turns into a bed, and if you ask in advanced, the couch will be already prepared as a bed!
Inês was simply amazing, she was always ready to help and answered every text ASAP!
The flat is very well located, Oporto’s downtown is 5 mins away by foot, a supermarket is available just 2 mins away! There is also many available spots for the car, however, during the week it’s required to pay.
All in all, the stay was wonderful, the host was amazing!
I surely recommend!

An absolute gem of an apartment in a beautiful area.
Inês accomodated where she could. I would recommend contacting her before you arrive regarding parking as the area is challenging, but not impossible!

I had a great stay at Ines’ place. The room was so beautiful, clean and on a good location. Ines thought of everything, had even her own map with recommendations.  If I’m ever going back to Porto I’ll definitely stay here again!

Appartment very well located. Close to many shops and cafes. But noisy at night. Bed a bit small for tall people. Amenities are enough for a short stay. Luís provides many information before and during the stay!

One of the best Airbnb I have ever been. Luis is an amazing host and his tips are very usefull.
Everything was perfect
The apartment's location is great! Apartment itself is clean and spacious. It also has old Porto charm :) The only downside is the noise outside but this problem is easily solved with earplugs.

My mom and I have spent a week in Luis's apartment. The localization is perfect (the city center and each of the monuments in Porto it's easy reachable by foot), the apartment is spacious and well equipped. Luis's hospitality was much bigger than we expected. Breakfast in the cafe was a great start of each day and Luis's tips about the city - priceless. It was a pleasure to spend time in this beautiful city and be a Luis's guest.

Luís is a very kind and welcoming host! He sent us useful tips every day for places to visit, or restaurants and bars to enjoy. The place is located in the center of the city, just a few steps and you can reach all the landmarks. Apartment itself is clean and spacious. It also has old Porto charm :)
The only downside is the noise outside in the night.
Nice value overall !
Great location and perfect to explore Porto... Luis gave a lot of good info. Would stay here again for sure.

Luís is a very kind host, he did not stay at the same house but sent us daily tips via WhatsApp. The flat: What you see is what you get. It’s clean and in the very center of Porto and due to the house is very old, it can get louder at night. If you are a large person, the bed might be a bit too short, your feet must be aware of monsters at night. ;)
We would like to stay in this flat again (with a larger bed), and say THANK YOU, LUÍS!

All perfect 👌
-Perfect Location
-Clean and cozy
-Great money value
Luis is really attentive and friendly!

The reviews are accurate. Luis is a super host for a reason. From check in to check out (even before check in) I felt taken care of. The place is spacious and clean and I was able to walk everywhere. Luis is so thoughtful and has suggestions to help you make the most of your trip. I will stay here over and over again.
PS. The street is vibrant so bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper.
Luis, Was very helpful and everyday had suggestions of where to see and eat. The location was/is great as it is at just at the back of downtown next to cafes and the great "Base" bar ontop of shops

This little apartment is in a great location, close to everything in central Porto. Luis is an amazing host; always available and has amazing tips on where to eat and what to visit.
I highly recommend this apartment.
Luís is an amazing host. Everything is communicated extremely well and he is really thoughtful when it comes to suggestions and helping out. Apartment is on a great location.
Really great stay in a wonderful location- Luis was a really attentive and informative host, and the place is spacious and so well connected for exploring Porto!

Staying at Luís' apartment was wonderful. Check-in worked out smoothly, even though we arrived quite late on the day. Luís sent us suggestions for what to do, where to eat and have a drink everyday and he replied very quickly to any questions we had. He was also a very friendly host and even greeted us with a bottle of wine. Our favourite thing about the place was the cute balcony. Would definitely come back!

This is exactly what an airbnb should be! The place was as described and pictured and was very charming - I loved the balcony from which you can watch local life. The neighborhood was was very convenient, yet did not feel touristy. Luis was very responsive and also proactively gave me recommendations for sightseeing and restaurants, and his suggestions were great!

Amazing host, gives great daily suggestions,places to eat, and see.
I love the balcony and doors to open for a breeze.
Walking distance to many sights and activities.
Will most definitely return if I am lucky enough to find a vacancy.
If the dates are open, book it!
Luís's place was beautiful and very well located. Luís was very responsive and gave a lot of great daily recommendations for things to do or restaurants to go to.

We have enjoyed our stay. Luís made it as comfortable as possible and even provided some local wine. Apartments are located in the very center and surrounded by many restaurants and cafes. It was a little bit noisy on weekend though.

Luis was very helpful in recommending things to do and places to eat and always replied quickly to any questions.
He is well versed in musical events in the city. All in all a great stay.

Luís is a phenomenal host and this stay is in a great location! It's easy to walk to the bulk of Porto and transit is close for the rest. Luís sent great recommendations for food and sights that I otherwise would not have found on my own
Luís was a FANTASTIC host, truly the most helpful person imaginable. Lots of great activity and restaurant recommendations. and he even lent us towels for our beach day!

What a fabulous stay. Luís was beyond welcoming and friendly; he sent daily recommendations of activities, food, and drink as well as left beer, wine, and fruit for us to enjoy. I particularly loved the balcony to sit on in the morning and evenings. The space is beautiful and well located as well as spotlessly clean. We are so happy to have chosen his place for our time in Porto!

My sister and I stayed with Luis for 4 nights in Porto and we could not have found a more perfect place for our stay. The location is excellent, right on a beautiful pedestrian street with a delicious restaurant right below and cafe to grab breakfast across the street. Luis gave clear check in instructions, greeted us and gave us a run down of the place when we arrived, and sent us local recommendations of what to do and where to eat every day. The place was clean, comfortable, and Luis was very responsive if we had any questions. I would definitely recommended Luis’ place if you are visiting Porto!

Located on one of the main commercial thoroughfares—so there was some noise but that’s to be expected—with a section being pedestrian-only. Lots of good restaurants and cafes within easy walking distance.
Luis was welcoming, friendly, thoughtful and easy to communicate with. His hospitality is top-notch. Highly recommend.

I would say it's a pleasure to stay here in Porto. As you can see on the comments from other guests, Luís is always welcoming and friendly. Since we arrived Porto during the new year's eve, most of the stores and restaurants are closed for the holiday, Luís still gave us a lot of tips and restaurants every day. And for the environments and supplements, you can always tell Luís is a thoughtful person since he prepared a lot of supplies for us to have a comport stay in Porto.

From the moment Luis greeted us warmly on arrival we knew we were in the company of an absolute star of a host.
The apartment was wonderful, it was as pictured and described in the listing.
Everyday Luís contacted us to make sure everything was OK, he also gave us suggestions for dining and adventures.
We so appreciated his local knowledge and his excellent communication.
We shall always remember Luís kindness and charm.
We recommend this wonderful apartment to anyone considering a stay in this charming city. It's fabulous.

★★★★★
Our stay with Luís was exceptional! Their warmth, generosity, and accommodating nature made us feel right at home. Each night, they provided thoughtful recommendations for local restaurants and activities, perfectly tailored to our interests, which elevated our trip. The space was spotless, cozy, and well-equipped. Highly recommend this incredible host for a memorable stay!
Would 10/10 recommend again. Occasionally loud in the streets at night but place overall was clean and host was wonderful

Lovely flat - the place was sparkling clean upon arrival, including a welcome bottle of wine - always a good start to any holiday! The rooms were even more spacious than we expected, and very quiet at night despite being close to the busy waterfront. The whole place is very nicely decorated. The beds were super comfortable - excellent mattresses. The showers had great water pressure. Thanks again to our hosts for booking our taxi transfers and a magical trip to the Douro Valley.

Fantastic location, space and hosts!  We loved out time in Porto and the apartment itself was modern, clean and in a great location.  Will recommend to others, and hope to come back for another visit ourselves!  Thank you Porto City Hosts's for making our stay a great one!
Very nice place on a top location. I advice not to choose for the breakfast service, because this is very poor for the money you pay.

Location is excellent in the middle of everything with out the noise, lots of restaurants and cafes near by . The apartment has everything you need beautiful decoration and comfortable beds. We will stay again!
Perfect location, cannot be beat. Quiet but right off the main drag. Several friends and I stayed in this place and it was easy, clean, really nicely put-together. Overall, great spot!
Brilliant apartment , clean and modern. Minutes away from the centre yet a step away from the madness. Thanks for sharing the apartment with us
The great place/location and professional host. The materials used are fairly low budget. Not enough hot water for six people to have a decent shower. Otherwise the place looked nice.

Recommendations: Electricity going off if you have a large group. Multiple appliances in use WILL NOT work!
Needs to have: paper towels for the kitchen, hand soap for the bathrooms. No toiletries provided: shampoo, conditioner, body wash
Very nice place! Very responsive people!

Amazing place. Close to the river, where there are lots of bars and restaurants. The instructions given to us were clear, and the communication was quick and helpful. The apartment was clean and the amenities were as described.

Our stay in Porto was amazing. The location was absolutely perfect, steps from the river and everything the city has to offer. The Porto City Host's were so responsive to questions and the space was comfortable and spotless! Having air conditioning was a blessing as it was unseasonably warm while we were there. We would definitely visit again and happily stay in the same location or another Porto City Host's property. First class operation!!

This apartment is perfect for multiple couples vacationing together, or families with older children that do not require strollers. We were traveling with two under 5 and it was tough at times. Because we were driving, this location was tough on finding close parking when the Ribeira livens up during the evening hours. The location cannot be beat just steps away from the water and there are so many restaurants and a grocery shop right outside the door. The apartment had everything we needed for our stay. Definitely recommend!!

This was a nice place right around the corner from Calem on the Gaia side. It was an easy walk to the Porto side of the River (lower), and we were even able to find parking for our 8 passenger van.  The beds were nice, the rooms were big to big enough. The only complaint is they should replace the wicker chair. It was so uncomfortable, no one would sit on it.

A warm and friendly welcome by Joao who was very helpful and communicative.  The house is in pristine condition, very clean, spacious and comfortable with lovely peaceful surroundings. Unfortunately we only stayed one night so did not have enough time to enjoy the beautiful outdoor area and swimming pool.  We would love to return in the summer next year and would highly recommend Joao's place.
Great location to stay close to Port Lodges and Restaurants.  Apartment is small but perfect for two people.

My stay in this apartment was really nice and went as planned. The place was very clean and the location is really convenient. Communication with hosts was super easy. I would definitely recommend this place and/or consider staying there again in a future visit to Porto.

Perfect apartment suitable for a couple. The service and support given by  the host was exceptional.  The apartment is very clean and comfortable and exactly as the photographs Location ideal for exploring both sides if the river, highly recommended it for a short stay.

I was so happy with my stay I extended my trip. The hosts were very accommodating and responsive. Also I made a request for  items and they immediately brought them over. They went beyond expectations. They even offered to clean mid stay.   the view from my window was wonderful and the apt is as pictured.
The only negative was being on the 3rd floor and no lift, quite an effort to get your bags up. Otherwise apartment was great, well located and everything you need

Jorge's place was so lovely and we had the best time! the hosts were attentive and wonderful :) do make sure to make note of the city tax as it is not advertised obviously in the description and will have to be paid before departure but this is mentioned in the small print. It was still great value and we would absolutely love to come back, thank you so much Maria and Jorge :)

A wonderfully situated base for exploring both sides of the Douro. The apartment offers enough space for a family of four, includes a fully equipped kitchen and comfy beds. Small shops and a bakery are a two minute walk away and offer you a perfect opportunity to practice a few Portuguese phrases. We recommend getting a rental car for day trips to the beach or surrounding cities. Thank you Jorge for a wonderful stay! We hope to be back soon!

We had a Great stay, perfect location for visiting Porto and very kind Ines who took time to give us advises. Thank youuuu. Maybe add some tea bags in the kitchen for future guests and all will be just fine : )

Looking for a place right in the heart of the city? Not to worry, you have just found it. João's place was more than expected. Very short walking distance to the Clérigos Tower, University of Porto, Lello & Irmão Bookstore and a breathtaking 'Mirante', just few metres away of the flat. Plenty of cafés, restaurants, lovely bars like 'Taberna Santo Antônio' and the vegetarian 'O Oriente no Porto'. João's place was also spotless - we had everything we needed for a perfect birthday celebration :) Lovely neighbourhood too   Chana and Daniel were in touch with us at all the time. Promptly replies, great communication and such a kind people. Check-in was pretty easy and they were very helpful since we arrived a bit earlier than the check-in time. We recommend João's place and will definitely be back when in Porto again. Obrigada! =)

Maya and Chana were really reactive when we had questions. The flat is very nice with a peaceful atmosphere and the street is quiet. It's very central and we were surprised to see how close it is from the must-see places in Porto. Thanks !
It’s a cool studio in a perfect location, very calm but really in the center. Beautiful, minimalist design.

We had a very nice stay. The location was excellent: in a quiet, scenic part of town a bit away from the more touristy crowds, but close enough to be convenient to anywhere. The place was neat and the balcony was a nice little plus. We asked for recommendations before we came to Porto and greatly enjoyed the restaurants and cafes recommended.

Better than pictures! Location is perfect - 15mins walk from the Sao Bento train station. (If you have to wheel suitcases, take the main road from the station, don’t go into small streets even if Google Maps tells you to!) Perfect location from which to explore the city - all main attractions within 20min walking distance. The apartment is clean and spacious, the bed is comfortable, the street is quiet. There’s space for hanging clothes, ample drawer space, hangers - came in very handy. There’s a guest booklet with lots of useful info, and the co-host, Ophelie, was very patient, efficient and responsive. I had a great stay and would book again if I returned to Porto.
We had a great time in the apartment. Central location. Easy check-in and great communication. Thank you

São Miminho is a small but cozy apartment in one of the most beautiful locations of Porto!
The self check-in was easy and super efficient. I think that there should have been a bit more care in the cleaning (specially now in the times we live in and taking in consideration the cleaning fee that is charged) and also the internet is a bit slow (specially if you need to work during your stay).
But overall we had a nice stay and a good time in João's place! :)

Nice stay, in the center of old Porto. Walking distance from all the nice places.
Also we went with a baby and they have a baby bed and AC which makes it very reassuring for us

A great apartment in a historic section of town. Walking distance to most major attractions in the area. The apartment was a spacious, quiet studio that looked even better than the photos. A perfect balance of historic feel with modern accents. Balcony had a great view.  Perfect for 1-2 people. Would definitely book again.
Very good location and a cozy little apartment.  everything was without disappointment.  we spent wonderful days in Porto.

We couldn't have found a better spot. In the old center of Porto and so atmospheric. I am delighted with this location. Close to the biggest attractions. There is a viewpoint nearby, which we stopped every now and then and admired the view of the old town and the bridge. There is also a small cafe right next to it run by lovely elderly couple where you can have breakfast and drink coffee. It is right next to Taberna D'Avo where we had a delicious dinner. The apartment itself provided us with everything we needed. Excellent contact with the host. I very appreciate we could pick up our luggage later. I highly recommend this spot!

The place is exactly like the photos. It’s very well kept aim a nice quiet area. There is lots to do and see in the area and is easy to travel around by foot. I would recommend this Airbnb to other people.

Very good location, can walk everywhere.  Fairly quiet, just some footsteps (stomping) up stairs.  Comfortable bed.  Heater worked well.  Lots of hot water.  Very poor in the dishes and cookware department.  I would stay here again.

Rita’s place was clean, comfortable and right in the heart of the city close to all the main attractions. I loved how charming the apartment was and it gave us a taste of what it’s like being a local for a few days.
I had a great time staying at this loft! The loft itself was so cozy and in a beautiful building! It was close to everything I wanted to see in Porto! I would stay here again!

The location was perfect and had great restaurants nearby. 10 min walk to most major tourist destinations. Isabella and Yasmine were easy to coordinate with. We also loved coming home to good air conditioning!

Perfect stay, the location of the apartment is so good. I recommend without hesitation.
ps: the most is the pool on the roof top to refresh after a good day of walking.

This is an amazing place. We loved everything about it. The location is right next to beautiful viewpoint, close to everything in the center, the house is beautiful and interior design of the apartment is very stylish. We appreciated all the details. This place has a soul. I visited Porto with my mum and she was in love with this place. When I will be back in Porto I know where I want to stay
Phenomenal place and great owners. Beautiful street and great walkability right in the old town.
It was a great location and highly recommended for a short stay! Check-in was easy and very responsive hosts who also shared local recommendations.

Great apartment! So walkable, and a really lovely area. Super cuter, very clean, kitchen was great and sleeping arrangements were just what we needed. Roadworks outside that we weren’t told about, but they seem short term and weren’t much of a problem.
Overall a great stay, in a lovely place for a great price!
Great stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable and in an amazing location easy to walk to everything. Check-in was smooth and communication was excellent. Would definitely stay again :)

Very helpful and responsive host, especially with leaving my bags at the air bnb before/after check in/check out times. The area is really central and great to be in to explore Porto. Apartment was very clean and a perfect little oasis. Also, great wifi in case you have to work. Highly recommend!
Nice place, host that met me was good, decent neighbourhood, easy to visit central locations, lots of places to eat nearby. Got a feel of the old town along with the new town.
Do not hesitate to book! Perfect location, comfortable room, and the rooftop pool was an added bonus! The host greeted us with a map and bottle of chilled wine. Absolutely amazing Airbnb!
Great place with gorgeous view of Porto. It rained on us most of the time but there were plenty of restaurants and entertainment near by to keep us busy and dry. Would stay here again for sure!
We had a lovely time at the apartment. Beyond the beautiful view, the communication was flawless and we didn’t have any trouble. Super recommended !

Wow! I couldn’t not imagine staying anywhere else in Porto. The photos of the view do not do it justice. It was a beautiful view, and an incredible apartment. It was very clean, and we really enjoyed our experience. Communication was perfect. Next time I’m in Porto I will definitely stay here.
Absolutely amazing place. You cannot beat the view of the bridge and Douro river from this place. Very comfortably slept 3 adults and was very clean and spacious. AC was an added bonus!

A lovely stay in Gaia! The apartment had million dollar views of the Douro River and Ribeira. It was ideally located, close to all the action, but very relaxing at night. I cannot stress the views from the balcony, so beautiful you may want to cry.
The apartment was on the third floor, no elevator, but this is typical of Portugal. It was clean and spacious, easily fits 3 people comfortably. Well equipped for a short or long term stay. There was no supermarket near by for groceries, but plenty of restaurants just steps away.
The team at OPO apartments are easy to communicate with. Mariana was such a pleasure in all our conversations. I will most definitely stay here again!
Can’t say anything bad or even average about this place. Excellent location, best views, plenty space and constantly good follow up. I recommend this apartment without reservation.
This is a first-class house. Though small, it is well-equipped, spotlessly clean and in an interesting location with good access to the metro and local shops (10 minutes walk). Highly recommended.

Absolutely loved this place! It was so clean (floors, beds, bathrooms, everything!), and it was the perfect place. They really thought of everything - they even had little port wines for us to welcome us to Portugal. Not to mention Carla and her staff were so kind and helpful. I think it’s my favorite airBNB that I’ve stayed at this year.  Highly recommend!  FYI - it’s in a quieter part of Porto which is nice for quiet nights and to be a bit pushed back from the big city :) was great for our stay

Light, spacious and airy - perfect for our August visit when temperatures exceeded 35 degrees at times.  Beds were extremely comfortable and the bathroom, especially, very stylish, with a powerful shower and lovely toiletries.  If you want be further away from the hustle and bustle of the centre (which is a 20 minute walk away) this is the perfect place to stay.
We had an amazing stay at 1820 Oporto appartment! It was a beautiful building and well located in Porto! De host is really friendly and flexible with the check-in time.

Fully recommended
Great stay
Beautiful place
Modern design with touch of history

Andre's place was beautiful, with high ceilings, huge windows, and modern, simplistic decor. there wasn't much of a view which is a shame, but the location was ideal with a cafe and market on the same block and a short walk from the train station, river, and other touristy spots.

This apartment is very classy and has good amenities. Sara was was very good with greeting us at checking in and open to all our requests. There are many nice restaurants around the apartment. Definitely recomendable for others to stay here.

The apartment is stunning; beautiful architecture, details, interiors and furnishings. The location is wonderful, close to everything, but just outside of the historic core. The neighborhood is filled with restaurants, great coffee shops, etc. The host and guest experience was wonderful. Seamless communication, check-in, follow up on questions and even assistance in arranging an early morning taxi to the airport. I can’t say enough about this apartment or host. I’ll be back for sure.

Great apartment in a central neighborhood in Porto. The building has a beautiful atmosphere that’s also to be found in the apartments high ceilings and classical details. Very clean, with a. nice modern interior. Would highly recommend booking this apartment for your stay in Porto! The host was nice and welcoming and gave us some great tips.

The pictures do not do this place justice. Porto has many nice Airbnb’s but few with as much charm as this one. We were more than pleased with our stay and will certainly book again. Thank you for having us.

Wonderful apartment in a great location. It is very easy to walk to all the main sights and city centre. The apartment was very clean and stylish, with 2 big comfy beds and good air conditioning. Highly recommend!

We had a beautiful stay in Porto. The apartment building and apartment itself is simply beautiful and very spacious and clean. It has a great location which is very quiet, yet not too far to walk downtown. Also Uber was very convenient while it was raining a few times during our stay. We would for sure recommend this place.
Apartment with local Portuegese design and motifs. Rooms with high ceilings and very airy. Convenient location 15 mins to center. Air conditioner did not work properly, that is the only disadvantage.

Really beautiful and spacious apartment, with original features and comfortable and stylish furnishings and fittings. Incredibly quiet and tranquil, but only 5-10 mins walk from the busy centre of the city, and lots of great cafes on the doorstep for lovely breakfasts. It was a real treat to come back to after busy days of sightseeing and felt very safe to walk around neighbourhood after dark.
Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Porto. Mariana in the office was really informative and helpful thank you, and we had a wonderful time!
Gorgeous spot in a beautifully renovated old building with 18 foot ceilings - quiet and cool, yet minutes away from downtown. Lovely neighborhood.
Andre’s apartment was wonderful and Mariana was an amazing host! Great location! We walked everywhere! Super clean and very unique! Will definitely stay again if in Porto! Thank you!
This is an outstanding, beautiful period apartment and is situated on the edge of the central area of Porto. As described it was quiet. It was a great stay and a very responsive host.
Perfect location,restaurants & cafés nearby.Very nice desigend apartment,stylish and not overdecorated.Quiet,no street noise.Mariana is very responsive and caring.We recommend it absolutely.

Rui is a great guy and a great host.
helped us with all we needed and more. the place is in great location with a sea view. lot of free parking
the apprtment if fully equipped with everything you will need.
stylish and comfortable.
we had a good time there.
Sharon

We had a nice stay in Porto, the apartment was ok but smaller than it seemed on the fotos. The location was good with walking distance to the city center, communication with Claudia was easy and she was helpful when we had any questions.
The place is good and very stylish. It can be a little bit noisy, but if you close the windows everything is alright. Thanks for hosting us, Claudia!

Beautifully furnished apartment with all necessary equipment. The apartment is clean and cozy and is located in a perfect location near the bus station and close to the center of Porto. I can only recommend accommodation.
Great place in a fun location with an extremely good host. Wi-Fi was good enough to work from home. Good amenities. Great local recommendations
Pluto was waiting for us when we arrived. She was very friendly and the place was perfect. Outstanding location.

We just finished our stay here while in Porto and felt it was the perfect apartment for our group of 4 adults. The location is perfect! Easily able to walk to all of the attractions around the city, and also close to a large market. Plus we tried the restaurant next door and it was fantastic. The host provided a great overview of the apartment and main attractions when we arrived, and she was very prompt with communications. The air conditioning was great and kept us comfortable. We would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto.
We had a great time here. It is nicely set up and very clean. Very close to Sao Bento and shops and restaurants.

Loved this place. Very central to all the sights and a lovely, clean space with everything you need. Joao was so friendly and nothing was too much trouble, including welcoming us late from our flight and well beyond the usual check in time. Spacious and comfortable, and would have no hesitation in returning. Thank you.

Host was very responsive and was there to greet us and gave us recommendations. location is very walkable to all major areas of Porto. Rooms were spacious and clean. Beds were comfortable.  Recommended to those looking for a central location in Porto.

The location was great, Puro was extremely responsive and was quick to give me a call to answer a quick question we had. Location is right in the center of it all.
My daughter wants to come back to stay in the bunk beds.

The house is small but nice, quiet and extremely clean. We had a great time there. The only difficulty is to go to the city center by public transport (bus is very infrequent and the ferry to cross the river is expensive), however Uber works perfectly and is even cheaper than the bus for 4 people.

This location is perfect! It was absolutely clean, the communication with Cristina (the host) was fantastic and there is a great view from the balcony. I can definetely recommend this apartment and would try to stay there again whenever I am in Porto!
Cristina and John were very hospitable and accommodating, and the apartment is in an ideal location with tourist hotspots and everything else you could want nearby. Would definitely recommend!!

We really enjoyed Cristina's place.  The location was fabulous.  The space was perfect for a couple.  It had everything.  The bed was great as were the linens.  The view is spectacular.  Loved Porto!  Would highly recommend Cristina's place.

Cristina's apartment is ideally located, close to everything: train, metro, restaurants, grocery store, and all major Porto attractions. Apartment is very  functional and clean and Cristina is a super host. There is construction work in the area, but it ends by 6:00 pm. It did not bother us. We would rent this apartment again without hesitation.

Cristina’s place is the best! So close to everything, including the train station, the river, awesome restaurants and bars. There is a lovely balcony overlooking the rooftops of Porto that we enjoyed with our welcome bottle of Port. The apartment itself is modern, stylish and clean. Cristina even met us at the train station to make sure we found the apartment. Highly recommend and would love to come back sometime soon!

This apartment is absolutely beautiful – it feels more like you're staying in a private hotel room! Nothing can beat that view any time of day – from having an espresso on the balcony in the morning to sipping on a glass of Port at night (thanks for the free bottle!) The apartment is perfectly located to explore the city :)
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Near the train station which we used very often to get around. The view from the balcony is absolutely incredible.

Cristinas appartment is just wonderful. It is perfectly located in the center of the old town, so we could walk everywhere. The flat was super clean, the recommendations for restaurants neary were great and the view from the balcony is stunning! We would definitley come back.
Cristina's studio is great. The view from the balkony is awesome and it is located on a perfect place to see porto. We loved it.

Cristina's appartment is a great place to stay in Porto. It is in the middle of the centre and it is a very stylish and comfortable appartment. The view is great and you can see a lot of cats walking and sleeping on the roofs. Everything was very clean and there is a little kitchen which is hided in a cupboard, but which has really everything you need! Cristina and her husband received us very kindly and explained us everything in the house and gave us useful advices for bakery's, supermarkets and other things. We certainly reccommend a stay in this appartment. A trip to the fisher's village Afurada (at the other side of the Douro in Porto) or to the nearby city of Guimaraes we can also recommend.

This is an immaculate, well provisioned, centrally located apartment in the historic heart of Porto.  The view from the balcony is wonderful.  Best of all, Cristina is a welcoming and highly competent host.

We had a perfect stay at Cristina’s lovely apartment. It’s the perfect base to explore the city as you’re right in the middle of Old Town but tucked away on a peaceful street. Having our morning coffee on the balcony listening to the bells and seagulls was the best way to start the day. Cristina was a great host - she gave us plenty of recommendations for local vegetarian restaurants and supermarkets and helped us arrange airport transfers. I’d recommend to anyone!

I’d highly recommend staying at this spot! Location is wonderful! You get a great leg exercise in climbing up to the entry, but the central location, views of the city and amazing ambience within the unit are perfect!

Cristina’s apartment was beautiful and so perfectly located for my two days in town! The view from the balcony of the castle is awesome and the space was sparkling clean. She also graciously picked me up from the train station in pouring rain to make sure I got in okay, and left a little bottle of port to make the welcome even sweeter. I would highly recommend this lovely room for anyone in Porto!

We were only in Porto for a quick two days but Cristina made sure we were taken care of with local tips and being available by phone whenever we needed. The place has a great view of Porto - sitting on the balcony with a coffee in the morning is a must do! And with some Port wine at night of course! ;) The surrounding streets are super charming and great for exploring. Can't beat the location.

Super easy UBER from airport.  Beautiful apartment located on quiet one lane cobble stone road with easy and secure ground floor entry with a deck overlooking historic tile roof homes below and cathedral across.  All the amenities of home comfort from cable TV with US (CNN, CNBC, AMC, NBC, etc) and European (BBC, local,..) channels, full modern kitchen, beautiful bathroom, coffee maker, small grocery store a 5 minute walk away, historic landmarks everywhere walkable, a Hop On Hop Off bus stop 5 minute walk away near Tower Clerigos takes you everywhere from seaside, riverfront port and neighborhoods..  Cristina arranged for a 3:30am taxi pick up for my 5am flight to Amsterdam... Airport drive that time of day was a quick 15 minutes leaving plenty of time for check in... otherwise plan on 30 minute drive..  Awesome host, apartment and location!

Great apartment situated amongst the hustle and bustle. The apartment is tucked away only minutes from the main tourists streets which is far enough to keep it nice and quiet at night! During the day there was a lot of construction noise from surrounding buildings, in the evenings however, it was quiet. Great view from the balcony, great furnishings, good washing machine and iron - perfect for delicate clothes. Overall we had a really good experience and Cristina was very helpful!

Excellent find! Great location, the balcony had a fantastic view and Christina was delightful. When our arrival flights ran several hours late and we arrived at midnight, she never made it an issue and even picked up some wine, meat and cheeses for us. Everything was as described. Her restaurant recommendations were excellent (especially Intigro and the little tapas place right up the street. Just a wonderful place to stay.

This place was as amazing as all the reviews indicate! Beautiful view, sparkling clean, and close to almost everything we wanted to do. Additionally, Christina has great recommendations. I told her I was a vegetarian and she recommended a place that ended up being one of our favorite restaurants of the trip! Highly recommend and hope we can return!

Cristina was an amazing host. She went above and beyond to greet us, makes us feel welcome and provided many local tips. The apartment was lovely with a superb view over the Porto rooftops. It was beautiful waking each morning to the sounds of the seagulls after a peaceful night sleep in the oh so comfortable bed. Memorable stay.

Cristina’s place is in the heart of old Porto. It is in short (but hilly) walking distance of all major sights. The amenities are great and the balcony is superb. Cristina went above and beyond to give us informed recommendations and concerned care.

A beautiful apartment in the best location! We stayed here for 3 nights and absolutely loved it. Everything is within walking distance and Cristina has the best recommendations for different bars and restaurants to try. The view from the apartment was amazing! We spent a lot of time out on the balcony drinking wine. Also, Cristina was very quick to respond with any questions we had and was very helpful during check-in when we arrived late.

Our stay was amazing. The apartment is in the perfect location to walk to many popular and well kept locations. In the evening the views of the city from the balcony were amazing for sharing a nice glass of Port wine. Highly recommend and will visit again in the future!
Cristina was an amazing host and gave us the best recommendations for food, drinks, sightseeing and enjoying some of the local scene.
Amazing location! Christina is also such a great host and super accommodating. I plan on being back and staying here in the future!

Christina and William are  friendly hosts, they gave us much useful tourist information. The view of balcony is great, you can sit there and enjoy a glass of port wine that Christina provided. We would highly recommend this apartment!

We absolutely loved our stay! Christina gave us many recommendations and was always available for questions. The place itself was perfect; it was clean and proved to be a great location as well. Almost everything was in good walking distance. The private balcony with the most astonishing view of the city really gives it that “wow effect”. We highly recommend this place! 10/10!

Cristina’s place was fantastic - centrally located and very comfortable. The apartment was spotless and welcoming, we had all the amenities we needed, and Christina was responsive and accommodating from start to finish. The neighborhood was beautiful - a 10 minute walk to both the top of the hill and the riverside. I would highly recommend, thank you so much for everything Cristina!

What a lovely stay. Cristina was so kind and thoughtful. She was extremely accommodating when we needed to check in early. The place was extremely clean. And of course the showstopper was the balcony and the view. Wow. Pictures don’t do it justice. I would say the next best thing about this place was the location. If you want to go do the touristy thing - head down to the river. If you want a more localish dinner experience, head north and there are endless options. Highly recommend this place!
Christina’s place is great! The view is amazing, location great, and the apartment has everything you need. Our only slight issue was the bed, for us, was very firm.

My husband and I stayed at Cristina’s for one night during our Portugal trip. The location was perfect and it was a short walk down (a little longer when you’re walking back up) a street to the main road is. Many nearby restaurants, shops, bars and cafes. Walking distance to all of the main attractions. Cristina was very helpful with providing recommendations and useful information. We highly recommend and hope to return one day.

The location was superb! The apartment was adorable and had everything we needed! The view from the balcony was amazing and perfect for coffee in the morning and wine in the evening. We loved our stay!

Wonderful, clean, and comfortable little studio in a perfectly central location with a breathtaking view and allowing easy access to all there is to do in Porto. Cristina was not only extremely responsive but also accommodating. Would highly recommend !

This was the best Airbnb my partner and I have ever stayed in! THE VIEW WAS ABSOLUTELY INCREDIBLE!!!!! We sat for hours having drinks on the balcony looking out across the beautiful rooftops and listening to the church bells - it felt very authentic.
Location is perfect - close to the water, restaurants and beautiful sites.
Cristina was an awesome host - she had a full book of recommendations and was always prompt with responding.
We will definitely be back again😍

This place was amazing! The view and private balcony were both incredible. The location was great, as it was very close to Rua das Flores. Christina was extremely responsive and helpful and also had a thorough recommendations list for things to do in the city.

Cristina’s flat has an amazing view of Porto which can’t be beat on top of being a super convenient, comfortable place to stay. She is a great host and was available to answer all my questions in a timely manner and gave easy to follow instructions for check-in. I highly recommend this place place if you are taking a trip to Porto!

Cristina's place was the perfect little getaway for us! It's cutely decorated and in the most perfect location. The apartment is on the ground floor so there was no lugging our luggage up or down stairs. It is at the top of a fairly steep hill so you'll get your exercise in though! It was clean, had the best balcony + view and check-in / out could to have been any easier! She even provided us with a bottle of port!

Really great location, place worked out very well for us!  The view was incredible , unit was comfy with everything that you could need.  Also, close to some really great restaurant options.  I’d definitely stay here again!
We had a wonderful time! The place is very nice, felt safe, and the view is outstanding! Cristina was also very responsive. I would definitely recommend her place!
The absolutely view is spectacular. Did not feel too small for 2 people given it’s a studio. Bed was very comfortable. Access to a washer was nice, as well. Central to a main street
Very clean space with an amazing view of Porto! It was perfect for my partner and I, very quiet and great central location. Thank you for your hospitality Cristina!

We stayed at Cristina's place for 4 nights. What stood out most was the central location,  balcony view, comfortable bed and Cristina's overall communication. We were happy with our stay and would recommend!

Perfect stay! Gorgeous view of Porto!
Great location, comfortable bed and linens, great shower pressure, Castebel soaps and shower wash. Really thoughtfully designed place! 10/10
A great place to stay for a couple of nights! It was in a perfect location with so many restaurants around! The view was incredible and Cristina was very nice and great with communication.
Beautiful house with a amazing view! Exactly as described. Metro and Restaurants, all within walking distance. Will surely stay again in this place whenever in Porto.

This place is truly amazing, the apartment is a great size for a solo traveler or a couple. The view alone on the balcony speaks for itself. Walkable to landmarks, parks, restaurants and a pharmacy is right around the corner.
I had a medical emergency my last day in Porto and Cristina went above and beyond to help me through navigating the hospitals and was able to accommodate me one extra night. Super hosts doesn’t even come close, she’s more than that.

Absolutely loved our stay in Cristina’s apartment! The view was just amazing, the apartment clean, tidy and spacious for 2 people and the location was perfect - everything was in walking distance. The host was very responsive which made us feel at ease the whole trip. Thank you so much for letting us stay in your beautiful apartment.
Cristina’s place was perfect for our stay in Porto! The location was super central, the space had everything we needed, and Cristina was very responsive.

We loved our stay here. The view was great and we enjoyed sitting on the balcony at night. It was within walking distance to everywhere we wanted to be, and the place was clean. The host is very responsive and helpful for any questions or recommendations.
We really enjoyed our stay in Porto at Christina’s home! It was a wonderful combination of the perfect location with the best view in Porto. Highly recommended!

Everything was perfect!  The room with a view is in a perfect location. The room is modern with a comfy bed and very clean. The bonus balcony was perfect for morning coffee. Cristina supplied all the information we needed promptly. We hope to visit again!

This place was perfect in every way! Five plus stars in every category! Marianna was so helpful in getting us oriented and offering suggestions of places to visit. The apartment was beautiful, sparkling clean, and the location could not have been better.  Hope to come back some day!

We stayed at Mariana’s place for 10 days in November 2018. You cannot find a better place than this for any sense. It locates two minutes from the station São Bento by walk, right in the historical area in Porto. Apartment is stylish and spacious and very clean. Mariana was very caring. She helped us anytime we needed.
Mariana was extremely helpful and the flat is very well equipped and perfectly located. Would definitely come back again!

Marianas apartment was superb. Central and within walking distance to most places of interest. The hop on hop off bus was within 200 metres of our stay. Mariana reccommended a local traditional restaurant called Brasao we ate there 3 times during our stay in Porto. Truly  a classic experience and relatively  inexpensive. We will return to Porto sometime as the city is a very beautiful part of Portugal Thank you Mariana for making our stay in your apartment  a truly  memorable one
Mariana’s place was great. Great location and hospitality. The private garden puts this place over the top
Beautiful place. Clean and spacious. Gorgeous building. Fast WiFi. So conveniently located. Would definitely stay here again. Thank you Mariana!
Cristina’s place was great, just a short walk from most of the city. The view was also nearly unbeatable.

Cristina’s apartment is walking distance to all sites. Lots of restaurants and cafe’s close by. The apartment was very clean and the view is amazing.
Would definitely stay there again!
Great location and great interior space. Balcony view is gorgeous. Close to food, culture. Cristina was a wonderful host and answered all of our questions promptly.

Great walking location. Enjoyed having the little balcony that had a newer table and chairs. Good bedroom. Perfect if making breakfast and not expecting to make a big meal although equipped to do so. Would book again. Need to provide Passport information to comply for government but no other providers seem to.
Diogo's apartment is very good for travelers: location, amenities, very hospitable host... Everything was great. We will recommend
Absolutely beautiful place in the best location! Everything you could possibly need along with a beautiful big backyard, and the host is super accommodating!
Mariana is an excellent host! She was informative and communicative! The apartment is wonderful and centrally located to all the major sites in Porto! We highly recommend!

Marian's place is lovely. Located very centrally, it sits on the ground floor with your own private garden in the back. It was a great retreat after a long day of touring. Spacious apartment with all the expected amenities. Mariana met us for check-in and had a map waiting for us and provided us with a recommendations and tips! Only downside was no AC so the bedroom got a bit warm, but the fan was greatly appreciated.
Great apartment, quiet and perfect base to explore Porto.  It’s only a few minutes walk to major attractions, shops and transport. Porto is quite hilly though , take comfortable shoes!

Mariana’s place was better than expected. Modern and stylish with a cozy garden that unfortunately we couldn’t enjoy because of the rainy weather!
Mariana was helpful for us for the check in but Unfortunately we couldn’t meet her because of the of our flight delay.
The apartment is very central, 2 minutes by walk from Famous train station Sao Bento, Se Cathedral and Luis Bridge
We’ll definitely come back at Mariana’s place if we ever visit wonderful Porto again. Definitely recommended!

Very nice House, Nice location and very clean.
Mariana is very friendly. I will come back here.

Our flight was cancelled a few days before our arrival. As a consequence, we couldn’t visit the accommodation. Very sad. When we contacted Diogo about this, there was nothing he could do so we didn’t get our money back. Can’t say anything about the apartment but wouldn’t recommend as a consequence of the poor service!

A decent sized, well equipped apartment in a brilliant location. Couldn't really ask for much more, given the price. If you want an affordable apartment within a stone's throw of the city, this is a great choice. Good communications and assistance with booking an early taxi too.

Great place in the centre. It was clean, quiet and had everything you need for your stay in Porto. A small but good equipped kitchen and a washing machine.
Clean place with a good price.

Mariana´s place was the best choice we made in this trip! The check-in was so easy, all the details were provided so quickly. Her place has basically everything you need and more. Felt like a home away fom home!
Thank you for providing such a comfy space for your guests. We could clearly see you go the extra mile to make it a good experience for everyone :) !

Great space and very well equipped , easy self check-in,
Mariana is wonderful and the communication with her was great.
Highly recommended ! !

Easy going And quite confortable flat. No view and we had heavy rain so no use for the terrasse ! It is a good value for money but quite impersonal (for Mariana has several other flats...) Nothing special to welcome us

We had a great time in this apartment! Super location, really clean and easy check in/out! Mariana has made a great list of things to do, places to visit and eat which had some great suggestions on. There were also some supplies e.g. shower gel, shampoo which were really useful.  Overall we had a great time here

The apartment is beautiful, central location, close to everything. it looks even better than in pictures, private, quiet, I especially enjoyed a terrace and a little private garden. The apartment is fully equipped with anything you might need, wifi is strong.  Mariana was very responsive.
Good location, easy access, useful space. It was a bit musty and upstairs neighbors were a loud one of our three nights.

Absolutely amazing place. Not only the location was super convenient for trips but also the equipment in the apartment was really good. Especially well equipped kitchen. If I was to travel to Porto again, I would choose the same apartment.

Clean apartment, easy check-in process, and clear communication from Mariana. We loved the interiors and furnishing. Apartment is in a good location, with most attractions at a walkable distance. Highly recommend!

Just a very short walk to São Bento station, Mariana's place is private, quiet, and very well equipped for a comfortable stay. Great restaurants, historical sites and attractions, train/bus/metro stops are close by.  The bed was super comfortable, and the kitchen had all you need for meal preparation. We appreciated the private patio and spacious living room.

We could’ve spent a month here 🥰
Wonderful home, great location, within walking distance to most everything we wanted to see.
Just wish our trip was longer! Until next time…

Very cental location. We were very pleased with the convenience, the facilities, Marianna's explanations, the quietness. The private area out back is a plus. The washing machine. Definitely recommended.

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto, the location is busy and has a lot of tourists but also offers amazing restaurants, attractions, shops and views. You can walk pretty much anywhere and there are a few metro stations nearby. The house and the lovely garden made us feel right at home and Mariana left some great recommendations for things to do in the area. Thank you and we hope to be back soon!
Great spot out of the way from most tourist traffic but right around the corner/walkable from the main attractions and streets

A really modern and beautiful apartment! We totally recommend this airbnb :)
We even came in the middle of the night and the check-in was no problem at all.
We absolutely loved this place. Amazing location, super clean and our host was very responsive. We particularly appreciated her tips for must-see attractions. Thank you!!
Very comfortable rooftop appartment. Impeccably clean and quiet despite being located in the center of the action. I highly recommend this airbnb!

This apartment is just amazing! The location is perfect in a not too touristic shopping street – so everything is within walking distance! It seems like the whole house was just renovated and the apartment itself looks brand new with some very cosy details. The hosts were very nice und supportive and gave us a very detailed list (oral and written) about the things to do in Porto! The communication also was very good, we would always get a reply very fast!
So to sum it all up – as soon as you enter the door you just feel like you arrived in your Porto-home!
For our next trip to Porto we will definitely come back!

Great little open plan flat. Perfect at the weekends in a really cool location, although during the week it seemed like the preschool/school children were being taught how to bang things and scream as loud as possible. Perhaps I'm just being an old grump though.
Request this place today! Clean, great location, adorable patio, and super-friendly and hospitable hosts. This was the perfect place for my sister’s and my vacation.

The place is just what you see from the pictures. Bruno and his sister are amazing hosts. Place is right in the center, close to everything to visit in Porto. A real pleasure stay in their place and really nice people and place!!!! All the stars and more if i could!!!!😍

Best choice I could have made in Porto. This great intimate apartment in Cedofeita street is all you’ve ever wanted for your stay. Is located in the city’s center, 2 minutes from Livreria Lello, on a street full of bars and shops, 7 min from the supermarket this cosy apartment is all you need for 2 people.
First of all, the place is super clean, clean fresh sheets and towels, new furniture and comfy bed, great cosy lighting and a beautiful terrace where to enjoy Porto atmosphere while having breakfast.
Check in and check out super fast and easy, great communication with the host Bruno and his sister, great value for the apartment.
I would probably add in the kitchen a toaster for the bread and a boiling pot instead of the microwave but for the rest everything is just perfect!
So happy to have booked this place in Porto and definitely will come back here!
I highly recommend, enjoy!!
Lovely appartment right in the heart of Porto with all major sites within walking-distance. The hosts were very forthcoming and provided a number of tipps to get around Porto.

This room had the perfect location, is very clean, has a very nice balcony with a lot of sun and has all the basic equipments you need to sleep, chill, bath and cook. We had a lot of good tips about Porto from Patricia and she was always available trough text for extra questions. We had a very nice stay!

The appartment is really great, well decorated with everything you need (AC, tableware, even Netflix ;) )with a nice terrasse to enjoy breakfasts. The location is great as well, close to an artistic district (rua Miguel Bombarda) and surrounded by good bars and restaurants. There are also many parkings in that street. I also had easy interactions with Patricia and Bruno , who were very helpful.
I totally recommend!

Great little apartment for exploring Porto - the neighbourhood is convenient for travel to/from Lisbon and the airport and there are lots of great places to eat and drink nearby - we enjoyed Idiota and Aduela Bar.
The apartment is really cosy and well decorated and the balcony is great - really enjoyed it. Thanks.

Thank you Patricia and Bruno for staying at your awesome flat.
The aparatment was very clean and exactly as described at airbnb.com .
The Check-in and check-out were very easy and your tipps helped a lot.
I would everybody recommend to book this apartment.
No worry to book this appartement, everything was perfect. The only thing, a little bit noisy as the buses passes in front. João is a perfect host !

Very nice apartment. João thought over all the details so there is everything you could think about in the apartment. Even the umbrellas which we thought we would not need but eventually needed them. Highly recommend to stay at João's place.

Our stay at Joäo was perfect. Everything was clean and beautiful. The apartment is well located. The old Porto is at 15-20 minutes by walk.
So thank you so much!

The apartment is extremely clean, spacious and equipped with sufficient ammenities to cook up a feast. Each occupant is given a proper bath towel, face towel, soap, conditioner and shampoo much like the treatment of a hotel.
The host is very friendly, met us in person to do a detailed walk down of the apartment and provided enough recommendations to explore the city for two full days.
The host is always responsive to all our enquiries and was even give to aid us when we were accidentally locked out of the apartment.
Would definitely return.

João's place was spacious, clean, modern and perfect for our family's New Years trip to Porto.  Everything has a new and up-to-date feel.  The rooms are spacious, the beds comfortable, bathrooms large (rare in Europe) and it has all of the modern appliances and amenities one could expect.  The location was perfect, less than a block from a brand new supermarket.  It was equally close to cafes, banks, and other business, and easily walkable to the tourist attractions.  We had a great trip, and João's place played a big part in making it great!

Joao exceeded our expectations at such a great price and great location. We were in walking distance to all the sites and right next to a Continent to get any groceries we needed. We saved a bunch of money since we didn’t need a rental to get around due to the proximity of our stay. I would recommend everyone to use Joao since he answered all of our questions in a very timely manner.
The apartment was okay, however, it is located in a very noisy area and the check-in was complicated.

I really enjoyed my time at this apartment. It was the perfect size for me and loved the cozy feel. Patricia and Bruno were very nice and gave me tons of suggestions for things to do.
The location was perfect though on the weekends a little noisy. But it didn’t bother me. Would definitely stay again!

The apartment was comfortable and located in the perfect place, right near the centre, attractions and public transport, as well as bars and cafes. Patricia E Bruno responded very quickly and were always there to help!

Very nice location : in a nice street, not far from the historical center of the city. the hosts were here to answer our questions. they were really nice.
The appartement is very clean and well decorated: we loved it !

The best place I ever rented on Airbnb so far and certainly one of the highlights of my first time in Porto.
The description provided is accurate and the apartment looks even better in real.
Netflix, Amazon Video, Spotify, etc are available with your own passwords.
Patricia was lovely and very welcoming.
Thank you :-)

Great location -- walkable to anywhere.  Felt  very  safe.  Apt was very well equipped (from coffee to toiletries).  Main bedroom was large with its own large bathroom.  Everything worked well in this room as well. as the second  bedroom.   The third bedroom was small with no window -- definitely need the door open at night and with fan on in. order to feel. comfortable.  Check in. was. very easy. since  host. Joao was so helpful.   He provided great listings and recommendations on restaurants  as well as attractions.   Parking was fine with help of Joao (who helped me park the car in underground. garage.).  There's also a supermarket right next door to  the apt which was very  convenient.

Lovely apartment with a beautiful terrace. So central and within walking distance of all the main sites. Would definitely come back! Patricia was lovely and gave us plenty of tips for the city. 100% recommend!

Amazing location, host, overall space was amazing and had everything we needed and more. Smart TV, close to everything even a market and pharmacy next door. Patricia was very quick at responding and the terrace was everything. Would 10000% stay again

We loved our stay at this flat - Patrícia was so helpful allowing us to check in a couple of hours early and sending us recommendations. It's close to everything including some great bars and restaurants but still nice and quiet and it's a perfect start to the day sitting in the sun on the balcony.

Great little apartment in a quiet part of Porto. Meticulously clean and stocked with everything we needed for our stay. We loved the balcony and the welcome bottles of port. We wish we could have stayed there longer.

Really nice place, the flat is beautiful, the balcony awesome and very well located.
Patricia and Bruno are both very kind and make everything to help you to enjoy your stay.
Really looking for come back Again !

Patrícia E Bruno's apartment is perfect for a solo traveller or couple staying in Porto. Clean, well decorated, great kitchen facilities. Great communication. Everything went smoothly. The apartment is in a nice part of town. Highly recommended!!
Everything is as described. The apartment is excellent size for 2 and very well located. I would return again no problem and would highly recommend 😃

This apartment is spacious and very centrally located. It’s on multiple metro and bus lines and walkable to much of the city. It’s also around the corner from a big grocery store. It was a little loud a couple of nights, but that’s to be expected in a busy neighborhood. João gave us good recommendations on places to visit and was very communicative. This is a good base for exploring Porto and the surrounding area.

This was the perfect b&b and it was perfect to see all the sites of Porto! Patricia and Bruno were the perfect hosts, they had great communication and accommodated everything  we needed. Went above and beyond! So much food on the street and perfect to get to all the sites. Definitely book!
Great location, quiet, clean! The hosts left some port for our arrival and the terrace was a great place to enjoy the views!!
Beautiful place. Very good location for everything,  restaurants, bars, a parking lot, stores. Great comunication and it was very clean.
The appartment was great, super well located. It was clean, cosy, decorated with taste and well equipped. The host was nice and responded quickly! The overall experience was amazing.
Large Space with great location and easy access to train station, grocery stores and walkable distance from city center.
Amazing place to discover Porto, sunny balcony to start the day. Very nice apartment - small but everything you need.

So glad we stayed here! The neighborhood is very cute, it’s close to many nice restaurants and not far from downtown, but a little less touristy. Patricia was very helpful and flexible. The apartment was also very nice, with a great balcony.
Very nice appartement and very clean! The situation is perfect! We loved porto and the place we stayed in!

The apartment had all the necessary amenities, the location was fantastic and the roof top terrace truly heightened our experience of Porto. Enjoying a glass of wine overlooking the roof tops and listening to the buzz and music from surrounding local bars was a great way to wind down and relax after a long day out enjoying the sights. Patrícia and Bruno were fantastic hosts, gave clear instructions and good recommendations. Plus they were always quick to answer, very kind and helpful!  Would definitely stay here again!

we had a lovely 5 days here, great central location but peaceful, we would recommend this for a couple. The host was great, friendly and flexible with check in. We felt very safe and welcome in the area. Local people were friendly.  50 steps up to the apartment but worth it 👌

Patricia and Bruno were excellent hosts. Great communication, clear instructions on how to access the apartment and useful advice on things to see and places to eat. The apartment is small, but the available space has been used very effectively and we happily spent a week there. Bed was comfortable , air con worked well and the veranda was nice to sit out on. Great central location, walking distance to all of the sights. Recommend the food market at Bolhao for lunch - great seafood and wine

Patricia was a great host. She was really fast to reply to my messages before and during my stay. She ended up meeting me at check in, giving me a quick tour and explaining the set up of the place. Unfortunately due to the weather i didn't enjoy the patio as much as i'd hoped, but was great place for dinner the first night i was there.

The apartment is very well located for touring Porto by foot. The unit is quite small however and very bare bones. We knew about the 50 stairs and were fine with that but others should be aware. We had a pleasant stay.

⸻
Staying at this apartment in Cedofeita was a great experience! The location is ideal – close to the city center but in a relaxed, artistic neighborhood full of galleries, cozy cafes, and cool local shops. The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and thoughtfully decorated, with everything I needed for a pleasant stay. The area also has great nightlife, with plenty of bars and vibrant spots to enjoy in the evenings. The host was friendly, helpful, and always quick to respond. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to other travelers visiting Porto!

Really awesome little apartment located in an extremely convenient part of town. You can get almost anywhere from here.
Hosts are amazing. Provided plenty of help. Would love to stay here again one day. Thanks!
We enjoyed our stay here a lot and would recommend it highly to others looking for a comfortable stay.

I stayed for a couple of nights. The apartment is well appointed and has everything you need. It is tastefully decorated and sitting out on the balcony was lovely!
The hosts were responsive and provided lots of recommendations for sights and food in Porto which were really helpful!
A lovely stay!

Overall, we loved our stay and we would go back again. However, the place lacks a few conveniences, such as night tables on both sides of the bed and reading lights on the bedroom. We had to rearrange the bed to be able to get access to the closet drawers. Finally, a binder with instructions would also be helpful (It took us 15 minutes to find the drawer with the silverware!)  In spite of these minor negative aspects, we would recommend  this place for its location, the little terrace and the closeness to nearby sights.
The hospitality was amazing, everyone was so nice to us and eventhough we only stayed for one night we loved it, nice and cozy
Really nice place! Clean and beautiful! Small but well organized and easy to use! Parking inside gates so your car is safe.

The property was as listed. Good Wi-Fi. Close to bus transportation. Carlos went out of his way to help us with local tour and travel information. Communication was excellent and quick!!   We would stay here again, and highly recommend this property.

Carlos was an amazing host: he provided many suggestions about what to see and how to get to various places, and even drove us back to the airport at 4 in the morning!
The apartment is really nice and cosy, very well equipped and only 15min away from the beach. We had a very pleasant stay

This little apartment was great. It had everything we needed and walking distance to the grocery stores and beach. There was also a garage for our motorbike and a washing machine. Carlos was an amazing host and gave us lots of information about the area and sightseeing opportunities. His mother-in-law delivered some fresh mandarins from the garden. We had a great stay and highly recommend this place.

Off the beaten trail, but purely cosmopolitan. Ocean is within a healthy walking distance, and streets are well lit at night. Safety, due to unfamaliarity, was no longer an issue once acclimated to the neighborhood.
Due to my scheduling snafoo, a small hiccup quickly resolved. Carlos et al were able to work with us. GREATLY appreciated!!
Also enjoyed the family atmosphere in our little "villa". yes, I would definitely stay here again.
Very nice loft, stylish  and close to the center. Jose was always very communicative and gave us a warm welcome. I'll definitely come back if I ever get the chance to visit Porto again. Thanks a lot!

Lovely stay at Jose’s apartment. The apartment is small but has everything you need for a short stay for 1-2 people.
Jose was really helpful and gave some great recommendations.
And the super comfy bed was most appreciated after all our walking around Porto!
Would stay again.

It was an extremely pleasant stay at this apartment and we would gladly come again to Porto. The communication was perfect and Jose the host answered quick, gave us super tips and even ordered a taxi for us to the airport at night. The apartment is located in a quiet area ,yet in the center and shops and cool cafes are in direct vicinity. Also transport with metro from airport is very convenient. Check out the fruit shop at the Agosto 24 station. Super good goat cheese and fruits for low prices!!!
You can get to the center, sights in 5-10 minutes walking.
Tall people should regard that the ceiling over the bed is low. (~1,70m). But it didn’t really bothered me. It’s a nice house and a nice apartment, equipment is good. Jose prepared a breakfast on arrival and was super professional. You hardly can find something better!!!
Thanks to Jose!!!!!

Sparkling clean, very accurate description. Great location. 15-20 minute to Ribeira , Luis Bridge on foot. Mezzanine Apartments is a must stay in Porto. For those who have time, also consider checking out Douro Valley for a day tour

Really great spot with great bus service and easy to navigate around Porto.
Lovely flat and helpful host
Great time had !

José's place was perfect for our few days in Porto. It was very close to the old city and it was also nice to actually be in a real neighborhood as well. Nice space, very clean and communication with José was easy and fast. He also met us in person and was very welcoming. Obrigado!

Adorable place in a great location.  If driving, be prepared to park a block or two away.  We didn't have a problem finding a spot to park but it depends on the time of day/night as to how far away you might find something.  We walked almost everywhere and enjoyed all the little shops in the area.  So much to see in Porto!
Such a lovely apartment in a great location. Restaurant recommendations were fabulous. An easy walk to local places and not too far from the centre of town. We would stay again.
It is close to the center, smelled great, had kitchen equipment. The host was very helpful and friendly, I’d recommend it to couples!

Stylish appartment near the city center, looks exactly the same as the photos. Very clean and cosy, comfy bed and nice bathroom. Jose is really caring and lovely host. Only one thing to consider (which is definitely not the host's fault) - it is right by quite busy street (three lanes) so nothing for light sleepers. However, it is near metro station and many good restaurants and cafes and the city center was easily reachable by walk.

We had a great time! The accommodation was gorgeous and exactly as shown in the pictures. Due to the excellent location it was easy to walk around Porto. Also, the self-check in made it easy to arrive and leave at any time.

We had a great stay here. We liked the location a lot because it wasn’t super loud or right in the center so we got to explore less busy/touristy places but also be a quick walk to the center. The hosts were great and everything was super clean. Thanks for an awesome time and would totally recommend

José was a great host and so was his flat. Quiet location, far enough from Porto's busy streets yet close enough to walk. Clear instructions and communication, always responsive. José was very kind to let us have a late check-out. Great stay. Beautiful building
Great apartment that had everything we needed for a short stay. Was quiet, clean and safe and the host very proactive and responsive. Definitely recommend.

It was fine.
No oven in kitchen, just a microwave.
Dining seat uncomfortable.

We stayed there for 4 nights and we loved our stay! Everything is as described, the hosts were responsive and were even able to provide us with extra towels at our request. The city itself is humid so you might want to keep the AC on dry mode at all times. They also have umbrellas for the rainy days. Walking to the city centre takes 15 minutes and it’s safe to walk at night. Overall, I would come back there again and I would highly recommend this place to others!

I had a great stay here. I loved the neighborhood because it was close to the city center without being in the middle of the chaos itself. The apartment was just as described and the owner was great in communicating with me before and during my stay.
The location is just outside of touristy area, which was what I looked for. The area is dotted with many grocery stores and eateries catered to the locals.

We had a great stay in Porto. The apartment was as described and it was easy to follow the instructions for check-in and -out. We were not bothered by the traffic at night.  Also the location was convenient for walking to all the main attractions. Just what we hoped for!

This place was amazing! It's in a great location just a short walk into the busy centre, but a nice quiet street, which was ideal for us. It was the perfect size for us, as well as beautifully decorated. In fact the whole building was incredible! The balcony was bigger than we expected and it had sun on it all through the day, so it was perfect for breakfast or a few drinks before heading out for dinner.
The check in and check out process was great, with Alano on hand to answer any queries and even checked us in late and held our bags for a few hours when we checked out.
We would 100% stay here again, or one of the other apartments in the building if we return to Porto.

Ana gives her guests a very warm welcome and goes out of her way to help your holiday go well.  The accommodation is well placed for exploring Porto City and all the surrounding beautiful beaches and countryside. Only 15 mins drive to Airport. The apartment was homely and well equipped with most items you are likely to need.  Wifi excellent.

The house is in a quiet residential area.  It is perfectly fine to park in front of or near the house.  There is everything for cooking. Washing powder and softener are slso provided.  A big supermarket is within walking distance. The host is nice with promptly reply.

Me and my son stayed in YourPlace during the Nation Leagues games. Checkin in the night was not a problem. Ana also helped great on questions about public transport. She is a great host. YourPlace is very clean and enough space. It takes almost half hour to go to Porto centre by bus. Was no problem for us. I recommend this place.

Beautiful small apartment, very clean, with a well-equipped kitchen, small living-room area and a super comfortable bed. The apartment is located in a quiet area, very close to a metro station but it's also possible to walk to the city center which takes about 15 to 20 minutes.
