Everything was perfect, we would definitely stay here again.
Nice place to be while you are in Porto. Good host, who respected our extra wish. Recommend highly.

Very nice and clean room with air conditioning! If we had questions the responses were really fast and additionally Anabela and her team provided us with interesting tipps for our trip. I definetely recomment booking this apartement!

Apartament is perfect for a trip in Porto. There is everything you can image and even more. House is very nice, clean and comfortable! Antonio is a super host, always available and kind, we were lucky to stay here.
We've had a great time at António's apartment. It was spotlessly clean and spacious, and the location was excellent. His communication was very clear and prompt. I definitely recommend his place.
The apartment is clean and well equipped. It is only a short walk to downtown. The neighborhood felt safe. There are some cafes, stores, and a nice park very close to the apartment.
Nice apartment, 4 min walking from a metro station and 15-20 min walking to Porto downtown. The apartment is equipped with all you would need. Overall,  good stay for reasonable price.

1st time in Porto , and had an amazing time. The apartment smells really good , spotless and clean. Very comfortable bed easy to get in the accommodation and Antonio is very responsive. I very highly recommend this listing it’s all I wanted . Convenient, calm and clean ✅
The apartment is cozy for a short stay and has all the necessary equipment. The host is kind and very responsive. The only minus is the occasional smell that comes from the shower.
Nice flat, kitchen has everything you need. Comfortable bed and pillows, no noise at all.
We enjoyed a very nice week in Espinho and Daniela's place was a great place to stay!
Daniela is a great host with a wonderful home, we felt at home immediately. Great location for the beach, restaurants and all amenities - Daniela provides lots of recommendations. Highly recommended.

I highly recommend this Appartement because it is very lovely, very clean, and top located to walk to almost every place you want to see. There is a supermarket near and some shops and nice cafes. In the evening it is a little bit noisy but totally fine! You have to know this when you live in the center...We would always come back here. The Host was very nice and the communication quick and also very nice!
Wonderful apartment within a good location. It’s close to everything we wanted to checkout from museums, stores to restaurants. Would come back every time.

I would highly recommend this place to everyone. The apartment is in the city center - on the main street and you can walk everywhere you want. The apartment is really nice, well equipped, and with a lot of natural light. There was no noise at night. We really appreciated the self-check-in option. We stayed there for 3 nights and was lovely.

Very nice place.
No private owner and check in.
Can be noisy but thats part of the location.
Clean modern little flat with everything two people need.Great position ,a short walk into town and or along the river to the Riberia

Overall, the apartment is very clean and conveniently located.  Photos from the listing are representative of the entire building (has multiple rentals) as opposed to the rental itself.  The space was smaller than expected.
Perfect location. 10 minute walk from all the attractions, on a fairly quiet street with a beautiful view of the riviera. There is also a great little cafe downstairs. 100% as advertised!

A really lovely spot to hang out and explore the city from.
Self check in really helps for these mini breaks so that you can quickly drop bags and start enjoying the area.
Amazing views of Porto are afforded just outside the building.
Great value for a comfortable stay.

Thierry and Nastia‘s place was exactly what we wanted and needed. The communication and check in was super easy. We got a lot of great recommendations! The location is in a quiet area with an amazing view over Porto and only walking distance to the city center.
I can really recommend to stay there

Location is excellent, flat is small but has everything you need. There are two shops/cafes right next to the flat.
Only criticism or perhaps even suggestion I would offer, is to have complimentary bottled water for guests on arrival. We arrived after 2am after travelling for almost 10 hours, a glass of cool water on arrival is something that would make a world of difference to your guests.

Nice little apartment, good location to discover the city by foot
Good communication and tips for our stay in Porto
very comfortable place just off the beaten path but close enough to all of the great attractions. a super place to stay in Porto.

Lovely apartment for a city break in beautiful Porto. Our hosts helped us in sharing information about where we could leave our luggage and accommodated an early check in for us. Our host also shared lots of recommendations and ways of travelling around the city which was really helpful. Really clean, great location and a superb view out onto the river. Would definitely recommend.

The house is very clean and bigger than we thought. It's  in a good location. Luis&Madalena's brother-in-law welcomed us in the apartment, they are really kind,helpful and gave us lots of information about the city.

The apartment is truly great. The location is very convenient, everything necessary is available, check-in and check-out are easy.
Communication should be mentioned separately, it's lightning quick and totally helpful. And all the tips we got from Luis & Madalena's co-hosts when checking in brought clear structure to our visit, it's not possible to expect more.
Overall, we got an outstanding experience and would definitely recommend their place!

Very nice apartment, clean, pleasant hosts, highly recommended.
Samuel and Olga Krnac

We had a short, but very enjoyable stay in Luis and Madalena’s apartment. They awaited us on our arrival, helped us with paying for our parking space and gave us great tips for our stay. We even received a taste of the local Port and a delicious local pastry as a welcome treat.
Everything in the apartment was clean, tastefully furnished and the bed was very comfortable. The apartment is close to the centre, everything is in walking distance. We would always come again! Thank you!
Luis and Madalena are great hosts, they went out of their way to make us feel at home.  The location is perfect, easy walking to the main tourist areas and very close to the Trinidad metro station.

I stayed here for a month and it was delightful! Madalena is such a great host and the space is just what I needed. Very close/walking to most sites and loads of good eats!
She truly cares about her hosting and I would stay again.

I stayed at Luis and Madalena's place for a month. It was a very pleasant experience. I felt at home. the location is exactly what I needed. 5 min away from the gym and chain supermarket. lots of local shops, restaurants, coffee shops, and entertainments around. walking distance (if you are a fan of walking) to almost everywhere.
This young couple is very nice and helpful people. they made my stay a memorable time. I will be back in Porto and I do my best to get to this place again.

We worked with Pedro this trip and he was amazingly quick and responsive with check in and questions. The place is clean and extremely convenient to public transportation. Located in the middle of everything and all neighborhoods  are a quick walk from the apartment.

We were warmly welcome by Pedro who was very nice and available from the booking to the check-in. Pedro took time to give us the best places and sights to visit we really appreciated the explanations.
Regarding the apartment, it was as described in the description, which means, supplied with all the necessary things you need during a stay. (Towels, soap, appliances…) .
The kitchen is fully usable with all the ustensiles needed.
The accommodation is also spacious for three (2 adults+ 1 Toddler).
The strong point is its location next to Trindad the city center metro station.
I would recommend without hesitation this place for those who would like to visit Porto!

our stay was lovely and the apartment was perfect for us. the location was very good within a walking distance to everywhere touristy. it is in a building with other residents above which can be noisy but it's understandable. the amenities are all good and the place was comfortable with everything we needed. the shower was good and good water pressure. the place also had a heater so that came in handy on sime of the slightly chilly nights. thank you for having us we would definitely like to be returning to this place when back. thank you!!

Great location, just far enough away from the hustle and bustle but close to walk everywhere. The view was amazing from the balcony. The condo is extremely clean and modern and has all the amenities one might need.
Lovely modern flat in good convenient location with a parking spot Easy to walk to all the sights of the city from here Liked the balcony views most of all The place has the amenities you need

What a wonderful apartment. Everything required - and much more. Porto is a beautiful city. Would love to make a Douro river trip.
Restaurants fantastic. Uber so available and cheap. All in all a great 5 days break.
Highly recommended. Excellent location for exploring the town, modern, clean, warm, great views, secure, lift. Welcome very professional and friendly.
Amazing stay. Location, views, and apartment were all great. Wouldn’t have changed a thing!
Very nice apartment, cool view of the river and bridges and great city centre location. Nice welcome.

The apartment is very pretty and situated very well. We especially liked the balcony with the nice view on the river. At the check-in we received great tips about the best activities in Porto. I can totally recommend this AirBnB.
The apartment was well-located for the centre of Porto while being quiet. We loved the beautiful view of the Douro!

The apartment has a lovely view of the river and the area from the living room and balcony. The location is quiet and reasonably convenient to main areas of Porto. The living room and dining area are very comfortable. However, the lighting in the kitchen and bathroom is inadequate and the counter in the bathroom needs to be upgraded.

Stunning view, excellent location, and spacious.  Bathroom needs updating.  The panini press is a nice touch!  Don’t rent a large/wide car or you’ll have trouble getting out of your car after parking it, but that parking spot is such an asset!

Great location for walking around Porto and visiting Gaia too. The apartment has really stunning views of the Duoro river. If you have a rental car like we did, the parking is ideal and easily accessible. Thank you to our lovely host, who checked us in quite late as our flight was delayed! We really enjoyed our stay in Porto and will be back soon!

Nice stay in this destination. I liked staying by the water front and having easy access to everything close by, including the waterfront, restaurants and bars, as well as sites.
2 areas of improvements: having automated checkin would be nice and having a more updated bathroom. Relatively minor things overall.
We enjoyed our time in Porto and the apartment  had everything we needed. It was also well placed , in easy walking distance to the rail station and all the main sights.

Clean and cozy place in a very quiet and secure building. Lovely view of the river and easy walking distance to the Old Town area and restaurants. We met Sandra and she was very helpful. The place had everything we needed. We would definitely stay again.
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Loved drinking our coffee on the patio overlooking the river. Hosts were responsive and helpful. Would stay here again!
The apartment was what we needed for our family. The property matches the description and it was close to the city centre. I'd recommend it to anyone visiting Proto.

Just as described…! Clean and spacious just perfect for me and my other half! Very close to main areas…within walking distance… Maria is a great host and very easy to communicate with her.  Thank you Maria…we had an awesome time in Porto…

As soon as we checked in we knew we would love staying here. The apartment was clean and had everything we could need for a three night stay in Porto. Greta location and an amazing view of the River! Can’t wait to come back and stay here again!

Fantastic place for our first trip to Porto! The location is convenient, the apartment was well-appointed, and everything was very comfortable. Our host was very helpful in getting us oriented to Porto and the surrounding area. We are looking forward to planning our next visit!

The apartment was clean, great bed and shower. It was within walking distance of everything. Being able to park the car in the apartment garage was a plus. Maria was great and available and very helpful. I would stay here again. Book this place if you have the chance.

Clean, spacious apartment with a great location near most of the major sites.
The biggest attraction is the balcony overlooking the Douro River. Wonderful sunrises and misty mornings over the river - the perfect place to enjoy a glass of wine at the end of the day or coffee in the morning.
My only concern was the limited amount of hot water.
I would definitely recommend this as a first choice for Porto.

One of the best places I have stayed on Airbnb, great and spacious apartment overlooking the river. Perfect location for exploring Porto. Check in and communication with the host was easy and straightforward. Thoroughly recommend and would definitely be back if I come again to Porto!

Very nice position, close to lots of Porto's attractions. The room was large and the place was clean. Rita was very quick in responses, and gave lots of nice tips about places to see in the city. Recommended!
We spent a week in Porto. The room is close to everything in the center. The room is very spacious and bright. There sometimes we’re noise on the street but it was all in all very ok. We recommend !

Ines is very kind and very quick responding! The accomodation was clean, nice and the room quite bigger than it seems on the photos. Also it has very nice light because of many windows and we loved it.
Ines gave us a very good contact to wonderful surf teacher so she help us to fulfill our surf dream.
Also she gave us list of many places we should visit and we visited most of them and they were very amazing!
So we racommend this place a lot.
Thank you Ines!

The location of this apartment was great - walking distance to everything. The room itself was very big, bright, and clean.  It was a little cold so bring layers if the weather calls for it. I would stay here again.
Lovely suit. Everything is around, all historical buildings, also great bars and restaurants. Few minutes walk down to the river!

Ines is a very kind and friendly host. Before and during our stay the communication was very fast and smooth. She gave us a lot of recommdations for restaurants, bars and must see places. The room is spacious, clean and has everything that you might need.
Everything was more than perfect and I would recommend the place.

Even though we didn’t met in person due to Covid, Inês was super helpful, gave many recommendations for food etc.
The location is super central so you can reach everything by foot!
I can really recommend the place!
We had an amazing time! It’s in a great location and Inês had some great recommendations on things to do and food to try!
Lovely and spacious room with a comfortable bed and clean sheets. Located right in the city centre. WiFi was a bit spotty. No access to kitchen.

Perfect location in the heart of the city. Very clean and the room was spacious. Inês was so nice and gave us great recommendations of things to do and see to make our trip even better! Highly recommend, it was a very comfortable stay!!

We had a comfortable stay at Inês' place. The location was perfect and Inês was very responsive and friendly. However, with the central location comes noise, so for light sleepers it might be difficult.

I loved my stay at Ines place, the location was absolutely perfect and central. The room was exactly as described and great having my own bathroom. Ines also allowed me to use the room on the day of check out after I’d been out on a day tour, I was able to store my belongings and check out later . Totally recommend this place and would stay again if I came back

Perfect place to stay for a couple of days as a couple. The place looked even better than in the photos and the location is right in the center. The one and only downside is that it can be a bit loud in the evenings, but there’s hardly anything Inês could do about this.

Very clean and tidy place to stay in a central location, with a communicative host! The place was spotless and comfy.
Only small con, was that is a was a bit noisy. There is a bar underneath the accommodation and there is also some construction across the street.

The flat was absolutely spotless, the decoration is very charming and tasteful, stocked with fantastic wine. it is a very confortable flat and the team is very responsive and accommodating. I strongly recommend.
Another stay at Filipe's gorgeous apartment.  Perfectly located and a beautiful, relaxing, light-filled space.
The appartement was beautiful, in the heart of Porto. It had al the comforts you need.
This is a beautiful apartment perfectly located in Porto and is accessible to all major sites. Many outstanding restaurants are nearby by. The hosts are very accommodating and very professional.

This is a spacious apartment with high ceilings, conveniently located in the centre of Porto, easy to access form the airport and within walking distance of all the sites in central Porto. Communication was great and the self check-in was easy and convenient. A great place to stay!

Excellent location and communication!  Very quiet and clean.  Comfortable bed.  Didn't see a washing machine in the apartment but perhaps there is a shared one somewhere in the building.  Highly recommend this place.

Would definitely come back to stay here! We had a week in the apartment, which was a great place for exploring Porto, as well as staying in the apartment and relax. Super WiFi connection. Hosts are very responsive and helpful. Thank you very much a nice stay.

This apartment is perfect! It’s nice and bright, very nicely decorated and has everything you need. The location is very good right in the middle of Porto. We had a welcome gift waiting for us with port wine, water and coffee. Communication was very easy and we definitely recommend this apartment!

The hosts made our experience in Porto fantastic, and told us everything we needed, or didn’t know we wanted to know (: . We felt very well taken care of, and the apartment is fantastic! Thank you a lot!
good location and it was a very nice trip. I hope I will find time to come back again.
Overall a really nice spacious place with modern furniture and bathroom. The seagulls behind the building can be very noisy so sleeping with windows shut was a must for us.
Wonderful and absolutely recommended!!! Comfortable bed, perfect location, great couch, perfectly appointed. Will have this saved for our next Porto trip!
A very nice flat, clean and very well located. The hosts are very friendly and communicative. We would come again.

Lovely, well-appointed place in nice location close to train station but not in the super busy central hub. We appreciated the amenities in the kitchen and the decor. A fan in bedroom or some way to keep windows open and flies out of bedroom would have been ideal to improve air circulation. Overall a great stay!
A great spot to stay in central Porto. Everything is within walking distance. Very spacious rooms, with tons of space on the balcony which is hard to find in Europe.

We stayed at this apartment during our last visit to Porto and liked it so much we came back! The location is perfect and everything is as described. It's a beautiful historical space with modern amenities.

Wonderful AirBnB experience! Location is central to everything you need/want to see, they provided an extensive book with recommendations to eat/visit/see, and a wonderful apartment with all necessities. We even had a mishap where the glass shower door (quite literally) exploded into the main room and within an hour of contacting the host we were in an identical apartment with a discount to our room. 12/10 experience and will absolutely book again next time we visit Porto!

Had a great stay here! Worked remotely for the week and the internet worked perfectly. Was a perfect home away from home in a very walkable part of Porto. Very close to the action but not right in it which was nice that it wasn’t super noisy. Would stay here again!
Excellent location plenty of restaurants nearby. Easy access to the best sights of the city and near to metro for sights further away.

Location was easy to find and to get in. Popular area with lots of restaurants, bars, and shopping to keep you entertained. They had great instructions in all aspects so you can’t really be mad, and it felt super safe. The actual apartment was clean and beautiful, very mid-century modern. The tenants left three wines you could purchase and leave cash for which was a beautiful touch. All the extra information for the city, and neighborhood was wonderful and extremely useful. We really only have small complaints. The television situation, it wouldn’t connect to internet or really access anything but we weren’t really in Porto to watch television, would of been nice when we were relaxing though. The couch wasn’t comfortable at all, and the bed was pretty thin. Like most locations in Portugal, it was easy to hear our neighbors next door unfortunately but in all it was a great stay and we are just being completely honest in our review of the location.

We had a lovely stay, the flat is as described.   The location is great, the market and metro stop are just around the corner but avoiding the building work for the new metro line that seems to be taking over much of the city centre. The check in information was clear but we did get a little confused arriving later than planned after a delayed flight so would suggest paying close attention when arriving. We really enjoyed the balcony, while a little urban it was lovely to have somewhere to sit on a sunny morning.
Great location, everything you want to see in Porto is walking distance. Easy underground parking across the street. Responsive and helpful host

Very nice apartment with a beautiful balcony and comfy sleep accomodations. The apartment is a bit loud, so you can hear the upstairs neighbor and people in the hall way. Besides that a very nice place.
Stayed here for almost a week and it had everything I needed. Great location and the AC and washer were big pluses. Responsive hosts too.

This is a great place and is just as shown in the photos! Next door is a friendly cafe where you can get a cheap yet filling breakfast and it is very close to a number of other restaurants and a small brewery! Perfect to use as a base to explore Porto.
Very clean. Very stylish. Well located. Coffee places around and a very good restaurant just in front. The only thing is that it was smelling very bad (sewage odors).
We loved our stay here! The apartment was so cute & stylish - the location was amazing = double winning. Our host was really helpful and accommodating with check in! Would stay here again!

The studio apartment is really nice and spacious. Check in went smoothly and Ed always responded super quickly. He also organised a parking space because the apartment’s car park was full. I recommend!

Everything was as advertised, the apartment was super clean and the space was lovely; perfect for what we needed.
Eduardo was super quick to reply to all our messages which made the whole trip so much smoother, so thank you!

Probably one of the best airbnbs we've started at in a city. Excellent communication, cleanliness, and amenities. The location was absolutely IDEAL. Quick 5-10 min walk from the bridge and all the attractions/restaurants/center. Free parking definitely a plus since we had a rental car. If you're in Porto, this place is a no-brainer!

Nice place, clean and tidy. Looks exactly like on pictures. Great location, right in the middle of the historic area of Porto. The host was really nice, sorted out parking space last minute and we even had a bottle of wine waiting for us in the room. Would definitely recommend.

Location is excellent. Apartment was clean, well maintained, and well furnished. Hosts was excellent in communication, and checking in and out was a breeze.
Would love to stay again at this place when we are back.
Very nice apartment in a great location.  Appreciated the help checking in and getting our car parked.

Perfect place to stay! It was comfortable and neat. It’s next door to a cafe if you’re looking to have breakfast outside the apartment. Walking distance from the historical centre and the riverside. I’d be looking to stay here again when I return for another visit.
The place is well located,  the appartment was very clean , judite and pedro were very friendly, helpful persons. We absolutely recommend their place.
Judite’s apartments are exactly like described in Airbnb, she is a great host, everything was perfect. Nothing to add.

Judite’s apartment was absolutely great! Exactly like described, very clean, located in a premium area, plus there were lots of activities to do nearby. Highly recommend staying at these Porto Deluxe apartments.
Lovely apartment with great balcony and pool access. Great central location. Everything is walkable and close to the metro and train. Hosts were very helpful, friendly and responsive.
Brilliant location and nice & clean flat. Was perfect for the 3 of us. The hosts were very responsive which was great. Would recommend this place to someone visiting Porto!

Great stay at Bom Jardim, flat is superb, location is really convenient and hosts are extremely friendly and responsive.
Just a note that houses on each side of the building are undergoing big construction works - and works start ~08:30 during the week.

Really lovely flat, I'd say nicer than the photos even! The balcony is amazing and faces the sunset.. Really clean and had everything we could need. My husband even said he'd come back to Porto just to stay here again. The location is really great, just outside the main centre and very quiet. Check in was super convenient.

Be careful!
You may find yourself spending more time inside than exploring Porto! 😅
We couldn’t of ask for a better stay so I’m very grateful for the experience here and will recommend to all!
Pedro and Leonor have been accommodating during our stay. The location was ideally located, and we will come back for sure.

Pedro and Leonor were wonderful and considerate hosts.
Their place is full of light, stock with everything you may need and decorated with fine taste.
We enjoyed sitting on the terrasse overlooking beautiful green gardens.
Cedofeita street is just a fun street to live and walking distance to the historic center.
We stayed 6 weeks and the place was cleaned every 2 weeks.
We do recommend this place.

Pedro and Leonor's apartment is beautiful, artful, and well located for touring central Porto.  Even though it is on a very busy street, inside it provides a calming escape from summer tourist crowds.

The apartment is a very special mix of old architecture and modern, tasteful interior, with much thought to detail. We enjoyed the tranquility in our apartment and the beautiful garden. We didn’t meet Pedro in person, but we were welcomed with a bottle of wine and he made sure we had everything we needed. Very friendly and thoughtful! The area is perfect as well. Nice restaurants, bars and small shops and all the tourist destinations in walking distance. Would definitely come again!

Pedro & Leonor’s “sewing apartment” is one of the nicest places we have ever stayed in! I would very much recommend it to anyone. The building is beautifully designed, the flat is decorated with so much taste and attention to detail and the garden is like a little oasis within the city of Porto. Petro & Leonor are wonderful hosts. We felt very welcome and at home and will definitely come back.

Pedro and Leonor are excellent hosts, attentive, friendly, they shared tips on the necessary services to have an excellent experience. His apartment is very beautiful, elegant, comfortable, it is an incredible place, it has everything you need. An unbeatable point, close to the main attractions and services. Rua de Cedofeita is a beautiful place to stay. I traveled alone and always felt very safe. I would return without hesitation, 100% recommended.
My parents stayed 10 days in the apartment and were super happy! Easy communication, good location and super friendly owners

Beautifully presented apartment in a really great location. Friendly and responsive hosts. Perhaps not the most comfortable sofa bed - more appropriate for children. Small bedroom but a good base for a couple who are out and about most of the day. Fairly thin walls so you can hear people moving about upstairs but it wasn’t a major concern for us. Lovely view and balcony at the back to enjoy the sunset.

Perfect place to stay for a couple of weeks - such a gorgeous flat and in the perfect location to explore Porto. The garden is a huge bonus too! Pedro and Leonor were lovely and attentive, really helpful if we ever needed anything. Couldn’t recommend it more highly!

Ideal place to stay for a Porto trip, everywhere is very walkable from the apartment and it's in a great area for food and shops. Also easy pickups for taking ubers or bolts to and from the airport. The apartment has everything you might need - big shower, comfy bed, clean kitchen, beautiful balcony with private garden views. We had a great time - thank you!

It's a nice place, new and mordem.
The equipments are good and comfortable bed to sleep! It's a nice choice!

Cosy and new appartement! It has everything you need...and very clean! The contact was fast!
I can recommend it!

We had a wonderful stay here. It’s a short walk to the middle of the historic part of town (circa 15 -20 mins) but much quieter for it, we were never disturbed by noise and the studio itself is very stylish. Shower is amazing
The apartment was beautiful, comfortable and well appointed.  The check in process was excellent and many great local tips were provided.
Very stylish place, comfy bed and bright. Check in was perfect and shower was nice and warm.
We loved this space. Why? Good location, modern apartment, sparkly clean. I would return!

Small but well equiped apartment. 10min walk from the historic center. The only drawback is that it is located on a busy street. Passing traffic is rather loud and therefore it wasn't always ideal to open the windows.

Great house, very convenient for groups in a quiet village.
Nice pool and great BBQ.
Paulo and Ana are perfect hosts. They are always helpful and very reactive.

Absolutely perfect place. Even better than the pictures suggest. We had 11 people and plenty of space for everyone to be comfortable. There’s a shop and nice bakery/cafe 10 min walk away. Otherwise a car is a good idea to explore the area.

Quinta O Riacho is just as beautiful as we had hoped! We used it for a week-long family gathering, and it had more than enough space. We had rental cars, so we were able to enjoy the picturesque location, buying fresh bread every morning from the bakery that is a 2 minute drive away.
If you like a quiet, secluded stone house, in nature with wonderful gardening, amazing location by the stream…. This is the place for you.
We really enjoyed our time in Villa Loios!  The place is newly renovated, very stylish, comfortable and have an excellent location.

This is an excellent 2-bedroom apartment for anyone traveling with friends or colleagues. Highly recommend. The place is just as advertised: spacious (with two queen-sized beds) and immaculately clean. Very nice terrance on the top floor overlooking some of Porto - great place for a morning coffee or a glass of wine in the evening.
Location is perfect for anyone visiting town. It is right up the street from S. Bento train station and is walkable to most key sites in the city if you're doing touristy things. It's also very close to bars and restaurants, all of which are within a 5-10 block walk.
Hosts are proactive and helpful with all aspects of the stay, from check-in through check-out.

We had a really comfortable stay in this Airbnb. Lots of space, super clean, and super conveniently located to everything in Porto. It's definitely in the thick of the tourist area so expect that you'll likely have to walk a block or so with your luggage to get to/from a cab but so long as you're up for that, this place is perfection. Not only was it super centrally located but it also has a great common area for gathering in the evenings. Also, the communication with the host was easy and quick. Thank you for a great stay!

Location was perfect. 2 restaurants below great food at both. And 2 perfect little bars. We walk to all attractions from the apt. We really loved the apt, its very well maintained. It’s a big apt for the city. The communication was excellent!!

The apartment is beautiful. Honestly one of the better places I have stayed.
It was a great experience, well organised and in a great location. You can walk everywhere from here. Lovely hospitality and great communication. The place was very clean and had everything you need for the perfect stay in Porto. Early morning coffee on the balcony was my favourite highlight. Thank you so much guys.

Great spot in the center of everything in Porto. Plenty of room. The kitchen and living room are upstairs but the setup was perfect for us. The host was very friendly, gave us some local recommendations, and was responsive. Great stay!
Great apartment that was centrally located.  Really helpful and knowledgeable staff - useful in having somewhere to drop cases before return journey

The apartments location is a perfect base to explore Porto, it has been designed well with the living space upstairs with a terrace view of the city and is fitted out with period furniture that offers a relaxing haven after a day of sightseeing. The bedrooms are well proportioned and comfortable, the bathrooms and kitchen have everything you need to make a stay special.

Wonderful apartment with balcony.
Very cosy, well furnished and well located to visit the city.
just perfect and comfortable !
Recommend !!!
Would definitely recommend this beautiful apartment. Was quiet and much bigger than expected! Great views from the Terrace.

The apartment is stunning, full of cool, comfortable, retro furniture. The position is perfect to discover the city centre, everything is so close. The girls on reception where we picked up the keys couldn't have been more helpful and were always on hand if we had any questions. We haven't been to Porto before, but we will be back! Overall 10/10.

Cristina's loft is absolutely stunning. As soon as we walked in, we were planning out next trip to Porto to stay there. We traveled with our one-year-old son, who was delighted with the amount of space to explore. The art, decor, and furniture are all top-notch, quite aside from the magisterial views of the city's historic center. The only minor glitches to note are some difficulty with water pressure in the shower, and the fact that there isn't an elevator in getting to the fourth floor. For us, the trek up and down the stairs with our luggage was well worth it!

Perfect location, a great space, and a wonderful view. The listing was extremely spacious and well decorated. The views from the balcony were fantastic. The location couldn't be better, overlooking the city and a short walk to both the river and the more central restaurants.
There was a problem with the water pressure during our stay, which is the only reason I'm not leaving a 5 star review. Christina was responsive to the issue.

The pictures—as wonderful as they are—don’t do it justice! Such a beautiful Airbnb with the best view in Porto. Cristina is a responsive and attentive host. The AC is cool, the noise nonexistent, and the city at your fingertips! A must stay :)

Luxurious, spacious, and beautifully decorated penthouse with a panoramic view it Porto! Staying in this gem of a home was a highlight of our trip. We loved playing the well-maintained grand piano and drinking port on the roof at sunset. Walkable to riverside dining, fado concerts and historic architecture.
It’s a wonderful apartment, very special. Sol was extremely helpful when we had questions. The location is very close to the bridge, the river and the cathedral . Highly recommended

Not sure there is a better location in Porto. If you’re a couple or small family traveling to Porto, take this place if available. The location and terrace alone make this 5 star. We had a great stay, thank you.

We stayed for 10 days and enjoyed every one of them. The location is perfect and the view unbeatable. The loft was exactly as described and very clean. The check-in and response to any of our needs was immediate. Would not hesitate to recommend it to any of our family or friends and definitely try to stay in this loft again when in town.

Very nice place and great location — recommended.  The only thing is the nice terrace needs to be cleaned because of birds there.  Otherwise, we really had a very nice time in this appartment, enjoying the great views, nice big place, absolutely best location!  Thank you!

Loved the stay here. The view every day was one of my favorites. Saw the sunset every day from the balcony. I would stay here again and definitely recommend. We had a car rental and parking became easy. Always parked in the street in front of the place and parking is free after 7pm to 9am.

The location is good and the house is very beautiful and clean.
Host is very kind and responsive.
I was able to have good memories in Porto and will stay here again the next time I visit Porto.
Beautiful apartment. Thoughtfully designed. Homey touches. Bigger than it looks. Great neighborhood with restaurants, bars, supermarket very close by. Metro is five minute walk. Loved the apartment.

An amazing 4 days in Porto which Pedro and Leonor helped make it a success. Their Apt was spectacular and was the perfect place to rest and recharge for sightseeing. The host made sure we were comfortable and answered any questions we had immediately. The Apt was exactly as advertised and even better. The location was perfect and I liked that it was on a walking street with a grocery store and restaurants close by. What a pleasant experience and I really thank Pedro and Leonor.
The views are everything you'd want.  This was absolutely the cleanest place I have ever stayed at.  The kitchen is stocked for coffee and tea.
This is probably one of the best views for an Airbnb that I have ever seen. The location is perfect and just enjoy the views! Very very clean!

Super place with great views, sunny and short walk to key sights in Porto!!  Space was very clean, stylish and had everything we needed, including a great parking space.  Hosts responded quickly and were very helpful.  Two bathrooms were a plus for the 2 bedroom unit.  Highly recommended and would stay again.  Thank you!!
This is a great place to stay. Beds are comfortable and spacious. View is awesome. Location is great.  Home is very clean.  We would stay there again.

The view is worth EVERYTHING!!! cute little place close to the river and all the restaurants surrounding it. Cute little cafe next door for early morning coffee. Also close to the bridge and the telefrique. Marcelo is so helpful and quick to reply. Even helped book our taxi to the airport at 3 am! Would highly recommend and would use this air bnb again!

We spent three nights in MArcelo's apartment. The apartment is reallly comfortable, exactly like described on the site. We enjoyed the amazing view on Porto and all Porto's touristic curiosities are very close.
Marcelo has been very available for us during our stay to answer our questions.

We think that location of this apartment is one of the best possible, especially if you travel by car and need parking.  Apartment was clean and ready by check-in time. The view from the balcony was incredible. It was only about 8-10 minutes walk to Ribeira (Porto riverfront tourist area).

The location and view were stunning! The list of suggestions Marcelo provided about local places was very helpful and the apartment was attractive and comfortable. Marcelo was very helpful. We had a great stay.

Without the best view of Porto old town. Directly above the port warehouses and restaurants and a short walk over the bridge to the main city
Our hosts were very responsive and made sure we knew everything relevant to our stay
Highly recommended..even in the mists and light rains of the area!
Amazing place! Best view of the city. Place felt big, super clean and the hosts were perfect!
This was a great place to stay! Fantastic views, and lovely and clean. Hosts were really helpful and quick to respond to queries. Would completely recommend

Great location, with an amazing view of the river and Porto, and very close to all the Port wine cellars. The apartment is very well kept.
Communication was great, checked in without any issues, Marcelo was always quick to reply when I had questions.
I definitely recommend staying here!

This was a fantastic place to stay. By far the best view of Porto and much less busy, with just a quick and beautiful walk over the bridge to see the sights. Clean place and attentive hosts. Would absolutely recommend!!
we really enjoyed our stay in the appartment. It was comfortabele, clean and the view is just fantastic!!!
Apart from the amazing view, the apartment hasn’t got that much going for it, very bare bones.

Wonderful, bright, quiet and cheerful accommodation in a fabulous location. And, Oporto is a really fabulous little city and if you like walking…..you have arrived! The hosts were very caring and considerate.

Location: I would rate 5 out of 5.
5 min walk to famous Porto wine cellar, and Louis bridge. The view at rooftop is amazing, stunning, completely worthy every penny we spent. Due to the view, we don’t need to stay under the sun at Louis bridge. We can easily enjoy sunset at rooftop, talking with friends and drinking. The rooms inside are comfortable, cozy, but toooooo clean.
Super clean unit and fantastic location! Host was very communicative with us and accommodated our reservation within a 24 hour period. Would stay here again!

Excellent base for exploring Porto , amazing view from the balcony. 5 mins from public transport but walkable into old town in 15 mins or the port houses in about 10.
Clean and comfortable with all the visits required for your stay.
Really good communication from the host and super easy check in.

This was the most amazing Airbnb I have ever stayed in! We thought the pictures of the view and the space were too good to be true given the price but they were 100% accurate. The flat was amazing and nothing can beat the beautiful views of Porto through the bedroom windows/balcony. Marcelo was very quick to respond and assist with our needs. He also sent a long list of recommendations, given it was our first time in Porto! I cannot recommend this place and Marcelo enough! Thank you for making our trip truly amazing!

My family of 4 loved our stay! We arrived just at sunset and the views are stunning and beautiful. The bedding and towels also smelled so good!
Highly recommend!
The place is really well located, with a great view! Marcelo and Ana were very attentive.

We spent a month in the apartment and had a great time. Daniel and Adriano are very attentive and respond very quickly. The place was well furnished, decorated and equipped. The apartment is close to downtown, two metro stations, grocery shopping and places of interest. Also, the apartment is very quiet thanks to its location and double sliding doors that face a big patio. We definitely recommend this place.
Good apartment, in quiet residential area!! Very good tips and easy communication! Only one thing which was bothering me during the nights- no blackouts on the windows.
DA’Home was an excellent place to explore Porto. It was close to the end of the main shopping street.  It was very pleasant to come back to and rest after a day of exploring this beautiful city.

Very cute, comfortable apartment. My husband and I enjoyed it very much. The terrace is lovely for having breakfast. Location is good, super close to the metro. There were a couple cleanliness issues, but hopefully that will be taken care of for the next guest. Overall nice stay!

This is one of the best appartment I’ve had pleasure to stay! Great location, stylish furniture, beautiful terrace, quick answers from host.
Highly recommend.

Great atmosphere, nice apartment and everything clean. A little bit outside of the City center but supermarket and little cafes etc. are very close. The communication with the hosts was flawless. Thanks for everything!

I'll definitely would recommend this apartment!
We stayed there for 2 weeks and enjoyed it so much! Communication with DA'Home was quick, easy and helpful on all our requests. The apartment is very clean, has everything you need to stay short or long term. Stylish, cozy, good value. We like to cook, so we'd appreciated all cooking devises. Also the heating was very helpful, as the winter time in Porto was rainy and cold. Supermarket Pingo Doce is 2 min walk from the apartment and beautiful Quinta do Covelo park 5 min walk.
Thank you for the hospitality! Hope to come back one day :)

We really liked to stay a DA’Home’s!
The apartment was equipped with all that we need, it was easy to get in and most of the attractions were walkable

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos — very clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The terrace/patio was perfect for enjoying meals outside, both for breakfast and dinner. Even though there is no air conditioning, the apartment is very fresh and comfortable. Access was super easy and the communication with the host was perfect from the beginning until the end. Everything worked smoothly and we felt very welcome. When we return to Porto, this will definitely be our first option to stay. Highly recommended!

Thank you so much Pedro! He was the best host we’ve ever met ! He sent me loads of recommendations and links and he was always so quick to respond to me. His place is honestly much better and more spacious than it looks in the photos. We will 100% come back and stay at his airbnb again <3

This apartment is so nice and peaceful, but it is also I the middle of the cooler parts of Porto. The bed was really comfortable. The sun really flooded into the apartment each morning when we opened the shutters.
perfect stay in Porto. Ideal location to discover the town. Very nice balcony to enjoy the breakfast outside. We loved it....

Beautiful apartment that we didn't want to leave. Great, trendy location with lots of stylish coffee shops, restaurants and bars. very comfortable apartment with a lovely balcony we we could have breakfast every morning. Beautifully designed and great communication, Highly recommend. Thank you for a brilliant stay in Porto and Chloe was so helpful at check in.

We had a lovely stay at this beautiful, clean apartment. The bathroom is tiny but fully functional. A few extra hooks and shelves would be good. The location is great, easy walking distance to lots of good spots.

We had a lovely time in Porto and felt very comfortable at the lovely appartment. The communication with Tiago was very quick and the checkin was  easy and flexible. He also gave us very good tips for local restaurants and activities in Porto. The appartment was clean and comfy and the balcony was very nice. Everything is in a walking distance so the appartment was a good starting point for discovering the beautiful city!
We were said to leave this flat. Enjoyed lots of wine and cheese on the terrace and the cozy amenities.
It’s a nice apartment in a good location, walking distance to many attractions. Good communication. I would recommend to stay there.

This is a stylish apartment in a quiet area that is easily walkable to the downtown area. We were surprised and happy to stumble upon two vegan restaurants nearby and a great coffee and pastry shop for the mornings. There is construction in the area which you hear and see from the balcony, but the balcony is very nice to sit on. The apartment was not sparkling clean (lots of dust bunnies and the bathroom wasn’t perfectly clean) but it was ok. Overall fairly happy with the stay.

Mariana's apartment was beautiful and sparkling clean. The furniture was comfortable, and the balcony had sweeping views of the city. The light was amazing in the apartment, and the location was perfect. We could walk to everything in the city, and it was very convenient for restaurants, shopping,  and visiting sites. At the same time, the apartment was quiet despite being in a festive area. The Lovely Stay team was friendly and gave us great tips for restaurants and things to see. There are also maps and a guidebook in the apartment, which is helpful. I highly recommend this place!

We absolutely loved everything about the apartment from the lovely view to the spacious feeling inside. Both mattresses were very comfortable. This is the most quiet city space In which we have stayed. It is exactly as shown in photos.
We stayed there for 2 nights and next time would use it as a base and stay for a week.
Our welcome and orientation could not have been better! Being able to rely on the 4:00 am transfer to the airport meant a lot.
We would highly recommend this 3rd floor apartment!

Our time in Porto couldn’t have been better! Mariana‘s home is the perfect place to discover the city, it has everything you‘d need and also it‘s easy to walk around as it is close to most of the sight‘s. We were welcomed by the very friendly José, even though we arrived quite late. Communication was very easy and all our questions were answered within minutes. So thank you!

We really enjoyed the stay at the apartment. It was a great location close to center (walking distance). Furthermore, the apartment had a fully equipped kitchen and other items which made our stay very convenient. The communication was very well and quick. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay!

Great flat at very central location, perfect for short stays!
Would not necessarily recommend for long stays (>2 weeks) though, because there is no washing machine nor in-house garbage disposal and the kitchen is a little small.

We had a wonderful stay at Mariana’s apartment in Porto. The location was amazing for our 5 day trip. We were in a very hip area with lots of restaurants, bars, and coffee shops. Also, it was very convenient to walk around the city and get to everywhere we needed.
The apartment had the most incredible light throughout the day and the little patio facing the back of the building was ideal to cut out all the hustle and bustle of the street. The apartment was surprisingly large when you got inside and had all the amenities needed to enjoy your stay. You do have to walk up a few flights but it was well worth it for the view and the sun you get when inside. Overall, we had a lovely stay and would welcome another stay at Mariana’s place in Porto.
Great location in the center of everything and by great cafes. Be sure to check the welcome message you receive as the address for key pick up is different than the apartment location.

Great apartment, illuminated, specious, the location is great as there are many bars and restaurants in the area and the apartment is still quiet. Mariana is a great host, the self-checkin instructions were very clear and she responded to our messages quickly and with a friendly vibe. Highly recommended.

Mariana’s Airbnb was in a great location and was super clean and tidy! We also loved the balcony! The only thing that we didn’t like was the fact we only got one towel each for 5 days and when we requested new towels we were told that it would incur a 20 euro fee and there was no washing machine to wash the towels we had!!

Easy and nice. Beautiful view. A touch impersonal for my taste but some might appreciate the hotel-like management of the place. Place overall was comfortable and would gladly recommend. Whole building recently renovated and feels clean. (Neighbor building are in construction/full renovation). Should mention that being on the 3rd floor (4th for usa) there is no elevator, and hard for long term parking access. We did enjoy our short stay! Thank you for having us!

Located at a walking distance from the main tourist attractions and yet at a reasonable distance from the hustle bustle of Porto, the third floor apartment had a lovely view of the Porto cityscape. The apartment itself was very spacious, comfortable, quiet and clean. The bedroom was spacious too and there was a lot of space in the living room for morning yoga with light flooding in through the French windows. The kitchenette was well-equipped. There’s a small balcony too. Mariana is very proactive and ensured that we had a very smooth checkin experience. Definitely recommend this place!
Mariana’s place was fantastic! Great location and beautiful apartment! Ideal for a city getaway!
Lovely place, very cozy with lots of natural light! And the surrounding area offers a lot of nice bars and cafés. We had a great stay there and would recommend it without hesitation :)
WARNING - DO NOT BOOK! Unit is described as a two bedroom apartment, but it only has one bed! When we messaged the airbnb host about the issue, he just ghosted us and stopped responding!
Strategically located around restaurants attractions, and public parking . Easy check in process and the apartment are new and clean.

Carolina was a great host and the apartment was so cute. Just as pictured and I loved the floor the ceiling windows with the balcony. The location was great too. Very close to the river area plus many shops, restaurants, and public transportation right outside. As the listing notes, be mindful there are some stairs to walk up and also the city is very hilly if your are carrying your luggage around. But Carolina was very responsive and accommodating at check in with me.
Exactly as listed. Perfect location, very well organised, good communication. Would return and certainly recommend.

Great apartment in a really ideal location. There is some construction noise that starts in the morning, but it’s not really a bother and half the city seems under construction. There is a garbage pickup quite late at night.
Place is super nice, clean and very central + hosts are very quick in responding therefore communication is pretty good too. Though the noise from the street is a bit loud.

Carolina’s place was absolutely wonderful, it far exceeded our expectations. Her place is meticulously cared for, and is in the perfect location in Porto. You can walk to the river, and right when you walk out of the flat there are adorable cafes.

Great location with lots of excellent restaurants and cafes around. The apartment was spotless, stylish and very comfortable.  Great communication with the hosts and easy checkin.  Great kitchen and bathroom.  All in excellent taste and simplicity.
wonderful location with gorgeous floor to ceiling windows. would stay again. there was loud construction at night, i would double check with hosts if construction is scheduled.

This is a wonderful place to stay in Porto! The location is incredible, right by the water and amazing restaurants. Carolina was so kind and communicative, check in was seamless and she offered us so many recommendations: steak sandwiches, traditional Portuguese cuisine, great spots to just hang out in the city, sunset watching spots... I highly recommend!!

We loved our stay here. The place was very clean. There was a very small lift, you did have to walk up to the first floor to get in it and it was very VERY small but it helped with getting our little one up to the apartment. Some bottled water was in the fridge for us. The little balcony is perfect for people watching. Location is great...excellent for getting to anywhere really. Lots of places around for food and drinks (although we struggled to find anywhere with a highchair!).
The host allowed us use of a travel cot which made things a lot easier for us as less to bring. Also there was a baby bath we used which was helpful as there wasn’t a full size bath we could out him in. Air con/heating was great. A really lovely place!!
Great little apartment in central location but be prepared for some nighttime and early morning noise that comes with the location.
Cute little place a close walk to the water. Easy check in/check out. Great communication and location. We loved our stay!!

Great location, clean, light-filled, lovely apartment, with a comfortable bed. All was as described. The street is noisy with the windows open (great to see what's happening below) but fine with them closed and the air conditioning was effective.

The location is great. The apartment suits for people to whom sleeping under one (thin) blanket is ok.
We were a group of three friends and that I informed the host several times. However, when we arrived in the middle of the night, the preparations were made only for two people. Even the (intact) wine glasses were just two.
A lovely Airbnb apartment equipped with everything you need. Super location, very clean and comfortable. We had a great stay!

It was as great stay, very nice place and Carolina was a very responsive and flexible host. The only downside we experienced was that the construction happening on the street just outside the door gets extremely noisy at night. Make sure to bring some ear plugs if the construction is still ongoing.
Carolina was a wonderful host! We had an issue with the WIFI, but she was eager to help and quick to fix the problem. It is loud at the early hours outside.
Nice apartment, great location! Maybe not for people who are sensitive to noise, since there are construction works just in front of the house and the street is quite busy.

I loved staying here. It’s a perfect location and a comfortable apartment. Carolina warned us about the construction noise and left earplugs for us, which was nice. I would definitely stay here again!

Great location, right in the heart of Porto’s nightlife. I was serenaded by buskers every night and woken up by church bells in the morning. The flat is spacious with lots of light. It gets hot in the afternoon sun, but the AC units work quickly to cool the large space. There’s major construction going on at the time of my stay, but it wasn’t terribly disruptive (save for a couple of building-rumbling tremors from the heavy machinery). Overall, I’d absolutely stay again. Muito obrigada!

The absolute perfect location to discover Porto from.... Carolina's place was clean, spacious, and centrally located. She provided very clear and thorough updates on check-in and check-out. Perfect, seamless AirBnB experience!
Carolina is a nice host, she answers questions quickly and helped us with an earlier check in into the apartment, the apartment is spacious and clean in the very center of the city! we recommend it

Clean, as described and as seen in pictures. There are quite a few stairs, 3 flights, so be prepared to carry your luggage up the stairs. There is a small elevator, very small, but we didn’t try it because it has been broken and we were told we may get stuck in it if we used it. We drove a car and parking is very expensive in the public garage nearby, but it was very close and easy to park.  Overall though it was just what we expected and was perfect for us.

Great location as close to main sights and range of restaurants. We walked everywhere. Lovely view from the balcony and listening to the music in late evenings.
Worth noting that can be noisy at night as metro construction work would take place some nights and lift is not working.
Would recommend others to stay here if they don’t mind the noise and stairs.

We had a lovely weekend at Carolina’s place!
It’s super well located, walking distance from lot of the city’s landmarks!
The place was super centrally located which is a bonus for me, however, it can get a bit noisy at nights. Spacious, pretty place. Kind and caring communication. Definitely worth the stay :)
My family and I stayed at this apartment and absolutely loved it, it is very comfortable and was near many tourist attractions. We would absolutely stay again!

We absolutely loved this place in old town. It was historic and the magnificent floor to ceiling window/doors leading to the wonderful balcony along the full living room and bedroom to a ;th floor view! It is our style. Everything was walkable with 4 min walk to the bridge and lively alleys and shops everywhere.
The street musicians with their speakers have a spot up and across the street that is used all day until 10 so you can hear them at night. So bring earplugs if you are early to bed like us :-)
They should update the sofa/hide-a-bed in the living room as it is not comfortable to sit on as a sofa but not a huge deal.
Carolina was the best!
We would easily stay here again!

If you’re ever going to be staying in Porto you have to stay at one of Andre’s amazing boutique apartments. Centrally locates right opposite Sao Bento station, the rear facing flat I was in was heavenly. Quiet, clean, cosy and comfortable. Andre is charming, attentive host and is always available to offer hints about places to go or practical advice. The bed and bedding were divine and I had a perfect nights sleep. The shower was really powerful and great to use. One thing you need to be aware of is it’s location on the fourth floor. If you have mobility or health problems this may not be for you. Got the rest of us it either validates all those expensive gym fees or, in my case, prompt an urgent return. Thank you Andre for a wonderful visit - I’m only sorry I wasn’t staying for longer. Good luck with this new venture - I’m sure it will be an amazing success.

Clean, stylish, secure, and perfect location for Sao Bento Metro or trains! Great for a couple only staying a short time and easy to get around everywhere from here. André was lovely and went out of his way to meet us early. Obrigado!
Ps - go on the Walks & Bites experience with Natercia through Airbnb too - just fabulous!

André’s place was amazing. Perfectly well located in the heart of Porto. The place is sparkling clean and nice to stay. André gave us quick and easy instructions to get there and many suggestions about the things to do in Porto. He was a superb host. Definitely staying again.

This apartment is superbly located in the centre of Porto. It is a stylish place to relax and unwind after a busy day exploring this beautiful city.
Andre was an amazing host. He was very helpful giving us local tips ensuring our time in the city was maximized.
I would 100% recommend this place to anybody who is thinking of visiting Porto. Thank you.

Just exactly what I wanted and expected from my first air b&b experience. Cozy, quiet apartment,  in a convenient location, just be able to do the stairs. Totally and completely worth it.  Andre was a very responsive host,  a very clear communicator, and even went out of his way to mail me back the adaptor I left behind. Thank you, Andre.

It was totally worth to spend money and time at Andre's place. Everything was good and room is very stylish, clean and super convenience to go anywhere. Great location and very comfortable. Strongly recommend.

André’s flat is perfect for a couple and for a short stay in Porto. The flat was clean, nicely decorated and had the most comfortable bed I’ve slept in when staying in an Air bnb. The location is great, very close to the metro and train station and to all the sites of Porto. Even though it’s very central it’s very quiet once you’re in the apartment. Be warned that you have to be reasonably fit to stay here, as André’s flat is on the 4th floor and a lift cannot be installed as the flat is in a conservation area. It was our first visit to Portugal and I have no hesitation in recommending André’s place if you come to Porto.

This is in such a great location! Beautiful apartment! Would recommended! Lots of stairs to enter apartment so not for those with mobility issues ! We loved our stay! Thanks Andre! Also Andre answers in seconds and give excellent directions and tips!

Location is perfect.   Studio flat with a tucked away kitchen.   No air con but a large fan in the room to help with hot temperature.   Pros were: great location.  Communication was good.  Very clean and secure.  Enough space for two people.  Cons were stairs to flat, hot flat on hot days.  But overall would stay again.  Good host.
The best thing about this place was the location - super central and plenty of great places to eat nearby. The flat was clean and Andre was very responsive. A perfect base for 4 days in Porto.

Lovely flat in Porto, you cannot find more in the center !
The flat is really modern and pleasant : highly recommended !
A cute apartment conveniently located right in front of the Sao Bento train station! The check-in process and the communication with André was very easy and we had no issues at all! Would recommend!
Location is perfect. The staircase to the apartment is high, it will be convenient with a backpack or not huge luggage.

André’s apartment was great! I highly recommend, it’s in a great location right across the street from San Bento station and close to lots of restaurants and sightseeing. André was very responsive with all questions and accommodations throughout our stay. Highly recommend you won’t regret it
The location is truly ideal, the apartment was very clean & comfortable, and André is a great host. Definitely recommend!

Simply, clean apartment in a great location. Surprisingly quiet despite being in a busy area. Excellent location right by the train station and lots of busy streets. We followed Andre's restaurant recommendations and had an awesome meal at Cantina 32 just a few steps away.

A great stay! Super clean and comfortable.  André responds very quickly and his instructions are detailed and clear. The apartment has a great view and has everything you need!  It was actually chilly the night that i stayed, so i was so happy there was a space heater for my use!  It's central location makes it even more appealing. Highly recommend!!

Lovely appartement, very well accommodated, in the center of Porto.
André was very kind and helpful every step of the way,
It was perfect !
A true gem right in the center of Porto. Although the location is so central, the place is really quiet, which is really hard to find in Porto. The host was extremely helpful and responsive.
Great location and pleasant room - clean, tidy and easy check-in. There is no lift to the 4th floor but otherwise it was a really nice stay. Thank you André!

Andre’s place was in a great location right across the street from Sao Bento station with lots of restaurants around. The bed was comfortable and there was a lot of light. One thing to keep in mind is that there is no AC unit so during the day the room gets quite warm, but in the morning/evening with the windows open it was very nice and cool.
We had a very comfortable stay in Porto. The apartment was great, the location is very central..busy area during the day but really quiet at night.

We had an amazing stay at Andre’s place in Porto. He was so kind and communicative, and even let us drop our bags a little early. The location is perfect right near the train station and very quiet at night. We would definitely stay here again.

Really awesome place to stay! Clean, simple, cozy & close by to everything you need and more! I won’t lie, the stairs are pretty rough but that wouldn’t deter me from staying there again! Easy check in! Andre responded quickly and was very helpful.

Thank you Andre for a great stay in Porto. Central location and clean studio. Really good communication
Nb its on the 4th floor with no lift that might make access difficult for some

The apartment couldn't be better located: it is right in front of the iconic São Bento train station from Porto.
Self check-in was very easy thanks to André's instructions; just be aware that the apartment is located on the 4th floor without elevator.
Unfortunately, it was not possible to leave our luggage anywhere in the building after check-out time but André suggested using the locker at São Bento station, which is apparently easy and safe (we ended up not using it).
We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was located in a great area and super quiet. We slept very well. Would recommend.
Location couldn’t be better! Andre was quick in responding, and we felt well taken care of the whole time. Thanks so much !
Super communication with Andre and very pleasant stay at his studio apartment in the center of Porto.  Highly recommended!

Wonderful location in a beautiful building.
Given the character and charm of Porto it was lovely to be able to stay in the historic heart
Of Porto with everything so walkable.
A gem of an apartment.

Great place in the center of Porto, right across from São Bento train station.
Highly recommended for Porto stay.

Such a nice cozy place for a couple. The location was amazing, right next to the Sao Bento station - everything was very close to us. Pro tip: pack light, because it is on the fourth floor sith no elevator or find a strong companion to carry it for you (like I did 😀).
Everything was very nice. The apartment is located in the center of Porto’s old town. André is a nice host who give recommendations and is quick to respond. Great stay! See you soon :)

Clean lovely stay in the middle of town but the host needs to warn about stairs before whilst booking or write it in his description. I had too much luggage and had to go to train station to leave at lockers! Not so close either cos there is construction in front of building! The rest is great!
Maria is very nice host! The loft is clean and cosy it was perfect our stay in Porto ! Thank you Maria

She was helpful, and when needed she was always there to solve any problem. The house was really nice and clean. located 2 km away from the city center. Around 20 minutes by walking. Close to supermarket.
I would definitely stay there if i go to Porto again. Thanks Maria❤️
Stunning little place to stay, has everything that you need, very clean and tidy and special little touches. So beautiful - even better than the pictures.

Great place. A little bit outside of the city but great if you’re looking for a walk (30 mins) staying for a longer period - all amenities within convenient distance. Only advice to improve - faster responses for queries and quicker resolution. We had certain issues with wifi and the Ac which took longer than necessary to resolve. Other than that was a great place

Had a great stay at Maria's loft. Cozy and stylish place located a 15-20 minute walk away from the highlights of Porto. Really liked the shower and the bathroom overall. Also really appreciate the fact we could use the washer. Certainly recommend this place!
Really nice apartment! Its cute and very comfy. Maria is an awesome host and super easy to communicate with! We really enjoyed it there!

We did not appreciate the fact that she asked us to cancel the reservation because of water damage. However, she was very helpful and very nice during our staying. The house is very cosy and way more comfortable than an hotel room. The situation is also good and near the marquês Station.
We hope you well.
Nice location. Loft is well equipped for small family. The loft is facing the street so could be a bit noisy.

Really recommended stay. Check in and out was really easy, Maria has helped us with it and told us about the recommended sites of the city, which you appreciate. Everything in the house was clean and tidy, and various details make the house even more comfortable. thanks!

The place is ok to spend one night, but it's definetely not the place where you enjoy staying. The apartment is dark on both levels, and very humid, which affects everything starting from the bed and sofa and your clothes becomes wet.
The stairs up are narrow so almost impossible to bring your luggage to the bedroom.
The pillows are not comfortable, and even I get used to sleep on small pillows these ones was super miniature.
There is a small garden with a table outside to have your breakfast.
Maria was a great host,  communication was quick and really helpful and the apartment was a perfect base from which to explore Porto!
We very much enjoyed staying here, would just take in mind that is a bit far from the center but Ubers were pretty cheap

We spend 5 days in the apartment and worked remotely. The apartment is exactly like on the pictures, very clean and welcoming. There is outside area with a beautiful garden, table and chairs. The internet connection was amazing! We mostly took Uber to go to the city, because it was very affordable. I would totally recommend this place!

The flat is located just two metro stations away from the city center, making it very convenient while offering a peaceful stay. It’s absolutely amazing—beautifully decorated, clean, and incredibly cosy, perfect for a short trip. Maria has been a fantastic host, always helpful and full of great recommendations that made our time in Porto even better. We had a wonderful experience and will definitely stay here again if we return to Porto!
A very private and clean apartment, near the metro. Maria is a kind host. We would definitely stay again.

Great location, clean studio flat, very helpful & reliable host.  Would highly recommend for a solo traveller. Kitchen equipped but without kettle or toaster or oven.  There’s a microwave and double burner stove. To make a cup of tea, you have to heat the water in the microwave which I soon got used to doing. There’s also a coffee machine and a tv.  Tourist attractions within walking distance as well as the metro which has a direct train to the airport.  Would highly recommend this flat
I enjoyed my stay at Teresa's house in Porto.  Teresa is a friendly and nice host.  This is my first visit to Portugal, so I think it will be remembered for a long time.  thank you !
Nice studio 20min walk from the centre...Teressa was very helpful.I visited Porto  for business and it was all I needed.

Exactly as described and pictured. Great shower. Comfortable beds. Secure. Double-insulated windows helped with road noise (unit faces street) but honestly the traffic dies WAY down at night.  Super close to Trindade metro station and easy walking to shops, restaurants and Douro River.

This was a great little studio. Everything was as described. The studio is really well priced for Porto. I've stayed in other places in the city and this was the most reasonable. It was also nice and quiet even though there are several units all close together. I would stay here again for sure.
We had a fantastic time staying here. Very convenient (on top of a shopping centre with supermarket), a couple of minutes walk from the subway, the apartment was clean and Marcia was very helpful.

The studio is very clean and cozy. The location is fine if you have a car and prefer to be in an outskirts. It is easy to access the metro but you are not in the heart of the city. The communication has been great and I would definitely recommend this place again.

Beautiful modern apartment in an old house. Perfect place near restaurants and cafés and main tourist attractions and still very quiet. Bakery just around the corner.  Christina was very kind and helpful and we got good information of restaurants, cafés and attractions of Lisbon. I highly recommend to stay here  and would like to come here again.
Very stylish! Definitely in the city so a bit noisy at night. It’s easy to walk everywhere from the location.
We loved this apartment. It’s such a great space and the location is excellent.  Everything is very accessible but you are away from the crowds.

We had a very nice stay in Porto. I guess the apartment is located in one of the best parts of porto! There are a lot of really cool restaurants, bars, cafes and shops in the street. We would book again :)
I loved this place, close to so many good restaurants and super comfortable! Would be be back!
Great hosts! Super central flat near loads of cafes and bars. 100% recommend and would go back :)

Our stay in Porto was excellent at the Indulge property! It was in an excellent location and had everything we needed for our three day stay. The property was all updated and modern, it looks exactly like the photos on the listing.

Great place! Central location, stylish building, extremely comfortable bed, powerful shower, good stove. There is a good cafe/bakery right next door which made breakfast very easy. The host also provided cleaning free of charge. We enjoyed our stay very much!
You get good value, cleanliness, modern apartment, close to the sites of interest. You will not be disappointed.
We really loved the apartment and the garden. The communication was also on point, the host even offered an extra cleaning while we were staying. Would go there again anytime!
We really liked the apartment. The location was very good, you are near the city center. communication was very clear and everything was easy. We would definitely come again!

The communication with the host was amazing! She was reachable the whole time at any hour and helped us with everything we needed.
TOP Airbnb - nice, clean, with a garden. I would always come back.
Clean, quiet and simple. Does exactly what it says on the advert. I enjoyed my time here and would have happily stayed in the same apartment for longer if required.
The location was excellent, very central and easy to reach everything by foot. The flat was clean, big enough for one or two people and well-equipped.

Key pick-up in a different location, approximately 10min walk so not super inconvenient. Location is great, 10min walk from grocery store, nice restaurants and tourist attractions. Area is quiet and it felt nice being further away from the very busy city centre. We enjoyed the outside balcony that overlooks a quiet communal courtyard. Neighbors are respectful and we never actually had any contact with anyone. Kitchen relatively well equipped for cooking your own meals, which we could eat on the balcony.
A few downsides: Bed not super comfortable and mattress should be replaced. The apartment was a bit dusty and did not feel overly 'fresh' upon arrival. We also only got one towel per person even though the pictures showed two towels per person. There was also only one wine glass. Kitchen can do with a few additional items.
Overall we had a very comfortable and pleasant stay.
My parents-in-law stayed at Cesar's flat. It is really beautiful and comfortable, very close to the beach and to the metro station. Highly recommended!
