Lovely place! Clean, wich awesome view at the ocean, near the beach, metro/bus stops and supermarket. We simply enjoyed the stay. And Celso was also very nice and helped with everything we needed. Thank you!

This is an amazing apartment, so stylish and clean. One of the best places we have stayed in while using Airbnb! You must go!
Great location for the beach with lots of fantastic restaurants very close by ....especially if you love seafood.
Very good for transport links for the bus and metro. There is also a Lidl very close too if you need anything, but there are lots of bits in the cupboards too.
Great hosts, so informative and kind.
We will return....Thank you for having us!
The perfect Airbnb experience. Beautiful flat, very well furnished, spotless clean, beautiful view, great location, very nice hosts, very smooth check in and check out. Thanks alot!

Celso is an excellent host and his place is amazing! We enjoyed the location and sunset from the kitchen. He and his team have provided the best Covid-19 cleaning protocols we have seen so far! We highly recommend the place.
Celso was a wonderful and accommodating host and the place was in a fantastic location close to the beach with lots of public transport options and food around.

We really enjoyed our stay in Celso's apartment.
Celso was a great host, organizing everything went smoothly through excellent communication.
The apartment located with few minutes walking distance close to beach for surfing and sea swimming. Fantastic seafood restaurants nearby offers super reasonable local price. Very accessible with public transport all around.
The apartment itself is a cosy 'home from home' feels, host provided everything essential needs. Very thoughtful and generous gestures for the guests, so thank you!
Matoshino is a local seaside/port area, away from touristy busy center. So if you want to experience live like real locals, this is the place for you.

Celso was a great host! He was welcoming, friendly, and invitational. He met us and welcomed us into the apartment showing us around, answered all of our questions, made sure we knew how everything worked, and provided clear instructions. The location is great - close to the beach, cafes, lots of restaurants, and the metro. I love that the apartment is on the top floor with a super fast lift! Highly recommend!
Well located, near the metro and the beach. Good restaurants around. Cheap parkings all around the airbnb.

Located outside of Porto city Center and ideal to travel to Porto without being in the middle of the city. Beautiful beach surroundings and the best fish restaurants of the north.
Very close to the metro station (5min walking) that gives you access to Porto Center. Loads of coffee shops around to chill, especially with sea view. The hosts were great, always responsive and available. The house is great, all you need for a short or longer staying.
It was pleasant local experience.   Restaurants were super.  Our host was very helpful and friendly.  Gave great instructions.

The location is great. Walking distance to the center and with many places to eat around. Even though there are bars in the area, the apartment has double windows so we didn’t really hear any noises at night from the people on the street.
The bed was super comfortable and everything was very clean. We even spent some time watching TV later in the day because it felt like home.
We will be back for sure. Perfect place in a perfect location.

This apartment is really great. Very well located, clean and perfect for up to two people. We were welcomed kindly and felt comfy. It’s close to multiple bars and the Lello library and other sights as well as the city center with the river are close by. Would recommend staying here and will come back!
great place, very comfortable and quality furniture. high quality insonorisation. host is super friendly and available. would stay there again.

Beautiful, large apartment in the heart of one of the most lively neighborhoods in Porto. Double windows keep the noise out, but there are literally bars and restaurants feet from the front door. Highly recommend this location. One of my favorite Airbnbs.
Perfect experience, great location (central and full of connections / places to see and eat out) and very friendly communication with the host. Highly recommended for a touristic stay in Porto.
Great place!! One of the nicest AirBnB I went to. Afonso was a great host and the apartment is awesome. Highly recommended.
Alfonso was friendly, helpful and very responsive.   Highly recommended apartment close to a good market and to lots of sights.  Very clean.  Will recommend Alfonso to friends.

Afonso was a great host and the apartment is in a great location next to some amazing bars and restaurants. It is only a short walk to the river as well. Afonso was very helpful and gave us a list of restaurants and things to do. We dined exclusively from Afonso's recommendations and were very impressed!
We had a wonderful stay at Afonso's place. He was very helpful and shared lots of great recommendations. The place was clean and had all the required amenities. We would love to stay here again!
Great property in a great location. Everything was as advertised. Afonso was an excellent host! He was super helpful and very generous with time and knowledge of area. We will be back!
Alfonso was great in giving suggestions on what to do. The location was perfect. Easy to walk to places. He was willing to be of assistance in whatever we needed.

Hotel quality stay. Genuinely could not have imagined a better AirBnB experience in Porto! Afonso gave us great recs and immediately made us feel right at home. He even answered some questions prior to arrival.

Alfonso was accomadating and helpful from beginning to end. he gave us a huge list of recommendations, explained a bit about the neighbourhood, had complimentary coffee and tea for us and so much more. when visiting porto again i will be sure to book with him again! oh and his home was gorgeous, clean and in a GREAT location! thanks again!

Alfonso was super communicative, sent me lots of recommendations and checked in with me before I arrived. The apartment is just like the photos, well maintained and in a great part of Porto close to the bars and restaurants. The apartment is super quiet and easy to access. I highly recommend this place and will definitely stay again if I come to Porto!

Afonso was extremely helpful and kind from the moment we booked until the moment we left. Lots of local recommendations and all were excellent! Perfect location with lots of brunch spots on the door step. Comfortable nights sleep; would recommend.
Very helpful, responsible host, the apt. is such a convenience place to stay during visiting Porto. Thank you all Afonso's advises.
This listing is as advertised! It’s very clean and close to sites in Porto. When we return to Porto next spring this will be our preferred choice for an accommodation. I highly recommend!

Great place for a short stay in Porto!
The apartment is clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything you might need. It’s conveniently located – just a 15-minute walk to the city center, very close to the metro, and there’s a supermarket nearby. We also had no trouble finding parking in the area.
The only minor downside is a small bar on the corner – it can get a bit noisy at night when locals gather for drinks. But it didn’t spoil our overall experience.
All in all, a great base for exploring Porto. Would recommend for a short stay!
The apartment is close to a Metro stop,accessible by lift and is well equipped.We were received by a friend the host and the local tips provided were helpful.Would highly recommend.

Lovely place, amazing host and an all around great experience. Not to far walk from centre and surrounded by shops and bars! Wish we stayed longer! Thank you for a great stay. Would recommend to anyone!!
Maria’s place looks just as good in person as it does in the pictures. Very quick communication, would definitely stay again.

This apartment was very clean and well presented. Check in was easy. A great location for discovering central Porto.
We would recommend and definitely stay here again.
The appartement is very close to the metro and shops, rooms are confortable, the bathroom is amazing, the neighboorhood is quite calm when there aren't any "works"
Lovely comfortable stay. Clear communication. Super close to food and metro. Hot water isn't massive so take short showers if you have a group.

Perfect apartment to visit Porto, near the metro and supermarkets and bakery’s. Host was very helpful and gave us great suggestions for restaurants and port tasting! Would definitely recommend and come back here !

Maria is an amazing host. She was very helpful with hints and recommendations regarding places to visit and restaurants in the city.
The apartment itself is clean and cosy.
I recommend staying at Maria’s place.

The apartment is beautiful and the location is excellent if you want to be close to the beach!  Nuno is very quick to respond to any questions you may have.  The rooms have beautiful views on the beach as well.  It is about 15 minutes from the city center but Uber is very popular and you can always find an Uber to take you to the city center if you don't want to take a bus. Overall our stay was fantastic and I would definitely stay there again!
Amazing place, we enjoyed our vacation in Nuno's apartment. Nuno was very helpful. Thank you for everything.

What a great flat! Super clean! Great view from the bedroom balcony. Comfortable living room and kitchen. 2 minute walk from the flat to the beach. Nuno was a very accommodating host! Whenever we needed help, he was ready to help us.
100% would recommend!
if you look for peace and quiet and the same time to be near Lisbon then this is the place for you.easy walks , good resturants and wonderfully clean.
The apartment is cosy and has everything you need. It is situated in the city center so we couldn't ask for anything more. Eduardo was a great host, we had a wonderful time in Porto!
Amazing!!! Clean and very accommodating!!! Location is perfect, walking distance to so much. Would definitely stay again!

Modern and comfortable apartment, clean and well equipped.
Located in a quiet area, 5 minutes walking from the métro.
The only negative point is the view from the bedroom and the sound insulation.
The communication with the host was very easy and we received useful touristic advices.
Everything was as described. Our hosts quickly answered any requests we had. It was an enjoyable holiday.

Peerfect location for accessing both sides of the river. Short walk across the bridge into the heart of Porto.
Comfortable and clean 3 bedroom apartment close to Porto. Eduardo and Mell were easy to communicate with and very responsive. We enjoyed our 4 days staying here

Best AirBnb I have ever stayed in. Meibel gave us so many recommendations for our 3 day stay. The place was so cute and clean and we all got our own bedroom. Price range was very reasonable and I feel like we found a gem. So worth it, thank you Meibel for the best trip in Porto!
Thanks so much for your help and support. We enjoyed your apartment and had a great stay in Porto. Thanks to Adam too

Mell was a brilliant host, was very responsive throughout the whole process and the apartment matched the pictures. The apartment was very clean and items such as water, shampoo and body wash all provided. When we arrived Mell got out a map and highlighted restaurants, bars and areas of interest. The flat is in a good location with a supermarket and bakery etc near by. It is around a 15/20 walk across the bridge to the attractions. The cable car is also on the side of the apartment. Walking up the hill is steep however Mell explained there was a car park where you can take a lift which cuts the journey. Overall great host and apartment all 3 of us enjoyed our visit I would highly recommend Mell.
Very nice host, friendly and warm welcome with some tips about Porto! We enjoyed our stay at this apartment and thanks a lot for the flexibility for check in and check out! Such a pleasure :)

Very welcoming host, she gave us loads of relevant and useful information. The apartment was very well situated close to the metro and within walking distance of all the attractions. The local restaurant Real serve Portuguese cuisine which was excellent at a reasonable price. Mel was very understanding when we had an issue which delayed our departure.

We stayed at Mell's place for 3 nights. It was super clean, and the location was perfect, walking distance from the best breakfast place, and the well-known bridge. Mell was super fast to response to any question I had. Definitely would recommend.
Lovely clean apartment, great location, easy check in and Mel was really helpful. Would recommend.

Mel and Eduardo’s welcome was warm and informative. Thanks for the helpful tips! This apartment was very clean and within walking distance to everything: main attractions, public transport if needed, a small grocery store, restaurants. Everything was just as described. Thank you for a great stay!
Brilliant flat, clean and in a lovely, local, quiet area yet very close to the centre! Mel is the most responsive host I’ve ever come across! Would definitely recommend.

Our stay in Porto was wonderful! The place is very close to the main attractions, so we were able to walk to most of them. It has three bedrooms, a spacious washroom, and the check-in process was easy and clear. We were very happy with our stay.

Sofia’s lovely studio is in a brilliant location, just a stroll down the pedestrian street of Rua das Flores down to the waterfront but there are no Marlon Brando’s here... just nice places to eat or nibble, drink or breathe in, and just be, plus some excellent buskers and even a string quartet on a good day! Quite a hill climb back though if you’re not so young and fit but not enough to be any sort of deterrent! Sofia’s recommendation of the Terreiro restaurant in Largo de Terreiro, tucked neatly into the top left corner of this square (the first square you hit as you get to the waterfront down Flores, and the most errrrr westwards I guess) is totally backed up by us... so good I had the octopus with garlic, green and red peppers, onion, potatoes... twice. Exquisite :) there ya go. I’ve said enough. Lovely 😀

A MUST STAY IN PORTO! We couldn’t have dreamed of a better place. This apartment is absolutely stunning, in the best/most charming location, and equipped with everything you could need and more. We loved how we could always stop to rest our feet for a little or drop of any souvenirs because the apartment is conveniently located in the middle of everything. Restaurants around the apartment are also fantastic. I enjoyed being able to drink espresso in the morning on the balcony while gazing at the beautifully tiled buildings and listening to the street artists below. Just total relaxation.
Sofia is also the most amazing host I’ve ever met. You can tell she is passionate about Porto and puts so much effort into the little things. She also provided a personalized map and recommendations that really let us experience Porto to the fullest!
I fell in love with this city and can’t wait to visit again. I recommended anyone to book this apartment 100%!!!

Sofia's place make the porto experience even better! It's a pretty uniquely well appointed apartment, centrally located and with all the amenities one could need. The check-in was super easy, and Sophia was really courteous. Her mother helped us to store our luggage after check-out in the building and provided us really helpful tips for booking an Uber. Overall, we had a great time, and highly recommend hr apartment!

Amazing place to stay! Really stylish and comfy. Sofia was an excellent host and made everything really easy for our check-in, checkout and stay. Great detail leaving 2 small Porto wines ♥️.
Definitely would come back!

Sofia’s studio was in a perfect location!  Easy to walk to everything in Porto. On a busy, trendy street but very secure doors to the balcony which blocked out noise. Perfectly clean. Sofia very friendly with great suggestions for dinner. Easy pick up/drop off service at the airport by Carlos, a big plus!  I would recommend highly for anyone to stay here!!  Also Portugal is an awesome place to visit, everyone has been very friendly and accommodating.
Great place for a stay in Porto! Fantastic location, easy check in and out. Super responsive host with great communication . We highly recommend this place for a stay in Porto!

Sofia’s place was great! Super clean, great location, and decor was cute! Sofia was such a great host. She responded to messages right away and was very helpful. She made our first time in Portugal a memorable one! I would recommended staying here!
Perfect place to stay in Porto. Sofia was an amazing guest and the place is located in a perfect place. I recommend this place 100%

Sofia’s place was perfect for my husband and I. The location was excellent. Very close to everything on a beautiful street. Very safe. The apartment is cozy and the bed comfortable. Sofia had a list of suggestions for us and the ones we tried were all places we would return to. Would definitely stay here again if we are ever back in Porto!

The apartment is great, clean, comfortable. All needed amenities were the + some extra :) Perfect location!
Sofia is a friendly and attentive host. She replied in time and helped with many things during my stay (arranged transfer etc)

Excellent location and very comfortable apartment. On a busy pedestrian street in the heart of town but the apartment has good sound insulation is very quiet. Sofia was great at communication, offering useful tips and advice for our trip. The check-in/out process was very smooth. The apartment was compact and self-sufficient - perfect for our short stay in Porto. Highly recommend!

The position of this flat on the Flores walking street couldn't have been any better and the communications and recommendations were excellent. The little bottles of gift port were a very nice touch. Highly recommended when in Porto.

very nice place really in the heart of this nice city, close to all important places amd surrounded by great restaurants.
highly recomended :)

We loved our stay here! The location is close to everything! The place was comfortable and met our needs. The host had outstanding recommendations that really made our trip! We absolutely loved it!

Sofia was an amazing host who went above and beyond to meet my needs during a 2 week stay. The place is very well located at walking distance from the river and many beautiful sites. I highly recommend it.
5 Stars really stayed in Airbnbs all over the world this one is absolutely one of my all time favorites, from the location , to the Wi-Fi speed, the facilities all were amazing!!!!

This was one of the best airbnbs I have stayed in. Sofia made sure to provide me with all the possible details to accommodate my stay and make me comfortable. Carlos the driver is very kind and welcoming. The studio is in a perfect location, very clean and spacious and has everything you need.
I will definitely stay there again next time I am in Porto.

Sophias apartment was fantastic! Perfect location with an easy walk to all the sites and restaurants you would want to visit. The apartment was spotless, well laid out and perfect for a couple or a single traveler. We will definitely come back next time we are in Porto. Thanks Sophia!

We enjoyed staying at Sofia's place. Very easy
check-in, good communication. Sofia was always available to help and give us directions and recommendations. The apartment is lovely, well decorated, and has everything we need, including a comfortable bed.
We enjoyed our stay at Sofia's place and recommended it to other guests.
One of our favourite airbnbs of all time. Very clean, modern and in a fantastic location. I would highly recommend without any hesitation 👍

It was so comfortable, beautiful and have a good accessibility in Porto. Sofia was very kind. She gave us a lots of informations about Porto for our convenience. We can had a wonderful time with this place. The landscape from window view was so nice to see Porto street. I want to come here again.

We were so lucky to have booked Sophia’s apartment.  She was a fantastic host and her place was charming and so cozy. The bed was probably the most comfy we have had so far in an Airbnb. :D The whole place was a perfect respite after a busy day of exploring Porto. But what my husband and I enjoyed most? It was just sitting in the balcony (with a cuppa and a torta) watching the world go by. Thank you, Sofia! We’ll definitely be back!
Amazing location, beautiful place, easy to find and get in to. I'd for sure stay again.
We had a great stay. We needed to check in a bit earlier and they accommodate. The communication was great and we received whatever we needed to have a comfy stay. Will go back again 🙏🏻

My favorite place we stayed during our entire 16 day trip. Sofia’s apartment was so CLEAN, pristine, and homey. Thank you for always providing clear instructions and responding so quickly. The location was also perfect and Sofia provided a ton of great recommendations for brunch and dinner. Thanks for the perfect stay in Porto.

That apartment is a pure gem! We highly appreciated our stay there, and will not hesitate to go again when we will return in Porto.
The apartment is located on the best and most beautiful street of Porto. Everything you need or want to visit is nearby at a walkable distance.
The host is also very proactive and responsive.
Thank you so much for making our stay so memorable!

My fiancé and I loved our stay at Sofia’s place. The apartment was super clean and exactly what we needed. We could not get over how perfect the location was. Being in the middle of Rua do Floras put us right in the heart of the city. And easy access to anywhere we wanted to go.
Sofia was amazing she had fantastic recommendations on restaurants, cafes, and experiences for us on our trip. I highly recommend staying in this place and soaking up all of her recommendations.

Perfect area on the popular walking avenue of Rua de Flores! Close to everything. The flat is small but we really only slept there and had coffee in the morning and it was perfect. It’s was clean and the bed was comfy!

My wife and I stayed here on our honeymoon and we absolutely loved it! Sofia also gave us the best recommendations for restaurants, cafes, and activities which made planning our trip a breeze. Next time we come to Porto we will be looking to book Sofia’s place again!

Wow. I don’t know where to begin. The place is lovely and exactly as shown on the listing. You will find yourself at the center of Rua da Flores, where there are many stores and restaurants by you. It has a pretty tight balcony but still usable. The airbnb is on a busy and exciting street but the windows block out the sound so nicely. We also enjoyed the black out curtains so much! My partner and I had a wonderful stay.  Next time we are in Porto, we plan to stay here again. As for Sofia, Sofia you were completely lovely. Thank you for being such a wonderful and gracious host. Thank you for checking and always responding to us. You were truly appreciated it !

I had a great stay at Sofia’s. The apartment was clean, cozy, and just as shown in pictures. Sofia is one of the best hosts I’ve ever had a pleasure of dealing with. She communicated in advance, answered all the questions, set up rides to and from the apartment (driver Carlos is punctual, sweet, and very helpful), and was generally a pleasure to deal with. One slight issue I’d note is that you are on a busy pedestrian street so if you need it to be completely silent at all times, this might not be the best location. But I loved the little patio where I could relax and read my book while listening to musicians a block away. Wonderful stay! Thanks Sofia!
Highly recommended ! - Apartment was lovely, location was very convenient, and Sofia was helpful and responsive. Thank you for booking Carlos to transfer us to the airport.

My boyfriend and I stayed here for three nights and couldn’t have asked for a better experience! This location is right in the middle of everything you want to do in Porto city center and the arrival/check-in process couldn’t have been easier. We also got a ride with Carlos to and from the airport - he was wonderful! When we return, this is where we will be staying again.
Lovely very small apartment. The street is a bit more noisy than we expected (a pedestrian street but still some cars and trucks) but has a great atmosphere. We had a great time.

Location, location, location!
I had a brilliant stay at Sofia’s apartment. It’s in a brilliant location and I was particularly thankfully for Carlos to pick me up from the airport! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The location is so great! The area is also very safe and the apartment feels very safe as well! Thanks for a great stay.

I had a wonderful stay in Porto and couldn’t have asked for a better host than Sofia. She helped arrange our airport transfers, even for an early morning departure, which made everything so easy. The apartment is in an ideal location, within walking distance to all the sights we wanted to explore. Sofia was warm, responsive, and full of great local tips that really made our visit special. The place itself was spotless and just as lovely as the photos. I’d love to come back and stay here again!

We really enjoyed the stay. The location of the apartment is fantastic. It’s right in the middle of everything. Mins away from nice restaurants and key spots. Sofia is very responsive and we are grateful that she accommodated our early check-ins and there’s a storage for the luggages after checkout. Also, her instructions for check in is so detailed and clear that makes everything so easy. Would highly recommend!

Although rare for me to write a review even after a great stay, I feel compelled to say how truly amazing our experience of Porto was thanks largely to Sofia, her advice, arrangements and gorgeous apartment that was perfectly positioned. I don't believe it would be possible to find a better host or experience. Obrigardo Sofia

Pros:
- amazing location
- clear instructions
- clean place
- comfy bed
Cons:
- stayed for 4 nights and had one bath towel per person

Isabel is very kind. she left us milk, mineral water , muffin and croissant for us for breakfast. Her place is  big, perfect location.  I love the self check in, we been given the code the day before. thank you for host us. recomend her place. will definitely go back to stay if we visit Porto again.
The location of the house is really good, parking is very convenient, and the owner of the house answers any questions in a timely manner!

Cute apartment, very clean! We were very comfortable, the location was awesome! Only thing was it was a little noisy at night with traffic, but you would have that anywhere in that area, being close to waterfront. I  would book this apartment again!

Really convenient place to stay to enjoy Porto. Simple and nice and just like the pictures. Only be aware there is a road nearby that is a little loud if you are a light sleeper. Everything you need to be self sufficient and good advice on where to eat. The restaurant underneath (Brazilian) is good and very reasonable - best banana jam desert!
isabel was very nice and helpful and the flat was in a great location. easy to access everything

Great place. as described. Well equipped, including a few days of coffee and tea greatly appreciated.
slightly noisy

Great location! Short walk away from the heart of Porto.
Isabel’s property is super clean, the mattress are very comfortable, we had great sleeps after lots of walking. It was nice to find water in the fridge and some pastries/cakes on our arrival. Good communication with the owner. Highly recommended.
Thank you 😊
Loved our stay! Walking distance to the beautiful riverfront town and wine galore. The apartment was neat and easy to get to from the metro. Our daughters loved the space!
It was clean and in a good location. The host's sense was evident everywhere. I will stay here again when I go to Porto.

Clean and easy to find. Great little flat for a short stay in this beautiful city.
Had everything we needed including a super little wine bar literally next door.
Great friendly communication and super value.

Fantastic location, super clean, great amenities. We couldn’t hear any outside noises from our apartment. It’s quite a few steps up to the room.  Our host was amazing and responded to all our needs. Close to heaps of places to eat and drink. Lovely safe park just outside to enjoy some relax time and watch the world go by. Close to many attractions, including the Ribeira. We would definitely come back.
Recently updated apartment with plenty of room! Owners are very responsive and are excited to make your stay in Porto amazing.

This is one of the nicest AirBnB’s in which we’ve stayed. The location is near the university, so there’s a great vibe. There are also some of the best restaurants in town nearby. The apartment is nicely furnished and very comfortable. We appreciated the little extras like a bottle of port and bottles of water.

Great location in the mist of many happenings.  Including late nights.  My wife had some trouble sleeping with all the fiesta but I didn’t.  So it is all in whos perspective.  Overall love the place and area.  Host was responsive and checkin was automated.
This place was the perfect base for exploring Porto - we got around on foot most of the time and loved all the restaurant and bar recommendations provided by Norvinda. We had a great stay!
flat was amazing,exactly what we needed in ideal location. great communication with host, really nice and helpfull person. We had fantastic time!
Great apartment in a great walkable location.  Very clean. It had everything we needed and more.

Norvinda was very responsive and helpful. We enjoyed our stay at the beautiful apartment very much. The washer cum dryer in the apartment was really helpful!! We walked everywhere from the apartment, no need for public transport at all. Thanks for hosting us!!

The condo is in a terrific neighborhood, centrally-located and within walking distance of just about everything you'll want to do in Lisbon.  With three security codes, you can be sure that you will be safe.   The apartment was very clean, comfortable, uncluttered.  There were some glitches with appliances -- e.g. getting the burners on the Bosch stove to ignite, but Joao responded with detailed instructions to get things fixed.  Importantly, the condo is very quiet and a nice respite from the city.
Everything was very good, from the check-in, the support, the baby equipment and especially the many tips from Norvinda. Location is great.

This airbnb is in an excellent location that is easily walkable to all the areas in Porto that we wanted to visit. The host was very responsive and provided many great recommendations in the area. The place was spotless with a kitchen adequately supplied to cook home meals.
Excellent location - lots nearby and easy to walk anywhere in Porto. Host was very responsive and helpful, especially with restaurant recommendations.

This is our 3rd stay here and I can't imagine staying anywhere else while in Porto. Norvinda was wonderful and so responsive. Follow her recommendations as she won't steer you wrong! So responsive and welcoming. We can't wait to stay here again.

Great place with a great location! Host was extremely accommodating and gave wonderful recommendations. Very clean and wonderful shower. Such a good area to stay in Porto. Perfect for walking around the entire city. Would definitely recommend.

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The location is unbeatable, right in the heart of the city with plenty of cafes nearby. Despite being in a bustling area, the apartment is quiet, thanks to its windows facing a calm street. Everything inside is brand new, fresh, and spotless. The apartment is well-equipped with all the essentials, including an iron, washing machine with drying function, hair dryer, and dishwasher. The bed is incredibly comfortable with soft pillows and a great mattress. The host was very welcoming and helpful. We would definitely love to stay here again!

Norvinda was an excellent host!  She provided grocery, restaurant and sights to see without a request from. She also checked in with us a couple of times during our stay to make sure everything was okay. I willnot hesitate to recommend this accommodation to anyone that asks!! Our stay was great!!

Very nice and tidy room.
Bathroom very clean. Neighbourhood very quiet at night.
Locking system worked well, communication was also great.
Location: Relatively central and a few minutes walk to the city centre, Ponte Dom Luís I, Super Bock Arena and other sights. Around the flat are some small shops, restaurants and bars.

It was really nice to spend time in that place. Guido welcomed me verry well, the neighbors are very friendly and warm.
it's a peace calm place.
I had verry good times in that place.

Claudia is very nice, hospitable and caring. She helped me to find my way to her place from the airport via WhatsApp.  The arrival and departure time was flexible. The room is clean and pretty, even if a little bit dark. The bed is comfortable, there are extra blankets. The area is green, close to nice parks and beaches. It's a nice place to stay.
We enjoyed warm and friendly welcome, the clean apartment and stay in Porto.aThe location is amazing.

We had a lovely stay in beautiful Porto in Late June/early July. Sonia's apartment was a great find. A spacious 3 bed apartment, beautifully decorated with everything as described. A very short walk to the train and local shops made it an ideal location, near but far enough from the centre which meant there was little noise at night and not much early morning traffic outside either. The only negatives we would have with Sonias place would be: 1. the beds were not very comfortable. 2. As it was very hot when we were there, an air conditioning system would have been lovely. There were fans in each bedroom but they were noisy at night.
Otherwise we had a lovely stay and found Sonia, very helpful and contactable at short notice. A lovely visit!

Claudia was an amazing host. She was very helpful with all of my needs while visiting Porto. She went above and beyond and was an extra special host to my little NEO. She had some great ideas to help me get around. Nice little place. Very private away from it all.
It’s a great neighbourhood location with little cafes and other stores nearby. Great walks to the beach every day and you can find your way downtown by walking (an hour) or local transit or a scooter.

Claudia is a super caring and kind host, very friendly, not at all intrusive, but honest, sweet and super helpful. Super flexible and accommodating as well.
The room is exactly as advertised, small but perfectly clean, nice cotton sheets, lots of privacy. The location is awesome, not far from the centre but calm and not touristy. Excellent local restaurant a few steps away and shops and all amenities within 200 m.
We had a lovely stay!

Claudia is an extremely caring, kind and hospitable person. She was always ready to help whatever question we had. She gave us a lot of advice and instructions about our visit in this beautiful city. It's a bit cool in her place in early April, but it is a big plus when the weather's hot and she offers heaters if you need. Overall, we felt like staying at our friend's🥰

I was very impressed with Claudia’s place. Although  one half below street level, it was bright with a patio, kitchenette, bathroom and entrance. Additionally, she sent me clear instructions in advance as to how to get to her place from the airport. Afterwards, she pointed out major attractions around the city and how to get there.  I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto. Claudia is a very nice and friendly person.

We highly recommend Claudia's place, easy to find, good location not far from the beach and the centre of Porto. Supermarket, bakery, cafes and restaurants in  walking distance and Claudia is a lovely host. We had a great time, thanks Claudia.

Great place and location, just in front of the Douro
Easy and quick communication with YourOpo
If you're staying in the duplex on the top floor, there are a lot of very steep stairs.  It isn't a problem if you're travelling light, but if something to consider if you have physical frailties.
Such a fantastic stay, loved it! Absolutely stunning apartment in a beautiful location. The view was incredible. The communication was efficient and friendly, couldn’t ask for better.

This apartment is amazing! Gorgeous views of the river and it is perfectly located in Porto. The hosts offered great communication and speedy replies. They set up a driver from the airport and were always there to help if we had questions. There is no elevator and the three flights of stairs are steep with luggage so be prepared , but the views are worth it. Amazing apartment!

We have had some fantastic days in Porto in Bateira apartment. It is really a lovely place with a fantastic view to Douro river.
Bateira have been a heat host and always easy to contact and fast reply.

We truly loved this location. We were only there for 1 night but will be back for a longer stay.
House so clean and the beds and pillows were so comfortable. Got a great sleep that was well needed. Loved the easy checkin as we came in late.
The location of this accomodation was incredible! Stunning views from the balcony. The rooms were nice and clean. If you do have heavy suitcases there are some steep stairs to walk up.

The location can’t be beat and the apartment was great especially if you need 2 separate bedrooms!
The only thing I’ll warn is that the apartment is up 3 steep flights of stairs. This was not an issue for me but keep in mind if that would be an issue for your party.
Stunning apartment in a great location with BEAUTIFUL views of the river! Central in ribeiro and with a balcony that’s hard to beat
Super clean, convenient, and the view is amazing. Wonderful communication from host and very responsive. Would 10/10 recommend!
The host was always responsive and helpful. The place was great.  I wish we could have stayed longer.
Great spot in a bustling, exciting area! Host kept the place clean and equipped with anything we needed.
My family and I had a great stay in Rui’s beautiful apartment. The views were incredible and it is very well located. Highly recommended!

This is a great place right on the river in Porto.  The location is amazing.  Restaurants and activities all around, yet you can get away to the apartment and it’s quiet and peaceful.  We also used the luggage cages after we checked out which allowed us to walk around the city for a little bit before our train departed.  Would highly recommend this apartment to anyone traveling to Porto!

Maria's apartment is open, clean and SUPER central. Very easy to find and a lovely space for our 5 day trip. It does receive quite a lot of street noise and light, so I used my eye mask and earplugs each night, but the bed is quite comfortable and we enjoyed the space. We were unable to meet Maria due to our arrival time but check in with her colleague was easy and Maria was very helpful in giving us restaurant tips (and help on where to get our travel COVID tests!). Recommend!

I had a great time in Porto and enjoyed staying in Maria's place. The location is very convenient, the apartment is exactly how is shown in the pictures and was clean. Maria is a great host and made herself available throughout my stay.

Maria’s apartment was clean tidy and spacious. It was in an ideal central part of the city with easy excess to the main train station and other big attractions in the city. Maria was an excellent host and was there to offer help and advice if needed.Definitely worth consideration.
Winston Peden.
Northern Ireland.
We had a great stay at Verónica’s apartment, which is ideally located in the heart of Porto and looks just as stylish as in the pictures. Verónica was very responsive and helpful.

A great stay in Porto! The apartment was delightful and in a perfect location for exploring the town and the port/water front. I found that there was a slight inaccuracy on the description of the hotel as there were pots and pans but not cooking basics like oil, salt, and pepper despite saying so on the listing but nothing we couldn’t get around.
All in all though, a fantastic stay! If I return to Porto, Veronica’s would be too of my list.
Very nice house in an excellent location, a very short (but steep!) walk from the river Douro. Everything was spotless and we felt very welcome. Highly recommended!

Loved our accommodation in the city off Porto. It was our first time so we didn’t had any expectations of the city and the area. We booked last minute , only thing we knew was that the house would look super nice. A place were we could unwind from all the rush in our everyday life.
The house is located very well. So it was super nice to roam around the city during the day and by night.
Mónica is a very nice hostes. Welcoming and so helpfull throughout our stay!
Would def. return again!!
The house is great and has everything you might need. The location is great and close to the main attractions.
The apartment is in a great location and it looks amazing! The check-in and check-out process was super easy and we had an amazing stay!

This house is beautifully renovated and designed. Its location in the old city center of Porto is great. The view from the upper sleeping room down on Porto and the Douro River is outstanding. All sight seeing spots and restaurants can be reached in walking distance. At the same time it is completely silent.
The manager Jessica is definitely a super host. Always helpful, kind and supportive.
Definitely a place to come back to. 🙂
The place was beautiful, as in pictures, plus the astonishing views through the upstairs windows. The location was great! We had a lovely stay.
Porto is magic. This home is so beautifully located for shopping and eating. An amazing view. Comfortable beds and a nice kitchen area.

The appartment is very nice, clean, beautiful and well-organized.
The host is very helpful, and you can ask everything when you need.
I totally recommend this stay.
Beautiful house, in the most perfect location, close to everything. and such an incredible view from the window. we had drinks there at night, overlooking the Sé, before going out for dinner.

Fantastic location and great hosts. Easy to get to everything.
Be aware that the apartment is pretty small. Washer and Dryer not in the apartment if that's important.
Great great location! Beautiful views and great value. Staff were friendly and very helpful. Would definitely recommend

Perfect location to explore the city from! Not a very big house, but the bedrooms are spacious and the beds are comfortable. The view from the top room is breathtaking over the city.
One tip though: bring earplugs if you are staying with snoring friends… there aren’t any doors to shut out snoring (we have a loudly snoring bulldog at home, so are used to it)
Francisca was very attentive and helpful, very fast in answering any queries.
Loved staying there! Thank you for a wonderful stay!

If you like to stay in deep with a tiny cobblestones hills this is the place.
Very difficult to find it at first time.
We stayed a long weekend in the appartment, and it was just perfect! Would make the same choice again next time!
Fantastic place in the middle of historic Porto. Veronica was super responsive and the place was in great shape. Would definitely stay here again.

Our host Joanna was very attentive and accommodating by letting us check in 3 hours early.  The house location was perfect with great views of the Douro River and city skyline and the convenience of walking around downtown Porto.  The restaurants recommended was some of the best in Porto.
Adorable place within walking distance of so much entertainment! It was spotless and the hosts were fantastic communicators!

Absolutely gorgeous apartment with beautiful design elements and right in the middle of everything!  Very atmospheric!   Since the apartment is in the middle of the historic part of town, parking and finding the apartment is slightly complicated but Joana appeared at the parking garage immediately to help us - still not sure how she could have arrived there so quickly!   Truly a wonderful stay!
Central apartment with two double beds. Nicely decorated. Beds are on separate level but there is no door that you can lock

This place was small but mighty!!!! Other than the very steep street that was tough for my 73 year old mother, this place was PERFECT for the rest of us. The actual space is amazing. The view from the upstairs bedroom is just stunning. Super Clean, super efficient space.
Parking was a 4 min walk!!!!! Loved how central it was.

Great base to explore Porto, situated in a quiet backstreet with awesome view from the main bedroom. The apartment is modern and functional. We were charged an additional 20 euros over the 2 nights to use nearby secure parking which was very convenient. Communication was prompt, friendly and helpful.

A stunning, beautiful place & absolutely spotless. Great location, can walk everywhere! An amazing host, who met us prior to check in and ensure everything went smoothly. Couldn’t recommend enough, will definitely be back!

We had a wonderful time in this fantastic appartement! It is very nice, clean and perfectly located for tourists who like to walk around the city. We learned to love Oporto and the house II was a big plus, thank you Joana for these nice memories!

This is such a lovely home tucked into the historic streets of Porto. our host was so helpful and responsive.  Our only recommendation is to clarify that laundry is in another nearby building and it is shared with other apartments.  We wasted most of our first night finding it, waiting for it to be free, and then realizing it was a very long cycle. Otherwise we'd highly recommend this place!

Cozy apartment for sleeping and kitchen access. Great location. Provided excellent restaurant recommendations- some of our favorites that we wouldn’t have found without the help.  Nice amenities - delicious cookies, coffee, tea and filtered water was much appreciated. Comfortable beds and spacious bathroom.  To be aware - Laundry service was a quick walk down the street. Parking was in the public parking garage. Quick walk to the airbnb.

Loved staying at this place during our time in Porto. The apartment was perfectly equipped and very comfortable with beautiful views of the river and old Porto rooftops. It’s exactly as advertised - be advised that the street the apartment is on is very steep - getting bags up and down isn’t easy but well worth it!

Would 100% stay at this place again. The house is in a great location. We arrived and someone met us at the street for when we got out of the taxi so we knew exactly where to go when entering the home. Clean, good space, close to a lot of things!
The apartment is beautifully designed and decorated. Very clean and well equipped. Verónica and her team made us feel welcome and were very helpful!

This was an amazing Airbnb in a very central location. It looked exactly as in the pictures, and Veronica and Joana were great hosts. It was very easy to find the home (even in the rain at night, when we arrived), simple check in, and we felt at home immediately. Tons of cute cafes, restaurants, and shops nearby, and everywhere that we wanted to go in Porto was a short walk away. We will definitely be back!

absolutely stunning house in a fantastic location. the rooms and bathrooms were both really highly decorated and clean. the kitchen is small but works for the area (going for tapas a lot!). the rooms don't have much privacy as both a mezzanine style- didn't bother us but just an fyi

Had an amazing time in Porto and at this airbnb! The location is perfect - in the heart of Porto and about a 10-15 min walk to the river where there are a lot of restaurants. The airbnb was very clean and Veronica was very responsive. Would highly recommend!

This was such a perfect hidden gem in Porto!! Veronica greeted us when we got there, showed us to our place and was super great at communicating. The space was so cute, clean and private. Close to everything! I would recommend this place to everyone!!
What a beautiful space! It was a great location- walking distance to so much of the city! Also felt very safe.
The flat is great, perfectly clean and with a wonderful view on the Douro. We had a great time ! It is perfectly located in the centre, near plenty of very good restaurants ! I completely recommand !

Great vacation rental spot with attentive and kind employees. The place itself is a fantastic location on the river front promenade. It’s loud at night but it’s too charming not to enjoy. The building has an elevator and isn’t too difficult to use the stairs if need be. The staff were able to give us great recommendations and insights into the vibe of the city.
Beautiful place. The view from the apartment is breathtaking ! The apartment is located in the center, just a perfect location!
A must stay! Just do it. I will be recommending to all friends who go to Porto.

One of our best Airbnb experiences so far. The apartment was exactly how it looked on pictures, the views from the balcony were amazing and everything worked well. They also have an office where they allowed us to store our luggage on the last day, which is a plus for an Airbnb.

A wonderful apartment, in a wonderful city, in a wonderful location.
Our hosts were brilliant at communicating with us & guiding my daughter, who was travelling earlier & separately from the rest of, to the location.
I’m not sure you’ll find a better location in Porto.

We loved our stay at the apartment. The view is absolutely amazing! The apartment is in a great location within walking distance to everything. We appreciate the amenities like washing pods, drying racks, and complimentary port wine. The apartment is clean, spacious and the balcony is perfect to watch the crowds and Douro River.
The host was responsive and checked in was easy.

A good apartment in a fantastic location with amazing views - just a short walk to so many good bars and restaurants. Great, quick communication from the owners. Small issue with second bedroom, restricted height as built into the roof space.

Beautiful location and apartment was stunning.  In the heart of the Ribeira district which made everything walkable.  Balcony had an incredible view of the bridge, river and monastery.  Highly recommended.

Great location and great views.  Place as advertised. Nice place for two couples to stay, with two bedrooms and two full bathrooms.  Check-in was easy with a code.  The inside was clean, our only gripe was the roof deck was extremely dirty and we were unable to sit up out there and enjoy.
Nice apartment with a view and great location .The only issue we had the washer was  broken.

The apartment was positioned centrally. Everything was easy to walk to. The view is almost indescribable - I wished we had stayed longer ❤️
One of the hosts, Ricardo, was prompt to respond, courteous and willing to assist with anything ….. thank you!
We would love to return. Thank you!

Great location and nice apartment, with a beautiful view. The folks at YoursPorto were so easy to work with and very helpful! They went above and beyond to help us find a private driver when the train strike affected our ability to get to Lisbon. We would absolutely stay here again.

Property was clean and a good location. There is a patio to sit outside to enjoy the views of the river and Vila Nova da Gaia. It is great for couples traveling together with one bedroom downstairs and one upstairs.  The loft has sofas and a tv for relaxing. Would definitely stay again.

The location is in the heart of the historic district with fantastic views of the river, Porto and Gaia. Very convenient location and the balcony overlooking the river was a nice spot for happy hour. Antonio was responsive and helpful. He greeted us at the apartment and had a carafe of port ready for us to enjoy!
We had one small problem with a leaky sink, but they fixed it quickly. Otherwise, it’s in a great location and the view was outstanding.
One of the best airbnbs we’ve ever stayed. Apt is beautiful. The waterfront views stunning. Location is perfect. Would definitely stay here again.

Very good location and great view
Due to raining, sorry that we could not enjoy the terrace
Little uncomfortable, specifically the fire

Even more impressed than expected. The apt is beautiful and in a wonderful location. The views are incredible!!! We were in such a perfect spot to explore the area and get to anywhere we wanted. The upstairs was incredible and the apt had just anything we needed. Actually wish we stayed longer.
UNESCO neighborhood. Sympathetic restoration with great amenities. Central to all we wanted to see. Very walkable. Comfortable beds. We had an amazing time in Porto and Gaia.
Wonderful place to stay in Porto!! A beautiful view of the city and river. Comfortable accommodations and the host's diligence with responding to questions made us feel at home.

We loved this place. The view was incredible of the river and the natural light coming into the apartment was a huge positive. During our stay, there was a lot of rain and the weather was cold, and because of this we stayed inside and it was really nice to have such an accommodating apartment to be able to rest in. The beds and towels were comfortable, and the heating and air conditioning was really well set up the kitchen also had most of what you need and the refrigerator was big. I did have a little bit of a wait to check in, which was annoying because the host knew I had arrived earlier, but we worked it out. The only other thing that I would fix is to have faster better Internet service which impeded our ability to watch TV. Overall, the location was great and there were a million restaurants to eat at. This apartment is perfect for your stay in Porto.

Beautiful & central location, the double balcony adds so much to the space because of the amazing river views. Very clean. Loved how the upstairs and downstairs made the apartment feel like two separate spaces. Would stay again! Prepare for a short walk with your suitcases to the apartment as drivers are not allowed on the road out front.

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Porto! The view of the Douro River from the balcony is absolutely breathtaking — one of our favorite parts of the trip was enjoying a cold beer out there each evening after a day of exploring.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. We visited during a heat wave (95°F / 35°C), and the A/C worked perfectly, keeping the space cool and comfortable the entire time.
Being right on the river gives you a peaceful, scenic atmosphere, but keep in mind that most of Porto’s major sights are uphill from here. We’d recommend grabbing a metro card or using Uber to make getting around easier — totally worth it for the setting. This place was a relaxing home base with unbeatable views, and we’d gladly stay here again. Highly recommend for anyone looking to soak in the best of Porto’s riverside charm!
Amazing view of the Gaia and the Luis Bridge. It's exactly as it looks in the pictures. Right near bus and metro stations for getting around the city.

We had an amazing stay! The place was spotlessly clean and had more than enough space for two couples to relax comfortably without ever feeling cramped. The view was absolutely stunning—truly unbeatable. It was easy to find and in a great location, close to everything we needed. Honestly, we have nothing negative to say. Highly recommend!

Nice comfortable apartment! Very bright, large windows and good location. We were three families and we are comfortably accommodated in the apartment. Jose met us personally. He told and showed everything in the appartment. Also showed all the attractions on the map. Thanks!!!

Fantastic place to stay! Felt like a home away from home. But what made this stay extra special were the hosts. Joaquim actually picked us up from the airport after our transatlantic flight, gave us a tour of Contumil and kindly dropped us off at the city center since we wanted to explore downtown. Excellent communication between us and Joaquim and his daughter, Patricia, who is fluent in English.
Every morning, Joaquim brought us fresh bread and pastries. Not to mention the fresh eggs (Joaquim has chickens) and lettuce and fruit Joaquim grows organically (he welcomed us to take whatever we needed from his little farm)
What can I say - the hosts are just genuine, down-to-earth, kind, compassionate souls. We are so pleased that we will be ending our stay in Portugal with 2 last nights at Joaquim's place after our travels in beautiful Portugal.
Extremely clean and everything you needed. Less than 3 minutes to the beach. With e-steps you reach the centre of Porto in 10 minutes!
Excellent stay in Gisela's apartment. The apartment is very clean, ideally located and offers all amenities. A big thank you I absolutely recommend.
We had a wonderful stay next to the ocean and close enough if you need to explore Porto. It is good for long walk or run at the coast. Gisela was helpful und kind. Nothing to complain.
Gisela is a great host,easy going and friendly,the location is very good close to Porto,nice and clean apartment with two bedrooms and bathroom,good for four people,I recommend it to other guests

If you are looking for a very comfortable and family-friendly apartment in close proximity to the ocean, that would be a terrific choice. Quite far away from Porto's fuss, but still easy to get there (around 20-25 min by taxi/car).  The place is super-clean, cozy and fully equipped.
Thank you for letting us stay in your beach apartment. We had a wonderful time. Thank you for everything. We hope to visit again.

Very comfortable, nice apartment. You can see ocean through the window. Beach is just around the corner. Minimarket in the same building. 20 minutes walk supermarket. Perfect location for short and longer stays.

Gisela’s apartment was perfect for our family stay near Porto. It was very spacious (bigger than what it looked on pictures) and very comfortable. Everything is well equipped and extremely clean. Gisela was a friendly and helpful host :) in terms of location , it’s right next to the beach with some restaurants and bars. Going to Porto with a car is very close and easy. Definitely recommend !

A very nice apartment in an ideal location for a stay in Porto. The apartment is very spacious (larger than it appears in the photos) and cozy, with a lovely interior. Everything is well equipped and very clean. Gi is a great host and would stay here again anytime.
Very stylish apartment, perfect for 2 or 3 people in a great location. Only 5 minutes walk away from shops and restaurants! Would stay there again!

The appartment was very clean, the self check-in instructions were clear and easy. All basic supplies were there and the communication with Pedro went very well. The appartment is also very well located, with a supermarket at less than 5 minutes walking distance. We would definitely stay here again. Oh btw, the bed is very, very good and almost feels like you're sleeping in a hotel.

Marta's place was excellent. Location was just perfect, had all the amenities you could wish and communication with her was very quick. Check in and out was piece of cake and we could have not wished for a better stay. We will come back!

Good apartment that’s accurately depicted in the listing and is walking distance to some great cafes and restaurants.  Marta was very responsive which made our stay seamless. There are a lot of neighbourhood dogs so be prepared for some barking.  The bed was a bit smaller than a standard Canadian queen bed but still fit two people comfortably.
Everything was great. Easy to find and check in. Flat was clean and the layout was good. Can only recommend!
Very nicely and central placed. Good apartment. Small bathroom and loud and annoying dogs in the backyard.

Loved staying here! Very close to public transportation when arriving from the airport, but also so walkable - super great location!! Though it is a little cozy, we felt the apartment was the perfect amount of space for my brother and I to stay, especially with so much to do and see within walking distance! I also really appreciated not only having a laundry machine but also a small closet upstairs to hang my things!
I would book this again in an instant!

We really enjoyed the apartment and the neighbourhood. You can walk to the old city centre but also nice coffee places and restaurants.
Marta even prepared an extra towel for our baby and we were glad to have a washing machine at the apartment that we could use. The place felt really peaceful and not far from the busy city :)
It was an amazing place to stay. Very central, close to many attractions.  Petrónela was very good too :-)
A very central apartment close to the river and the Ribeira area. We loved our stay there.

Our family loved this place. It is very centrally located yet we had quiet evenings and slept well. We had restaurants, shopping, site seeing, and public transport all within minutes of walking from this apartment. It was clean and the host was very quick to respond. The place was spacious overall. I was traveling with my husband and two kids ages 5 and 3 and stayed for 2 nights. We would definitely stay here again when we come to Porto.

This is a lovely place to stay when you come to Porto: The apartment s superbly located - just up the hill from the river and within easy reach of some lovely restaurants. We especially enjoyed the two just opposite the apartment.
Patronela met us for the checkin and was amazing not only showing us on a map all the best places to go but also leaving us a decanter of port to welcome us too!
We had driven up from Lisbon and whilst there was parking in the street below it is very narrow so we ended up leaving it in the underground car park about 500 yards away.

Our stay at Petronela’s apartment was fantastic. She was a perfect host, taking the time to welcome us and give us local tips, and even saving a street parking spot for us out front when we arrived because she knew we were worried about parking. The apartment was a great size for 4 of us, and we joked that we would have had room to invite a few more!
Great central location; a few minutes walk to the station and the Ribeira. The apartment is spacious and comfortable. Petronela is a great host - friendly, helpful and very responsive.

Beautiful location in the heart of Porto. Petronela is very hospitable and quick to respond. Happy to help us with all our questions and local tips.  Great views from the loft windows, very lovely decor, walking distance to everything.  Great cafe directly next door - really enjoyed our stay and would stay here again next time we visit!
Petronela is super nice, check in was very easy going, she gave very good tips to visit around. The appartment was very clean, incredible location. Thanks Petelronela

Fantastic place, so beautiful! Such a great location. Nothing is far. Restaurants, tours, bars, cafes all within walking distance and the airport is also not too far. Great place for a trip with friends, more than enough space:) the balcony is beautiful.

Great apartment in old Porto. Spacious for our family of 5. The kitchen looked well equipped, though we didn’t use it other than for morning coffee. Walkable to everything we wanted to see and do. The apartment is on the top floor with multiple stairs. This was not an issue for us, but could be for elderly guests. We would definitely stay here again! Petronela was a great host!

Petronelas place was in a great location, just travelling the stairs was a bit struggle with luggage.
Apartment was special and we had a great time.
Petronela was very helpful

Petronela was a great host who was always responsive and proactive. The place is well-located and is a great spot for families. It was clean and well-equiped. I highly recommend to stay at Petronela’s apartment

Great location, simple and clean accommodation with great host who was flexible with our arrival and departure. You have accept there is a lot of building and renovation work going on in Porto to make it an even better walking city to visit. Thank you.
Petronela was lovely and met us at the flat to explain all to us. Restaurant and bars are just steps away from the building. Location is great and nearby to all. Flat is comfortable and very secure.

We had a great stay at Petronela's apartment. It is clean, very comfortable, and spacious. The location was a perfect base for our stay and was also really quiet for somewhere so central. would definitely recommend it.

Fantastic location in the heart of the old town. Great to have 4 bedrooms. The restaurant/bar next door was busy and noisy in the evenings, which could be disturbing for guests in the front rooms, but was fine for the 2 bedrooms at the back of the flat. There is also building work across the road, which created noise during the weekdays, but we were out all day, so that was not a problem. Had we spent more time in the flat, it would be nice to have more settee/comfy seating.  The kitchen was enough for our needs because we ate all meals out, but might need more pots and pans and a bigger kettle for families wishing to dine in more. The location and space was the real plus.
Place was in a great location, however construction was going on the entire stay right across the street and was unable to get good sleep each night.

Great location with some excellent restaurants close by. We walked everywhere and found the apartment to be very comfortable. There was construction on the street but that is not uncommon in beautiful old cities. A perfect Porto experience!

Absolutely charming home. Every room was full of character and beautifully displayed.
Backyard was a nice addition for a larger group. Many bedrooms for a larger group but main sitting area is smaller if that’s important to you. It was not an issue for us. Kitchen was well stocked for dinner cooked at home. Thank you for a lovely stay in Porto
The accommodation was fantastic. Very clean and in a good location to explore Porto. The accommodation absolutely matched its description.

Amazing place in the historic center. Next to everything. City town bridge restoration etc and Petronela is amazing. We had a problem with our key at 2am and she was here to help in few seconds..... just perfect

Petronela was a very helpful host, giving us advice on things to do during our stay and always responding immediately.
Would highly recommend this apartment for its cleanliness and location, definitely would stay again.

everything was good, the apartment is perfect and great  locations with a lot of good restaurant very close. Petronela is an excellent host who received us at the check-in and gave us recommendations of the best spots to visit in Porto.

We enjoyed our stay with Petronela. A warm welcome when we arrived. Petronela took her time to  explain about how to get to the historical sites in Porto. The apartment is very centrally located and you don't have to walk up a staircase, just 4 steps. Restaurants and nice coffee places are a few minutes walk from the apartment.  Kitchen is well equipped. A cosy place. Thanks for your help in organising a taxi for us Petronella and having metro tickets ready for us.
Petronelas place is in the perfect location to explore Porto. We had a wonderful 4 night stay and loved the city. Everything was very clean and the kitchen well equipped. Highly recommend!

Wonderful. Just as advertised. Beyond perfect location. Be aware that there is one back window and no view of anything other than the back area of a restaurant. But, that was clear to me in advertisement so not a negative. Just clarifying for others.
Nothing bad to say whatsoever about this place - clean, comfortable, in a great location and well worth the money! Petronela is also a really friendly and responsive host - 100% recommend!

Very central flat, within easy walking distance of everything. host was very responsive.
Didn’t realise that the flat was next to a bar, although quite there was a courtyard light that was on, with no blinds at the bedroom window…it made it very light! Very clean and comfortable though.

The location truly can’t be beat! You’re right in the middle of everything and just steps away from the train station. Plenty of restaurants and sights within walking distance. Communication was always quick and friendly.
Such a great value and amazing set up.  I was able to prepare breakfast, get to the city center quickly, and be away from crowds at night.  Loved it
Teresa is thoughtful and kind in communicating and making sure I had all I needed... the apartment was clean and perfect for me with some lovely extra touches.

Teresa’s apartment space is simple and pleasant. The no-frills apartment does just the trick when you need a place to stay that is in the city and close to great transportation! Teresa greeted us at the building in a timely manner, showed us the place, and gave us great local tips.
I recommend this place for anyone needing a nice landing pad in Porto. Thanks again, Teresa!
Teresa is an incredible person and her house is very well located, really clean and a great place to stay while visiting Porto
Beautiful sunny apartment in the center of Porto. Teresa was a responsive and very helpful host. I felt very comfortable staying at her place.

Lovely and cosy apartment in an ideal location in Porto. The whole process was very smooth and communication with Teresa was easy; she even provided me with a useful guide to the city and some delicious wine.

Clean and safe budget studio accommodation near the city centre and only a few minutes from nearest Metro station (with direct line to airport). Teresa and her husband Jorge  were friendly and helpful. Excellent communication throughout - recommended.

Teresa is a considerate and caring host but her place is definitely not worth the deal. I, by mistake, made a reservation for one person and I considered a fair price for the house. Then, once found out that I had to change the reservation for 2 people, the price almost doubled. I believe I overpaid for this accommodation. The house is basically a converted room with a good bathroom and not much more. Not very clean (I found a mass of hair on the TV table). The furnitures are cheap and you can hear every sound your neighbour produce because of the thin walls. The location is good and within walking distance from bars and restaurants.
Teresa was a great host. The apartment was exactly as described. It was a great location, close to the Trindade metro and an easy walk to the historic district.
Great stay with easy access to Trindade metro and walk into central. Thanks for the food recommendations and clean apartment.

Great location. Easy walking distance (unless you have health issues) to so many things. Easy to walk down to Luis I Bridge, Torre dos Clérigos, shopping, and many nice restaurants.
We had problems with the refrigerator. Teresa responded immediately and the issue was resolve quickly.
This is a great location from which to see much of Porto.
Great stay! Great location for the airport and city centre. Teresa was very friendly, provided us with a huge list of recommendations and some Port :)

The flat is very well located, and Teresa was always available to answer questions.
It was clean and similar to the description and pictures :)

Loved my stay in Porto. Teresa’s apartment was amazingly located in the city center. It was so easy to walk to all the city attractions. Teresa was very communicative and even gave a handful of great recommendations during my stay!
Lovely flat very well situated. In a nice area very close to bars and restaurant. Could be a bit noisy at night.

It was honestly the most beautiful apartment I’ve ever stayed in on Airbnb so stylish and had the X factor. Terrace and location ideal.
Communication and welcome amazing.

Stylish apartment in a fantastic central location close to great restaurants, bars and the sights of Porto.
The booking process was extremely efficient. We were met at the apartment by Rui who was prompt, extremely friendly and helpful. He gave us several recommendations of restaurants to visit and places to see, all of which were excellent.
We would book again.
Rafaela's place was pretty.  It was centrally located to enjoy Porto.  The amenities were lacking, but it was sufficient for our stay.
Perfect location, great recommendations for restaurants etc. very clean. Would recommend! If you are there over the weekend it is quite noisy at night
Great localisation, beautiful place, Rafaela explain everything, so we are going to come back for sure!
The location is perfect, near everything. The place was just the right fit, it was clean and just perfect.
A very comfortable apartment in a lovely central location . The apartment was clean and well presented.  Nice place!!!
Great location in town, apartment is on a Main Street 1 floor up so expect some noise. Parking lot is close and very walkable to attractions and restaurants.
Lovely apartment right in the fun part of town. Perfect if you’re looking for night life, but still quiet for sleeping.

Stayed here before I walked camino Portugese.  super close to everything and nice quirky space. there's a bus stop right underneath the window, so it  can get noisy but there are shutters that block the noise and street lights.

Great apartment, well located at the city center.
Rafaela communicated proactively, and was very helpful!

This place was in a great location with easy access to public transportation but most places were walkable. The place felt super homey and everything was clean. Only minor thing is that we couldve used an extra towel or a sponge but overall such a great stay!!

Rafaela's place is super cute and comfortable! The almost Parisian-like flat is eclectically decorated, yet very relaxing and beautiful. Loved the large windows and terrace doors (although not much of a terrace), and they allowed in wonderful Porto breezes. Everything was super clean, and although the kitchen seemed oddly pieced together, it still had everything needed. The only issue there was that the microwave powered on but did not heat up anything at all, but Rafaela promptly promised it would be replaced for the next guest.
While the check-in/out was pretty easy, the instructions themselves are a little over-written and could seem a little overwhelming - perhaps simpler instructions would be less confusing. Once understood, though, check in/out was smooth. Again, Rafaela was very responsive to every question and a good host.
The flat is also very central to absolutely everything! Would gladly stay again!

Great location! There was some construction going on so it was loud a few mornings but it’s directly in the middle of great restaurants, attractions and convenient stores! Everything was in walking distance so I never had to use transportation
Great location, outside noise wasnt an issue, if you know you book airbnb in the heart of the city you can expect some disturbance but it was totally fine for me. Great ambience, beautiful decor.
Apartment was great, at night we heard a little bit of  noise from outside, but we were tired from walking all day, so that didn't bother us too much.

This is a lovely place which we think was recently renovated and now made available to the public. It has everything one could desire except for the four flights of stairs with about 75 steps. Just climbing them is a challenge and going up with luggage is exhausting.
The staff managing this apartment are wonderfully efficient and helpful.

Really nice apartment in one main streets with diverse restaurant options. It is walking distance from the center and despite the 4th floors with stairs the apartment and beds are comfortable and just perfect for 4 people even for more. I would strongly recommend it’s is good value for money!

A comfortable house to stay and located quite close the public transport. It is also around 20 to 25 mins walk away from all major sightseeing location. The house is well equipped to cater to almost all needs. I enjoyed my stay and would recommend this place for your stay in Porto.

Stay was great! Maria communicated throughout the stay and made sure everything was good. The place was clean, organized, and in a great location. It's about 15-20 minute walk to the city center. The streets are wonderful to walk around and give you a good picture of local Porto life. Highly recommended!

Great Airbnb, couldn’t recommend more. All very good sized bedrooms with en-suites, lovely kitchen, living and dining rooms which were all very well equipped. Walking distance from all amenities and good restraurants and fantastic hosts!

Our apartment was in a great location! Within walking distance to everything Porto has the offer! The beds were very comfortable and having a bathroom with each bedroom was great! I would highly recommend Feel Porto and this apartment!
Enjoyed our Porto stay and this excellently located condo worked perfectly for our family!  And then best part was that there wasn’t any fight over the bathrooms as every room had their own!

As we were two families traveling together this apartment was just right. It has a nice open common area where we all spend time together. The en-suite bedrooms were small and has no closet but there’s a bar for hanging your clothes. There were some cupboards in the common area but it was not convenient for all 9 of us to use them. We were there for 3 night so we all managed. Location wise it was just right for us, it’s walkable distance to the Bolhão market and Santa Catarina (a pedestrian street in the center of Porto).   It was also an easy 15min walk to the river.

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto.  The location is perfect.  Close to the market and plenty of restaurants.  Rooms are small but having separate bathrooms was fabulous!  Yes the stairway is dark and could use some work.

We had 11 in our group and were very comfortable with the sleeping arrangements. One person slept on the pullout sofa and made that space their bedroom. There was plenty of other seating around the table. We walked everywhere, including across the bridge to Gaia and back. We did take the metro to see FC Porto play. Very easy! Our host was very responsive and helpful! Highly recommend!

The place was perfect for our group of 7 people. It had everything g we needed. Very clean, team was always helpful and available for all sort of questions . Perfect situated .
Thank you !

beautiful apartment!
perfect for 2 people, amazing views, perfect location. easy access to buses and trolley.. pictures didnt do it justice.
9/10 would recommend
Location, and the apartment is knocked out. Can't say enough except you will not be disappointed staying here.
Beautiful place right in the heart of the Ribiera. Even with the noise of outside on the weekends, the apartment is still quiet and i slept amazingly well each night.
