Location is exactly as it looks in the photos, you can sit on the sofa and watch the boats go by on the river, yours Porto was very responsive and easy to get hold of . Can be noisy at the weekends as you are right in the heart of the action , restaurants , bars etc and you can also see and hear all the action from Gaia , a quick water taxi or a stroll across the bridge gets you to the port houses etc on the other side . Everything we needed was in the apt including a washing machine , a cool experience but busy area
This was a top class stay in every way in a perfect apartment, ideal location and service excellent. It would be hard to better.

This place was amazing….The views!!! Host was super nice and responsive. Perfect size for 2 people. We really appreciated the restaurant recommendations and we ate at 2 of them.  Best dinners we had in Portugal!! The Alibi had delicious steak and Cervejaria Brasao had THE BEST Francesinha which I now crave daily, but can’t find it as good in Lisbon. Thank you for an amazing stay!
Amazing location right at the river within walking distance to the major sights. Great apartment to stay in!

Incredible view of the river.   Super comfortable and quiet.  Very modern amenities and well furnished with lots of space.  Great check-in with the host who was super nice.  Loved the neighbourhood.  A real find!

Listen, I booked this place last minute! Was in a rush and had no plans!
I reviewed everything, looked and had certain expectations and when I tell you this place exceeded it? It did!
The view, the location, the instructions, the space! Golly! Would come back again! And I just might!

Condo is in a great spot with a good view. However, you CANNOT drive to the condo to drop your bags off and then go park. U have to park and lug ur items to the condo. There was no plug for the bath, there no info about recommended locally owned restaurants. The washer hard to open and details on to use it.

Clean and beautiful room in a really charming building, just a few hundred meters from the ocean. The breakfast included was delicious and beyond expectation with fresh pressed juice, bread, cakes and cereals. Recommended.
Ana was very welcoming and helpful. She had a lot of great tips for us and would respond our messages in a matter of minutes. The place is brand new, very spacious and sparkling clean.

Lovely host. We had issues with the shower and bathroom but the host addressed all issues promptly.
Location is good and the flat looks great.

Great flat in city center, quick response, there’s everything inside that you need for your stay, only thought room WIFI could be better but other then that the flat amazing and the price is nice for the stay in such a flat. I really enjoyed the stay hopefully it’s not the last time.

The place is really nice, decoration is nice, the position of the flat is perfect and you can find all what you need for one or 2 nights. I think this is really important to say, that ear plugs are necessary cause the noise of the restaurant is quite important. I had some so was not a problem for me, but I can imagine if I couldn't have some ... would have been more difficult to sleep.
Very good location, all necessary amenities, just a bit noisy as there are many bars downstairs, but that did not bother too much. Quality worth price

The place is in an amazing location and everything was in order. Communication with the hosts was super easy and Mario was really friendly and helpful.
Definitely staying there again.

We had a great stay here, was everything we expected and a bit more with how good Mario’s communication was on helping with anything we asked
You won’t regret staying here , we hope to again In the future 😎

I had a great time at Mario's place. Very nice, cozy and well equipt. It is located in the heart of the beautiful old town, which makes the distance to many attractions just a walking distance. It's also surrounded by many nice food places.
Mario is a very kind and enthusiastic host. He reacts very quickly and is always willing to help.
He hand-made a map with routes that cover many beautiful spots and attractions are amazing. Plus his recommendation for restaurants and bars is superb!
Will go back again for sure!

Amazing location and very good communication with the host. Lovely spacious studio and very clean. Quite loud at night with music playing in bar/restaurant below, it didn’t bother us at all as we can sleep through noise but just a heads up if you stay. The host always responded instantly and we had a fabulous time here, thank you!
Great place to stay for a couple of days. Everything is within a walking distance. Alex was very helpful in his recommendations.
There is to much noise from the street cars. It is impossible to sleep in the groundfloor bedroom.

The apartment was perfect !! I loved how 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms were on separate floors that was very unique !! There was plenty of parking even in the front of the building, especially after 6 pm. We never had an issue parking.   The neighborhood was very quiet and easy to get to the downtown area, we had a car but there is subway, taxis, many ways to get downtown.   The kitchen was fully stocked with everything necessary and the apartment and linens were very clean !! We had a wonderful time and would definitely stay here again. Maria was accessible by telephone and was extremely accommodating and explaining things easily to us. She was so pleasant on the phone.  Thank you for a great stay and our first time visiting porto!!!
Alex’s place was wonderful and very centrally located. He let us store our luggage before our checkin and was a huge help. Highly recommend!

Great space. Private and well-located. Only cons: the apartment is beside the utilities closet for the floor or building. So, there's some noise and vibrations. Also, the apartment is above restaurants so there is noise from music and tourists but only until midnight or so on weekend evenings. Lastly, more detailed cleaning would make this place 5.0 rating but.
Overall, a great place to stay if you are out and about until late on weekend nights. Good value for a private space. Away from heavy tourism but so close to everything.

Grate location at the heart of porto, very , nice studio
can be a bit noisy at the evening from the bars and restaurants at the street

The place is very centrally located in the historic area of Porto, perfect location for a weekend or week away.
The appartment is nice, spacious and feels like home.
Mário was very attentive and quick to respond anytime we needed help.
We had a very nice holiday.

We absolutely loved our stay! The natural light that filled the room was an amazing surprise and it was perfect for what we were looking for. The location was great - in the middle of everything but couldn’t hear the hustle and bustle from inside! Highly recommend!

Very central location, extremely close and amazing restaurants (right next door some of them) and bustling street. It is a bit of a party area and can be loud at night! The bed and pillows were very comfortable which made up for it.
very nice studio in a great location! but 2 of the 3 nights, the flat above was playing loud music until the early hours. nothing the host could do but it does need saying
Great spot, nothing bad to say, only thing was not great wifi connection, but the location and quality of the stay was lovely :)

Diogo was a great host! We had a great time at his tiny glass house! It was clean and cozy. We loved the jacuzzi and the view. It was very quiet there so we completely relaxed. You can ask Diogo everything and he will help you with it, he got good advices and recommended places to go.
Just one word to describe this place and his host: Amazing!

The host were very very kind and reactive to the message. They offered us a bottle of wine and call a restaurant for us cause it was really late. Nice view, great jacuzzi, and a quiet moment of kayak on the river. Thanks !
Take a Jacuzzi or make a campfire while looking at the stars with relaxing rippling river noises in the background.  20 minutes from Porto. Car needed.

Diogo has created his own little paradise with this retreat. I really had a wonderful time in the glasshouse where I enjoyed the amazing view and the singing of the birds. This place is great if you want to get away from the city for a few days.

Diogo created the perfect place to have a relaxing and calming vacation. The glasshouse is such a cool alternative to normal apartments and in the middle of nature. It had everything we needed.
You must do the kayak tour on the river - it's worth it!!
Diogo is a very nice and helpful person. But at the same time he gives you enough space and privacy.
We would love to come back, we had a wonderful time :)

I’ve been using Airbnb for my travels for many years now and Diogo is the best host ever! He was always easy to reach to when needed. Also, a great guy to have a conversation with :) Definitely recommend staying here!

Location great. Cleaning could be done better, the previous guest's dirty sheets had been left in the stairwell which was not very pleasant.. Showers quite dirty too. Good place for a bigger group, nice, big terrace and as i said, the location is perfect just next to jardím do Morro.
Very good location, very spacious plase, close to mainly all important attractions. Very confortable beds and the terrace is really nice for enjoying an evening glas of port wine.

We thoroughly enjoyed staying in the apartment for 5 days. We received warm welcome and good intro from Daniel, who was very accurate and reliable. Apartment is great: super clean, spaceous, equiped with all you need and very well maintained. We liked the location a lot as it is in quite neighbourhood and just 10 min from center by metro and we walked back from old center every evening and could enjoy town more, restaurants on both sides of river and nice atmosphere on the streets. Highly recommend staying at this place. Very good value for the price and comfort.
Daniel’s place come highly recommended. It was very clean and the kitchen is well equipped and it is close to the metro.

We made a very late, same-day booking and Daniel was still able to accommodate us. He met us at the appartment and the whole thing went smoothly.  The place was simple but functional, with everything you need for a quick stay in Porto, close to shops and just across the river from the downtown tourist areas.  Great value too!

The place was exactly as it looks in photos and nice and spacious for us. The balcony gets sunlight, which is lovely. We were a little warm in the bedrooms, as there is no air conditioning in the bedrooms and ventilation isn't great. Additionally, the keys are sticky, which caused some issues, but Daniel was helpful. Overall, a good deal!

We had a lovely time in Daniel's place
The house is spotless clean and very easy to access
Would definitely come back
Fantastic welcome with local treats. host was warm and incredibly informative. Good location. Not right in the city but very easy access. Beautifully appointed apartment. Spotless with added extras.
The flat was suitable for a short stay.,comfortable and clean .Very attentive for check in and any problems.
Can highly recommend this flat, great central location. A safe place to stay also for a solo traveler. I’m definitely coming back to stay
Great modern apartment in a superb location. Lovely balcony with a peaceful atmosphere, right in the heart of the city. Everything you need for a stay in Porto.

The apartment is compact but has everything you need. It is clean and comfortable. The balcony is a good place to sit and have a drink and you can see the Cleric's Tower.
The location is ideal. All the places you want to visit are walkable. Sao Bento station and the metro are only 5 minutes walk away.
We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend Downtown's apartments as an ideal location to explore the lovely city of Porto.
Pedro and Sandra are wonderful hosts! The check in was very easy and everything was as described. We would highly recommend their Airbnb for a couple!

Wow! This was our first time in Porto and we could not imagine a better stay. This place is SO conveniently located: it’s close by the São Bento train station, lots of restaurants, and beautiful churches. The opportunities to explore are endless.
The place itself was clean, easy to access, and has an AC - a must have after long days of exploring.
Thank you so much HomePorto for this amazing stay. We cannot wait to come back.

We had a great stay in this apartment! It was very clean, looked just like the photos, and was  equipped with everything we needed. The location was also perfect, very easy to walk to everything you might like to see in Porto.

Pedro and Sandra’s apartment was great and just what we needed for our time in Porto. The location is amazing and they both couldn’t do enough to help. I would definitely stay at their airbnb if I was to visit Porto again!
great location! small space but more than enough room for 2 people. super easy to walk everywhere. we had a lovely stay
This apartment was perfect for our stay in Porto! It is clean and comfortable and close to all the Porto sightseeing and restaurants. Can’t wait to come back soon!

We had a lovely time staying at this property. It had all the listed amenities, was very clean, and easy to check-in. Surprisngly sound-proof as well, which was a nice bonus.
Also in a great location, close to shops/markets and everything was a walkable distance.
Fabio's place is an excellent choice for Porto! The magical advantage is l-o-c-a-t-i-o-n! The flat is spacious,  super easy to find, very clean and Fabio was very quick to answer all questions.
Really great location. Simple , but thoughtful accommodations. The women who checked me in even came back with an extra layer and umbrella when it started raining.

Fabio and Henrique were great host, very helpful and flexible. Fabio’s mother was also here for us and she took care of everything
Thank you so much.

The apartment is perfectly located right in the city center. The communication with the owners was fine, we just recommend placing an information about the WiFi somewhere, to make the access easier and avoid searching. In total a nice location to explore Porto

The place was clean and very central. The former Imperial Cafe turned (fancy) McDonalds is right around the corner. Amelia was the one who checked us in. She was incredibly kind and fun, but just be prepared to use google translate to communicate if you don't speak Portuguese.
ALSO make sure you have the keys in hand before the door shuts or you can get locked in.
Great location and very spacious for a flat. There was no air conditioning, just a fan, which made the apartment very hot in the summer months.
Fabio´s flat was very clean and very good located. It was a good choice. The only disadvantage was a noise in the building (doors, elevator) and from outside.
I have been a guest in this cozy apartment for a month. LovelyStay was very helpful and quick to communicate. The apartment was great, in the center of Porto, would definitely recommend it!
Nice place but sofa bed was a little uncomfortable and living room was nonexistent when the sofa bed was out
Really friendly host. She was very flexible regarding the time of our check in. The apartment is located in the city center where you can reach everything by foot.

Great stay at Susana’s, she was very responsive and allowed us to check in much earlier which was super helpful. Check in and check out we’re a breeze.
The place is just like the photos and located perfectly in walking distance of everything you will need.
We found it was missing a couple key items like there was no soap for the shower and no drying rack for dishes but otherwise had all the essentials. Thanks for hosting us!
Nicky
really central location. the flat was as described and comfortable. Susana was very kind and there to meet us when we arrived.
Nice apartment in a great location.  Raul is very friendly and with with clear and fast communication.  Would definitely stay again.
We had an amazing time in Raul’s flat, near the center of Porto. Raul’s communication was efficient and flawless, he also was truly thoughtful with us. Easy check-in.
Spacious apartment, with great location in Porto. Clean and comfortable. Outside area of the apartment very nice to sit and relax. Communication with Raul was great. Thank you!

This is a great apartment to immerse yourself in Porto but still be a little out of the noisy areas. Great sunroom for early coffee and sundowners. Apartment clean and we'll maintained. Would stay there again when in Porto

A superb location - not too touristy, yet hip with lots of stylish wine bars, restaurants and Vegan-friendly cafés.
The flat is spacious and well designed. When the temperature dropped outside, the flat got slightly cold, despite the two heaters, but nothing too drastic.
Raul, the host, is a super friendly, helpful and thoughtful person, making the whole staying even better.

Fanastic Airbnb apartment and host!! I stayed at Raul's place for four days on a work writing retreat. The apartment is fantastic - in the best location in Porto. It's nestled amongst the best food and hipster coffee shops in all of Porto, just away from the busy tourist centre but easily accessible to the whole city. The apartment is really big and beautiful, and the balcony is such a wonderful space.
Raul is a phenomenal host. He went out of his way to help me fix some issues I had with my personal laptop on day 1, so that I could work effectively during my stay. He sent excellent details before my arrival that made the check-in smooth and easy. He gave me excellent tips for where to rent a bike so that I could explore outside of the city centre.
I recommend Raul's apartment to anyone visiting Porto.

A big apartment in a great location. The apartment has a lovely sunroom and cool decor. The check-in was easy and so was the communication with Raul. He is such a welcoming and friendly host! This was definitely one of the best airbnb experiences I’ve had.

The place was perfect for a couple of days in Porto. The apartment is very well located and everything in the city can be easily reached. We loved the sun terrace!
Raul was a very welcoming host and provided a lot of information about the city.
Raul is the perfect host. Thoughtful touches like a personal map, treats in the fridge, and a very well equipped apartment in the perfect location made this an ideal stay.

Great, well equipped and comfortable apartment in walking distance of the historic centre of Porto.
Perfect as a base for a few nights in the city, and parking is a real bonus. (Although careful driving is required, and a small car mandatory).
We had everything we needed and were pleasantly surprised as to how large the place was.
My only critique is that although the location itself is quiet and safe, the building can be a little noisy due to the sound of the elevator. Also no air con, but fans are provided.
Lastly, Raul’s check in instructions were impeccable, and we really appreciated the beer and water left in the fridge for us.
Thank you Raul!
Raul place is perfectly located to visit Porto. The apartment is exactly as pictures and we loved the patio !  Raul is really responsive. I do highly recommend.

What a fantastic four nights at Raul’s home. To begin with, his communication was excellent. The instruction video he provided for entering the apartment was so informative. I felt very confident the moment we approached the building and had no doubts about what I needed to do. The apartment is spacious, clean, comfortable, and very quiet. Having a parking spot in the basement and elevator access made life really easy. A great location to have as your home base. My hope is we’ll return for an extended stay next time. Raul is absolutely a super host!

Raul was very helpful, friendly and the communication with him was easy and fast.
Its a nice Appartement, well located and good for stays in Porto. :)

Raúl‘s place is amazing and well equipped, also for longer stays. Great restaurants and bars are around the corner. We stayed for 3 months. The internet is working perfectly for home office.
The communication was super easy and Raul is very friendly and if you need anything he will take care of it quickly. We would 100% recommend staying here!
We had a very nice stay. Central position, clean, nice and spacious apartment, good communication with Raul. Everything was excellent, I would definitely recommend Raul's place.

I enjoyed this spacious apartment with lovely decor, and it was clean and well equipped with everything I needed. There were heaters in the living area and bedroom, which helped keep the chill out. It also has a nice sun room. The bed was very comfortable. The elevator was definitely convenient for me, but there are a few stairs to get to it. I found it very peaceful at night and I was there New Year's Eve! I liked the location and it was easy to walk everywhere. Raul was so nice, sent over very clear instructions, and was very flexible with my arrival/departure times. I highly recommend.

Raul has been an amazing host. He gave us a list of recommendations and the flat is very big and equipped with all the essentials and the bed is so comfy- feels like home.
The flat is quiet and closed to all the main locations.
He has been so helpful during our stay. Thank you again !

I can’t say enough about my stay at Raul‘s flat.
From the beginning, he communicated with very clear instructions regarding the flat. It was very clean and had all the amenities .
It is located in a very nice neighborhood where there is everything around you markets, restaurants, bars, etc.
The neighborhood is super cute and is in a hipster location, which was right up my alley
I will definitely stay here again, the next time I’m in Porto
Had an amazing stay. Raul has truly thought of everything a guest might need to have a comfortable stay.

We had a wonderful stay! The flat is very beautiful, had all the amenities you would need and is in a brilliant location! Our host was quick to respond to any questions/advise we needed! They were also flexible on the check-in time to suit our flight!
We had a lovely stay and would thoroughly recommend!

Our stay at Esmeralda Luxury Apartment was amazing. We were delighted with the comfort and design! We have everything that you need just like home, with that extra attention to details like you got in the hotel.
The location was excellent, so close to everything. Just one minute walk from Sāo Bento Railway Station, Dom Luis Bridge and Sé Cathedral.
Thank you for having us, we loved Porto!!!

Stunning apartment! Comfortable,  classy, clean and warm. Great location and great hosts who were quick to reply and gave us some good tips for the city.  Would definitely recommend this place to anyone who visits Porto and wants "a bit of luxury" during their stay.
Awesome place and perfect location walking distance to 80 percent of the best things Porto has to offer like food views and culture

Location, location, location and gorgeous décor are the highlights of this property. You will be able to walk everywhere (including to and from the train station, which is a few minutes away).
We found this beautiful apartment pristine and very comfortable. The water pressure is fantastic, as are all details that have been chosen with great attention and care.
Communication was also great. Highly recommended.
Really nice place in the historic center of porto. We had a great stay and would definitely go again. Recommended!

Emerald City!
What a lovely flat! We had a great time in Porto and our hosts were super attentive from the moment of check-in, to giving great recommendations and all the way through check-out.
The place is spotless clean and in an absolutely wonderful location, close to the river, to the cathedral and only a short walk from various restaurants and the nightlife. Couldn’t recommend enough!

Absolutely loved this place! Super stunning inside and the location is perfect. Few mins walk from the bridge with amazing views of the river. And a few mins walk the other way to Flores street. Unfortunately we found it quite noisy but I think we just got unlucky with the people staying upstairs! The hosts send lots of tips and it made for a really great stay.
This place is GORGEOUS and in the center of the city! They even allowed me to have an early check-in and a late check-out, which was SO appreciated!

We had a wonderful stay here during our time in Porto! The inside was very clean and beautifully decorated. The location was perfect to be walking distance to anything we wanted to see in the city. We would definitely stay here again!
this is an amazing place to stay in porto and the service is really great i really hope to visit again
Had a great stay at the apartment, easy walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go and great hosts.
The apartment could not have been in a better place, near the train station, the cathedral and central to everything we did. We had no complaints, only good opinions. Thanks fora great stay.

Lovely apartment in a great location. Very nice bed and linens. The location was perfect, close to restaurants and an easy walk down to the river. My only issue was that I wasn’t able to operate the stove- I had planned to cook a few meals, and written instructions would have been very helpful. Otherwise the apartment was great.

Great location and lovely apartment! Would recommend for an easy stay, close to the bridge which makes it super easy to see both sides of the river. Apartment was clean and tidy with all the amenities. Would stay again ⭐️

Their place was in the ideal location if you’re looking to spend time on both sides of the river with direct access to ponte Luis. The place was the perfect size and had everything we needed. Restaurants and coffee were super close by as well.

They were quite helpful over text. The place has amazing towels + water pressure +  soft robes after a day of walking the streets of Porto. Discounted parking (~40% off) 5mins away if youre doing a road trip. Centrally located but the windows can let in sounds / light or can block the sound/light depending on your preferences.

We stayed at the music flag for 6 nights. The apartment is located in a quiet portuguese neighborhood which is great for someone who wants to experience more than just the touristic parts of Porto. There are plenty of bars and cafes within walking distance. It is also very reasonably priced and clean.
It is a good size for two people but the walls within the apartment and in the building are paper thin and it is very easy to be overheard and to hear things you might not want to :)
Overall it was a convenient and pleasant experience and definitely worth recommending!
Nice and cosy flat, near to metro and bus station. Can be loud when the windows are open. Kitchen is very small but weel equiped.
The room is well located and it has a lot of amenities, we enjoyed our stay and the communication is very good in terms of taking actions and responding.

I can highly recommend Martha's accommodation.. friendly reception.. absolutely clean.. if I had any questions, she was always ready to help me.. and proper duvets.. 10 minutes to the train that goes to the old town... Next time in Porto I will definitely book with Martha again...

Martha has been a wonderful host
She has always been happy to help or accomodate us during our stay!
Very nice place to stay when visiting Porto. In between the centre and the coast, very spacious room and comfortable beds, and great DIY breakfast. Highly recommended!
Marta is a lovely person and was very helpful during our stay. The room was very comfortable and clean. We had a nice stay and would highly recommend it.
Amazing place! Super clean space and a good location. Walkable from lots of the shops and beach

Very good location in center of everything, very comfortable bed.
Free parking is not always available depending on your luck.

When I say peaceful, it’s hard to believe because I was steps from amazing restaurants, famous streets & landmarks in the middle of a super busy town. Yet, with shutters closed it was super quiet. The unit is as described and Yanan is a beautiful person always checking if I needed anything. Would stay again x 10 :).
Great location, everything is in walking distance. We were greeted by host's friend Luis. He was extremely friendly and made a list of things to see around the place.
Yanan’s place was great! I highly recommend this for the great location and she is very sweet!

This place has what you need for a short-term stay in Porto. It’s located very close to São Bento station and makes for a great hub to sightsee around Porto. We felt very safe walking around this neighbourhood at all times.
It’s close to the center of Porto, The host is very kind and supportive.highly recommended.
Great place at the great location.  Very clean and organized. Yanan was quick to respond and helpful.  I definitely recommend!

Our stay at this charming loft was absolutely delightful! The space was clean, beautifully decorated, and had all the amenities we needed for a comfortable stay. The host was incredibly responsive and provided great local recommendations, making our visit even more enjoyable.

Yannan was a great host and very helpful. The location was great (but note you’ll have to climb a large hill to reach) close to Porto’s main activities and extremely walkable. The place was clean and as described, perfect!

Yanan’s place is in an excellent position - close to Sao Bento Metro with cafes and restaurants very close. It is very comfortable for two people, is well equipped with good facilities. Yanan was easy to contact - always responded quickly in a caring manner to any enquiries or concerns. Would stay there again.
Yanan’s apartment was in the perfect location, comfortable and exactly as advertised. She was very communicative and provided local recommendations. Would definitely stay again!

Wow! We couldn’t have asked for a better place for our visit. We had everything we needed. Great for two people.
Warm shower. Comfortable/firm bed. Enough outlets. Excellent location. Friendly host.
Enjoyed the uphill walks after eating so much fabulous food.
I would definitely come back but for much longer.
To know: Uber picks up in the parking lot off the main street by the bus stop. They are not allowed to drive on the street at apartment. We got dropped off at the apartment so didn’t know differently.
A great place close to the train station. Easy walk to everywhere in Porto and Gaia. Yanan was a great host and very friendly to communicate with.
Perfect flat in superb location. Yanan was very responsive and helpful. Right in centre of town so not quiet especially during Sao Joao!!

Yanan’s place had everything we needed for a very comfortable stay.  It was clean and quiet. A/C worked great.  Detailed instructions for getting there and checking in.  An easy walk to shop and restaurants.   Yanan responded very quickly to any questions we had.  Will definitely recommend to anyone I know that’s headed to Porto.
We loved staying here! Yanan was extremely welcoming and ensured we had everything we needed, including recommendations for Porto. Her apartment was super comfortable and perfect for what we needed.
Great  location in Porto.  Everything was  a short  distance  away.  We  enjoyed our stay immensely.

I really enjoyed staying at Yanan's property. You couldn't ask for a better location, being near so many points of interest, ideal for spending time in Porto or Vila Nova de Gaia.
Yanan was a great and courteous communicator, offering suggestions, and had a genuine interest in making you feel right at home. I would not hesitate to stay at Yanan's place upon a return to Porto!
Obrigado Yanan!

We had a good time in this lovely apartment. It is very clean and has high quality furnishing and we liked the location a lot.
We would recommend to bring ear plugs because the seagulls can be kind of noisy, but that is everywhere in the city (has nothing to do with the apartment).
It was just perfect:)

Great location and reasonable price. Clean. No AC so not ideal for hot summer weather. Although the listing says keypad check in, the host required a lot of communication both days and an hour before expected check in time and referred to needing this information for a host to “meet” us, which was not ideal as a traveler who was not making very set plans, and ultimately, after having to give these specific timed notices, no one met us physically and we were just given a code via whatsapp right before.
Beautiful apartment with two great balconies - great for relaxing and drinking some wine! Nice central location - very close to the tourist center.

Super clean and well equipped place in a cool neighborhood. Communication and check in and out is super easy.. Very friendly and warm people run this place. The linens smelled sooooo good.  Well situated for airport. Csn totally recommend!

Jose and his staff were friendly and helpful.
The Airbnb is located conveniently to walk around.

Overall, I liked our stay, Jose was very helpful. The housekeeping lady Amelia was the best and the nicest. However, the main disadvantage is the lack of the air conditioner - it gets very hot in there. :)

It's a pleasure to stay at this place. It's very quiet at night. 3 mins walking distance to Sao Bento train station, very convenient. There is reception desk  in front of the apartment building to help with check-in and check-out. We enjoyed our stay there. The only issues we had were no hand soap in the bottle when we arrived, and the shower head don't stay in place properly. But will definitely recommend this place to anyone planning to visit Porto! A very clean and lively apartment!

Everything was perfect. To all the aspects to be considered when traveling and staying in a place, I give 5 stars!  Special thanks to Eloi, who received us, gave us a map with great tips that we followed and helped us enjoy Porto a lot! We are DEFINITELY staying again here whenever we come back to Porto! Thank you!

Our stay in Porto was perfect! The apartment was in an amazing location, very walkable into the city with a supermarket and restaurants right outside the door. We’d especially recommend the steak restaurant, ‘Cumplice’ for a great dining experience.
The hosts were very responsive and met us at check in to show us around the apartment.
The apartment had everything we needed and was very clean and comfortable. We’ll definitely stay here again if we visit Porto in the future.

This apartment is really chic and located in a quiet neighborhood not far from the historic center (20 mins walk). We loved the balcony facing a cosy backyard. Only downside was that we couldn't get hold of one of the oranges growing there.
Sunny apartment in a quiet neighborhood. The sleeping area has low ceilings with beams, so it could be uncomfortable for someone who is particularly tall. Otherwise we loved our stay there.

The apartment is very aesthetic and photogenic! It's also warm to sleep there with air conditioner on which is of primary importance to us. There is everything you need: soap, shampoo, coffee capsules, dishwashing liquid, etc. The apartment is relatively not very far from the center. We walked, but Uber in Porto is also very affordable. We really enjoyed our stay!

It was a unique stay - the apartment included intriguing details such as the bedroom, and how it was set up. It was a comfortable and cozy space for when it rained during our stay - being able to overlook the orange trees from the living room, whilst hearing the rain-pours down the roof and the basement/ceiling window, made me feel right at home.
I must also point out that when we needed to make a query, our concerns were promptly taken into consideration and actioned.
Elegant apartment perfect for a couple with a postcard-perfect view of the Douro. Great welcome from apartment managers.
I can only recommend this apartment, location was perfect, host was really friendly and helpful. Hopefully I will come back soon. Greetings form Slovakia
Goncalo and the team are really attentive and professional. Flat was equipped with everything we might need and their communication was great. thanks!

The apartment is excellent! A great location, close to all land marks and tourist attractions and são bento station. The view is stunning. The hosts were very receptive and carrying throughout all the stay, checking in to make sure everything was good. The apartment is big, airy, bright and clean, with new appliances. The bed is really good. Overall a great stay in Porto.

Communication was great, the team were really attentive and made sure we had everything we needed. Overall the apartment is great, has everything you might need, it's just like in the pictures. Location is good as well

The apartment looks like in the pictures.
The host was helpful and kind.
The apartment's location so great. 👌

I had a fantastic time.   Even with iffy weather everything was wonderful and so comfortable.  Having three cafes so close was nice in case we ever wanted anything and one had a Fado presentation.   I will hope to stay again when I return.  Our host was wonderful and recommended a few things that I did while I stayed.

This could not have been a better location. Truly in the center of everything. Multiple Cute little cafes to get coffee, food and snacks with an absolutely amazing view. Will definitely come back here if we go to Porto again. Great recommendations, responds quickly, awesome
Stay. Thanks so much!
Great place to stay in Porto, there are everything you need in this appartement and it was a very great location close to the center ! Would recommend it

We had a really lovely and very comfortable stay at Domingos and Nair's apartment. It was big, bright, spotless and very well equipped with everything we needed and more. The photos don't do it justice. There was a lovely bottle of port there to welcome us. The location is fantastic, a 5 minute walk to a beautiful sandy beach with lots of cafes and restaurants. I would highly recommend the Alves restaurant! Amazing food and service at reasonable price. We took Uber to Porto downtown few times and loved ot there too. we could have taken the tram there but the uber was very cheap. I would also recommend the vineyards tour with wine tasting, great experience. All in all, we really enjoyed our stay at the apartment and had a great relaxed week.  I would definitely recommend it. Thank you so much Domingos and Nair and wish you all the best. x

I have spent with my friend 4 nights in this appartment. It was clean and cute place (1 bedroom, kitchen, bathroom). We have faced first night problem that there is no heating but it was solved the next 3 nights. We have received some brochurs and tips from Vitor which helped us to organize better our trip.
Near the appartment, you can find supermarkts, bus station and metro station (combatente) which led directly to the center of Porto.
Unfortunately, we couldn't use the swimpool ( 10h - 19h ) as we prefered to explore city.
Big thanks to Vitor, Patricia & Co. and we would like come back to your place once we visit Porto again. ;-)

Everything went great with our stay. The staff was always available, the place is well located, clean, full of details that contributed for the entire experience. I will always recommend this option when friends are traveling to Porto.

Enjoyed our stay there for a week. We loved the area being not touristy but still had a lot of good food options around. Very friendly host smooth communication and lovely swimming pool. Definitely recommend!
Had a great stay here. The room was really clean and spacious, the pool area was so nice and the hosts were super friendly and helpful.

We stayed from Sept 23-26th.
The apartment was very clean, charming with high ceilings and wood beems, wooden shutters o windows. There was a small kitchen and it had everything for cooking! We loved the quite space with pool outside in the back!
The location is good and close to metro, café and shopping.
We especially enjoyed our Hosts Filipe and Jose. They are both very friendly and knowledgeable about Portugal.
We definitely would recommend this apartment!

Thank you Parisa. You were a star nothing was too much trouble. You made our stay in Porto so memorable.
Even giving help with directions for various things we were interested in doing.
The accommodation had everything you need for a comfortable stay.

Everything was perfect. The host helped us to check in he was supper friendly and also provided a complimentary wine which we enjoyed it and the apartment was clean  and have all the amenities that we will need during our stay. My child he really like the pool and the pool area was clean and tidy. I will recommend my friends and family members if they go for vacation in Porto. Bus stop is near by the house and metro is 2 to 3min max from the metro and it is very easy to access all the tourist spot from the apartment you can go all the prime tourist spot with is 10 to 15 min from this location. When ever we come to Porto we will stay here great place for stay.
We had a lovely stay. I needed a place to rest after surgery and this was ideal. The pool was very nice and warm, the staff was very friendly and helpful. Thank you!

The perfect place to stay in Porto- a lovely apartment with all the amenities you need and very close to the metro where you can really easily get anywhere around Porto. The hosts are so welcoming, friendly, and communicative, and take the time to show you everything and even create a map with recommendations.
Thank you to the hosts, I would definitely come back! :)

Our stay in your accomadations was excellent. The response from our host was exceptional. Having the ability to walk into the old city was fantastic. For those who do not enjoy the 45 minute walk back up the hill, the bus stop is steps from the apartment. We would highly recommend this place.

We had a fantastic time staying here for a week and would absolutely stay here again if we were in Porto!! The pool was a big highlight. We stayed in May when the temperature is a little variable outside, but because the pool has an enclosure it was enjoyable to lounge in every day and really made the trip for us.
Pros:
- Friendly, pleasant staff
- Clean, well furnished room with AC, cooking facilities and comfortable bed
- Quiet, nice atmosphere in the building
- Well connected with a metro stop 5 mins walk away and a shop even closer
- The pool!
Cons:
- No downsides - for the price this is a fantastic place to stay :)
Thank you for an amazing week!

The place is really cosy and right in the center of the city!
The terrace is really enjoyable too in summer.
Perfect for a full week for a group of 3-4.

We really enjoyed this place.
It Is clean.
It is very well located.
Small outdoor is very cool to share moments.
Beds are confortables

Pedro and his airbnb were incredible. Very helpful with tips and suggestions. The airbnb was clean and perfect for what we needed.  7 -20 minute walks from everything you need. Thanks Pedro, we will be back!

The location is very close to everything, just within walking range. The apartment is clean and cozy. I loved the little patio where I enjoyed my cup of coffee. The host is very friendly, welcomed us, and gave a lot of useful information. Thank you!
Great place for my young family. Having the patio was very nice for my 16 month old to run around and play in.

Lovely stay here. There were 5 adults and plenty of space for us all. The ceiling height on the mezzanine is pretty low but that was fine for the 2 of us who were under 5’5. Good amount of standard apartment stuff and didn’t feel like anything was missing. Location was great and we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go in under 20 mins.
Very spacious apartment in a great location. We did remote work for a week and it was great. Very fast internet and two tables to work on. Would come again!
Spacious apt for 5 people, free parking was great, restaurants close and very walkable to sites. Great deal on price for 2 bathrooms and 3 bedrooms we were pleased.

Apartmentis really well located in the middle of restaurants and sights. the windows close to keep the street noise out and blackout shades for complete comfort.  elevator was a great plus for our bags and tired legs.
This apartment was clean and located in a fanatstic section of Porto. We will use it again if we return. Pedro is a great host.
A really lovely stay in a perfect location. It's on a street with bars and clubs so can be a bit noisy but that suited us!

What an amazing place for a family of 4 with two teenagers.  Clean, spacious , modern, well-appointed and a fantastic central location.  Close to all the sights and nightlife.  Great communication as well with our host, Pedro.  The Portuenses are a very friendly people.  Will definitely be back 😎

Beautiful, spacious and well-equipped apartment in the best part of Porto with good wifi. Checkin and checkout was a breeze. Pedro was super communicative and responsive. He helped us store our bags as we needed some more time. Our only issue was with the club outside playing til 6am on the last night of our stay. This might be an issue if you are a light or sensitive sleeper.

The apartment is really nice and the location is amazing
It is in the center of all the activities of Porto
The apartment is also strangely quiet, being in such a busy street we were expecting it to be noisy by them insolation is really good
Very large, clean and central appartment. Easy communication with the landlord. Due to central location (party street) it can get a bit louder at night.
The apartment have a perfect location, it was neatly cleaned and very confortable for our group of 4 people.

Beautiful apartment in a very central location.  Apartment is large and  felt like home. Would recommend to those who enjoy the nightlife located on the street. Apartment is super central otherwise and a good base to discover Porto.
Very nice place, close to many attractions. Everything was as described and we enjoyed our stay. However, it is located on a street with several clubs and the music was loud.

This is a spacious, well-appointed and detailed apartment right in the thick of things in Porto. Large kitchen that is reasonably well- equipped, comfortable living area, two comfy bedrooms, and two nice bathrooms. The street itself is quiet during the day, hopping at night. Easy walking distance to many things in Porto.
As others have mentioned, it is a busy nightlife area. The windows and shutters helped a lot - we heard no voices at all. There is one bar in the next building that is open until 6 am and plays bass-heavy music beginning around midnight. Heavy-duty earplugs helped, but still not able to completely eliminate the sound. A consideration if you are a light sleeper or prone to waking up during the night.

This is a really nice Airbnb and great value for visiting Porto. We stayed 3 people here very comfortably. Worth noting it’s on a bit of a party street, but the thick walls and windows prevent any sound while sleeping so all good. Walking distance to lots of great restaurants and areas in Porto :)
The place is very central so everything can be done walking . The leak in the apartment damaged our close and had an awful smell . And it is very noisy up to 6:00 Am

Stunning, modern space in a great area. Key features: Comfy beds, elevator, central air, updated furniture, TV with good streaming options, and easy self check-in. Most notable for us was the large living room area that gave my baby niece enough room to crawl around. The host also provided a crib for us upon request :) Side note: it is true that it gets a bit noisy at night. You can definitely hear the bass from the local bars, but we had no issues falling asleep. Thank you for an excellent stay!
This apartment is a perfect place to chat with friends after a long day in Porto, as it has huge round table which promotes warm and sincere discussion!

Very nice and clean apartment, good location near the shops and only 5-10 minute walk to the main old town. Good communication with Pedro, a good host! Would have liked maybe a few more essentials like salt and pepper and oil but a great holiday!
We really enjoyed our stay - the flat is well-equipped, well located and extremely comfortable. Pedro was very good at communicating and helpful throughout our time in Porto.

António ist truly a superhost... not only always ready to help but also from an unseen hospitality.
The place has one of the best possible locations. Central and with amazing connections to speedways and/or to public transportation.
The apartment was very clean and well designed. You are in for a treat with the sunsets, the garden on the first floor and the private gym.
Overall a great apartment with a very well-educated and friendly host.
My spot in Porto from now on.

This was definitely one of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed in. The apartment was very, very clean, nicely decorated and the bedroom as well as the bathroom were just fantastic. The private basement car park is for free, which was just perfect, too.
Antonio was the best host ever. His hospitality and quick responses to any kind of questions were just brilliant. Thank you so much Antonio, we’ll definitely come back!

António’s apartment is absolutely great, fancy and super clean, in a nice location of Porto. Garage is available and António was very responsive all time.
Highly recommended apartment!
Brand new apartment with everything you need. Full kitchen, smart tv, private parking, and a small gym. Host also allowed for a later check out time.

The appartment was very clean. Check-in is also very easy as you can open the door with your phone and you can do it by yourself.
The appartment has a very nice view. Walking downtown Porto takes about 10 minutes. António answered questions very quickly via the chat which really helped especially because of corona testing. Overall we had a very nice stay in António‘s appartment and we can totally recommend a stay there.

Antonio was very helpful, communicated very well and accommodated an earlier than planned checkin. The space was clean and comfortable. Location was a bit distant from the city centre; it was walkable nonetheless, and very close to a key landmark - the Jardins do Palácio de Cristal. Enjoyed my stay and would book again.

A new apartment, very nice, as shown in the pictures, with excellent location, quiet and view to the duoro river. Excellent for families and with small children. Everything you need for a comfortable and quiet stay in a wonderful city.
Nice apartment, a little out of the main area of Porto. Getting into the apartment is a bit complicated. Otherwise nice apartment
Lovely apartment in the middle of the city - location is perfect! highly recommended. Pedro was a great host who gave loads of tips and was available for any questions. Thanks!

This Airbnb was the perfect place to stay in Porto it was modern, spotless, and beautifully designed.  The location was perfect, with easy access to great shopping, restaurants, and the waterfront just a short walk away.  The patio was a wonderful spot to relax and enjoy the atmosphere, I’d highly recommend this home to anyone visiting!

Our stay was great! The location was very convenient within the core of Porto, making it easy to do sightseeing. Lots of cafes and restaurants are nearby. The apartment is quite spacious. Check-in was very accommodating and flexible. The shower had good water pressure. Internet was also good for two remote workers with good options to work in different areas of the apartment.
Lovely apartment at a great location.  Highly recommend! Will stay there again when I come back!!!
The place was fantastic! Incredibly clean with an amazing location. Pedro was so helpful and responsive the entire time. Highly recommend!

Probably the best place you can find for such a good price and its outstanding quality. Much more than we expected! The location is simply 5-10 minutes walk from everything, the area is safe and very beautiful. On the bridge next to the apartment you can watch spectacular sunsets (tip). The manager of the property is very professional and flexible for the best experience of her guests. If we go to Porto any time soon, I will with no doubt contact her to stay there again.

I really appreciated Jorge’s place - very welcoming and very well kept. I rented a car and could park right outside on the road. I also went to various places at the Arouca Geopark and Jorge’s place was a central location for the outlying communities. Also walking from Villa Tavares to downtown was about 5 minutes as there were walking paths handy near that location. I travelled alone and felt very safe. I highly recommend staying with Jorge at Villa Tavares!

It was all very good at this place. The only problems were that the bathroom smelled very strongly of humidity and that when you showered, too much water would spill out of the shower floor, wetting the bathroom floor.  All the rest was impeccable.
The whole place was wonderful, really luxury, located in a calm neighborhood but close to the city center and with easy metro access. Would definitely come back

We had a wonderful four night stay at Miguel and Ilze’s apartment. It was so convenient for exploring Porto, with many great options for food nearby - we did our best to tick off their brilliant list of local recommendations! Everything was as expected and we really appreciated being able to check in a few hours early and the quick communication! Thanks again!

Even thought we gave him a very short notice (actually less than an hour) Tiago was really fast in his response and eager to help. Our previous host cancelled and we were able to find somewhere to rest thanks to him. The place was really chill and cozy, it had even coffe and some spices to cook. It was clean and tidy and he welcomed our dog without problems. We had a very pleasant experience and would recomend it to anyone!! 😁

I had a great stay. I was traveling solo, so wanted somewhere that was safe but still convenient - and this was perfect. About half an hour walk to the city centre and only 15minutes to a large grocery store. The kitchen was great and fully equipped - the apartment has everything you would need for a comfortable stay.

When we arrived very late we were able to easily check in alone, the place was clean and tidy. The kitchen is well equipped, the whole place looks exactly like from the pictures. The location is great if you want to be a bit further from all the city hassle, it’s not far from the airport. The host was always responsive and helpful if we had any questions! The only thing is that it’s very humid inside and our clothes and bed sheets were always a bit damp, but other than that we liked our stay here a lot!

Great place to stay.
Although a little far to walk into the city center (about 30 mins) it’s well situated for bus stops and public transport but there are a few shops, restaurants and supermarkets close by. The host was very responsive and very pleasant to deal with. The accommodation is exactly how it is from the photos.

Clean and well equipped studio.
However is a basement, humid and has a musty smell.
Easy check-in/out. Good communication.
Beautiful apartment that is located in the old part of town of Porto. Very easily accessible. The apartment is clean and very well equipped. Highly recommend for a couple or small family!

Beautiful apartment in a great location to all of Porto's top sights. The street is a steep hill (like most of Porto) and the apartment is on the 4th floor (by American standards) so be prepared for a small climb going home. Cute restaurants close by. Great host! I would definitely use this apartment again on my next trip.

The place is so great!
Joana replies really quickly for everything and is really kind, she only has good recommendations, you should definitely follow them. The location is PER-FECT (I insist, we saw a lot of other rental apartments but still think this location was the best) and the coffee Capela down the place was our breakfast place for the week.
The pillows and beds are comfy, there is enough soap/toilet paper/coffee/tea for a stay. It was very clean (even inside the kettle and coffee machine, AMEN). It’s really bright, which we loved, but fully dark when you close the blinds.
Looking forward to our next stay in Porto!
The apartment is so pretty, bright and lovely. It is very, very close to everything (the center) and still in a quiet street. It is perfect!
Great place to stay, in the middle of the old city center, close to the river and also to more "alive" parts of the city center.
Great apartment in a wonderful location. Lots of excellent vegan restaurants within walking distance. Would happily stay here again.

Great place!! Looked newly remodeled, the location really made us feel like we were staying in old town Porto, well lit streets, very close COOL bars and restaurants. Up and down steep streets that curved like a maze, yet a few blocks and you’re in central business area or the river or the pharmacy (for our Covid test for return flight). We walked down the river to the ocean, we E biked a 3 hour tour and 1 day trip to Douro Valley, then we went back to a very cool modern apartment and slept like babies.
Thank you for sharing your place
This apartment was a perfect spot for travelers exploring Porto. It was very clean, comfortable, and in a convenient location for accessing the downtown.

I absolutely love this airbnb  location. Its a very   peaceful and quiet  area and  It's not that far from the main attractions. Place was very clean and comfortable. A/C was a plus and the rest of the commodities as well. Also the comunication with the host was  great. I  totally recommend this airbnb.

This apartment is in a perfect location, walking distance to the river, restaurants and all the general tourist hotspots! We even managed to walk to some of the beaches (roughly 1.5 hours). The apartment was modern, clean and had all the things we needed. The check-in / check- out was easy!
We will definitely stay here again when we come back to Porto! Thank you so much :)
The location was perfect - walking to distance to so many places. The streets around are charming. Apartment was very clean and welcoming. We will be recommending it.
Great location and a pretty apartment. We were 2 couples and very comfortable. There are heaps of things to do within a short walk. Had a nice dinner at The Door, not far up the hill.

Maria Joãs’s place was beautiful, just like in the pictures. The neighborhood was perfect, close to everything and very walkable (but hilly as is most of Porto!). Maria and Sarah were so helpful with recommendations and quick to respond to any questions. Loved this place, would definitely stay again!

We had an amazing experience staying here! Maria Joao was so incredibly responsive. She even had someone greet us at the apartment to show us around who drew recommendations out on a map for us. First time experiencing this and it was amazing. The location is in perfect walking distance to see everything Porto has to offer. Highly recommend this place!

Maria’s place was just as pictured and beautifully decorated and clean. We were met at the apartment and shown around and provided local recommendations, which worked out well. The apartment is in a very picturesque part of town and Porto was definitely one of our favorite places to visit. Thank you Maria for your hospitality.
Very nice, bright apartment. There are many stairs but that didn’t affect us much. We loved the place!

A fantastic stay in a fantastic apartment. Would not hesitate to recommend to anyone, location and cleanliness perfect and a fabulous host with lots of great local recommendations. We will be back for sure !

We had a great stay. The apartment is in a great location for the city. Lots of lovely small restaurants and bars nearby. The apartment is stylish, comfortable and very clean. The apartment is in a quiet area (we slept so well!).  Maria is an excellent host, friendly and informative and so helpful. Thank you Maria!

We had a great time in Porto. Maria was very helpful and helped us with places to visit and restaurant recommendations.
We would definitely look to come back here

We received a warm welcome including a gift of wine. Would recommend staying here if you want to be in right in the historic centre.
Note that the stairs up to the top floor are very steep with a low ceiling and can be difficult to go up/down for those that are taller.

Beautiful apartment! Super spacious and felt right at home. AC is a plus. The stairs are a lot with suitcases but it was manageable. Parked in a garage near by for a reasonable price. Would stay here again!
Had an amazing stay!! Thank you to Maria for making the stay extremely comfortable. Would definitely recommend people to stay at her place :)
We had a lovely stay at Maria’s place - the location is perfect and not far from Porto’s major attractions, yet quiet at night. The place is spacious and clean.

Loved Maria’s place, very clean and neat. Functional kitchen with everything needed: She was so kind and quick to respond and gave awesome recomentations. Perfect location, not too noisy but close enough to the good areas.

Nice and cosy place though have to walk up many flight of stairs in the apartment. The many flight of stairs will be tough for the elderly, those with knee problems and those that have heavy and big luggage. On the whole, the place is within walking distance from most place of interests.

This flat is on the third floor of an apartment building. It's clean comfortable and well-equipped. The local area has a few restaurants and cafes and is within easy reach of other places on foot. 10 minutes from the metro which takes you straight from the airport
We had a lovely stay for our girlstrip. Very nice appartment, location and host! Would recommend the appartment and Maria as host!

We stayed at this Airbnb location during the last week in June 2025. The unit was exactly as described and was super close to the sights of the city. We loved having the ability to walk everywhere we needed to go. We would definitely return to this AirBnb.

Maria and Sara who showed me the apartment were very helpful. Maria was responsive to accommodating my travel needs. The apartment is gorgeous and clean. There are a lot of stairs up to the apartment but doable. Would stay here again.

Super clean, spacious living and large enough table for two people to setup their laptops and work from for the day.
Dishwasher and fridge are brand new which made things easier for us.
One of the best showers with two heads, super hot and strong flow.
Even though it’s centre of the nightlife the whole apartment is incredibly quiet.

Wonderful host. Beautiful, spacious, and clean apartment with all the amenities needed for a 5 night stay for my husband and and I. Location within walking distance to many wonderful areas, train station, great restaurants, shops, and bars very near by.
I have already been a few times at Sofia’s place and it’s an absolute recommendation for a short trip to Porto/Matosinhos.
Close to everything, right in the restaurant/bar area but noise was not an issue. Comfy apartment that looks like just the pictures, would stay there again.
Super quite Airbnb in the middle of the center. Communication, location and the appartment itself were superb - would recommend !

Everything was amazing just some comments
- Bathroom: everything was great- we had soap provided but nothing else so make sure to bring your own shampoo and stuff
- Kitchen: mostly great but the frying pans were scarred so had to use the pots but it was okay by us
- everything else including Communication, Location and value: 10/10 would highly recommend
Would definitely rent from again. Walking distance to everything including metro. So many restaurants and nightlife options to choose from. Air conditioning and great water pressure were a bonus.
Everything was all right. Even when I wanted to store my luggage after check in, there was no problem :)
The place was really clean and so easy to access however it become a little bit too noisy in the early morning

We had a pleasant time there and the location was convenient enough to get to the ocean easily. The public transport was nearby as well. The bathroom door was broken, so that is a minus, however for us personally it didn’t influence the stay. Would recommend!

Very nice place to stay in Porto. Great position, clean, with all the comforts.
Really suggested!

Really nice place! The outside passageway and apartment is very clean. The apartment is exactly same as the pictures even more beautiful! The kitchen and sofas are decorated with a good teast. You can have a very good sunshine in the morning and daytime. Bathroom is clean and the shower part is good separate. All the stuff you need is there such as a complete set of dishes. The location is also convenient, you don't even buy a bus ticket and can easily go anywhere only by walk. Most important is the check in and out is totally touchlos in this special time which is very nice!
Really lovely place - had everything we needed and was in a great location. Front bedroom near the road is a bit noisy but second bedroom quiet.

Very clean, spacious and nice apartment and value for money! Self-check in very smooth and very responsive host! Also walking distance to most of the touristy places in Porto and would definitely stay there again!

Amazing apartment ! Exactly like the pictures, everything new and clean! Location excellent.
The manager is also very responsive.
For sure, I would stay again.

Nice place in best locatio.
Communicationwas really good and helpful.
Can only recommend to stay here!
Perfect appartment with extraordinary quality on short distance of Porto citycenter. Thanks for having us, we had a great visit!

Was a lovely place to stay, comfy beds, good bathroom, beautiful interior and the inside the building is all new and looking good. Would definitely recommend to stay
over in Porto in this apartment.
Gorgeous apartment with every amenity you could ask for!! Very close to São Bento Train station and a Taxi stop!

This is a delightfully cosy flat,  near the river and close to all the major attractions. Gary and the LovelyStay team have always been prompt with their responses and even allowed us to store the bags at their offices with an early check in. Should definitely recommend visitors to select this place.

Great location next to the heart of Porto tourism. Also one of the most beautiful houses i’ve stayed in Airbnb; Simple and really worth the price. All rooms had AC and good Wifi
Hqve nothing bad to say, 5/5 would recommend

From the moment we turned the key we were very happy. The apartment was spotless, very welcoming, had everything you would want. We found a restaurant a few doors away which was fantastic. It is right in the middle of the old part near the bridge. Would definitely stay there again! Gary the host sent all the information we needed and responded very quickly to any questions. A perfect 10!

LOVED this place in Porto! So quiet even though on a Main Street. Host was so responsive and kind. Felt safe. Would def stay here again. Wish we could have stayed longer! Thank you Gary for everything!
Beautiful apartment. Located in a nice area with walking distance to restaurants, shops, city central. Gary is an outstanding host ! Will stay there again. Thanks Gary

This place looked just like the pictures. It was within a few minutes walking distance to the main attractions and to restaurants and shops. The place was very clean and had all amenities needed. Would recommend
Excellent stay! Managed by a company not a personal host but overall a great experience. Thank you!

Fabulous property, just as described. Well apointed and welcoming. A great location for us. Had a great local neighbourhood vibe with excellent eating options and easy access to the must see areas of Porto. Looking forward to seeing more of Portugal and would definitely stay again when we return to Porto

The place is ideal for a group of 4! Situated right in downtown Porto, we found our stay to be convenient, comfortable, and safe. The apartment is well equipped for cooking and there is a lift to the apartment from the ground floor (a plus if you have heavy luggages!).

The flat is stylish, but the bed and the sofas are not very comfortable. The kitchen is perfectly equipped, and the cooking with induction was amazingly quick.
We loved the garden very much! Also the location of the appartment is perfect! Its really in the center and everything you might need is right in front of the door. The gardenside of the appartement is very, very quiet, and we loved that very much.

The home owners are really helpful and friendly, our stay was really great and pleasant. The location is good, close to the main tourist area and historic center. Everything you might need or want to see is within walking distance and public transportation is really efficient in the area, in case you want to reach further destinations. The beach and some museums might require bus or subway but stations are really close to the apartment.
Great Location. Great apartment. Just as described. It was everything we needed for another fantastic stay in Porto.

Although we had a late flight into Porto we found the check in process to be very good and flexible to suit our timings. The position and area of the accommodation is very convenient for walking to most of the best attractions in Porto. Within a few 100 metres of the accommodation we found good coffee/breakfast shops and local restaurants. The accommodation had all the appliances needed and the small balcony over looking a rear garden was just right for a quiet glass of wine at the end of the day

This flat was definitely a great choice. When we got there, everything was made into a really easy experience from beginning to end.
Carolina made sure everything was perfect at all times and ensured a good communication.
The flat was really tidy and stylish.
The balcony gives an excellent touch when it comes to bring guests over for a late dinner, for instance.
Perfectly clean nicely decorated and very convenient location. Carolina is very efficient and super friendly.  Good cheap restaurant right outside the house!

This apartment was the perfect choice for my stay in Porto. It is located in a quiet street away from noise but it is also within walking distance to some great shops and restaurants. The main Metro station is only a 5 minute walk and to get to the riverside takes about 20 minutes on foot but you can get the Metro which is so cheap. The apartment itself was cozy and the bed was very comfortable. I would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was super central and made it very easy to reach all the spots of interest in Porto. It was very clean and fully equipped if you wanted to spend a night in possibly cooking for yourself and relaxing. I have reached out different times to Carolina and she has always promptly answered and helped. I recommend to stay here if you are visiting Porto.

I stayed at Carolina’s place for 3 nights and everything was fine: the flat is really cute, well furnished and in a great position.
I had some queries and she has been responsive and always available.
I would recommend this.
Thank you!

A pleasant and fully equipped apartment. The apartment is equipped with all basic necessities (towels, sheets, basic products,...) . The room and bathroom are clean. The air conditioning and the terrace are a great added value.
You are located just under 10 minutes from Trindade. The center is a short walk away. The ideal location.
Highly recommended!

Amazing stay. Great location, very close to the metro. Carolina is very quick in communication, and the appartment is beautiful. Balcony, great couch and a kitchen. We had everything we needed for a lovely stay.

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto helped by us having such a great base to stay in. The apartment was just round the corner from Trindade metro stop which enabled us to get to all parts of the city quickly, while only being 15 minutes walk from the river front, yet was in a very quiet location
Lovely modern venue thst was perfect for us.
Lovely stay, spacious apartment. Bit of noise from the apartment up top and down below but other than that, great.
Brilliant stay in the heart of the city. Everything you need very close and a lovely space.

Loved staying at this Airbnb, very well located, comfortable and quiet despite being in the middle of a busy city centre. Carolina was also very helpful and had no problems organising a later checkout than we initially agreed. Would recommend!
Very cozy and clean apartment, great connection with the airport transport line and host with the great local recommendations to plan your stay better :)

The apartment was perfect for our 5 days in Porto. It was clean, well decorated and had everything we needed. The location was easily walkable into the centre of Porto but also close to Trinidade station which has good connections, including easy access to the airport. We would definitely stay here again.

My friend and I had a lovely time staying at this apartment. It’s a great and cosy space which is very close to the metro and city centre. It’s great value for money and has a balcony which is an added bonus. Would certainly recommend!
Great stay in Porto. Spacious studio apartment walking distance to metro and bus station, Trindade, as well as centre of Porto. Carolina was a fantastic host.

Super cozy and comfy place, very well located and close to the center which made walking around really convenient. The place was very well kept and had all the amenities we needed. The only downside was the central heating that we felt took a long time to heat up the place. Everything else was perfect 🫶

Great place when visiting Porto for a few days. Walking distance to nearly everything and if it isn’t possible public transport is just around the corner.
Felt really welcome by the owner and overall a great experience. Can definitely recommend!

It’s a fantastic spot to explore Porto from. It’s with walking distance from all the sights and good food. The apartment was also squeaky clean and our host was super attentive and helpful. Will recommend everyone to stay with Caroline!
10/10 location in porto. No need to uber around if you are ok with walking its all within distance. Amazing

Our stay at Carolina’s place was wonderful, the place was super clean and easy to reach.
Carolina is a great host, easy to reach and quite proactive when it comes to messaging. Would definitely recommend :).

The place is really nice and we loved the balcony! It was super clean and tidy too, we had everything we needed!
Everything you need is in a walkable distance and getting around the city is easy.
Carolina was very welcoming and even gave a few recommendations!
The accommodation was in a great location, was clean, quiet and had everything you needed. The host was also very friendly and responsive. I would definitely stay here again.

A nice place to stay for a few days in Porto. Convenient location to the tram with direct connection to the airport. 10-15 minutes walking distance from the main city streets. Basic amenities but had everything we needed and the flat was clean and comfortable.

Great stay, exactly as described and in a perfect location just off a busy square so the balcony and room were quiet and private but the stay was in a couple minutes walk to main restaurants and shops
Clean, quiet and modern apartment still in the heart of Porto with the metro 3 minutes away and walkable to all the historic attractions.  I highlyrecommend staying here.

Myself and my Mam stayed in this apartment. It was so close to the city and all attractions were close. We stayed for 4 nights and it was an enjoyable stay. It was very easy to communicate with the host. The only thing is there are a few flights of stairs which you will have to carry your luggage up. The host did help us. I would definitely return and I would recommend this airbandb to others.

The place was great! The location was perfect. The morning walks from the Airbnb to the river was great. Everything was close. My flight was later than the Check out but I was able to leave my luggage with them until my time to leave this beautiful city.
110/100.

Mario’s place is great, located in the center of city. Susana gave us so many suggestions of where to go and to eat. The room is also very spacious and nice, got everything we need. I would stay here again!

Great place to stay in Porto! You cannot beat the location- just steps from the famed Mercado Bohlao, Chapel of Souls, and great restaurants and shopping! Also very close to the Sao Bento train station. Clean and quiet building, and very spacious apartment; although LOTS of stairs so definitely not for those with mobility issues.

Had a great stay here, Susana was super responsive and kind. If I am in Porto again soon, I will definitely stay here again! Overall a great apartment with all essentials and super close to the city center.
Very clean and cozy apt.  Had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.  Great communication from hosts.  Good location for walking.
The apartment my was spotless and very close to the attractions. The market is just at across the road

We really enjoyed our stay at Mario’s place. It was very central but also quiet at night! Short walk to the train station but you can also take a metro from the train station if you don’t want to walk. It was very nice having the AC as it was hot weather during our stay. This place was everything we needed for a few nights in Porto.
it was right in the middle of where you want to be. Susana was extremely helpful & friendly upon arrival.The place was clean and well appointed with beautiful decor.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I recently had the pleasure of staying at this wonderful apartment, and I can't recommend it highly enough! The location is absolutely perfect—conveniently situated near attractions, restaurants, and public transport, making it easy to explore the area.
The apartment itself was exactly as depicted in the pictures: clean, stylish, and well-maintained. I was particularly impressed with the thoughtful touches and the excellent selection of amenities, which made my stay incredibly comfortable.
Our host Susana, was outstanding—very responsive, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed. Overall, this was an exceptional experience, and I would love to stay here again on my next visit!

The place is situated 1 min from the Balhao metro station and shopping mall as well as boutiques. The neighborhood is calm walkable and lots of places to discover nearby. A friendly advice bring your running trainers or trainers for long walks as the city is not built on a flat land always hills
Excellent location and price! The apartment has everything you need. It was very clean and spacious. Excellent choice!

The apartment is located in the central Porto. There are plenty of good restaurants and cafes around and most of attractions are within walking distance. There are plenty of buses to get around as well if the hills are too much for you.
