The interior is modern and clean. The shower is working great and all the amenities are working well including the washer and dryer. This particular unit is facing the back of the adjacent building so there isn’t much view but that makes the apartment very quiet.
Overall the stay was very comfortable and I highly recommend the apartment.
The place was clean and looked just like the pictures. Neighborhood is a great location with everything being within a walking distance. Host was responsive and accommodating. Would stay again.
Lovely quite apartment with a lot of outdoor space. WiFi and kitchen were both great and the bed was very comfortable. Definitely recommend.

Incredible value for money. The duplex is exactly as advertised, walking distance to many shops and amenities, with the bridge and other sites all within a worthwhile 20-25 minute walk.
Perfect for a two person trip, absolutely no complaints from check in to check out!
Lovely, cosy, perfectly located and very clean! Joana welcomed us in perfect English. Highly recommend this house.

Pedro's Apartment is well located, clean and with every comfort. Pedro even gave us a welcome drink, with the local typical wine! We really appreciated all the Details and the City Center was just a 20 minutes walk away. We will definitely stay here again if we come back to Porto in the future.

Great studio apartment in the heart or Porto, easily walkable to all the sites and areas. Lots of great local restaurants and the studio apartment was quiet, we heard no noise at night which was great. We would highly recommend staying here, it was great value.

The studio is brand new, very well equipped and very comfortable. The location is great, very central and a quick walk from a lot of Porto’s iconic places.
We really enjoyed our weekend here!
Very clean. Well equiped. Luminous. Good localization. We felt like we were at home. Joana is always available when you need. One of our favorite BnB in Porto !

This is our second time in Porto. The location definitely beats those more touristic areas. It is close to transportation and has a much more local vibe.
Restaurants, coffee shops and pastry shops are within blocks. It is nicely configured and spotless. On the day of arrival, we requested to drop off our luggage and Joana had the apartment ready for us hours before the check in time. Thanks again.

This experience is one of the greatest stays I’ve ever had on Airbnb. The place was cozy and I felt safe. The kitchen, the bed, the couch and the blinds outside the big windows were just amazing. When you put down the blinds, there is literally no light coming through, which is great for deep sleep. Location is excellent - popular areas are usually within walking distance.

Can not even think about any negative things
There weren’t any problems at all
Thanks Joana

Perfect studio in the heart of Bolhao.  Wonderful location to explore Porto.  Apartment was just as described - clean, comfortable, contemporary - everything you need for a visit to the city.  Close to transit and many wonderful markets and attractions.

Joana was a fantastic host - very communicative and helpful with my early arrival as far as options for my luggage and such before her previous guests checked out.  Location could not be better and is a few minute walk to many of the major sites in Porto and a short walk to most everything else.  My favorite part was the proximity to Mercado do Bolhao which was great to pop over for a coffee or snack anytime.  Unit was very nicely furnished with everything I needed for my short stay.  Great internet as well since I work remotely sometimes.

Joana’s place was lovely and homely, super clean and as described. The location was very convenient and a walkable distance to all the shops and restaurants near the river. We really enjoyed our stay and would stay again!
One of the best apartments I have ever stayed at. Great design, sparkling clean, perfect location, amenities. Everything is there. Cannot recommend enough and would definitely come back.

Apartment matched the photos. When I arrived it was clean and maintained. The appliances all worked (I didn't use the TV so I am unsure about this one). Location was very close to Trindade which was effectively the central station for my trip. Overall the apartment met my expectations and was wroth the price.

The location was perfect and the apartment well decorated. Unfortunately, the cooling didn’t operate well and the host was very slow to respond until the next day. It is next to an outside speaker that plays loud music during the day.
There wasn’t any shower toiletries like shampoo, conditioner, and shower gel. What looked like possible shower gel dispenser was almost empty and watered down. Was very disappointed.
This apartment is in a great location for exploring Porto. Self check in is easy and not having to worry about a key is great.
Very clean and modern looking apartment at a very good spot in the city. We really enjoyed our stay there and will come back for sure !
Great apartment! Clean, spacious and a perfect spot to stay whilst in Porto. Joana & team are great at responding to any questions and making sure you have a pleasant time.

It’s a lovely flat, very clean and minimalist. The location is fantastic, we were lucky enough to listen to the classical music event in the square on Saturday evening by opening the large windows - beautiful. Joana is a good communicator and will help with anything during the stay
This spot was great! Within walking distance of the river and tons of restaurants. Loved the loft style apartment and big windows.
Thank you for a wonderful visit to Porto!! The apartment is fantastic - such a beautiful place and great location!! Joana was so kind and helpful throughout our stay ♥️ will absolutely stay again!!
A clean, cosy and well furnished place in a great location. Check in and out was very easy and the host was responsive.

Apartment was as fabulous as in the pictures. Close to Trindade Metro (for the airport) and loads of other locations. Check-in with keypad was easy, plenty of storage space (we counted 27 hangers in the wardrobe). Coffee machine was great, bed comfy and shower spacious. Complimentary bottle of wine on arrival and voucher for breakfast nearby was also a lovely touch. Well soundproofed on the 4th floor too. We didn't bother with an organised tour to Douro Valley but got the train (5 min walk to station and much better views onboard than being stuck in a minvan) to Pinhao instead (around 50 euros for 2) and did a winery tour at Quinta do Bonfim (18 euros each) and a fantastic lunch at Quinto do Rosa. Would highly reccommend a stay at Joana's.
Perfect location, great apartment.  Quiet at the 4th floor, simple with everything you need for a good trip!
Lovely apartment in walking distance of all the main sightseeing. Inside you have all you need for a comfortable stay. Will choose it again.
we are very pleased with the stay, everything is as described, beautiful apartment in the center 😊

This was a fantastic place to stay. The apartment was modern, stylish, clean and exactly as described. The location was ideal, close to shops, restaurants and key sights, with great transport links. Joana and the team at VIVA were very responsive and helpful throughout. Highly recommend and would happily stay again.

Very nice apartment, and very friendly and responsive host. Easy to access with no need for keys. The apartment has a great location with short walking distance to good coffee shops, grocery stores, markets and good restaurants. I will definitely come back to this place!!
This is my second stay at this apartment. Very nice apartment and it’s location is very central. Definitely worth the price!

Beautiful loft, very spacious and clean as well as great air conditioning for the hot summer. Good distance from the historic centre and shops. It was very easy to walk around.
Joana was an amazing host, very helpful and gave us lots of recommendations for restaurants and bars around the area.

Overall very good place to stay, very close to all sights, apt is pretty bright and comfy. Unfortunately WiFi connection was very bad. I used my mobile internet but for someone it may be critical thing if they don’t have local SIM cards. Also apt was located on the 3rd floor without elevator, for consideration especially for women traveling alone with big suitcases.
Very nice and clean room in the centre of Porto...check in very Easy and Sousa gave me many advice for  visit the city. Very recommended.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Souza's apartment. The place is quiet, convenient, extremely clean, and modern. In addition to the very  comfortable interior, the thorough explanation of the Porto and surrounding areas provided by Luisa helped as enormously.

A beautiful modern studio with all the necessary facilities. Diogo, our host, was very friendly and thorough throughout our stay. The room does not have views but it is in a prime location within the city center. Highly recommended for solo or couple travelers who wish to spend a few nights in the beautiful city of Porto. Cheers! 😊

Nice and cozy place, located in a good location of Porto. Place was very clean when I arrived, and apartment is equipped with all the necessary appliances. Definitely recommend this place for a solo traveler or a couple.
Clean and quiet place, conveniently close to the restaurants and bars area but not touristy, perfect location. The host was super helpful advising on places to go to, would stay there again

The apartment is well located, just next to the main monuments in the city centre. The kitchen and the bathroom are fully furnished. Sousa is a great host, kindly and quickly responding to questions. A perfect place to stay in Porto!

Perfect stay. Clean and modern flat on a cool street. So many cafes, bars, restaurants and sites to see all within walking distance. The neighborhood is exactly where you want to be for a stay in Porto and the hosts are helpful and responsive. Don’t hesitate.

It was great to stay at Sousa's place. The apartment was spotless and welcoming. Sofa was comfortable and bed was easy to pull down and put back in place. Easy access to Metro and bus transport, and very close to the city centre. I would recommend the place and would stay there again. Sousa was fast to respond to my questions. It was a pleasure to stay there.
The apartment was modern, clean and in a great neighbourhood location within walking distance to all areas of Porto. I highly recommend staying at this Airbnb!

Super great place! Beautiful compact studio with a pull-down bed. There was a guidebook provided to us which was just beautifully designed and fitted with all sorts of recommendations and how to navigate the studio. We particularly loved the large lockers at the bottom floor where you can pay 1 Euro (and get it back after) to store your stuff after you check out or throughout your stay if you don't want to run up to grab something.
The neighbourhood is great with lots to do and lots of great food. You'll be close to the entertainment area but not so close that it's going to bother you. Super accessible area.

Had a truly warm welcome from Julio with lots of helpful information. The studio is well located in a safe area (solo traveller) with cafes, little arty shops to browse in as you ramble down. Trindade Station, Mercado do Bolhão Rua da Santa Catarina all within walkable distance. It was a great spot with the kind and helpful Souza team always there to help. Oh! and a nice bottle of red wine to welcome you.
I am looking forward to my return visit, this is a little gem. Thank you

This particular apartment has a Murphy bed which was quite comfortable. The security is good and it is an easy walk downhill to the historical district or uphill to grocery stores and Trindade station. The hosts are very responsive to requests.

The place was amazing! It’s even better than in the pictures, super clean, fully equipped with everything that you need for a comfortable stay. The location is also great, walking distance to all the main points in Porto. Sousa was an incredible host, the communication was effortless, she is very responsive, friendly, and she also gave us great recommendations. Definitely recommend this place! Thank you Sousa for a wonderful stay :)
nice location and apartment. There was a small issue with the Murphy bed which the host fixed within the day.
This is an excellent option for anyone staying downtown Porto. I loved it was very clean and all very well explained

This place was fantastic—immaculately clean and incredibly walkable to restaurants, shops, and local attractions. The neighborhood felt safe and vibrant, making it easy to explore the area on foot. The apartment was well-equipped, with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The bed was cozy, and everything looked exactly like the photos. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area

Very modern and nice apartment in too location.
Just be aware that there might be seagulls waking you up in the morning by walking on the roof 😂
Besides that an absolute recommendation for this beautifully thought out space.
Make sure to exchange the card for the parking garage when you use the recommended one from the agency because they can’t be changed later.
We payed 70€ for 3 days I stead of 20 because we didn’t know.

Beautiful, spacious and modern place. We had a great time! The location is really convenient for getting to popular tourist areas, and the apartment itself is well-equipped. Apartment is on the top floor but building has an elevator, and the skylights are lovely!

I loved this apartment!
Beautiful, comfortable, well located, modern, amazing service from the host, just great :)
Easy self check in and out.
The apartment is in very convenient location. Room is clean and comfortable with modern interior design. The host responded very quick and provided many helpful tips. Highly recommend.
This is a lovely apartment situated in the centre of Porto. Andre communication was excellent before and throughout our stay. I'd highly recommend.

Great location, clean, comfortable and with all the amenities to make one's stay very pleasant. Andre's apartment was throughly cleaned and matched the descriptions listed on Airbnb perfectly. There are two bathrooms one in each floor which made it very comfortable. The location is extremely convenient within at most 10-15 minutes walk to all the great restaurants and attractions in central Porto. Communication with the host was very easy including smooth check-in/check-out process. We really enjoyed our stay at Andre's place and would highly recommend it.
great place to stay in Porto, you won’t regret it. Walking distance from key attractions and easy to find. The place was very clean and exactly as described

Can not recommend this property more. While slightly pricier than others in Porto, it is well worth the money. Probably the best equipped kitchen of any Airbnb I’ve stayed in (even knives that are sharp!). Very nice and comfortable furniture, spacious, nice bathrooms, beautiful building and a great location for walking everywhere in the city. Air conditioning that works well.
Communication was excellent and very responsive. Very helpful with requests.

Our stay was amazing. This place was even better/bigger than it appeared in the pictures. Everything was very clean, the location was excellent, and the digital lock made the check in process very easy. I will stay here again when I come back to Porto. We do not have a single complaint, thank you for the excellent place to stay.

Andre was quick to respond to our emails. The apartment was well situated, neighbourhood felt safe. Elevator was a hidden gem! Apartment was very spacious and we felt very much at home. Our only complaint was one set of towels for 7 nights, but in saying this we used the washer and cleaned them! Would definitely recommend or stay here again!
Great apartment. Didn't end up using the kitchen as there are so many options to eat out but it was well equipped. Comfy seating and bed. Well located for access to central Porto.

Very Nice Duplex just outside the City center.
very clean and bright.
looks exactly like the photos👌
Thanks a lot.
I had a Great time🥳

We loved staying at Andre’s Airbnb in Porto. The apartment is just as it looks very nice and comfortable. My husband and I were able to enjoy it for a month and felt at
home. The apartment was located in a super walkable neighborhood with lots of great sights and restaurants nearby. Would definitely recommend and stay with this host again.
The apartment was comfortable, clean and close to everything. The place is as described and Andre was very accommodating.
Great place.  So beautiful.  Spacious very well equipped.  Couldn’t have asked for a more perfect place to stay.
We found the location very handy with lots of restaurants and bars nearby. The home was very clean and we had a good night sleep.
Diana’s place was a wonderful place. The bed was super comfortable and it was conveniently located. Would recommend!

Hosts were nice and easy to communicate with. Location is perfect, tons of restaurants and sights nearby. Only downside were the beds and pillows. Pillows were flat and beds a bit hard but great for a 3 night stay. Would come again.

Diane’s place was just as described in a great walkable location and the accommodations were outstanding. Even though it is in a bustling neighborhood, the apartment is well insulated for sound and the shower, air conditioning is fantastic. As a single person traveling alone, I felt very safe and Diane was very helpful in answering questions regarding my stay. I would stay at her place any time I travel to Porto.

Diana’s place was super close to everything in Porto but tucked away just enough to not be in a loud touristy area. You definitely felt more like a local. The place is perfect for 2 people! The automatic black out blinds are also a plus (there are switches behind the curtains)!

Amazing Studio! Right in the heart of a very happening area!! And just on the first floor so easy to carry bags even without elevator . Perfect for a young couple. Just had a little trouble finding it at the start but once settled it was perfect!

Nice apartment in a lively neighborhood. Communication with the host went well, easy check in, accommodation as described. Only the kitchen utensils could have been a little cleaner. Thank you very much :)
Nice neighbourhood and perfect to explore the city. The apartment is good standard but we experienced some defect equipment and furniture.

I absolutely enjoyed my stay at Diana's flat. The room looked exactly the same as the photos - clean, modern, and spacious. I especially enjoyed sitting at the round table with the buddha's head sculpture on it. It was the centrepiece of the room.
Diana was also helpful with recommending some indoor activities for the stormy weather that hit Porto during my visit. I'll definitely book this place again if I ever come to Porto next time!

Great apartment on a quiet street within walking distance of the city and river. The apartment was very clean and had everything you needed. Diana was a great host, easy to check in and out. Thank you!

Fantastic location, close to everything.
The place is exactly like the pictures, comfortable and clean. Would definitely stay again.

Highly recommended! Needed an urgent place to stay and 30 minutes after my booking I was already at the apartment. The apartment is cosy and warm. Location is perfect and very close to local shops / restaurants.
This is a great stay in a great location and our host Marisa had some great tips! Wish we had more time in Porto.
The apartment was great! Clean, comfortable and cozy! Marisa made our stay in Porto just perfect!

First of all, the check-in was super smooth. We were not only warmly welcomed, but also given lots of nice recommendations about the city and the places that were worth visiting.
Great apartment with an amazing location. It looked exactly like on the photos, nothing was missing.
Marisa was very responsive and helpful.
I can recommend this place for staying.
Big thanks to the host and I hope to stay here again :)

Everything was great, the apartement was even big enough for three people. Since it's in the middle of Porto you can walk everywhere and won't spend the day inside anyways. The small garden is also very beautiful. 😊

We had a great time staying at this apartment in Cedofeita. It's a perfect location for exploring Porto on foot. We also appreciated the little guidebook in the apartment which included some suggestions on landmarks and restaurants to visit. Some of the restaurant recommendations are less touristy than others which was nice, you can use online reviews to find more information too.
The only downside to staying here was on our last day, our key card stopped working to open the main door. We were stuck outside in the rain at 8am with all our bags inside and had a train we needed to catch in 30 mins. Thankfully we were able to call Marisa and she gave us instructions to get a separate key from a lockbox to get back inside. Being given this lockbox information during check-in or being warned the key card may not open the door would've made the stay 5/5.
Marisa s place is charming.  In a great location and right away you know you are in beautiful Portugal.  Everything thing you need.
Loved the place was easy to get to, apartment was very clean, will use again amd i do recommend.

We stayed 4 nights at the perfect little place in Porto. For us, a young couple, it was perfect. All the kitchen essentials, a good sized washroom. We would definitely stay there again. Francisco was a great host and very quick to reply. Thanks again Francisco! :)

It was a nice private apartment. The bed was surprisingly comfy for a pull out couch and the kitchen was stocked with any dishes you might need. It was a quiet neighborhood and not too far from downtown. Also, the instructions for check in were really detailed and helpful!

Francisco’s place is perfect if somebody stays few night in the city. It’s very clean and bright, the bad vas very comfortable, it’s not too far from centre. I used uber two times and it was cheap.  I’m sure I will go back. Thank you!

Had a lovely time there. Francisco was very helpful, answering all my questions. The area is peaceful. The metro is on walking distance, also a food shopping.
The place was very clean and match with the pictures and description.
Highly recommend.
Perfect place for a short stay. Exactly as described. The check-in was painless and simple.

Good location, bars and restaurants are only 5 minutes away.
Very quiet at night.
very nice stay, perfect location and very clean apartment! the communication was always smooth. Fully recommended!

It was a wonderful stay, easy access to everything (Train, bus, cafe, sightseeing). only 5 minutes walk to supermarket. The apartment is spacious and nice decorated. kitchen is well equipped, the highlight is 65" Smart TV, Super!!! Efficient communication with the host, thank you!!!

The apartment was really great, it was located quite central in the city and we could reach almost all destinations walking. The metro was just 3min away, too. It was very clean and well equipped, really enjoyed the stay
There are all kinds of comfort and the owner is a good person, I am very satisfied, thank you
Really nice apartment and in a great location. We got to many monuments by foot. And it was near the Christmas tree and markets. Amazing trip.

Apartment is really nice and convenient. Area is also really friendly with lots of cool restaurants - best coffee is in Alice in Brewland :) It’s also really close to the railway station that we used a lot, was very convenient. Definitely recommend this place

The apartment is really beautiful and well located! We could walk everywhere within the city center and it only took a short bus trip to the beach. The apartment is even equipped with a tv that can be used to watch Netflix and Amazon prime if required. We had everything we needed, besides stuff for cleaning maybe but that was just fine. Consider that there are no doors besides the bathroom and entry door so there’s not much privacy. Overall, we had a wonderful time and would definitely recommend staying here.
Amazing beautiful place. Super location. Loved the design of everything and would definitely stay here again in the future :)

Modern, clean apartment within about 1km walk of the old part of Porto.  Good local amenities including supermarkets and restaurants just around the corner.  Seemed nice and quiet at night.  Two separate bedrooms which was great as other similar properties only offered one double room and a sofa bed for 3 people. On the top floor so several flights of stairs - not a problem for us but might be for some.

This place is excellent! Beautifully finished, very comfortable beds, stays cool, wifi works fine, shower is great, and the location is perfect. Once we closed the blinds, the place got sufficiently dark. The only odd bit was that there are no doors to the downstairs bedroom - that would be nice, even if it was just a screen or something. Would definitely stay again!
Perfect 3 nights-stay, the apartment has everything you could need. And the neighborhood is very nice with everything around. Very walkable to get everywhere and metro is also close-by.

It was a great pleasure staying in the Duplex Douro apartment: it was was very comfortable for four persons with 2 great bedrooms with bathrooms, a well equiped kitchen and a great view over the Douro. David respondeer immediately when we asked for something. We never had this fantastic experience when we were in an AirB&B
Awesome location! Amenities were great and the views from the Airbnb were super nice. Really enjoyed staying here.

Great location and view! This was perfect for our week stay with for 4 or us. Very clean when we arrived and they allowed us to leave our baggage prior to check in so we didn’t have to carry it around Porto! Excellent communication and help when it was needed. Would definitely recommend to his place to others.
Great place! The view is really beautiful and easy to get to town by walking/Uber. Recommend!

It is a lovely apartment with a lot of light and space, the view is amazing. It is very comfortable for 4 people, I would definitely stay here again. Walking distance feom the center and a lot od cafes and restaurant around.
Thank you for Port wine on arrival!  The view and area were fantastic.  Loved the up to date interior with old world charm outside.  Great location.

We choose to stay in Porto to celebrate our son’s 1st birthday.
The apartment was wonderful and we all absolutely loved the view.
The blackout shutters on the windows meant we all slept very well. Even my 1 year old wasn’t waking up early.
The restaurant directly below was super tasty. We even got takeaway one night when the kiddies were in bed.
I’d definitely stay again
Thank you

This apartment was great! Completely as advertised with a great view of the Douro River.
We recommend this apartment, and would stay here again.

Pretty little house near the sea, quiet and clean about 30 minutes by bus into the city. The only downside is that the bathroom is on the ground floor and the bedrooms upstairs which wouldn't be so much of an issue for some people if it wasn't for the very narrow spiral staircase. The area is lovely and it was nice to be away from the crowds of the city. The house is very well equipped and Joana is a kind and welcoming host.
Definitely one of the best places to relax. A great experience for tourists and even local citizens. A place that everyone should visit!
Great spot in Porto. Close to the tourist city center. Beautiful decorated houses in a nice garden with fruit trees.

A great place to stay: Check in is easy and the Hut is very cozy and cool..it's like a small Paradise in a City.
Our expectations we're exceeded!
You have to walk a little bit to get to the Metro Station Trindade or to find breakfast, but don't worry: you will probably walk a lot in Porto ;-)
>>absolutely recommendable<<
In down town lapa, half an hour to the river. part of a complex of 5 huts. Tranquil and lovely. We enjoyed our stay.
Great location in downtown Porto! It's conveniently near restaurants and shops but also far enough so you still feel a bit away from the hustle and bustle of the city.

Paradise in Porto! Carlos's eco hut was the perfect honeymoon getaway while being a quick walk to the heart of Porto. We loved being close to the metro station, a pharmacy, and a great grocery store (Pingo Doce) for daily needs. The bed was so comfortable that some days we slept until 11am! On days when we felt like staying in we could prepare a spread of local produce and enjoy the magical scenery of old winery architecture and fruit trees. Overall we would 100% book again.
A private little paradise in the midst of a bustling city. The grounds are gorgeous and the unit was comfortable and quiet.

Absolutely stunning little peaceful retreat in the middle of a beautiful city! Restaurants and a supermarket within short walk. Little longer (15-20 mins) walk to the heart of Porto and all it has to offer! The apartment was clean, spacious and a perfect way to start our holiday, with everything we need provided! Only wish we booked more nights there!
Muito obrigado!
Tom and Ellie

Great location, very close to downtown and the metro station. The patio area is spectacular with lots to catch your eye, it’s like a little paradise in the middle of Porto! Bathroom and water pressure was great. Worth the stay!
It was clean and tidy! Great location. Excellent information provided on all logistics by the hosts. Nice to find tea and coffee in the house too!

Very nice stay. We particularly liked that there was coffee, salt, pepper and oil available. You don’t find that at every Airbnb! The bed was very comfortable and it was clean. It was also quiet at night which was much appreciated after having stayed in Lisbon.
The reason we only give 4 stars is because the toilet malfunctioned and we would have appreciated a quicker response and more help resolving the situation from the host. You don’t want to spend your holiday having to deal with something like that.
These things happen however and all in all we liked the Airbnb.
Really lovely oasis of calm in the center of Porto. Room was spacious and clean. Garden was beautiful and quiet. Really appreciated our stay

Anna is a welcoming, warm, approachable host. The place is very centrally located in the heart of Porto and we felt very comfortable during our stay. The beds are great to sleep in and the apartment is very clean. Definitely, our pick when we come back to Porto!

An amazing house in a great location. great restaurants and shopping are right at your doorstep. The house is wonderfully equipped and tastefully furnished. And the host, Anna, is friendly, accommodating, and responsive.
Anna’s apartment was perfect! Beautifully designed, very clean, and in a great location. I highly recommend Anna’s apartment if you are visiting Porto!

A lovely apartment in a great area - east walking to everything and good eating in the area. And there could not be a more caring host than Anna. She went above and beyond in caring fir us and fir our stay in Porto. Communication was clear, timely, and really helpful

The apartment of Anna is very nice and it's a perfect location to visit Porto. Anna is very reactive and kind and  it was a perfect choice to visit porto with our 2 children. We warmly recommend Anna's apartment.

Beautiful newly refurbished apartment in a fantastic location. The bedrooms in the basement were a little cold in March but there is heating which kicked in really fast. Anna was great, super communication and helpful with local recommendations.

This is a nice local spot to walk to almost anything. Not great to walk to the river area just because of the steep hills and stairs. But if you want a quiet, quaint and local vibe…this is your place.

We enjoyed the big but cozy apartment. We had plenty of space for cooking and chillin after an adventurous day in Porto. The apartment is verz close to the city center and therefore we didn't use any public transportation. All in all we loved the apartment!

Excellent hospitality and perfect location. Only one bathroom and was extremely small with no place to put any toiletries. For a family of four the bathroom was far too small. Otherwise everything was great.
Great location, rooms are in basement and there is a musty smell. Otherwise very clean, beautiful apartment.
Anna’s place is a very good 2 bedroom  in a very good location. Place was very clean and with plenty of space.

We really enjoyed our stay. The only negative was that the bathroom was quite small for four people. Otherwise the apartment was wonderful. We received a nice welcome bottle of wine which was lovely to start off our stay.

Beautiful apartment even though the only bathroom was so small. There’s a little bit of a humid smell downstairs.
Great location, you can walk everywhere.
This place was great! It’s been renovated so the issue mentioned in other reviews of smells downstairs did not arise.  Super location

Anna accommodated a last minute and very late in the evening check in. She also went above and beyond to help me out on the day I was checking out. I had a few hours to kill before catching my train. Anna let me stay in the apartment for a few hours after check out which really helped my day go smoother with my toddler. Felt like a big act of kindness. The place was clean and everything went well. Thanks Anna!

This was a great find! We enjoyed our stay immensely. The apartment is very well located for visiting the sites of Porto.
The pictures of the place were accurate and check-in/out instructions were very clear. We would definitely stay here again.
We were with 4 people and we had a great time. The location was great and close to other areas of interest.
Good location, kind hosts and clean apartment! The pool isnt private and the sofa is the second bed. That was our only surprise. Other than that the place is wonderful to stay at

Romain was a fantastic host and the AirBnB was brilliant. Perfect location and a really lovely apartment, just wish the weather was a bit nicer to make use of the pool! Would definitely stay again if returning to Porto

We had a lovely stay at Romain’s place. The bed was super comfy, strong shower and well stocked kitchen. Good location to walk into Porto centre (20 mins ish…). Good coffee place (7g coffee roasters) round the corner for breakfast. Would recommend!

Very easy self check-in. The place is very clean with everything needed for self-catering. Close to the city centre and within walking distance of the river and great restaurants. Would just like to point out to any light sleepers, the walls are incredibly thin so the neighbours can be heard talking quite clearly from the bedroom but the place was quiet during sleeping hours for us.

We had a fantastic stay at the apartment. The apartment was clean, well furnished and had everything that we needed. The location was excellent, everything was in a walkable distance and the area was lovely and quiet. We would stay again or recommend the apartment to others.
We felt very comfortable during our stay. The location was perfect and central to be able to walk around the city. Romain was also friendly and helpful. I’d recommend this place to other guests!
The place is nice, and well organised but some of the item in the kitchen were a little bit dirty. In general was really good
We had a good time at Adriana’s apartment despite the fact that the apartment is very noisy because of the road beside. I recommend anyway

We had a really lovely stay in Christina’s house. Plenty of room for two grown up families of four. House was spotless with lots of supplies for the week. Cristina was brilliantly helpful, especially when our son needed to see a doctor on a bank holiday. Pool area was fantastic for hanging out with lots of shade and lovely loungers. We didn’t rent cars but walked to train, supermarkets and got a few Ubers. A gorgeous part of the world and a relief to return to the quiet after a busy day in Porto. All in all, a really brilliant rental - would fully recommend.
Beat stay I have had us in Airbnb. Cristina the best host ever. Nice friendly and really helpful. We can come back anytime any day.  Amazing home 👍👍👍
This is a lovely apartment in a beautiful part of Porto. It was decorated nicely, spacious, clean and modern. I would stay here again!

A beautiful flat, modern, clean, great views of the river and ribeira (from living room) and views of statue and museum (from bedroom). Location was perfect, right next to the ribeira, easily walkable to the bridge towards Vila Nova de Gaia. There were some coffee pods and water bottles for us, and abundant supply of toiletries, an excellent touch!  We had a minor issue with the washer/dryer and Isabel was quick to respond. I loved the flat and did not want to leave. I would definitely come back and would inquiry about longer term rental!
Great location and view. Place was clean, spacious, and had everything we needed. communication and check-in was fast and smooth. Definitely will consider staying here again.

Amazing home at a great location with awesome views.
Hosts were super responsive and helpful.
Highly recommend.
Fantastic views and an absolutely gorgeous apartment. The location was ideal for us for a short getaway to Porto

The appartment is perfect for a short stay in Porto. The location is ideal and the views are breathtaking! The bed, the sheets and the commodities of the appartment are of a very good qualities. Another good point : it was very easy to check in thanks to the availability of Isabel. We will certainly go back in the same apartment if we can come back to Porto!

Great apartment. Lift is available from the First Floor only. The apartment is on the Third Floor.
Great value, views and clean and modern.

There is not a negative thing to say about Isabel and Igor or their amazing home. It is PERFECTLY located right in the center of town; an easy walk to everything. The apartment is very modern and meticulously cared for. It is also much larger than you imagine it is going to be. The elevator worked perfectly, check-in was incredibly smooth and checking out was even easier. The view from the living room is of the spectacular river and the view from the bedroom is the palace and the park right next-door. You must absolutely book this apartment if you have a chance!

Great place! Bigger and more spacious than pictures, perfect location near water and great food spots, and very clean and accommodating. I will recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay in Porto.
Great location in Porto. Easy to walk everywhere and check in was a breeze! Great for a couple or small family because of the space in the living room. Amazing views as well!

Isabel & Igor were exceptional hosts, and we would recommend their beautiful apartment to anyone visiting Oporto.
The location, the views, and the high standard of accommodation makes this incredible value.
Everything was perfect. Great location, clean, exactly as advertised. Couldn’t ask for much more.

OUTSTANDING property! The kind of place you almost don’t want to give too good a review so it stays a hidden secret! Haha
Isabel was super helpful throughout and communication was superb. Great instructions on how to arrive and she even sent over some lovely local suggestions :)
The flat itself is truly stunning. Ceilings were lovely and high and the place is furnished with great taste. Tonnes of storage space for clothing. We left wishing that we lived there!
The only missing element we would have appreciated and I stress ONLY as the place is really magnificent was an ironing board & iron. Other than that it was truly flawless.
Thanks for the magical stay and the water/Port on arrival was such a sweet touch <3
We cannot wait to come back! Porto will remain a special place in our hearts!
This apartment was in a great location to walk to many things in Porto. Host was here helpful and responsive.

Absolutely loved our stay here. The place is even nicer than the photos show which was surprising. The apartment is close to everything and made our comings and goings throughout the day super easy. It's also close to the Luís I Bridge which made it easy to go from one side of the river to the other. Great views of the river from the living room and if you shut the wooden shutters it's quite at night while sleeping.
By far one of my favorite AirBnbs I've stayed at : )

We had a wonderful time staying at Isabel and Igor's place.   The location was perfect - we could walk to everything!  The apartment is very spacious, light filled and comfortable.  With new windows and shutters, the bedroom was very quiet and dark - perfect for sleeping if you are still trying to get over a bit of jet lag.   I would highly recommend this apartment and will try to stay here again when our travels bring us back to the wonderful city of Porto!
Great location near the river and restaurants. Can be a bit loud some nights as a result. Still, very nice views of the square across the street
My wife and I went for three nights in Porto and absolutely loved the location. We walked all over from the apartment being central to many areas. Highly recommend and wear good walking shoes!
Top notch accommodation in a fantastic location. Very buzzy vibe. Nice and spacious accommodation with great views from both sides. Accommodating hosts, always happy to help and very responsive.
Absolutely adored staying here. Location, views, furnishings - impeccable. The host was friendly and responsive. I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again.
Fun place right near the river in Porto.   Easy to find as host sent pictures in advance.

Miguel's apartment is a lovely one bedroom with a superb view. Miguel is a very caring host and I felt comfortable staying at his place.
The apartment is well located in the best part of Porto. I would definitely book his place again!
Amazing views and location! Bed was comfortable and the bathroom was a good size - the only thing we were not given was toilet paper. Would recommend to any friend traveling to Porto!

Miguel was a nice host. He provided us with his studio flat which is quite comfortable and well-kept. He even sent us some tips where we can visit after checking-in. He was very helpful and was very responsive to any concerns we had.

Absolutely fantastic location in one of the most romantic cities in the world. Isabel and Igor were welcoming and friendly hosts who communicated well. Walkable to everything and in a location where you won’t need to walk far. While it wasn’t an issue for us, I would note that with such a great location comes some street noise in the evening. If you are looking for quiet and secluded - this may not be your spot.

Excellent apartment, perfect for 2 people. Well appointed, lots of space to unpack. Fantastic location walkable to the river, and many Porto and Gaia locations. As is clearly stated in the listing, the apartment does not have A/C, but we were able to stay adequately cool during a relatively warm week in April with the big windows that all open, temps that cool at night, and a tower fan that was in the unit.
Amazing apartment! We had a great stay. We enjoyed the views of the river and the lively park. The apartment is centrally located and perfect for a brief stay in Porto.

Miguel’s apartment is a great choice if you want to stay close by the river. Miguel is very responsive, gave me a lot of information about Porto and services around the apartment and made an early checkin possible.
I used the apartment by myself and was happy with the size although it looks bigger on the pictures. For two people it might get cosy, in particular if you want to cook. Otherwise it is perfect to explore Porto by foot or take a bike to the beach!

This was a really nice stay! The room is like a private hotelroom but with everything you need from an appartment. The view is great and the neighbourhood is nice. The AC saved our life and the room stays dark so you can sleep in if you want.
Miguel is very nice! He gave us great tips and made sure we enjoyed our stay

Miguel was the perfect host, he picked us up from the airport and could not have been more friendly and helpful! 100% recommend booking with him, the location was exactly as described and beautiful too.
Miguel was really nice and the studio was perfectly located in the center of Porto. It was clean, but not as quiet as I expected.

We stayed in Miguel‘s apartment for one night and really enjoyed our time there. It is situated in a nice neighborhood near the river with a lot of cafes and restaurants around. Would definitely recommend!

It was wonderful days in this accomodation. It has nice view on each side, spacious rooms, and good accessibility from douro river.
Hosts are very friendly and kind. They recommended good places to travel. Thank you :)

Place is very modern, clean, big, with awesome views. Has everything I needed. The view is hard to beat, I’m watching people who are watching sunset on the other side of the river. The bedroom is a bit noisy given the centered location.
Excellent stay. Hosts are extremely responsive and had great recommendations. You can’t beat the locations, it was amazing to watch the sunset and sunrise while drinking coffee at the table.

Isabel & Igor’s place was the perfect spot for our vacation. The apartment was spotless, beautiful, and the check in was easy as Isabel gave clear instructions and was very responsive to messages. The views from the apartment were beautiful and we felt right at home!

This air bnb is nicely located in the heart of many attractions. It was very clean and beautiful. The view was also beautiful. The kitchen was stocked with basic things. The main downside was the construction in the building that started at 8 am and wouldn't finish until 6 pm. Even with ear plugs and white noise it was so loud. This made it difficult to enjoy our stay during the day. Otherwise we would have enjoyed it but feel we should have been warned about potential construction.
I found Isabel & Igor’s place to be a very beautiful with plenty to do nearby. They were very responsive and I would highly recommend staying there.
Great location! Right by the riverfront with great views/restaurants/shopping. The space is clean and spacious. Would recommend!

We stayed here for our last night in Porto and you can't beat the views and location. Its a little pricey, but it was clean, private, had good wifi and amenities plus was walkable to everything you would want in Porto.
The host also provided a number of recommendations, which is nice.
I would stay again.
The apartment was great – everything was clean and comfortable. It’s in a very good location, close to everything, and the view from the window was beautiful. I really enjoyed my stay!

Good location , between the old and modern city.
Quiet street in the night but safe area ( two blocks from police station)
Walking distance to supermarkets (Pingo Doce), pharmacies, restaurants and El Corte Inglés (huge clothes & home retailer).
The place is brand new, all the appliances are new. Great decoration. Big TV, very modern washing machine (washer/dryer), iron, microwave, oven, coffee maker (with capsules), kitchen has everything to cook your own meals. Medium size fridge, high speed Internet (WiFi).
Renovated building with few apartments.
Small front balcony but very nice to see the city, large back balcony with plenty sun in the morning. Nice backyard, and quiet.
Walking distance to the famous bridge in Porto.

We had a great time here. It’s a very comfortable beautiful flat. The white wine fridge was a pretty classy touch and we used the secluded communal garden and barbecue one night which was also great. Communication was very easy and smooth. The location is perfect if you want to visit the port lodges or have a few drinks down by the water. Easy access to the centre too and I’d highly recommend walking over the top part of the bridge at least once during your stay.

Our stay in Porto was perfect! We couldn’t have picked a better airbnb. The location was central and convenient, with loads of bars and restaurants minutes away. Check in was simple and fast, and the airbnb was super clean. The apartment is spacious and modern with all new appliances. The balcony was our favourite part, with sun from early morning up until the evening, we spent a lot of our time out on the balcony.

susanna was super kind and helpful in all moments. The flat is new and very comfortable, bed is great and the terrace is a plus.
Building is new
We had a great stay at Susana’s flat! Beautifully clean, great communication/checkin, comfortable bed and close to lots of great restaurants/bars and walking distance to all the sites.

5 stars all around! Bruno’s Wine House is spectacular- clean, tastefully decorated, and GREAT location. Bruno pays attention to detail and left great guides with additional info you may need on your trip in several languages  (supermarkets, transportation, closest hospital etc) The apartment is close to tourist sites (walking distance to Ribeira Square) but also “tucked” in a neighborhood that makes you feel at home away from home. The view of the city from the front balcony is amazing and I loved sitting on the balcony in the back with a glass of wine after a day of sightseeing. The check-in process was seamless and Bruno was great with communication. This was my second trip to Porto and I plan to come back again…I’ll definitely book Bruno’s Wine House and plan to book his beach house location as well!
Thanks for a great stay, Bruno. Excellent communication throughout and very timely to respond if we had any problems. Would highly recommend!
Susana was a great guest. She made us feel very welcome. Communication was smooth and the apartment is beautifully furnished

Super beautiful appartement in the heart of the city! Absolutely everything was in walking distance and the balcony was lovely!
Also a very helpful and kind host, thank you, Susana! :)

Susanas place is just perfect for a stay in Porto. The apartment is equipped with everything you need. A comfy bed, a nice bathroom and a sunny balcony. It was very easy to get around with public transportation and walking distance to awesome bars, sights and restaurants.

We loved this modern well equipped apartment which was in an ideal location. The balcony was an added bonus. It was comfortable and decorated to a high standard. It was in a busy street but that wasn’t a problem as the wooden shutter doors drowned out the noise at night. Susanna was very helpful.  We had a great time.
A lovely light and spacious flat which is conveniently located near a main metro station. Susana was particularly helpful and accommodating regarding our check in and out times.
This apartment is everything you would need for a great stay in Porto. Susana is a perfect host, the location is ideal and the apartment is clean and comfortable. Really lovely. Thank you Susana
Wonderful apartment centrally located. We had everything to make our stay confortable. The bed was comfortable and we were close to all major attractions with great restaurants nearby

Stop looking and book this place already!
It was by far the best Airbnb I've had stayed in so far. The pictures are completely accurate. The place itself is super pretty and comfy and it has elevator and a cute balcony to enjoy your espresso which is also provided :)
The location is amazing, walking distance from everywhere!
Also, great shower and AC!!!
Honestly the best, I loved staying here so much.

We were in Porto for a month and this place was a good base for exploring and was well equipped for our needs.   The location was not too far from the river,  the metro and a train station. The neighborhood was quiet.  You do have to go up or down the street to get places as it is on a hill. Bruno had maps and recommendations on places to go and was quick to respond to questions and also checked in with us.  I would stay here again.

Wow - what an amazing place!  The location was perfect with some local restaurants, cafes, beer pubs, mini-market and large super market so close by!  We loved the balcony - perfect for daily breakfasts and soaking in the sun!  I have to say this was by far our favourite Airb&B in Europe.  It was the perfect size for us and the location was beyond ideal for commuting with public transport to and from Lisbon and the Douro Valley.  Susana was easy to communicate with and even accommodated a late checkout!  The decor was great - shower was amazing - huge with great water pressure!  Everything about this place was amazing highly recommend it!

What an amazing place!  Susanna’s apartment was in the perfect location!  Walkable to everywhere, bars, restaurants, a supermarket very close by.  The apartment was immaculate. The kitchen was well stocked. We bought ingredients at the market one day and made dinner!  Susanna was extremely responsive and very helpful.  I would highly recommend this apartment when visiting Porto.

A lovely apartment in a great part of the city. Easily walkable to everything in the city center and near a lot of amazing restaurants and bars. Susana is very friendly, helpful and quick to respond. We would definitely stay here again!

We absolutely loved Susana’s place in Porto. I have stayed in a few different airbnbs throughout my trip through Europe and this was definitely one of the best. Super cute, nicely decorated, and very clean. Susana was super communicative and helpful with our stay. The area was great, nice view and near many restaurants and tourist attractions. I would recommend this place!

Very cozy apartment in the perfect location! Everything you could have on your Porto to-do list is within walking distance. Susana was a great host, was willing to provide flex check-in and was there to welcome us to the airbnb herself - the experience felt very personalized. She was also very responsive to messages and had a Porto binder with recommendations available for reference. 10/10 would recommend and personally stay again!
Great location. Walkable to the pier and many restaurants. Susana was a great host and very responsive.

Stay was great! We had a last minute change and Susana was able
To get us into the same apartment building just a different unit. Super cozy and we really appreciated her help. I would recommend any units hosted by Susana.

The apartment was clean, cozy, and very well located! Susana was a great host, and kindly let us see stay an hour longer after our check out. Easy check in and close to all nice places. Would recommend it!

We had a fantastic stay here. The apartment was clean, the building felt very secure and the location was ideal. Susana was a wonderful host - very friendly and accommodating. We would definitely stay here again and would recommend to others.
We had such a lovely stay. It’s a great little apartment, with everything we needed. Really good location too. Susana was very nice, helpful and a really responsive host too!

Very nice apartment. Very modern and clean.
Enjoyed many excellent restaurants nearby.

We absolutely loved our stay at Susana’s place. There truly could not be a more comfortable and convenient place to stay for a trip to Porto. The apartment was walkable to everything in the city, the place was super clean and just so lovely. We really enjoyed spending time on the balcony. Susana and Joao were very responsive and easy to communicate with. We felt very much at home. If we ever get to return to Porto, this is where we want to stay. Thank you!
Perfect place for a couple to stay! Was close and walkable to everything, and had a nice little balcony to relax on.

Susana’s apartment is the perfect place to stay in Porto. It is clean, convenient and comfortable. Susana was extremely helpful in so many ways, from flexible checking in and out to making helpful suggestions. She even met us personally at check in! We highly recommend this listing.

The apartment is very modern. We had an amazing stay, we were greeted by the owner. Walkable to all the sites we wanted to go to. Very nice laundromat half a block away, as well as restaurants and small grocery store if you want to cook.

Susana met us at the property entrance on arrival and escorted us to our room.
As a bonus there is a lift installed in the building which makes for easy access for luggage and less mobile people.
She gave clear and precise instructions about the property, and local ammenities.
The rooms were spotless, with appropriately sized furniture and the bed was comfortable with crisp clean linen. I would certainly recommend this property.

Susana’s place was very charming. The location was great, walking distance to everything. The bed was super comfortable and we loved the feel of the sheets. Susana was very friendly and always quick to respond. Thank you for a great stay!

Susana's place is cozy and impeccably clean. Its central location is perfect for exploring Porto, though it can be a bit noisy at night—but with earplugs, it wasn’t an issue. Susana is incredibly friendly, kind, and responsive, making the stay even more enjoyable. I highly recommend her place to anyone visiting Porto!

The stay was exactly what we were after. Spotless, spacious and comfortable. In a great area for highly recommended restaurants and bars, not too close to the noisy major tourist attractions so was tranquil and made you feel more like a local. That being said, it was an easy 10 minute walk to the hotspots if that’s what you’re after.
Communication was on point, any questions I had were answered promptly. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a few days in Porto.

Fantastic stay, I'd absolutely recommend this place. It was on a great location and super clean. The hosts responded really quickly.
Nothing negative to write down here.

We loved our stay. It’s super close to lots of restaurants and bars. Susana was really responsive, flexible and have us loads of great recommendations.
The apartment is quite noisy at night, but you would expect that based on the location.
Beautifully decorated and with a charming balcony.
Would definitely recommend to others.
Only good things to say about Susanna’s apartment. Every aspect 1st class and communication excellent. We were extremely well looked after during our stay. Highly recommended.
Such a lovely apartment - clean and comfortable.  We were able to readily walk to all are chosen destinations.  Communicating with Susana was easy, and enjoyable.

Susana was an incredible host she allowed me to drop off my bags before check in due to my flight arrival and was just an all around angel of a person. The apartment was stunning and couldn't be in a more perfect spot. I fully expected to hear people on the street at night due to it being a super busy neighborhood but I didn't hear a thing and slept like a rock. Couldn't recommend this place enough. I'm in love with Portugal 🇵🇹

What a great AirBNB. Perfect location and has everything you need. We arrived on the day of the Great Blackout of Spain and Portugal and our hostess went out of her way to get communication to us (all internet and phone lines were down).
The apartment is located on a quiet street and walkable to everything. There is even a laundry facility around the corner if you need.
We highly recommend Susanna’s place for your stay in Porto.

I had an amazing stay at Susana’s place in Porto! The flat was perfect for just me—cozy, comfortable, and exactly as pictured. It was also close to restaurants and things to do. It’s beautifully appointed and very well equipped with everything I needed. Susana and her partner were also incredibly responsive and flexible with my departure schedule, which I really appreciated. You can tell they put a lot of care into both the space and the guest experience. I’d definitely stay here again!
We had a great time and appreciated the excellent communication from host. The bedroom was very comfortable with AC and quiet with the windows closed. Highly recommend!

We really enjoyed our stay! The house is fully equipped and the view just makes it so much worth it!
Thank u!

Bright studio in a super central location. Straight across from Sao Bento station and the Rua Das Flores and conveniently located just above delicious pastry shops. Apartment was clean, comfy and has all the amenities you might need.

Good communication and some nice thoughtful touches. Right in the heart of town so easy to walk to everything.
Clean and modern!
Great stay!

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment in Porto! The location is absolutely perfect, right in the center of everything, which made exploring the city very convenient. The apartment itself was great, offering all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. Adriano was a great host. Highly recommend for anyone looking to experience Porto!

The place is really new and clean. Everything works perfectly and Sara is really nice. There are multiple TVs with Netflix :) the oven and everything looked really new. It has two balconies, de one on the backside is really nice to sit in the sun with your morning coffee. It is really close to the beach and within 5 minutes walk there is a bakery where you can get some fresh bread and cakes and stuff. Overall, loved it!
Sara was very kind and we could reach her whenever it was needed. The place is Amazing. Thanks you again.

Sara is a fantastic host. The BEST Airbnb I have ever stayed at. Every single detail thought of. Huge, modern, clean comfortable, fully equipped with all the essentials, plus. Host was quick to respond. A delightful stay indeed, metres from the sea,  even has beach accessories to utilise. Plenty of parking spaces. Huge Hypermarket 4 minutes drive away. Would definitely stay again. Extremely highly recommended.
It was a real pleasure to be a guest there. Charming place, kind atmosphere, great localization, clean, sophisticated detailes, garden, restaurant. Just perfect

This place has beautiful aesthetics and is everything you need. Great location, simple but tasty breakfast, warm people and they are there to help you with anything!
If you are a light sleeper, I would consider the building is charming but older, therefore you might hear some noise on the street at night or people walking on the level above you.
The bathroom is great and the room comfortable. I would totally recommend!

Casa Antiga was such a great find and happy surprise when we were looking at the last minute for a one-night stay. We love everything about this special place and will definitely return. Next time for longer! We really liked being in a less touristy neighborhood with lots of great restaurants and walkable to Porto’s highlights. We look forward to returning to this cozy charming guesthouse with a wonderful family history!
Really nice room in a walkable district. The cafe downstairs and cute common room was a plus.

The place is beautiful and cozie. You feel right at home. The reception is friendly, accomodating and helpful.
It was super comfortable.

Had a great stay at Casa Antiga.
The room is clean, charming and comfortable, and the hotel is located in a cool area with lots of restaurants and coffee places. What made the stay special, though, was how responsive and helpful the host was. They were flexible about check-in and check-out, and strived to be of service along my entire stay, constantly checking if I needed anything and offering suggestions for exploring the town.
Definitely recommend it!

Lovely, comfortable inn located right on the edge of everything (but five minutes away, so delightfully quiet). Hosts couldn't have been kinder. Very well appointed. Fabulous shower, nice big bed, very comfortable bedding. A++++.

The accommodation is great! We really enjoyed our stay and the apartment was lovely. Since the flat was located to the back of the building, it was very quiet but very centrally located close to the river. Would definitely recommend to anyone.

I loved this space. Very classy and modern. Dripping with good taste and design choice, this is a wonderful spot for a single traveller or couple in a very nice area of Porto, right next to the river. Communication was super easy and simple. I needed to check in early because I couldn't extend my stay at a previous Airbnb, and Katherine was very accommodating and helpful.

I had a great stay at Katherine's. I had a little issue with the internet connexion upon arrival, but the team was very efficient in solving it the next day. The apartment was very clean and comfortable. I enjoyed the small balcony as well. Merci!

Very nice and comfortable . Quiet though very close to Ribeira .
Fully furnished. Nice stay !
it was wonderful! Lovely apartment with everything i needed at a very nice location. Couldn't have imagined it better. Highly recommended.

Great stay at Katherine’s place. It was right in the center of a number of restaurants and beautiful sites. You could hear a little bit of loud talking from the hallway into the apartment during the afternoon, but it was not bad in the evening. Overall, great place to land for a few days.

Great apartment, great location, very quick and responsive host.
Only slight negative is the water flow in the bathroom sink very low and one tap was held in with screws.
Would definitely recommend and would be very happy to stay again.

Wonderful overnight stay in Porto. The flat was a great find, beautifully decorated, clean with great amenities. Really close to the riverfront with a fab restaurant at the end where you can’t go any further. Warm place with a great shower. Thank you
Although the bedroom is a little claustrophobic and has no nightstand, and the view of the unit is not very pleasant, this apartment offers a perfectly walkable location with cute decoration inside.

We had a lovely stay at this beautiful apartment. The location is fantastic, with everything you need just a short walk away.
The apartment itself is cozy, well decorated and very comfortable. While we did experience a couple of small issues like the handheld shower wasn’t working and the bathroom faucet only had hot water, but Katherine was very responsive and assured as they would be fixed soon. The bedframe, however, was a bit of concern as it wasn’t securely attached making the bed feel unstable. Despite these minor issues, the apartment’s charm and amazing location made our stay enjoyable, and we would still recommend it!
Lovely little apartment, great location. Easy place to come and relax in after a busy day around porto

Lovely little spot in Ribeira:) The apartment was cozy and perfectly located. We were situated near many restaurants and cafes, and we were a quick walk from the riverside and from Porto's center. There were plenty of amenities and lots of storage in the quaint apartment. Katherine was kind enough to check in with us every step of the way:) I would definitely stay here again!

Although the flat itself was lovely and in a great location, the bathroom was missing a cold tap and the a tap for the main shower. The owners were clearly already aware of this as they’d tried to jam a nail into both, to no avail. We raised this issue on check-in but they’re clearly satisfied that a non functioning bathroom is ok. I hope this has been fixed for future guests, however, based on our interactions and the fact this wasn’t rectified before we checked-in, I would reckon not. We did get some of the price back however which was appreciated.
great place and beautifully updated, safe and  comfortable. absolut perfect location! highly recommend and would definitely stay here again. Porto is definitely a most when visiting Portugal.

This lovely furnished apartment is located perfectly - everything you need and want to see in Porto is nearby. Heaps of cafes and restaurants are only a few minutes walking distance apart.
The communication has been amazing. I would definitely come back. Thanks so much!

This apartment is amazing, I stayed there for a bit more than a month. The location is perfect, the bed is comfy, the wifi is great..! The kitchen is well equiped and the water is steaming hot! I really recommend this place.
Great stay at Aposentus ! Everything was great. The location of the apartment is amazing right in the middle of all the beautiful things to visit in Porto
Lovely apartment, perfect for a short getaway! Communication with the host was easy, the location of the apartment excellent:)

We had a lovely time in Porto and staying with aposentus. The apartment was clean, well equipped and in a perfect area. 4pm check in was a lot later than we would have liked but other than that the hosts were really helpful!

AMAZING location! Yes, the street is a little busy at night, but that is to be expected when you are right in the center of the city. Airbnb is clean and felt welcoming. Very easy to access room and hosts were very clear with instructions. Highly recommend for guests who would like to stay in the hub of the city. The mini balcony is also a beautiful bonus.

Nice and bright apartment, located close to public transport and in the center of the city.
Would definitely recommend.

Perfect location and very good apartment for a short stay. Host is very communicative and check-in is very simple and practical. Could be a little bit better in terms of cleanliness, but otherwise I would really recommend this apartment.
Cute place to stay in good location! We were able to walk everywhere from here, and were very comfortable during our stay!
Really nice and clean flat, located in a great part of town. Lots of bars, cafés just around the corner and easy walk to sights.  A bit of street noise overnight but fine when windows shut.

This was a good stay. The apartment was beautiful, bright, and in a great location. The rain shower didn't work for us while we were there. The host offered to fix it during our stay, but we declined to avoid the hassle. Everything else was great!
Good spot near town  smaller than expected. Check in was very late so had to wait for 4 hours for them to clean a 500 ft apartment. Wow why so long. Who knows
Location location location! This place is in the perfect spot to enjoy all of Porto and is easily walkable to everything from restaurants and sights. Definitely recommend.
Beautiful apartment in a very good part of town. Close to everything really. Would have been nice to get some more coffee pods for our 3 nights (and an ironing board) but otherwise a very good place.

Ideal location for exploring Porto. Plenty of restaurants and bars close by. Door lock is a bit tricky at first. Apartment is pretty much as advertised and was perfect for first trip to this lovely city.
We had an amazing stay! The place is nice, and well placed, the street is not too noisy either. We will definitely be back if we ever come back to Porto.
Location was perfect, communication also. Some parts (especially towels and headboard) could be cleaner.

Wow 🤩 we loved our stay here! Excellent location, stylish, comfortable and thoughtfully equipped.
The views were amazing! We spent hours in the garden watching the world go by.
Hospitality and communication was great, especially as we were quickly forgiven for settling ourselves in the wrong apartment 🤭 ☺️
Great location with lovely garden  and views from the garden  , handy for cafes and restaurants . Alex was very helpful host
Excellent location, incredible views, and very clean - couldn’t ask for a better place to stay. Hope to be back soon!

This is a lovely apartment with probably the best views over Porto, and in a great location. The bed was very large and very comfortable. The kitchen was well-equipped and Alex provided Earl Grey tea bags and some coffee pods for the Nespresso machine. We had a good time and if we came back to Porto, we'd definitely stay here again. Alex communicated quickly and the provision for leaving bags in the apartment block before we checked in and also after we checked out, was easy and very useful.

Manor house is a unique gem in beautiful Porto. The location is incredible with a jaw dropping view and a lovely garden/terrace overlooking the iconic bridge and river. It’s shared with the 3 bedroom apartment which has a max of 6 people. We only saw them one night and it was totally fine since they were lovely and the space is huge. The interior of this historic, wood beamed apartment is beautiful and well appointed; it’s very clean and super quiet/dark when the huge wooden doors are shut. Perfect for sleeping at night. Great shower too. Much larger than the pictures look. It also has a mini split AC unit which makes a big difference since Porto can get very warm.  Highly recommend!

This apartment is wonderful. It is unique and stylish. The terrace is lovely with a great view. The apartment was super clean and comfortable. The location was excellent near Sao Bento station and within walking distance to major streets and neighborhoods. I had great communication with Alex and his pictures depicting how to get to the apartment were exactly correct. I would love to stay here again!

Manor House Porto was just awesome. The unit was really cool inside with almost all stone walls. The bathroom was spacious and everything worked very well. The terrace is just amazing with the best views of the bridge. The terrace is shared and we did see other guests out there, but everyone was quiet and respectful. We would highly recommend staying here!

Manor House Porto was such a great experience. The location of this AirB&B was perfectly aligned to see the river and city. We enjoyed the stay. Apartment had everything we needed for 3 days in Porto. Definitely recommend this location. Easy walk from Sao Bento station and the Riberia/riverside. Bring your walking shoes and go explore.

This place was amazing to stay in. The view from the garden is priceless, we really enjoyed it. Also a very centric location, in the middle of the beautiful Se neighbourhood. The place was neatly organized and was very comfortable. I would fully recommend it. Looking forward to stay in this apartment again!
Beautiful place, perfectly located. Patio is comfortable and has a million dollar view of the famous bridge and the Douro River. Far exceeded my expectations.

You stay in this apartment for the view. It’s even better than advertised. If as a tourist you’ve ever come across a nice building with a gorgeous patio and thought to yourself, “Imagine staying there and having this view,” well, this is that building.
That said, the space itself is a trade off. The apartment was spotless on arrival, but — being an old, historic stone building — there’s lots of dust and little small rocks that accumulate over time. The kitchen counters and floors were pretty dirty after three nights there. For us it was definitely worth it, but I guess it comes with staying in such a building.

Our studio apartment had lots of character and fabulous views of the river from our patio. Easy walking distance for many activities.
Our host was responsive, friendly and very helpful.

What a wonderful accommodation in the great city of Porto. Alex was very proactive in communications and he provided us with awesome recommendations that we otherwise would not have known. Pictures do not do justice of the view from the shared garden space. Thanks for having us!

This place was gorgeous, it felt like a slice of Porto history, from the stone walls to the amazing grassy terrace with chairs and lemon tree-with stunning views-it surpassed the pictures.  A modern interior and good heating for the cold rainy winter nights with the history of the city all around you.  Hope to stay again.  HIGHLY recommend!
Absolutely stunning property with incredible view. Host is very friendly and accommodating. Would recommend to anyone who wants to experience everything Porto has to offer!
Apt had a beautiful view of the Ponte De Luis bridge! Really got a feel of the Porto lifestyle.

One of the coolest places I’ve stayed. Beautiful views, feels private but is located close to everything, lush outdoor space, unique features, so much character! Loved the door to the backyard. And the bathroom was stunning. And the keys!! So cool. I could go on and on. Meeting the host Lisa was also an absolute delight. She recommended some great spots, shared history of the area, and was a text away when I needed anything at all. She was so welcoming and warm. Would stay here again!
Alex was friendly and helpful. Gave great recommendations. Great location with amazing views. Located within walking distance to several attractions.
This was a great location. So many great attractions and restaurants in walking distance! The view of the city is also incredible! Highly recommend!

Absolutely perfect location, nestled within the historic core of Porto. The apartment is lovely and well kitted out - but it is the private terrace that is worth the stay.
We spent hours watching the boats and views over a glass of wine.
Beautiful cosy natural wine bar - Arco Das Verdades - less than a minutes walk, is well worth a visit (or two). We never had to walk more than 15 minutes to anything.
We had a wonderful stay!  The apartment is in a perfect location and the host was very communicative!  we took their fado house recommendation and did not regret it!
Our stay at manor house was perfect! Best view in Porto. Amazing host that gave good recommendations. Location was close to everything we wanted to do.
We enjoyed our stay! The airbnb is near a metro so its easy to get around. We would recommand this place for a single traveler, its a bit tight for 2.

The apartment is very good. It is very functional for sleeping and cooking something punctual. Well connected with the subway that takes you directly to the center. A Lidl nearby to buy something. Some kitchen utensils or improving the quality of the pillows are missing, but I am sure that the tenant has taken note of these recommendations to improve the experience of future guests.
Great spot. As others have said, smaller than it looks, but overall very good value, decent location close to bus stop (Ubers are cheap anyway)

Perfect place for a short stay!
the host is really helpful and polite. Nice communication and really clear instructions to check in and check out. Pictures belong to the place. Highly recommended for travellers :)
Thank you very much!

For a quick one night stay, it was a great small studio. Very clean and cosy. Had everything that I needed such as towels, heater, router with WiFi, some cutlery and crockery.. very good.
Had some trouble to get in due to locks and missing key. However, host Claudio was very helpful and always responsive.
Definitely coming back 😄

This is a lovely, bright and impeccably clean tiny apartment, ideal for 1 or 2. Space is enhanced by a generous balcony.  Great location and expansive view of the sky. One thing to be forewarned about is that even though there is an elevator, you must climb a steep, narrow, and twisty flight of stairs to access it. Other than that, a perfectly wonderful apartment with hosts who are easily accessible.  Thoroughly enjoyed my stay!
The place was clean and fully equipped. Really nice location with everything you need nearby. Hosts were super helpful and friendly.
