We stayed there for three nights and everything was perfect. Our flight arrived late in the night which wasn't a problem because of the self check-in.  We would come again!

We enjoyed our stay at the place. The location is convenient and close to the metro. Also the city center was close and we appreciated the quietness of the location whereas the hustle and bustle of the city center. The apartment was clean and well equipped. The balcony is a plus and invites for cozy brunches or dinners outside. All in all, we recommend the place and would book it again when we'll be back in Porto.
Amazing view from the balcony, easy check in and close to the river! We loved the apartment very much.
Highly recommended! We had a very confortable stay in Paula and Rafael’s place. Check-in and out was very easy. The space was just as expected!

This is a studio flat with a small balcony in a quiet residential neighbourhood. The parking garage recommended is a 15 minute walk up and down a hill. I recommend an Uber that costs just three euros.
The balcony is ok but could do with a spouse up to look like the photos and the nearby view is not spectacular even if the more distant one is.
We came home from downtown Porto at 2.30am in an Uber for 5 euros, you can’t beat that!
There were some comments about a lack of curtains, I can only guess those guests did not see the excellent electric shutters that block out the light perfectly!!
Overall, very functional flat for two.

Very responsive host, we had some little miss up where the bed was not made. Getting in late and have to make the bed was not great, but they sincerely apologize and owned up to the mistake. Some very great restaurants around!

Overall a good stay. Kitchen was stocked minimally. Very basic supplies (garbage bags, toilet paper) only lasted for a couple days then had to supply our own. Couple areas needed a deep clean.  Quiet building, didn't really hear anyone around us. Lots of stairs, but a small elevator can be used. Decent area to get to transit. Would stay again.

Excellent apartment in the heart of Porto. Spotless clean, modern, brand new, all facilities included, very comfortable bed. Ideal for a couple and also suitable for longer stays. Great and very attentive hosts. One of the best stays I’ve ever had in rbnb.

We loved this apartment. This is a very clean and modern place in a very good location for walking around and seeing all of the great attractions in Porto. There are a ton of excellent restaurants and shops close by. The bathroom and shower especially were very small but that is the only con of this place.

My stay at Reginas place was amazing. The location is great. The apartment has everything you need in order to have a pleasant stay.
The communication with Regina was also very easy. I would love to come back! :-)

Modern, clean and well equipped apartment in the best location of Porto! The hosts are nice and communication is always fluent. I can't imagine a better place to stay while visiting this beautiful city.
The apartment was very clean, in a central position, with high quality features. Regina always answered to any questions and the check-in/out was very easy. Highly recommend!
Beautiful apartment with a perfect location. We enjoyed our stay and we would definitely recommend to stay there during your trip to Porto!
great place with lots of space. great central location and really enjoyed my time here, would stay again.

Regina’s place is beautiful and exactly as described. The windows are fantastic and show off the beautiful view and cute street. The best part by far is the location. You are in a perfect spot to try fantastic local restaurants but also easy to reach popular tourist destinations

Really cool apartment in a sensational location! so close to everything. very clean space with plenty of room. the only thing to consider is that there is no lift, and the shower is very very very small. otherwise excellent apartment to stay in Porto!
We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is very clean and in a good location.  Would recommend to anyone! Thank you Regina!

Fabulous location. Perfect spot within 10-15 mins of what you would like to absorb in 3 nights. Regina was quick to respond to all questions. Very tidy and pristine apartment. Would stay again in a flash..

Not only is the apartment comfortable and well-designed but it's in a great location! There was a bit of an issue with the AC on our first day but George was incredibly quick and responsive to find a solution. We would absolutely recommend this place to our friends and family and hope to stay here again in the future!

Great location in Porto, central and easy to get around. The loft was cozy, clean, had everything we needed for our 4 nights stay, and the view is also very nice.
The only downside is having to collect the key from a separate location for check-in, 10-15 min walk from the flat, which is still ok if you don't have heavy luggage.
The communication with the LovelyStay team went smooth, we were well-informed of everything we needed to know.
Enjoyed our stay, so we'd definitely recommend it.

Fantastic stay in Porto
Regina’s apartment is perfect for visiting Porto, close to many of the tourist attractions, easily walkable.
The luggage drop off is extremely convenient for early arrivals. We had an issue but it was not Regina’s fault and even while on vacation, she read my message and corrected the situation. The apartment is very comfortable and has all the comforts needed for a home away from home We had a wonderful stay and I will definitely return if we come back to beautiful Porto. Thank you, Regina!
The house is in a great location but all fixtures, doors, cabinets and furniture are old and malfunctioning.

The apartment was clean and conveniently located near all the attractions in the very center of Porto. But most of all I'd like to highlight the exceptional manager, Helena. She was always available and responded quickly to all my requests. She was very kind and ready to help. Helena, it was a grest pleasure meeting you!

Our stay was beyond our expectations! The description and pictures were accurate and the little touches with a complimentary bottle of wine and coffee were top notch. The space was spotless and you can tell it is well maintained. A wonderful location right in the heart of Porto!

We enjoyed our stay in Porto. Regina was a great host and very responsive to our requests and questions. Perfect location to explore the city. It was 5 min walk to Sao Bento station and Torre de Clerigos which are great places to pick up transportation and tours. Will definitely stay again. Thank you.
Great place in the center of the old city.  Extremely easy self check-in (and I was able to check in early as well)!

That's the best place to stay for 1-2 persons. The place is exactly like on the pictures with fantastic view from the windows to Cathedral. Very central location, all connections are nearby. Was easy to find and get in with instructions and no questions at all during the visit. Good place to fall in love with Porto - we plan to come back :)

The flat is perfectly located in Rua das Flores, all major spots just 10 mins or less away. The space looks just like the pictures and was nice and clean on arrival. Host was very responsive and kindly allowed just to check in early and let us keep our luggage at their office. Would definitely stay here again next time in Porto.

Great location on a lively pedestrian street close to everything. Place itself was spotless, check in via lockbox perfect as our flight was delayed and it was late when we arrived.
Only stayed for 3 nights but would recommend for longer stays too, it has everything you need.

This was an amazing place to stay during our Porto visit. The unit itself was clean, modern, spacious, and had AC. The location was just perfect — right on the bustling Rua das Flores, with lots of restaurant options nearby, and within 5 minutes of walking distance from the Sao Bento train station. We will definitely stay here again if we were to return to Porto!
Convenient location, comfortable stay. We were in Porto for a short period so was a great base to do and see everything we wanted.
Wonderful location and beautiful apartment. Lofted ceilings and woodwork were beautiful, and the view overlooking the city was stunning.

Very close to everything, walkable, and easy to find. You didn’t have to go far to see the sights and get something to eat. Beautiful views of the city from the window, enjoyed it being home for our time in Porto.

Really enjoyed my stay. There was one inconvenience, but it was handled properly.
Positives: Beautiful apartment with amazing view. Spacious bathroom. Great location with plenty of things to do. Responsive host.
Negatives: Know that the key to get inside apartment is difficult to turn. Turn it from the keychain metal.
We also missed an experience because we were locked in the apartment: a guest locked the deadbolt, preventing us from leaving. The airbnb host refunded us for the loss in experience, which is nice. Do not use a key to get inside the building, use the code.
We had such a great stay here!! The view is SO good and also very great location to visit different places in Porto!
I would highly recommend! The location, the host, and the space were all great. Julien gave us a lot of recommendations and communication for the check-in and check-out was easy.

The hostel is really nice, with a lovely garden and bar and it's conveniently located in a good central area. Unfortunately the private room was outside of the building, quite dark and directly on the street, which for me did not represent a good compromise quality-price.

I stayed at the apartment for a few nights. And that was my mistake. Next time I should pay more attention to the reviews. To keep the long story short: if good night rest is not among your priorities then it’s good place to stay. Otherwise I would not recommend for longer than couple of nights max. The apartment is clean, and location is convenient. But..the quiet hours will be from 2 AM until 6.30 AM. Cars outside, neighbours walking above, people passing your door. You open the door and you are immediately on the street. To be fair the location is very central and the hostel has lovely garden. There is a laundromat down the street.

I really enjoyed my time there!
The apartment was very nice and super comfortable and cozy. It had everything I could possibly need.
They asked me everyday if I wanted my room/apartment clean. Every time I told them yes, they left the room completely spotless to the same level I got when I first arrived on my very first day. I was very impressed with the level of commitment they have with making the guest experience pleasant and easy.
I have no problem recommending this place and I will definitely keep it in mind for my next visit to Porto.
We really enjoyed our stay! Great location, smooth check-in process, very clean, and the host was always quick to respond. Gladly recommend this place to anyone visiting Porto 🙂

This place was absolutely fantastic. From the location, the brightness of the flat, its cleanliness, to its kitchen equipment it was absolutely perfect. And on the top it was extremely quiet. Absolutely nothing negative to say, I highly recommend it.

Great little apartment. The location is good, it's just a 20 min walk into the centre of the city. It would have been nice if there was a fridge but other than that it had everything we needed. Would happily stay again :)

The location and the check-in is very good. You can get to the appartament any time and it is very close to city center. The apartament has all you need for having good stay. Higly recommended place in Porto

Paula & Rafael were great hosts. They provided a 5 star experience. The loft was in a great location, quiet neighborhood, and perfect size for me as a solo remote worker. The only complaint I have was whoever lived above the unit walks around like an elephant in the middle of the night for a few hours. Hopefully it’s just another Airbnb so future guests don’t experience it. Altogether I am very happy with my stay. Porto is amazing and I will definitely be back to stay at Paula’s and Rafael’s unit!
Great place to stay, hosts were responsive and helpful. Not too far from the river and São Bento station. Some issues with moisture but that seems to be pretty normal for Portugal in general.

Everything was perfect. Easily accessible and nice and quiet. Location was ideal far enough away from the centre to be peaceful and only a 10 min walk.
The flat was exactly like the pictures very clean and tidy.
Hosts were very attentive and helpful with some great recommendations and quick to answer any questions we had.
Made our trip to Porto that much better and stress free.

Great location, clean, host provided good recommendations. No faults with the accomodation apart from the shower head which kept falling down.
Would recommend to anyone coming to visit Porto.

Very cute tiny house which makes great use if space. The complex has nice neighbors and maintenance and is located in a central location close to the bridge and riverwalk for restaurants and stores. The house had everything we needed for a short weekend and was comfortable. The hostess Paula was very communicative and responsive. Thank you for the hospitality - we enjoyed our stay!!
The place is sooo cute! We loved the outside area too. The only things would be about the air conditioning. It was not cooling the space so much and we were hot at night. The rest wast perfect

I have been in a lot of Airbnbs over the past few years of traveling and this by far is the best one I have stayed in. Upon arriving, I felt safe with the gated area and the apartment was incredible. It was super clean and the whole aesthetic was amazing. The hosts were wonderful in providing such an amazing place and in providing such detailed instructions. It is a beautiful walk to places nearby. If you are looking for an amazing place in Porto this is 10/10.

The appartment is located in the middle of the old centre and you can easily visit the hotspots in the area. It's well furnitured an also very clean. We loved this place very much and recommend it for a great stay in Porto.

Absolutely stunning apartment with abundant natural light, an amazing view, nice kitchen and bathrooms. Location was central and easy to get to public transit or walk to the south side of ether river. Highly recommend staying here!

Claudia's place is amazing. It is very spacious, beautifully designed & decorated and was very clean, when we arrived. The apartment is in a perfect spot in the city center close to all the sites. While it is close to a main pedestrian street, the windows are well insulated, so you can sleep well even during the weekend. The terrace & the view were our favorite part of the stay. Communication with Claudia was easy and she was very nice. Check in & check out was also seamless.
Fantastic stay in Porto! The location is unbeatable, and the apartment is beyond comfortable and cozy. Claudia's team is friendly and easy to communicate with and we absolutely loved our stay.
A beautiful apartment in an excellent location. Claudia was very easy to communicate with in advance and during our stay. We would very much recommend this place to all travellers.

Claudia and her place were amazing. Location is right in the heart of everything.  The apartment was spotless, large and decorated with great taste.  One of the best air bnbs that I have stayed at.  Very close to the train station. The small touches were great, comfortable beds, plenty of linens and bathroom supplies. Felt like a luxury hotel.  Air conditioning on the main floor and large fans in each of the bedrooms downstairs. Lastly Claudia provided great restuarant recommendations.

5 stars all the way for our experience!! What a beautiful place to stay, right in the heart of Porto. Clean and beautifully decorated with everything you could need. Also loved sitting outside overlooking the Main Street that was really great! Will definitely stay again!!

Had a great stay at Claudia’s place. Everything is literally walking distance. The place look exactly like the photos. It is also fully equipped with everything you can possibly need. Little warning though, since it’s in the center, it can get loud during late evenings. Make sure to close the windows and doors to block out noise. Overall highly recommended

Claudia’s place is a comfortable two bedroom, two bath apartment in the heart of Porto’s historic district.  The beds were comfortable, toiletries were provided and the bedrooms were spacious.  The views were amazing.  A perfect location for exploring Porto on foot.  Convenient to the Metro and train station, we highly recommend Claudia’s Place.
Enjoyed our stay which was in a fabulous location close to the river, cathedral and the station.

This was our tenth stay in an AirBnB and was the most superb luxurious and award winning designed apartment - a very Special experience . In the centre of the historic quarter but quiet . With outdoor balconies above the rooflines .

Incredible location, we walked everywhere. The actual apartment was even better than the photos show and we made great use of the terrace to relax after long days of exploring. Highly recommend and would stay again in a heartbeat
Better than advertised, heart of the city, comfortable and enjoyable stay. Host was easy to communicate with and very accommodating with both early check in and late check out.

We had a wonderful time in Porto, staying in this marvelous apartment which is in a very central location. Mariana was very responsive. Nothing to do with the host but a central location does come with some street news which was expected and didn’t bother us. We would stay here again.
Perfect Porto location especially for our short visit.  Clean, comfy beds, and the balcony and views were awesome!
Claudia's place is gorgeous. We loved being close to the action and close to the river. The views in the apartment are fantastic. Would definitely stay again.

My family absolutely loved our stay at this apartment. It’s right in the heart of Porto and offers breathtaking views of the city. The layout of the place is well structured and offers plenty of room for a family of four. By far a favorite AirBnB spot for us!

We received a very nice welcome and tour of the apartment. The apartment itself was beautiful and had a great layout. Location was amazing within walking distance of all amenities and many of the historic landmarks, including lots of great restaurants and bars. Overall 10 out of 10. Thank you!

I had very expectations for Claudia's place, and they were exceeded in every way.  The communication was excellent, and I was graciously given the opportunity to check in a few hours early. The location is perfect - right in the middle of everything, and you can hear live music from  the balcony, which is amazing. There are so many nice touches to the unit - the overall craftmanship is top-notch; Claudia surprised us with a bottle of sparking wine; everything is super clean and well laid out. This was one of my top AirBnB experiences over the past several years - thank you, Claudia, for a magical weekend :)

Glad we stayed in the center of happenings with shops and restaurants right outside our door and a short walk to the water, train station etc. Just what we expected! Thanks to Claudia for such proactive assistance as we neared our visit and the coffee, tea and snacks--made us feel welcome!

In the heart of Porto. Easy to get to. Plenty of good restaurants and shops within steps of the apartment. The apartment was neat and tidy. Felt like I was living in an apartment right out of Architectural Digest.  Excellent host. Accommodated my late arrival and special requests with ease and kindness. Responsive and communicated well.
Amazing house! I wished we had stayed longer to enjoy the house a bit more and see more of Porto.  We loved the space, the deck, the view. I highly recommend this apartment and host!

We were so happy with our trip to Porto largely because this was the perfect location to be able to walk to everything. The place felt really good, beautiful windows and light, we especially enjoyed spending time on the balcony relaxing. Claudia was an especially attentive host, easy to communicate with. She let us check-in a few hours early which was much appreciated. Thank you Claudia!

The apartment is in the lively centre of the old part of Porto, with bars, cafes and restaurants close by. The apartment is spacious, nice furniture and with good facilities. The balcony is especially nice when the sun is shining, a perfect place for for an aparitive before heading out. Sao Bento station is very close as is easy access to the metro.
Convenient location and beautiful space. The views from the upper level were fabulous. Beds were super comfy. Would definitely stay again.

Beautiful flat right in the heart of the city. The place is gorgeous, very modern and filled with light. We absolutely loved sitting on the balcony at night, listening to the sounds of the city and admiring the moonlit cathedrals in the distance. Not a single complaint, would love to stay here again!

Thank you very much for a really special stay. Spectacular apartment on a beautiful street in the heart of Porto. We’ve stayed in airbnb apartments for over 10 years and this is the best. It was beautifully furnished with clever design features, super comfy beds and lovely linen. Great views and very atmospheric. We wished we could have stayed longer.
Gorgeous apartment in a super central location ! We were so happy here. Claudia was so helpful. We would definitely stay again and highly recommend.

I highly recommend this place !!
A stunning apartment, an amazing location in the heart of Porto
Carolina and Luis are very helpful
Thanks Carolina and Luis
The place is centrally located, with a very chic design and pleasant furnishings. It was a very nice stay and definitely my choice when i will come back to Porto.

Very nice flat and location at the heart of historical Porto
The host is very reactive and always available to help
Highly recommend
Excellent rental. The team is responsive and friendly. The location is ideal and the suite is large, clean, and well decorated. Def recommend!
Excellent location, great responses to questions and very helpful host. Very clean lovely apartment so close to Ribiera, would definitely recommend
Everything was perfect! Thank you for such a comfortable stay in the very heart of Porto. We loved it there!

Great location close to Rua das Flores, and quite neighborhood. Well distribution in the apartment and properly equipped. Best for single family or young couples as it has stairs between kitchen to rooms, which have glass walls (with proper screens for privacy).

Amazing place in the city center. Responsive and friendly host, self check-in and check-out. The place itself was fully equipped and matched the description perfectly. The only slight discomfort was the absence of the natural light in the apartment (there are only two small windows in one bedroom). The rest was perfect!

I stayed here with my mum and sister for 4 nights, and we loved it!
The apartment was so much bigger than we had expected and is lovely and spacious, yet cosy.
The kitchen was well stocked if we wanted to cook for ourselves and the whole apartment was very clean and tidy.
The location is great and everything is walkable and easily accessible. Check in and check out were very easy and the instructions were clear. We felt very safe in the apartment and neighbourhood.
Carolina was great to communicate with and is very responsive to any questions and kindly arranged taxis from and to the airport for us.
I'd highly recommend this apartment!

Great place and lovely hosts! Myself and three other travelers lived here for 3 nights.  The apartment was a great fit for us! Located in the heart of Porto, Sao Bento station was located less than a 7 min walk away. Despite the central location with diverse restaurants and local shops, the apartment was located in a quiet alley. The hosts also helped us organize an airport shuttle from the airport to the airbnb. All in all, we had a great experience, and would recommend this place.

The team at this, Airbnb did a great job and providing quality customer service along with helpful and responsive time to messaging through Airbnb. We really do appreciate everything they did for us. A+ on service and stay.

We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment in Porto. The place was spotlessly clean and well maintained, which made us feel very comfortable from the start. The location is ideal – close to many sights, nice cafés, and easy to reach by public transport. Communication with the host was excellent as well; they were always quick to respond and very helpful with tips and recommendations. Overall, it was a wonderful experience and we would be happy to stay here again and highly recommend it to others.
Very nice apartment. Comfortable and spacious. In very good condition and well equipped. Walking distance to river and next to a grocery store.
Host was responsive and helpful. The flat was nice and had kitchen supplies which was a plus. Spent a week in Porto and felt right at home in this comfy flat.

A very large apartment with great decor. Check in was easy as someone greeted us and showed us into the apartment. A supermarket is literally 1min walk and a few others only 10-15min walk away. Trams are down the hill (which can be more expensive than other transport) or local buses nearby (which aren’t very reliable). We used the electric scooters to get around as some of the more busier beach areas with lots of restaurants/shopping were not within walking distance. The host rectified a wifi problem and communication was easy. The apartment was very spacious with 3 bedrooms and great for a family.

we loved our stay! Close to a metro station. Also some great restaurants and supermarkets a few minutes away. The airbnb looks exactly like the pictures. We appreciated the air-conditioning on both floors alot!
Perfect apartment near the city center. There are a lot of restaurants nearby, supermarkets, viewpoints and etc. I really like my staying 🫶🏼 will come back for sure

Really enjoyed my stay at the BnBird apartment! The host was really nice, contacted in advance, the check-in was very smooth. The place looks as in photos, quiet area, clean and comfy. Recommended!
Thank you guys!

Neres was beyond helpful...when a tourist travels soo far and arrives at the apartment late and tired and Neres greets them with a boost of energy..best host ever.
Johnny

Lovely little apartment with an outdoor space - nice to have for our week long stay, perfect space for 2. Not in the middle of the city centre but very accessible by walking. Our host Giovanna was very friendly in meeting us. Some damage to the bedroom wall upon arrival which wasn’t an issue, all in all a lovely stay and would happily return :)
Nice apartment in pretty centre location, though a bit noisy now due to construction works in a house nearby..
Brilliant place with lovely views and close to everything. The kitchen is really well equipped and everything was seamless

Bebe’s flat is in a perfect location for seeing the sights of Porto.
It has a large terrace with amazing views over the city and the Douro. The beds are comfortable and the kitchen is well equipped.
We had a wonderful holiday
Brilliant central location, great views, good facilities for a fairly short stay. There is a building site next door still, but there were no works taking place on the days we visited (fri-mon).
Amazing place to stay! It never gets old being right on the river. Great location, very responsive host and next to a cute cafe. We will definitely stay there again!

Had a fantastic couple of days in Porto! This home was a perfect base for exploring. Such a great location with a wonderful view. We were 2 adults and 2 kids (6 and 8) and there was plenty of room and all the place was stocked with everything we needed. Would definitely recommend this spot for a family or two couples or a couple of friends traveling together. Note it’s on a very steep hill and has 3 floors so wouldn’t recommend for toddlers and little kids or older folks or those with mobility issues. We had a lot of fun visiting the “world of discovery” museum (great for kids) which is just down the hill only 250m away. We did a short cruise on the Douro. And generally just wandered around taking in the beauty of this really cool city. Loved it!

This property was fantastic! Bebe was very communicative, attentive, and kind. The apartment is a great size, and the location is perfect, with an amazing river view. We would most certainly stay here again!
this place has everything you need to relax and enjoy your time.  amazing views and walking distance to lots of great attractions and food.

My first time using Airbnb.  The location of the house is very good, and the service of the landlord is very fast and humane.  The beautiful balcony is great for drinks and chatting with friends in the evening.  Although the house next door was being renovated, it was not disturbed as we only stayed in the room at night.

This place was absolutely stunning. The terrace was such a great place to sip on a few glasses of wine in the evenings and hang out but still feel like you’re experiencing Porto. Would highly recommend to anyone!

Bebe’s place is great for your stay in Porto. The views from the balcony are perfect, the whole place is very clean and very well maintained, and your are right in the center of the historic city area. Plenty to do and see. The apartment is on a very steep hill, but everything in Porto is on a hill so you are likely prepared for that. One thing was that we believed it to be a two bathroom, but it is only one full bathroom and the second only has a sink and toilet. Not a very big deal but just in case you are looking for two showers..I will say the one shower is huge and very comfortable compared to most typical European showers. I would stay here again! Thanks for a nice stay.
One of the nicest places I’ve stayed in in Portugal. It’s super clean, beautifully designed and huge! We loved our stay here. Very comfortable and we would come back again

This house was amazing! The location was perfect for exploring the city of Porto--we walked all over! It was so easy to do check-in and check-out, and the balcony was an added bonus. It was great for enjoying a glass of wine or a cup of coffee. The kitchen had everything we needed, and the beds were very comfortable. Also, the house was very clean. Bebe was helpful and responsive. Well worth the price we paid. Would absolutely stay here again our next time in Porto!!

Nice and quiet location. The drawback is that there aren't any decent groceries around.
Apartments were clean, furniture is in good conditions, kitchen is well-equipped. Host is very helpful.
Haven't used terrace because of the weather.
Overall, my stay met my expectations. Highly recommend.

This quaint 3-level home with terrace overlooking the river is as amazing as the pictures. It is a perfect setting in the best neighborhood surrounded by all Porto has to offer. I recommend this home highly. Bebe (host) was just as amazing, communication was a 10.

Our stay in this townhouse properly exceeded all our expectations and the pictures didn't do it justice. It was well located and every room was spotlessly clean and decorated beautifully.  The small garden overlooking the river was an added bonus. The extras left for us like the wine and biscuits were an added bonus and the toiletries in the bathroom smelt amazing!
Just wow ! The apartment is amazing, beautifully decorated, very spacious and the view is just stunning. Can’t wait to be back!
Great townhouse with a fantastic view in a lovely location. Outside space is a bonus and everything very well thought out and designed.
Great location! We walked everywhere! Loved the location and private patio. Ate at the two neighboring restaurants next door. Quiet neighbors. Fans in bedrooms helped.

Beautiful place with a great view of the river. Spotlessly clean. A couple of good restaurants nearby.
Please note, as most of the city, the area is walkable, however not for the faint of heart, and strength as it is very hilly with long stairs.
Hopefully the description has been changed but it said 2 bathrooms when in fact was just one with a powder room.

Amazing place with great views. I loved the layout and felt right at home. So convenient to all things in Porto. Multiple great places to eat right out the door and many more with in a two min walk. We were i
Disappointed that the balcony was not functioning since that was a big part of our decision to rent. Hopefully it is repaired soon.
Very nice studio with everything you need. I stayed for a week and really enjoyed my stay. Good and quiet location

The flat is located in a nice quiet place and nicely furnished. Two things that bothered us though: firstly, the water from the shower got cold quickly and secondly, everything around the window frames was mouldy.

Very cute place, the only problem is that the house can be very cold because of poor heating. The water in the shower gets suddenly cold after ten minutes of using it and you have to wait hours for it to become warm again. Other than that, it is a very cute place with a nice position.

Response time was incredible! Very attentive and caring! The place was HUGE! Lots of room to spread out in and had all the amenities. Very clean and comfortable. I couldn’t have been more happy! Book this! It was the best value but I also truly believe it was the best choice as well!! Don’t hesitate!

Was exactly what we expected, excellent location to walk to city centre and easy access to drive out of the city. Excellent cafes and restaurants nearby and would definitely choose this location again. Thanks for making our stay easy and comfortable.

I had a great four night stay at this place when I attended a wedding in Porto in July. The apartment was clean, the service was great and the house had all the household commodities needed for a shorter stay. The location was great, just a few minutes walk from the best view of Porto (which also was a great place to hang out in the nearby park as well). I also enjoyed the silence after returning from the more vibrant city core.
Really cozy apartment which includes all the basics. Close to the metro stop with nice places to walk. Host was very friendly and helpful.

Nice place for a family of four, house is lovely, it has all needed for a long stay, good location, 5 minutes to the luis I bridge. walking distance to main town monuments, busy area for parking but some free spaces available from time to time. Supermarkets and restaurants available in the area
Situated in a quiet street, but just around the corner of the city's hotspots this was a perfect place for us to stay.
My stay was great, just stay a night, basics covered and the place was ok, great location.

The location was great and the studio is nice but the walls are paper thin. I am usually a heavy sleeper and was awoken many times during the night until 4AM by people taking the elevator, walking up/down the stairs or closing their doors. I barely slept the past few days.

BEAUTIFUL apartment  with amazing views of the city. And Itay is fantastic because he will send you a long list of recommendations of what to do around Porto and Gaia! Check in was easy and communication 10/10

Amazing place. Itay responds quickly, let us check-in early so we could return the car in time, everything was clean, the place looks super cool. There is everything you might need during your stay. The view is breathtaking. Best airbnb I have ever visited!

The apartment is in a great location, with amazing BBQ restaurants and a lovely local feel. It’s an easy walk, cycle, scooter from Vila nova de Gaia, and all the restaurants, bars and views. It’s in a quiet area at the top of a hill so the views are beautiful and the balcony gets sun all afternoon and evening.
The swinging chairs on the balancing were really relaxing and a great way to take in the view.
The house has a great interior decor and the kitchen is well stocked with equipment.
We had a great stay here, thank you.

Wonderful stay in this unique and spécial spot. The location gives you a feel of living as a local . the fisherman village with the wonderful restaurants were amazing. loved waking up to looking at the Douro river and the wonderful view.  thanks

We had a great time in Itay’s space. Aesthetically pleasing, great view, and comfortable beds. Within walking distance to some cute eats. Itay was quick to offer tips and assistance when we struggled with the heater. Enjoyed our stay.

Nice apartment with a beautiful view! Basically it is the same as on photos, but there are two points which could be improved: electrical sockets are in need of repair and more light is needed in the bathroom. Itay is a very nice person, our communications went smoothly and he allowed us to make a late check-out for free.
I was in need of a relaxing holiday and Italy's place was just the perfect place for it! Peaceful, quiet, amazing view of the river and comfortable beds! Perfect break for me!

The home was very serene and just what we needed to unwind.  It was close enough to the City Center, but just far enough away to have peace and quiet.  The instructions for check-in were very clear and much appreciated.  Thanks for sharing your home!

We stayed in this house for 3 days and we had a really good time.
Itay is a very kind host and he replied instantly to our doubts.
The things that we liked the most about the house were the beautiful kitchen, the fact that the house is full of plants and the way the house is furnished.
The only things that made us rate the house as 4 stars was the fact that the kitchenware wasn’t that clean so we had to wash it ourselves before use, and the fact that the bathroom lacked lighting.
However we had a very nice stay and we would recommend this house!
What a beautiful and peaceful space- just as described! Be sure to bring enough time to enjoy the breathtaking views :)

Our stay at Dahome apartment was excellent! Flat is located in the city centre (3 min walk to Sao Bento train station and to the Liberdade Square). the host was very helpful and responded to our messages very quickly.

Excellent location! Communication with the host was great, check in was great. The place was clean. Only thing I will point out is that the front room with the single bed is street facing,so it is slightly louder in there on a busy night. The main bedroom is very quiet though. I loved my stay!
Great location. Close to the river and some tucked away restaurants. The only thing we were lacking was WiFi so my son could do his online schooling.

We had an amazing experience. apartments are super clean spacious.
Location is incredible, walking distance to city centre.
Host sent a lot of helpful information before the trip.
we will come back for sure. can't recommend enough
10 of us came from the UK and booked 5 flats between us. It was perfect location and the host was very responsive

Above and beyond of our expectations!
Clean, stylish, and spacious place. Super easy check-in experience. Located I a heart of Porto where you can find shopping, restaurants, and malls.
I would definitely come back again and stay in the same place!

Great location, very comfortable and lovely vibe. We had an issue with the door getting stuck but Paolo was very responsive and replied right away. Overall great communication from the hosts and definitely a good place to stay in Porto.
The apartment is clean and spacious with good air conditioning. The view from the balcony is breathtaking. The location is good - It’s a short walk to the metro or the riverside bars and restaurants.
The apartment is a very gem, with a strategic location. Paulo helped us with the check-in and provided lots of information about the city: a very kind person. Highly recommended.
Exactly as described. We enjoyed our stay there, the attention from Paulo, the cleanliness and the fabulous location. I highly recommend this apartment. Thank-you.

We recommend Maria and Paulo's apartment! We had 5 people and plenty of space for all of us. The place was very clean and comfortable and had everything we needed for a few days visiting Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia.
The apartment is a walkable distance from many good places to eat, as well as the WOW museum, the river, the bridge to take you over to the Porto side. And the best part - you will enjoy an amazing view of Porto and the sunset is spectacular from the balcony.
This apartment is amazing. The most beautiful view of Porto. Easy to walk everywhere. Very clean and comfortable. Paulo was extremely helpful and welcoming. Would love to return one day.

The view alone was worth the price admission. Two big bedrooms with an additional pull out sofa just in case. The host was very responsive and friendly, and gave a lot of good recommendations from the onset. Easy walk to the bridge and downtown central area. Would 100% recommend this to any friend going to Porto!
Beautiful place, picture perfect views. Relaxing and all we could ask for. Would recommend staying here when you visit! We could walk everywhere.
Great host, very responsive and easy to deal with. The apartment is awesome and the view to the river is AMAZING!!! I would highly recommend it.
Great location and great hosts! Would recommend staying here for its proximity to so many of the best parts of Porto! We really appreciated the hosts attentiveness.

The views of Porto from the apartment are simply amazing. Waking up, watching the sunset and staring at the stars from the balcony are incredible extras for a great-location and confortable apartment.
First time visitors from Canada, 2 couples.  Great location, wonderful host.  The beds were comfortable, kitchen well stocked.  We recommend this apartment!
Very responsive and friendly staff; well-located in old town where you can literally walk to all attractions.
Nice little studio in a good location, the host gave some nice recommendations. We enjoyed our stay, but wouldn't recommend it for longer times or if you really want to cook dinner often.
Great location & a decent space to base yourself in Porto. The room was a bit noisy as others have mentioned but it didn’t keep us awake. The check in was easy and communication was clear.

Location is perfect, venue is very clean and owner is very responsible. Just one thing, quite noisy day time for building construction and neighbours dogs barking all time. However I highly recommended this air bnb.

Had a great weekend stay! The location is amazing, everything is extremely walkable and the central location made it easy to make a quick pit stop at the Airbnb during the day. The only downside is that you can hear the people upstairs pretty well, so bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper! Other than that, we had an easy check-in and out, and enjoyed beautiful Porto :) Thank you!!
Great location, nice shower and a welcoming host! The walls were a bit thin but other than that I had a great stay.

The best view in Porto. Wow!! A perfect location close to many of the best places this beautiful city offers. The flat was completely spotless & then there is Goran! The perfect host. So helpful & friendly & lots of good advice. Highly recommend.

What a place! Göran was super helpful and had lots of recommendations for us, which made our stay very pleasant. The views from the balconies are stunning, and the apartment itself clean and modern. Will definitely stay here on our next trip to Porto. Highly recommend!
Göran was so helpful with local recommendations and our stay was a pleasure! Would recommend this to any friends visiting
Beautiful place with the view. I would love to stay here again. Goran’s recommendations are great!
5 star in Gaia! Very clean, beautiful view and Göran had great local recommendations and was very helpful. Highly advise to book this apartment in Porto!

Beautiful location. Loved relaxing on the terraces in a private setting and watching all the activity in Gaia. Goran is the perfect host with great recommendations and helped us with a special port wine tasting. We enjoyed our stay and it was walking distance to both sides of the river.

We had a great time here. The views from the balcony are unreal! So nice! The apartment was clean and had everything you could need while you stay. The location is walkable to everything. Goran the host was so nice and warm and welcoming. He gave us a map of the city where he hand wrote us notes on places we should go and see and all his recommendations were amazing. Everything was smooth and easy :)

It’s a lovely, albeit obscure location to afford that view of Porto and the riverfront. Goran’s partner, Celia, was very helpful and accommodative. They clearly endeavor to make the stay a pleasant one. But we were surprised by a 5 euro/night occupancy tax expected to be provided in cash. Given Airbnb’s recent effort to disclose all fees upfront, this was incongruous.

Göran was extremely friendly and kind, giving us a full review of Porto with a map with recommendations. He also reserved us an amazing winery tour, which we enjoyed very much. Göran would also check on us every now and then during our stay.
The villa had an amazing view, with a private balcony included which was amazing.
I appreciate the hospitality of the host, first of all. The place was great, it had an amazing view and the accommodations very nice.  Also close to our favorite restaurants. We loved it !
Great location, beautiful space, and even better view. Central to train station, the water, bars, and restaurants. Definitely recommend.
Great  little studio apartment in a fantastic location! The flat faces the back of Rua Das Flores and has quite the view without all the street noise. Would gladly stay here again ❤️
Everything was amazing. The place was inspiring, with beautiful interior, wonderful views and great location. To top it off, Anna was a kind and easy host to communicate with.

We came in Porto in November, so it was rainy outside and we enjoyed even more this apartment - we literally didn't want to leave, because it is so cosy, clean and with an amazing view.
It's very comfortable also that you can have a very good breakfast and lunch in the cafe on the ground floor.
The only thing might be not very comfortable - there is not a double, but two single beds. Maybe with an additional mattress it might be more suitable for couples.
Anyway, we enjoyed our stay a lot.
We loved Anna’s place! The location, the facilities were great and the apartment was so cute! We will definitely be recommending Anna’s place to others travelling to Porto and may be back ourselves!

You can stop looking now as you have found the perfect place to stay. Well located on the pedestrian walking street, close to the metro and train station, with easy walking to all of Porto’s sites. The apartment is beautiful and stylish while everything is new. Every convenience has been thought of and provided. Lovely view out the windows and super quiet at the back of the building. While it does not have a washing machine, a laundromat is close by. The cafe downstairs is the perfect place for brunch  and added to our stay. We can’t thank you enough for contributing to our magical weekend.

Such a perfect place for a calm stay in the very middle of everything! I loved sitting next to the lovely windows, looking outside, to the beautiful Portuguese façades. Anna is an awesome and warm host, would love to stay again at her place.

We loved the appartment. It was very cozy and clean. Everything was in a very good condition. The appartment was very central and we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. Communication with Anna was great. She was very friendly and helpful. She responded quickly and also contacted me proactively with advice and offered help, for example offering to help organizing a taxi or that we could leave our luggage after check-out. Thank you Anna!
Very nice apartment. Central for everything but quiet as at back. Anna on hand to help with everything if required

The view at this airbnb is outstanding. I don’t think I’ve ever had such an amazing view from a place! I loved how clean the airbnb was, also- that’s something I am very specific about! Location was great- on an awesome pedestrian street with lots to do right around it. Thanks for the great stay, Anna!

We had a wonderful stay at Anna’s apartment. While it is right in the center of the best district in Porto, it is remarkably quiet as it does not face the street. Additionally, the apartment has a beautiful view of the city. We will gladly return here when we are in Porto next. Thank you Anna!

Perfect apartment and location! We would absolutely stay here again.
Anna was a very proactive and responsive host and I loved that she is a local and the apartment has been in the family for generations. It looks like it has been recently renovated with modernized touches throughout that made the stay very comfortable but maintained all of the charm of the historic building. Everything was spotless and well designed. There is an elevator and air conditioning (huge plus).
The location is in the middle of everything and although we typically are not big fan of heavy tourism spots, it was very convenient and as soon as we entered the building we forgot how busy the street was - it was quiet and peaceful inside the building. The cafe right outside was one of the best cafes we came across (and of course there was a long queue everyday).
We enjoyed our stay very much!

My daughter and I soooo enjoyed our stay. Anna was easy to reach and quick to reply. Will definitely seek out another stay at Anna’s in the future and will recommend to anyone I hear is going to beautiful Porto. Thank you.

Anna’s place was as advertised. Great spot in the heart of Porto. It’s walking distance to all the great attractions.
Anna was a wonderful host who provided us with all the information we needed to get in and around the apartment. We would not hesitate to book with her again.

Just back from 4 nights staying at Anna’s place. Anna was a fantastic host and was very easy to contact. She gave us lots of recommendations for restaurants/places to visit.
The apartment was just perfect. Spotlessly clean and exactly as described. Great location and very central.
Thank you so much Anna. We will be back and will definitely be recommending you to our friends.
What a fabulous place - you won’t be disappointed!! The staff are really helpful and do everything to make your stay in Porto first class.

A great apartment for a large group who want to be centrally located within east walking reach of the main sights, shops, bars and restaurants of Porto.
Super clean and comfortable as well as being stylish - would throughly recommend and would stay again when with friends in Porto.

Stayed with 7 friends. Great common area! Awesome view from the balcony. 2 rooms had ensuite bathrooms that we had to share between everyone (although one didnt have a door separating it drom the room...) 3rd fully communal bathroom was very small and fairly uncomfortable.
No major complaints. We really enjoyed our time here!!
We had a great stay here (4 friends). Location was perfect. all the other reviews I read before booking are fair. We especially liked the communal space.
Great place in a center of Porto, close to everything yet off the busy street so quite and no noise. Great decor and overall space
Absolutely loved our stay. The apartment is in a brilliant location. Loved the view of the river as it is a top floor apartment. Porto is stunning. Just wish we could have stayed longer.
My family and I loved our stay at this beautiful and spacious apartment! Beautiful views, very walkable, wonderful host - could not recommended more!!

The apartment is in a great location. Check in was easy with very good communication from property management. The apartment was a nice size for our group of 5. The apartment could use some touch up - walls are scuffed and some of the furniture has minor tears - but there was nothing that negatively impacted our stay.
We had a great stay! The host was very responsive, space was clean and comfortable, and the location was a perfect starting point to explore a lot of the city.

The property managers were incredibly responsive and attentive to our needs. The place is centrally located with lots to do nearby. Our friends and I loved staying here and we would highly recommend it for your stay in Porto!
Great place to stay with everything you need to make it easier. Great location with lots of really cool bars and lovely restaurants.

The apartment is in a great location and all the sites are within walking distance. its a very spacious apartment and a lovely Mexican restaurant a couple of doors away.
The street is a busy street but with two sets of double glazed windows it didn't make any difference.
Communication with Maria was great and even though our flight was delayed there was somebody there to meet us.

This is a great, stylish apartment and was perfect for my wife and I for a weekend away. It is situated in a very nice area with lots of restaurants and bars around, and an excellent coffee shop just a 100m away (very important for us!). Despite the activity around the apartment it was extremely peaceful and quiet. Will definitely be back. Thank you to Maria and the team!

Loved our stay in Porto and this apartment was fabulous!
10/10 for location - very fun and lively area - however, the owners have ensured you can get a peaceful night’s rest thanks to the very awesome double x double glazed windows and blinds.
The area is central and buzzing with activity - easy to get to anywhere you need to go with lots of lovely restaurants and bars in waking distance. The apartment is spacious, light, comfortable, has good remote working space, a comfortable decent-sized bed, a great bathroom and all the amenities you need. There is a lift which is great for luggage.
Our host,Sylvia was wonderful, responsive and accommodating and I highly recommend this apartment.
Amazing apartment in the best location in Porto. Great hosts and lovely neighborhood with many restaurants.  Highly recommended!!!

We loved staying in this apartment. It was walkable to all of the main sites but still had a neighborhood feel. The host was responsive, and we had everything we needed for a great couple days in Porto.
Beautiful and comfortable apartment in the heart of the city. Walkable to everything including restaurants, shops, the beach, and monuments! We loved our stay.

This apartment I chose to live in Porto for two months  has everything I wanted for comfort. The south façade provides a wonderful light in the apartment and from the balcony it is possible to see the landscaped and wooded spaces of the neighboring backyards that give an excellent environmental quality to the place – every day I practiced yoga contemplating this beautiful view. The address is next to the Faria Guimarães station, which connects to the other subway lines that serve the city, so it was easy to go to work or for leisure on the weekends. Preparing meals was a huge pleasure as the kitchen has exceptional functionality. The apartment has an intelligent proportion of spaces with cupboards that provide organization to the place. On sunny days, the heat that enters the room is enough to keep the apartment warm. However, on cloudier rainy days this does not occur due to the lack of direct sunlight, for this reason I recommend that the host provide a heater for the apartment.

We loved the stay, modern and clean. Air con was a life saver with how hot it was. Had a nice view balcony with electric shutters. We also loved that there was Netflix and Disney+ for the evenings. Host was also very friendly and responsive. Thank you.

The apartment is clean, well-equipped, and recently renovated. It is located in a nice and quiet neighborhood. There is a metro station right across the apartment and the main sights, restaurants, and stores are within walking distance. The hosts were proactive and responsive, and provided us with helpful information.

Daniel's apartment was one of the best Airbnb flats we have stayed in! The attention to detail was spot on and as my husband is a builder he commented on a few things that may not be noticed by everyone eg the magnetic locks on the internal doors, the automatic lights in the bedroom cupboards and the quality marble finishings. And then there's the terrific location close to the river and within walking distance of all the sites  and restaurants, and a private carpark which was a prerequisite for us. As an earlier reviewer said  'If you see this apartment available, just book it!'

We had the pleasure of staying in Daniel's apartment for over 3 wonderful weeks. The apartment is perfect, it's spacious, tastefully furnished and has everything needed for a comfortable stay. It is also well located with lots of restaurants and cafes within walking distance. The apartment is located at the back of the building so it's very quiet.
We have stayed in many Airbnb properties around the world and Daniel's property is one of the very best.
Daniel is an exceptional host. He deserves 10 stars, not 5! He is super responsive, helpful and friendly. Thank you Daniel.
If you're going to Porto this apartment is the place to stay. Bring your walking shoes and explore beautiful Porto.

Probably one of the best AirBnb experiences I have ever had.
Super responsive host, excellent location, and spotless accomodations. I asked for multiple extensions and they were given without question. The maid service that was requested was also excellent.
Highly recommend a stay here.

This was one of the nicest places we’ve stayed our entire trip in Portugal. The place was spotless and I’m picky when it comes to staying at other places, but it was very clean so I felt comfortable.
The washer and dryer was really nice to have because we’ve been traveling for 20 days and needed to wash clothes. The apartment’s location is walkable to great restaurants and historical downtown Porto! What a perfect location! It was super peaceful and quiet at night even though it’s in the heart of the city. I 100% recommend this place.
No air conditioner, was very heat at night, and was bitten by mosquitoes. Couldn’t really sleep.

Beautiful location to stay if you visit Porto! It was quite convenient to walk to locations that were on my bucket list, and take a stole around the strip every evening to watch the river! Very Safe neighborhood! Diana was such a lovely host, she responded quickly to messages and was very polite. Definitely will be staying here again next time  I visit Porto!
Very good ! It’s clean, but above all the hosts are listening to us! I had a great experience with this accommodation. I can only recommend it :)
The apartment was just like on the pictures, nice, clean and located right in the center of Porto. Best place to stay, I recommend it to everyone. :)

Perfect place and location. It is quiet even though it’s on a Main Street. It was a bit hot but once the windows were open and the fan was turned on it was cool enough. The place is clean and has what you need. The best part is the private outdoor space. Communication was great. We used the airport service and it was so easy and nice. I would recommend this place for sure!

Carolina’s place is the perfect place to stay in Porto. It’s central location means everything is just a walk away but it’s surprisingly peaceful and quiet when inside the apartment. Everything is so well equipped and Carolina was extremely helpful in her regular messages and updates. I could not recommend this place enough!

This was an excellent apartment. The location couldn't have been better, right in the heart of an area full of shops and restaurants, but it was very quiet once you were inside. Porto is compact enough that you can walk everywhere from here - all the top attractions. I would definitely recommend staying here and we liked Porto so much we will probably be back.

The location couldn't have been better and the winter garden + terrace made for a great space to work remotely for two people. Communication was always clear and quick and we felt very well looked after. We would definitely stay here again!
Bright, clean, lovely apartment with a private courtyard in a great location. Will definitely stay here again!

The location is ideal for anyone who wants to be right in the heart of Porto. It’s very vibrant and busy with loads of restaurant options literally steps away. But once inside the apartment, the hustle and bustle outside is barely noticeable and you can relax on the beautiful private patio. Carolina was great and super responsive as well!

This is a beautiful apartment in a fantastic location in Porto. Check in was really easy and we had great communication with Carolina throughout our stay who even helped us find somewhere to store our baggage on our last day. We would definitely book this apartment again!
Beautiful home with great patio space right in the most central location. The host was very kind and responsive. Would recommend to stay.

This was a great stay. It was easy to find and very comfortable. It’s a beautiful studio located near a lot of restaurants. It was pretty quiet inside at night even though its on a busy street. It does get humid but there was a fan to help keep cool. The bed is kind of soft if you prefer a firm mattress. I enjoyed my stay.

Wonderful location in the middle of it all but super quiet inside the flat! Super comfortable bed and amazing patio to enjoy wine and relax after a day of walking! Kitchen had everything I needed to cook a few gourmet Portuguese meals! The fans were a plus as it was hot a day or two but they made it comfortable. Fantastic place to stay!
absolutely lovely place, extremely pretty and cozy. super central location with plenty to do nearby. would 100% recommend!! responsive and helpful host

Carolina’s place was perfect for what I needed while I was staying in Porto. The studio was clean, spacious, and had plenty of natural lighting. I wouldn’t hesitate to book with Carolina again, would definitely recommend

We stayed here for three night. The acommodation was just as described and the location was ideal to explore from. Caroline was very proactive in giving us recommendations a d responding to any messages. I would definately stay here again next time we come to Porto.

We loved our stay at Carolina's apartment. The flat was clean, spacious, and exactly as described. The apartment itself is in a great location in the centre of town and it was easy to find with great transport links.
Carolina was proactive, friendly and informative, and was always quick to respond.
We would highly recommend this apartment!

Carolina truly deserves more than a 5-star recommendation! She is friendly and responds promptly. The apartment is charming, and boasts a lovely balcony. Our time in Porto was truly delightful. I am already looking forward to returning and staying in Carolina's apartment again!

This apartment is perfectly situated in Porto. Carolina is a very nice host, and was quick to respond to any questions that I had. The check on process was super easy and hassle free. The apartment was clean and so very cute. I loved my stay here. I will definitely be back whenever I visit Porto again, and I recommend this place to others as well.
Right in the center of activity, but amazingly not noisy once you were inside. Clean, cute terrace. Great for two.
Adriana’s place was perfect for our stay. Great location, had everything we needed and an awesome terrace to enjoy. Would love to return.
Very clean, safe, and near many attractions! I would recommend to any friend. The host is very responsive to messages as well. Love it!!!

We couldn't have chosen a better place to stay in Porto. The flat was just as described and in a perfect location to explore this beautiful city.  Check-in was easy and from booking until our stay ended Adriana was always super helpful ad prompt to respond if we needed anything. We would absolutely be back!
the flat was in a great location and very quiet at night despite being in the heart of the city. there was very little hot water and we never got enough for a shower.

Beautiful place and a fantastic location. We only stayed two nights, but we wanted to stay a lot longer just because of the comfort and beauty of the home. Nice patio and views as well. Easy to walk anywhere from there.

It is an amazing Portuguese apartment with everything you need and even more. The area is perfect for walking and exploring Porto, all  attractions are very close to reach. Adriana gave us a list of useful recommendations of attractions and places to eat and drink. We really enjoyed our stay and next time will definitely return to this cozy place. Thank you, Adriana!

Adriana’s place was wonderful! The location was absolutely amazing with it being close to the water as well as near a Spar and restaurants and a wine store. The apt is a close walk to/from the train station. The apt is on the 4th floor so there are some shares. There is an elevator but we didn’t use or try it. Check in was super easy and we got lucky that we could check in early too. Would definitely stay there again.

We stayed at Adriana's place during our trip to Porto
It's perfectly located. It's clean, well furnished. The terrace is a nice bonus!
Will obviously stay again!

Great location, clean space, and host was very prompt with communication! We were worried that it might be loud because there was a fair bit of nearby construction during our stay, but the apartment itself was impressively quiet.

Adriana’s place was exactly as described and a perfect position for Porto. While it was close to restaurants and bars it was still quiet in the apartment. If we were to return to Porto, we would certainly stay there again.

This is an amazing place if you want to be close to the center of Porto but benefiting from all benefits Vila Nova de Gaia has offer.
Göran prepared everything nicely. Everything was clean and the room tidy.
The shower has a very good pressure.
communication was outstanding and we received a lot of tipps and hints what to do and visit.
would definitely recommend staying here.

Göran is the perfect host.
His airbnb is close to the city center, perfectly clean every day (at least twice a day) and he has all the informations you need.
(City map, books about Portugal, secrets places ...)
I hope i'll have the chance to meet again with Göran.

We had a wonderful stay at Göran’s place. It was very clean, cosy and on a great location. He gave us a lot of great recommendations things that we must see in Porto and some of his favourite local restaurants.
About Göran, he was very kind and communicative, hope some day we can visit again.
Göran had a map for us with handwritten recommendations. Every suggestion was very nice and enhanced our time in Porto. Everything was very clean (he cleans the shared bathroom twice a day!)

The stay at Göran's was great, the room and bathroom were clean and good furnished.  The location is great and the terrace has a beautiful view.  And Göran is a super nice and helpful, he made our experience in Porto much better ❤. I would definitely recommend this guest house!

We can only recommend staying in Göran‘s beautiful AirBnB.
With everything freshly renovated, it’s super clean and nice.
We‘ve had the chance to go to the top terrace, as it is normally reserved for the upper apartment but as there was no one in it, we could go upstairs as well and had the best view above Porto!
Göran was very friendly and caring and gave many many tips for our stay. Don’t mind asking him, he knows his city!
Thank you Göran,
Lena and Sara
A pleasant stay - perfect location and comfortable room! Göran is very thoughtful and professional host. Would absolutely recommend!

Memorable stay!
Göran was super friendly and helpful. Absolutely loved all his reccomendations.
Thank you for such a warm and pleasant welcome.
I Hope to come back soon!
Thank you again Göran!

This cozy accommodation is run by one of the kindest person in the world. Situated between the Douro River Promenade and the Morro Park at the Luis Bridge its very central. The owner Göran is running the accommodation with all his heart. He takes time to explain everything and giving tips where you get good food with good atmosphere. The accommodation itself is very clean and quiet, the beds are good. Go there you won't regret the stay. We loved it and made Porto even better for us. We recommend to stay at this guesthouse. Thank you Göran for wonderful stay.
Fantastic stay at Göran’s guest house. He is a very friendly host with lots of local recommendations. The location is great and very walkable to central Gaia and Porto.
Göran was an amazing host. He is very friendly and communicative. His place is in an excellent location having some amazing views. Highly recommend staying here for your next visit to Porto.
Really enjoyable stay at Goran's place. Beautiful location, and he was helpful, friendly and responsive at all times.

Top spot to stay a few days in Porto..  while being 'on the other side' of Porto, in Vila Nova de Gaia, where you get the best port and everything seems a bit more relaxed, it is still located very central, and the walk over the bridge every you go 'home' is simply amazing. Göran is a very nice and friendly guy, taking great care  of his guests, and providing helpful tips for bars or where to hang out for a good Fado night. I very much recommend this place, and will come back here upon my return. Obrigado, Göran!

We loved Ana's place, it was clean easily accessible! In the center of everything. The washing machine in the apartment really helped us as we were traveling for a while so it's hard to find time to do laundry.

It was amazing too stay in their apartment. I think it would be even better for a romantic couple. 😁 enjoyed my time after bunk bed galore. And you could play your own music and play tour own movie. Which is really nice.

Perfect location. Right in the heart of the city center. We had a few issues with our car and parking, but that is expected in such a bustling city. João was extremely helpful with ideas about how to resolve our issue.

Just 10 mins from Sao Bento station and in the heart of the Old Town Porto, Sundari Studio is a comfortable, well situated , spotlessly clean place to stay. Most importantly the oversized bed and sofa bed were very comfortable. With all amenities to self cater if desired, restaurants and cafe on your doorstep, buses and trains within 10 mins walk it has been an ideal place to stay.
Word of warning ! Many streets in old town are very steep, with some precarious cobbles. As a 70 yr old woman who needs a walking stick it was a challenge but so worth it.

We had an excellent stay. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. The place is in a great location, walkable to anywhere you need. Nuno was very helpful and always responsive. Would recommend this to anyone, and would definitely stay there again.

Lola & Nuno's place was exactly what we were looking for. Central, clean, and all the amenities. Be aware of the numerous flights of stairs, but you can't beat the location.
I will definitely be staying here again whenever I find myself in Porto.

perfect location. San bento 1 minutes by walking. Even it is located in center of the town, very quiet and peaceful.
good sleep, drink wine and beer at the dinning table was absolutely romantic.
I love this Nuno' beautiful house.
Thank you !!!
Lovely apartment very close to good restaurants and 2 supermarkets and a 10-15 minute walk to most of the main sights.   Hosts very accommodating!

This was the best checkin of any Airbnb. They helped us get to the place. They showed us on a map how to get to all of the main attractions. They are super responsive to any questions. Very kind and lovely people. The place is very clean, easy to get in and out of, and has comfortable beds. If you are a light or early sleeper you might have a hard time, but we loved the location and busyness of the square. It is a fantastic location with amazing food options just outside the door. (FYI It’s a one floor walk up.)

Great spot on top of the hill with all of the creature comforts. We stayed for 6 nights and loved it.
Achilleas was friendly, prompt, and thorough with check-in and communication.
We recommend!
Great location, near plenty of restaurants, bars, and attractions.  A/C works perfectly and the apartment is well appointed.  easy check in and out.  will definitely stay here again.

Brilliant location and apartment.
Communication was fantastic and the owners couldn't have done more to help us. It was the perfect base for me to explore Porto.

Wonderful, renovated building. The apartment was well furnished, clean, and the hosts quickly responsive with any needs. We found the location great. It was away from the big crowds and noise of the main tourist areas yet in easy walking distance of many sights, restaurants, and interesting attractions.
Lovely apartment, fantastic location, with everything you need for a few days stay to explore the city! ❤️

Brilliant stay!
The flat is in a beautiful model complex in a quiet back street which makes it very peaceful, even with the windows open.
The flat itself is gorgeous, clean, and very spacious. Although I would not recommend using it while you’re visiting such a beautiful city, having Netflix is a nice addition too 😊
Would definitely recommend and stay here again for my next visit.

Our stay was wonderful! I totally recommend this place your are with in a short distance to all the main attractions.
It’s located in amazing quiet area, with amazing restaurants and local stores!

Host was fantastic at communicating, the property was beautiful and very well maintained, and the location is brilliant. You can reach everything important within 10 minutes, but still have amazing places to eat and drink on your doorstep.
We really loved our stay at this Airbnb - it was clean and modern and spacious! Super easy communication with the host too.

I really enjoyed my stay in this apartment. It felt cozy, private and safe, was close to many tourist attractions yet a little quieter and without the touristy feel. I loved having the space the apartment offered and communication from the hosts was excellent. Would definitely stay again.

This is an apartment where one could live in. Very elegant and very walkable to sites and reataurants
Luxury hotels are not as upacale as this!!

This flat was nothing but amazing.
The location was perfect!!!
Everything looks brand new and the kitchen is really well equipped. The host was great and the lock box for check in/check out was quite handy.
I would definitely stay there again!!

We had such a lovely time at the apartment and in Porto. It is extremely conveniently located. Although currently (Aug 2022) the road it's on is closed due to metro construction, it makes it a very quiet street, even if you have to add on 5 mins to your travels to and from the apartment!
We had everything we needed in the apartment and were very grateful to our host for their great communication.
thank you
Really lovey place to stay. In an amazing location, walkable to everywhere include main train station, would not think twice about booking here again when we return to Porto

Perfect base for exploring Porto. Only 15 min walk from the main metro station and historic Porto. Despite being only a couple of streets away from the lively bars it was a quiet street with no noise from the nearby metro building work. Nice modern flat with all amenities and a fab brunch spot right next door.

Perfect location. Everything is easily reachable. Bedroom was quiet, in the living area you heard the typical
street noise. Easy communication with the host.

This appartment did not disappoint . Centrally located , down a quiet road with easy access to all of Porto with 2 fabulous breakfast cafe's  literally next door. The appartment was very clean and much bigger than expected with a great use of the space . The mattress was so confortable we had some great nights sleep after sightseeing. Would totally recommend and definitely stay when visiting Porto again . Have already recommended to family and friends !

The apartment is spacious and beautifully furnished. The location is very central and yet the noise doesn't carry to the apartment which was very quiet. Amazing brunch restaurant below with lots of other places nearby. Comfy bed. Great value.

This place was beautiful! And after seeing Porto I wish I had stayed longer in this city. The place is exactly as described, and I would dare to say it is even prettier in person. The bed was comfortable, the view of the balcony was cute, the place was quiet, and the location was perfect. It is near a lot of places to visit and restaurants to eat. Highly recommend this place.
Lovely apartment! Looks exactly like the pictures and is close to everything you would want to see in Porto.

Lovely experience can't complaint at all.
Thank you for the help provided when we forgot ours keys inside.
All the best success to you.
It was a pleasure to stay in this apartment! Minimalist but very functional and elegant design. Thanks for the good responsiveness.

The apartment was fantastic and the location can't be beat! It was very spacious and comfortable. Virginie was phenomenal and extremely responsive. We got locked out (we forgot the keys inside) and she arranged for the situation to be solved with an extremely chilled attitude! Highly recommended.

The apartment was absolutely perfect for the four nights I had to myself in Porto.
Fantastic location right in the centre of town, everything was incredibly clean and the space itself makes you feel right at home. It also had the comfiest bed I have ever slept in.
Only thing to keep in mind is the street below is quite noisy (which is fair due to the location) though you can barely hear a thing when the windows are shut.

Perfectly located, clean and comfortable. Host was kind and quick to respond to any of our questions. I recommend 100%.
On a side note the Do Norte Café right beside the appartment is a MUST. We went there two mornings in a row and it is just perfect. Staff is very friendly and the food is amazing.
The location can't be beetter, would definitely go here again!  Spacious and clean.
We had a pleasant stay. It was very clean, the neighborhood was great, and communication with the host was easy.
Wonderful place! Well designed, extremely clean, comfortable, and well-located. Also excellent check in and communication. Highly recommended.

A perfect apartment in the heart of Porto, exactly as described and located on a quiet street in the centre of Porto. Short walk to many attractions, bars, restaurants etc. would happily stay here again. Thanks!

The location is great and the apartment gets a lot of sunlight. The TV has English channels too and the kitchen has the basic stuff you may need.
As others have written, the bathroom is really small and because the shower curtain is too short the floor always gets wet. Also the wifi only worked sometimes
