The place was clean and in a good condition. Very fast response for help and a nice Team.
I really recommend this place.
The bed ist big and comfortable, the view is nice at night because the music hall is literally in front of the building on this side and you can reach a lot of places by walking.

We used the space as a hub to explore Porto as well as some of the surrounding towns. It was just the two of us and it worked perfect. It is right next-door to a parking garage where you can park your car with unlimited access day and night, just be aware it does lock at midnight. It’s surrounded by great cafés and very close to a few grocery stores. It’s about 10-15 minutes by car into the historic Ribeira/city as well as out of Porto. The suite had everything we needed and was clean, the host was very responsive and we would happily book again.

I loved my stay in Cedofeita, such a great area and apartment. The apartment itself was perfect for me. Spacious, exactly like the pictures, great communication, flexibility, internet, cleanliness. I stayed for just over a month alone and was extremely comfortable and felt super safe in the apartment and area. Thank you for a great stay. I would love to come back!

Had an amazing stay for a solo female traveler who wanted to have a quiet, private and convenient place during 4 days in Porto. The apartment is well-equipped with everything you need, very responsive host and I did sleep very well. Thank you so much and I would love to stay here once again if I ever come visit Porto in the future :) Highly recommended!
Good apartment, nice communications with host. Could be a little bit noisy on the street at evening.
Would definitely recommend for anyone visiting - especially large groups. Luna was very communicative and accommodating. Would highly recommend.
Great hospitality by the hosts, check-in and check-out was smooth. The location of the apartment is perfect in the middle of the city with everything around. Absolutely recommendable!
Wonderful old historic building with lots of character in a very central location. Owners were very responsive and friendly. Their home was full of thoughtful little touches. We highly recommend!

Great location for a stroll around the old town of Porto!
Luna was very helpful and such a great host.
The house is beautiful. However, is a historic old building made with granite stone and as you can imagine is a bit cold inside specially now at winter time as expected.
The house has all amenities described and fits up to 4 ppl.
We really enjoyed Porto and our Stay at Casa de pedra!
Thanks for having us

Perfect location. Walking distance from a lot of attractions. Bakeries and restaurants in the vicinity. The street was quiet at night. We stayed here in the winter; the apartment was a bit humid. But dehumidifiers and a heater were provided.

We loved every minute we were in Porto and it was even more helpful with staying at Lunas location. We had the top floor and it was fantastic, warm and beautiful. When we come back to Porto we will stay here again.

Nice apartment in central historic district close to transportation, restaurants, points of interest.  At the bottom of the street there is a great location to take in the views of Porto, particularly at night.
Great place in the middle of Porto. Very central. Great apartment for a visit to the city. I would highly recommend.

Excellent service, clean apartment, and just super fast communication. The apartment was even cleaned and tidied during the stay at no extra cost. We were amazed. The hosts are super friendly, the apartment itself was brilliantly designed and everything is top modern. We were also not aware of what a top location we had. The apartment is right in the center, and restaurants and attractions are within walking distance.

The location is super convenient and the staff are enthusiastic and friendly. They create a group for contact and they offer every information I need with some traveling advice. The room is big with good view so you can enjoy sunshine in the balcony. If I back Porto I will definitely choose them again. Nice experience and thx for hosting!

Fantastic location right next to Clerigos tower And 5–10 minute walk to all the main sites. Right in the hustle and bustle of Porto with Tram line going straight underneath the balcony. Only downside to the central location is the noise at night but this is to be expected.

This apartment was perfectly centrally located with a gorgeous view of the church. Everything was within walking distance which made our stay care. The place was kept really well and check in was a breeze. We highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto either for a weekend stay or longer!

Centrally located and a beautiful apartment- check in was easy and the hosts were very communicative. I found it the perfect stop to drop by or drop off souvenirs while exploring Porto. Sometimes a little loud in the evening, but just because it’s in a busy area.
Fantastic location and a lovely little flat. Great balcony. Did not find it too noisy at all either

A fantastic location - that alone gets 10/10. Clean and lovely place. The sound isolation for the windows could of been a bit better, but overall an amazin place!
Would definitely recommend!
Very easy stay, central location. Good communication from host, and easy checkin instructions. Would recommend!! (Load at night with street noises, so make sure you bring earplugs)

The place is a bit smaller than it looked on the photos, we were three girls and it was quite difficult to arrange all our stuff. The location is perfect and the host answered really fast to all of our questions:)
Carla is the perfect host, very sympatic and helpful. The apartment is really pretty and it is in very beautiful neighbourhood. Porto was amazing! Loved it.

Carla's apartment was cozy and super clean.  The location is close to the Douro River with walkable options to restaurants and touristy stuff (Super Block Arena has one of the best views of the river).  A 20min walk North, gets you to Mercado Bom Sucesso indoor market with plenty of dinning options and Continente Bom Dia Bom Sucesso supermarket.  A 30min walk East, gets you to the city center and even across the Luis I Bridge where I took an electrical bike tour through Airbnb.  There are trolly stops close to the apartment, but I found it easier to walk everywhere.  Carla responded quickly to any questions and even offered parking suggestions as I had rented a car.  And, I didn't let the crisp March air stop me from having morning coffee on her lovely balcony!  Highly recommended!!
Excellent location, very close to many restaurants, cafes, bars, and super market. The check in was super easy and Carla was quick to respond and give tips on getting around. Great stay overall!

The whole experience from booking, communication the stay itself was absolutely perfect. Carla was a great host, the self check in was really easy and instructions were clear, couldn't be better! The apartment was spotless, comfortable and very quiet. The location was just a short walk from amenities and we had everything we needed. It was great wandering back from the hustle n' bustle of Ribeira each night to a lovely peaceful apartment. Would 100% love to stay here again and fully recommend this wonderful apartment, look no further, you've found a real gem :) xxx

Carla’s place was a lovely base for our visit to porto, positioned next to a gorgeous old church and close to the river front -
It was only a 20 minute walk to the centre of town.
Amazing value for money and Carla was so responsive and helpful, only real problem we had was the A/C became really really loud at points in the night, disturbing our sleep a little.
Thank you so much for our stay Carla!
great place! very clean and welcoming. right by the river, great location. my girlfriend and I enjoyed ourselves a lot! thank you for the accomodation!

Beautiful apartment with anything you could possibly need. It is a stylish new and modern apartment. Very quiet and relaxing location. It is very close to the river so nice walks close by as well as several very good restaurants. Definitely recommend in Porto. The host Carla was always responsive and gave very good recommendations the area.

Carla’s place was fabulous, great location just near the Douro River, walkable to all the things you want to see, very comfortable to stay in and Carla is very helpful when you need anything, we enjoyed our 1 week stay and would recommend highly

Carla was so kind and helpful. As a solo female traveler, I was looking for a safe place in a great location. This was perfect for those requirements! Also, Carla went above and beyond to help me and communicate with me during my stay. Instructions were clear and through. She even ordered me a taxi for my early morning flight. The apartment was beautiful, clean, and peaceful. It was a wonderful stay!

This apartment was well located for restaurants and sightseeing. But finding it wasn't easy as no actual street number appears in the advert!
We had to call our host, who came immediately and helped us get in. She was also most helpful in making a dinner reservation close by for us.

This place is perfect for access to the center of Porto while still enjoying a peaceful place to come back to. It is fully stocked and the host is responsive. Beautiful apartment, you won’t be disappointed!
Great stay in Porto, lots to do in the area.  We loved having the balcony/windows over the street.  Close to attractions and restaurants.  Host communication was great.

We enjoyed our stay at Luna’s place. It would be best for a stay in the warmer months— two small space heaters were provided for supplemental heat which was definitely needed, but we could only turn them up part way without shorting the electricity in the unit. It’s in a good area near lots of great eats and green space. It’s a nice space at a good price, particularly if you’re not planning on spending too much time hanging out at the apartment.

A comfortable stay in a great location. Nice local restaurants. Supermarket and breakfast cafe.
Carla made the trip easy and all the more enjoyable.

We had a lovely stay at Carla’s apartment. Communication with the host was amazing, everything was explained well and they were very attentive responding to any questions we had or anything we needed. The location is lovely as it is by the river. It is a 25min walk into the main area of Porto which we didn’t mind as we walk a lot but something to bear in mind for those who don’t. Couldn’t fault how clean and spacious the apartment was, would recommend.

Carla is great host. You can see and feel that is is experienced and knows what she is doing :)
Communication is duper easy, fast and friendly. I always felt - Carla is by our side ;)
Room is extremely clean.
Paintings are amazing!

We loved our stay at Carla’s apartment. The location was quiet and a 20 minute walk to the centre, but lovely to be near the river and close to transport and amenities.
The apartment was modern ,clean , bright and well furnished . Good to have use of the little balcony .
Nice touches, like good quality toiletries supplied in the bathroom .
Many thanks Carla !
We had a great stay in this apartment, very clean and tidy, and easy to commute to other parts of the city. Our host, Carla, was very helpful with any questions we had. We would absolutely recommend!

This is indeed a stylish and beautifully appointed apartment!  We highly recommend it!  It is extremely clean with everything you need.  The terrace was a great spot to start the morning with coffee.  The location is excellent.  Far enough away from the crowds of the busy historic district but close enough to walk there in 20 minutes.  It was also very easy to get to the beach by the historic tram along the river.  Carla is an excellent host!  She is friendly, responsive, and communicative.  We had an issue with the door lock on arrival day, and she had it fixed immediately that day.  She also provided excellent restaurant recommendations.  We particularly enjoyed an oceanfront lunch at Lapa Lapa based on her recommendation.  Thank you, Carla!

Had a wonderful stay in Porto! The hosts were very friendly and were quick to respond to questions/requests. The location was great as it is located away from the busiest parts of town but still plenty of restaurants and attractions within walking distance. Will definitely stay again when we come back!

Convenient location - easily accessible to train station and main metro stations.  It is up at top of hill so a walk from the riverside.  Try e place is spacious and quiet and clean. Worked perfectly for the three of us.
Great stay right in the heart of Porto. Small but comfortable aparmtent with easy access and easy rechability. Super quick answers by the host just made this experience even better.
We felt very much at home! Very quiet and small but cute. In the middle of the city and you can do a lot around there. Also very clean, small kitchen but it has everything in it.

They are excellent hosts, very friendly and willing to assist you with whatever you need. The place is very comfortable, clean and tidy and its location is perfect for visiting the tourist spots in Porto. I highly recommend staying in this place.

Luna's apartment is located near the university in the historic old town section of Porto. The apartment and building itself is unique and is typical of an early 20th century living accommodation in Porto.  It is located on the 3rd floor with several flights of stairs. so if you have mobility issues this is not the accommodation for you. That said, Luna offers visitors a true and memorable Porto experience.

We really enjoyed our stay at Luna & Joao's place. The apartment is located in a monumental building, very close to the metro, restauranta and the main street for night life. The Douro river and historic centre is just few mins away. Luna is very responsive and helpful with local recommendations. The apartment itself has plenty of space and multiple choices to sleep, as there are many beds. Perfect for a short stay in Porto!
Luna’s place is perfect for travelers that are looking for a location in the middle of the action in Porto. It has a ton of historical charm.
Great location in Porto. Walkable distance to many historic sites and key attractions. The apartment was clean. Host is friendly and very responsive and cleared up any questions in a timely manner.
Lovely apartment in a great location in Porto- a really good place from which to explore the city with our two young daughters.
The location is really great, right at the heart of the city ! The house was clean and the host was super friendly and responsive
The apartment was in a fantastic location in the center of town. Everything looked exactly as it did in the photos. We would stay again 😊

Great place. D&S Smart Housing, the company that hosts this property, is right next door. We got there early and they were happy to hold our luggage for the day. They were also very helpful in guiding us around the city. We had a fantastic stay

The location and the view were spectacular. The Wi-Fi was pretty good too. Unfortunately, that’s where the good stops. The space is tiny! And I don’t mean by American standards. If you are a solo traveler, it would make sense. There is barely enough room to move around.
Also, while the space is outfitted well, they don’t provide anything for you use. Has a washing machine but won’t give you detergent to wash clothes. Same with dishwasher detergent, a couple of coffee machine capsules, and no shampoo or conditioner. I cannot recommend this place.
We really liked our stay! Nice place nice view! Clean and easy little appartment!  Everything you need for a short stay in porto!

The good - great location, amazing view, good price. The studio was small but cozy and well equipped, we had everything we needed. Julieta was very quick to respond to messages and did everything she could to help us solve the problems below.
The not so good - we had problems with door locks two times in three hours, and based on some of the recommendations the hosts were aware that one of the doors/locks doesn’t always work properly.
First we couldn’t lock the studio on the way out and had to wait 45 minutes for someone to arrive so we could go to dinner. When we came back the lock on the main entrance (different lock) wouldn’t let us in and we had to stand outside in the rain for an hour.
Two small additional things - the bed is a bit short for tall people, and the bathroom is very loud when you use water (probably a sewage pump?)
Absolutely lovely! Our host went above and beyond. Absolutely wonderful flat with so much to see within walking distance!! Would definitely recommend.

We had such a lovely stay here! A beautiful space, that’s in a great location in Porto city. Great for a couple, and good value for money. We have no complaints, or issues, but just a heads-up for future travellers that when we went (start of July) it was super hot. This Airbnb was a perfect place to come home to, and as an escape from the heat.

Amazing apartment. Amazing interior design and functionality. Everything was very clean and the location was close to everything we wanted to see in Porto…we could walk everywhere. The host was super friendly and helpful. Would recommend this place for sure!
Absolutely loved Porto Class.  Jin was very helpful to us both in planning our visit, and in answering any questions we had during the visit.  The place was very modern.  We loved it.  Perfect!
Amazing place, very clean and the location was perfect. Would definitely recommend it to anyone. 5/5

We loved staying here! Jin was super responsive and helpful and gave us all the information we needed to check in and also recs around Porto. The place is decorated so nicely and is the perfect space for 2 people. Everything was so clean, and the huge projector with Netflix was a nice bonus. Would definitely come back!!
Thank you for the great stay ! The flat is really nice and corresponds well to the photos. The host is also available by message and very helpful if needed :)

Everything went great. Nice and cosy apartment. The flexible check in made our lives so much easier! Jin was very nice and a great help. The bed was a bit too hard, but this was the only negative thing I could think of. Definitely recommend!

Beautiful apartment, great location, exactly as described and super clean! The host was so lovely and welcoming and sent us extremely clear instructions on how to get in and how everything works, and he replied super quickly too. Also sent us many recommendations which was lovely. There’s a super market 5 minute walk, and a station 5 minute walk too. 20 minute walk to the beautiful river. overall brilliant experience, loved our stay and felt at home. The projector is so great too, we loved it. Would definitely stay here again if I return to Porto. Thank you for a lovely stay
A very good apartment with convenient transportation and clean and tidy rooms. The landlord is also very friendly, communicates promptly, and provides many effective strategies.

My stay at the Porto Class was awesome.
Jin, the host, was incredibly courteous and always quick with responses. The house was not just clean, but it matched the pictures perfectly. The location was top-notch, making it a breeze to reach all the must-see places within a comfortable 20-minute radius. Getting from the airport to the house was a cinch thanks to a nearby train. The metro station was a hop, skip, and a jump away, taking less than 5 minutes to walk to. Convenience was the name of the game with shops and restaurants just around the corner. Check-in and check-out went off without a hitch. If I find myself in Porto again, I'd without a doubt book this place once more!

We had a lovely journey in this beautiful apartment !
The place is clean, modern and well decorated.
The bed was comfy, though it was a bit cold but our host had had prepared heating things for us.
Jin sent detailed instructions via photos and videos and even gave us some really good adresses !
We definitely recommend this place for an amazing trip in Porto !
See you soon :)
Very cozy and sweet room with nice decorations... We've passed a perfect holiday with this experience , the host has been very nice and welcoming,  thank you !! Truly recommended
A great stay! The host was very thorough with instructions and recommendations. The place was super clean and the bed was very comfortable. Easy to walk to nearby attractions.

Rui was an absolute fantastic host. As he gave us clear instructions from start to finish. This included some excellent recommendations for restaurants and places to visit.
Apartment was excellently located - a short walk from many amenities. The space itself had everything we needed - the projector was a great touch!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here (5 out of 5)!
Very clean, very new, and very convenient located close to the metro and the city center. Great communication!
What a fabulous stay we had at Julieta’s place. The view is amazing and the apartment has everything a couple needs for a short visit to Porto. Julieta is a top host. Would love to stay again.

Great location, just next to the beach. We had lovely long walks on the wooden promenade and also did some skating on the bicycle lines. Perfect for the total beginners that we are ;-).
Thanks Bruno and Andre.
PS: loved the dogs "Bruce" and Luna

We loved our stay in the Appartment.
The view is amazing. Very close to all the Portwine factories. The access to the apartment was really easy. All in all, Julieta was an amazing host.
We had such a great stay at Julieta’s! Close to everything, clean and just as the photos described it, and the view was the best!
The view is beautiful, and really worth it. The apartment is cozy, except for the water boiler that is a bit loud when you use the water, but nothing that I was not able to deal with.

Cute and compact apartment with a breathtaking view.  Close to port houses, restaurants and just a 15-20 minute walk to the city centre. The place had everything we needed for a 4 day stay. As it is on top of a hill with a steep incline, make sure to wear running shoes!

I have stayed in this property before and it is always my first choice when I visit Porto. In my opinion, this place is perfection. The view is unparalleled in the location is wonderful. It is a small apartment but it has everything and individual travel or a couple would need. I would highly recommend staying at this apartment and I look forward to doing so again in the near future.

Our stay in Porto was amazing! Jin was proactive in communication, and made checking in and out a breeze. The apartment was in a convenient location that was accessible to public transportation and convenient for days we wanted to walk. Would absolutely stay again!
Good location near the metro station and a short walk to the central area. The space was clean and practical.
It's a nice and clean appartment, perfectly located (near the river and near Sao Bento Station). The host Florinda is a very very friendly and helpful person. She made us feel really welcome.

I was warmly welcomed by Florinda. She explained everything I had to know about the city. The one-room apartment is simple but nice.
Can be a bit noisy due to the bar on the other side, but it's fine with earplugs. Wifi quality varies, sometimes not good enough for Video calls.

Place was very clean and a super convenient walking location to shopping and other restaurants. The day of check out we were also able to store our luggage to further explore the city which was unexpected and made this experience a lot better! I would recommend this place to people!

We spent a lovely week at Elisa and Andrés beachfront Airbnb. Communication was flawless and we were even welcomed with a complimentary bottle of Portugese wine which was a nice touch.
Once checked in, we had a slight issue with the loud noise coming from the pool pump and Elisa responded within minutes, sending her Father around to check it for us.
Location-wise, we chose this because it is right on the beach and it really is. You can hear the ocean from inside and see it from the windows. On a clear night the Sunset is sensational.
Elisa was super flexible with our check-in and check-out times, offering both an early check-in and later check-out to accommodate our travel plans which we were super thankful for.
All in all, a great trip, can highly recommend!
The accomodation was fantastic! Great location, close to train station, metro and supermarket. Susana & Pedro, thanks for the Fabolous experience!
Awesome place with everything you need, even for longer stays. Supermarkets and laundry nearby and not too long of a walk from central places. Would definitely stay again.

The accommodation  in the apartment was excellent. Thank you for the wine offered to us by the hosts upon our arrival. The house and the water were very warm. There were TVs and Netflix available. The location and the area was beautiful, quiet and well accessible. We would definitely choose it again.
Excellent location, clean property with everything one needs. Hosts were also quite responsive. Would stay again!
Great stay at this air bnb! Hosts were very responsive and helpful, good location - 10-15 min walk into town and 5 min walk to metro station!
Everything I needed and more, wonderful location and Pedro was super helpful. 10/10 would stay here again.
Very responsive host and helped with everything, the location is good and the apartment is very good and functional.
Nice, elegant, confortable apartment. Groceries and supermarkets in the closest nearby. The city center at about 15 min walking like the metro station. I was a very nice experience in Porto.

We had a very good stay at Pedro's flat. It is central, very close to the metro station but also only 15minute walk from all main attractions and the historical part of the city and the river. Places to eat and supermarket around. The place was clean and looked as the pictures.
Ana was a great host! The location was great, very close to a metro stop and with a lot of stores, bars and restaurants nearby. I completely recommend this stay!!
Ana was a very responsive host. Location is close to transit systems to get into Porto which is nice.

The location is very convenient, walk three to five minutes to the light rail, the room is clean and tidy. The disadvantage is that the landlord is not proficient in English, we found a local English proficient person on the street to help the translator to complete the communication. The room had no cooking oil and could not make simple fried eggs. We found myself on other floors and borrowed some cooking oil.

Wow what a great location! Could not ask for a better stay. Accommodations were as described! We would definitely come back again. Tomas provided timely responses with any questions we had including an adjustment for self check-in last minute. Would recommended to everyone!
Thank you!
This Airbnb was in the perfect location. It was walking distance to everything. It was super clean and the communication with the host was great. I highly recommend booking this Airbnb!

Brilliant location. Quiet with doors closed so great sleep. All new and beautifully designed
Highly recommended

Great place to stay! Very clean and safe.
Lots to do and with great restaurants around it.
Right in front of the metro, which was very easy and hassle-free to get to and from the airport.
Highly recommend!

The place is super convenient and right across from the train station. It is easy to find. The condition of the place look exactly like in the pictures. It is very new and clean. The elevator makes easy for us to transport luggages upstairs.
The only draw back is no luggage storage allow before check in time but the host has helped to have out room ready as early as possible. Will definitely come back for future stay. Thanks !

Great apartment.Great host.Everything was clean.The location was really good.The services were perfect.If i ever visit Porto again I’ll definitely choose that apartment and the same host.You made our holidays even better!

We enjoyed our stay at InBloom apartments - very centrally located so a good base to explore Porto but there is some noise which goes along with being so central (which we didn’t mind).
Clean and as described, lots of nice restaurants within a short walk, and the guest book with food and drink recommendations was appreciated.
We visited during the Sao João festival (which was a nice, but noisy surprise!). The hosts were kind enough to give us a noise warning in advance and the advice of “if you can’t beat them, join them”, which was heeded !🍻
We had some trouble with the apartment door on our first day - Tomás was brilliant and sorted it for us after work hours.
Would recommend!

Great stay with InBloom! Super clean, air conditioning worked great! The water pressure was good and we had plenty of hot water, the provided hair dryer was better than any hotel we stayed at and the one I brought. The location was fantastic it was easy to swing by and drop off items we bought and use our own restroom during the day rather than public ones. Truly a great space!
We enjoyed our stay. The hosts were very responsive, the place was clean and the location was great. Would recommend 😊
Very prime location, able to walk everywhere, very responsive host, and beautiful accommodation. I definitely recommend this residence for your stay.

Thank you to all at Bloom apartments for making our first stay in Porto easy ! The guy ( maintenance) in the apartment was super friendly and very helpful ( thank you )
It’s a very busy area but wilt in the apartment the noise wasn’t too bad

Beautiful apartment, and the hostess is very welcoming and friendly - she even left us cake wine and fresh fruit. The location is great and there are a lot of restaurants around . The problem was that the bed was not comfortable, and the water in shower are not warm enough.

What a beautiful and centric apartment. I absolutely love Claudia’s place, the apartment was just like the pictures on the website. I love the modern feel and how close to train stations, bus stop and restaurants around. Only down side I would it’s the noice, that walls are very thin, therefor you can hear clear the people next to you talking. If you have sensitive ear that could be an issue, thankfully I have a deep sleep so I don’t mind much. Thank you Claudia for the great communication loved your apartment.
We had a really nice stay in Porto. The appartment was really chill and cozy. Claudia is a really nice host.

Great, cozy apartment, perfect for two! We loved the location, many restaurants and shops around and pretty central as well. The place had good WiFi and everything we needed to cook and relax. Claudia and Ana were very kind and quick with responding whenever we had questions, and we had a lovely time! Definitely recommend :)
Anna has been super responsive all the time. The apartment had everything we needed and it was very easy to do the self check-in

this place everything you see on the pictures. but what you don't see is the squeaky floors and stomping neighbors above you. we were not able to sleep the entire week because it was loud, no quite or comfort because of it. we wouldn't stay here again because of this.

Great place with lots of restaurants and close to local attractions.  My only complaint is the bed is very hard, if you have joint problems it can be very painful to sleep on.  Also the walls are very thin and you will hear your upstairs neighbors every footsteps.  Other than those things, great place, very hospitable host!
Had a great stay at Claudia’s place - fantastic location, level of comfort, and attentive hosting. Would highly recommend!

The location and actual house are great. Claudia is an awesome host - super helpful and very responsive. Unfortunately the place wasn’t very clean when we got there, especially disappointing given the $60 cleaning fee. 2 of the towels were stained - despite clearly having been washed, there was a few pieces of hair on the toilet and around it, and the bathroom  faucet wasn’t cleaned. Bed also was SUPER soft, which maybe a great or terrible thing for you. Otherwise, it was a great place and suitable value.
We loved our stay here! The place was clean, it had everything we needed. Matched the photos and description. Very clean, easy check in, perfect location. Thank you so much!!! This is a Gem

A lovely little apartment, perfectly cosy for 2 people. Very close to some fabulous restaurants and most other key places in Porto, like the main metro station Trindade which provides direct links to the airport.

Perfect stay in Porto.
Very helpful with all enquiries
Very clean
And not far at all from restaurants and city centre

Very clean and beautiful space. I only had this for 1 night unfortunately but I decided to come back early to enjoy the space. You can hear almost everything from the flat upstairs and when people come in/out of the apartment though so perhaps not ideal for light sleepers but it was clean, cosy and comfortable at what I now know to the heart of Porto. Would definitely recommend!
This perfectly located apartment is a great place to stay while visiting Porto; the neighborhood was very quiet and pleasant; I would recommend it to stay but does not have A/C nor elevator

Had a great time in Porto. The apartment is located near everything, restaurants, parks and transportation. Wish I had more time to spend in Portugal. I definitely will stay at Hugo's place next time I visit Porto Portugal. I stayed in the third floor apartment. Very nice accommodations. Everything you need to enjoy your stay. We ate out but if you need to cook there is everything you need to do so. Thanks again Hugo for allowing us to experience Porto.

perfect locations for everything! We didn’t have to go far for anything, it’s near all the Porto attractions, and so many restaurants and coffee shops as well. There is a gorgeous church near it and you do hear the bell ring every morning.

Unfortunately We had problems accessing to the place with the code, Hugo answered but we spent two hours outside, he settled us in another place with a better location but we did not have hot water or blankets :(
Very central, cosy apartment. The place was clean and easy to find. I would definitely book it again!
Loved the location, very clean, unfortunately bathroom did flood from the shower after use which wasn’t ideal and no coffee pods for machine! Otherwise very nice stay

Perfectly located apartment in Porto with a view out onto Porto Cathedral.
The apartment is perfect for exploring Porto as easy to walk to the river and all the sites of the City.
Apartment has everything you could need as a base to explore the city. Sao Bento metro and train stations within a 5 minute walk, as well as easy walking access to Luís I Bridge.
The apartment is on the third floor, so is a walk up with bags.
Would 100% stay in the apartment again.

Absolutely brilliant acomodation. The pictures of this listing cannot even capture the beauty of the place. The design of the tiny house is very nice, with quality pieces. You have everything you need and the host and his family are extremly friendly! Would highly recommend to anyone.
Fine place, wasn’t amazing. Shower was clogged to the point that we couldn’t use it and the fridge wasn’t working. It was clean and cheap-ish.

The house is very nice, clean and well located. Inocencio and Joana are very friendly and available anytime for assistance and with recommendations. We only had a small issue with water and electricity, due to the building of the new metro line nearby, but we were warned by Joana the day before our arrival that it was possible. Overall, a nice and pleasant stay!
Joana's place is in a great location, really clean and has everything you need for a fantastic stay in Porto.

We really enjoyed staying at Joana place in Porto. It had everything we needed for our family of 7 adults. Very walkable to the center of Porto. Parking was tricky at first but we figured it out.
Joana was very communicative and easy to work with. We loved the area and would definitely stay again if we travel to Porto in the future
Joana’s house was exactly what we were looking for. Spacious, private and relatively close to the city center. A good value for what we needed. Very clean and organized. Highly recommend.

Joana's place was exactly as described on-line. Clean, warm, tastefully decorated. Joanna was very friendly and gave very clear instruction and lots of information and recommendations on the area, places to see, where to eat, shop, etc. The backyard was a lovely oasis. The kitchen came with everything needed - honestly it was just a lovely place to stay and we would highly recommend!

Joana’s home was outstanding in all aspects.  Comfortable, beautifully decorated, and in a location close to everything.  We enjoyed the ease to walk to the historic section, while also being very close to the Mercado Bom Secesso, a fantastic and modern eating area filled with so many options.

Joana’s house was beautiful. Very well located, able to walk to coffee, restaurants, parks, etc but once you stepped inside it felt very quiet & peaceful. Home is exactly as pictured, so thoughtfully decorated & comfortable. The garden in the back is so enjoyable, even on a rainy day. We had a wonderful few days here. Would definitely stay again! Thank you, Joana!
Great place to stay! Joana is very friendly, always available for questions and provides you with tips for sightseeing, restaurants, bakery, supermarket etc
Joana's house is beautiful, spacious and stylish. The garden was a fantastic space to relax in and Joana was a brilliant host who was always responsive, professional and friendly. Highly recommended.

We had a great stay at Mafalda’s apartment. The apartment has everything one needs, the bed is very comfortable, the bathroom is very nice and the kitchen is fully equipped. The location was also perfect for us. We would gladly stay there again!

Our stay was excellent! The apartment was very comfortable, clean, and quiet. The location was perfect, a quiet neighborhood about a 20-minute walk from the city center. The Feeling Inn team was always attentive, friendly, and willing to resolve any questions or issues. If we return, we will definitely contact them again. Thank you so much for everything!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Nuno's Airbnb in Gaia, Porto, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. The apartment was beautifully furnished and boasted magnificent views of the river and Porto skyline, offering an energetic atmosphere in the morning and a romantic ambiance at night.
The location was perfect for exploring the vibrant city of Porto, with easy access to the main attractions, restaurants, and shopping areas. The apartment was well-equipped with all the necessary amenities, and the garage was spacious enough to accommodate my Mustang Mach E, making it a perfect choice for those traveling with larger vehicles.
Nuno, our host, went above and beyond to ensure our stay was exceptional. He provided us with a plethora of invaluable recommendations, insider tips, and guidance to help us make the most of our visit. His attention to detail, genuine care, and warm hospitality truly enhanced our overall experience.

great place! very modern and nicely decorated. spacious for 2 people, with bedroom, bathroom, living room, kitchen table area and outside sitting area. great restaurants nearby and lovely walk to town centre. 18 min drive to areinho parking for the susp bridge and then you must do the paiva walkways... 8.7 km. took us about 2 hrs. then get a taxi ( 17euros) back to your car.
parliamento restaurant had great food!
Sandra's place was in a great location and very clean. I would recommend to anyone looking to stay in the area.

I would definitely recommend this apartment for your stay in Porto. The location of the apartment is perfect, very centrally located and super close to public transportation. The interior of the apartment was very nice. The room was really specious and well equipped. Communication with the hosts was very good and check-in and check-out times were very flexible! We very much enjoyed our stay!

Excellent stay in Porto. Clear and timely communication from the team as soon as the booking was made. Very helpful instructions on how to locate the accommodation and how to access it. Lift access was much appreciated. Very clean flat, comfy bed and great bathroom. All essentials eg kettle etc included. Great value for money with a fantastic location.  Very central but very quiet in the flat at night. Across the road from the train station and from where a lot of the buses go. Short walk to some great bars and restaurants. Would highly recommend this place - thank you for our stay!! 😊😊

Amazing location - central, walking distance to all the cool spots in Porto. Apartment was also very safe and easy to access I arrived late at night around midnight and was able to easily access the apartment. Very clean and had everything you need for a quick couple of days.
Very well located for a city trip, the room looked like in the photos, we felt very comfortable right away! Only the bed could be a bit bigger. All in all, highly recommended!

Location was superb as we arrived via train from Lisbon and the airbnb was right at the doorstep. It was close by to all amenities and great food just within a 5 mins walk radius. Close by to Riberia as well which was a plus. Room was very spacious and even though its on a busy road, the apartment was facing the inner part of a square which was quiet and windy at night.

I had an amazing time in Porto. The location of the apartment is great and it has everything you need to stay for a few days. Also the apartment was very clean and even though it is located in a busy street, you cannot hear any noises. I would definitely recommend this place!

Great apartment in the heart of Porto. Really close to public transport and major sights a walkable distance. The apartment was spacious, clean and tastefully decorated. Great soundproofing as couldn't hear any Street noise.  Loved the balcony.  Host was proactive in checking we had everything we needed. Couldn't fault this place.  Would stay here again.

Couldn’t have had a better 2-night stay in Porto here. The apartment was clean, spacious, and perfectly located. Even though it’s situated on a busy street, since the unit itself faces into a courtyard you don’t get any street noise and it’s surprisingly very quiet. Would definitely stay here again!

Absolutely loved my time in Porto, and that was due in no small part to this Airbnb. The location was fantastic and it was always a quick and easy walk to tons of great restaurants as well as lots of fun places. Everything was clean and there was no noise that kept me up!
Such a great clean apartment and very close to everything. You can walk everywhere. Having a balcony is a really nice touch to get some fresh air.
Really enjoyed our stay in this fabulous location with everything on your doorstep, yet so quiet inside the building. Super proactive and responsive communications making check in & out very simple

Thank you for a perfect stay for a long weekend in Porto.The apartment is clean, bright and very cosy. It’s an amazing location and walking distance to all the main areas and attractions, but super quiet at the same time. The host was very responsive and gave clear instructions throughout. Highly recommend! Thank you again!

The flat was very comfortable and the matched the description beautifully. It's in an amazing location to sightseeing and transport. Just a heads-up for future guests: it's a very minimal setup, so things like shampoo, body lotion, and even small touches like sugar for coffee aren't included. That said, it's clean, quiet, and a solid option if you're looking for something simple and functional. I would stay there again for sure.
perfect location, easily walkable and next to the train station.Responsive host and beautiful apartment. Recommended.

Sophia Urban Suites was a wonderful accommodation that was clean, private and modern. While well within walking distance of downtown Porto it was far enough removed to allow for a peaceful night’s sleep. I found Lurdes to be both professional and extremely friendly. Highly recommend!

Staying at Sophia Urban Suites was great. Everything is so well-organized, space is used ingeniously, things are nice-looking and well-designed, everything was perfectly clean. Lurdes was helpful, communicative, and super nice. I was a bit worried about the neighborhood after looking at Google Street View, but in fact, it's a very pleasant place 5 minutes away from great places. I would definitely come back here. One of my top Airbnb experiences.
Nice place in the city center. Great location, close to restaurants, attractions, many coffee shops nearby with good coffee. The apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay.
Patricia was a great host! The Apartment is cosy and beautiful. It is a bit noisy, being in the very centre of the city! We had a lovely time!

The apartment was better than expected and is on a great spot in the heart of the historic city center. Because of the there is a lot of noise coming from the streets. So bring earplugs if you sleep light.

The apartment is in a great location, right in city center and we could walk everywhere. We did an easy self check-in and the instructions were clear and easy to follow. Although the apartment needed some renovation it was good value. We had a great time in Porto and we definitely recommend the city for a getaway.

We enjoyed our stay at Patricia‘s place!, Thank you very much!
But we were kind of disappointed of how small and soiled the Place was. Not everything, but the Bathroom was old and dusty. We still enjoyed our stay, because of its location.
Thank you very much!
Perfect location and very open apartment! The host was awesome in communication with me. Would definitely stay again. Thank you!

You won't find a more fun location to stay in Porto! So much space & light, huge & comfy beds. Even though you'll look out directly into the music, feasting & action of Rua da Flores, the thickness of the windows & shutters surprisingly block the sound (& musicians stop just after 11pm). We loved this place so much!
Great apartment and location! We just had some noise issues in the apartment hallway and construction outside. Otherwise, great!

Excellent location, close to shopping, history, culture and amenities. Great view of the square from the windows. Clean spotless and comfortable unit. Being in a busy square, it gets noisy at night but the host is extremely kind to provide ear plugs for complete comfort.
Will recommend to anyone!

This place is simply beyond! 10/10.
Perfectly located in the heart of Porto, close to everything! The view is fantastic. The place is beautiful and spacious. Most definitely would recommend to everyone!

Loved staying here and had a great experience communicating with the hosts. The place was STUNNING with beautiful open windows and nightlife below us. So easy to get around either on foot or via ubers. 10/10 overall!

Lovely place. Perfect location.
We really enjoyed the stay.
Team was friendly, responsive and gave us clear instructions :)
Will come back here when I get the chance. Thank you😊

We absolutely loved it! The space was wonderful, just as described. The location was amazing and it was great to come home in the evening and open up the windows to people watch. There was a singer outside in the evenings who we loved and it was just a great atmosphere. It was also super centrally located and we appreciated having a water station just outside the door. The hosts were super proactive and gave us very clear instructions.
The host was very helpful and responsive when necessary. The place was easy to find and very easily walkable to the center of the city. The house matched the description and was worth the price.
We had a great stay! The hostess was very friendly, the location was convenient, and the place was clean and well-kept. We definitely recommend it!
Best place ever! Really nice room with The host and his family being the nicest people ever!

The tiny house of Miguel is great. It is located in a beautiful garden close to the city center (20 min walk). Miguel is a super host and makes you feel very welcome. We enjoyed our stay and In would definitly recommand!

This place was magical. We were received wonderfully. Miguel and his wife were very very helpful. Everything in the space was very clean and calm. Fresh air and quiet all around. In the morning we were greeted by two very loving dogs. If you want to take a break from the bustle of the city, then this is a great place.
Miguel and Helena were so welcoming and always quick with responses! They recommended lots of nice places to visit in Porto. It was such a lovely stay, and enjoyed the stay :)

I would definitely stay at Miguel's place if ever in Porto again. It's walkable to the tourist area while being far enough away to offer a peaceful  break. There is a beautiful walk along the river nearby that is not full of tourists and a couple of supermarkets within walking distance as well. Relaxing in the hammock surrounded by beautiful trees is the perfect way to end or start the day. The bed is comfortable with soft sheets and every detail is covered. I enjoyed every minute of my stay.

If you’re overwhelmed by the options of places to stay, stop looking and stay here. Miguel, and his amazing little (mush)room couldn’t have been more perfect. It was the perfect peaceful getaway that is still extremely close to everything in Porto/Baia. And! It’s only a 4€ bolt to the center of Porto.
Everything about the space had personal touches and thought given to make your stay extra special. It was clean, cozy and an incredible value. Miguel went above and beyond our expectations both with communication and local recommendations. You can tell from the moment you meet Miguel that his passion of architecture has been poured into the place. I truly cannot recommend this airbnb enough, you certainly will not regret your choice staying here. Thank you Miguel!

We had the loveliest stay at Miguel & Helena’s! They are such warm and knowledgeable hosts — Miguel had so many great local recommendations, and upon checkin, Helena had coffee and cake for us. It’s tucked away in a peaceful neighborhood (with free street parking) and just a short Uber/taxi ride to all the sights in Porto. Would definitely stay here again!
Very cozy stay at Miguel's, he's a very nice host with an eye for the comforts and conveniences of his guests.

What an awesome stay! Miguel and Helena are incredible hosts and pay incredible attention to their guests. It was exactly what we needed after a few busy days in Lisbon, a nice quiet and secluded place, but still very close to the center of Porto which we could easily get to in under 10-min with Bolt or Uber.
The only sad thing is that it was raining the entire time we were there, so we didn't get to enjoy the nature and green spaces around where we were, especially the outside table and chairs and the hammock (but if we ever make it back to Porto when it's sunny, we'll definitely stay here again and take full advantage of everything the Mushroom has to offer).
Mushroom is the most interesting house I have ever lived in!! Very good and beautiful environment!

Had an absolutely fantastic stay at the Mushroom! My Partner and I were blown away with the location and the stunning surroundings - so calm and peaceful - had such a great time - Miguel was the perfect host, so full of recommendations and was super flexible with an early check in! Gave us lots of tips and showed us on a map all the places we should go! Couldn't have asked for more! Will be recommending Porto and the Mushroom to all my friends!

Miguel’s place was a wonderful base for exploring the Porto area while being immersed in nature. He was kind and welcoming, and his recommendations gave me two of the best dinners I had in Portugal! The place is a short walk to places in both Porto and Gaia. Will definitely be staying here again on my next trip to Porto!
The appartement was very nice and easy to reach with public transport. It is perfect if you prefer to stay outside of the city center.
Had a great stay in Porto! Accommodation is in a very convenient location and everything was as described. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again!

Very welcoming and friendly hosts. Check-in was without any problems. Apartment is very nice and clean.
I highly recommend the apartment and hope I will come back once in the future.
We had such a lovely stay. It was all clean and well furnished. We could walk everywhere. Our hosts were helpful and reactive. I highly recommend their place.

grate grate host!!! very very helpful at all times. on the day they had to do some work on the place, she offerd me (i didn't even get the chance to ask), to work in one of the empty rooms and even fixed it to my convenience.
on her own initiative, she asked me if i needed any thing and what will make my stay fit more to my needs.
very big screens, both in the rooms and in the living room.
kitchen is very well equiped.
little bit pricy for a room with sharring space and for the location that is not in the center but very suitable for working on line.

excellent place to stay if you are visiting Porto. very nice and clean rooms, lots of privacy when you want it, and located in a quiet area with very quick walking access to good restaurants and attractions

We really enjoyed our stay in Pedro’s place. The apartment is about a 15 minute walk to the city centre which is not bad  at all. The neighbourhood was nice and quiet with a grocery store nearby. The place is beautiful, sparkling clean and had everything we needed. Communication from the host was also great and clear. Would definitely recommend staying here if you’re visiting Porto.
Good location, as near friends who live close by, but also walkable to the river front and parks.

Everything was perfect when we arrived we were warmly welcomed by Pedro who explained how everything worked and answered all our questions. The apartment was even better than the photos it is lovely, spacious and well equipped with everything you need to make your stay comfortable. It was very clean and it was a pleasure having a washing machine and dishwasher. We enjoyed being able to sit on the large terrace in the evenings. Thank you to David who answered any questions we had during our stay and Pedro for the warm welcome. We will definitely be back and would recommend the apartment to anyone visiting Porto. It near the metro and there is a supermarket within walking distance and an Uber into the center is under 10€.

Simply incredible!
Would recommend to anyone anytime!
Great location with everything at waiting distance. Close to the WOW that truly is amazing 🤩

It was a wonderful stay, very close to the downtown, very close to public transportation and several restaurants around. The communication with the host were fluid and responsive. The apartment was exactly as the picture, definitely we’ll be back.

Great clean apartment with comfortable beds. Lovely views of Porto. Busses, trains to Porto within walking distance. Uber at reasonable prices. Easy 25 minute walk to Gaia side of Porto. Shops and restaurants also within walking distance.

I was a bit sceptical about staying in Vila Nova, but the location was perfect! Couldn’t ask for better and really stayed in the perfect place as it has a lot of things to do around the area. It’s literally walkable everywhere (you can just cross the bridge and you’ll be in Porto) and it has the best views. The place was clean and the outside area was great for a late-night dinner in. The house was clean and the communication with the host was quick and easy. I really had a great time.

Great location, lots of food options within walking distance, terrace is nice to relax by with food and drinks and the host was nice and friendly. The airbnb is a little bit small, but it is quite reasonable given the price that we pay. Porto is a beautiful city and this airbnb did us well given the location being so convenient.

We had a great stay. Check-in was easy, the home was extremely clean and spacious. It was very nice having a parking spot in a location where parking would be otherwise difficult. It is an easy 30-minute walk across the bridge to the other side of the river, and metro is available too if you prefer not to walk. Highly recommend!

Lovely apartment and the balcony was a joy.  We loved Porto and will come back in the future.  Ricardo, Paulo and Magda were very helpful and quick to respond to any queries.  A short walk to the city centre and would recommend the hop on/off bus trip to see round the city to start with.   Lovely to walk round Porto as well.
We really enjoyed our stay, the apartment was spotless and the view exceptional.  Also very quiet and you will have no trouble getting a good night sleep.
Great location, fantastic views, just would like there to be coffee in the room, for the morning to sit out on the balcony

Nice appartment, fantastic view and location. The apartment it self is a purposebuilt Airbnb flat with basic interior and good air condition. Kitchen facilities are  limited which limits your options if you want to make the most of abundance of fresh food Porto has to offer.

We enjoyed our stay of four nights in Paulo’s apartment. The apartment is as described. The location is ideal for visiting Porto. Communication with Paulo was excellent, and the check in/check out process was easy. We highly recommend Paulo’s apartment.

Off the beaten track but that's what made it special once you figure out where you are!
Incredible view and local charm, I would go back!

The apartment has a stunning view from its balcony and it is in a very convenient localisation. It is within walking distance of many restaurants and places worth seeing.
the host was very helpful and the Check-in /out instruction was very clear. I definitely recommend this place.

The highlight of the aparment is the view.  Lofty location above the River Douro with an unblocked view of two amazing bridges. The apartment is perfectly big enough for two people. Shower had great pressure! Porto is just a lovely city. Shabby in places which just adds to its authenticity. Paulo, thank you.
This place was great, with amazing views of the river and within walking distance to all the main attractions. A truly wonderful spot!

Fantastic stay in Porto!
Amazing views from the apartment and walking distance into the main town.

Great place with a fantastic view! Clear check-in details and a bonus to be able to drop off our heavy luggage early to go and explore. Easy access to walk into town or down to the river with lots to see and do. Plenty of kitchen facilities if you want to prepare your own meals. Comfy bed and good shower with large towels. Thank you Paulo for prompt communication and helpful advice.
Paulo's place is great - fantastic views of the river and close to the city centre. It's compact, but doesn't feel small, and overall we were very comfortable there.
A great apartment on a top-location, quiet -  and with Maggie being a great host, giving me loads of great Porto-tips! Highly recommended!

Fabulous apartment and I would not hesitate to recommend it.  Maggie was very informative when we arrived and we followed her recommendations and confirm that she was spot on.   An amazing location - easy to find even after several glasses of Port!   Extremely clean and everything was provided, although it took us a while to find the cutlery drawer with the corkscrew!

We stayed at Maggie’s place for five days in September 2022. Maggie met us at check-in and gave us several tips for our time in Porto. The location was excellent — walking distance to everything in Porto but off the street so it wasn’t too loud to sleep at night. We had plenty of space for three of us and made good use of the kitchen for a quick charcuterie board while taking a break from walking Porto’s intense hills. Great place to stay!

This apartment was wonderful. It was super cozy and clean and was located in the heart of porto. Communication with the hosts was easy. There is AC, elevators, and apartment is stocked with anything you may need. I 100% recommend staying here!
Maggie’s place was fantastic. Perfect location for walking everywhere on a great pedestrian street. Definitely have breakfast directly across the street at the Forester Cafe by Hungry Biker!

Ideal location for exploring Porto on foot. Close to the river, cathedral and the main site seeing attractions.
The apartment was clean, well equipped with comfortable beds and pillows.
Would highly recommend.
It was the perfect place for our stay! We especially loved the location. Close to everything but still quiet. We would definitely stay here again!

A bit hard to find the entrance as there were no apartment numbers or identifiers, but once we figured it out we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Apt was very clean and we enjoyed the sitting room. Loved the large open air window with gorgeous views of the bridge and the river, especially at night.
Would be nice to have some shelves or some counter space for personal items in the bathroom as the sink is really tiny. All in all it was a great place to stay, within walking distance to the Ribeira District. Very nice location. Created great memories.
My husband and I loved our stay! The neighborhood is quiet which we appreciated. We highly recommend!
Lovely little apartment, great location with views of the river, lots of charming cafes and bars nearby and very central location. Would 100% recommend!
Great apartment — right in the center, very well maintained and pleasant to be in. The host is communicating quick. It could be noisy on the street, but not too noisy. Highly recommend!

Another great stay in Porto. This place was easy to find and the communication with Diogo was good. After arriving in the city i just had to message him and he met me at the apartment to let me in and gave me a quick tour of the place.  Very clean, comfortable bed, and good wifi, only 2 hangers so maybe a few more would be good, but other than that i liked it there.

Great place to stay while visiting Porto. It is in the middle of the old town and you can walk to many sightseeing places. Being close to the metro and bus stations makes it easier to travel across the city.
Great location between old and new Porto, walkable to everything touristic. Clean and simple room.

There are pro's and con's about this place. First the pro's: friendly hosts, super responsive and kind, amazing location. The con's; this place needs an update. There is a clear humidity problem and the room has almost no furniture appart from a bed and chest of drawers. This means no place for hanging clothes.

A great place to explore the city center with atmosphere. The host was very accommodating. Given the lack of a kitchen and washing machine, I think this is a perfect place for a rather short stay if you want to enjoy Porto. I recommend it!
Great stay, the apartment was as described if not better, spacious and clean and the view from the roof terrace towards the bridge and port wine area was amazing especially at night.
clean al, spacious with a fantastic deck overlooking the river and bridges.  the sun was always shining on the deck naking it an ideal place tp relax.

We had an amazing time in Porto! The apartment was super clean and cozy - we immediately felt home. And the view from the terrace is just amazing. Probably better than in a lot of restaurants. We will definitely come back!

Ricardo was very responsive to our last-minute requests.
The place is as described, the terrace is big and the view from there is simply amazing, we had a wonderful time in Porto.
Highly recommended, especially if you plan to enjoy the terrace.
Great location. Bed a bit small and not much room to move around it. Otherwise lovely spot and felt safe.
This was absolutely phenomenal. Best view we could genuinely ask for and it makes me want to come back for another time in the future. HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend choosing this if it’s available.

Amazing place! The view from the big terrace is just great!!
Very friendly hosts I loved my stay and will come again! OBRIGADA
Great location with beautiful view. Really enjoyed staying at Paulo’s. Walking distance to many places. Communication with Paulo was easy and quick. Would stay again if come to Porto again.

The apartment was very spacious and had all the amenities we required, it even had two toilets which was convenient. The terrace and the views were worth the stay alone. There wasn’t much in the vicinity but there were many amenities just a ten minutes walk away. Our only snag there is very little room to get passed the bed and there were no side lights either side of the bed.
I would highly recommend this apartment.

very nice view. apartment was very clean. host was very responsive. main Cathedral is walkable in about 10 minutes. other nice squares are equally close. matras on the bed should be improved, the host is planning to do this.
Joao was easy to communicate with and an attentive host. Place was comfortable and clean. Easy check in. Walking distance to all amenities. Exactly what we were looking for.
Spacious apartment, close to everything. João was very responsive. Beds a little hard, but you get used to it.

This is the most perfect location in Porto! You are right in the center of the action! everything you could want from an Airbnb is included in this beautiful space. The only thing that is concerning for travelers might be the accessibility if you need to be driven right to the door. Most people will have no issues! I think this host is extremely well organized and trustworthy.

Really beautiful place! It is on a busy street so expect some noise, but if you close the balcony doors it is completely silent. We were there when it was in a heat wave but they’ve said they’ll have a fan for future guests. Would definitely stay here again!

Pedro’s apartment is centrally located and easily walkable to many sights.
The apt is small but perfectly laid out so feels comfortable for 2 people. Great balcony, all new furnishings and modern fixtures.
Pedro was quick to respond to questions and sent us a long list of recommendations for restaurants, bars etc across the city - really helpful.
I would recommend this apartment.

Pedro was very responsive and communicative at all ours of the day/night and was a pleasure to deal with. Overall we loved our stay and the location of the apartment was perfect. Washer was very useful but make sure to look in the closet to the right of the bed next to the kitchen for the clothes hanging rack if you need to dry your clothes. It's a bit of a hidden closet lol.
Other than that the only negatives was the apartment was a bit dusty in some areas, the lack of shower caddy or a ledge ro place shampoo etc, and the lack of power outlets next to the bed (you need to unplug lamp to plug in phone chargers).
We really did enjoy our stay overall though and this apartment served as a great base camp. The view of the Duoro river from the small balcony of the river was cool too. Would definitely stay again.
Obrigado!

The apartment was perfect for visiting Porto as close to everything , Pedro was so good when we needed him.definitely recommend
Thank you

Very nice and clean apartment, and Pedro was a great host. The only problem was the sofa-bed, which was very old and uncomfortable. Perfect for a couple who share a bed but a bit harder for two separate people. Pedro was great though and worked hard to meet every need.
Had a very good stay! very close to everything, very nice and Light room and the balcony was super. enjoyed a few hours of sun there. the room is not super big, but it was perfect for me.

Fantastic. Just fantastic. The unit is charming, beautifully updated, and the decor was very aesthetically pleasing. The location was perfect, and the balcony overlooking the river was beyond charming. If I could buy this unit, I would. I hope to book it again on my next visit!
Great experience! He was very responsive and nice even let us check in early since our flight landed so early. In a perfect location that was walkable to everything. Would definitely go back!!

Pedro’s place was perfect for our stay. We loved having breakfast on the balcony, and it was easy to walk everywhere from the central location. Pedro was super helpful and gave us great recommendations for activities and restaurants. The flat was charming with all the amenities we needed. We would happily stay there again in the future.

We had a wonderful stay at Pedro’s Airbnb. It was absolutely beautiful, really well located in the heart of Porto and had gorgeous views off the balcony. Would absolutely recommend to anyone to stay here.

We absolutely loved our stay! The apartment is modern, scandi style and cosy. The view from the balcony was beautiful and the seats and table were an added bonus! The pictures were 100% accurate of the view and the apartment itself. Pedro’s communication was excellent and we received a fantastic list of recommendations and check in instructions were clear. The location was fantastic, it was about a 3 minute walk to the river and each landmark/attraction was a short walk away. We would definitely recommend others to stay here and can’t wait to be back ourselves!  5 stars ✨

Great place, beautiful simple decor and lovely balcony. But even though the windows were impeccable the area is simply noisy. Also note there’s no air conditioning so one is likely to want to keep the windows open at night…

The apartment was so beautiful. I couldn’t stop staring out the windows whenever I was there. Really nice soft ambient lighting provided inside too with the lamps etc. Can’t beat the location. Would definitely stay again if I come back to Porto.
Location was great, in the old town.  Great restaurants and bars etc within easy walking distance. Pedro was always very responsive and we really enjoyed our stay.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! The location is right in the middle of everything you need in Porto - we were able to walk everywhere. The apartment itself was sparkling clean and all of the finishes in the bathroom and kitchen were beautiful & like new. The balcony overlooking the street was beautiful as well, and the decor/furniture was a super relaxing vibe. Note: this is up 3 flights of stairs, but there’s also an elevator(although it’s very slow). Would definitely stay here again!

Pedro and Viva were over communicative and very helpful. They shared a list of local recommendations and all info/services that come with the Airbnb were clear and comprehensive. The place and location was perfect for a few days in Porto!
Everything was great until all of the arsenal fans showed up and started yelling in the streets! The apartment was amazing and provided a wonderful home away from home. Thanks for everything!

We had a great stay but worth knowing that it’s close to the river so quite a bit of traffic.
Quiet at night, however.

Great communication from start to finish. Very helpful and responsive.
The apartment is nice and is in a great location close to the river. It’s a little more rundown than the photos portray but not a big issue.
Thanks 😊
We had a lovely stay in Porto and enjoyed this apartment! It was in the perfect location and the host was so responsive and flexible. Highly recommend!!

The apartment is in a great location, with a great view of the Douro It was well stocked with everything The only negative we found is that the apt faces west, so gets quite hot in the afternoon, with only a fan for relief, which even in May, was insufficient

My daughter and I had a wonderful three-night stay in this Porto apartment on Rua dos Mercadores/Merchant's Way. Porto is a beautiful city, and this apartment is ideally situated to explore the enchanting riverfront. The elevator was a fantastic amenity, particularly for managing our luggage, and it was helpful on those days when the hilly Porto landscape was a challenge (at least for me) as we made our way to the third floor (that's the fourth for us). The apartment is starting to show some wear and tear, but Pedro and his team were quickly on top of our concerns and dealt with them quickly.

The location was great, close to the main attractions of the city. Very private once you get inside from the narrow alley. The space was a bit tight, workable for a short stay, but not an extended one. Host was very responsive and helpful with recommendations and advice.

The location was fantastic, and the property was generally as described. However, there was significant noise due to ongoing construction behind the property, which made it hard to relax. The biggest issue was the bathroom, which had a lot of black mold—a major concern for me. While the location was great, the mold issue and noise made the stay less enjoyable.

Pedro’s place is very cute and cozy. Nice sunny balcony for a coffee with side views to the river and access through a typical ribeira back street where time seems to have stoped.
The flat had everything needed for a few days (at least for me) and it was well cleaned.
Being in ribeira area, it’s very close to the river side but it is an uphill walk to the city centre, a nice one if you don’t mind walking.
There are restaurants, bars and shops around.
Only critic is that some details need attention as things get worn out! Overall 👌

Lovely little flat in a great location. Perfect for a couple’s getaway or with a friend.
Pedro was a great communicator and the process was seamless. Would highly recommend!
nice and clean. had a washer which many places don't offer. very responsive host and helpful.

Lisa and company were Extremely friendly, and responsive especially when I
Had some questions early on! Place is very spacious with 3 bedrooms !!
Very easy check in, the space is beautiful and there’s two terraces to watch the sunrise and sunset. Space is huge and you don’t feel cramped, it was perfect for my group of 3.
Apartment was clean and suitable as described but had a musty smell. The weather was cold and the small heater in the apartment was not adequate
A little noisy late at night due to nearby venue playing very loud music until 1am. General decor in need of freshening up.
The flat was really nice, clean and new. We were allowed to check in earlier and the host was very proactive. Great location!

Place is gorgeous. It actually looks better in person. Joana was very proactive about helping me get settled, even when I wasn’t as proactive. The check in process is the easiest I’ve ever encountered. Download an app and Joanna gives you access to a digital pin, which allows you to come in and out of the apartment with your phone. The bed is super comfortable. The place is centrally located, everything is right there. I only stayed for one day, but even at that de to got my money’s worth.

It was a nice apartment, good location with lots of resturants around. Only thing that bothered me was that on Friday and Saturday there was loud music that started playing around midnight somewhere around that we heard well in the apartment.
We had a great stay! The apartment was beautiful and extremely clean. Great location, easy check-in and good communication with the host! Thanks for having us :)

Very small, but also comfortable.
The bathroom is the best one I’ve seen in Porto so far, bed is comfortable, windows are facing a yard with trees and grass, so the air feels fresh there and there’s no noise there considering it’s close to a crossroad of two busy streets.

It’s a cozy, immaculate studio with almost everything you need. The staff were very helpful, let us store our luggage at their office when we arrived early. Also gave us all sorts of information for traveling around the city. They even packed us some salt, pepper and olive oil for cooking as requested. They replied my message almost always immediately. Even though it’s a quiet neighbourhood, it’s easy to walk to all the destinations in the city centre. We stayed five nights there, and we loved going back to this comfy ‘home’ after a long day exploration. Also liked that there’s no TV, so less distractions. Would highly recommend for a solo traveler or a couple.
Nice and clean little apartment in an interesting and not too noisy neighborhood. Balcony with morning sun. Communication went smoothly.
Awesome stay in heart of Porto, loved it. Had morning coffee with a view, and two colleagues asked why I'm calling from such a nice place

This property was perfect for one couple. It has a nice little balcony, clean and functional kitchen and bathroom, but most importantly the location is fantastic. You are a 5-10 minute walk from the best restaurants and cocktail bars in the city, many of the best monuments, and two of the largest transit stations. It’s very easy to the take the train/subway in from the airport and very easy to access the train/subway system to go to the surrounding areas like Douro or moving along to Lisbon/Algarve. I recently had knee surgery that was reducing my mobility but this location made everything walkable.
It was a little difficult to find but once we’d overcome that it was brilliant. Nice and clean, good location and the air con was very good!
all great, except one guy came without notice to fix the thermostat. No notice AT ALL, just went into de apartment when mi girlfriend was alone in there and he didn't even speak English. scary

A fantastic spot location wise and we were incredibly impressed by the host. Very clean, as we stayed for a month we also had the flat cleaned every week free of charge.
The WiFi was really good too which was great for us as we were working.
Only things to consider if looking at this property, there is construction work going on next door. We did not find this too invasive or noisy, but some people might. Plus the noise from the main road is quite loud at times at night.
But overall we had a fantastic stay
Beautiful and cozy place. Great location, quiet and comfortable. The welcome wine and the map of Porto were such a beautiful treat 🙂

My friend and I stayed for 4 nights in this great apartment. The communication went all very well. It was very clean, cosy, spacious and all in all, a great experience. We loved the great design and the location just around the corner of sights, bakeries and restaurants. We can very much recommend this place.

Great location. The smart App did not work for us , so checking in was a bit cumbersome. But Joanna helped us get in and we used the back up key. Stairs to the elevator were a flight.
The street could be noisy if you opened the windows but closed it was quiet. The noisy fridge was not too bothersome, as we were too tired to notice it.

Joana’s place was a great find in the heart of Porto! The space is VERY clean, well laid out, and spacious. The location is perfect for seeing the main attractions and experiencing nightlife in the city. I can’t recommend this place enough!

The location is great. Very close to metro station and train station.
The apartment is clean and the mattress is comfortable.
The host is responsive and friendly.
