However, there is a bar downstairs and pretty noisy during the weekend night. Other than that, all is good.

We really enjoyed our stay! The location was perfect. Pictures of this place are slightly deceiving. It’s smaller than they make it look. The view and location made up for its size! Great hosts that were very responsive!!

The apartment was very central and in a great location although being central, a little noisy at night. Being on the top floor, many stairs to climb.
It was very clean and convenient.

Probably the brightest apartment you’ll find in Porto. There were 5 balcony doors on the first floor and 3 windows on the second floor. Amazing location, convenient to everything. The host was extremely flexible with check-in, which was a major relief since we arrived early with our luggages. Overall just a very pleasant experience and a very responsive host. Would definitely recommend staying here. Obrigado!
very central and right in the middle of Porto. If you like calm and less crowded it might not be the right spot, since all bars and restaurants are in walking distance.

What a beautiful place with a spectacular view! Close to everything you’d ever want or need. Everything is within walking distance. The beds were super comfy! The bathroom sink/shower drainage needs some love but everything else was perfect. Highly recommend this place. We’ll be back!

You couldn’t improve on the location or cleanliness and we really appreciated coffee pods and a bottle of local wine so much.   The apartment has a wonderful wrap around balcony and is at the top of central Porto so it’s a steep walk up.  Then it’s on the fourth floor which is tough after walking there with luggage. The air conditioning was very welcome but there isn’t any in the main bedroom.  It’s in the most incredible location though so we’ll worth any compromise.

Very nice place. Well located and great view.
Many steps though so be aware if you have heavy luggage

Really enjoyed our stay here. It was a perfect central location to explore Porto with great views and looked exactly like the pictures. Feels secluded yet is in the middle of the city. The hosts were incredibly responsive and helpful. Only downside would be the bathroom drain doesn’t work the best and there is no central heating. Would definitely recommend for your stay in Porto!

Amazing rental and an even better location. Super central and within walking distance of everything.
Very clean unit that was well stocked.
Very responsive host.
Loved the location and the views from our apartment were beautiful. Being over a Starbucks wasn’t bad either!

The house has recently been remodeled and is in a tiny village close to the beach. Neighbors were friendly and check-in was easy. The village is very quiet and remote - good if you want to be by the beach, larger supermarkets about a 10 minute drive.

The apartment we have been was absolutely amazing, very spacious and perfectly clean, equipped with everything you need, everything was super new and fully functional. The host is really helpful and super kind. Shower was cold and they fixed it as soon as possible. The bathroom was small but well cleaned and equipped with everuthing necessary. Location is perfect for visiting Porto. Would recommend to everyone for sure.

Judite place was fantastic. Very clean and stylish place with everything you needed. The bed is comfortable, bathroom and terrace are excellent. Location is incredible.
We had a such a great stay !!!!
Thank you!!!

Simply wauw! Quick communication, parking is private and safe. The apartment is the best we ever booked! Every detail is perfect. The bed is good, the jacuzzi and shower very nice, kitchen complete and the smart TV handy for background music. The whole entourage is just PERFECT!! The location is central. We unfortunately only stayed 1 night but we hopefully will be back next year. We had a wonderful stay!

Wow! We could not have been more impressed with this property - better than the photos and description.
Beautifully designed, immaculately clean with luxury hotel quality bedding / towels and a well equipped kitchen.
Judite and her team were super efficient and very helpful. The location, for us, was brilliant, with easy access to local buses, metro and direct access to and from airport.
We hope to go back soon!
Judite was so responsive, very helpful, and understanding. The place was perfect—very cozy. In more of an urban area of the city but it’s not difficult to drive to Porto. Love and highly recommend!
Judite’s place was awesome! Great location, great apartment and flexible communication with a gracious late checkout :)

We had a wonderful stay in this beautiful apartment. It was very special with amazing large bed, jacuzzi bath and terrace with great views. Judite was so helpful, always responsive and very kindly let us keep our bags overnight in the building, thank you 😊

Our stay was absolutely wonderful! The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and very comfortable. The location was perfect, making it easy to explore the area. Everything exceeded our expectations, and we truly enjoyed our time here. Highly recommend!

Judite's place was a real gem! Even with the power outage affecting Portugal when I arrived, Judite went above and beyond to ensure I was looked after. She was incredibly responsive and even let me store my luggage so I could explore the city before my flight. The accommodation itself was amazing – spotless and peaceful. I wouldn't hesitate to stay there again.

Incredible stay at Judite’s place! Felt very luxurious with the Jacuzzi and the private outdoor space. She was extremely attentive when we asked about extra amenities. Thank you so much for such a wonderful, stress-free experience!
This is a perfect appartement, beautiful and very private we had a great time, we recommend everybody who is visiting Porto to check this out!
Great apartment in a great location. Roof terrace is spacious and a perfect place to enjoy the sunshine. Garage is really useful if you have a car.

Fantastic apartment! From the moment we arrived, we felt right at home. The apartment was fully equipped with everything we needed. The location is ideal, just steps away from great restaurants, bars, and nightlife. The balcony overlooks a lively terrace, where music plays in the evenings, which we didn’t mind at all. Overall, we couldn’t be happier with our stay. Highly recommended!

Joao's apartment was very nice, spacious, and decorated. We had everything we needed to do basic things in the kitchen for a short visit. It's a prime location in a great neighborhood and Joao gave good directions to find it from the airport. We visited during winter, and it gets pretty cold in most of the buildings in Porto. But Joao had a couple of high quality space heaters plugged in when we arrived that kept the place nice and toasty. It was totally comfortable despite the cold outside.
We really enjoyed our stay! The place is beautiful and it has an amazing location for restaurants, shopping, and the waterfront.

Pros: great location, good amenities, clean and comfortable.
Cons: can’t run both heaters at the same time so may be chilly in either bedroom or living room, trash is hard to find ( needs pictures / better instructions since it’s not located in the building), there are 20 steps to get up so may be tricky with luggage and host commutation style is abrasive/rude (had some trouble with checkin and host made it clear we were interrupting his dinner with his friends and family. ) No freezer/ apartment just has a mini fridge.
This place is so nice and has an amazing location! The apartment was also very well-kept. Check-in and Check-out were super easy and Joao was very communicative.
Joao’s place was spotless, easy to access and a great location.  Joao was easy to work with and communicated well.  Definitely would stay again.  Dwayne & Shin

Excellent location. Walkable to all the touristy spots in Porto. Despite being in the center of everything, the windows have great sound proofing which guaranteed a quiet night's sleep. Lovely and responsive host. 10/10 will come back!
Loved our stay. Place was exactly as described and pictured. Was also very centrally located and easy to get to. Thanks for having us!
Great stay, central location and easy to get most anywhere in the city. The rooms were clean and the bed was very comfortable.
Wonderful apartment and location. Excellent communication with host. Easy check in and out. Thank you!
The location of the Airbnb was great! We could easily get around to the major sights. Overall, highly recommend.

João’s place was better than advertised! It’s a very large space and very comfortable. He is also a great host who is very responsive and helpful. The bed was very comfortable and everything was nice and modern. We were able to park in the Cardosas parking lot which was cheaper than most things around to leave the car for a couple days. Use the Saba website. Also, the location was great. Close to the main tourist streets and very walkable. We would definitely stay here again! When you enter the building, it’s very dark so don’t be alarmed. It’s a lovely place
Our host João couldn't have been more attentive and accommodating! The apartment is indeed wonderful, immaculate and well-appointed. Even the pull out couch was comfortable.

The cobblestone road out front was noisier than expected, but not too bad once you closed the windows and shutters.
It was great to meet Joao on the street on the day of the county's 50th anniversary of independence and he told me where I could get the special edition newspaper.

the home is beautiful and was equipped with everything we needed for our stay. it didn't have a bunch of clutter so was really good with our 6 month old baby.  my husband has mobility issues , but didn't find the 20 stairs up to the elevator difficult because it is straight. it is in a very lively area so the streets stayed busy until late at night, but the windows and shutter blocked most of the noise. easy walk to the river.

Great stay in a central location.
Very comfortable.
The apartment looked better than photos provided.

This was the best Airbnb I have ever stayed in. A fantastic location and beautiful apartment. We felt so comfortable and relaxed. Thank you for an amazing stay. Highly recommend to anyone coming to Porto!

This is a spacious and clean newly renovated unit that is in a centrally located area in the city center. Check in is easy and the host responds quickly to any needs. Bed was comfortable, wifi strong and the shower and bathroom very nice. There is a little street noise, but everything else overshadows that issue.
Overall a 5 * place!
Great host and place! Felt like home, the apartment is well located, easy to walk to any of the turistic places 🙌

This place is absolutely beautiful! Having an actual bedroom was a huge plus!! Perfect location and walkable to sites and restaurants. The bed was very comfortable and the sheets felt like upscale hotel. And there is even an elevator after the first flight of steps
The city itself was beautiful and clean.

Absolutely loved our stay here! The Airbnb was clean, comfortable, and quiet despite being in a prime location. Our only minor frustrations were the non working elevator at times and having to take out our own trash. Still, we'd happily stay again!
Very roomy and clean apartment In Ribeiro - so close to everything. We enjoyed our stay very much and would recommend highly

The apartment was clean, spacious and very comfortable. It appears newly refurbished with a lovely bathroom and walk in shower.
The location was just right with everything we wanted within a few minutes walk. The river in one direction and Sao Bento station in the other with the Time out market , which we found to be a brilliant place to eat. There are many other nice restaurants very close by.
João is a great host; responding very quickly and allowed us to check in early as we had arrived with heavy cases on an extremely hot day.
I would recommend this apartment without hesitation.

This great place and location great hospitality from host , as I am over 12 years in Airbnb traveler around world
I will book this place without ask questions
If you are digital remote working , great internet and speed
Thanks again for the hosting us, great
We were really impressed with João’s place. Clean, spacious, loved the minimal design. Also in a great area - central and ideal for heading off any direction.

! I was a little worried because there weren’t any reviews yet, but,  wow!, what a beautiful place! Small but super comfortable for two people. Lovely apartment with all amenities, perfect location, very friendly and helpful hosts. Thoroughly recommend!

Awesome little spot in a cozy corner of Porto. Loved the outside patio area and close access to the sea. I didn’t get to meet the hosts but they were very communicative and helpful. Would definitely stay here again and recommend it if you want to be in a quiet area but still not too far away from the center of the city!

Look no further if you are looking for the perfect place to stay near the beach and with easy access to Old Town in Porto. The apartment is very clean, comfortable for two and close to both restaurants and grocery stores. The 500 bus was easy to catch and took us right to the center of town.
Ricardo and Andreia are the perfect host. This was our first time in Portugal and they provided us with all the information needed to navigate public transportation, fado music options and even researched gluten free dining options in the area, all of which are now listed on their postings.
Thank you so much for a wonderful first visit. We would easily choose to stay here again.
Andreia and Roberto were great host! Arriving and leaving was a simple. The place was clean and quiet. A perfect place to retreat to after spending the day in Porto.

Such amazing hosts!! Andrea was so sweet! Waited for us to get there, explained everything thoroughly, had EVERYTHING we needed provided, but over all so nice and helpful. Definitely recommend staying here!

I can’t say enough great things about the hosts, the location and the accommodation. So glad we stayed near the water and not downtown. It’s an easy bus ride to get there. Fantastic space with comfortable bed and pillows and linens. Peaceful patio to relax and have some wine and everything you need in the kitchen. Great value.

Comfortable apartments, everything matches the description, very clean, all devices work (AC, kettle, coffee machine, hot water in the shower). Windows have window blinds (both for daily privacy and blackout option). Sleeping area is separated by the shelves stand. Laundry (washing machines and drying machine) is shared with other apartments in the building and located in the building corridor. Costs 1 euro per 2 hours, washing quality is good. Located in a quiet area, but has cafes in 5m walk. And host is very attentive and friendly :) Totally recommend.

This was the second time that I stayed in this nice and modern studio. Everything was great, the place was clean, the hosts are friendly. Access to a communal washing machine in the building is convenient. Close to the centre of Foz and the ocean. I can recommend!
Alexandre’s place is amazing and walkable to absolutely everything! Super easy to check in and out. The patio/balcony was also so much fun to hangout on!

Alexandre’s apartment was in the perfect location for us, minutes walk from many bars and restaurants. The apartment was very clean and felt very spacious for 6 people. Would 100% recommend someone to stay there!
Alexander's place was super clean and very nice.  Great location.  Good communication. He offers baggage drop off before check in and after check out. Which is a big plus.  Highly recommend!!
Alexandre was a great host, the apartment was in a perfect location and the place was super clean!

Very centrally located, so easy to get about.
Nice and spacious
and very quiet even though in central location.
Only issue was difficuly in drying wet clothes, as there was heating but no radiators. The weather was very wet and we got soaked every day. But this was not Alexandre's fault.
I would use again.

Location was great, place was easy to get to from the train station. Walkable to the whole city center w/in 10 minutes. The place was clean and spacious enough for our group of 6, beds were comfortable and linens were sufficient. The only thing is one bathroom had no ventilation so we noticed black mold along the shower edge and on the ceiling where the seemingly broken bathroom fan was. Humidity from the shower had nowhere to go. Can’t say for sure but might’ve contributed to some coughing and discomfort among the group. Overall great place to stay for Porto if you’re planning on spending most your time out and about.
Lovely spacious apartment in a great location for exploring the city. Central but not noisy or cramped. recommended!
nice apartment, easy access to the city and only 10 mins from a metro stop. great for 2 people
The host responds very quickly and the place is clean and tidy, but it's very noisy throughout the day and night.

We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment! Due to work, I and my colleague stayed there for a month, and it really felt like a home for that period. The apartment is located in a nice and calm neighborhood & is only a 10-15 minute walk away from very good restaurants and bars. The apartment itself is spacious, equipped modernly, and has everything you need, for example, to cook and wash your clothes during your trip. I especially enjoyed the balcony, sipping a glass of wine & reading a book there in the evenings.

Great apartment, spacious, light and airy. Is as beautiful as the photos show and has a pleasant rooftop balcony which got some afternoon sun. Perfect for 2 couples.
Was a little further into town than I expected, but definitely walkable or super cheap Ubers.
Would stay again!
The apartment was very clean and very pleasant. The location is great since it was within walking distance of the center. It also has a very enjoyable terrace.

We had a fantastic stay with Vacationy. The apartment was perfect for us close enough for an easy stroll into Porto but just the right distance out to have a peaceful stay. The apt was comfortable with great spaces for relaxing.
We had a fantastic stay, the terrace was so lovely to sit out on and the apartment felt spacious even with 5 of us! Walkable from the centre but up a hill on the way home! Thanks so much
The place was great and located in a great area! Spacious, pretty, clean and the kitchen had just what we needed. We had a great stay
You pay for what you get. The place is small. One bed and two futon beds. Area was quiet.

It's ok to stay for 1 night, would advise to fix air conditioning as bit hot. I understand that it was mentioned that there is no air conditioning, but if you open windows, then it becomes very noisy. Otherwise good place.
Great place. communication was helpful with clear instructions. Very spacious for a studio and it was very clean. Great stay for us!
Awesome place in the heart of Porto! André cares very much about his guests and their needs. We had an excellent stay, and are looking forward to come back in the future to André's place.
We had a great stay, close to the center of the Porto. The house is well equipped, even with coffee :)

lovely place one of the best I've stayed in.
even let me check in earlie.
the little touches like rolled up towels and oiil and vinegar in cupboard.
everyone
was so friendly

We spent a great week in Porto at Andre's. The appartement matched the description and was very clean. It is very well situated and everything is easily accessible. Getting to the appartement was very easy, instructions were clear. André is an amazing host, we had a little gift for Christmas and another one as a souvenir of Porto on our last day. We'll come back to Porto as we really loved this city and it we'll definitely be at André's 😊
We had a great stay and enjoyed our time in this airbnb! The apartment was comfortable and very clean. Andre was very kind and helped us with all our questions.

We loved our staying in Andre’s apartment! The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos! Very clean and fully equipped! It even had welcome gifts from Andre! He was very helpful with whatever we needed and very fast at his response. Totally worth staying there! 🙏
Highly Walkable. Clean room. Host is highly responsive and accomodating. Overall good quality. We enjoyed our stay.
clean and as described. local recommendations would have been helpful. very noisy street  (as expected), but windows had little sound protection.

Andre’s apartment was a great choice for our stay in Porto and probably the best located and most clean Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Instructions were clear for self check-in and we found the place easily. There was little noise at night but nothing too bothersome. We will definitely stay here again when we return to Porto!
This apartment was in the perfect place for us. Really walkable to the centre, great restaurants super close and not a noisy area.

André was a very friendly and helpful host! The airbnb was really spacious and clean. We really loved to relax at the airbnb after a busy day in the city of Porto. Also, the location of this airbnb was amazing. There were a lot of restaurants and bars nearby. We actually didn't need public transport to get anywhere in the city. Thank you André for letting us stay at this amazing airbnb!
incredible value for money, location was perfect! it was near all the points of interest we wanted to explore. Very clean as well, highly recommended.
Great location and good for our stay in Porto. Easy to access. Some noice at night on the street but overall didn’t bother us.

Amazing place. The apartment was clean, new and had more than enough space for a couple with 3 bags. The bathroom was good too, one of the biggest ones I’ve seen in Europe so far. The host was super helpful and let us store our bags in the apartment before the check in time. The location was perfect, we were close to everything. And the building had a lift, which was a good surprise. Absolutely loved my stay here and definitely recommend it.

The room was a fantastic stay, from André and Alex being incredibly responsive and flexible to a very clean and lovely room that was a walkable distance from everything in the Porto city center and Historic center! There were so many food options and the location was a good stay to experience Porto to it's fullest!
We had a great stay, it was close to everything we needed. Easy to locate. Wish we could have stayed longer.
Access up or down is a bit of an adventure, but we'll worth it for the fantastic outlook over the river and bridges.

Absolutely loved the place!
The view is gorgeous and has a nice balcony that fits 2 people.
The streets nearby are pretty steep, but it wasn‘t too hard to walk them for us. The location is a walkable distance to the centre, which we really liked. It was also very pleasant to walk in the neighborhood and we also liked the food at the local restaurant just up the hill.
Both bed and couch were comfortable, kitchen had everything we needed.

We stayed in Ricardo’s apartment for 4 nights, mid summer. We received very clear instructions regarding our arrival and the communication was very smooth.
The apartment was very clean; I couldn’t find any dirty dishes or something familiar. The view from the apartment was great and the neighbors were very friendly.
The apartment has a great view but is located on a very steep hill, therefore I won’t recommend it for elder people.
All in all, we had a amazing holiday and we keep dreaming of the incredible view from the balcony!

Beautiful views from this apartment. We also loved being able to spot it from the river, the bridge, all over!
It is up/down a steep hill with quite tricky access for vehicles, which was fine for us but definitely take into consideration if you’re less mobile.
Comfy bed, nice shower. Great stay! Highly recommend.
Host really helpful and accommodating

The view was amazing, spent a lot of time on the balcony, the kitchen well equipped and instructions easy to follow. The mattress was a bit crap as it dipped in the middle and although the location was super convenient, walking up and down the massive hill with suitcases was a little hard. But if you’re looking for a basic accomodation for a couple days, I would definitely stay again.

Great stay and great host! The apartment was easy to check in to and super clean when we arrived. The view is amazing and in a quiet neighborhood not far at all from the historical center and many great cafes and restaurants. Paulo communicated clearly about check in and check out procedures. I would stay again!

The unit is exactly as described. We loved our stay in Paulo’s home and would recommend it to others staying in Porto.
The hills are no joke so take the reviews seriously!
The only thing that would be helpful is a guestbook where visitors could share recommendations as we were told this isn’t something the hosts offer. There are many many options but having a quick reliable reference would’ve made our decision making much easier.
Cute apartment with a stunning view. It was clean and easily walkable to all the main attractions on Porto. We enjoyed having morning coffee on the balcony.
The Apartment was good there weren’t a lot of empty closets to store your stuff. When you showered a lot of the floor was wet. But the rest was good.

We really enjoyed our time at the accommodation. In the evenings, we loved the wonderful atmosphere on the balcony, watching the sunset and taking in the beautiful view of the bridges. During the day, it was a pleasure to watch the lively bustle of the ships on the Douro.
The location is quiet yet very central – everything was within easy walking distance. The last stretch up to the apartment is a bit steep, which is not unusual for Porto, and can be a little challenging with luggage, but it’s absolutely manageable.
Communication was smooth and reliable. We did miss having a dishwasher – there was a washing machine, which is nice to have, though for a short weekend stay we didn’t really need it; perhaps it’s more useful for longer stays.
Overall, the stay was very pleasant and we felt completely comfortable throughout.

Jennifer and her husband were great hosts! Communication was always super smooth and they were always ready to help!
The house is super comfortable and the pool is great for the kids!

We stayed at the house for four nights as we were attending a wedding nearby. We loved the garden, pool and jacuzzi - a great way to cool down in the summer heat. The house was nice, the kitchen well-equipped. Air-con or ventilators would have been nice, but then it was exceptionally hot during our visit. Communication with the hosts was very friendly. I'd recommend this house to anyone seeking to explore the area or who wants to chill at a pool for a few days.
Fabulous apartment in a central location. Spotlessly clean, well appointed, quiet and comfortable.  This apartment has everything you need for a couple of days in Porto. Highly recommend!

Lovely apartment right in the heart of Porto, although it’s on one of the main streets the room is very quiet because it’s located at the backside and was very quiet at night. The patio was amazing and gets lots of sunlight in the morning! The check-in process is not ideal with having to meet a separate concierge service for a specific time so doesn’t leave much flexibility to meet them if you’re wandering around the city during the day and want to be flexible about when to pick up the key. Also note that if the main entrance is not working, as it was in our case, you have to use the back entrance which is on a different street and has a ton of steep steps on a hill, not very ideal and this was not communicated to us prior to arriving. Lastly, the hot water was not enough for 2 people to take a hot shower in the morning.

The room is very well located, right in the middle of the touristy area, but quiet. Everything is walkable, which was excellent. The bathroom is clean and shower great. The kitchen didn't feel as though it was intended to be used for anything more than preparing breakfast, as staples such as oil, dishwasher tablets, kitchen spray etc weren't provided. But the location is excellent.

We had a great stay at the apartment - everything was perfect!
The check-in process was great. We were met by Esmael, who was super friendly and took time to talk us through everything.
The apartment itself was lovely, we couldn’t believe how private and quiet it was! The location was fantastic, with lots of nice restaurants, shops and cafes on the doorstep.
We hope to go back to Porto in the summer, and would not hesitate to stay in this apartment again.

Wonderful apartment in a great central location. The apartment was clean and comfortable. The neighborhood had much to offer for restaurants and was easy walking distance to explore Porto. Ruis was a very good host with prompt replies to any questions.

Perfect location! Everything within walking distance!
Apartment was nice and clean. I definitely recommend.

What a great location and host. We had a great & relaxing break in Porto and the apartment in down town Porto was exceptional - with a welcome port on arrival. Highly recommended & would hope to return soon
Neil & Phillipa

Fantastic stay at this apartment, it looks exactly like the photos. The host was incredibly welcoming and took the time to explain everything to us upon arrival. The location is right in the center, yet surprisingly quiet. Highly recommend!

The place is beautiful, immaculate, and thoughtfully appointed, and Rua das Flores seemed the perfect home base for exploring Porto. It was pretty, historic, safe, lively, and centrally located to all we wanted to see and do. Ruis and Anaelle were gracious, communicative hosts. I'd highly recommend this apartment to friends and family. Obrigada!

We had an excellent stay at this apartment
It is central and all the tourist attractions are at a walking distance. The apartment was quiet and very clean - just as described and in the photos
The host was responsive and friendly and allowed a late checkout
Some suggestions -
it would be useful to know the address for the back door - so a taxi could be directed. We were running late from the airport and it would be easier to have a key box for the apartment so the host didn’t have to wait for us and rush off to another appointment

Absolutely great little apartment right in the heart of Porto! Super easy to walk everywhere, close to store, restaurants, historic sights, and more! Host was fantastic and offered a number of local recs for food and activities. Easy to check in and check out

Great little apartment in a fantastic location. Lots of bars, restaurants and shops within a few minutes walk and very close to the train station.
The apartment was lovely and very comfortable, was nice to have some outside space. I would recommend staying here, we will definitely book here again.

The apartment was beautiful and everything was as exactly as described. But the real star of our stay was Sara, the host. Very rarely do you meet someone who is so genuinely kind and caring. She went out of her way to help us with some issues we were having in our travels. She also left us the most amazing cheese and jam platter! Thank you for everything Sara :)

Sara is a gracious and kind hostess. Her place is comfortable, modern, and stylish. You are provided with all you need for a great stay. The buses into the heart of Porto are just across the street and a very beautiful park is nearby for a lovely walk. Thanks Sara for helping to make my stay in Porto so meaningful.

Little oasis - Sara very welcoming, wine and herbs,  oils  welcome touch if self catering. Attention to detail in the garden and pool area shows how much the property is cared for. Would definitely recommend - Porto town not walkable but Uber VERY reasonable.

Such a beautiful oasis in this vibrant city. Sara’s apartment was beautiful and perfect for our short stay in Porto. The inside is light and airy and the garden just stunning and lovely place to relax.  The location is a 15 min ride into town with very easy bus and Uber options. Sara is a lovely host - helpful and friendly. Her dog Kiera also a highlight. We loved it! Thank you

We stayed at Sara’s place during our long weekend stay in Porto and it was lovely! The place was very clean and tidy and has everything you need including kitchen utensils. The bed was also very comfortable and didn’t take us long to fall asleep!
Sara was incredibly friendly and accommodating. She welcomed us and showed us around when we arrived and was always happy to answer any questions.
Ubers are readily available to get to and from the city centre. There is also a bus stop just outside Sara’s place which takes you into the city centre. If you’re travelling as a couple or small group the Uber cost per person can be cheaper than bus tickets.
The garden/swimming pool area was beautiful! Very well maintained and decorated perfectly! The pool is big enough to do a few lengths in too!
We would love to visit again one day!

A really nice place quite close to Porto city and easy to get to the centre from. A good base if like us you wanted to get out of the main area and have a place to relax after a long day of exploring.

Sara was a wonderful host. Very attentive and always responsive.
The facilities were fantastic, very picturesque and clean, boohoo chic comes to mind. My personal favourite was the outdoor hot showers for getting ready in the evening after a pool day especially for the kids!
The apartment, bedding, towels, outdoor areas, washing facilities and other amenities were excellent and succeeded expectation.
Very close to all restaurants and cafes and our favourite was The wine box. (Amazing lemon mousse)
We also had good service from uber eats who delivered to the front gate with ease and if we had wanted there was plenty kitchen equipment for dining at home.
10/10 in every aspect and we hope to return again in the future.
Thank you so much Sara!
Love Rebecca and family.

Great place to stay in Porto. Centrally located at walking distance of main sites. Plenty of restaurants in de neighbourhood.
Be mindful of the stairs when renting as the apartment is on the 3rd floor. No issue if you are in good condition.
The apartment has big rooms and are exactly as in the pictures.

This apartment is in the middle of everything. It is a beautiful place with amazing views from the upper level room. The host team is amazing, greeting you, providing local suggestions and responsive to questions that come up. We had everything we needed and more.
Great place! convenient location, hosts were super helpful and friendly. Only issue is one of the showers was really slow to drain. Otherwise great
Very nice flat downtown Porto : close to everything. Stairs weren’t a problem for us  but it could be an issue for some. The view from the top bedroom is awesome !

Overall a great place to stay, interesting layout, high ceilings, great kitchen, super location.
Got all questions answered and supplies re-stocked very fast.
Would definitely recommend to a friend.
This was a great place to stay.  Beautiful and clean!  Felt very safe.  Easy to get to.  Great host with lots of little necessities that were wonderful to have.  I would recommend staying here.

Brilliant location and incredible views of the city from the top floor.  We thought it might have been very noisy at night because of the central location but we found that it was actually quite quiet and peaceful! The hosts were really responsive and the flat was spotless when we arrived. Would definitely recommend!
Had an excellent stay. Clear check in instructions and very communicative hosts. Place itself was excellent and in a fantastic location. Thanks!
Nice room with a beautiful view👍🏻 And it was possible to get in touch with the host real quick when i have any questions! Really enjoyed the stay thanks 😊

This place was an amazing find for a great value. My room was super clean and modern with all the amenities to make me feel as if I’m at home. The host was super attentive, helpful and hard working returning messages promptly, (when do you sleep?) Breakfast was amazing and healthy. With close metro access, it takes no time to get downtown. I will definitely book a trip to beautiful Porto and stay at this place again :-)

Fred's House is a very confortable accomodation next to the Politechnic Institute of Porto and at just 10 minutes of metro from the city center. The room are very nice and clean.
Fred is a kind and helpful host, and a nice and easy person, very attentive to his guests' needs, providings a very good breakfast and tips on places to visit and restaurants where to eat.
Very recommended!

Quite, nice neighborhood, and the flat has everything you need including plenty of kitchen tools, a washing machine with detergent, and a very comfy bed. Alexandra is a great host too, she checked in with us during our stay to make sure we were doing fine!

It was great! Just a brisk walk to the centre (15 mins) alongside the river, which, we quite liked. It was very cool inside despite the hot temperatures outside. The couch slept just fine and we didn’t mind making the bed ourselves. The only downside was that there were little utensils. For example, there were some pots and cutleries but no towels to dry the dishes with nor a rack to put them in. Also, the shower drain was a bit slow so the water would sometimes spill into the rest of the bathroom. However, overall I would recommend this place if you want to stay in Porto for a few days. Thank you!

It was a nice stay. The host had some issues with the shower drain but he actively contacted us to try solve it. Good location if you like walking around a lot. But taxis in the area are not too expensive. Was a pleasant stay.

really happy with the entire stay, lovely apartment, very modern, walkable distance to centre but really cheap Bolt's.
loved every moment will stay again!! thank you
Sweet place, a bit disappointed with the bed with a hard spot in the middle but still enjoyed my stay.

The Airbnb’s Check in was very easy.
The host was very kind and tried to be always helpful, although I did have nothing to complain.
The apartment was as expected, in a nice location and in a 15-30 min range from the City Center.
Overall worth the price
Ps; go watch the sunset @ Jardim do morro

The location was very convenient and walkable, and check in was smooth.
I only stayed for one night, so I didnt use the kitchen, but only the room itself and the bathroom. Bathroom was very clean and had all the necessary amenities. Very spacious and comfortable to use.
Room itself is quite nice, comfortable and clean. There is a space to study which is really nice as well.
One thing I would say, is that due to multiple units, it can be quite noisy. I would recommend ear plugs to light sleepers. Host was very friendly and responsive.

Me and my partner had a great stay at Mike's house. The place is really central but quiet at night. In the surrounding area, you'll find a lot of nice bars and restaurants. The atmosphere on the weekends is awesome. All famous spots and sights are to be reached on foot in less than 10 minutes. Mike was an amazing host who offered support where needed. We can highly recommend staying with him. Thank you!

I recently stayed at this wonderful accommodation and had a fantastic experience. The host was incredibly kind, attentive, and understanding, making my stay truly enjoyable. The location was perfect, right in the heart of the city, making it easy to get around to any destination without any hassle. There were also plenty of great restaurants and dining options in the area, so finding something to eat was never an issue. Overall, I would definitely choose to stay at this accommodation again for three reasons: its ideal location, reasonable price, and the exceptional treatment from the host.

We enjoyed staying at Michael’s place for 8 days. There was a cleaning lady every day. The walls were a bit thin so we could hear what was going on in the house but that did not matter much for us.
Thank you for hosting!
It was a great place to stay. If I come backnI will stay at Michael’s place. It is spacious, you have everything you could need and it is close to city center.

Very nice place to stay in Porto! Micheal is a great host and will help will you with whatever you need, the house has all the amenities that you'd expect and the location is a 10min walk from the center, with loads of cafés and restaurants nearby!
Would recommend & come again!

I visited Porto last week and loved staying in Michael’s place. The room was comfortable and spacious and exactly like it looked in the pictures. There was access to a well-stocked kitchen for cooking and a nice dining space. The place was always nice and clean. The location is perfect, just a short walk to the city centre.
Michael was a wonderful host, great communication, and always helpful. Thank you and I will definitely be back.

Excellent location and kept very clean. Cleaning staff was there daily for all shared spaces.
I was working remotely from this Airbnb and it functioned perfectly fine for that. The wifi was usually stable and fast enough. I only had slight issues with the connectivity on one day, but I could still partake in meetings.

Good value, place to rest your head, clean and as listed.
Only issue was it was slightly loud throughout night with people coming and going, doors closing loudly etc
But overall, very good value for money in Porto
Michael is a really nice and caring host, the apartment is in great condition and provided with everything you need for your stay in Porto. Highly recommend.

Patricia's loft is in a premium location close to the central Trindade station. It's walking distance to basically everything you'd want to do in Porto.
The space itself is really cool, showcasing the building's history, but with contemporary and comfortable fixtures and amenities. The bed was a highlight for us, two very good nights sleep.
Patricia gave perfect check in instructions, and was always very responsive. This was perfect accommodation for us, can't fault it.
Perfect location. So many good restaurants in the area and a short walk to the water. Thanks for the great stay!

The place is central, easy to reach all things of interest, but still was quiet.
Patricia was very helpful. Can only recommend this place.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The apartment looks just like the photos. It is quiet and clean. The location is a convenient walk to lots of places. And there is a Froiz supermarket just a few blocks away.

Great location and cute little apartment. I would recommend to people without any mobility issues because the stairs to the bedroom are precarious. Also, the wooden beam above the bed is low and you have to be careful to not hit your head (which unfortunately I did).
Great loft for a short stay. Easy to walk to the major touristy spots in the city. Lots of restaurants near by and not far from a grocery store.

very easy to get to, we arrived at night, but we were able to get into the room without any problems, in general, the apartment has new furniture, everything is clean and very tidy, there is an iron, a washing machine, a fan and a hair dryer. The owner is always in touch and can always help. also a living room, and a table outside to have dinner)

Lovely Apartment. The metro is 5 minutes away and you only need 15 minutes until you're in the heart of the city.
There is also a supermarket near the apartment nearby.

The casa is exactly as shown in the listing.
15 mins from the city center of Porto.
5 mins from metro station.
Perfect place to spend a short stay in Porto.
The only thing we thought as the downside was the shared bathroom and toilet. It is shared between 4 rooms.
Because it says dedicated bathroom on the listing. May be we dint understand it.
Otherwise, it's a lovely house.
Had a perfectly fine stay at this place! Super flexible check-in and very helpful and quick responses to my questions :) recommend!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is very clean and modern, beautifully decorated, and well-organized. The kitchen was fully equipped with all the necessary utensils. Distance is probably 10-15mins walk to the main of Porto and great restaurants. I highly recommend!
Great apartment for a few days in Porto. Quite new, bright and spacious. Certainly recommended it. Tks João.

We loved our stay at Joao’s place. Joao was friendly and informative, and gave extensive instructions and help when it came to getting to the accommodation and checking in.
The location is superb. We had no trouble finding small bars, restaurants and shopping. It was a great spot to feel like a local.
The apartment had everything we needed for our stay, and the hammock was a welcomed inclusion.
I really don’t have any complaints! I would happily stay here again.
Thanks Joao!
Joao was a really good and flexible host. The apartment was really clean and in good conditions.

Sadly the intetnet didn't worked or was incredible weak to the point that it wouldn't even load messages and they did nothing about it. Also please be aware the hot water lasts very little and even with the air conditioner on he's not enough for the whole place and it's a bit cold. Also theres no curtains so if you want daily light people can see you from other windows. The bathroom also lacks a place inside the bath area to put our personal cleaning amenities. If you come witu a big bag the entry door is small and there's no elevator

Really nice place! Wifi a bit bad but when you are there you are mainly outside! Place really nicely located , 2min from a metro station and if you walked the main street down you are in the center. Host were really proactive. If you are going there in the winter I would recommend taking an extra layer at night since the warming system is not really sufficient for how huge the room is.

It was overall a really good stay! Me and my friend felt straight at home.
Location is perfect and the apartment was clean!
The only issue we had was that because the building is now detached (due to a building being destroyed next to it), it’s really impacted the insulation of the property. It was extremely cold during the night especially as there is no bed stand so our heads were straight touching the freezing cold wall. We both got sick but that’s not stopped us from having a great time overall. I would only suggest to add an extra heater near the bed and a stand to cut off the cold air coming through the wall.
Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Great location and easy check in process. Host was very communicative. The bathroom had a weird smell and we were not warned about the loud construction going on next door. Other than that, everything was fine. The room was spacious and light. We enjoyed our stay.

This is the really nice place. It's very clean, cozy, modern and well-equipped. You will find here everything you need either for long or short stay.
The host is extremely supportive. I had small issues and they were resolved fast
Place was clean and had all the expected facilities. great location to most of Porto highlights, main metro station, and many restaurants around.

This place was great. It was very clean and well maintained. It is in a great location for exploring Porto. Lots of shops , good restaurants and grocery stores near by.
Very close ( 5 minute walk) to the Trindade metro station.
Highly recommend this apartment for a great stay in Porto.
The Apart was Perfect! Very well situated and all new, with Teo bathrooms, very lightly, with all you need to spend beautifull days in Porto!
We had a superb experience at Antonio’s place.  It was safe, clean, attractive, comfortable and so close to wonderful restaurants, bars, shops and sites.  We couldn’t be more pleased with our stay.

Very clean two bedroom unit in a great location.  However, having only a three seater couch made it uncomfortable for two couples to socialize.  Unit needs a minimum of a comfortable chair and coffee table, plus new towels
Great location. Easily walkable to many things. Building was safe and secure. The apt was very nicely updated, clean and furnished. Great choice.
The apartment was very central, well laid out and very clean, quite noisy at the weekend but did not detract from our experience.
Great apartment. Very clean. Great location. Great mix of restaurants and prices. Close to airport metro station with left luggage facilities. We had a wonderful time.

It is a nice and clean apartment that is centrally located. Easy access to tourist attractions, restaurants, and supermarkets. Perfect for our family. I will definitely book again if we visit Porto next time.
Great accomodation - comfortable, clean, walkable to many attractions / bars / restaurants. Was perfect for 4 adults. Highly recommend. Would come back to this spot!

Hosts were great from initial booking to check in. Apartment in fantastic location and full of character on the outside and very modern inside. Great facilities. Highly recommend and wouldn’t hesitate booking again.

The apartment has a very good location, it is close to everything you need.
The street noise at night was loud/can be challenging if you’re a light sleeper.

The location was great. It is right near the city center with lots of restaurants, bars, and activities. Saturday and Sunday nights were a bit noisy though. I would stay there again if I returned to Porto.

A wonderful apartment, ideal for two couples.  The location is excellent, and everything went smoothly. The hosts responded to any messages very quickly and the get in was very straightforward.  I would happily stay there again and would recommend it.

This is a great place to stay. There are many restaurants, bars, and shops within walking distance. It was a great base for our adventures in the city. The apartment overlooks the street, but the noise outside was minimal. Loved the big windows and the balcony, but unfortunately it was raining so we couldn’t use it.
Absolutely perfect weekend for a few night stay in Porto. Super walkable to the main attractions and restaurants/bars. The apartment was gorgeous and exactly like the photos with a sunny terrace.

Joanna's apartment is a complete gem, one of the best airbnb's I've stayed in. It's quiet considering the street construction that was happening all over Porto while we were there, a/c works super well - we had the best sleep we've had in months. The kitchen is also very well-equipped and the place is clean, stylish and super centrally-located. Can't recommend enough.

Beautiful home right in the center of historic Porto. Walking distance to all major sights, restaurants, etc. The decor is wonderful and the space was very comfortable for our stay. Highly recommend booking for your next trip!

This is an absolutely stunning 2 bedroom, 2 bath apartment located in the heart of Porto. The apartment is spacious and well appointed. Looks as good, if not better, than the pictures. Location is perfect for exploring both sides of the river and all the historic sites. Restaurants abound in the area and beyond. We will be back to Porto and look forward to staying in this beautiful apartment again.
Such a beautiful place! Convenient to the most interesting parts of Porto as well as Gaia. Highly recommend for two couples or a family of four.

This is a great location right in the city center. Everything is really convenient. The apartment is beautifully decorated and equipped with everything we needed. We didn’t cook but everything was there if you wanted to cook. The laundry was convenient. We loved this place and we would highly recommend it.
Very clean , convenient location & host is very nice too !  Will  book again when we come back in the future !!

The apartment is wonderful…beautiful, clean and tastefully decorated.  It is like a luxury hotel with all amenities.  We could walk to everywhere.  The host was very responsive to my messages.  Our thoroughly enjoyed our four nights in Porto, a large part of which was staying at this place.  I will definitely recommend this to my friends who will visit Porto.

Everything exceeded expectations and was better then photos showed. Bedrooms and living space much roomier then I anticipated.  Valentim was excellent in meeting us and showing how things worked and made great recommendations!  Loved all the extra touches and details. Wonderful and comfortable bedding and towels. Love the slippers and robes! Great location!
Fantastic location!  Wonderfully equipped with slippers, robe and even chocolates on arrival. The host was fantastic to work with and very helpful.  Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend :)

Wonderul flat in incredible location.
The hosts were so extra communicative and kind
Highly encourage you to book this place
Great for two people or two couples
Lots of room
We had a good stay at the apartment. The house is very pretty and user friendly, I can totally recommend. Also the place has many nice restaurants, supermarkets and important stations nearby.

We can really recommend A Cor De Cá. The zone where it is located is a silent neighbourhood so you get a good rest during the night.
Jessica who was communicating with us was very helpful and we got all the necessary information in advance.
The apartment is clean and cosy, however a bit (too) small for three persons. Since we stayed out most of the time, it didn‘t bother us. In case you would like to spend evenings cooking and relaxing in the apartment, I would recommend to rent the location as a couple or with a good friend.

We had a great stay at A Cor de Cá. We received instructions in advance and it was really easy to find and access the air bnb.
Everything was in great condition and super clean, beds were comfortable.
We were able to walk to most major landmarks easily from there and on our last they we were able to leave our lugagge in reception whilst we kept exploring the city.
Would highly recommend!

Absolutely wonderful location and super cute cozy apartment! Walking distance to almost all attractions including a few grocery stores. Really easy to access the building and was grateful to be able to store our bags in the building’s shared laundry room after checkout. Nice to have an elevator and stairs were wide and safe (not common for Portugal it seems)! Beds were really comfy and the little balcony was cute. Had everything we needed except cutlery. The whole space was very clean including the bathroom (the edges of the shower were a little moldy but that’s kinda to be expected in my opinion). Honestly was missing this place as soon as we left it so would absolutely stay again and recommend to others!
Although the laundry machine is in the common laundry room on G/F, it is very convenient. Jessica is very responsible and always reposes rapidly.

We had an amazing stay at Alexandra's place in Matosinhos. The apartment was incredibly clean, had everything we needed, and offered enough space. The location was exactly what we were looking for since our trip was focused on surfing (beginners). The beach was a 7 minute walk, a Lidl supermarket at 4 minutes, and a bus/metro stop at 5 minutes. Taking the metro to the citycentre is doable (around €2 and 40 minutes) but we preferred taking the Uber. We can definitely recommend Alexandra's place!

A lovely apartment with everything you need in place. Nice size bedrooms, good beds, kitchen is fully equipped, can't fault the place. The location is close to the beach and perfect for catching the metro into Porto. Lovely fish restaurants in the area, truly a very nice place to stay. A shame about the miscommunication regarding leaving our suitcases in the property to pick them up at a later stage on our day of departure, so that we could enjoy the beach that day and catch a plane at 8pm in the evening.  We spent 8 minutes in the apartment to pick up our suitcases, changed our clothes and left again. We didn't use the showers or the toilets as per instruction but instantly received a message telling us that we took liberties by changing our clothes and disturbed the cleaning team. This was a shame and we didn't realise we couldn't change our clothes, but apart from that I can highly recommend the place.

Great location - ideal for a visit to Porto. The space is beautiful however given open concept, may be better suited for 2 vs 4 adults. Sound travels easily and given newness of space, adding a couple of more mirrors may help people share the space better. Would highly recommend based on gracious host who helped make our stay comfortable and location.

Excellent location- walkable to so many great restaurants and attractions. The apartment is exactly as it looks in the photos, and the balcony is such a nice touch. Great communication from our host, and no issues at all during our stay. Will definitely rebook when visiting Porto again and recommend this place as a fantastic option for anyone considering.

We are so happy we found Ponto’s place. It was a last-minute change in plans. This was the perfect place for us. Bright and spacious! Clean! Fantastic location.
Thank you for everything! We hope to return to Porto again & will look up your BnB first!

I stayed here with two friends and had a great time - the apartment is beautiful with tall ceilings and nicely furnished. It’s in a good location for visiting everywhere on foot. The team were really responsive and also were very helpful with organising a taxi to pick us up from the airport late at night. I’d definitely stay here again and would recommend.

We absolutely loved this apartment- from the location, to the large space, to the gorgeous balcony where we could see all the hustle and bustle. The location was so close to everything, many restaurants and sights within a short walking distance. To any bringing large suitcases- please note while this is a first-floor unit- there is still a steep staircase and a half up to the unit. This in no way prevented any access for us but it’s worth considering. The host met us and walked us through the apartment, lights, AC,  etc and helped us quickly get oriented to the city. We would absolutely return to his gorgeous Airbnb!

Beautiful well-located high quality flat. Appreciated having comfortable real beds for 4, and that the whole flat is in excellent brand new condition, super clean, and stylish. Couldn't ask for a better location. Pedro offering to book a transfer from the airport appreciated too - thank you
The apartment was exactly as described. It was quiet and yet centrally located with easy access to sights, restaurants and markets. We would return.

Everything was perfect about this place - location is central, walkable to all main attractions and yet was quiet at night.
The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed.
Communication was easy, we received all responses within an hour.
Great value for money, we would give it five stars.

Love this apartment. It’s new with nice furnishings. Located in city center where we can walk to most of Porto attractions.
Appreciated with host waiting for us to check in and explain the apartment detail.
Highly recommended
The apartment was great, plenty of restaurants and bakeries ( NATAS ) close by and close to all major attractions, we made a great choice.
We traveled as two couples and love the location and the apartment.  It was very comfortable, extremely clean and had the perfect location.  I would highly recommend this place to anyone traveling.

The location of this Airbnb is perfect in Porto and I would recommend staying here. However some amenities listed are not present in the apartment such as the washing machine and the iron. There is also no cutlery so do not book expecting to be cooking your own meals. The apartment was clean and communication was great with the host. I would stay again.

The house is cosy, beautifully decorated and well equipped. Within walking distance to lots of caffes, supermarket, restaurants, train and metro station. And finally Alexander is super friendly and accommodating, always making sure we had everything we needed. Definitely recommended. Thank you

The house is in a very central location, right next to the Campanha metro station which can take you to anywhere in Porto. The place in general was quite nice, renovated and had all equipment needed to feel like home. Definetely recommended!
Super nice apartment nearby all the hotspots. We had a great time! Host is very friendly en responds quickly. Would definitely recommend this Airbnb!
Our stay at Casaporto was perfect. The apartment is brand new, spotlessly clean and beautifully decorated. The location was excellent with lovely restaurants nearby. I highly recommend Casaporto!

Great location, close to several major attractions, comfortable modern apartament in an old building, with a very well equiped kitchen and very comfortable large bed. It was a bit smaller than expected, especially the bathroom with no space to hang the bath towels.
Hosts were accommodating by allowing us to leave our luggage in a safe location ahead of our check in time, which was also brought forward by an hour, and for which we were very grateful.
Two extremely well designed information booklets were available and they proved very accurate and helpful in advice about attractions and local restaurants and shops.
Unfortunately, we had to abstain from opening windows during the day due to noise and at times also dust coming from major renovation works in nearby buildings.

Casaporto was perfect for us. A great central location and everything within walking distance. The street was quiet but with a nice atmosphere. The room was easily accessible with a lift inside for other floors. Communication with the hosts (company) were super quick and easy. I would highly Recommend this place if you just want a base to explore Porto x
Great location, great interior and very clean. It’s quite compact for a flat but manageable for two people. Hosts were lovely.
We found the stay perfect.  The location couldn’t be beat and the flat was stylish and fun.

The apartment was very well located and great restaurants walking distance.
Monica was a great host and responded quickly whenever we had a query. I would definitely stay here again; there was a little noise in the evening but wasn't too bad.

Lovely clean place, situated at an ideal location. The host was very responsive and was kind enough to help making restaurant reservations. I was also able to drop off my luggage before the check-in time so I could go explore the city first. Highly recommended!

We had a great 4 night stay at casaporto it was very central and had lots of lovely restaurants near by. Monica the host made several good recommendations for where to go and eat in the evenings.  The apartment was spotlessly clean and smelt fresh and clean as soon as you walked through the door.

Cozy place near the heart of Porto. Close proximity to all the tourist attractions. Host was very attentive to our requests. The host communicated very well. For example we arrived early for check-in and were able to store our bags.
There is a washer and dryer in the basement. Kitchen was well appointed. Bathroom was very small but worked out fine. The bed was nice with great linens. TV had lots of options. The A/C worked great.
It is a studio so it isn’t very big. But everything in the place is top quality.
Overall I would highly recommend it because of the excellent host and the proximity to everything you want to see in Porto.

This was an amazing spot to stay in during Porto!! Had all the amenities needed, was so comfortable, had an elevator, washer & dryer, and the hosts were great!! Super close to everything and was truly perfect.  The hosts were very responsive & helpful as well!

Amazing Stay
Was there during Soa João Festival
It was close to surrounding events, but not on a main road.
About 15-20 min walk to the river, close to everything
Great Communication and Great Stay

We really enjoyed our stay and would love to come back. The flat has a beautiful interior and is well equipped. It’s on the smaller side but for a couple it’s not an issue. The check in was super easy because of the digital lock, which allowed us to arrive in the middle of the night and be inside of the flat in no time. The house itself is also the prettiest on the street and has slight illumination, so it was very easy to spot it. Many attractions, restaurants and bars in the walking distance.
The only slight downside was an odd design of the bathroom, because it’s not a proper room by itself, so it lacked privacy.
My best friend and I visited Porto for 3 days and had a great stay at Casaporto! We felt very comfortable and loved the whole interior of the apartement. We would definitely come back.

We enjoyed our stay in this clean and spacious place that’s located in the peaceful side of the neighbourhood. It’s only minutes away from all the attractions. The host was welcoming and was always available if we needed her.

This Airbnb was amazing! The entire building was so clean and high tech. There was a doorman at the front of the building during the day and the host was very responsive. This apartment was in the middle of all the popular stores and restaurants. I would highly recommend Casaporto to anyone looking to stay in Porto.
Place was perfect. Great location. Felt right at home. Only downside was very loud building renovation literally right outside are window exactly at 8am during the week.

Terrance’s place was a great spot for a 5-day stay. The terrace offers absolutely perfect sunset views. We spent hours up there taking in the stunning view and the blanket was helpful when it got a bit chilly at night. The rest of the apartment was clean, looked just like the pictures, and was the right size for 2 people. The bed is firm, but comfortable. The location is fantastic - a lot of great restaurants within a 5 minute walk, and the rest of porto is just across the water. Of note - there are lots of stairs leading up to the apartment. I would definitely stay again!

Terrace was a wonderful host and made sure we had everything we needed in terms of checking in and during our stay. The property itself is a true gem. The view from the deck is LIKE NO OTHER! The nap I took on that swing was 1000/10. Also, you can totally spot the swing from the Ribiera on the Porto side - super cool. Perfect stay for two in the cutest and much more peaceful neighborhood than what you would find in Porto. Highly recommend getting coffee/breakfast/brunch at 7g Roasters, just 5 min walk from Airbnb.

This is in the top 5 of all the Airbnb we have stayed. GREAT location; walk along the river , sample some port. Easy walk to bridge and Ribera as well as the City Center. Take an Uber or Vintage trolley out to the Foz and the Atlantic Ocean. AWESOME views; sit up in bed in the morning and the view out the window greats you, have coffee on the rooftop to greet the day and wine in the evening as you enjoy the view. Truly a special place to call home in Porto.

This was one of my favorite stays at and AirBnb. The flat had everything we needed for a short stay. Beyond the flat itself, the view of Porto was breath-taking from both inside and the rooftop. Porto was extremely walkable from here as long as you don't mind a few hills!!  If we are ever in Porto again, we will definitely look to stay here!

We loved this place and that is after travelling through a few countries. Spanking clean, with plenty of crockery, towels and even our own little setup backyard. Sandrynn was always in contact and nothing was too much trouble for her. Awesome host! We will be back!

The overall experience was okay. The room was super clean. There was a problem with a window tha didn't lock and as a result it stayed a little open and all the noise came to the inside. The location was not bad but surely not very central and convenient. I'd say fairly priced if you look at the overall experience.
Elisabete is a fantastic hostess and the place exceeded our expectations.   Great breakfast and helpful advice for local places to eat & wander.   Really enjoyed our stay!

Knowing nothing about Porto and it’s neighborhoods, we took a chance on the Blue Suite at the Art Nouveau Townhouse. And we are so glad we did. The building is located on a quiet street in Bonfim, making for a nice stroll to Baixa and Ribeira. Plenty of restaurants are a short walk from the building.
The apartment is comfortable, tastefully furnished, and well-maintained (as are the common areas). The washer and dryer available to guests are a bonus.
What stands out most from our experience is the warmth with which Manuela greeted us and the time she spent with us reviewing a map of the city and suggesting sites, restaurants, and bars. (We went to one bar and two restaurants that Manuela recommended; they were on point!)
We would love to return to Porto and stay at the Art Nouveau Townhouse again!
This air  bnb was one of our top picks for our one month vacation to Europe. Thanks for sharing your beautiful space with us to make our stay in Porto memorable!

The unit and building are beautiful. Everything was as described and the unit was well appointed with everything we might need, including complimentary snacks, coffee, and wine.
The place is exactly as shown in the pictures and feels luxurious and high end. The neighborhood is quiet but walkable and Jorge made plenty of recommendations when we arrived.
The bed was very comfortable and the shower was hot with great water pressure. I couldn’t ask for a better stay.
The place has a awesome bed, walking distance from everywhere in town, good parking place and we felt welcome

We can’t rate Jorge’s air bnb highly enough! It’s what the best air bnb stays used to be like, feeling like you are getting that little bit extra that hotels just don’t offer. Jorge’s wonderful sister, Manuela, helped us upon our arrival and talked us through a map of her recommendations of Porto, Manuela even left us avocados  from her garden and saw us off on the final day, she was fantastic! The building was beautiful and so well restored, very well equipped apartment and a very comfy bed. The location is great, easily walkable to the centre. We would recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Porto and will be returning!

Wonderful hosts, beautiful property. Book for the special touches.
We could not have asked for a warmer or more helpful checkin with Manuela who took extra time to share recommendations for the beautiful city of Porto. This property is special. A unique lounge for guests to enjoy with a range of port and whiskey, chocolates and biscuits. There is even a choice of port in your room with Nespresso coffee, teas and everything you need for your stay. Shortly after checkin we found a beautiful fruit basket outside of our room which we really enjoyed.
We loved the neighbourhood and the recommended restaurants. For our 6 nights we were transported to understand what it would be like to live in Porto as locals. This was exactly the experience we were looking for.
Don’t hesitate to book this property for a special Porto experience and warm responsive hosts.
Thank you Jorge and Manuela!

My husband and I really enjoyed staying at Manuela and Jorge’s place in Porto. It’s located in a leafy suburb just outside of the busier part of Porto but walking distance to popular sights.
The apartment is in a beautiful building of approximately 4 other apartments.. There’s a communal living room at the entrance on the lower level where you can have port, wine, fresh fruit, biscuits and chocolate. All of these items are also in the apartment as well as many amenities within the apartment.
Jorge recommended a few places to eat and visit which we visited and all were winners. Some are within only minutes from the Airbnb.
We appreciated the authentic airbnb experience with great hosts that we don’t often get.
Jorge and Manuela were fantastic hosts! I would visit again next time I'm in Porto!

Absolutely stunning boutique accommodation. The hosts were very helpful and informative. The foyer was clean and had delectable snacks and a selection of alcoholic and non alcoholic beverages. The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed. The laundry was accessible and the laundry detergent was supplied. There was also an iron. We would have loved to have stayed longer.
This was truly iconic and exceptional accommodation. The work and detail inherent in the restoration of this lovely building was  manifestly evident and tasteful.

The Blue Studio was in a perfect location in a safe and quiet neighbourhood for our week in Porto. Jorge was an excellent and caring host and took time to explain things and give recommendations (the Red Bar was a top tip)! The space was adequate for a couple but the shared laundry arrangements might not suit everyone. The studio was well provisioned with treats which is always a lonely touch. Overall a great stay in wonderful Porto!

Photos accurately reflect the unique charm of this rental. It is very clean and well equipped, and close to city center and main attractions Despite our late evening arrival, Jorge was there to receive us with a warm welcome, show us around and share great tips for our stay in Porto. We will be recommending it to friends and family.

BOOK IT NOW!! So beautiful and in such a lovely part of town, easy to walk to the attractions but also out of the way enough to be peaceful and tranquil. Our host was excellent, we got amazing recommendations for museums and local restaurants. Any time you are in Porto, this is the place to stay.

We had a great stay. The building is very beautiful and Jorge and Manuela have taken great care to remodel the interior while preserving the original architecture. Manuela was very helpful, giving us lots of recommendations and tips. The apartment was stocked with everything we needed, including chocolates, fruit basket, and wine which made for a very nice welcome. We highly recommend.

Jorge's apartment was absolutely beautiful. We felt well taken care of as Jorge sat down with us and gave us personal recommendations and overview of Porto. It was incredibly helpful and deeply appreciated as this was our first time visiting Porto. Jorge also generously left a delicious bottle of port and sparkling wine for us. The neighborhood felt safe and we deeply enjoyed our time at Jorge's. We will be back!

Staying at this Airbnb in Porto was a true highlight of our trip! Jorge and Manuela were incredibly welcoming, taking the time to sitting down with us to mark must-see spots on a local map and sharing a personalized list of restaurant recommendations; several of which became our favorites!
The building is stunning and perfectly located, surrounded by fantastic restaurants, cafes, and bars. The apartment was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had all the comforts of home; including a washer and dryer, which was a huge plus.
We also loved the cozy shared living room stocked with thoughtful extras like Porto wine, cookies, adapters, and more. Every detail was so well thought out. We can’t wait to return!

Jorge was a fantastic host—friendly, helpful, and full of great local recommendations. The apartment is beautifully decorated, well-equipped with excellent amenities, and perfectly located in a charming neighbourhood full of great restaurants, with easy access to central Porto.
We loved staying at Jorge’s place! It was beautiful and clean, and a great location. He was very hospitable and we loved all of his recommendations!

What an amazing treat to stay in Jorge and Manuela’s beautiful lovingly renovated historic townhome. Close to everything - walkable to all the great sites and the Luís Bridge it’s a perfect location for a Porto visit. Manuela and Jorge provided wonderful restaurant recommendations for our stay. The unit was spotless and comfortable and the wine and snacks made available to us as guests was just lovely and appreciated as well as the washer and dryer- wonderful stay and hope to be back another time !

Special is how I describe this accommodation. Every detail of what you might need as a guest was well done and then some. From Manuela taking us through to our apartment and sitting down to explain on a map our location and key places to see.
The building and neighbourhood was lovely. Truly a highlight on our first time to Portugal. Thank you.

This apartment was clean, tidy, and a pretty space. More importantly, it was comfortable and idle for a solo traveler. The description matched what the space had to offer. The host was very helpful, proactive and welcoming.
The location was right in the middle of the things I wanted to do in the city. Exploring Porto by foot from here was easy, and there are plenty of shops and restaurants around. When I come back to the city, I’ll definitely be booking with them. I recommend.

Very nice apartment with everything you need for a short stay in Porto. We booked spontaneously and could check-in right after booking. Communication was very proactive and fast with loads of useful informations. We apartment was well equipped and looks exactly like on the pictures. Because it’s on the ground floor, you sometimes hear the garage next door or the gate from the entrance, but nothing too annoying. Location is great and you can discover Porto by foot pretty well. We felt also pretty safe in the apartment and neighborhood. We had a great stay and can recommend the Bolhão apartment house.

Great location but yet on a quiet street which allows you great sleep. Teresa greeted up with some wine and cake from the area which was very thoughtful! She was also very accommodating to a short notice change of trip which I really appreciated. Great stay, clean & modern.

We had such a lovely night at this apartment in Porto. It was super clean, beyond cozy, modern, and beautifully decorated. Got arguably the best night’s sleep here on my whole month-long European vacation.
Teresa was so warm and welcoming, the check-in process was flawless. Oh, and the decanter of port was a really nice touch!
Obrigada for a beautiful stay, wish we could have stayed longer! Guess I’ll just have to come back to Porto 😇
The apartment was right in the middle of everything we wanted to do. It was impeccably clean and the hosts were very responsive. Lovely place to stay in Porto!

What a wonderful stay in Porto! Firstly, the check-in process was extremely smooth and instructions very clear. Specifically the host provided video instructions on how to enter the gate and doors to the building which were very much appreciated. We were delighted to find a surprise pastry and some port wine to welcome us upon check-in. Location was perfect, only about a 15 minute walk to Luis I bridge and steps from the Majestic Cafe. Very clean apartment and great to have a washer/dryer (detergent pods included) to do some laundry mid-vacation. Bathroom was spotless with great water temperature and pressure. Definitely recommend to any and all travelers in Porto!

It’s was the best stay we had in Portugal - good location close to all attractions, the apartment had very thoughtful touches that makes you feel right at home. The host was very friendly and helpful. I strongly recommend.
