We had a wonderful stay here during our time in Porto. It was walking distance to everything we wanted to see in the town center, easy to get to via public transport from the airport and overall a very comfortable space. The hosts were also extremely responsive!
It was really clean and comfortable, we had all we needed from washing machine to hairdryer. The host was really helpful and responsive. we hope we get a chance to come back and stay there again .

Had a very relaxing stay. Thank you to the hosts who were very proactive at explaining how to check in. This Airbnb had all the appliances and items that I needed to feel right at home after such a long time traveling. Would highly recommend anyone to stay here.

Better place to stay for tourists. Close to metro station and walk away from center of town. Good café’s and restaurants around the place. The room was quiet big, confortable and very clean. Good experience!

João’s place is perfect. Modern and clean appartement in a big complex with a pool right by the river that looks just like the picture. We were welcomed by the owner and got a tour of the complex, which includes a big parking garage. It’s just a ten minute walk to a bus station that takes you right into the heart of Porto (ride for around 10 stops or 15 minutes). We would highly recommend this place, if you want a lovely stay in a calm and peaceful part of Porto.

All went well during our 3 nite stay, very quiet building & lovely view over the river & sunset.  Used the bikes provided and had easy ride into the Ribeira which was great considering the traffic & people there.  Our host was very accommodating & recommended some restaurants for us, thank you João!!
Marcus’s place is wonderful! Right in the historical centre close to all the historical sites! Great and real experience of Porto! It is very quiet and comfortable! Will book it again!

Short but lovely stay. Marcus was generous and helpful the apartment I beautifully decorated and the small, intimate upstairs terrace was wonderful for relaxing in the evening and morning.
Highly recommend.
Thank you again for accommodating our late departure!!

If you want to be in the heart of Porto, in the centre of all the action - this is the place to be! The location was second to none, my husband and I absolutely loved our 4 nights in Porto. We will definitely be staying with Marcus again!
The place was very lovely and right next to the water with many shops and restaurants nearby. Marcus was very friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay again!
We cannot recommend a stay at Marcus’ apartment more highly. The location is unbeatable , scrupulously clean, simple and stylish and Marcus was so responsive and helpful. A dream !
Fantastic location! The  rooftop patio was just beautiful!  We loved it! I would stay there again and would highly recommend! Bed was comfortable! Very clean!

This was one of my favorite Airbnbs I have stayed at! The building has a great rooftop terrace that we spent both evenings enjoying. The location was great and it felt very cozy and clean. The A/C was incredible!!

Location couldn't be any better. Marcus was very helpful every time we contacted him. Obviously this is not the most quiet place b/c of it's touristic location but we earplugs we had a great night sleep. I recommend Marcus's place.

We had a great time in Porto in Marcus apartment! The apartment is extremely well located and was perfect for us navigating the city! The check in is one of the best check in experiences I’ve ever had using Airbnb and was so easy!
Would have loved the addition of an iron for ironing clothes outside of the suitcase but other than that we had a perfect stay☺️
Had to find a last minute place to stay and couldn’t have been more lucky to find such a lovely place! Great location and breath taking views, wish I could have stayed longer

We loved this airbnb. Its a beautifully renovated apartment that is very clean, comfortable and stylish. Also great location - 5mins walk to the river and 5-15mins walk to most of the old town attractions.
Marcus was a great host and very kind to let us check in early and store our luggage after check out.
We would definitely book again next time we are in Porto!

Marcus was as lovely as his place - very accommodating to my needs! I would definitely recommend his place for any to stay- I’ll surely be coming back should I visit again :) Muinto Obrigado Marcus xx

Everything was perfect for our short stay in Porto
Only thing I would recommend is extra pillows
As the pillows are very flat

Outstanding experience. The apartment was very conveniently located, was super clean and neat upon our arrival and was quite comfortable.  Communication with Marcus was terrific (timely, professional, informative) from the initial booking, to instructions for check-in and recommendations for local sites to see. When we checked in, we could not find the bathroom towels and I sent Marcus a message.  He immediately called me back to let us know the towels were laid out on the bed.  When we checked in, we had quickly unpacked our luggage on the bed and, to our chagrin, simply didn't notice we had covered up the towels. Marcus was polite and professional...  I had no sense of any annoyance from him in helping to solve our problem. I plan to return to Porto and would not hesitate to stay at Marcus' apartment again.

Wonderful and great stay! We loved Porto and this airbnb was perfect. The location was amazing and so walkable and close to great restaurants, views and many pastel da nata shops (must try!) Marcus was easy to communicate with and shared great recommendations with us!

Marcus was lovely and this was a perfect start to my trip!
Very comfortable bed linens, considerate accommodations, INCREDIBLE private patio areas (shared with other tenants but private from city)

Marcus was great with the late checkin and flexible since we were unable to meet before hand.
His parking suggestion was spot on, location and ease of finding the place was great. Place was spotless and as shown in the photos. Cozy, central to many restaurants and stores. I would highly recommend this place and would stay again!

This is a beautifully remodeled apartment. I loved the contrast of the exposed stone wall with the modern fixtures and lighting. It was all keypads and felt very secure. Marcus provided a secure place for our bags so we could explore while our apartment was getting cleaned. We stayed in five Airbnbs on this trip and this was our favorite.

We loved our stay at this apartment! Very cosy and it has everything you need. The private garden is a nice addition to it.
Appreciate your hospitality, Marcus!

This space completely exceeded our expectations. It was easy to find, amazing location with cafes, shops, the river steps away. We felt like we were in the heart of everything. The apartment was perfect-we had everything we needed in the kitchen, the bed was super comfortable and the bathroom was lovely. The rooftop terrace was so sweet and private-the perfect place to end your day with a glass of wine looking out over the rooftops of the city. We will definitely be back and we highly recommend this host and guesthouse.

The accommodations were perfect: clean, tidy and extremely comfortable. The location was excellent and very close to the waterfront, restaurants and great shopping on adjacent streets. Starting with my initial booking, Marcus was continuously communicative and was quick to respond to questions. He messaged me on check-in day to let me know the apartment was ready and  welcomed us a few hours earlier than we expected. Marcus was a phenomenal host and we would love to stay here again, should we return!

Location could not be better. So close to everything. Clean and comfortable space with a great shower! We didn’t use the outdoor space but it seemed like a nice private area. Easy to find and check in. Would highly recommend.
We had a wonderful stay at Marcus’s place. Wonderful location, very clean and very responsive host. We cannot recommend it enough!

This is a magical place. I could say more positive things about my stay here. The location is very central but not noisy in the slightest. The room is spacious and comfortable. The rooftop balcony is truly the highlight with a spectacular view of the Ribeira. Would highly recommend staying here:)

A very nice, cozy flat that has everything you need. It's located perfectly to discover porto by foot. Also nice bars and restaurants in the neighbourhood. and the little garden on the top is just perfect to have a little rest and apéro after a day full of experience ☺️ marcus is very helpful and answers always very quickly. we can highly recommend the accommodation and we definitely would go back.

Great spot to stay in Porto. You'll have access to almost all attractions by foot (although there will be a bit of climbing involved). Since we were in unit 1, we could hear moderate levels of noise from people passing by and cars. But other than that, this is a great property which I'd recommend to other travelers!
Such a cool and well thought out spot. Location was easy, the building was exceptionally nice and the AirBnB itself was very cute and had everything we needed. And loved the rooftop terrace!

The apartment was beautifully appointed and in a great location by the river! The rooftop garden was lovely for an evening wine. The only downside to the apartment was the noise. The windows are older and not well insulated and the apartment is directly above a bar. It was very loud at night. May not be a great fit if you are a light sleeper.
Excellent location just yards from the bustling riverside. Apartment is brand new and really well equipped and laid out - perfect for a city break.

We booked Marcus' place on short notice due to a hotel cancelation.  The location was great; the accommodations were nice; and Marcus was helpful getting us an early check-in.  The price was good too.  I'm happy to recommend this rental.

We had a great time at Marcus’ place. The apartment was immaculate, comfortable, cozy & had everything we needed. It was easy to get in & out of the apt, the neighbourhood is beautiful & full of places to eat & shop, & the rooftop balcony & garden was a peaceful & scenic place to read with a glass of port.
Place was great! Central to everything we wanted to hit in Porto. Cute place! And Marcus was super responsive and helped us find parking near the Airbnb

We had a wonderful time at Marcus’s place. The location was excellent and walking distance to many restaurants and boutiques.
The apartment was very charming and clean.
Such a lovely place in the perfect location. Marcus was an outstanding host. Place is as described. We enjoyed our time there and will definitely be staying here again next trip to Porto!

Loved our stay and Marcus was a fantastic host! Perfect location
Will definitely return
Only spent one night but this was a great little apartment in such an easy location! Marcus also was kind enough to let me leave my bag throughout the day after checkout. Would stay here again

We had a lovely stay at the Casa Farrapos Guesthouse! The guesthouse is tucked into a quiet winding street just off two main thoroughfares in Porto and a few winding streets down from the Cathedral. If you’re looking to be close to stores and restaurants at the waterfront but appreciate a quiet local residence, this is the spot for you!
The guesthouse has beautiful, original stone walls and windows and is neatly decorated. Our favorite part of our stay was the quaint rooftop garden providing views of the city. Visitors of the Cathedral were able to catch a glimpse of us enjoying evenings in the garden while they looked at views of the city.
Marcus was entirely communicative before, during, and after our stay. We were even able to stow our luggage before check-in time allowing us to explore the city for a few hours luggage free! We absolutely recommend this lovely residence and will definitely stay again!
Everything was clean and the place is very pretty. Only issue is that the neighbourhood is quite noisy so light sleepers might be bothered by the late night activity.
This was an excellent location - easily walkable and a the rooftop terrace was very relaxing. Thank you for making this vacation incredible.

We really enjoyed our stay in Porto! The apartment is in a great central location, making it easy to explore the city on foot. Check-in was smooth with the door code, and the strong AC was a lifesaver during the warm days. The space is recently renovated, very clean, and well-maintained. Would definitely stay here again!

We were very happy with our stay!
The apartment is in a quiet area of Porto that we know and like, meaning that it’s away from the hustle and bustle of the city center but with amenities nearby and easy public transport access to the center of Porto.
It’s a small but well equipped apartment that makes good use of the available space.
Description is accurate, and we felt it was good value for money.
We would stay there again!
Stunning apartment with a gorgeous view. Walking distance from the stadium and shops. Apartment was very spacious and luxurious and was the perfect little get away.
Great flat, but the location was poor, too far away,  looks a bit rough in that area. definitely get an uber on the night
Great place, excellent hosts, all good! The apt is walkable to the Porto hotspots and I’d gladly stay here again

This was a great place that was just a few blocks from the heart of Porto. It was easy to get to on the metro line from the airport and bus stations. It's walking distance to basically everything in the city and the room looked exactly like the photos. It was a comfortable place to stay and definitely a great choice if you want something cheap and simple in the middle of Porto
It’s a perfect place, good transportation literally in the front door, you will have supermarkets, coffee shops, bus, good restaurants (for all budgets) and of course a marvelous view of the river
Location is great, interior is also great, I liked everything. Around is cute cafe, and small restaurants. View on the river is wonderful. :)

This place is AMAZING! It was my favorite Airbnb out of a 2 week Europe trip. Ricardo is the sweetest, he let us check-in early and his wife even baked us a delicious cake for us to enjoy! The location is perfect, central but still quiet. We were a group of 6 and had plenty of space, and looked forward to coming back and unwinding after exploring the many hills of Porto :) I appreciated how modern and clean everything was and would stay again in a heartbeat.

Our stay was incredible! The host, Ricardo, was exceptionally kind, always responsive, and proactive in his communication. He personally greeted us at check-in, gave us a tour of the house, and provided a helpful map along with fantastic recommendations for local sites and restaurants. The house itself was amazing—spotlessly clean, thoughtfully designed, and filled with personal touches that showed how much care had been put into it. The location couldn’t have been better, close to top attractions like Livraria Lello and surrounded by excellent cafés and restaurants. We had an unforgettable experience and would highly recommend this place!
Thank you for the hospitality, we had a great time!  Ricardo's house was fantastic, great location, and everything we could ask.  We definitely recommend this house when visiting Porto.

The stay is very next to Porto old town. Most of the highlights were walkable distance away.
The apartment is as described.
+ very close to old town
+ access to supermarket
+ private covered parking
+ responsive host
+ welcome with a bottle of wine:)
Neutral:
old apartment building with lot of keys (counted 6 and used 5). Front door, apartment door,lift to parking lot. Parking lot entry.
- parking lot is right next to a pillar and a bit tight to enter with remote doors which closes very fast. Need expert driving skill to park
- the oven was not working and the moment we turned on to grill something entire power to the apartment was lost. The fuse tripped. Reported it and Hopefully they fix it soon.
Suggestion : They still could do with a curtain to go with the rollers.
everything is fine. but it is a pity that there is a coffee machine, but no coffee, only capsules that do not fit this coffee machine

Very nice apartment! Unfortunately, the weather was not nice enough to enjoy the beautiful patio. Very clean and comfortable. Location is amazing. Walking distance to everything and easy access to the airport (metro E is direct). Bolhao market, which is less than 5 minutes away,  is wonderful in the morning, the afternoon and a night. The check-in instructions are sent the same day, just a few minutes before check-in time (4PM). Make sure you have internet access.
Very nice apartment and the host was friendly. Also there was a bottle of wine as a gift 😍

Place and location were perfect. Professionally managed.
A couple hiccups but was fairly compensated for them at the end of the day. Thanks for the lovely stay! Would recommend.

Very nice and cosy place. The decoration with the Tin Tin posters was an original detail. We missed an extra fan and a microwave in the kitchen. Otherwise everything was perfect and the host service was 5/5.

Our stay was a pleasant one and suitable for a couple staying in Porto for a few nights. The facilities were adequate, the bed was comfortable and the location was in a good area near bars and restaurants. A couple of small things that could be improved like providing some more amenities like more toilet paper, cooking oil, tea towel as well a bit more of a guide on how to use the appliances like the stovetop and the oven. Other than this it was a great space and she is a good host.

We had a lovely stay at GuestReady's apartement in Porto.
The accomodation was as it seemed on the photos and in the listing.
Very calm street, no noise coming in. The appartement is a nice 10 min walk from the center of the town, ~20 min from the river shore.
We had every item in the flat what we needed. It is a quite cozy, comfortable space for a studio appartement.
I highly recommend it for couples.

Great apartment, much more spacious than the photos suggest and it has everything you could need. It was very clean and the location was great - lots of restaurants and bars in walking distance! We definitely recommend this place.

We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment. Although having a slight issue with check in, the host was very quick to respond and the issue was quickly resolved.  The apartment was clean and nicely decorated with Tintin posters with plenty of space for 2 or more guests. The apartment is well located in Porto, a short walk from nice bars and restaurants, we particularly enjoyed Oldman Pizza & Co around the corner! It is easy to get to the various tourist centres of Porto and we enjoyed walking to Vila Nova de Gaia and visiting the various port and wine museums in the area. We would definitely stay here again!
Great place to stay, and the host was so kind.  I'm definitely gonna stay again in the future.

This lovely place didn’t disappoint. The Pictures describes very well the place. The Hosts were great communicating. There is plenty of restaurants around the area and a short walk to the stop to the airport! Very convenient and totally recommended.

We were in Porto for a few days and the small apartment was exactly what we needed to be able to process all the impressions of the day in the evening - lovingly renovated small apartment under the roof, quiet to sleep with enough space to drink coffee in the morning.
Many thanks for the reliable communication and the large umbrella!
Amazing location. Apartment is simple and very spacious. It’s true what other reviews said about the smell- in the morning it was strong - but it was only a night, so no problem.
Full of mold, I do not recommend it to anyone. It is a clear health hazard. We woke up with a tight chest and headaches
We had a great stay in this apartment.  Odete was very responsive, provided with clear instructions for check in. Thank you!
Great location.  A number of very good restaurants on the pedestrian street right behind the apartment.  Short walk from the subway station and the river front.

My recent stay at Lovely’s place was simply delightful! From the moment I stepped through the door, I was greeted with a sense of warmth and cleanliness that immediately put me at ease. The apartment was spotless, exactly as advertised, and even more charming in person.
One of the highlights of my stay was the thoughtful gesture from the host—a lovely bottle of wine from the region, accompanied by candied nuts. It was such a nice touch and added to the overall experience of feeling welcomed.
Location-wise, this Airbnb couldn't be more perfect. It's conveniently situated close to everything, from local attractions to great restaurants and shops, making it incredibly easy to explore the area without having to travel far.
We enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean and well appointed. The location was great. Within walking distance of shops and restaurants. Would staying there.

We were very happy with this renovated house located in the center of Porto. We can walk to the main spots. It's next to the road, so you can hear a little noise at night, but it's not a problem unless you're very sensitive. Highly recommended.

What an amazing place. It was comfortable, beautiful and in the heart of heart of downtown. We were able to stay out late and come home to this beautiful spot overlooking a busy area. But when doors and windows were closed, it was very quiet. Air conditioner was good. I was able to cook in the kitchen.
The street is busy so parking is tough. There’s a parking lot on the same block. But I don’t recommend a car if ur spending several days in porto.
Really great area to stay for our girls trip to Porto! Lots of restaurants around and the apartment had everything we needed.
Great location in Porto (at the bottom of most of the hills so your commute home is downhill). Easy to get in and lots of natural light. Beds were comfy and great blackout view in the second bedroom!

Would stay here again.
Clean, comfortable, & great location.
Just as described.
Great apartment in a great location. Just as advertised. Very proactive host. Will definitely check this place out again when I return to Porto.

We had a great stay in Porto here. It's very centrally located to all the tourist attractions. The apartment itself is comfortable for 2-4 people with two beds, air conditioning in each room, and very dark at night for sleeping. The WiFi isn't the strongest but satisfactory for basic needs. Overall I'd recommend it for any visitors who want a clean, restful stay while spending most of their time outside exploring. Thanks to the LovelyStay hosts!

The apartment is modern with a great location. My family of 4 was comfortable for a city apartment.  The apartment was clean and had most needed items in the kitchen. We were able to walk to everything.  We would stay at the apartment again when visiting Porto.

Luis was amazing host and the communication was very easy and fast. The place was on great location and you have everything necessary close. Not far from downtown. Rooms are small but clean and cozy and as well as the house was cleaned daily. i definitelly recommned Luis place if you plan visit Porto.

Joana was a lovely host, very friendly and helpful. The apartment was tidy and in a nice area.
Unfortunately I couldn't sleep because you can hear the street noise of cars from the room all through the night, it was constant.
Also, the pillow cases on the bed did not feel or smell clean, and there were stains.
It was really nice to stay with Joana, very uncomplicated. Perfect for a few days. Thank you!
Paula's place was beautiful, spotless clean and well stocked with Tea, Coffer and breakfast supplies. She was a gracious and welcoming hostess and the location was fantastic, very close to the sea.

As a family of 4 Paula’s place was ideal, spacious and modern and a very short walk to the beach. Paula greeted us on arrival and very kindly bought us pizza’s as we were late getting in, she checked us in seamlessly and gave us all the local recommendations. Paula checked in regularly to make sure we had everything we needed, a great host.

The pics were accurate. The place was clean. The company that owns the apt is 2 doors down if you need anything like a new towel, directions, or luggage storage. It is in a very central neighborhood. Great for a 1st visit. Americans: the 4th floor wall up is the 5th floor as the ground floor is 0.

Had a short stay of just a few days in Porto but this was such a great air bnb. A bit on the small side but the location was perfect. The host was awesome and the office we had to pick up the keys from was conveniently located next door. I would recommend for maybe 1-2 people max but overall great place and great experience

Small, cute apartment in a central location. It’s on the top floor and the elevator was not working - not a problem for us but worth noting if you have a lot of luggage or mobility issues. A good experience!

Very nice apartment in a central location. The apartment is right next to their office which came in handy for checking in- and out. Communication with the host was very easy through chat, and always straight away
Comms was great, every question was answered right away. Location is so convenient it being a few mins away from Sao Bento station. Clean apartment and check in was a breeze.

Super central location. Really cute place. Super easy check in and so handy you can leave luggage with them at the check in desk. Only downside was limited crockery with only 1 tea cup in the whole place but asides from that great accommodation

This location was amazing. Walkable to everything, great sunset spots, restaurants and cathedrals. Timeout market is just behind it and the location is so quiet. Great afternoon sun on the deck too. Couldn’t recommend more. Will be telling everyone
Francisco is here for you, really nice and he answer fast. The house is in a cute neighborhood near the bus station.
Francisco‘s place was nice and welcoming. It was very clean and looked like the pictures. It‘s a tiny room but has everything one needs for a nice stay. We can only recommend Francisco‘s place.

Everything was as described. I couldn't sleep the first hours, due to cars passing but that's me. I'm very sensitive for noise... The place was perfect!!! And the contact with the owner was all the time quick...

Quiet and cozy space. Perfect for one to two people.
The host was very kind, responsive and clear when delivering instructions.
It is close to the bigger city and there are plenty of tasty restaurants nearby to try.
I enjoyed my stay and would return. :)
Gabriel was very helpful with any of our questions. Parking was a bit difficult but we got it all worked out. Thanks
Nice quiet place. Has what you need. I was surprised by the pull out cough bed but it was large enough and comfy so no problems!

A tiny 1-room apartment near the bus station (Flixbus/ Rede Expressos). It’s really not more like one tiny room with a bathroom, but it’s perfectly fine for one night. You can just make a nice little walk to the places of interest (half an our) or use the bus/metro. The communication was very clear and friendly.
Just the light could be a little warmer to have a more cozy atmosphere. But all in all it was a really nice stay. I would book again :)
Beautiful apartment, close to lots of crest restaurants and public transit. Hosts were quick to respond and very accommodating.
Such a beautiful and clean apartment. Great place to stay with friends or family. Definitely going to come back as it was worth it. Felt right at home.

If I could give more than 5 stars for this review, I would. Joana went out of her way to greet and welcome us with a bottle of wine and gave us a tour of the house.  She also spent a great deal of time advising us of the area attractions and recommended excellent restaurants. She made sure all the essentials needed for our stay were well stocked. The apartment itself is beautiful, new, spacious, well cared for and very clean. Joana’s kindness, generosity and professionalism are the standard EVERY Airbnb host should be judged by.

Lovely apartment more spacious than expected and very good facilities
Good communication easy to check in and out
Response very quick to queries
Loved Porto

The place was spacious and had everything we needed for our stay ( 3 families). Perfect!
The tips Joana gave us were great: local places to eat ( the food was great) and the use of Uber ( so worth it for a few Euros).
I would recommend her place.

Great location in Porto with nice restaurants. Easy walk or ride to the heart of Porto. Joana was a great host with many good recommendations and attentive to our needs. Would highly recommend the spotless clean home.
Wonderful place to stay! Very clean and great location to uber into town! Lots of room for our family! Joana was a great host - very helpful and responsive!

Joana was great with our group of 8. Having laundry in the condo was a huge help. The location although a bit noisy sometimes due to a busy road, we slept well and had easy access to the highway and downtown. Having the 2 parking spaces was also a great asset.
I would highly recommend.

Perfect place for our large family. We had so much space and it was walking distance to essential shops and restaurants.
We loved Porto and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend

Great place to stay in Porto, very close to the center yet far enough to escape the noise and crowds, flat is spacious and has everything one can need, it was great to have a washing machine and a parking spot included, definitely recommend.

Eduardo E Elisabete are wonderful hosts who are thoughtful and communicative. It was a pleasure to stay in their flat. The place is newly renovated and in excellent condition with everything you would need and the location is excellent.
excellent apartment in porto! great location, super clean, plenty of space for two people! would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Gorgeous place, better than in the photos even
Good location and lots of nice bars and restaurants a few minutes away
Beautiful apartment, very comfortable stay.  Would definitely stay again. Our host met us and showed everything in the apartment, which was very welcoming!

A very comfortable appartment with wonderful shower and lots of light. It has everything needed for a great stay.
location was convenient although it is on a busy road, but the road was quiet at night. I would definitely recommend it.

We loved our stay at Daniel's place! The accommodations were beautiful and very clean. Daniel was helpful, responsive, and provided clear instructions for check-in/out. Would stay here again the next time i'm in porto!
Beautiful, fully stocked home. Easy walk to the main tourist sites and restaurants. Street parking right outside. The home is very, very spacious.

Daniel and Luisa were very accommodating. The place was large and clean.
Thank you!
A lovely stay in a beautiful apartment that had everything we needed. In a quiet part of town but very walkable to the city centre
Wished we stayed longer! This place was so comfortable and clean, and a great quiet location close to the action.
Fernando was an awesome host. Always kind and responsive. Beautiful apartment and close to many attractions.
Fernando was a super host to a super appartment! Felt so comfortable and the place was spotless. Really enjoyed out time in Porto and it’s walking distance from everything! Thank you
Amazing location, clean and access to a free closed garage. The flat is nice. The only downside is the lack of darkness for the room on the first floor and the noise of machinery closeby

The apartment was clean, comfy, and the perfect place to call home while we stayed in Porto. The apartment had everything we needed and was a great walking distance from so many great sights and restaurants. So glad we chose this area for our stay. Fernando was an amazing host and even helped us arrange airport transportation. Him and his hosting partner were super responsive through our entire stay.

Such an amazing stay! Fernando was an extremely considerate and flexible host, helping us get an early check in despite our travelling mishaps. His response time was immediate, regardless of the time zone from where I messaged. His place was absolutely stunning! We were shocked at how spacious, clean and modern it was. He even provided some complimentary wine and bath supplies. Truly wonderful, wish we had booked more days there.
Great space and location ! Definitely recommend for 3-4 people staying. And Fernando was a great host too

We had a great stay in Porto at this apartment! We were met at check in and given a list of all local recommendations that were absolutely delicious.
The apartment was so nicely decorated, comfortable and clean. Would highly recommend

Fernando is a wonderful host! Very responsive and met us when we arrived at the apartment building to let us in.
The apartment is exactly as described and a great home base from which to explore Porto.

We enjoyed our stay here. Great location, decorated nicely, clean and soft linens and towels, clean kitchen and bathroom and had everything we needed. Very walkable and on a street that cars can go down which was convenient. Would recommend this place to anyone going to Porto.

A perfect apartment located in a great area just on edge of the hustle and bustle. We loved the location and apartment suited our needs very well. If your thinking of booking you wont be dissapointed.

Great location and very comfortable apartment.
Fernando was very responsive. Parking was a huge bonus.

The place has everything you need and it is closed to restaurants and supermarkets. Also if it is your first time in the city, there’s a sightseen bus stop just in front of the building, super helpful if you want to discover the city

Hello Fernando
thank you for letting us use your Apartment
Everything was the way I expected it to be. A genuinely niche place to spend a few days while visiting Porto.
there were o ly a few Points that need to be thought through.
1. A few more cleaning accessories.
..there were no clothes for wiping the Tabel and /or Worktops.
2. Better cleanliness check.
..there were a lot of Dark Hairs Caught up in the living and bathroom furniture.
3. The silicone seals at the bottom of the glass around shower needs to be changed. it leaks so much so that water makes it into the bathroom.
.
Fabulous location for  this beautifully furnished flat. Parking very user friendly and super clear & responsive communications with host!

Fernando’s place was awesome for a few days in Porto! It was centrally located and easy to find. Fernando gave clear instructions for getting in and offered recommendations for around the city. The view was incredible! And the beds were very comfortable!

The apartment has great location with everything you need very close by.
However the description and the reality is different. This is marketed as 1bdr apartment in the ad, so this is not true.
The apartment in fact is a studio with the wall separating the bed from the rest of the apartment.
So this is very small studio. The king bed almost touches the wall. No space to put the luggage. The sofa doesn't unfold so its not possible to sleep and again its very small and hard.
The truth is that this studio is only for 2 people MAX.
The cleanness of the apartment could be much better.
The sink in the bath got clogged right after the first use.
So i don't recommend. There are much better options.
Very comfortable size for 6 adults and 1 baby. Kitchen/dining area is great is you want to cook a meal or two. Location is fantastic for getting around porto. Highly recommend!

The host/management company was very responsive, even walked us to our door. The management office is where you pick up your keys, less than a 3 min walk away. They gave me recommendations for things to do, restaurants, etc. The unit had a great view and came with everything that we needed.
Extremely pleasant stay, big living room and well equipped kitchen and dining area. Very spacious house with 3 rooms and very responsive host.

The apartment is located in a perfect location, in the heart of Porto. It was beautiful and clean, ideal for a comfortable stay. Our hosts were very friendly and helped us with anything needed throughout our stay.

While a bit pricey, the location can’t be beat. This beautiful apartment has city wide views from the back balcony and a stunning view of the church from the front. The stairs to the apartment are quite steep.  The ‘attic’ bedroom was the best!

Lovely accommodation exactly as described and pictured.  We were able to check in early which we really appreciated. Anything we needed was provided and made our trip to Porto very memorable. Very close to all amenities and everything is walkable!

Apartment wit spectacular views from the windows, absolutely breathtaking.
I loved the apartment’s smart layout: rooms, charming small windows, yet everything we needed was there.
Cozy, functional, and thoughtfully designed.
Would gladly stay again.
excellent place, with car  parking in garage, we arrived late hours, there was no problem, we requested parking after checkout solution was provided I highly recommend.
Everything was fine! We really enjoyed our stay in Porto and would always stay in Cristina‘s apartment again.
The place is very clean and comfortable, just as shown in the pictures. Nice location, good value, recommended.
it is a great place close to everything. The room is a little small but it is fine for two people.

Nice clean place. Carlos is so friendly and helpful.
The bed was a bit of cheap kind and made some noises. Not a big deal since Carlos said that he is replacing it with a better one soon.
nice clean place near metro and the flat is upstairs from 2 cafes, 1 meat market, and 1 vegetable market so it is very convenient

Fantastic accommodation. Incredible surroundings. Pool was beautiful - with a great shallow section for smaller kids to use.
Private grounds. Peaceful and relaxing space.
Close to Porto and the airport. Would thoroughly recommend.
a lovely peaceful stay in the beautiful wooden cabin. really cosy and amazing pool with shallow kids pool. excellent hosts- would highly recommend.

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment!
The apartment itself is perfect.
The bed is comfortable; the kitchen has everything you need; the sofa is comfortable, and there is a smart TV to use; there is a nice balcony with a table and two chairs to use; the bathroom was spotless and spacious AND the apartment is air conditioned.
The building it is in is nice and feels modern; there is a lift, and all the corridors are well lit.
Carolina (co-host) was very responsive and super helpful. I had all the information for a swift and easy check-in, and the WiFi password all before I arrived in Porto.
The apartment is very close (10min walk) to Trindade station, and also there is a supermarket between the station and the apartment.
I would definitely recommend staying here when visiting Porto. It was a fabulous place to stay at.

Greta Spot. Very quiet for that location and Porto standards.(mostly seagulls rather than street noise). Very close to supermarket, gym, bars and amazing restaurants. Apartment is very clean and has everything needed. The Cutlery a bit hidden but it is there :)

A lovely spacious apartment in a great location in Porto. We thought this was fantastic value for money. While it is in a central spot, it’s still very quiet at night and the bed was comfortable. It was new and clean and had all the amenities we needed for a four night stay.
It’s worth mentioning the shower pressure wasn’t the best, but this didn’t impact how much we enjoyed our stay.

The apartment was clean, very light and comfortable. The balcony was great and the bed was very comfy! The area is lovely and it is walking distance from everything. Would definitely recommend!! 10/10
We wouldn't hesitate to make a reservation here if we return to Porto. The neighborhood is very convenient, the apartment is excellent, and it's close to everything.

The place is a good location, it’s a little more north than some touristy sites but still in central area and surrounded by a lot of restaurants, bars and stores. The place was very clean, spacious for two people and bed was comfortable. Check in was also easy.

Great place for the price! The location is ideal for exploring the city. The apartment has an air conditioning which helps to warm it up quickly during the cold winder months. I stayed for four days and felt at home. Plus, I was able to cook homemade meals and enjoy Netflix during the stormy January weather
:)

We had a great time staying here for our time in Porto. So easy to get around the city from here and a comfortable, quiet place to stay. Great communication and quick responses too. Would highly recommend

We really enjoyed our stay at the apartment - it was spotless and the location was great. The hosts were super responsive, including at unsociable hours. The door to the apartment was slightly awkward to open at first (requires a bit of force) but soon got used to it. Would happily return!

Our stay at this apartment in Porto was excellent. The apartment is within walking distance of the city center, surrounded by numerous cafes, restaurants, and shops. The place was spotless and modernly furnished. The host was very attentive and helpful; the check-in process was seamless. We highly recommend this apartment to anyone wanting to explore Porto!
Very good location!  <10 min walk to many City sights.  Many restaurants and shops nearby.  Very clean and comfortable unit!

Porto is worth visiting.  We were very comfortable in Joana‘s place and found lots to do within a few steps of the door from restaurants, to galleries.  We were 10–20 minutes from several attractions.   We loved sitting on the balcony and felt at home.

This is the perfect place for vacation. Apartment was clean, beautiful and cozy. The host was met us and told all the instructions.
We were very pleased! I recommend!

Amazing location for your Porto stay. Easy communication and very helpful.
The street is busy at night but you are right in the heart of the action. Spacious, clean and cool.
Loved it

As described!
Very good location, RIGHT in the center, but therefore also a bit noise - which we didn’t mind.
Very responsive when texting. Great choice !

We loved staying at Joanna’s beautiful place. The apartment is gorgeous, stylish and newly renovated with luxury towels, sheets and robes. It was very clean and comfortable. Also the surrounding area is walkable to many of the most famous destinations in Porto, but still has a very local neighborhood feel. Joanna was also a wonderful host - so kind and helpful. I would love to stay there again and would recommend highly.
The apartment was great and the hosts were kind, responsive, and really helpful. it's amazingly quiet despite being in a great area.

Joana's apartment was perfect for our 3 night stay in Porto! Having a garage to park our rental car was important, and having a full kitchen - including electric kettle, coffeemaker and toaster - made it the ideal rental. Location is fantastic with lots of shops nearby - we ate a particularly good dinner at Meia Nau, a short walk away.

Joana, Melissa and Valentim were great hosts - very responsive and helped us schedule drivers on short notice. The place itself is indeed quiet, comfy and in a perfect location for seeing pretty much everything in Porto. Would definitely stay again.
Very close to the metro (1min walk) and city centre, safe community, nice apartment. Overall very good.

We really enjoyed our stay. Amazing location, easy to access to everything.
Claudia was very helpful and always available to help. Thanks ❤️
The aprtment was beautiful and very clean. The location was perfect, we could everywhere. We didn't have to use public transportation even once. We would love to come back, strongly recommended!

We’ve had a great time in this nice, clean apartment! It’s a quiet neighborhood and near the center (easy to walk). Carolina arranged a taxi for us, the communication went really well. Thanks a lot! Definitely would recommend this place!

Carolina’s place is well located and provided us everything we needed for a few days in Porto. The only issue was an extremely intense sewage smell. We asked her about it and she told us it’s an ongoing structural problem so I would recommend asking if it’s resolved before booking.

Place was exactly like the pictures. Super clean and well decorated, we really enjoyed it.
The walls were thin though, but at least we know the upstairs neighbours enjoyed it too. Twice ;)
All good - a bit of an issue with the wrong code for the key lock on check in and AC not really working, but all in all, good experience with a fab tub!
This Airbnb is in a great location, has great decor, very easy to check in and out of, and loved the water and snacks left for us when we got there. Would 100% recommend!
Had a wonderful detail stay with Claudia, and place was well equipped with water, snacks, and even a bottle of something special from the host! Perfect location

Great helpful host. From booking information passed to aid with stay. Price was right, location was right for us , close to lovely spots for evenings. Highly recommend host and apartment. Excellent stay in Porto 👍🏻
Centralized location, very clean, lovely view from the balcony and well maintained. Would very much recommend the apartment.
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Had absolutely everything we needed and absolutely fabulous balcony, we loved it.  Comfy beds and good air con. Would totally recommend. Tastefully decorated.

I had a great stay at Carolina’s apartment in Porto. The place is spacious and perfect for four people. The description is accurate, and the apartment was clean and easy to reach. Check-in was smooth, and the instructions were clear. Carolina was very kind, attentive, and quick to respond to any questions. The apartment is in a convenient location, close to a main shopping street and areas with lots of restaurants. Overall, a very positive experience. Highly recommend!

What a beautiful stay in Porto — spacious, comfortable, and walking distance to everything! The balcony was our favourite; place to sip your morning coffee or your evening wine and listen to the city. The perfect place to help us explore the city and all it had to offer!
excellent host and an excellent property, would reccomend to anyone looking for a nice place to stay in Porto for a great price.

Great apartment and perfect accommodation for a trip to Porto, sits on a quiet street, but also super close to some amazing places - including Bolhao market and Metro station.
Apartment was more spacious than it looks in the pictures, and it was a great 'homebase' to explore Porto. It had everything we needed and we thoroughly enjoyed chilling there between our adventures in the city! Balcony is also a major plus for us, when we had the chance we sat out there for meals and a cheeky drink of port!
Host was extremely responsive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the trip. Was aldo open to suggesting places and advising, which is a nice touch. We even had transfers from the airport arranged for us, which was very helpful and convenient. I'd highly recommend this place and when I and my family return to Porto (cus' it's great!) I'd stay here again :)

I had a lovely stay at Claudia’s place. The apartment does not have a lot of natural light, but it is stunning. The location is central, close to authentic Portuguese restaurants. Coffee capsules were provided for the Nespresso machine. Communication with Claudia was very good.

A very nice little apartment in a great location that is a relatively short (downhill) walk to the majority of tourist sites.
Very clean and equipped with a huge bath and basic kitchen including a pod coffee machine.
Unfortunately it is right at the front of the apartment block (other properties I'm assuming owned by the same company upstairs). This means you have the sound of the street door opening and closing early in the morning and late at night. You ability to sleep is also at the mercy of whatever guests are upstairs and whether they will have a 0230 argument...

This was a great place that would have received 5 stars, however, the pool was out of use during our stay which was a great disappointment and would have been good to know about prior to arriving. Other than this the apartment was extremely clean, easy to access and has some great local places to drink wine 🍷!

Lovely place and beautifully decorated. It is in a good location 20 minute walk to the city center. There are coffee shops in the area for breakfast. Plenty of space. Although on a street with traffic (not heavy traffic) the bedrooms are at the back of the home so peaceful sleep super quiet at night.
wonderful apartment with a very good location. we liked everything very much. the apartment was very clean and cozy

What a beautiful apartment! The apartment has large rooms with laundry area and large back patio to relax after a busy day. Beds are comfortable and bathrooms nicely finished. Good quality dining and living room furniture. Extremely clean. Great neighborhood and within walking distance to attractions.

Paula and Rafael’s place is incredibly beautiful, super spacious, aesthetic and makes you feel right at home. I would give it a 9/10 location wise. To get to the river it’s about a 20-25 min walk. We travelled with an 8 month old and we felt very comfortable in their home. We even took her to the back pool that she enjoyed. I was even able to use all amenities in the kitchen to cool her a home made meal! Thank you for sharing your beautiful space Paula and Rafael
Very nice apartment in a good location.  There is a 24 hour parking garage close by.

My family and I really enjoyed our stay here. It’s a very comfortable apartment. The beds were comfortable and we loved the extra pillows. The area doesn’t have any restaurants right by, but a short drive away there’s lots of choices.
Would highly recommend staying here to anyone. Loved visiting Porto!

A very relaxing stay with everything we needed!
Very comfortable beds although quite a walk to main area it was nice to escape the real tourist areas
Incredible shutters on the windows very peaceful sleep

Great location in the heart of Porto.   Easily accessible.   Apartment was clean, very cozy and well stocked.  Loved having the washer in particular right in the unit.  Kitchen had everything I needed.  Was a great place to stay and I would highly recommend it!!

I loved this place 200%
Miguel was kind and fast to respond and also introduced famous spots.
The place was cozy and perfectly clean.
Most of all, the location was so great. I could walk to San bento, bolhao market, groceries, and shopping street.
Doors are safe and easy to lock&open.
Elevator was also very helpful to move my luggage.
If I come back to Porto, I definitely will stay here again.

5 stars
We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Porto! The location couldn’t have been better—right in the heart of the city and walking distance to everything: restaurants, shops, the riverfront, and all the main attractions. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Would definitely stay here again!

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment exceeded our expectations - modern, spotlessly clean with a stylish design. The elevator was a bonus! WiFi connection was reliable, allowing us to work remotely without any issues. The neighborhood itself was quiet, safe and conveniently located near bakeries, cafes, supermarkets and some restaurants. Contrary to some reviews, we found the area to be secure, even at night. We felt comfortable walking to nearby grocery stores for late-night essentials. A huge thank you to Leo for his exceptional service and hospitality. He warmly welcomed us during check-in ensuring a seamless process. Leo went an extra mile to provide invaluable insights on Porto's hidden gems, top sites and local eateries. His prompt responses and helpfulness made all the difference. Also, the 15 minute walk to central Porto was easy, passing through safe and flat areas. We highly recommend this wonderful property and would stay here again. It is the perfect home away from home!

Wonderful apartment in Porto!
We stayed in this apartment for a few days and were absolutely delighted. It’s spacious, stylish, and very cozy—everything you need for a comfortable stay. We especially loved the modern interior, comfortable furniture, and impeccable cleanliness.
The hosts were very friendly and responsive, always available and provided great recommendations.
We would definitely recommend it to friends and would love to stay here again!
The stay exceeded our expectations. Definitely contributed to our great experience in Porto. Ana was a great, communicative, sweet host.

Our stay in Ruy's flat was really great.
It's well located with near a mercado, the metro, shops, bakeries and so on and we were able to visit several places by foot.
The flat has all the necessary amenities and we loved how it is very cosy.
Ruy was really welcoming and he gave us great information on places to visit.
If we return to Porto, we will not hesitate to book again this flat, we recommend it!

Stayed a week with a girlfriend and it was just right for us.
Clean apartment and very convenient minimart just next door.
Excellent location, walking distance to all the top spots.
Rui was an amazing communicator and had very good recommendations for us.
Definitely recommend for a short trip.

Loved this beautiful loft airbnb! Felt right at home, location was amazing. Super walkable to everything! Just be mindful that if you’re a really tall person, you might feel a bit clausophobic  in the bedroom since half of the room is slanted by the roof. Overall this is one of my favorite airbnbs and would definitely stay here again!

This Airbnb was very clean and offered several amenities. Portoclass was very responsive about any questions I had. The location is perfect as it is one block away from one of the main streets which made it quiet but very convenient for walking to shops and restaurants.

Very nice apartment in a very convenient location - easy to walk to all sites and very close to metro for getting to the airport. Comfortable and modern. Great, helpful host. Only slight negative is the outside noise in the bedroom coming through the exposed roof.
But overall, a lovely place to stay.
Extremely well appointed and cozy stay. Host was helpful and awesome communication was key to our stay in Porto. Love it. Thanks for everything.

Enrico was a fantastic host! He was very responsive and helpful when we arrived a little earlier than excepted. The space was perfect for us, the room was clean and we had an easy walk to restaurants in the area. Breakfast was delicious and the staff was all very kind and friendly. I would definitely stay again, great air bnb!!

I can't say enough about Enrico, his family, his Airbnb and his VERY Delicious food. This establishment is run by Enrico, his wife and their two sons. They are the absolute sweetest people you will ever meet. They were very knowledgeable and helpful when planning our daily excursions. Coming for a loving family, I felt right at home. Most notable of our experience was the food. The room comes with a breakfast which consists of fresh squeezed juices, homemade yogurt, fresh baked breads, delicious meats/cheeses and coffee. More importantly, you should make time for the dinners that are served in the evening time. I've spent many years in the restaurant industry and the food being served at Vila Camila is TOP NOTCH. If I find myself back in Porto, I will definitely stay in this wonderful establishment.
Thank you for a memorable experience!

Location great for the football but also the centre was easily reachable. The apartment was as advertised & Tomas, the host was maintained good contact along with the daytime receptionist who was very helpful. Would definitely stay there again.

Awesome spot. Close to everything. Plenty of fun places to walk to. Just outside the touristy zone. 1/2 a block to Cedofida that’ll connect you to most of downtown and eventually the riverside. The Pingo supermarket has two locations within walking distance as well. We took the bus to Matosinhos a couple days. Beautiful apartment with everything you need.
The place is fantastic. Looks even better than the pictures. Co-host Ana is being very responsive and friendly. It was a pleasant stay.

Staying at Ana’s flat made my trip to Porto so much more enjoyable and lovely. It grants an immersive experience into Portugal and would stay there again if I were to ever come back! Ana also sent a lovely list of local recommendations that were amazing! The thoughtfulness and warm hospitality contributed greatly to making this trip so memorable.

We absolutely loved our stay at Ana's place! We were there for a week and we didn't want to leave. It's spacious with lots of natural light, beautiful decor and a well equipped kitchen. Ana provided us with lots of amazing local recommendations. Would absolutely recommend staying here!
We were two people and had a nice stay in Porto. Supermarkets, restaurants, bars, cafés, public transport etc. on walking distance. Clean bathroom, nice kitchen, warm atmosphere.

Miguel and Ilze's place was very clean, easily accessible and perfect for a short stay in Porto. It's about 20m walk to the center of town, close to some nice cafes and quiet at night. I'd recommend it .

Lovely and spacious place for a solo traveler. Would 100% recommend booking, location is good only a 20 minute walk from most places.
Would book again.
Berta is a hospitable hostess. The apartment is in good condition, has everything you need. It is located in a nice place.

The apartment was smaller than we thought, but it had everything we need. It is very clean, beautiful and well equipped. Unfortunately, at the time of our stay there was a construction site on the street in front of the apartment, which made it a bit noisy. We still had a nice stay there.

This place was absolutely lovely — the ocean views were stunning and the home itself was modern, beautifully maintained, and incredibly comfortable. It was the perfect setting for a relaxing girls’ weekend celebrating my birthday. Every detail made our stay feel special, and we couldn't have asked for a better spot to unwind, laugh, and soak in the beauty. Highly recommend!
so blessed to have found this place :) beyond spacious and loved the location to look at ocean not far away at all from the busy city.

We couldn't recommend this apartment enough! It was the perfect size for two, in a great location that felt less touristy but still a stones throw from all the sights. There are some great bars and restaurants nearby, and José was there to recommend anything we needed. We would absolutely stay here again!
A fantastic location, out the way enough to have a peaceful sleep but still so close to all the hustle and bustle that Porto provides!

A comfortable flat in a really great location.  A short, uphill walk from the river and near to the lovely Rua das Flores and the Torre Dos Clerigos, so easy to visit many of the main attractions.  We found some good places to eat nearby too - brunch almost next door, Cafetaria da Bolsa at the bottom of the hill,  and for us the star attraction was O Fado, Largo Sao Jose Novo - a treat to eat here - delicious food, great service and Fado music - only 5 minutes from the flat.  The flat is also very near to the Miradouro da Vitoria where you can watch the sun set over the river.  The host is very responsive - replies very quickly to messages.
A very comfortable apartment in a great location. Host was very responsive, left us clear instructions and also provided recommendations on where to eat and what to do. Thank you!

Great communication overall from the host. He sent us pictures beforehand of the entrance to the building and gave a detailed explanation of how to get in. The apartment itself was very nice and in a great location, just a short walk away from a park and the river. The view from the apartment was great as well. Would definitely stay here again.

Apartment is great for a long weekend. Compact in size but perfect for a couple getting away. Location is good and just a short walk from everything you require. We did have some issues with the bathroom which José said he would address. Would certainly recommend.

Super close to downtown porto but in a chill area-
I will definitely stay there again!
Flexible and communicative host!

Jose was a wonderful host  always helpful and responded quickly. The apartment was comfortable and  a great location, an easy walk to the town.  Porto is a very pretty scenic city and our stay in Porto was made more enjoyable by having a great host in Jose.  Thank you Jose.

Juan Carlos is an amazing and thoughtful host.
The apartment is very nice, clean and in a great location.
If you come by car there are some affordable parking garages nearby, which Juan Carlos assisted us with.
Highly recommendable experience.

Very nice apartment that fits the pictures perfectly. Jose welcomed us personally with a precise introduction, he was very considerate and we felt very welcome in the apartment. Only minus is noise from the big street nearby. The windows take most of the noise but light sleepers should maybe bring ear plugs :)

José was a wonderful host and the apartment worked great for our family of 5! I would highly recommend! It was easy to walk all around the historic area and when or little kids were tired of walking it was very easy to catch an Uber. The apartment was very clean and tidy and well equipped with all we needed. José, his wife, and daughter greeted us upon check in, showed us around the place and gave us great recommendations for food in the area. I also highly recommend a visit to the MiBa Artisanal Bakery just a short walk from the apartment for incredible pastries and coffee! We loved our stay in Porto!

Apartment very clean and centric.
The communication with the host was so good.
I recommend it

The place felt super nice and cozy, and had everything you could need! We were pleasantly surprised by the amount of amenities in the place, and everything felt clean and lovely. We were even greeted by complimentary wine and biscuits! We had a great time, and would definitely recommend this place.
Great location and beautiful apartment. I didn’t have any problems with noise even though it’s a busy street. Kitchen has everything you need.
Great place and great host. Checkin process was smooth. The apartment was clean, very comfortable , and had wonderful ac and amenities. The location was very convenient and safe.

Great stay nearby the center with lots of shops, bars and restaurants close to it. Clear communication with flexible check-in.
Great value!
Nice apartment, looks exactly like pictures and description. Easy to find. Comfortable bed. Would book again.

Lovely studio apartment in the city centre. Walkable distance from all the highlights. Allthough the building is next to a busy road, as long as you keep the windows closed there was no issue with the noise. Overal very much worth the price.

Place was just as described.   Beds were okay.   Noise level on some nights was a little loud.  Overall good place to stay with very responsive hosts.  They provided daily activity thoughts and communication was daily with the group.

We enjoyed our stay and the apartment was excellent. Lots of restaurants nearby and a shopping centre including supermarket. All questions were answered promptly and helpfully.
The apartment is 10-15 minutes from the nearest Metro station.

In Porto for 9 nights for a family holiday.
Modern furnishing, lots of storage clean & modern bathrooms. Lots of natural light, dual aspect with 3 balconies to sit outside. Cracking view of the Bonavista Rotunda statue from both bedrooms. Comfortable beds & sofa bed.
Kitchen had most essentials, those that were not there were provided quickly.
Location is great for transport and for arrival from the airport. Lots of local amenities. 20-30minute walk to the centre / water front. Mercado Bom Success 1952 is 4 minute walk away, great place to try lots of different types of food - great vibe and at times live music.
Allegro Boutique Apartments management were helpful and responsive if we had an issue.
We will definitely come back.

The apartment was beautifully appointed. Very modern, wonderful linens and towels. The smart TV had a great selection of show channels and news in English. We felt extremely comfortable inside the apartment as well as the modern building. The air conditioning was very appreciated, as the weather was very hot. We were welcomed with a cheese board and a bottle of Rose. We enjoyed it after our arrival on the back patio which was shaded and comfortable. The interior decor was well thought out and very well coordinated. Overall a high quality experience. We would definitely stay here again. Loved it!

Our new go-to-place in Porto. wonderful Appartment with a big terrace where you have a surprisingly view in a green area while beeing close to the Porto city center. The Appatment was super clean, in very good shape and communication was super friendly, quick and helpful. We can strongly recommend this place and will come back next time travelling to Porto
The accommodation was very nice. Super clean and comfortable. Liu always answered quick and polite, it was not a problem to add an extra person last minute. A great home and a great host :)
We enjoyed our stay, it was clean and matched the description. Many great restaurants nearby and in walking distance to the city center which was a plus. We appreciated how responsive our host was!

Very nice apartment close to the center of Porto (ca. 5 min walk to sights like the Lello bookstore or the Clerigos tower). In an old but newly renovated house in a lively area with lots of shops and restaurants, but quiet as windows open into the inner courtyard. Kitchen fully equipped incl. dishwasher. We a had a very pleasant stay there!

The apartment was beautiful, clean, and looked just like the photos. It was also well-located and very walkable to areas of interest. Host was very helpful and even let us drop off our luggage earlier than the check-in time.

Liu-Qi's place was perfect for us:  very comfortable, excellent location to explore the city on foot, great supermarket just minutes away for fresh produce (Pingo Doce) and a really helpful and responsive host! We would definitely recommend this apartment.

Our stay was great! The apartment is gorgeous, with a lot of light, and great taste in decoration. The location is great because it’s walking distance from main points of interest in Porto.
The communication with the our host was super clear and timely.
I highly recommend this condo for your stay in Porto!

Loved our stay in Porto. Great location with lots of good food and drink options nearby. We were there during some very hot summer days and the apartment was hot without AC but fans supplied for both rooms and living space

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here! The host was i credibly responsive, kind, and helpful. The apartment is in a great location and has a beautiful layout. Comfortable beds & great natural light. I would absolutely stay here again.

It was a very charming place. It was also perfect for a weekend where you can cook with a functional kitchen, but the plates and dishes were not well clean, meaning that we had to wash all of the dishes. There were missing glasses of wine and soap dishes. We only had one roll of toilet paper for a 4 days stay with people. Mining theses few details, it was overall a great experience.
This was a fantastic trip. Luis was flexible during the check-in and helped us with all of our questions and problems.

The apartment was spacious & with enough rooms to fit 8 persons. It was clean and located about 20 minutes walk to the historic area. I believe that if the kitchen & living room areas  are updated, it will be a very nice place to stay. Bedrooms & beds were very comfortable.

Luís, Thank you for an amazing stay, my group thoroughly enjoyed our stay.  The apartment is very  beautiful and close to restaurants, stores, café, cinemas, and the tour bus is right across the street.  Thank you very much.
Luis was helpful and flexible. We were 4 couples and had wonderful time in the condo.
Luis is always supportive allowing you to solve your doubts easily. The place is amazing, spacious, clean and cozy.

Daniela’s place was as described. I enjoyed the privacy and eventhough the place is quite small, it could very well fit 4 people and meet all their needs. Daniela was very responsive and made sure I found the place (was waiting for me on the outside). Probably the best part was that the place is immediately on the beach and I have seen probably the best sunset in my life :)
The place was Nice just a problem with the high slope. If you intend to return on foot, be prepared for exercise.
Great one room apartment, has everything you could need for a few days. Good public transport connection, we enjoyed our stay :)
Amazing apartment with everything you could possibly need for a short stay. Great location with multiple very quick links to various stations. Host was great and very responsive
A warm stay, with a super comfy nights sleep! The bed is divine.. great use of facilities not to mention the complimentary bottle in the fridge! Would stay again , definitely recommended.

We loved our stay in Porto! It is conveniently located near a main train station and close to multiple bus and metro stops. Cute neighborhood and very walkable. The room itself was very clean and comfortable with everything we needed. Our only comment is that occasionally the seagulls were quite loud in the morning, so if you are sensitive to noise we recommend bringing ear plugs. We highly recommend this Airbnb!

We stayed here for a week and had a great stay.
We felt very welcome and the place was as described.
We were there partly during a heatwave, so aircon would have been nice 😉
We definitely recommend staying here 😊
It is an excellent place very close to the tourist area - a downhill walk.  Everything was clean, and everything worked.   Would stay there again for sure.

We enjoyed our stay during a week. The weather was kind so we could also have some lunches in the terrasse. No surprises between pictures and the place.
Got some of the local vibe during Sao Joao.
Very much enjoyed it.

What a wonderful apartment! The photos truly represent the property. We had a great stay here. Sunny is delightful, helpful and an excellent communicator. The location was perfect - away from the masses of tourists, a short walk to a supermarket, metro and restaurants and within walking distance of all of the main attractions in Porto. We highly recommend it.

Amazing location!! Close to all highlights of the city and very nice surroundings where you can walk to almost everything. It’s situated close to nice restaurants and cafes. A nice little morning cafe place is just across the street where you can buy fresh bread and pastries for your breakfast.
The apartment is just as the pictures and description described - modern, clean and in top shape. We felt at home right away.
Only thing we had an issue with was the a/c that we didn’t seem to get to work properly. However, this was nothing we raised during our stay so there could have probably been sent some proper instructions to us otherwise.
The hosts were very responsive to any questions before and during the stay.
We really liked our stay and would highly recommend it to anyone interested visiting Porto.

Anabela's place was really nice. It looked even better than the photos with nice modern furniture, big skylights, large bedrooms, nice kitchen and comfortable family room for the four of us. We had a few small issues with electric blinds not opening and closing properly and Anabela sent someone over immediately to readjust them.
The location of this apartment is wonderful. You are very close to the waterfront and can walk everywhere. It is in the old historic part of town with narrow, cobbled streets and small shops nearby. There are good restaurants and you can easily walk across the bridge to Gaia and the Port Cellars. I highly recommend this apartment, especially for families who want a comfortable place to stay in Porto.

This is an exceptionally clean accommodation  exactly what was described.  The apartment was very nicely decorated with easy access in and out.  Much do to and see within walking distance!!  Communication was great!!!  I would stay here again!
We had an amazing stay Anabela's in Porto. The location can't be beat, and the apartment was perfect for our group of 5. Thanks for making our stay in Porto memorable!

This was such a beautiful apartment! Very well furnished. It had all of the amenities listed by the host. Clean and nicely renovated bathrooms.
It is a 3 minute walking distance from the Ribiera! You can walk out of the building and immediately see the river down there to your right. It is a 5 min walk from the Luis I bridge. Loved seeing all of the shops and street down there from the apartment. The swing is a nice touch.
It was a very smooth and easy check in and check out process. We were able to get into the apartment easily. The host was wonderful and provided thorough instructions.
Thank you for the wonderful stay Anabela!
We enjoyed our stay overall but the door to the apartment was quite sticky and sometimes difficult to open. Good value for money and amazing location - walkable to all the main tourist attractions.

Beautiful apartment in the most walkable central part of the city. One or two blocks in any direction brought charming streets with outdoor dining options and cute shopping options. Walkable to soooo much in the city.
The only thing we didn't notice was that one of the full baths is on the first floor and one on the second floor where all the bedrooms are. Took a little adjustment, but of course we made that work. Lovely spot.

Great location, very cool interior design, and super communicative hosts. The one drawback of this location is that there's construction next door. This didn't factor into my rating because it's not their fault and it may not be an issue when you stay there.

Our family had a great vacation. Good sized bedrooms and updated bathrooms. We were able to easily fit a pack and play in the largest room. All window coverings (including skylights) were blackout which was also helpful for our toddler and baby. Easy to walk to water front, cable car, port cellars, restaurants, stores/groceries, cafes, Sao Bento train station, and local tour pickup locations.
The host was very responsive to any questions we had.
A perfect stay in Porto! This is the perfect location, walkable to everywhere. Easy to find. The air conditioning was a life saver!

Anabelas apartment in Porto was the perfect apartment right in the middle of the historic district.  The apartment was safe, clean and as pictures portrayed.  Six of us were very comfortable and were so close to everything!  One minor issue was very quickly addressed and resolved.  Even  though the apartment was in the heart of the historic district, it was very quiet at night.  I would highly recommend this apartment for anyone looking to stay in historic Porto.
Great spot in Porto’s old city, very close to the Douro river and its attractions. The location is unbeatable and is an easy walk to all attractions.
Cute and very clean apartment; just be aware that all rooms and one bathroom are upstairs. Great location; near plenty of restaurants, bars, stores, etc.
Great place, well located, great for kids to stay as well and really lovely balcony. Stayed for leisure but was also able to get some work done in the little office balcony!

We stayed one month in this very comfortable and well equipped apartment on the edge of the city. Walkable into Porto centre within 20-25 minutes and also on a route for 2 buses and 10 minute walk to the fantastic metro service from Carolina Michaelis. The facilities were excellent and both beds were comfortable. The south facing balcony was a bonus as was excellent wi-fi which allowed remote working with no issues. There is an excellent supermarket 5 minutes walk away and local shops in what is very much a local neighbourhood with few tourists. Steep stairs to access it but overall a great place with responsive hosts.

Our trip started in Porto, so the first accommodation is very important! Well we were super happy with this place. Clear instructions, very close to everything in the center and even live music that I enjoyed from the balcony! This should be a great addition to amenities😂

My daughter and her 6 girl friends stayed here and loved it. They felt quite safe. Nuno was very communicative which set my mind at ease. Their comments after their stay: comfortable beds, great showers, very safe, quiet, plenty to do in the area (nearly every place they had on their list to go to was within 20 minutes walking distance), close to metro, large grocery store nearby.  They loved the apartment and also loved Porto!

We had an excellent stay at Nunos place. He was very responsive and was always quick to reply to everything we asked including some great local recommendations. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, it was clean and tidy and we had a great stay! Thanks so much Nuno!

Nuno was brillant, he always provided clear instructions and great recommendations. The house is well located and it was pretty organized. However, we found the space  smaller then expected. The roof of one bedroom is so low that an adult can't stand up inside.
Incredible Location, cozy place to stay. Nuno was fast in our communication and let himself always available to help regarding the premises.
Great location, lovely home! Comfortable stay for 7 between 3 beds and 1 sofa. Clean, and no surprises.
Very confortable, clean and central, booked in the same day and didnt have any problems, new favorite place to stay in Porto.
Great place to stay when in porto, nice places to have a drink things to do and just see the city. Thanks
Amelia was a great host!! She had amazing recommendations for local food and activities! She communicated very well and checked in with us often! Would stay here again!

Great location, only wish.the the place had an AC unit. We had to keep the windows open and the bar down the street was noisy.
It's a great location, public parking close by as well as tourist attractions.
Great place, cozy with big beds. Right near everything with a central location. Beautiful home very comfortable.

Great location! Several restaurants right below which may be noisy to someone, but okay for us
Will definitely recommend to others

Raj’s room was exactly as described. He and the whole family were very friendly and helpful. Easy going in giving use of the kitchen en comfortable bathroom.
I only had a bit of trouble with finding the way in the car. But Raj helped me out with that too.
