Even helped with my luggage. Perfect hosting family.
Raj's place was spacious and roomy. the room itself is big and had its own private balcony. quite walkable into the old town and also accessible by lots of public transport options.

Perfect Host - friendly and very reactive - and overall excellent apartment. Location was great and conform to description and pictures.
Some light humidity issues in the bathroom are our only reservation.
Excellent location, the apartment well equipped, very clean and everything very close, Ricardo excellent host, we really liked it, recommend it 100%

The space is quite cozy and comfortable to stay in. The location is great as you're able to walk to a lot of great sightseeing areas. But it's also on a very busy road, so if you're a light sleeper, it's a bit though to get a good night's rest. The apartment was spotless and the host was very helpful.

Good location, central and close to the metro, convenient to join the very center in 10-15 mins.
The appartment is clean and pleasant.
I recommend this place!

I had a wonderful stay in the apartment.  I particularly liked the outstanding amenities (kitchen utensils, dehumidifier, etc.) and the cleanliness.  Everything seemed very new and appealing.  The location is very advantageous as it is well connected but the nights were still quiet. The communication was fast, reliable and accommodating.
Very nice apartment close to the center of the city, and to a Subway stop. Definitely worth the price.

The apartment of Claudia was exactly like it was described. It was clean, easy to find and also closely to public transportation and near the city centre. Claudia was a very kind host and reacted fast to our questions. We had a great stay and we would definitely recommend staying here if you are looking at staying in a relax and cozy appartement in Porto!

Lovely apartment with good central location, front door key was very temperamental and had me worried for a second (a warning would of be helpful), but Claudia quickly responded and said this was normal and gave me a tip. Other than the front lock the apartment was clean and well looked after.
everything was perfect! super clean and nice apartment with a great kitchen. claudia answered immediately and gave us helpful recommendations. would book it again!
Responsive hosts, beautiful view of the river from the terrace, easy accessibility from the tourist spots and the airport. The apartment is very spacious too.

Such a beautiful area to stay — a quiet area away from the hustle of downtown, with a gorgeous (partial) view of the river. The apartment itself was very spacious, with brand new appliances throughout. Very nice layout and furniture as well.

I recently had the pleasure of staying in this wonderful one-bedroom apartment in Porto, and I can’t recommend it enough! The space was clean, comfortable, and beautifully designed, with plenty of room to relax after exploring the city. The fact that it had *two* bathrooms was a huge plus, offering extra convenience during our stay.
One of the standout features was the fantastic Japanese toilet—an unexpected luxury that truly elevated the experience!
The apartment is also perfectly located, close to great restaurants, cafes, and attractions, yet tucked away enough to offer a peaceful retreat. The host was responsive and provided clear instructions, making the check-in and check-out process seamless.
If you're looking for a place to stay in Porto that combines comfort, convenience, and a little bit of extra luxury, this is it! I’d definitely stay here again.

Spacious, Modern, and Clean!
We had a great time here. The Airbnb is very spacious. It has a washer + dryer. Full kitchen. Big smart TV. Japanese toilet. It is in a quiet street right next to Crystal Palace gardens.
Highly recommend!
Great value!  Everything smelled so clean when we arrived and there is lots did sun in the space. Hosts were incredibly helpful and went above and beyond. I’d stay there again!

The perfect point Has everything you need for life. There is a historical center and many restaurants nearby. Private parking and its availability is a huge plus for us. We are stay here in early March and we liked everything. Thank you and we recommend it.

Nice place although there are some weird quirks that make things annoying during a long term stay.
The feels like it wasn't properly used by someone. The living room lacks curtains on a side so it's impossible to watch tv during the day. The bedroom doesn't have a nightstand on one side of the bed. The vacuum cleaner is asthmatic.

Great flat for long stay. Equipped with everything you might need (washing machine, dishwasher, vacuum, dishes etc.) Looks like on a photos, spacious and bright.
Foz is a beautiful area, the cost is a 10 minutes walk, a lot of supermarkets and restaurants placed there. I recommend!

Perfect for someone who wants minimal street noise-- the apartment is located in a very residential, tree-lined area. The apartment was just as pictured in the photos, and was very clean.
The downside to being located in such an area is that you don't have the density of restaurants and grocery stores nearby that's possible with an apartment that is closer to the city center or the coast. Either way, I would highly recommend to anyone who prefers calm over accessibility.

Amazing apartment with great communication! The host was very responsive whenever we needed anything. The only thing we missed was a dish towel for cleaning dishes, which would have been handy to have.

Lovely place to stay. Great communication with the hosts throughout. Accommodation was ideal for all us friends especially with separate bathrooms.
View wasn't quite ideal but the inside space made up for it as very spacious. Close to walk to river or hop on the metro. Had a lovely time.

We had a wonderful stay at Andreia’s place! It really felt like a home away from home and we were all very comfortable there. I stayed with my family for 10 days and it’s a great base to use for exploring Porto and beyond. My 2 year old daughter loved running around the house and garden, and she loved playing with the toys too! A great place for families; it’s clean, cosy and beautifully decorated too. Andreia is so helpful and so responsive, such a lovely host :) We will definitely be back, thank you so much Andreia and Tiago!
Lovely and cozy place to stay, we had a great time! It would be awesome if there is a big mirror other than the bathroom though, other than that we are very pleased with the house😊
The space was very clean and open, also loved access to outdoor picnic table. Easy drive to center of Porto and closer to Foz beach, if you are a runner you can run to there and back in an hour

Excellent apartment with a cozy interior and two large balconies offering fantastic views, especially during sunrise and even sunset! The apartment was clean, everything was in its place, and it had all the necessary amenities, including kitchenware, towels, and clean bedding. We visited Porto in November-December, and despite the season, the apartment was warm, and there was an option to use a heater if needed.
There are two large supermarkets nearby (Lidl and Continente), and the central streets are just a 15-minute walk away. If you want to get to the ocean promenade, you can easily take the metro (metro station is just across the street).
Claudia is a polite and attentive host, and we had a wonderful stay!
This place was very central, but less noisy than staying downtown. Everything is within walking distance. We felt very safe here!

Claudia was an amazing host and her place was great.
well stocked, secure, and super walkable + near easy public transit.

Claudia's place was very convenient as it was a stone's throw away from the Porto Campanha station, with lots of buses that head to the city centre. It was also a lovely apartment which felt safe, and comfortable

The location is good. But what we didn’t know was that there are a couple of bars outside until 2am, and as it is street window it’s noisy.
Regarding the host, we received answers but no solution. No wifi during the whole stay and couldn’t be solved.
The apartment is nice and well equipped

My friend and I had a great time at Jose's place. It is very central and a very clean and modern apartment with everything that you need. Jose was also very communicative and helpful. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay! Place was clean and easy to find! It is near everything with lots of restaurants around and very walkable! Would recommend to everyone to stay here!
Lovely centrally located apartment. Clean, comfortable and good value for money. We did find it difficult to find - perhaps include ‘behind the bandstand’ or similar? Only a minor detail though.

The best location to see everything in Porto. Nothing was more than 20 minutes away maximum.
Lovely clean apartment, great communication and made our stay so easy and enjoyable. Thank you!

It's pretty good！it's the most beautiful hotel i lived before！The garden，the living room，the bedroom and the breakfast are really perfect！So herevyou just need to enjoy your time because the service is pretty good！I must recommend my friends come here next time！I will come back next time！

Fresh, new, stylish, spacious, comfortable and clean. Liked it a lot. Bed and couch very comfortable. Fine kitchen that allows for easy cooking. Host was very responsive and friendly. Highly recommended!

Beautiful studio in Porto, where the locals live. Easy to walk or take bus or metro into the old city center. We parked at the Garagem Antero Quintal less than a block away, was easy and reasonably priced at about 10€ a day. Responsive host and flexible check in- Would definitely stay again!

Wonderful stay in Porto. This is the best Airbnb stay I’ve experienced. It felt like home away from home. Sandra and her family made me feel so welcome and provided wonderful recommendations for sightseeing, activities and restaurants. I highly recommend Sandra’s place when you come to Porto!
We loved our stay from start to finish. Best of the best. Thank you Sandra. You were amazing. The little extras made our stay so special.

Our stay at Sandra’s place in Porto was absolutely fantastic! The apartment was even better than the listing described—beautifully furnished, warm, and perfectly located right in the heart of the city. It had everything we needed for a comfortable and memorable stay. What truly made the experience special was Sandra herself—an incredible host who made us feel completely at home. She was flexible, super responsive, and went out of her way to make sure everything was perfect. I would come back in a heartbeat and highly recommend staying here!
Check in was a bit of wait about half hour to get the keys and one of the key door was not the right one. Otherwise, everything was excellent.

We pleased to stay there.
It was very convenient location.
We could go everywhere where I wanted.
Thanks for Elsa!!!

The place is great. Host was responsive, if a little slow. The condition was awesome. but perhaps the last guests or series of guests knocked things a out. curtains were broken, toilet seat broken. Host repaired the next morning. but it was annoying.

Hello All ,
Over all we were happy with everything and we really enjoyed our stay being close to all the activities and restaurants.
Great location and waking distance to lot of great restaurants and bars and other activities.

I’ve stayed at dozens of airbnbs over many years but never felt truly at home until coming to Elsa’s lovely apartment in Porto. Her son is an architect, and this is very apparent in the design features in the home. It’s even prettier and bigger than in the photos. Perfect location, also. Plus, Elsa was an absolute kind sweetheart. We had trouble with the coffee machine and she insisted on fixing it immediately, which she did.
So much of my beautiful experience in Porto was due to this home. Highly recommended.
Fantastic host! Elsa gave us great advice on what to do in Porto and was very responsive to our questions. The apartment is huge and of high specification. Would highly recommend.

Elsa's place was spacious and clean and the location can't be beat. Very walkable and metro and bus only a short 2min walk. Elsa is a great host and very welcoming. She also has great local recommendations.

Great apartment a very short distance from Balhoa metro and market
Short walk to most of the main tourist spots
Surprisingly quiet given the central location and very well set up with photos as seen
Elsa is a kind and responsive host who looked after us well
This is a gem of a stay, easy to get to from airport or station via metro in a bustling area of the city
Loads of cafes / bars and restaurants nearby and Elsa recommended some great places as well
Would definitely recommend!

The ac was broke when arrived and reported. Not only that it leaked all over our things. I reported to host immediately. The host failed to resolve the issue instead offering us to cancel and find another place, 8.20pm night we arrived with two kids after 3 hour drive! Not helpful. Then the host proceeded to blame us for turning the ac on then contacted us the day later, and because I waited 15 minutes to respond, as we were sought seeing, the whole reason we went to Porto, she said as I didn’t reply shr cancelled technician. I then gave authorisation for the technician to come day  3 ( still no ac) she then didn’t respond to any of my messages. Totally unprofessional and unacceptable given the temperature were 30 degrees and it’s a small upstairs apartment. I would strongly advise against  anyone staying here, the host is impolite and unhelpful and rude
We loved our stay here, Augusto is an incredible host and the place was immaculate! It's in a fantastic location, we would definitely come back

This home and host are exceptional!
Looking for a convenient, walkable location in a quiet, authentic neighbourhood away from the hustle and bustle—an adorable place to unwind and relax? Then look no further. Augusto has impeccable taste, high standards, and is an outstanding host who is warm and welcoming. He offers excellent recommendations for local dining and activities in lovely Porto. Augusto was helpful and informative from my initial contact and made sure our stay was smooth from start to finish. It was a joy to return to the apartment each day and night; we didn't want to leave! I highly recommend this place and host—definitely the best I've come across on Airbnb.

The accommodations were lovely and I would recommend it to others. The only thing missing was a washing machine, however, we were aware of this when booking as it wasn’t listed in the description. LisBeyond were very responsive when needed which made our stay much more pleasant. The area was close to public transit, cafes and grocery stores. Love the unit!

We had a lovely stay! The appartment is very nice and in a great location. With a few minutes walk you are in the city centre. LisBeyon was a great host as well. We did self check-in and everything was super clear. Communication was quick and helpful.

We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment .
The location was great , we could walk everywhere. The place was spotless and had everything we needed for a short stay .
I would highly recommend this place .

lovely apartment, really clean and spacious. within walking distance of everywhere for us. Would highly recommend. only complaint i have was the constant messages, no doubt it's automated but it's overkill. Wouldn't stop me recommending  the place.

We really had a great time in Nuno's place. It was super comfortable. It was prepared with all of the kitchen utensils we needed to make meals at home (which to us is very important!) and the outdoor area was cozy as well. The surroundings were lovely and we really liked the neighbourhood with parks and the lovely Douro river very close! Thanks Nuno for such a great stay. :)

spotless clean in an amazing location. Quiet,yet near so much. excellent food right around the corner as well as a grocery store. plenty of parking
Maria was there in an instant to help out with any questions we had. Great experience and looking foward to coming back

A very nice and cozy place for a family. There is a patio for kids to play. TV sets in every room. Very beautiful church and river nearby. Pretty convenient for public transportation, but using taxis is much better and not very expensive.

New, stylish and comfortable place which met our expectations and looks like  the pictures on the site. Good location close to the city centre with a big supermarket and restaurants and cafes close to it. Very happy staying there and would recommend it.
Very clean and tidy apartment that looked exactly as the photos.  I bit of s walk down to the river area but not too bad.  Very peaceful and quiet overnight.
There was a power outage and there was no smooth check-in.The room as a whole was not bad, but because it was a terrace and there were too many bugs, the landlord didn't clean the terrace well.

This loft is suit for the family with kids. The environment is quite and very safe even the yard is small and your neighbor may see what you did at it. The location of it is very convenient for having a visit to this city by walking. You also will find Metro station and supermarket within 5 mins, so you can live here some days to feel the atmosphere of Porto. All main attractions can be achieved by walking and I believe you will not to regret to choose it.

We had a great stay at Carolina's place! The location was perfect for our needs with a coffee shop serving excellent coffee and also a wine bar down the road. Carolina was helpful and responsive whenever we messaged, and would definitely stay again when we visit next. Couldn't ask for more
Exactly as described - clean, comfortable and cool! Caroline was a great host and our stay was perfect. The location was great for exploring the area and we would highly recommend.
Great place to stay, clean and well looked after. Would highly recommend this place for your stay in Porto.
Great place to stay! Super close to attractions and check in was not difficult. Kitchen is stocked and you can find most things you need.
Great value place, but not a central location. Also the check in was late and the owner demanded 15€ to check in early or at least leave my bags at the place. Other than that loved the apartment
everything was fine . i like the place too much . one kitchen should be there and rest all things are good

The apartment is near the metro station. And you will get the metro every five minutes. One bedroom with a private bathroom and essential accessories made our stay way more comfortable. The host is very helpful.

I stayed in this apartment for a few days and the experience was really positive. The accommodation is well furnished and clean. The location is convenient, convenient for walking but also close to public transport. Host helpful and attentive.
Great stay, loved being so close to the beautiful public gardens and would 100%  recommend eating at Borboleta which is a 3 min walk!

Modern, compact, very well equipped, clean and in a pretty neighborhood. Easy check in and beatiful view from the big windows even though it’s not the Douro River. You have to walk a bit for the supermarket though, but I am very satisfied with this listing. Thank you!
the apartment is really located in one of the main streets. restaurants and supermarket a few meters from the house. clean, super quiet to have a good sleep. we really enjoyed our stay.
Lovely apartment,  good location with some great restaurants and a supermarket nearby. Walkable distance to major tourists spots. Only thing missing is somewhere to hang towels in the bathrooms

A wonderful spot to stay in the heart of Porto. Easily walkable to all of the wonderful sights and restaurants. It is on the 5th floor but has an elevator!
The spot was clean and comfortable! My only common is that it lists both a washed and drier, but just has a washer and drying rack. No big deal overall, though!

The villa was perfect! Very clean and modern. We were 8 girls and it was enough space for us all for a week. Liliana went above and beyond to make sure we had an amazing stay.
I highly recommend the place!
Pedro’s home is like a designer house, love the design. The house got everything you needed. so perfect.

We enjoyed our stay . The apartment was so comfortable and nice decorated . Location was great. We walked everywhere from there.
We hope to come back soon!
The apartment was beautiful and in such an incredible location - lots of restaurants, shops and cafes right at the doorstep!

Nice place,  two individual suite bedroom. However the drainage of shower is no good. No space and hooks for placing personal stuff in the bathroom. The lift cannot carry more than 2 persons and its overload alarms is always alerted.

Joana & Pedros’ apartment is beautiful, modern & very organized. It was easy to find and walkable distance to everywhere- Dom Luis Bridge, Mercados, Cathedrals, restaurants and groceries. We enjoyed our stay thoroughly and highly recommend their place.

Really enjoyed the location and the ease of access. The AC worked well on a hot day and the decor was minimal. There wasn’t much space in the rooms for luggage (especially anything over a carryon), but that wasn’t a big deal because we were out exploring all day rather than hanging out in the living room. I can imagine this is a temporary issue,  but there is construction / jackhammering starting at 8am on weekdays.

Loved staying here in Porto!
Right in the heart of things but somehow still very quiet. Everything was as described and very comfortable!

We had a great stay here! Everything was within walking distance to the apartment and there are lots of restaurants nearby. The place was extremely clean, beautifully decorated and just like the photos. We were sad we weren’t staying any longer! The hosts were extremely responsive each time we messaged and provided us a list of recommendations of restaurants and things to do. We loved our stay, loved Porto and can’t wait to come back, we will definitely book here again.

we found the apartment very cozy.
the location perfect, walkable and close to all transport. we also found so many great restaurants near by. thank you again to our wonderful host,
we really enjoyed our stay in Porto.

Pedro and Ana were wonderful, friendly hosts who went out of their way to make our stay enjoyable and peaceful. They cooked us a great dinner and we had good conversation. The room was great - nice bed, pillows and towels. Everything was new and clean. The neighbourhood was peaceful and quiet - we had a nice walk before dinner. We look forward to our next visit.
We had an amazing time feeling like family at Casa do Porco. Pedro was extremely kind, enthusiastic, and generous throughout our stay. Expect friendly, joyous vibes here!

It was a beautiful evening and I felt like I was at home and extremely comfortable. Authentic and very kind hosts who even invited me to their family dinner in the evening showing me natural traditions of Portugal and will always be extremely grateful and look forward to my return. And the sauna and hot stone massage were amazing. A natural peaceful surrounds and I slept very well and felt very rested. Thank you so much!!!
Thank you Pedro & Ana! Our stay was wonderful! Thanks for your hospitality and  the recommendations of the 222 road for the nice scenery! And the good restaurant! Thank you so much!!!
We truly enjoyed our stay. Pedro, his wife  and daughter were welcoming and responsive. A beautiful setting and excellent reno of a historic building!

I recently stayed at Henrique's place in Porto and had a wonderful time. The apartment was really clean, in a quiet and safe area, and close to both the metro and the city center, which made getting around easy.
Henrique was a fantastic host. He welcomed me warmly and gave me great tips on where to go and what to see in Porto. The patio was a lovely place to relax after a day of exploring. Plus, I enjoyed sipping Port wine that Henrique offered on the patio, which made the experience even more special.
I highly recommend staying here if you're visiting Porto. It's a perfect spot for comfort and convenience, with a host who goes the extra mile to make your stay enjoyable.

An excellent place to stay. The host is very responsive and it shows that he cares about making your visit to Porto memorable.
Kitchen is stocked with the basic necessities and also has the small extra details included like salt, pepper and olive oil.
Parking is a little narrow but totally doable even for a bigger car. But a wide Landcruiser would take some effort I think!
The subway is close but simply walking to the city center only takes 15 mins if you have a decent pace.
Overall a great stay and we would revisit without hesitation.

Really enjoyed our stay and Henrique provided some great recommendations   The apartment is very comfortable and parking was an asset.   Nice area and within walking distance to many of the sights.  Would stay here again

Great place and great host! Henrique has an absolutely wonderful Airbnb. Extremely comfortable, spacious, and clean. Another noteworthy thing is Henrique himself is an amazing host. He was there to welcome us, patiently showed us around the apartment and then spent time with us to tell us all about the local recommendations. I would just stay at this same place when I visit Porto again :-)

We had a great week at Henrique's place. It was exactly as described, central for walking into the city and quiet at night. We also received lots of good recommendations, which was really helpful. We would highly recommend!
Same as in the pictures, very clean, and within walking distance of many places. Highly recommended!
Superb Airbnb. Great river view and immaculately clean apartment. Maria is a very friendly host.

This townhome was perfect for our family of 4
We loved the location, the view, the interaction with our host and Porto at our footsteps!
Clean, great amenities, in the thick of the action, yet tucked away! Very safe as well!!! We will recommend to any of our friends traveling to Porto!!!

We had a fantastic stay at Maria’s, the location is just brilliant central to everything with an amazing view of the bridge.
The house easily accommodated 6 of us and had everything you need for a restful stay.
The football club bar at the end of the street is great, very close with minimal steps. The tiny restaurant opposite very friendly and quirky.
Maria offered lots of great tips for things to see and do and places to eat and was quick to respond from the time of booking onwards.
We would recommend a stay at Maria’s. Thank you for sharing your home with us.

The flat worked well for us (family with 2 adult children) with plenty of space (and bathrooms). The location was close to walk to some great bakeries and restaurants and down to the river - but some steps involved!

WOW. Everything was as described. Great location. House was sensational. Maria has a very special place in Porto. If I come back I wouldn’t want to stay anywhere else. Heaps of information provided. Nothing more to say other than it was fantastic. Highly, highly recommend

Great house to explore Porto from! We loved our stay here, having our own house to return to after long days of exploring the city. Waking up to the spectacular views of the Douro and the Dom Luis I Bridge were truly amazing! The house had everything we needed with plenty of space for the four of us. If driving, there is street parking at the end of the street and a lot just beyond that. It is towards the top of a steep hill, but that is to be expected of course, and there is a convenient funicular nearby that runs until 10pm. We couldn’t have asked for a better home base to discover Porto from!

The unit looks more beautiful and spacious than in the photos published. You have everything that you need for a traveler like us. The heating was working nicely. As an Asian, this is also the first time I used a European style bathroom/bidet and it was helpful for my bathroom needs. The room is not that soundproof though so you can hear footstep noises upstairs and some talking voices etc from the other room. Pedro's parents who welcomed us are also very kind, polite and made sure we have everything.

Everything worked well as pictures well describe the location. It is a calm neighbourhood, easy access to transport, beautiful park close by, apartment was very clean, hosts were very communicative and offered place to keep luggage before check-in.
I just wished there was a little more space in the kitchen, but still manageable for a short stay.

Great stay at a well-equipped apartment. Just as described, with plenty of amenities and fast, clear communication. However, it's 1 km from the nearest metro station, and the bed has a firm mattress. The room also gets very hot due to the lack of air conditioning, although the fan is a nice touch. Overall, an enjoyable stay.

Our stay here was lovely, the whole place has an authentic homely feel, we loved the traditional style and feel and the hosts’ parents were very kind. It’s right next to an Aldi so was very convenient and comfortable. We loved our stay thank you!

The apartment was located up a narrow lane close to the main road along the river. Nice restaurants, a bakery, a pharmacy, medical clinic and grocery nearby. You should know that there is a large flight of stairs to get up to it. Plus there were no instructions or information for any of the appliances or for the area. The apartment was comfortable, beds were nice. But, the attached house next door was being renovated/demolished so the noise during the day was rather annoying.

Pedro’s place couldn’t have been better, the apartment was exactly as described and very well kept. The location was perfect and everything was within walking distance of everything we wanted to. Pedro was very responsive and met us at the apartment to let us in, which was very easy, would Definately recommend his place to others and go back myself
The host was very friendly and forthcoming. We were able to put our bags in the appartement before check-in while it was still being cleaned.

Carla was lovely and the place was lovely!!! Plenty of space for 6 of us and loads of great balcony space! Loved our stay and will definitely be back here if we ever return to Porto!
Plenty of restaurants and grocery stores in walking distance!

We would highly recommend this accommodation.  It was spacious for a family of 5 with 2 adult children.  It was immaculate, stylish with everything we needed available.  We loved the location with cafes, bakeries and a great bar nearby. Carla was there if we needed her and provided us with plenty of information about Porto. We would definitely stay here again.

A great apartment for the price, especially if you're travelling in a big group. It has everything you need to be comfortable. It'a also very easy to reach most parts od the city by public transport. Carla is a great host that does everything in her power for the guests to have a pleasant stay.

The apartment was everything we had hoped for and more. The proximity to services, including restaurants, local attractions and remarkable scenery was incomparable. We will definitely consider this in the future if we are fortunate enough to visit the area again.
Thank you to Tomas and Alberto!

Beautiful place and proactive host. I would definitely stay here again when in Porto. Conveniently located on a quiet street in a lovely neighborhood away from the hustle and chaos of the touristy areas, yet a short ride to anywhere you want to go.

Everything was clean and tidy. Flat had a clever design and layout and we enjoyed the views over the other buildings and sea. Loads to do locally so no need for using the car.  Flat was equipped with just enough for a comfortable 2 night stay.
Great location. Nice layout and plenty of space for a family of four. Beautifully remodeled with new bathrooms and cabinetry.

Gorgeous modern apartment with high quality furnishings and decor. Beds, linens and pillows were very comfortable with lovely bathrooms. Two levels of outdoor space to enjoy the sun. Nice quiet neighborhood with excellent walkable neighborhood. Better than the photos.

Jaime is so friendly,is going.
Help us to everything,the house is so adorable.

the curtains were all very dusty,
the kitchen was not very clean and most pans are not compatible with the portable induction stove,
the bathroom is serviceable but the shower is a bit of a nightmare on the account of it having a curtain instead of a normal glass door.
the house overall is nice and well situated,
bedrooms were clean.

Our stay at Casa Maya was perfect. Zac was super friendly and always helped us out with recommendations. The room was beautiful and clean as well as the bathroom. We also especially liked the kitchen + patio/little garden (bonus points for the cute cats who visited us there). Overall we‘d definitely recommend staying here and would love to come back ourselves!

I really have no words😍 Zac was really friendly and helpful, he showed us the whole property and gave us recommendations for the city. In addition, the room was super clean and spacious. We had everything we needed for a Porto getaway. Nevertheless, the location is very nice, right next to a metro station. I recommend this place with all my heart🤗 we’ll definitely be coming back to Maya House!!!
Very nice place to stay at! Enjoyed our stay a lot and had no problems with anything. Only the street was a bit noisy.

Good location in a quiet neighborhood.
Close to the metro station.
The nearby coffee shop we had coupons for was amazing, we ended up going again.
I would definitely stay in this place again.
We loved the location which was between the tourist sights and the river on one side as well as restaurants and a nice neighborhood on the other side. Place was very clean.
Lovely little apartment! Great location with lots to do in the area and helpful hosts. Thank you☺️
Great location and easy check in process. Street is quiet and private, even just a block away from some of the main attractions. We had a great time in Porto! Hope to be back.
Great place, Cristina was extremely helpful with local recommendations and very responsive to any queries I had. The flat is clean and free of all clutter

The Airbnb is very well located, with everything from the historic centre to bars and restaurants within walking distance. There's also a nearby metro station, making it easy to explore the surroundings of Porto. The apartment is spacious, clean, and has a well-equipped kitchen. The hosts were very responsive, and the check-in process was smooth. I would definitely stay here again.

The stay at suasanas place was great, good location and a pretty clean place.
Suasana was responsive and helped directly when we needed her help.
An overall great place to stay in.
It is a good area of the city and Susana was very responsive, we were 5 people and it was cosy but as described, thank you!

Susana was a lovely and very responsive host. The apartment's clean, cosy and in a great location within walking distance to popular areas.
The electricity went out in the middle of one night so the lights and appliances stopped working. However, Susana was quick to respond and arrived quickly to the location to sort it out.
Lovely spacious flat in a bustling area, walkable distance from lots of popular areas. I was on holiday with a friend and it was nice to have our own spaces to rest and recharge between activities.

Rute was very easy to get in touch with. She responded to my questions immediately. The Location is fabulous and the place was nicely decorated and very clean. We were five adults and even though the space was small, we managed quite a well.
The stay was a pleasant experience and the São João festival was more peaceful because we arrived in Ribeira on foot and returned home quickly and safely at dawn. Everything was perfect.

very nice apartment! the host was very nice and everything was explained to en clean. great environment around the apartment is very lively and there is a lot to do. we were never bored and very happy with our stay.

We loved our stay in Porto and a big part of it is because we had Albino as our host. He picked us up and gave us a little tour and he gave very good recommendations in restos. He was so friendly, despite our language barrier, he felt like family :). Accommodation was great, too. clean and quiet, but when you get outside you are in the main shopping street. Thank you Albino and Cristina for letting us stay in your apartment.
The bed was clean and comfy with nice decor.  Joaquim went over and beyond to help make our stay pleasant and I would highly recommend this place to anyone or visit Porto.

The apartment was comfortable, very clean and modern on a small residential street (no cars) in a central location of Porto close to many restaurants, downtown and the river. Host was responsive and gave us great recommendations!

Beautiful view, quiet neighbors. Downstairs there is subway and cars, with open windows can be a bit noisy, but the view and amenities in the apartment override everything.
We had a good vacation here, we didn't want to go out

Everything was perfect! Filipa & Bryan communicated clearly, gave great recommendations & were always responsive. The room looked exactly like the photos. Sparkless clean. Conveniently situated in the heart of the city but also peaceful enough to get some good rest. There were lots of cute restaurants and shops nearby. 10/10

We had a great stay in the airbnb of Filipa & Bryan.  However we didn't meet them in person communucation was always easy and nice. The apartment has everything you need for a trip to porto and is very well located. The only small drawback is the noise you can sometimes hear from the street. We can definitely recommend the airbnb!
We had a great stay:) Nice interior and it was clean as well. It felt private and cozy even though It’s located in a lively area. Filipa and Bryan were very helpful and communicative.

A perfect flat for exploring Porto. Right in the heart of the Port district and just across the river from the busier sections of the city.
Very helpful hosts who had plenty of advice.
We had a very pleasant stay. The flat is brand new, clean and very comfortable. It has a parking space just across the street.

Great accommodation!  Just as described.  Very clean and comfortable.  Last minute booking due to my flight being cancelled.  I stayed for two nights.  Maria responded to my request to book with in minutes.  Very easy to find.  No problems at all!  The greatest plus was that it was very clean and comfortable.  Maria was accessible.  I would definitely book again!

This listing is a beautiful studio room (think, spacious hotel room) in the heart of Matasinhos. Everything was clean (with service optional every day), easy to navigate (Nuno answered any questions we had almost immediately at all hours of the day), and beautiful. We stayed here for Primavera Porto and the park was only about a 20 minute walk, but went by quickly as the surrounding neighborhoods are easy to get around and quiet. Right next to a park, numerous bakeries and restaurants, and cafés. We would definitely come back, thank you Nuno!

excellent place. very clean.
air conditioning is a plus for moisturing and cold night.
good location. there is also a outdoor free parking place just at the front of the apartment, excellent for those with car. close to a continental supermarket.

The apartment and our stay was amazing. I’ve never experienced that well equipped airbnb place, high quality and thoughtful. Everything was perfectly clean. The host was very kind and helpful.
Just a perfect stay. We felt like home.
Thank you!
Modern apartment with plenty of luxury. Ideal for groups and families.  Private parking! And the host is friendly and exceptional. I truly enjoyed staying at this place.
We loved our stay here! Easily walkable to many different areas. The host was communicative and we had all the essentials we needed. Would definitely come stay again. Thank you for having us!

Fabulous apartment, they kindly let us park our car before checking in, so we were able to explore. Really close to the Bom Sucesso Food court/market. Easy to get to the Douro, for a stroll along the river or to get a tram.
The apartment is very comfortable and really well equipped. Perfect for 2 or 4 people.
We will definitely use Lovely Memories again.

We had a lovely stay here. It had plenty of space inside and had everything we needed. It was quiet and spacious and the beds were comfortable. We didn’t realize the outdoor space and pool were shared and were not easy to access from the apartment, so we didn’t get to utilize them as we had thought we would. The garage parking was convenient to have for our rental car.

Fantastic location, very close to the river and truly in the heart of the Ribeira action. The place is clean and tidy. The key is tricky — you have to have it the right way up. We finally figured this out partway into our stay, and thank goodness, because it was driving us crazy. Once you sort that, no issues. It is very noisy outside, but earplugs took care of that. Make sure you bring them with you. Really can't stress enough how excellent the location is.

Great location but if you are in the centre of Porto you need to be aware it will be noisy.
We had a fabulous time. A lovely city to visit and enjoy yourself.
Great stay! Very responsive and super friendly host. The room was perfect and very clean. Thanks for the lovely stay :-)

Great apartment with an amazing view from the balcony. Our kid loved the rooftop pool with even better views! Construction nearby didn’t bother us at all. A little salt and olive oil in the kitchen would make cooking easier 🙂
But overall it was a fantastic stay, thank you!
Really lovely interior, great location as you’re in the nicer part of town plus surrounded by great transport links and shops on your doorstep. Great for solo and couple.

Easy to find, close to metro - if you're headed for the airport in the end of your stay, go to Aliados metro to avoid climbing uphill to Bolhao with your bags. Very centrally located, right off the main shopping street downtown, close to restaurants and cafes, large supermarket 5min walking distance. The apartment is well equipped, the only thing I didn't find were dishwasher tablets and washing powder - apparently not supplied by the owner, but I stayed only 3 nights so didn't really need it. Bring your own if you're staying longer. I stayed in December, and the heating worked very well. The building consits mostly of Airbnb units so it's very quiet; you may experience some street noise but the windows are well isolated and  keep most of it out. Overall a very comfortable stay.

I stayed for two weeks and it's a good value for the money. It's great for shorter stays - anyone with space issues might have an issue with the size of the common area with the kitchen, dining and bed being in the larger room - as I'd classify it as a New York efficiency with with a bathroom. Speaking of the bathroom, large shower stall and rain style shower head and for me at 6'2, was key. Hot water fast in the mornings.
Kitchen had everything I needed from a prep perspective. A little patio as well.

Great place—perfectly located for exploring Porto. It’s just a short walk from Mercado do Bolhão, the Chapel of Souls, supermarkets, and other key attractions. The suite is well-equipped, and the team was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I’ll definitely book again if I return to Porto!

Perfect house, clean and very well furnished !
Perfect host as well, Rui answers really fast had a perfect hospitality and helped us a lot to feel comfortable ! »

We had a wonderful stay. Rui’s home is beautiful— clean and with all the amenities we needed. The pool was refreshing and the yard was spacious and perfect for kids to play. Rui and Isabel were friendly,  thoughtful hosts and easy to communicate with.
Amazing apartment for larger groups. It looked exactly like the photos, and everything was really clean and comfortable. We had an amazing stay, and would love to come back!
Excellent Location. Everything was walkable and has great restaurants near by. The apartment was very clean and spacious. Luis was a great host and super responsive

Luis’ beautiful apartment is just steps from the Mercado do Bolhão. From the well-equipped kitchen to the washing machine, comfortable beds, and beautiful design, Luis’ apartment was a great home base for us to explore Porto with our extended family. Thank you, Luis, for your check-in flexibility, prompt communication, and excellent accommodations. Because the apartment is right in the city, you might want ear plugs if you are a light sleeper, otherwise, everything is perfect!
Walking distance to the river and tourist spots and yet it was wonderful and quiet. The beds were divine and everything else was lovely and clean and comfortable.
Great place just a short walk to everything!  The apartment had everything we needed including an elevator which was appreciated after hiking up that hill from Sao Bento!  🤣

We had a wonderful weekend stay. The apartment is right at the heart of the city, with a beautiful view. It was also very clean and quiet. The hosts were very nice and the instructions they left were clear. We can't wait to visit again!

Wonderful tidy apartment located in a fantastic spot in Porto. Everything is walking distance and close by. Really nice view from the balcony. Two small nitpicks - couldn’t find a microwave (though it is listed) and one bedroom is missing drapes on the windows so lots of sunshine comes through in the morning. All in all would highly recommend!

We really liked this place. Hugo was a great host, we lost the main door key and he showed up just 10min after we called him and he was super polite and helpful. I highly recommend this place.
Thank you Hugo for your help
It was a nice place to stay at for couple if days, the only downside was thin walls especially in the kitchen where you can hear the next room clearly. But overall good for the price
Well located apartment with a great balcony for guests to enjoy. Hosts were helpful and quick to respond to questions.
We had such good time in Porto. Our apartment is good location and cozy. Definitely come back when we visit Porto again.
Good stay during the festival, located in the city centre with very calm and peaceful neigbour.
Everything was perfect – no problems at all. Great communication with the host and I would definitely recommend this place!

Luisa is a very friendly host. Although she wasn’t around during our three-day stay, she was always available online to help whenever needed. Her home is extremely clean, and it truly gives you a sense of peace and comfort. I would definitely recommend staying here.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Porto! From the moment we arrived, our amazing host greeted us warmly, making us feel right at home. The spacious apartment exceeded our expectations, featuring two bathrooms which was a huge plus for our family.
The location is fantastic—just a short walk to the tram, making it easy to explore the city. We also found free public parking nearby, which was a great bonus for us.
Everything in the apartment was top-notch. The thoughtful touches really made our stay special, like the Nespresso coffee maker, which allowed us to enjoy our morning coffee in style. And we were delighted to discover a waffle iron! Our kids loved making waffles for breakfast, creating some lovely family memories.
Overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our time in Porto and couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay. Highly recommend this gem!

This apartment is very well located near the historic district and the river.  Across street from the stock exchange.  Air conditioning works great.  Rooms are well appointed and beautiful.  Three very nice bedrooms.  Beds very comfortable.  Large living room with gorgeous views.  Two minor notes:  master bathroom has no door.  And there is a double door between the master and another bedroom, which is a little odd  —but each room has its own separate entrance.  We would choose this apartment again.  A perfect place to see Porto from.

Hugo’s listing is a slice of heaven perfect for any stay you’re looking for. You could probably spend all day enjoying your time in the property soaking up the sun but alas you need to enjoy the city.
There are lovely cafes and restaurants just around the accommodation which make it perfect for early morning walks and late night dinners
I’d recommend this spot over and over again to anyone visiting

Yogo place was a studio flat that was well located for restaurants and the sites in Porto. The flat was clean, bright and airy.
It was easy to find from the bus station & airport. The flat is up on the second floor so if you find it difficult to climb stairs then this flat would not suit you. Although on the second floor, the flat is on a busy road and is very noisy.

Great until in an amazing location!! Nice, clean and spacious with lots to do around if you choose to walk or if you have a vehicle or decide to take public transit reasonably close to the historic city of Porto. Definitely recommended.

It was a perfect place to go with my family and my parents. Everything was great except that it smelled not so good the second day. Firat day was ok as they had obviously cleaned then sprayed alot of room sprays. It wasn't that pleasant when it didn't have any of the fragrance. We had to keep the garden door open for moat of the time. Besides that, we stayed without much complaints.

Really nice accommodation, beds were very comfy and the space felt very clean. It was nice to have the  garden area in between the two parts of the apartment to relax in. Having two kitchens and two bathrooms also really helps. Could do with some oil and spices but other than that it had all the basic things you could need like a washing up kit.

Highly recommondation for this apartment. It´s really beautiful. Fully equipped and atmospheric. The contact with Pedro and Sandra was super easy and very friendly! It´s easy to explore Porto from this place.
Miguel was very friendly, responsive and willing to help. He even allowed me to check-in early and made sure everything was going smooth for me.

This is a 5 star place, well and truly. Loved staying here. From the comfy bed and nice linens, to the indoor/outdoor patio and nice furnishings, to the neighborhood being walkable and pretty, I had a fantastic stay. Would stay here again. ♥️

We had a great time there, location wise it was pretty close to city center and attractions. Check in was super easy. The building was perfect and renovated, there were only few issues regarding bathrooms and communication.

This is a good place to crash for a night. Beware that even though there is no AC (as they said), there is no fan either, and the apartment can get very hot! You also may want to bring your own pillow…
With that said, the location is AMAZING! You are just steps from everything in Porto, and the hosts were very kind. For a night, maybe a weekend if you are on the go, this place is a great value for the cost.

This was one of the best places I've stayed at. The host welcomed us upon arrival and made us felt like home. She was super friendly and responsive throughout the whole stay. There is plenty of sun in the morning when we open up the balcony windows and doors. The neighborhood is just right outside the main tourist areas, which we appreciated. We will definitely book again if we come back to Porto.
The place was outstanding for the price. I would really recommend. The only problem we had was the Wifi, it's the same network for all Guestready guests and is really unstable.

Would be amazing to have a small air conditionning in the house. Very hot if you keep the windows closed, but a lot of noise until late at night due to the location.
But overall very nice stay!

I’ve really enjoyed to live in this apartment during 1 week. Everything was like I’ve expected. The apartment was clean, the area was quiet, the location is good (between the beach side and the city center). The only inconvenience was the leak of water under the toilet’s sit. If it’s fixed, the apartment will be perfect.
Everything was in a good resonance priced standards but some handles on doors are loose and few lights needs replacing but all in all lovely stay
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would certainly recommend the apartment to others. Thank you very much for hosting us in Porto.

The place was very nice.Everything was just as shown in the pictures. The only downside was the temperature inside. It was extremely hot, even hotter than outside, and there was only a fan, which didn’t really help much. There wasn't enough airflow, which could be uncomfortable, especially for someone sensitive to heat. Other than that, everything was great!  And our host, Inês, was very kind and responsive :)
I had a lovely stay in this plage in the heart of the Arts Quarter! The place was bright and clean and had everything you could need.

Beautiful and quiet apartment in one of the best locations in Porto, great restaurants, bars, bakeries and coffee shops nearby. Checking in and out was easy, and we walked pretty much everywhere. Everything is brand-new. The only downsides are that the AC doesn't reach the bed area (I asked if they had a fan but no one replied), and the steep angle of the staircase. We'd stay there again.

Busy street, but great location! The porch was a major reason why we stayed here. It was fairly clean, but needed more in the bathroom and table area. It lacked in basics like towels, toilet paper, and pillows. Overall, was a great place to stay!

This place was perfect for those always wanting something to do! The space was super spacious and clean. The location itself was extremely walkable distance to touring spots. The street itself the place is on is right on the shopping centre area. Loved our stay, the hosts were super responsive and quick. Thank you!
Great location, ideal base for a few nights in Porto. On a busy street but very quiet in the apartment

What can I say - from start to finish we had a great time at Aqua Villa Madalena. Our purpose for coming here was to attend Rally Portugal. The apartment was central to where we needed to go to see the stages of the Rally.
Apart from this, the apartment was exceptional - so clean. Sonia as a host was so responsive and always available when needed ( which I hope wasn't too often for her!)
Our children really enjoyed the pool, the place was so peaceful and quiet! An all-round fantastic holiday!
Thank you so much Sonia and family!!! Hopefully we will visit again another time!
Nice place out from the noisy city. We stayed for one night and had a car, so with us it was ok.
Wonderful unit and great location. Could not ask for any better. Excellent communication with host. Bus stop to airport just outside the building. Loved our stay.

Very peaceful flat with a cozy terrace and a comfortable bed to rest after long walks during a day. Since the apartment is on pedestrian street it is perfect for a peaceful sleep.
Location is central, on walking distance from many amenities, at the same time it's quite calm in the evenings. Overall very relaxing experience.

We stayed in the apartment for a week in the charming area Cedofeita. Fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bed, and a balcony overlooking Rua do Cedofeita. Construction work going on in the area (as in most parts of Porto), and in the building next to us, but it didn’t disturb us much.

nice apartment
small but fine, everything someone needs
great view over parts of the city
If you visit Porto, STAY HERE! It was an amazing location, centrally located, and had the most stunning, breathtaking views.
Perfect location, you can go everywhere by walk. Also they are so nice everything was perfect, thanks for everything

Duarte's place was very convenient to explore Porto and right next to some beautiful gardens.
We had 4 adults, and the space was a bit small for everyone to have their own space but we were mainly exploring the city so it was not a big issue. However there is only 1 shower which is something to be aware of.
The place was clean and had everything we needed. There is only one set of keys and the front gate is locked after 10 pm - just something to note.
Overall, I would recommend this stay - there was a beautiful courtyard and lots of sun during the day coming into the place.

We enjoyed our stay very much. The beds were comfortable. The apartment was Spick and Spa made a lovely view and outside space. We had all the amenities we needed coffee, iron toaster, tea, kettle dishes, clean linens it was very comfortable and the location couldn’t be better.

The apartment is nice but it seemed to me that the construction work had not yet been completed. There was hair under the bathroom cabinet, a wire coming from the street was tangled next to the bed as if it were an unfinished construction, a hole next to the exhaust fan and no curtains, since there are other apartments facing it less than 3 meters away, I felt like I had no privacy, something that could have been solved cheaply. For the price that was charged, I expected more.

Great apartment - spacious, well-designed and located in a quiet, pleasant neighborhood about a 20-minute walk from all the key spots in the city. Even though there’s no AC, it stayed comfortable inside thanks to the fans and dehumidifier. Having two bathrooms was also super convenient. Would definitely recommend!

The room and bathroom were clean and welcoming. With no kitchen, they served a small but adequate breakfast every morning, which we enjoyed. However, it was clear when we tried to contact the host on the Airbnb app that we were talking with an AI, which gave us contradictory answers to our questions and was not very helpful when we asked for accomodations. It also meant there was no flexibility around check in/out or leaving bags. Overall a nice space, even if the road outside was quite noisy, but felt more like a hotel. Easy access to metro so getting into town was fine, and for what we paid, it did the trick nicely. Would only recommend for shorter stays, but happy with our stay.

On arrival at the apartment the key hadn’t been left in the lockbox. After calling AirBnB and Portugal Active this was dealt with, but we were left outside for almost an hour. After a day of travelling this was less than ideal and unnecessarily stressful.
The apartment was comfortable and in a good location. The outside space felt a little unloved - with some attention it could be a more pleasant place to be. We didn’t use the jacuzzi as we weren’t confident that it was ready for use.
We loved Porto, it’s a great city.

We had a fabulous stay. The apartment was spotlessly clean with everything you would need.
Very walkable and close to all attractions .
Highly recommend.
Great place and in the heart of the city. Very close and walkable distance to many places.

Had a perfect stay at this beautiful apartment. It’s as stylishly designed as the pictures, very quiet to sleep, really comfortable and private, yet right in the midst of things. We had everything we needed, and Joanna was an easy text message away. We took advantage of a number of her recommendations and also easily worked remotely from there. Thanks for a wonderful stay, we hope to be back!

All good. Clean. Flawless check in. Flexible access. Not a place to book if members of the group cannot do steep staircases of which there are many.
Location is perfect in the middle of town.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Porto, Portugal. The apartment offered plenty of space spread over several floors, and everything was spotlessly clean. The host gave us a warm and friendly welcome, which made us feel right at home.
Place was a great central location. Perfect for what we needed. Plenty of restaurants and bars nearby and shopping. Great for old town. Super stay!

We had a wonderful experience. The house was beautiful, people were so nice and it was very clean. Before we arrived we thought it was to good to be true, but it is! The neighbourhood was not centrical but it was easy walkable and more peaceful. You have markets and restaurants near. Also the anffitrion was very responsive and helpful, they even let us do an early check in and a late checkout as well, without fee! Will definetely recommend this place, and we will come back everytime we travel to Porto. Thank you so much!

We loved this place. In a perfect spot next to cute cafes and bars but just out of the touristy old town. The place was clean and beautifully designed. There is also an amazing terrace to sit and have your coffee on. Do not hesitate to book this. Zhiang was very communicative and even gave us some amazing local recommendations.

We came to Porto for two sailing championships.  We were a group of 7 people.   The house was conveniently located between the two clubs, both of which were about a 10-15 minute drive away.  The house was spacious and comfortable.  It had all the amenities we needed.  We appreciate the host getting us a new dryer when we informed her that the other one was not working.  She also quickly got the air conditioner to work in one of the bedrooms that also wasn't working when we first arrived.  The location of the house was very good.  It was a pleasant walk to the beach or to the park, and the neighborhood was nice.  All in all, the house was the perfect fit for our needs.
Loved my stay. Rafael is a great host. 10/10 recommend booking his place.
Rafaels apartment was superb clean, and felt right at home, ideal for exploring the city, we did not miss a thing during our stay there, would return definetly.

Joaquim is a caring host who takes great care of his home and made me feel very comfortable and at ease. The bed and bedding are very comfy and no street or car noise so I slept very well even with windows open. He even gave me free coffee and toast for breakfast through his coffee shop just around the corner. The food gave me strength to ride to my next Camino destination. Thank you for being so kind and caring!
small room but perfect for solotravelers, got help/answers quickly and felt really comfortable! extremely cheap for the place and kindness of the host.

We really enjoyed our stay, the place is absolutely beautiful and all the supplies are great. The hosts were lovely and met us at the door as well as being super responsive and helpful to any messages.
The location is perfect as many tourist attractions are just a walk away or a short uber/bus.
I would definitely stay here again, we felt completely at home

Claudia’s was the perfect spot to stay on a weekend in Porto! The apartment had everything you could need for a short or long term stay and was very clean and well kept. The location was very convenient for walking and exploring Porto but very quiet for sleeping. Claudia went above and beyond when there was an issue with the wifi as well, letting us check out late. She’s a superb host!

Fantastic stay. Apartment was super modern, clean and in the best location. Very quiet considering the hustle and bustle outside. Amazing to leave the apartment and be in an area packed with everything you need. Kudos to Luís' co-host Antonio, who helped when we really needed it. All in all, you can't go wrong with this one.
